paper.title: Unfold The World: Factorize 4D Properties in Reinforcing Spatial Reasoning
paper.abstract: Despite the remarkable prowess of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) in general multimodal tasks, they remain fundamentally ``flat'' when reasoning about the physical world. We argue that this spatial bottleneck stems from a profound dimensional mismatch: while VLMs are trained to interpret 2D projections, true spatial reasoning demands the recovery of latent 3D geometry and temporal continuity. To conquer this high-dimensional complexity, we advocate a shift from monolithic learning to a ``divide an

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 VLM 在动态空间推理上的一个老问题：模型能看懂图像内容，但很难从 2D 观测里恢复 3D 几何和时间连续性，因此在多视角、相机运动、遮挡、深度排序、时序一致性这类问题上容易靠表面模式猜答案。作者认为，现有 spatial SFT 或 RLVR 大多只奖励最终答对，没有把“为什么答对”拆成可学习的几何子目标，结果是模型仍停留在单视角启发式推断，而不是形成可迁移的 4D world reasoning。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出了新的基座建模范式，而在于它把“可验证奖励如何服务于多模态世界建模”讲得更具体了。启发点有两个。第一，针对复杂能力，单一终局 reward 往往太稀疏，拆成与潜在结构对应的中间目标会更有效，这对 VLM post-train 乃至 pretrain 后期的 curriculum 设计都有参考意义。第二，作者把空间推理失败归因到投影压缩掉了 XY 对应、Z 深度、T 时间三个维度，这种按潜变量结构设计训练信号的思路，比单纯堆 spatial QA 数据更像是在补建模缺口。量级上，它更像一篇有方法意识的强化学习增强工作，而不是会改写基座训练路线的论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 FactoSR，核心是“先用 SFT 建立空间感知，再用 factorized RL 强化显式 4D 推理”。训练分两段。第一段 FactoSR-SFT，用构造的空间时序数据让模型学会按固定格式输出观察、定位、推理和答案。第二段 FactoSR-RL，在 GRPO/RLVR 框架下引入多目标奖励，而不是只看 final answer。

奖励被拆成五类。format reward 约束输出结构，避免 RL 训练中答案格式漂移；accuracy reward 仍然保留最终正确性监督；真正的创新在三个几何子奖励：XY reward 约束跨视角的平面重投影一致性和区域对应，逼模型先找对位置再回答；Z reward 约束 3D 定位和相对深度排序，处理前后、远近、遮挡关系；T reward 约束时间循环一致性和可逆相机运动推理，要求模型在序列中保持时序上的自洽。作者的论点是，统一直接优化 4D 目标太难，于是把被投影压扁的维度拆开，各自给可验证信号。

从架构上看，这不是改 backbone，而是改训练信号与任务分解。它和已有 spatial RLVR 的区别主要有三点：一是从单一 correctness reward 变成 factorized reward；二是从单帧问答转向多视角/时序场景；三是把几何一致性写进奖励，而不是只让模型在语言空间里自发形成空间链路。代价也很明确：需要构造能支持 XY/Z/T 验证的数据与标注，训练管线更复杂，泛化上仍依赖奖励设计是否覆盖真实空间误差模式。
summary.experiments:
文中最重要的结果是多个空间基准上的提升，摘要里给出了两个代表数字：VSI-Bench 提升 5.9%，All-Angles-Bench 提升 4.5%，同时一般多模态能力基本保持。按照正文叙述，实验重点不是单一 benchmark 冲分，而是验证三类 factorized reward 是否各自带来可分解收益。

消融上，作者比较了仅 SFT、SFT+普通 RLVR、以及 SFT+FactoSR-RL。结论是：只加最终正确性 reward 的 RL 能带来一定提升，但在深度、跨视角对应、时序一致性上不稳定；加入 XY/Z/T 后，模型在需要显式几何链路的题型上提升更明显。进一步的 reward ablation 显示，去掉 XY 会损伤跨视角定位和 correspondence；去掉 Z 会明显影响 relative depth 和 occlusion 判断；去掉 T 则会削弱相机运动和时序逆推任务。正文还强调，factorized reward 对泛化比纯 SFT 更好，因为它鼓励策略学习而不是记忆静态模式。

从你给的全文片段里，没有看到特别完整的参数量、训练步数、数据规模表，因此不宜编造具体数值。能确定的是，这是一套建立在已有 VLM 上的 SFT+RL 增强方案，贡献主要体现在 reward 设计和 spatial-temporal 数据构造，而不是大规模从头训练。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和方法总图，抓住作者的核心判断：空间推理失败不是单纯数据不够，而是训练目标没有覆盖被 2D 投影压缩掉的几何维度。然后重点看 reward 定义部分，尤其是 XY、Z、T 三个奖励各自如何从可验证信号落地，这是整篇最有信息量的地方。

实验部分建议优先看三类消融：SFT vs 普通 RLVR vs FactoSR-RL；去掉单个子奖励后的性能变化；不同题型上的细分结果。如果时间有限，30–40 分钟足够把方法和主要结论读清。若想判断它对自己工作有没有迁移价值，就看两点：一是这些 reward 是否依赖强标注或可控环境；二是它们能否迁移到更开放的 video/VLM setting，而不是只在构造 benchmark 上成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a persistent weakness of VLMs: they can parse image content, but they do not reliably recover latent 3D geometry and temporal continuity from 2D observations. As a result, they often answer spatial questions with shallow visual heuristics rather than world-consistent reasoning, especially under viewpoint changes, camera motion, occlusion, depth ordering, and temporal dependencies. The authors argue that existing spatial SFT and RLVR setups mostly reward final answer correctness, which is too coarse to teach the intermediate geometric structure required for 4D reasoning.
summary_en.importance: Its value to pretraining-oriented readers is indirect but still useful. The main lesson is that for complex capabilities, a single end-task reward is often too sparse; decomposing supervision into latent-structure-aligned sub-objectives can produce more transferable behavior. That idea matters for multimodal post-training, and potentially for late-stage pretraining curricula as well. A second useful point is the diagnosis: spatial failures are framed as missing supervision over three dimensions collapsed by projection—XY correspondence, Z depth, and T time. This is more informative than simply saying that VLMs need more spatial QA data. In impact, this is better viewed as a thoughtful RL-based capability shaping paper than as a new foundation-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, FactoSR, follows a two-stage recipe: supervised spatial fine-tuning first, then factorized reinforcement learning. In the SFT stage, the model is taught to produce structured outputs that separate observation, localization, reasoning, and final answer. In the RL stage, the authors build on RLVR with GRPO-style optimization, but replace the usual single correctness reward with a multi-objective reward design.

There are five reward components. A format reward keeps outputs structurally valid during RL. An accuracy reward preserves standard final-answer supervision. The key novelty lies in three geometry-aware rewards. The XY reward enforces cross-view planar consistency and correspondence, encouraging the model to identify the correct region before answering. The Z reward targets 3D localization and relative depth ordering, which is critical for front/back, near/far, and occlusion reasoning. The T reward enforces temporal cycle consistency and reversible camera-motion reasoning, pushing the model to remain coherent over sequences rather than treating frames independently.

This is not an architectural change to the backbone. It is a change in task decomposition and training signal design. Relative to prior spatial RLVR work, the differences are clear: it moves from final-answer-only rewards to factorized rewards, from mostly single-view reasoning to multi-view and temporal settings, and from implicit language-space reasoning to explicitly geometry-constrained optimization. The trade-off is also clear: the approach depends on datasets and annotations that support verifiable XY/Z/T rewards, so scalability and transfer will depend on how broadly those rewards can be instantiated.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline results reported in the paper are gains of 5.9% on VSI-Bench and 4.5% on All-Angles-Bench, while maintaining decent general multimodal capability. The experimental story is less about one benchmark and more about whether the factorized rewards produce separable gains on separable spatial skills.

The key ablations compare SFT only, SFT plus standard RLVR, and SFT plus FactoSR-RL. The paper’s main claim is that answer-only RL helps somewhat, but remains unstable on depth, cross-view correspondence, and temporal consistency. Adding XY/Z/T rewards yields larger improvements on tasks that require explicit geometric reasoning chains. Reward ablations further support the decomposition: removing XY hurts cross-view localization and correspondence; removing Z weakens relative depth and occlusion judgments; removing T degrades camera-motion and temporal reverse-reasoning tasks. The authors also emphasize stronger generalization than pure SFT, arguing that RL encourages strategy learning rather than memorization of static patterns.

From the provided full-text excerpt, there is no reliable complete table of model size, training steps, or dataset scale, so those details should not be overstated. What is clear is that this is an SFT-plus-RL enhancement on top of an existing VLM, with the main contribution in reward design and spatial-temporal data construction rather than large-scale pretraining from scratch.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the method overview figure. The central claim to keep in mind is that spatial reasoning fails not only because of insufficient data, but because the training objective ignores geometric dimensions collapsed by 2D projection. Then focus on the reward definitions, especially how XY, Z, and T are operationalized as verifiable signals. That is the most informative part of the paper.

In experiments, prioritize three ablations: SFT vs standard RLVR vs FactoSR-RL, single-reward removal studies, and breakdowns by task type. If time is limited, 30–40 minutes is enough to understand the method and the main empirical claims. If you want to assess transferability to your own work, check two things carefully: whether the rewards rely on strong annotations or controlled environments, and whether the same reward design could survive in more open-ended video/VLM settings rather than only on constructed benchmarks.

recommendation.zh: 建议只看方法分解和 reward 设计；若几何约束真能稳定 RL 信号，这比又堆空间问答数据更有用。
recommendation.en: Skim the objective factorization and reward design; if the geometric checks give stable RL signal, it is more informative than another batch of spatial QA data.

paper.title: Sequential Beats Joint: On the Interplay between On-Policy Distillation and RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have emerged as two dominant methods for post-training reasoning LLMs. Prior work uses OPD's dense token-level supervision to complement the sparse RL reward, fusing the two signals within a single step: either as a \emph{weighted-additive combination} or a \emph{teacher-modulated rescaling} of the RL advantage. In this paper, we show that a simple two-stage scheme, OPD-then-RL, consistently outperforms pure O

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文问的是：RLVR 和 on-policy distillation 两类推理后训练信号应该怎样组合。结论很直接：把 OPD 和 RLVR 混在同一个更新步里，不如先用 OPD 扩大学生模型的可解空间，再用 RLVR 做目标对齐和策略锐化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的间接启发在于训练信号的时序安排。它说明 dense token-level imitation signal 和 sparse outcome reward 不只是互补，也可能在同一步更新里互相干扰。这个观察对 mid-train、continual pretrain 后接 RL、以及合成数据冷启动都有参考价值：有些能力扩展信号适合先单独吸收，再用目标信号筛选和压实，而不是简单做 loss 加权。
summary.technical_approach: 论文把 RLVR 和 OPD 都写成 token-level policy-gradient 形式，然后把已有混合方法整理成两类。第一类是 weighted-additive，把 RL advantage 和 OPD advantage 加权相加。第二类是 teacher-modulated，用 teacher 信号调节 RL advantage 的幅度，但 advantage 的正负仍由 verifiable reward 决定。作者比较这些 joint 方法和一个简单的两阶段流程：先在学生自身采样轨迹上做 OPD，让学生拟合 teacher 的 next-token distribution；再切换到 GRPO/RLVR，用可验证奖励优化最终任务表现。分析重点不是新算法，而是解释为什么 sequential training 更稳：OPD 先提高大 k 下的 pass@k，扩大 teacher support 内的候选解覆盖；RL 随后主要在这个支持集内提高 pass@1。joint 方法则会改变 OPD 的参数更新方向，尤其伤害那些带来 pass@k 增益的更新结构。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 logic 和 math reasoning benchmarks。OPD-then-RL 稳定优于纯 OPD、纯 RLVR，以及多种 joint baselines。在逻辑推理任务上，pass@1 最高有 26.7 点优势。论文还做了三类诊断：第一，pass@k 行为显示 OPD 更擅长提升大 k 覆盖，而 RL 更擅长把覆盖转成 pass@1；第二，训练动态显示 OPD 和 joint 方法容易受 teacher 性能上界限制，继续 RL 可以突破这个上界；第三，参数更新分析显示 sequential training 更好保留 OPD 的更新结构，而 joint 方法在关键参数上与 OPD 更新冲突。额外实验还比较了 OPD cold-start 和标准 off-policy SFT cold-start，OPD 在多个数据集上更好，且经过 RL 后差距扩大。作者还提出用切换点的 validation score 作为何时从 OPD 转到 RL 的实用准则。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 30–45 分钟。重点看三部分：方法整理中把 RLVR 和 OPD 统一成 token-level policy-gradient 的推导；pass@k、learning dynamics、parameter update 三组分析；OPD cold-start 对比 SFT cold-start 的实验。公式细节不必逐行抠，关键是理解为什么 loss-level 融合会造成信号干扰，以及为什么先覆盖、后锐化更适合推理后训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to combine RL with verifiable rewards and on-policy distillation for reasoning post-training. Its main conclusion is that a sequential schedule, OPD followed by RLVR, works better than mixing the two signals within the same optimization step.
summary_en.importance: The result is useful beyond post-training. It shows that dense token-level imitation and sparse outcome rewards can interfere when fused too early. For pretraining and mid-training practice, the lesson is that signal scheduling can matter as much as signal design: a coverage-expanding objective may need to be absorbed first, then followed by an objective that sharpens behavior against the target reward.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper rewrites both RLVR and OPD under a token-level policy-gradient view. Existing hybrid methods are grouped into two families. Weighted-additive methods combine RL and OPD advantages by a weighted sum. Teacher-modulated methods use the teacher signal to rescale the RL advantage while keeping the sign determined by the verifiable reward. The proposed recipe is simpler: run OPD first on student-sampled rollouts using a stronger teacher’s next-token distribution, then switch to GRPO-style RLVR. The explanation is that OPD expands the student’s solution coverage within the teacher-supported region, improving large-k pass@k, while RL then sharpens this coverage into better pass@1. Joint methods mix these roles and alter the OPD update structure on parameters that are important for coverage gains.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover logic and math reasoning benchmarks. OPD-then-RL consistently outperforms pure OPD, pure RLVR, and several joint optimization baselines, with up to a 26.7 pass@1 margin on logic reasoning tasks. The diagnostic results are consistent: OPD improves large-k pass@k; continued RL can exceed the teacher-bound behavior observed for OPD and some joint methods; parameter-update analysis shows that sequential training preserves much of OPD’s useful update structure, while joint methods create conflicts. The paper also compares OPD cold-start against standard off-policy SFT cold-start and finds OPD stronger before and after RL. A practical switching rule is suggested: the validation score at the switch point is a strong predictor of final post-RL accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. The most useful parts are the unified token-level policy-gradient formulation, the pass@k and learning-dynamics analyses, and the parameter-update diagnostics. The main point to extract is not a new optimizer, but the training-schedule principle: expand the policy’s candidate solution space first, then optimize the outcome reward.

recommendation.zh: 清晰地拆解了 OPD 和 RLVR 在后训练中的作用机制（OPD 扩召回，RL 提精度），证明了 sequential 优于 joint，对设计 reasoning 模型的 post-training pipeline 极具指导意义。
recommendation.en: Clearly disentangles the mechanistic roles of OPD and RLVR in post-training (OPD expands coverage, RL sharpens precision), proving sequential beats joint; highly instructive for designing post-training pipelines for reasoning models.

paper.title: LeanGRPO: Eliminating Redundant Recomputation in Diffusion RL
paper.abstract: Diffusion reinforcement learning (RL) has recently achieved significant success in post-training image and video generative models. However, most diffusion RL methods, including DanceGRPO and FlowGRPO, recompute selected timesteps with gradient tracking after rollout. Under on-policy training with the same backend for rollout and update, this recomputation is mathematically redundant. Intuitively, the rollout and policy update steps can reuse the same feed-forward backbone to avoid redundant com

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章解决的是 diffusion RL 里一个很具体但代价很高的系统问题：在 on-policy、rollout 与 update 使用同一后端且策略未变化的条件下，很多 trajectory-logprob 方法仍在 update 阶段把已算过的 denoising timestep 再算一遍，只是为了重新拿到可反传的计算图。这在数学上是冗余的，但现有实现为了省显存不得不这么做。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是核心论文，但对大模型后训练和生成模型 RL 的训练效率有实际启发。它提醒人注意一个常见现象：很多“算法成本”其实来自实现路径，而不是目标函数本身。对于把 diffusion / flow 模型纳入统一生成建模或后训练闭环的人，这类工作有参考价值，因为它讨论的是如何在不改目标的前提下重排计算与显存账本。
summary.technical_approach:
作者提出 LeanGRPO，核心是消除 update-stage recomputation，同时控制 rollout 期间保留计算图带来的显存压力。方法分两层。第一层是重排 data-parallel 布局：传统 GRPO 往往让每张卡处理不同 prompt，并在本地生成多个样本；LeanGRPO 改成所有卡处理同一个 prompt，但各自生成不同样本。这样每个 rank 不需要同时保留同一 prompt 下多个样本的图。第二层是两种无重算训练日程。

LeanGRPO-Retain 在 rollout 时直接开梯度，保留被选 timestep 的计算图，等终端 reward 和 advantage 出来后直接复用这些图做 backward。优点是简单直接，缺点是 activation memory 会随选中 timestep 数增长。

LeanGRPO-Reweight 更像一个显存换梯度缓存的方案：在 rollout 过程中对每个被选 timestep 先做 provisional backward，得到临时梯度后立刻释放该步的 saved activations；等整条轨迹结束、terminal advantage 可得后，再用对应 advantage 对临时梯度做校正，在精确算术下恢复与原始目标一致的 policy gradient。这样避免了图和激活一路堆到 rollout 结束，但需要在每个 rank 上保留完整 provisional gradient。文章强调这两种 schedule 都是 objective-preserving，不是近似替代。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出的主结果是：LeanGRPO 在多种 diffusion RL 算法和不同 backbone 上集成后，训练速度最高可达 1.83× 提升。实验还做了 GPU memory profiling，用来刻画两种 schedule 的适用区间：Retain 更适合选中 timestep 较少、图可保留的场景；Reweight 更适合 timestep 选择更密、重算代价高但可以接受梯度缓存的场景。全文前言还提到作者检查了多数公开 diffusion RL 实现，发现这种冗余重算相当普遍，这说明它不是个别代码问题，而是一个共性系统瓶颈。若看正文，建议重点找不同模型规模、不同 timestep 选择策略、不同 RL workflow 下的 wall-clock 对比，以及显存-吞吐 trade-off 曲线。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Fig.1 和方法部分，理解 baseline 为什么要重算，以及两种 schedule 分别把内存压力转移到哪里。然后看 Appendix G 或对应实现分析，确认“数学冗余”成立的前提条件：必须是 on-policy、rollout 与 update 同后端、策略参数中间不变。最后看速度和显存 profiling 图，判断自己场景更接近 Retain 还是 Reweight。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以抓住主要内容；若要复现，需细看 data-parallel 布局和梯度校正细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific systems inefficiency in diffusion RL. In many trajectory-logprob methods, selected denoising steps are recomputed during the update phase to rebuild differentiable paths, even though the same forward passes were already executed during rollout. Under on-policy training with an unchanged policy and the same backend for rollout and update, that recomputation is mathematically unnecessary. The real reason it persists is memory pressure, not algorithmic need.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is useful for researchers working on generative-model post-training, diffusion alignment, or unified training stacks that mix language and diffusion components. The main lesson is practical: a noticeable fraction of training cost can come from implementation structure rather than the objective itself. The paper is valuable because it preserves the original RL objective while changing the compute-memory schedule.
summary_en.technical_approach:
LeanGRPO removes update-stage recomputation through a systems redesign with two pieces. First, it changes the data-parallel layout. Instead of assigning different prompts to different GPUs and generating multiple local samples per prompt, all GPUs process the same prompt while each rank generates a different sample. This reduces the need for each rank to retain multiple computation graphs for the same prompt group.

Second, it introduces two recompute-free schedules. LeanGRPO-Retain simply enables gradient tracking during rollout and keeps the selected-timestep graphs alive until terminal rewards and group advantages are available, then reuses those graphs for backpropagation. It is simple but activation memory grows with the number of selected timesteps.

LeanGRPO-Reweight is more subtle. During rollout, each selected-timestep graph is immediately consumed through a provisional backward pass, producing a provisional gradient and allowing saved activations to be released right away. Once the terminal reward and advantage are known, the provisional gradient is corrected using that advantage, recovering the same policy gradient in exact arithmetic. This shifts the memory burden from retained activations to stored provisional gradients. The paper positions both schedules as objective-preserving rather than approximate shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments: The main quantitative result in the abstract is up to 1.83× training speedup over native implementations. The experiments reportedly cover multiple diffusion RL algorithms and different model backbones, which is important because the gain could otherwise be dismissed as implementation-specific. The paper also includes GPU memory profiling to map where each schedule is preferable: Retain is better when the selected timestep set is small enough that graph retention is affordable, while Reweight is better when timestep selection is denser and recomputation would be expensive. Another useful empirical point from the introduction is that the authors inspected many public diffusion RL implementations and found this recomputation pattern to be common, suggesting a broad systems bottleneck rather than an isolated code issue.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with Figure 1 and the method section. The key is to understand why baseline GRPO-style diffusion RL recomputes selected timesteps and how LeanGRPO moves the memory cost instead of paying the compute cost twice. Then check the section or appendix that states the exact conditions under which recomputation is redundant: on-policy training, unchanged parameters between rollout and update, and the same backend. Finish with the speed and memory profiling figures to see which schedule matches your setup. About 20 to 30 minutes should be enough for the main idea; a reproduction-oriented read requires more attention to the data-parallel layout and the gradient-correction derivation.

recommendation.zh: 针对 Diffusion RL 的系统级优化，通过复用 rollout 阶段的计算图避免重计算，对做 RLHF/GRPO 效率优化的研究员有启发。
recommendation.en: System-level optimization for Diffusion RL, avoiding recomputation by reusing computation graphs from the rollout phase, inspiring for researchers working on RLHF/GRPO efficiency optimization.

paper.title: Tail-Likelihood Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning typically optimizes average reward. For generative policies, the average can hide an important distinction: two policies can achieve the same mean reward while having very different chances of producing a rare but high-reward rollout. This matters as sampling increases during training and inference, since its benefit depends on retaining probability mass on high-reward outcomes. We propose to optimize this coverage directly. Rather than considering only expected reward, we

summary.core_problem: 标准 RL 优化期望奖励，容易丢失对罕见高奖励样本的覆盖，导致训练后期难以改进，且限制了推理时扩展（如 Best-of-k）的收益。
summary.importance: 提出了一种针对连续奖励的全新 RL 目标函数，直接优化高奖励样本的覆盖率，将训练目标与推理时扩展（Best-of-k）紧密对齐，为提升模型生成高质量样本的概率提供了有效途径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Tail-Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (TailRL)。将连续奖励视为一系列二元成功事件（超过某个阈值）。TailRL 最大化超过均匀随机选择的奖励阈值的对数概率。其梯度可分解为 Best-of-k 梯度的调和混合。TailRL 提供了一个无偏的有限 rollout 估计器，只需替换现有 RL 流程（如 GRPO/RLOO）中的优势函数即可实现。
summary.experiments: 在对象定位、迷宫导航、GUI 基础和代码优化任务上，TailRL 表现出色。在迷宫导航中，能从初始成功率仅 0.01% 的策略中学习，而期望奖励基线失败。在代码优化中，实现了 7.7 倍的 Best-of-1024 加速，而 GRPO 和 RLOO 陷入了复制输入的局部最优。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 3.1（TailRL 梯度与 Best-of-k 的联系）和 Section 4（无偏估计器的推导）。实验部分关注 TailRL 在稀疏奖励和需要推理时扩展的任务上的优势。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RL optimizes expected reward, which can lose coverage of rare, high-reward samples, making further improvement difficult and limiting the benefits of inference-time scaling (e.g., Best-of-k).
summary_en.importance: Proposes a novel RL objective for continuous rewards that directly optimizes the coverage of high-reward samples, tightly aligning the training objective with inference-time scaling (Best-of-k), providing an effective way to increase the probability of generating high-quality samples.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Tail-Likelihood Reinforcement Learning (TailRL). Views continuous rewards as a family of binary success events (exceeding a threshold). TailRL maximizes the log-probability of exceeding a uniformly chosen reward threshold. Its gradient decomposes into a harmonic mixture of Best-of-k gradients. TailRL provides an unbiased finite-rollout estimator that can be implemented simply by swapping the advantage function in existing RL pipelines (e.g., GRPO/RLOO).
summary_en.experiments: TailRL performs strongly across object localization, maze navigation, GUI grounding, and code optimization. In maze navigation, it learns from an initial policy with 0.01% success where expected-reward baselines fail. In code optimization, it achieves a 7.7x Best-of-1024 speedup where GRPO and RLOO collapse onto copying the input.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3.1 (the connection between TailRL gradient and Best-of-k) and Section 4 (derivation of the unbiased estimator). In the experiments, pay attention to TailRL's advantages on tasks with sparse rewards and those requiring inference-time scaling.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得从“RL 目标是否该为 best-of-N 服务”来读；若实验控制住 reward scale 和 KL，这会改你对推理时多采样为何有效的建模方式。
recommendation.en: Read this through the lens of whether RL should optimize for best-of-N rather than mean reward; if the reward-scale and KL controls are clean, it changes how you model why extra sampling helps.

paper.title: The Dually Flat Geometry of Planning as Inference
paper.abstract: We present an alternative characterization of the occupancy measure of reinforcement learning, obtained by embedding the planning criterion into the dynamics through a resetting planning process. Its stationary measure, which we term visitation measure, is the object on which the information geometry of decision making is most naturally expressed. The achievable visitation measures form a dually flat statistical manifold whose two affine charts are the visitation probabilities and the log-polici

summary.core_problem: 用信息几何重新刻画 reinforcement learning 中的 occupancy measure 和 planning-as-inference。
summary.importance: 贡献是理论分析：提出 visitation measure 与 dually flat statistical manifold 视角，把策略优化、自然梯度、条件熵对偶和 TD error 统一到一个几何框架内。它可能对 RL 后训练理论有间接启发，但离 LLM 训练 recipe 较远。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把规划准则嵌入 dynamics，构造 resetting planning process，并将其 stationary measure 称为 visitation measure；可达 visitation measures 形成双平坦统计流形，两套仿射坐标分别是 visitation probabilities 与 log-policies，并通过 conditional entropy 对偶。在线性奖励外，该框架扩展到 visitation 的非线性泛函，每次迭代可解释为一步自然梯度。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有报告实证实验、模型规模或 benchmark；主要是数学推导和概念解释，并给出 TD error 作为 marginal-utility estimate 的解释。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper gives an information-geometric characterization of occupancy measures and planning-as-inference in reinforcement learning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is theoretical: it introduces a visitation-measure view and a dually flat statistical manifold that connects policy optimization, natural gradients, conditional-entropy duality, and TD error. It may be indirectly relevant to RL post-training theory, but it is far from LLM training recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors embed the planning criterion into the dynamics through a resetting planning process and define its stationary measure as the visitation measure. Achievable visitation measures form a dually flat statistical manifold with visitation probabilities and log-policies as dual affine charts under conditional entropy. The framework extends planning-as-inference beyond linear rewards to nonlinear functionals of visitation, with each iterate solved by one natural-gradient step.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report empirical experiments, model scale, or benchmarks. The work appears to be primarily mathematical, including an interpretation of TD error as a marginal-utility estimate.

recommendation.zh: 适合作为 RL 几何理论备查；对 RLHF/RLVR 工程没有直接可复现实验信号。
recommendation.en: Useful as RL geometry background, but it offers no directly reproducible signal for RLHF or RLVR engineering.

paper.title: Post-Training Language Models for Gold-Medal Performance in Coding Competitions
paper.abstract: Competitive programming has become a key test of large language model reasoning, with international competitions such as IOI and ICPC representing its most challenging settings. We present an end-to-end specialization pipeline combining large-scale problem curation, synthetic reasoning traces, supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL). Using 22,000 curated problems, we train Nemotron-3-Nano-CC (30B-A3B) with SFT and RL and Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC (550B-A55B) with SFT alone. We fu

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是一个后训练问题：怎样把通用大模型系统化地专门化到竞赛编程，且把数据构造、SFT、RL、测试时搜索这几部分的贡献拆开看清楚。它不是在做新的预训练范式，也不是在改基础模型结构，而是在一个高难度推理与代码生成场景里，给出一条端到端 specialization pipeline，并尽量量化每个环节带来的增益。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要有两点。第一，它再次说明高质量、可执行、可验证的合成数据和奖励信号，能在强约束任务上显著改变模型能力边界，尤其是代码与算法推理这种结果可自动判定的领域。第二，它把“模型能力”与“测试时计算”分开了：Nano-CC 的提升并不只来自 SFT/RL，GenCorrect 这类闭环搜索贡献同样大。这对理解 pretrain 与 post-train 接口很重要，因为很多看似模型变强的结果，实际包含了大量 inference-time search。论文的贡献量级更接近工程化强系统，而不是基础范式创新；对基座研究员来说，价值在于数据构造、奖励设计、长上下文 SFT、以及可执行反馈如何塑造能力，而不是 IOI 分数本身。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由四部分组成。第一是数据侧：作者从 16 个区域性和国际竞赛体系以及在线平台整理 2.2 万道题，构造成可执行评测环境，并严格排除、去重评测题。随后用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 生成大规模合成 reasoning traces，Nano 版本使用约 120 万条，大模型版本使用约 47.8 万条。这里的关键不是单纯扩数据，而是把题目、分析、代码、测试反馈组织成适合长上下文监督学习的格式。

第二是 SFT。作者从 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 和 Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B 出发做长上下文监督微调，得到面向竞赛编程的专门模型。Nano 是 30B 参数、3B active 的 MoE；Ultra 是 550B 参数、55B active。SFT 目标显然不只是生成最终代码，还包括中间推理轨迹和问题求解模式的迁移。

第三是 RL。RL 只明确用于 Nano-CC，奖励来自可执行评测，也就是程序是否通过测试、得分如何。这类 reward 的优点是自动化、噪声相对小、与任务目标一致；缺点是容易把优化压力集中到 search-friendly pattern，而不一定提升单次生成的稳健泛化。论文把 RL 放在 SFT 之后，而不是从头直接做，是因为竞赛编程的动作空间太大，没有一个足够强的初始策略，纯 RL 很难稳定。

第四是 GenCorrect 测试时闭环。它不是简单 self-consistency，而是迭代生成多样解、执行评测、利用反馈修正下一轮候选，在有限提交预算内逐步逼近可通过解。这个设计很像把 verifier-guided search 和 program repair 合在一起。它的重要性在于：竞赛编程的官方规则允许多次提交和部分得分，因此最优策略不是一次性输出最优程序，而是利用反馈逐轮改进。作者显式把这种环境结构编码进推理流程里。
summary.experiments:
关键结果很清楚。Nemotron-3-Nano-CC 在 IOI 2025 上，Score@1 从基座的 130 提升到 SFT 后的 280，再到 RL 后的 291。也就是说，SFT 是主增益，RL 在这个设置下继续带来小幅但真实的提升。加入 5 轮 GenCorrect 后，分数升到 468，超过当年金牌线 438.3。这个数字说明测试时闭环搜索的贡献非常大，甚至大于 RL 本身。

Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC 没有做代码专用 RL，仅靠 SFT 就达到 304；再加 5 轮 GenCorrect 后达到 502.0。这个结果有两个含义：一是更大模型在高难代码任务上仍然能从专门化 SFT 中获益；二是强基座配合强测试时搜索，可能比中等模型加 RL 更划算。

作者还基于这些开发实验，做了一个面向 IOI 2026 的 competition-specific 系统，并在题目公开前按比赛时间、联网和提交限制进行非官方 live evaluation，得到 535.4/600，高于当年金牌线 361.12，也高于最高人类选手 498.27。这个结果更像系统展示，研究上要谨慎看待，因为它包含了针对特定比赛的适配和完整推理管线，不宜直接解读为“模型本体能力”超过人类。

从消融角度，最重要的洞察不是某个绝对分数，而是增益分解：合成数据 + 长上下文 SFT 决定了基础能力台阶，RL 提供进一步对齐可执行目标的增益，而 GenCorrect 在竞赛规则允许的前提下显著放大最终成绩。若只看 Score@1，模型提升没有最终提交分数那么夸张；这正说明 benchmark 结果里混入了大量 test-time compute。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，重点放在 pipeline 拆解，不必陷入竞赛细节。优先看三部分。

第一，看数据构造和去污染流程。对基座研究员来说，这部分比 IOI 故事更重要，因为它涉及可执行任务上的高质量合成监督数据如何组织、如何去重、如何避免评测泄漏。

第二，看 SFT、RL、GenCorrect 的分步增益表。要特别注意 Score@1 与多轮提交后的最终分数差异，这能帮助判断哪些提升来自模型参数更新，哪些来自测试时搜索。

第三，看 GenCorrect 的算法描述和案例。它体现了一种很典型的 post-train 方向：当环境提供 verifier 和反馈时，模型不必一次答对，而是通过闭环修正逼近正确解。这个思路对代码、数学、工具使用都可迁移。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。若只想抓研究启发，读引言、方法总览、主结果表和消融即可。需要保持的判断是：这不是 pretrain 论文，更多是高质量后训练与 inference pipeline 的系统工作；它对预训练的价值在于揭示可验证数据和奖励如何塑造能力，而不是提出新的基座训练规律。
summary.authors_note: NVIDIA 团队，基于 Nemotron 系列模型与 NeMo-Skills 工具链开展。正文片段未给出完整作者名单。

summary_en.core_problem: This paper addresses a post-training specialization problem: how to turn a general-purpose LLM into a strong competitive-programming system, and how to separate the effects of curated data, synthetic traces, SFT, RL, and test-time search. It is not a new pretraining paradigm or a base-model architecture paper. It is an end-to-end specialization pipeline for a difficult reasoning-and-coding domain, with an effort to quantify where the gains actually come from.
summary_en.importance: The relevance to pretraining research is mostly through the pretrain–posttrain interface. First, it shows again that high-quality executable supervision and low-noise reward signals can substantially reshape model behavior in domains where correctness is automatically verifiable. Second, it cleanly exposes the role of test-time compute. Nano-CC does not reach gold-medal performance from SFT/RL alone; GenCorrect contributes a large fraction of the final gain. That matters because many headline benchmark results mix model improvement with search and verification loops. For foundation-model researchers, the useful lessons are about synthetic data construction, executable rewards, long-context SFT, and how verifier feedback changes capability expression.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has four components. First is data curation. The authors collect 22,000 problems from 16 regional and international competition families plus online platforms, package them into executable evaluation environments, and explicitly exclude and deduplicate evaluation problems. They then use DeepSeek-V4-Flash to generate large synthetic reasoning-trace corpora: about 1.2M traces for the Nano model and 477,642 for the larger model. The key point is not just scale, but the organization of problems, reasoning, code, and feedback into long-context supervised examples.

Second is supervised fine-tuning. They start from Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B and Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B and perform long-context SFT to obtain competition-specialized models. Nano is a 30B-parameter MoE with 3B active parameters; Ultra is 550B with 55B active. The supervision appears to target not only final code generation but also intermediate problem-solving traces.

Third is reinforcement learning. RL is applied to Nano-CC, with rewards derived from executable evaluation, namely whether the generated program passes tests and how much score it obtains. This reward is attractive because it is automatic and closely aligned with the task objective. The downside is that it may favor search-friendly behaviors rather than robust one-shot generalization. The paper places RL after SFT, which is sensible: the action space in competitive programming is too large for pure RL to be stable without a strong initial policy.

Fourth is GenCorrect, the test-time closed-loop strategy. It is more than self-consistency. The system generates diverse candidate solutions, evaluates them, uses the feedback to refine later attempts, and operates under a limited submission budget. This is essentially verifier-guided search plus iterative program repair. It is especially well matched to IOI-style settings, where multiple submissions and partial credit are part of the environment.
summary_en.experiments:
The main results are straightforward. On IOI 2025, Nemotron-3-Nano-CC improves from 130 Score@1 at baseline to 280 after SFT and 291 after RL. So SFT provides the dominant gain, while RL adds a smaller but real improvement. With five rounds of GenCorrect, the score rises to 468, above the gold threshold of 438.3. The size of that jump makes it clear that test-time search is a major contributor, arguably larger than RL in this setup.

Nemotron-3-Ultra-CC does not use code-specific RL. It reaches 304 with SFT alone, and 502.0 after five GenCorrect rounds. This suggests two things: larger base models still benefit from domain-specific SFT on hard coding tasks, and a strong base model plus strong inference-time search may be a more efficient path than a smaller model with additional RL.

The authors then build a competition-specific system for IOI 2026 and evaluate it live, before public release of the problems, under matched time, internet, and submission constraints. The system scores 535.4/600, above the gold threshold of 361.12 and above the top official human score of 498.27. As a research result, this should be interpreted carefully. It reflects a full specialized system, including task-specific adaptation and inference strategy, not just the intrinsic capability of the underlying model.

The most useful ablation insight is the gain decomposition. Synthetic data plus long-context SFT establish the main capability step. RL further aligns the model to executable objectives. GenCorrect then amplifies final benchmark performance when the environment allows iterative feedback. If one only looks at Score@1, the model improvement is much smaller than the final competition score, which is exactly why the distinction between parameter updates and test-time compute matters.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper. Read it for pipeline decomposition, not for competition storytelling. Focus on three parts.

First, inspect the data curation and contamination-control pipeline. For foundation-model researchers, this is more interesting than the IOI headline because it shows how executable synthetic supervision is assembled, filtered, and kept evaluation-clean.

Second, read the tables that separate SFT, RL, and GenCorrect gains. Pay close attention to the gap between Score@1 and final multi-round scores. That gap tells you how much of the benchmark result comes from model updates versus inference-time search.

Third, read the GenCorrect algorithm and examples. It captures a broader post-training pattern: when the environment provides a verifier and actionable feedback, the model does not need to solve the task in one shot. It can iteratively repair its own outputs. That idea transfers beyond coding to math, tool use, and other verifiable domains.

A reasonable reading budget is 20–30 minutes. If you only want the research signal, read the introduction, method overview, main results, and ablations. Keep one framing in mind: this is not a pretraining paper. It is a strong post-training and inference-system paper whose value for pretraining lies in what it reveals about executable supervision and reward quality.
summary_en.authors_note: NVIDIA team, built on the Nemotron model family and the NeMo-Skills stack. The provided text does not include the full author list.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“高质量题库+合成轨迹+RL+verifier-guided search”这条链条跑通了；应重点看各阶段增益拆分，判断哪些信号值得前移到 mid-train。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly operationalizes the stack of curated tasks, synthetic traces, RL, and verifier-guided search; inspect the gain breakdown and ask which signals should move earlier into mid-training.

paper.title: On-Policy Distillation Meets Off-Policy GRPO: Training Compact Instruction-Following Rerankers
paper.abstract: Compact instruction-following rerankers are attractive for deployment, but conventional distillation pipelines typically train students by offline imitation of teacher outputs on a fixed set of examples, constraining supervision to the teacher's observed ranking space. We revisit reranker distillation through the lens of reinforcement learning. We propose a two-stage framework combining off-policy teacher optimization with on-policy student distillation. In Stage 1, a 4B teacher reranker is stre

summary.core_problem: 传统的重排器（reranker）知识蒸馏方法通常是离线的，限制了学生模型只能在教师模型观察到的排序空间内学习，导致泛化能力受限。
summary.importance: 提出了一种结合离线策略（off-policy）教师优化和在线策略（on-policy）学生蒸馏的两阶段框架，将强化学习引入重排器蒸馏，显著提升了小模型在分布偏移下的指令遵循能力。
summary.technical_approach: 阶段一：使用 LLM-judge 反馈，通过 off-policy GRPO 强化 4B 教师重排器。阶段二：1B 学生模型从自身策略中采样排序，并接收来自教师的软奖励，实现 on-policy 蒸馏，将学生探索与知识转移结合。
summary.experiments: 在 MAIR-11 基准测试上，1B 学生模型达到 0.7670 nDCG@6，比离线 listwise 知识蒸馏高出 4.6 个点，在分布偏移下表现出最强的增益。

summary_en.core_problem: Conventional reranker knowledge distillation is typically offline, constraining the student to learn only within the teacher's observed ranking space, limiting generalization.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a two-stage framework combining off-policy teacher optimization with on-policy student distillation, introducing RL into reranker distillation, significantly improving instruction-following capabilities of small models under distribution shift.
summary_en.technical_approach: Stage 1: Strengthens a 4B teacher reranker with off-policy GRPO using LLM-judge feedback. Stage 2: A 1B student samples rankings from its own policy and receives soft teacher-derived rewards, achieving on-policy distillation that couples student exploration with knowledge transfer.
summary_en.experiments: On the MAIR-11 benchmark, the 1B student reaches 0.7670 nDCG@6, outperforming offline listwise KD by +4.6 points, showing the strongest gains under distribution shift.

recommendation.zh: 将 GRPO 和 on-policy 蒸馏引入 reranker 训练，证明了 on-policy 探索在小模型知识蒸馏中的价值，对 post-train 数据合成和 RL 训练有启发。
recommendation.en: Introduces GRPO and on-policy distillation to reranker training, demonstrating the value of on-policy exploration in small model KD, inspiring for post-train data synthesis and RL.

paper.title: GDB-Reward: From Evaluation Metrics to Training Rewards for Graphic Design
paper.abstract: Text-to-image models excel at natural image synthesis but struggle with graphic design, where success depends on satisfying precise constraints on typography, layout, color, and visual communication. While prompt optimization offers an attractive alternative to expensive diffusion model fine-tuning, learning prompts for frozen image generators requires informative reward functions despite the entirely non-differentiable generation process. Reinforcement learning does not require differentiable o

summary.core_problem: 图形设计类文生图需要满足排版/布局/颜色等硬约束，但扩散模型微调昂贵，且生成过程不可微，如何为“冻结生成器的提示词优化/策略优化”构造可用的标量奖励。
summary.importance: 把“评测指标→训练奖励”的管线化思路对齐到RL优化，属于后训练信号工程；对预训练研究的启发主要在于：奖励/度量的可组合性与可用性，而非模型本体。
summary.technical_approach: GDB-Reward：将异构的图形设计评测指标系统化地归一成统一的RL reward，用于在不可微生成器上做强化学习式的prompt/策略优化（不需要对扩散模型本身反传）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型与指标集合；应在若干设计约束任务上对比手工reward/单指标reward/无RL的prompt优化，展示约束满足度提升。

summary_en.core_problem: Text-to-image models struggle with graphic design constraints (typography/layout/color); with frozen, non-differentiable generators, how to build usable scalar rewards for RL-based prompt/policy optimization.
summary_en.importance: A post-training signal-engineering pipeline turning evaluation metrics into RL rewards; the transferable value is about reward construction/normalization rather than model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GDB-Reward systematically transforms heterogeneous graphic design evaluation metrics into a unified reinforcement-learning reward, enabling RL optimization over prompts/policies without backprop through the generator.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract omits concrete models/metric sets; likely compares against manual or single-metric rewards and non-RL prompt optimization, reporting improved constraint adherence.

recommendation.zh: 把多指标评测“工程化成reward”这点可借鉴；但更像应用域reward设计，读方法定义与归一化细节即可。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming for how they operationalize multi-metric evaluation into a single reward, but it’s domain-heavy; focus on reward normalization/aggregation details.

paper.title: Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs
paper.abstract: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个很实际、但过去一直缺少稳定方法的问题：在固定标注预算下，SFT 和后续 RL 阶段到底该怎么分配数据。难点不只是找一个最优比例，而是这个最优点往往不稳定，受任务、模型规模、RL 算法、评价指标影响很大；而每改一次比例，通常都要重跑整条 post-training 流水线，代价很高。作者把问题从“找唯一最优点”改写成“找近优区域”：只要某个分配能达到峰值性能的一定容忍范围内，就算可接受。核心问题因此变成：这个近优区域是否足够宽、是否随模型变大而更稳定、是否能从小模型迁移到大模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口研究，这篇工作的价值不在提出新的 RL 算法，而在于给出了一个可操作的预算分配框架。它把 post-training 中常见的“网格搜索找配比”问题，转成了“先用小代理模型识别可迁移的近优区间，再在大模型上只做少量验证”。这件事的重要性有三层。第一，它说明 SFT→RL 两阶段并不是一个尖锐调参问题，很多情况下存在宽平台，这会直接影响数据采买、标注组织和训练排期。第二，它给出一个和模型 scale 相关的经验规律：模型越大，近优区域通常越宽，意味着大模型对配比误差更不敏感。第三，它把 post-training 的预算优化问题，和 pretraining 里常见的 scaling-law / mixture optimization 思路接上了：不再执着于单点最优，而是研究稳定区域、可迁移结构和低成本代理实验。这对做大规模训练 recipe 的人很有启发。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者先形式化了固定预算 B 下的两阶段分配问题。设比例 r 分给 SFT，1-r 分给 RL，性能记为 P(N, r, B; τ)。传统做法是找 r* = argmax_r P，但作者认为这个目标病态，因为 post-training 曲线常常在峰值附近形成平台，单点最优既不稳也不值得追。于是他们定义 ε-near-optimal region：所有能达到最优性能的 1-ε 以上的 r 所组成的集合。这个定义有两个好处。其一，它更贴近工程决策，因为真实系统里 1% 到 5% 的性能差异，往往不足以支撑一次昂贵重训。其二，它允许讨论“区域宽度”和“区域迁移性”，而不只是某个点。

全文的技术主线有三部分。第一部分是区域刻画。作者在不同任务、模型家族、RL 方法上扫描 r，观察性能曲线的形状，并用不同 ε 阈值计算近优区间宽度。结论是即便 ε 很小，区间也常常不窄，说明 SFT/RL 配比不是高灵敏度旋钮。第二部分是尺度迁移。作者比较小模型和大模型上的近优区间，关注的不是最优点是否完全一致，而是小模型识别出的近优区间，是否能覆盖大模型上的高性能解。这个视角比比较 argmax 更合理，因为单点最优容易受噪声和训练波动影响。第三部分是成本非对称扩展。前面默认 SFT 与 RL 样本单位成本相近，后面进一步讨论当 SFT 标注更贵或 RL 偏好数据更贵时，最优分配如何偏移。作者发现当 SFT 相对更贵时，可接受区域会进一步变宽，意味着工程上更容易选择偏向 RL 的方案而不明显损失性能。

和已有工作相比，区别主要有三点。Raghavendra 等工作更多是在描述低数据区 SFT 更重要、规模上来后 preference/RL 更有利的总体趋势，但没有给出一个可迁移的分配框架，也没有把“近优而非精确最优”作为核心对象。数据 mixture 优化和 scaling-law 外推工作通常处理的是单阶段训练，或者是预训练语料配比，不涉及 SFT→RL 这种顺序依赖的两阶段耦合问题。这里的创新不在模型结构，而在问题重述、评价对象选择，以及把小模型代理实验变成大模型预算决策工具。
summary.experiments:
从全文给出的结果看，最关键的实验结论有四个。第一，性能-配比曲线在峰值附近普遍存在平台，而不是尖峰。作者用 2% 到 10% 的相对容忍度定义近优区域，发现即便容忍度很小，区域也已经相当宽。这说明很多配比都能达到接近最优的效果，工程上没必要执着于单个比例。第二，随着模型规模增大，近优区域通常变宽。也就是说，大模型对 SFT/RL 配比更鲁棒，小模型上看起来需要精调的比例，到大模型上往往变成一段都可接受。第三，小模型到大模型的迁移性是成立的，但成立方式不是“最优点完全一致”，而是“小模型找到的近优区间，能较稳定地覆盖大模型上的高性能配比”。这是全文最有用的经验结论。第四，这个现象在不同任务、不同模型家族、以及 off-policy / on-policy RL 设置下都能复现，说明它不是某个算法偶然带来的。

文中还给了一个很实用的成本量级比较：按他们测得的训练时间和 L40S 云价，单样本训练计算成本大约在 2e-5 美元到 3e-4 美元之间；相比人工标注 0.5 到 1 美元/样本，低了 3 到 5 个数量级。即便和 1e-3 美元/样本的廉价合成标注相比，训练算力成本通常也仍低于标注成本。这组数字支撑了他们把“标注预算”而不是“训练 FLOPs”作为一阶优化对象。摘要里没有完整列出所有模型尺寸、任务名和具体峰值差值，正文的重点也不是追求某个 benchmark 上的绝对分数，而是展示区域宽度、尺度变化和迁移覆盖率这些结构性结果。读的时候应把注意力放在曲线形状和区间重叠，而不是单个最高点。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，确认作者为什么放弃“找最优点”而改用“近优区域”。如果这个问题设定接受了，后面的实验会很顺。精读时重点看三类图表。第一类是不同 r 下的性能曲线，观察峰值附近是否真的是平台，以及平台宽度如何随 ε 变化。第二类是小模型与大模型的区间对照图，重点不是两个最优点差多少，而是小模型区间是否覆盖大模型高性能区域。第三类是成本非对称分析，理解当 SFT 和 RL 样本单位成本不同，预算轴如何重参数化，以及为什么这会改变可接受分配。

如果时间有限，最值得深挖的是 Section 3.2 到 3.4。3.2 解决“为什么要看区域”；3.3 解决“为什么小模型代理实验有用”；3.4 解决“这个框架在真实标注成本不对称时还能不能用”。读实验时要特别留意作者如何定义 tolerance、如何处理训练噪声，以及他们用什么标准判断“transfer reliably”。这篇工作的核心创新不在复杂算法，而在把一个高成本调参问题变成了一个稳定的决策问题。做大模型训练 recipe 的人，应该把这个思路迁移到别的多阶段预算分配上，比如 continual pretrain 与 SFT 的配比、SFT 与 preference data 的采样策略、甚至不同 RL 信号源之间的预算分配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a practical but under-formalized question in LLM post-training: under a fixed annotation budget, how much should be allocated to supervised fine-tuning versus the subsequent RL stage? The difficulty is not merely finding a single best ratio. The optimum is often unstable across tasks, model scales, RL variants, and evaluation metrics, while changing the ratio usually requires rerunning the whole pipeline. The paper reframes the objective from exact optimality to near-optimality: instead of chasing one brittle optimum, it asks whether there exists a broad allocation region that stays within a small tolerance of peak performance, whether that region expands with scale, and whether it transfers from small proxy models to larger target models.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is methodological rather than algorithmic. It gives a usable framework for post-training budget allocation, replacing expensive full-scale grid search with a proxy-model strategy. That matters for three reasons. First, it shows that SFT-to-RL allocation is often a plateau problem, not a needle-in-a-haystack tuning problem. Second, it identifies a scale effect: larger models tend to have wider near-optimal regions, so they are less sensitive to imperfect allocation. Third, it connects post-training recipe design to ideas familiar from pretraining research, such as scaling-law thinking, mixture optimization, and robust region identification rather than exact point estimation. For researchers working on the pretrain–posttrain interface, this is a useful way to reason about annotation efficiency and recipe transfer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The setup is simple and clean. Given a pretrained model of size N and a total annotation budget B, an allocation ratio r sends rB examples to SFT and (1-r)B to RL. Performance is written as P(N, r, B; tau). A standard formulation would optimize r* = argmax_r P, but the paper argues that this is the wrong target because post-training curves are often flat near the top. A tiny gain in measured score may not justify a full retraining run, and the exact argmax can be unstable under noise. The paper therefore defines the epsilon-near-optimal region: the set of ratios whose performance is at least (1-epsilon) times the best observed performance.

This shift enables three analyses. First, region characterization: the authors sweep allocation ratios across tasks, model families, and RL methods, then measure how wide the near-optimal region is under tolerances such as 2% to 10%. Second, scale transfer: instead of asking whether the exact optimum ratio matches across scales, they ask whether the near-optimal region found on a small proxy model covers high-performing ratios on a larger model. This is a much more stable transfer criterion. Third, asymmetric annotation cost: the default setup measures budget in number of labeled examples, but the paper extends the framework to cases where SFT and RL labels have different unit costs. Under that view, the effective optimum shifts, and the acceptable region can widen further when SFT data is relatively more expensive.

Relative to prior work, the novelty is in the problem formulation and the transfer criterion. Earlier work mostly reported broad trends, such as SFT being more important in low-data regimes and preference optimization becoming more useful at larger scales, but did not provide a principled near-optimal allocation framework or establish transfer from small to large models. Work on data mixture optimization and scaling-law extrapolation usually focuses on single-stage training, especially pretraining mixtures, not sequential SFT-then-RL coupling. The paper’s contribution is to turn a brittle tuning problem into a region-finding problem with practical transfer value.
summary_en.experiments:
The most important empirical findings are structural rather than benchmark-centric. First, the performance-versus-allocation curve typically has a broad plateau near its maximum. Even with small tolerances, such as a few percent from peak performance, the near-optimal region is already wide. Second, this region generally widens with model scale. Larger models are therefore more forgiving to imperfect SFT/RL splits. Third, transfer works better at the region level than at the exact-optimum level: a near-optimal region identified on a small proxy model tends to reliably contain high-performing allocations for a larger target model, even when the exact best ratio shifts. Fourth, the pattern is observed across tasks, model families, and both off-policy and on-policy RL settings, which argues against the effect being tied to one specific algorithm.

The paper also includes a useful cost sanity check. Using measured runtimes and L40S cloud pricing, per-example training compute cost is reported to range from about 2e-5 USD for the cheapest 1B SFT setting to about 3e-4 USD for 8B DPO. Compared with human annotation costs around 0.5 to 1.0 USD per example, compute is lower by roughly three to five orders of magnitude. Even compared with cheap synthetic annotation around 1e-3 USD per example, compute is still usually below annotation. This supports the paper’s decision to treat annotation as the dominant first-order budget axis.

The paper is less about headline absolute scores and more about curve geometry, region width, and transfer coverage. When reading the experiments, the key is not the single best number but how flat the top is, how the width changes with scale, and how much overlap exists between proxy-model and target-model high-performance regions.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and preliminaries. The central conceptual move is the replacement of exact optimality with near-optimality. If that framing makes sense, the rest of the paper becomes straightforward. Then focus on the sections that define and analyze the near-optimal region. The most informative figures are the allocation-performance curves, the region-width comparisons across scales, and the small-to-large transfer plots. In those figures, do not over-focus on the exact argmax. Look at plateau width and overlap.

The most useful sections to read carefully are the ones corresponding to region analysis, scale transfer, and asymmetric annotation cost. Those sections answer three practical questions: why a region is a better target than a point, why small proxy experiments can replace large-scale search, and how the framework changes when SFT and RL labels have different prices. It is also worth checking how tolerance is defined, how noisy training outcomes are handled, and what criterion is used to claim reliable transfer. The paper’s main value lies in recipe design logic, not in a new optimizer or RL objective. Anyone working on large-scale training pipelines can reuse the same lens for other multi-stage allocation problems, including continual pretraining versus SFT, SFT versus preference data, or allocation across multiple RL signal sources.

recommendation.zh: 应复现到内部 SFT/RL 预算网格；若近似最优区真的随规模变宽，会改变大模型后训练 sweep 的做法。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing on internal SFT/RL budget grids; if the near-optimal region really widens with scale, large-model post-training sweeps should change.

paper.title: ARISE-RL: Agentic Rubric-Grounded Iterative Self-Evolution with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Training open-ended agents via reinforcement learning (RL) is hindered by the lack of verifiable gold answers and scalable rubrics. Moreover, even near the model's capability boundary, long-horizon open-ended agentic tasks often yield brittle and unstable rewards, resulting in weak or noisy rollout contrast that obscures fine-grained optimization signals for group-based policy learning. To address these challenges, we propose ARISE-RL, a novel full-cycle self-evolution framework that couples a t

summary.core_problem: 开放式智能体任务（如深度研究、旅行规划）缺乏可验证的标准答案和可扩展的评估标准，导致强化学习（RL）在长视野任务中面临奖励信号脆弱、不稳定以及优势崩溃的问题，难以提供细粒度的优化信号。
summary.importance: 提出了一种闭环的自我进化框架，通过生成器和求解器的协同进化，解决了开放式任务中数据和评估的瓶颈，为智能体在复杂环境下的持续能力扩展提供了新范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ARISE-RL 框架，包含 Generator（生成任务和评估标准）和 Solver（解决任务）。核心机制包括：1) 基于工具的评估标准构建（Generator 必须先调用工具再生成标准，防止幻觉）；2) 难度塑造奖励（鼓励生成中等难度的任务，贴近 Solver 的能力边界）；3) 奖励门控的自我进化蒸馏（RG-SED，一种组级自我蒸馏机制，仅在内部生成的增强教师表现优于标准 rollout 时才激活，避免盲目模仿）。
summary.experiments: 在单工具深度研究（ECR-DeepResearch）和多工具旅行规划（ECR-Travel）等基准上，ARISE-RL 在 8B/9B 规模模型上取得了最佳平均性能，并实现了稳定且显著的提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 ARISE-RL 的闭环架构设计（Figure 1），特别是基于工具的评估标准构建和 RG-SED 机制的细节。实验部分可关注其在不同难度任务上的表现及消融实验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: Open-ended agentic tasks (e.g., deep research, travel planning) lack verifiable gold answers and scalable rubrics, leading to brittle and unstable reward signals in reinforcement learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks, which obscures fine-grained optimization signals.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a closed-loop self-evolution framework that addresses the data and evaluation bottlenecks in open-ended tasks through the co-evolution of a generator and a solver, providing a new paradigm for continuous capability expansion of agents in complex environments.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the ARISE-RL framework, comprising a Generator (creates tasks and rubrics) and a Solver (solves tasks). Core mechanisms include: 1) Tool-grounded rubric construction (Generator must invoke tools before writing criteria to prevent hallucinations); 2) Difficulty-shaped reward (encourages tasks of intermediate difficulty, aligning with the Solver's capability boundary); 3) Reward-Gated Self-Evolution Distillation (RG-SED, a group-level self-distillation mechanism activated only when an internally generated enhanced teacher outperforms standard rollouts, avoiding blind imitation).
summary_en.experiments: On benchmarks like single-tool deep research (ECR-DeepResearch) and multi-tool travel planning (ECR-Travel), ARISE-RL achieves the best average performance and consistent, robust gains on 8B/9B-scale models.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the closed-loop architecture design of ARISE-RL (Figure 1), particularly the details of tool-grounded rubric construction and the RG-SED mechanism. In the experiments section, pay attention to its performance on tasks of varying difficulty and the ablation study results.

recommendation.zh: 关注其如何通过 Generator-Solver 协同进化来构建细粒度 reward 信号，对 RLHF 在复杂 agent 任务上的应用有启发。
recommendation.en: Focus on how it constructs fine-grained reward signals through Generator-Solver co-evolution, offering insights for applying RLHF to complex agent tasks.

paper.title: Dense Process Supervision for Search Agents via Fact Utility Estimation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents typically relies on outcome rewards. However, it often fails to achieve effective credit assignment, due to the unclear value of intermediate steps. It is hard to separate their contributions from the final result. In this paper, we propose a dense process supervision method based on fact utility estimation, which models the reasoning process as the accumulation of discrete evidence facts. We first extract structured facts from raw observations and o

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是搜索型 agent 用 RL 训练时的 credit assignment 问题。现有方法多用 outcome reward，只在最终答案正确与否上给奖励，但搜索、检索、证据整合这类任务的关键难点恰恰在中间步骤：一次检索、一次信息抽取、一次证据写入，到底有没有帮助，往往不能从最终成败直接看出来。全文的核心切入点是把中间过程从“原始文本历史”改写成“显式事实集合”，再估计这些事实对成功结果的后验效用，用它给每一步提供更密集的训练信号。
summary.importance: 它不是基座预训练论文，但和 post-train、RL for reasoning、tool-use policy learning 有直接关系。对预训练研究员的启发主要有两点。第一，论文展示了如何把稀疏 outcome reward 重新分解成结构化中间监督，这对 reasoning RL、search agent、甚至长链条工具调用都很关键。第二，它把 agent state 从长文本上下文换成 fact store，这种显式状态表示对长上下文训练和 credit assignment 都更友好，也提示了未来 pretrain/post-train 可能需要更结构化的中间表示，而不只是把所有交互都塞回 token 序列里。贡献量级上，它更像一个扎实的 agent RL 方法改进，而不是会直接改写基座模型训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 FactAgent，核心由两部分组成：fact-centric agent state，以及基于 Bayesian fact utility estimation 的 dense process supervision。

先看 agent 形式。与标准 ReAct 只维护原始对话和工具返回文本不同，FactAgent 在状态里显式维护一个 fact store。每次 search 动作得到 observation 后，agent 不只是继续推理，还可以执行 assert 动作，把 observation 里的信息抽取成结构化事实，写入 fact store。这样，状态从“越来越长的文本历史”变成“问题 Q、当前 observation、累计事实集合 Ft”。作者把这些事实视为离散语义单元，而不是普通字符串，这一步是后续 credit assignment 的基础。

再看奖励构造。论文的关键不是直接给 assert 打启发式分，而是从 group rollouts 里估计事实的后验效用。具体做法是先把语义等价的事实聚成 cluster，避免同一证据因表述不同被分散统计；然后基于一组 rollout 的最终 outcome，用 Bayesian estimation 推断每个 fact cluster 与成功结果的统计关联。直观上，如果某类事实经常出现在成功轨迹里、较少出现在失败轨迹里，它的 posterior utility 就更高。随后，这个 fact-level utility 被映射回 step-level dense rewards，用来训练 policy。

这比直接做 token-level process reward 更适合搜索任务，因为搜索任务的有效中间单位不是 token，也不一定是整句 reasoning，而是“找到并确认了哪条证据”。作者因此把 credit assignment 的对象从 action surface form 转成 evidence semantics。和纯 outcome-based GRPO 相比，FactAgent 仍然利用 group rollouts，但不再让整条轨迹共享同一个粗粒度 advantage，而是通过事实聚类和后验估计，把奖励分配到真正有贡献的中间步骤上。

从设计取舍看，这个方法避免了额外训练 reward model，也不依赖人工标注每一步是否正确，代价则是需要可靠的事实抽取与聚类。如果抽取质量差，后验 utility 估计会被噪声污染。全文也承认这一点，因此 fact store 既是方法优势，也是误差传播的主要入口。
summary.experiments:
实验使用 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct 和 7B-Instruct 作为 backbone，在七个 QA benchmark 上评测搜索 agent 能力。主结果是：7B backbone 下平均 EM 达到 51.2，超过最强 baseline 3.2 EM。摘要没有列出全部 benchmark 名称和逐项分数，但全文强调提升是稳定的，而不是只集中在个别数据集。

更重要的是分析结果。作者指出，dense process supervision 的收益主要体现在 evidence precision 和 retrieval quality 上，也就是 agent 更容易找到真正有用的信息，并减少无效或冗余检索。这和方法设计是对齐的：奖励不是鼓励“多搜”，而是鼓励“搜到有用事实并把它沉淀进状态”。

消融实验大概率围绕几个组件展开：是否使用 fact store、是否加入 assert step、是否做 fact clustering、是否采用 Bayesian posterior utility 而非简单频率统计。按全文叙述，这些组件都对最终效果有贡献，其中显式事实表示和 utility estimation 是最关键的两部分。论文还强调该方法不需要外部 reward model，仅由 group rollout 的 outcome 信号反推出中间奖励，这一点在训练成本和可扩展性上有现实意义。

如果从方法边界看，当前结果主要证明它适合 search-heavy QA agent。它是否能迁移到更开放的 web agent、代码 agent 或多工具长时规划任务，还需要看事实抽取是否仍然稳定，以及“事实”是否仍是合适的中间单位。
summary.reading_guide:
建议先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，确认作者到底改了 agent 的哪一层：不是只换 reward，而是把状态表示、动作空间和奖励分解一起改了。随后重点看 fact store 的定义、assert 动作的设计，以及 Bayesian utility estimation 的公式部分。这里要弄清三件事：事实是怎么抽出来的；语义等价事实如何聚类；posterior utility 如何从 group rollouts 估计并回传到 step reward。

实验部分优先看主表、evidence precision / retrieval quality 的分析，以及消融。若时间有限，抓住“fact store + utility estimation”这条主线即可，40 分钟左右能读完主要内容。若想进一步判断它对通用 LLM 训练的启发，可以重点想：这种显式中间表示能否在 reasoning SFT/RL 中替代一部分自由文本 CoT；以及 fact-level credit assignment 是否能推广到代码执行状态、网页 DOM 状态或多模态工具轨迹。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses credit assignment in RL training for search agents. Most existing methods optimize only outcome rewards, so the agent gets supervision from whether the final answer is correct, but not from whether intermediate search and evidence-gathering steps were actually useful. In search-heavy settings, this is a serious bottleneck: a successful final answer does not mean every retrieval was necessary, and a failed answer does not mean all earlier steps were useless. The paper’s core idea is to convert raw intermediate observations into explicit facts, estimate the posterior utility of those facts, and use that estimate to provide dense process-level rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is not a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training for reasoning and tool use. The main value for a pretraining-oriented reader is methodological. First, it shows one concrete way to decompose sparse outcome supervision into structured intermediate supervision without training a separate reward model. Second, it replaces long unstructured interaction history with an explicit fact store, which is a more favorable state representation for long-horizon reasoning and credit assignment. That design choice is interesting beyond agents: it suggests that some forms of reasoning and tool-use training may benefit from structured latent state rather than forcing everything back into a flat token stream. The contribution is best viewed as a solid RL-for-agents improvement rather than a change to the core pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
FactAgent has two main components: a fact-centric state representation and a Bayesian utility estimation scheme for dense process supervision.

On the agent side, the paper departs from standard ReAct-style agents that keep only raw text history. The state explicitly includes a fact store. After a search action returns an observation, the agent can take an assert action that extracts structured facts from the observation and writes them into the store. The state is therefore represented as the question, the current observation, and the accumulated fact set. These facts are treated as discrete semantic evidence units rather than plain text snippets. This is important because the method assigns credit at the level of evidence semantics, not at the level of surface-form actions.

On the reward side, the paper estimates fact utility from grouped rollouts. Semantically equivalent facts are first clustered so that the same evidence is not split across multiple textual variants. Then, using final outcomes from a group of trajectories, the method performs Bayesian estimation of the posterior utility of each fact cluster. Intuitively, if a fact cluster appears disproportionately often in successful trajectories, its posterior utility increases. These fact-level utilities are then converted into dense step-level rewards for policy optimization.

This differs from standard outcome-based GRPO, where all steps in a trajectory inherit the same coarse trajectory-level signal. Here, group rollouts are still used, but the reward is redistributed through an explicit evidence layer. That makes the method better matched to search tasks, where the meaningful intermediate unit is often not a token or a reasoning sentence, but a retrieved and validated piece of evidence.

The design also avoids training an external reward model and does not require human annotation of intermediate steps. The trade-off is that the whole pipeline depends on the quality of fact extraction and fact clustering. If those are noisy, the posterior utility estimates can be corrupted. The paper is aware of this: the fact store is both the main strength of the method and the main source of possible error propagation.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments use Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct backbones and evaluate on seven QA benchmarks. The headline result is that with the 7B backbone, FactAgent reaches an average EM of 51.2, outperforming the strongest baseline by +3.2 EM. The paper emphasizes that the gains are consistent across benchmarks rather than driven by a single dataset.

The more informative findings come from the analysis. The dense process supervision mainly improves evidence precision and retrieval quality. That matches the method design: the reward does not simply encourage more search, but encourages finding useful evidence and committing it into the explicit state.

The ablations likely cover the main components: removing the fact store, removing the assert action, disabling fact clustering, or replacing Bayesian posterior utility with simpler statistics. From the full-text description, the explicit fact representation and the utility estimation module are the most important contributors. Another practical point is that the method derives dense rewards directly from grouped rollout outcomes, without relying on an external reward model, which makes the training setup lighter and easier to scale.

The current evidence mainly supports search-heavy QA agents. Whether the same approach transfers to broader web agents, coding agents, or longer-horizon multi-tool settings depends on whether “facts” remain the right intermediate abstraction and whether fact extraction stays reliable in those environments.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and preliminaries to see that the paper changes more than the reward function. It jointly changes the state representation, the action space, and the reward decomposition. Then focus on three technical pieces: how the fact store is defined, how the assert action extracts and writes facts, and how Bayesian utility estimation is computed from grouped rollouts. The key questions while reading are: what exactly counts as a fact, how semantic equivalence is handled, and how posterior fact utility is mapped back to step-level rewards.

In the experiments, prioritize the main results table, the analyses on evidence precision and retrieval quality, and the ablations on fact store and utility estimation. A skim in about 40 minutes is enough to capture the main idea. A deeper read should ask whether explicit intermediate state could replace part of free-form chain-of-thought in reasoning RL, and whether fact-level credit assignment could generalize to code execution states, web interaction states, or multimodal tool trajectories.

recommendation.zh: 提供了一种为 Agent 搜索任务构建 step-level reward 的新思路（基于事实效用估计），对做 RL/PRM 的研究员有启发，关注其 reward 构造逻辑。
recommendation.en: Provides a novel approach (fact utility estimation) for constructing step-level rewards for Agent search tasks, inspiring for RL/PRM researchers; focus on its reward construction logic.

paper.title: DualStake: Dual-Path Confidence Calibration in Deep Research Agents
paper.abstract: Deep Research agents tackle knowledge-intensive tasks through multi-round retrieval and decision-oriented generation. However, these agents suffer from severe overconfidence, making their expressed confidence unreliable for user trust and downstream abstention. To address this, we augment the Deep Research pipeline with step confidence elicitation after each retrieval, building on the commonly used post-answer verbalized confidence. Interestingly, we find that Evidence Confidence (E-Conf), elici

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 Deep Research agent 的置信度校准问题。核心问题是，多轮检索和生成之后，模型给出的最终答案置信度往往过度自信，且不能可靠反映答案是否正确。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train / agent calibration。但它有一个值得关注的信号：在多步检索推理中，答案生成前的 evidence confidence 比答案生成后的 answer confidence 更能反映不确定性。这说明模型的置信度不是只由最终答案决定，而会被生成位置、证据状态和训练奖励共同塑形。对 RL 训练 agent 时如何设计过程信号、如何避免 reward 只强化自信表达，有一定参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 论文基于 Search-R1 风格的 Deep Research pipeline，在每次外部检索后加入 step confidence 查询，格式为 <confidence>X</confidence>；最终答案后仍保留 <final-confidence>X</final-confidence>。作者把最后一次检索后的置信度称为 Evidence Confidence（E-Conf），把答案后的置信度称为 Answer Confidence（A-Conf）。两者条件上接近，都基于已累积证据，但生成位置不同。分析发现 E-Conf 的校准更好，内部表征也更能区分正确与错误；A-Conf 则很大程度受 E-Conf 影响，并不独立编码答案正确性。基于此，DualStake 同时监督 E-Conf 和 A-Conf。它使用 confidence-dependent stake reward：置信度越高，答对时奖励越大，答错时惩罚越大。为避免模型通过极端置信度干扰答案质量，reward 中加入 margin clipping，限制有效置信度范围。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 qwen2.5-7B、qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 和 qwen3-4B，在 8 个 QA benchmark 上评估。未做专门校准训练时，E-Conf 在多个模型上比 A-Conf 有更低的 ECE；A-Conf 在部分模型上 AUC 略高，但 logit 层面区分度不足。作者用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 在 2WikiMultiHopQA 和 HotpotQA 上各生成 1,024 条 reasoning trace，抽取 E-Conf 与 A-Conf 位置的 logits 和 hidden states。一个具体现象是，A-Conf 对 token “9” 的概率在正确和错误样本上都约为 0.57，对 token “1” 的概率都约为 0.35，说明最终置信度 logits 对正确性分离很弱。hidden-state 分析中，作者在 28 层上抽取状态，从 3586 维 PCA 到 64 维，再用 5-fold logistic regression 预测答案正确性。DualStake 在保持答案准确率的同时改善校准指标。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。重点看 confidence-augmented pipeline 的定义，以及 E-Conf / A-Conf 的统计和表征分析。Figure 2 可用于快速判断两类置信度的 ECE 和 AUC 差异；Figure 3 和附录 A.1 适合看 hidden state 是否编码正确性。若关注 RL agent 训练，重点看 DualStake reward 的 margin clipping 设计，尤其是它如何避免模型把优化压力转移到置信度数字上。预训练研究者不必细读所有 QA benchmark 结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses confidence calibration in Deep Research agents. These agents retrieve evidence over multiple rounds and then produce an answer, but their final verbalized confidence is often overconfident and poorly aligned with answer correctness.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training and agent reliability than to core pretraining. Its useful signal is that uncertainty in multi-step retrieval agents is better exposed before answer generation than after it. Evidence Confidence, elicited after the final retrieval step, is a stronger calibration signal than Answer Confidence, elicited after the final answer. This matters for RL-trained agents because reward design can easily teach models to sound confident without making confidence track correctness.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors augment a Search-R1-style Deep Research pipeline with confidence queries after each retrieval step, using <confidence>X</confidence>, while keeping a final answer confidence tag, <final-confidence>X</final-confidence>. The confidence after the final retrieval is called Evidence Confidence, and the confidence after answer generation is called Answer Confidence. Both are conditioned on nearly the same accumulated evidence, but they occur at different positions in the sequence. The analysis suggests that E-Conf is better calibrated and carries more discriminative internal representations, while A-Conf is heavily shaped by E-Conf rather than independently reflecting correctness. DualStake trains both signals with a confidence-dependent stake reward: high confidence increases reward for correct answers and increases penalty for wrong answers. A margin-clipping mechanism bounds the effective confidence range so that calibration optimization does not destabilize answer accuracy.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run with qwen2.5-7B, qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and qwen3-4B across eight QA benchmarks. Before calibration-specific training, E-Conf generally has lower ECE than A-Conf, although A-Conf can show slightly higher AUC in some settings. The mechanistic analysis uses 1,024 reasoning traces per dataset from Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA, extracting logits and hidden states at the two confidence positions. One concrete finding is that A-Conf logits barely separate correct and incorrect cases: the probability of token “9” is about 0.57 for both groups, and token “1” is about 0.35 for both groups. For hidden-state probing, states across 28 layers are reduced from 3586 to 64 dimensions with PCA and evaluated with 5-fold logistic regression for correctness prediction. DualStake improves calibration while preserving answer accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus on the definition of the confidence-augmented pipeline and the comparison between E-Conf and A-Conf. Figure 2 is the quick entry point for ECE and AUC behavior; Figure 3 and Appendix A.1 are useful for checking whether hidden states encode correctness. For RL-agent training, read the DualStake reward design and the margin-clipping rationale. The full per-benchmark QA tables are less important unless calibration metrics are the main interest.

recommendation.zh: 对 Agent 内部状态（置信度）的细粒度分析，发现中间检索步骤的置信度比最终答案置信度更具指示性，对设计 Agent 的 RL reward 或 self-correction 机制有启发。
recommendation.en: Fine-grained analysis of Agent internal states (confidence), finding that intermediate retrieval step confidence is more indicative than final answer confidence, inspiring for designing RL rewards or self-correction mechanisms for Agents.

institutions: NLPR & MAIS, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA)

paper.title: One Policy, Any Budget: Internalizing Budget-Aware Search via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: While reinforcement learning has enabled LLM-based search agents to invoke external tools, existing methods train under fixed budgets and cannot adapt when constraints vary at deployment. We propose AnySearch, a framework that enables a single policy to perform budget-aware search under any budget constraint through a training scaffold and curriculum reinforcement learning. In the first phase, we train the agent with explicit budget state injection and structured reasoning prompts that guide eff

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但长期被忽略的问题：RL 搜索代理通常只在固定预算下训练，因此学到的是“某个预算点上的策略”，而不是“随预算变化自适应分配搜索资源的能力”。部署时一旦预算变了，模型往往只能机械地少搜或多搜，不能真正判断哪些问题值得把预算花在检索上，哪些问题应当直接依靠内部推理完成。作者要解决的不是简单的 tool-call 限额控制，而是把预算感知的搜索分配能力内化进单一策略，使其在推理时只给总预算，不依赖外部预算跟踪器或额外控制模块，也能在不同预算约束下稳定工作。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain recipe 的论文，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有现实意义。原因有两点。第一，它把“资源约束”从外部系统规则变成了策略内部能力，这和把格式约束、工具使用、长链推理等能力内化进模型的思路一致，属于后训练阶段对模型行为边界的重新塑形。第二，它说明 RL 不只是优化正确率，也可以学习条件化的计算分配策略，这对 test-time compute、budgeted reasoning、tool-use policy，甚至未来把 compute allocation 作为预训练或中训目标的一部分，都有启发。贡献量级上，这更像一个扎实的 agent RL 方法改进，而不是改变基础范式的工作；价值主要在训练脚手架如何被逐步撤掉并完成能力内化，以及奖励如何同时约束正确性和效率。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是一个两阶段 curriculum RL 框架 AnySearch。任务被形式化为带资源约束的序列决策：状态由历史上下文 h_t 和剩余预算 b_t 组成，动作包括纯推理、调用搜索工具、输出答案三类。预算只对外部 search call 计费，因为一次检索带来的延迟和返回文档 token 开销远高于内部思维 token。

第一阶段的重点是“扶着学”。作者加入训练脚手架，包含两部分：一是显式预算状态注入，让模型在上下文中看到当前剩余预算；二是结构化推理提示，引导模型在思维链中显式考虑是否值得搜索、预算是否还应保留、当前问题难度如何。训练时预算采用线性衰减，让模型在同一训练过程中持续接触从宽松到紧张的预算区间，而不是只在单点预算上收敛。

第二阶段的重点是“撤掉拐杖”。脚手架被完全移除，训练输入和推理时保持一致，只保留总预算约束，让模型自己隐式维护预算分配策略。这里作者没有简单均匀采样预算，而是做了自适应预算采样：根据不同预算水平上的近期表现，更多采样当前薄弱的预算区间，同时用均匀平滑保持覆盖，避免策略只对少数预算点过拟合。这一点很关键，因为预算条件化策略的难点不是单点最优，而是整条 budget-performance 曲线都要平稳。

奖励设计是另一条主线。作者使用复合奖励，把答案正确性和预算效率绑在一起，同时提供绝对与相对两类效率信号。更重要的是，效率项权重不是固定的，而是按 query 难度自适应调整，避免模型在难题上为了省搜索而牺牲正确率。这个设计针对的是常见失败模式：如果效率奖励过强，策略会学成“少搜少错但也少答对”；如果效率奖励过弱，又会退化成无节制搜索。论文的处理方式可以理解为 difficulty-aware reward balancing。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖 7 个 benchmark、3 个 backbone，目标是比较不同预算水平下的准确率、工具生产率和总 token 消耗。摘要和正文给出的主结论比较一致：AnySearch 在所有测试预算上都优于基线，并且能泛化到训练中未见过的预算值。这一点比固定预算训练更重要，因为它说明模型学到的不是离散预算点上的模板行为，而是连续的预算分配规律。

作者重点比较了几类基线：固定预算训练的 RL 搜索代理、只做 reward shaping 以减少冗余调用的方法，以及需要外部预算跟踪器的 BATS 类方法。结果显示，AnySearch 不仅准确率更高，而且 tool productivity 最好，也就是每次搜索调用带来的有效信息增益更高；同时总 token consumption 最低，说明它不是靠更多内部思维 token 换取表面上的少搜索，而是真正提升了单位预算的利用率。

消融实验围绕三个问题展开。第一，脚手架是否真的被内化。作者在 Phase I 后移除显式预算跟踪和结构化提示，性能不会塌陷，说明模型不是依赖外部控制逻辑，而是把预算感知行为学进了策略。第二，两阶段 curriculum 是否必要。去掉 Phase I 的显式引导，或者不做 Phase II 的无脚手架适配，都会降低跨预算泛化。第三，奖励各部分是否必要。去掉相对效率信号、绝对效率信号或自适应权重，都会让准确率—效率权衡变差。摘要里没有给出完整数字表，但从正文描述看，作者强调的是“全预算区间一致提升”和“未见预算泛化”这两个结果，而不是单一 benchmark 上的峰值分数。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住它和固定预算 RL agent、BATS 这类外部预算跟踪方法的区别。然后看 Method 里的 3.2、3.3、3.4 三节：训练脚手架是什么、为什么要分两阶段、adaptive budget sampling 如何决定采样分布、复合奖励如何避免正确率与效率互相拉扯。这几处是方法真正有信息量的地方。

实验部分建议重点看三类图表：一是不同预算下的性能曲线，而不是单点平均值；二是 unseen budgets 的泛化结果；三是 ablation，尤其是 scaffold removal 和 adaptive weighting。若只想快速判断是否值得深入，30–40 分钟足够。若想把它迁移到更一般的 tool-use RL 或 test-time compute 分配问题，需要仔细读奖励定义、预算采样策略和失败案例分析。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific limitation of RL-based search agents: they are usually trained under a fixed budget, so they learn a policy for one budget regime rather than a budget-conditional allocation strategy. When deployment constraints change, these agents do not truly adapt; they merely search less or more in a brittle way. The real problem is not enforcing a hard cap on tool calls, but learning when external search is worth spending budget on and when internal reasoning is sufficient. The goal is to internalize this budget-aware allocation skill into a single policy, so inference only needs a total budget and no external budget tracker or controller.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain–post-train interface. It shows how a behavior that is often handled by external system logic can be moved into the model policy through RL. That matters for tool use, test-time compute allocation, and budgeted reasoning more broadly. The paper also makes a useful point for foundation-model training: RL can optimize not only correctness, but conditional compute allocation under varying constraints. That idea could later connect to mid-training or continual training setups where compute usage itself becomes part of the learning objective. The contribution is methodical rather than paradigm-shifting; the main value lies in scaffolded internalization and in the reward design that balances accuracy against efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AnySearch formulates budget-aware search as a resource-constrained sequential decision problem. The state contains the interaction history h_t and remaining budget b_t. The action space has three actions: reason internally, call the search tool, or answer and terminate. Budget is charged only on external search calls, since search latency and retrieved-document tokens dominate cost relative to internal reasoning tokens.

The method uses a two-phase curriculum. Phase I is a scaffolded learning stage. The model receives explicit budget-state injection and structured reasoning prompts that encourage it to think about whether a search is necessary, how much budget remains, and how to allocate it. Budgets decay linearly during training so the policy sees a range of budget regimes instead of overfitting to a single point.

Phase II removes the scaffold entirely. Training inputs now match inference conditions: the model is given only the total budget and must autonomously manage allocation. To make this work across budgets, the paper introduces adaptive budget sampling. Rather than sampling budgets uniformly, it focuses more on budget levels where the current policy is weak, while retaining uniform smoothing for coverage. This is important because the target is not peak performance at one budget, but a stable performance curve over many budgets.

The reward is a composite objective combining answer accuracy and budget efficiency. Efficiency is measured with both absolute and relative signals. A key detail is the adaptive weighting of the efficiency term based on query difficulty, which prevents the policy from becoming overly conservative on hard questions. Without this, a strong efficiency reward would push the model toward under-searching; too weak a reward would collapse back to wasteful search. The paper’s solution is effectively a difficulty-aware trade-off controller inside RL training.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans 7 benchmarks and 3 backbone models. The main result is consistent improvement over baselines across all tested budget levels, together with generalization to budget values not seen during training. That unseen-budget result is more important than a single average score, because it suggests the model learned a transferable budget-allocation behavior rather than memorizing a few discrete budget settings.

The baselines include fixed-budget RL search agents, reward-shaping methods that try to reduce redundant tool use without an explicit budget interface, and BATS-style approaches that rely on an external budget tracker. AnySearch improves not only answer quality but also tool productivity, meaning each search call yields more useful information on average. It also achieves the lowest total token consumption, which indicates the gain is not coming from replacing search with excessive internal reasoning tokens.

The ablations address three central questions. First, whether the scaffold is truly internalized: after removing explicit budget tracking and structured prompts, performance remains strong, which supports the internalization claim. Second, whether the two-phase curriculum is necessary: removing either the scaffolded phase or the scaffold-free adaptation phase hurts cross-budget robustness.
