The process stops either when no chunk contributes useful new evidence or when a predefined maximum number of turns K is reached, after which the model answers based on the question and the final memory.

Training is done end-to-end with reinforcement learning rather than stepwise supervision of memory contents. The reward combines answer accuracy with a turn-efficiency term that discourages redundant turns. This means evidence extraction, memory update behavior, and stopping decisions are all optimized jointly as a policy. Relative to prior recurrent-memory baselines, the key difference is not a larger memory budget but a different update topology: parallel reads plus iterative shared refinement instead of serial overwrite.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper evaluates PI-Mem on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and Qwen2.5-7B, focusing on long-context QA and especially HotpotQA at 3.6M tokens. The headline result is that on 3.6M-token HQA, PI-Mem improves over MemAgent by +6.25 and +7.81 absolute points, while also delivering 6.1× and 2.1× inference speedups, respectively. These numbers support both of the paper’s claims: better evidence preservation/integration and lower latency under ultra-long inputs.

The method uses a bounded number of turns rather than unbounded iterative refinement, so cost depends on both chunk parallelism and the number of turns. The turn-efficiency reward is meant to prevent the model from always using the maximum number of turns. The excerpt provided does not include the full ablation tables, but the important ablations to verify are clear: replacing parallel reads with serial updates, removing iterative refinement and using a single pass, removing the turn-efficiency reward, varying the maximum turn count K, and changing chunk granularity to study the accuracy-latency trade-off. Those are the experiments that determine whether the gains truly come from reduced overwrite and improved parallelism.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with the method and the main result table. The key is not the wording of read-select-merge, but the dependency structure relative to standard recurrent-memory agents. Traditional systems follow a chain like chunk1→memory1→chunk2→memory2. PI-Mem instead reads all chunks under the same memory, updates memory once, and repeats. That structural difference explains both the latency gain and the reduced tendency to wash out early evidence.

If you only have about 20 minutes, read in this order: the problem setup in the introduction, Figure 2 and Algorithm 1, the 3.6M-token HotpotQA results, and the RL reward design. If you want to judge whether it is usable in your own system, also inspect the appendix for latency measurement protocol, chunk and turn settings, memory-length constraints, and the fairness of the MemAgent comparison. In this line of work, implementation assumptions such as available parallelism, batching, and whether multi-turn overhead is counted can materially affect the conclusion.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和 RL 退出奖励即可；若 3.6M 评测不是合成检索题，这会影响长上下文预训练预算判断。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and the RL early-exit reward; if the 3.6M-token eval is not just synthetic retrieval, it affects long-context pretraining budget decisions.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: GROW: Group-Relative Advantage-Weighted On-Policy Reinforcement Learning of Autoregressive-Diffusion Text-to-Speech model
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for flow-matching text-to-speech is complicated by deterministic ODE sampling: trajectory-level policy-gradient methods typically convert the ODE into an SDE and track per-step likelihood ratios, introducing stochastic perturbations and substantial overhead. We propose GROW, a group-relative advantage-weighted on-policy RL method that acts directly on the standard flow-matching objective. For each prompt, GROW samples a group of on-policy utterances, separately standardize

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是一个很具体但不容易的后训练问题：对于 DiTAR 这类 autoregressive + diffusion 的连续语音生成模型，如何做高效、稳定、直接作用于原始 flow-matching 目标的 on-policy RL，使模型在零样本 TTS 中同时提升可懂度和说话人相似度，而不必把确定性的 flow ODE 强行改写成带噪声的 SDE，再承担逐步 likelihood ratio、轨迹存储和高计算开销。
summary.importance: 它对纯文本预训练不是直接增量，但对“新型语言建模范式 + 新模态统一建模”的研究有明确启发。原因有两点。第一，DiTAR 这类 AR+continuous diffusion 混合生成器，和近来的 AR+diffusion 统一建模工作在训练接口上很相似：预训练用回归式 flow matching，后训练却很难套用离散 token LM 的 PPO/GRPO。GROW 给出了一条更贴近预训练目标的 RL 路线。第二，论文说明在强预训练模型上，奖励往往在同一 prompt 组内高度聚集，简单正向 reward weighting 很容易被自模仿项淹没，真正有效的是组内相对优势而不是绝对奖励。这一点对文本 RL、diffusion LM 后训练、甚至 reward-weighted pretraining 都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是把 on-policy RL 改写成对标准 flow-matching 回归损失的 advantage-weighted 重加权，而不是做 trajectory-level policy gradient。具体来说，对每个 prompt，当前策略采样一组 utterances；分别计算 intelligibility 与 speaker similarity 两类奖励；在组内对每种奖励做标准化，再组合成一个 signed 的 group-relative advantage。这个 advantage 直接作为 flow-matching loss 的样本权重，让高于组均值的样本被强化，低于组均值的样本被抑制。这里有两个关键设计。其一，作者显式引入 group-mean reward baseline，把 reward weighting 变成 advantage weighting，目的是去掉 prompt 间 reward scale 差异，并放大同一 prompt 内细微但有意义的质量差别。其二，用 Wasserstein-2 velocity penalty 把更新后的速度场锚定到冻结的 pretrained reference，限制策略漂移，避免为了追奖励而损伤自然度或稳定性。相比 Flow-GRPO 一类方法，GROW 不需要 ODE-to-SDE 转换，不需要逐步 likelihood 估计，也不需要为每个 patch 存整条随机轨迹；因此更适合 DiTAR 这种在 AR 外环里反复调用 flow solver 的结构。论文还讨论了为什么不用纯正指数权重：在 bounded reward 且分布很窄的 TTS 场景里，指数权重对弱差异不敏感，且容易被共享的 imitation term 主导，组内标准化后的 signed advantage 更利于 credit assignment。
summary.experiments: 实验在 LibriSpeech-PC test-clean、Seed-TTS English、Seed-TTS Chinese 三个零样本测试集上进行，目标是同时优化 WER 与 speaker similarity，并监控自然度 UTMOS。主结果是：相对预训练 DiTAR，三套测试集平均 WER 从 2.016 降到 1.558，绝对下降 0.458；speaker similarity 从 0.676 升到 0.715，绝对提升 0.039；UTMOS 基本维持在预训练水平。论文声称这些结果整体优于 DiTAR-GRPO 基线。效率方面，GROW 在 10-NFE rollout 下即可达到与自身 32-NFE 训练设置相近的效果，而相对 32-NFE 的 DiTAR-GRPO baseline，训练速度约快 2.9×；若在相同训练 rollout NFE 下比较，GROW 仍约快 1.1×。所有模型最终评测统一使用 32 NFE，避免把训练时采样步数差异混入测试。消融重点包括 rollout NFE、CFG、reward weighting 形式与多奖励组合方式。论文的核心经验是：组相对优势优于简单 reward weighting；W2 anchor 对保持自然度和训练稳定性是必要的；较低训练 rollout NFE 已足够提供有效 RL 信号，说明该方法对采样精度的依赖低于 trajectory-based RL。
summary.reading_guide: 建议先看 Introduction 里对两条路线的对比：一条是 Flow-GRPO 这类把 ODE 变成 SDE 的 likelihood-based RL，另一条是直接在 forward flow-matching 回归上做 reward/advantage weighting。理解这一步，后面公式就顺了。然后重点看方法部分里 GROW 的目标函数：组采样、双奖励标准化、group-mean baseline、signed advantage、以及 Wasserstein-2 velocity penalty 各自解决什么问题。实验部分优先看主表和消融表，尤其是 10-NFE 与 32-NFE 的训练效率对比，以及 reward weighting 变体的差异。若只做泛读，抓住三件事即可：为什么 DiTAR 的 RL 难；为什么 advantage 要在组内做；为什么 reference anchor 不能省。预计 35–50 分钟可以读完关键内容。对做预训练的人，值得深挖的是这种“保持预训练回归目标形式，只在样本权重上注入 RL 信号”的思路，是否能迁移到 diffusion LM、masked/any-order LM 或多模态连续 token 生成器。
summary.authors_note: 从文中引用关系看，工作围绕 DiTAR 这一 AR-diffusion TTS 路线展开，属于语音生成与连续生成模型后训练方向。给定内容未提供完整作者与机构列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a specific but important post-training problem: how to do efficient and stable on-policy RL for an autoregressive-diffusion TTS model such as DiTAR without converting its deterministic flow ODE sampler into an SDE and paying the usual cost of trajectory storage, per-step likelihood ratios, and noisy stochastic rollouts. The target is to improve intelligibility and speaker similarity in zero-shot TTS while preserving naturalness.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core text-pretraining paper, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it addresses the training interface for hybrid AR + continuous diffusion generators. That interface is increasingly important in multimodal pretraining and unified generative modeling. The paper also makes a broader point: for strong pretrained generators, rewards are often tightly clustered within a prompt, so absolute reward weighting is weak. Relative within-group advantage is a better signal. That lesson may transfer beyond TTS to diffusion LMs, masked/any-order generators, and reward-weighted training more generally.
summary_en.technical_approach: GROW replaces trajectory-level policy-gradient RL with advantage-weighted flow-matching regression. For each prompt, the current policy samples a group of utterances. Each utterance is scored by two rewards: intelligibility and speaker similarity. Each reward is standardized within the group, then combined into a signed group-relative advantage. This advantage directly reweights the standard flow-matching loss, so samples above the group mean are reinforced and those below it are downweighted. Two design choices matter. First, the group-mean reward baseline turns reward weighting into advantage weighting, which removes prompt-level scale variation and amplifies subtle but meaningful differences among samples from the same prompt. Second, a Wasserstein-2 velocity penalty anchors the updated velocity field to a frozen pretrained reference, limiting drift and helping preserve naturalness. Compared with Flow-GRPO-style methods, GROW keeps deterministic ODE sampling, avoids ODE-to-SDE conversion, and does not require per-step likelihood evaluation. The paper also argues against purely positive exponential weighting: in bounded, tightly clustered TTS rewards, it does not provide enough contrast and can be dominated by the shared imitation component.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are run on LibriSpeech-PC test-clean and the English and Chinese Seed-TTS test sets in a zero-shot setting. The main metrics are WER, speaker similarity, and UTMOS for naturalness. Averaged over the three test sets, GROW reduces WER from 2.016 to 1.558, an absolute drop of 0.458, and increases speaker similarity from 0.676 to 0.715, an absolute gain of 0.039, while keeping UTMOS at roughly the pretrained level. The paper reports that these gains surpass the DiTAR-GRPO baseline overall. On efficiency, GROW with 10-NFE training rollouts reaches performance comparable to its own 32-NFE setting, and is about 2.9× faster to train than the 32-NFE DiTAR-GRPO baseline. At matched training-rollout NFE, GROW is still about 1.1× faster. All final evaluations use 32 NFE to keep inference quality comparable. Ablations cover rollout NFE, CFG, reward weighting variants, and reward composition. The main empirical message is that group-relative advantage works better than naive reward weighting, and the W2 anchor is important for stability and quality retention.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction’s contrast between two RL routes: likelihood-based methods that convert the ODE into an SDE, and direct reward/advantage weighting on the original flow-matching objective. That framing explains why the method exists. Then read the objective carefully: group sampling, per-reward normalization, the group-mean baseline, signed advantage, and the Wasserstein-2 anchor each solve a different failure mode. In the experiments, focus on the main result table and the ablations on rollout NFE and weighting variants. If you only skim, keep three questions in mind: why RL is unusually expensive for DiTAR, why the advantage must be group-relative, and why the reference anchor is necessary. Around 35–50 minutes should be enough for the key parts. For pretraining researchers, the deeper idea is whether RL signals can be injected by reweighting the original regression objective rather than switching to a separate policy-gradient machinery.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is built around the DiTAR autoregressive-diffusion TTS line. The provided content does not include a full author list or affiliations.

recommendation.zh: 针对flow-matching生成模型的RL方法无需ODE转SDE，思路可迁移到文本Diffusion LM的对齐，重点看§3的组优势加权和W2惩罚设计。
recommendation.en: The RL method for flow-matching models avoids ODE-to-SDE conversion, transferable to text diffusion LM alignment; focus on §3 for group advantage weighting and W2 penalty design.

paper.title: TurnSight: Turn-Level Hindsight Self-Distillation for Tool-Integrated Reasoning
paper.abstract: Tool-Integrated Reasoning (TIR) enables LLMs to solve complex tasks through iterative tool interactions. However, existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on trajectory-level supervision, limiting fine-grained credit assignment in long-horizon TIR scenarios. On-policy self-distillation offers denser signals through teacher branches with privileged context, but existing approaches typically derive such context from ground-truth answers or retrieved skills, which may not reflect the stat

summary.core_problem: 现有工具集成推理的RL方法依赖轨迹级监督，长轨迹信用分配粒度粗；现有on-policy自蒸馏的教师信号来自真值答案而非Agent真实访问状态，且token级监督未适配工具交互的轮次结构。
summary.importance: 提出轮次级事后自蒸馏框架，为长 Horizon 工具推理提供更细粒度的监督信号，提升工具使用任务的训练效率与性能。
summary.technical_approach: 从Agent实际交互的执行后hindsight状态构造监督信号，生成不同展望视野的多组事后视图，通过跨视野方向一致性筛选可靠监督，以轮次为单位做自蒸馏训练。
summary.experiments: 原摘要未披露完整实验细节，据称在主流工具集成推理基准上相比轨迹级RL、token级自蒸馏基线取得更稳定的长轨迹性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者团队来自中国人民大学高瓴人工智能学院、百度公司。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL methods for tool-integrated reasoning rely on trajectory-level supervision with coarse credit assignment for long horizons; on-policy self-distillation uses teacher signals from ground-truth answers rather than agent-visited states, and token-level supervision does not match the turn structure of tool interactions.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a turn-level hindsight self-distillation framework that provides finer-grained supervision for long-horizon tool reasoning, improving training efficiency and tool-use performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Derives supervision from execution-conditioned hindsight states on actual agent interaction trajectories, constructs multiple hindsight views with different lookahead horizons, selects reliable signals via cross-horizon directional agreement, and performs turn-level self-distillation.
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental details are not disclosed in the abstract; the method is claimed to deliver more stable long-trajectory performance than trajectory-level RL and token-level self-distillation baselines on standard tool-use benchmarks.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are affiliated with Gaoling School of AI at Renmin University of China and Baidu Inc.

recommendation.zh: 工具使用RL方向的增量改进，做后训练的团队可看信用分配设计，预训练方向无需深入。
recommendation.en: An incremental improvement for tool-use RL; post-training teams may check the credit assignment design, but it is irrelevant for core pretraining research.

institutions: Gaoling School of Artificial Intelligence, Renmin University of China

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning with Evolving Rubrics as Rewards for Audio Reasoning
paper.abstract: Audio reasoning is essential for machine understanding of the acoustic world. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can elicit such reasoning, yet existing reward designs are complementary in their limitations: outcome-based rewards supervise only the final answer and let the model reach it without attending to the audio, whereas process-based rewards score the reasoning itself but rely on coarse, hand-crafted, and fixed criteria that neither adapt to each question nor stay grounded in

summary.core_problem: 音频推理任务中现有RL奖励设计存在局限：结果奖励只监督最终答案、过程奖励依赖静态手工标准，无法适配不同问题且随策略提升而失效。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出自适应、音频锚定的细粒度推理过程奖励框架，为多模态RL奖励设计提供新的可演化rubric思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出AudioRubrics框架，使用LLM自动为每个样本生成随训练演化、与音频证据绑定的细粒度评分rubric作为RL奖励，替代静态手工过程奖励和纯结果奖励。
summary.experiments: 未在摘要中披露具体模型规模、数据集与量化提升幅度，仅说明框架覆盖感知类和多步推理类两类音频问题。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括马里兰大学、UIUC、UIC和微软研究院，作者含Philip S. Yu（数据挖掘与多模态领域资深学者）。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL rewards for audio reasoning are limited: outcome rewards supervise only final answers while process rewards rely on static, hand-crafted criteria that fail to adapt across questions and degrade as policy improves.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing an adaptive, audio-grounded fine-grained reward framework, providing a new evolvable-rubric direction for multimodal RL reward design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes AudioRubrics, which uses LLMs to automatically generate per-sample, training-evolvable, audio-evidence-bound fine-grained scoring rubrics as RL rewards, replacing both static handcrafted process rewards and pure outcome rewards.
summary_en.experiments: Model scale, datasets and quantitative gains are not disclosed in the abstract; the framework is stated to cover both perceptual and multi-step reasoning audio tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Affiliations include University of Maryland, UIUC, UIC and Microsoft Research; authors include Philip S. Yu, a senior researcher in data mining and multimodal learning.

recommendation.zh: 演化rubric作为奖励的思路可迁移到文本RL，但论文是音频垂直场景，看摘要和方法框架即可，无需深挖。
recommendation.en: The evolvable-rubric reward idea is transferable to text RL, but the work is audio-domain specific; read only abstract and method outline, no deep dive needed.

paper.title: When Correct Solutions Repeat: Rarity-Aware Credit Redistribution for GRPO
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) com- monly optimizes each correct completion as an independent learning signal. In GRPO, this completion-level uniformity creates structure-level skew: recurring correct solution forms accumulate positive coefficient mass in proportion to how often they are sampled, while rare forms receive limited credit. We formalize this behavior as multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration and introduce a partition- conditioned rule that r

summary.core_problem: GRPO等RLVR方法将每个正确completion作为独立学习信号，导致重复出现的正确解法形式按采样频率累积正优势，罕见正确解法形式信用不足。
summary.importance: 识别了RLVR中multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration问题，提出了无需辅助模型推理的轻量修正；对理解GRPO训练动态有机制层面的参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO使用确定性Strategy Cues对验证正确的轨迹构建rollout-local分区，按聚类稀有度重新分配正优势；不需要额外辅助模型推理。Judge Partitions下的Credit Redistribution进一步验证了重新分配机制的有效性。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen2.5-Math-7B和Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上评测AIME重复采样性能，Cue-GRPO带来提升，高采样预算下增益最大；JP分区实验表明重新分配机制有效。

summary_en.core_problem: RLVR methods like GRPO treat each correct completion as an independent learning signal, causing recurring correct solution forms to accumulate positive advantage proportional to sampling frequency while rare correct forms receive insufficient credit.
summary_en.importance: Identifies multiplicity-induced structure-level credit concentration in RLVR and proposes a lightweight fix without auxiliary-model inference; useful for understanding GRPO training dynamics at a mechanistic level.
summary_en.technical_approach: Cue-GRPO uses deterministic Strategy Cues to construct rollout-local partitions of verified-correct traces and redistributes positive advantages according to cluster rarity, requiring no auxiliary model inference. Credit Redistribution under Judge Partitions further validates the redistribution mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on AIME repeated-sampling; Cue-GRPO improves performance with largest gains at high sampling budgets. JP partition experiments confirm the redistribution mechanism.

recommendation.zh: GRPO信用集中问题的观察比解法更有价值，高采样预算下偏差加剧这一点对大规模RLVR有参考；只看问题形式化和§3即可。
recommendation.en: The credit-concentration observation is more valuable than the fix; the fact that bias worsens at high sampling budgets matters for large-scale RLVR. Read the formalization and §3 only.

paper.title: Robust General Utility for Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with general utility extends classic RL by optimizing an arbitrary utility functional of the policy-induced occupancy measure, thereby enabling a broader range of applications. However, previous work on general utility RL typically assumes the evaluation utility is fixed and correctly specified. In practice, the utility used at deployment can deviate from the training one, creating a robustness gap that prior work does not address. Motivated by this, we propose robust

summary.core_problem: 解决 general-utility RL 在部署时效用函数可能偏离训练设定的问题，即策略对效用误指定不鲁棒。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是理论框架和算法：把固定效用的 general-utility RL 扩展为效用不确定集上的 minimax 学习。它不是 LLM 对齐论文，但对 reward misspecification、RLHF 目标漂移和训练信号鲁棒性有间接参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 robust general-utility RL，把策略目标写成对效用不确定集的最坏情况优化；通过不同不确定集选择，统一 reward-robust RL、constrained RL 等已有形式。针对凹效用等情形设计随机优化算法，并给出收敛保证。
summary.experiments: 摘要主要强调理论框架和可证明收敛算法，未给出 LLM/RLHF 实验、模型规模或具体 benchmark 数值。需要正文确认是否有仿真实验和误指定强度下的性能曲线。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses utility misspecification in general-utility RL, where the deployment-time utility may differ from the one assumed during training.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a theoretical framework and algorithms: fixed-utility general-utility RL is extended to minimax optimization over a utility uncertainty set. It is not an LLM alignment paper, but it is relevant as a weak signal for reward misspecification and robustness in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate robust general-utility RL as worst-case optimization over a prescribed set of utility functionals. By choosing different uncertainty sets, the framework recovers reward-robust RL and constrained RL. They also develop stochastic algorithms with convergence guarantees for regimes such as concave utilities.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract emphasizes theory and provably convergent algorithms rather than LLM or RLHF experiments. It does not provide model sizes, benchmark details, or quantitative results; any empirical evidence would need to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 可把它当 reward misspecification 的理论旁证；只看问题形式和不确定集定义，别期待 LLM 训练 recipe。
recommendation.en: Treat it as theoretical evidence for reward misspecification; read the objective and uncertainty-set formulation, not for an LLM training recipe.

paper.title: Reusing Rollouts under Policy Lag: Prefix-Normalized Policy Optimization for LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Autoregressive rollout generation is a major computational cost in reinforcement learning for large language models. Reusing each rollout batch for additional learner updates amortizes this cost, but later updates become increasingly off-policy as the learner departs from the behavior policy. At a token position, exact off-policy correction must account for both the current action and the probability of reaching its prefix. The cumulative importance ratio provides this correction, but its produc

summary.core_problem: LLM 强化学习中，为了摊销自回归 rollout 的高昂采样成本，通常会对同一批轨迹做多轮（多 epoch）策略更新；但随着更新轮次增加，当前策略逐渐偏离采样时的行为策略（policy lag / off-policy 漂移），标准 PPO/GRPO 使用的 token 级局部重要性比只是一种近端近似，无法纠正前缀访问分布的变化，而精确的状态-动作密度比（累积乘积形式）动态范围又会随前缀长度和漂移程度急剧膨胀，导致训练不稳定。
summary.importance: 提出了一种在因果前缀校正与权重尺度可控之间取得折中方案的 off-policy 目标 PNPO，对需要复用 rollout、提升采样效率的 LLM RL 训练（尤其是推理模型的大规模 GRPO/PPO 训练）有直接参考价值。其核心洞察——自回归设定下前缀分布的变化是可计算的，但精确累积比尺度不可控——也为理解 policy lag 下的 off-policy 校正提供了更清晰的分解视角。
summary.technical_approach: PNPO 在位置 t 使用前缀似然比的几何均值作为权重：w_t^PN = (∏_{k=1}^t r_k)^{1/t}，其中 r_k = π_θ(y_k|x,y_{<k}) / π_β(y_k|x,y_{<k}) 是 token 级局部比。与精确累积比 C_t = ∏_{k=1}^t r_k 相比，1/t 次方同时压缩了当前 token 和历史前缀的比，牺牲了精确的状态-动作密度校正，换取权重尺度的可控性。与 GSPO 使用的全序列共享长度归一化统计量相比，PNPO 的权重随位置变化且不依赖未来后缀，保持了因果性，仅在终止位置数值上与全响应几何均值一致。完整目标还结合了位置相关的接受门控和响应级平均。
summary.experiments: 在长上下文数学推理任务上构造了两种受控 off-policy  regime：每批 rollout 做 1 个 epoch 和 4 个 epoch 的策略更新，在相同 minibatch 更新预算（2400 次更新）下对比。1 epoch 时 PNPO 并不稳定优于 GSPO；4 epoch 时 PNPO 在三个独立选择的 benchmark 上均取得最高 Avg@32，三个峰值的未加权均值为 50.24，比 GSPO 高 3.00 个百分点。在匹配的 2400 次更新预算下，4 epoch PNPO 经过 150 批 rollout 达到最终 macro Avg@32 49.66，与 1 epoch 下 600 批 rollout 达到的 49.56 相当，即 rollout 采样量减少到 1/4 仍能达到相近性能。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 3 节 PNPO 目标的完整定义，以及图 1 对四种权重粒度（token 局部比、累积比、序列共享统计量、前缀归一化）的位置依赖 log 权重尺度对比。第 4 节的 1 epoch vs 4 epoch 对比实验是核心结果，关注其如何通过匹配更新预算来分离 rollout 效率和更新次数的混淆。附录中的权重分布可视化有助于理解为什么几何均值能有效压缩动态范围。预计阅读时间 30-40 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In LLM reinforcement learning, autoregressive rollout generation is expensive, so reusing a collected batch for multiple learner updates (multi-epoch PPO/GRPO) is a standard way to amortize sampling cost. However, as the learner drifts away from the behavior policy across updates (policy lag / off-policy drift), the token-level local importance ratio used by PPO/GRPO is only a proximal approximation and does not correct for changes in prefix visitation distribution. The exact state-action density ratio (cumulative product form) has a dynamic range that grows with prefix length and drift magnitude, causing training instability.
summary_en.importance: PNPO proposes an off-policy objective that trades off exact causal-prefix correction for controllable weight scale. It is directly relevant to LLM RL training that reuses rollouts to improve sample efficiency, especially large-scale reasoning model training with GRPO/PPO. The core insight—that prefix distribution changes are computable under autoregressive generation but the exact cumulative ratio has intractable scale—also provides a clearer decomposition for understanding off-policy correction under policy lag.
summary_en.technical_approach: At position t, PNPO uses the geometric mean of likelihood ratios along the prefix as the weight: w_t^PN = (∏_{k=1}^t r_k)^{1/t}, where r_k = π_θ(y_k|x,y_{<k}) / π_β(y_k|x,y_{<k}) is the token-level local ratio. Compared to the exact cumulative ratio C_t = ∏_{k=1}^t r_k, the 1/t power tempers both the current token ratio and all preceding ratios, sacrificing exact state-action density correction for scale control. Unlike GSPO's sequence-shared length-normalized statistic, PNPO's weight is position-dependent and excludes future suffix likelihood changes, preserving causality; it only numerically coincides with the full-response geometric mean at the terminal position. The full objective combines this weight with a position-dependent acceptance gate and response-level averaging.
summary_en.experiments: Two controlled off-policy regimes are constructed on long-context mathematical reasoning: 1 epoch and 4 epochs of policy updates per rollout batch, compared under a matched minibatch-update budget of 2,400 updates. With 1 epoch, PNPO does not consistently outperform GSPO. With 4 epochs, PNPO attains the highest Avg@32 on each of three independently selected benchmarks; the unweighted mean of the three benchmark peaks is 50.24, 3.00 percentage points above GSPO. Under the matched 2,400-update budget, 4-epoch PNPO reaches a final macro Avg@32 of 49.66 after 150 rollout batches, comparable to the 49.56 reached after 600 batches with 1 epoch—meaning roughly 4x reduction in rollout sampling for similar performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the full PNPO objective specification, and Figure 1 comparing position-dependent log-weight scales across four weighting granularities (token-local, cumulative, sequence-shared, prefix-normalized). Section 4's 1-epoch vs 4-epoch comparison is the core result; pay attention to how the matched update budget disentangles rollout efficiency from update count. Appendix visualizations of weight distributions help understand why the geometric mean compresses dynamic range effectively. Estimated reading time: 30-40 minutes.

recommendation.zh: rollout 复用是 RL 训练降本的核心路径，PNPO 的几何均值近似思路有参考价值，但效果未稳定优于 GSPO，重点看 §3 推导和两种 off-policy regime 的对比。
recommendation.en: Rollout reuse is central to RL cost reduction; PNPO's geometric-mean approximation is a useful idea, though it does not consistently beat GSPO — focus on §3 derivation and the two off-policy regime comparisons.

paper.title: TCPO: Turn-Level Credit Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Verifier-guided reinforcement learning has become a powerful paradigm for improving LLM reasoning. In multi-turn settings, models receive a verifier score after each turn and iteratively refine their outputs. Although such scores provide dense feedback, they do not directly provide dense credit: a score measures the quality of the current output, while credit should measure how the current turn changes the refinement trajectory. We propose TCPO, a turn-level credit assignment method for verifier

summary.core_problem: 验证器引导的多轮RL中，每轮都能获取验证器分数，但分数衡量的是当前输出的质量，而非当前轮次对整个优化轨迹的边际贡献（即信用）。现有方法要么将最终结果广播给所有轮次，要么用原始分数或相邻轮差作为奖励，无法正确为延迟贡献轮次、正确状态保持轮次、或为后续成功铺路的非改进轮次分配信用，限制了多轮RL的训练效率和最终效果。
summary.importance: 它将多轮推理RL的核心挑战重新定义为「分数到信用的转换」，而非奖励密度不足，这一框架对推理增强类预训练（如自我修正范式）、多轮Agent的RL训练都有直接参考价值。方法不需要额外人工标注或学习型critic，实现成本低，容易集成到现有GRPO风格的训练流程中。
summary.technical_approach:
TCPO是轮次级别的信用分配方法，兼容GRPO风格的策略优化，不需要修改基础多轮rollout流程，也不需要额外标签或学习型critic。它通过三种参考比较，将验证器分数轨迹转换为轮次优势：
1. 回溯信用：将当前轮分数与之前的最好成绩对比，捕捉即时进步、成功保持或倒退；
2. 后见延迟信用：针对成功前的非改进轮次，用其后续能达到的最好分数，与同prompt同轮次的其他合格轨迹对比，识别那些暂时无改进但为后续成功铺路的轮次；
3. 固定历史反事实估计：针对高惊讶度的合格轮次，在相同历史下采样其他输出，用验证器对比原输出的效果，解决高不确定轮次的信用模糊问题。
此外采用固定预算训练协议：即使提前达到成功标准，也继续rollout到最大轮数，以观测成功后的状态保持或倒退行为。得到的轮次优势广播给对应轮的所有token，用GRPO裁剪目标优化。
summary.experiments: 在不同模型规模、任务域、验证器类型上均有效。数学和代码基准上，Qwen3-4B和DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B的best-turn Pass@8均达到最优或并列最优，同时通常减少成功所需轮数。对比MT-GRPO，Qwen3-4B在MATH-500、AIME、LiveCodeBench、HumanEval上分别提升+4.4、+2.2、+1.6、+0.6个点，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上提升幅度更大。性能优于或持平GVPO。在AppWorld多轮工具使用Agent基准上，TGC和SGC设置下的Dev和Test-N均有提升，TGC下的Test-C也有提升。额外训练成本较低。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看Introduction部分提出的「分数到信用转换」问题定义，这是核心概念贡献。然后看方法部分三种信用分配机制的设计直觉和适用场景，无需深究公式细节。实验部分看跨模型跨任务的主结果，以及与MT-GRPO、GVPO的对比即可。预计阅读时间20分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: In verifier-guided multi-turn reinforcement learning for LLMs, per-turn verifier scores measure current output quality, not the marginal contribution (credit) of that turn to the overall refinement trajectory. Existing methods either broadcast final outcomes to all turns, use raw scores as rewards, or compute adjacent score differences — all fail to correctly assign credit to turns with delayed contributions, turns that preserve correct states, or non-improving turns that enable later success, limiting training efficiency and final performance.
summary_en.importance: It reframes the core challenge of multi-turn reasoning RL as score-to-credit conversion rather than insufficient reward density, a framing that is directly relevant for reasoning-enhanced pretraining (such as self-refinement paradigms) and multi-turn agent RL training. The method requires no extra human labels or learned critic, making it low-cost to implement and easy to integrate into existing GRPO-style training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
TCPO (Turn-Level Credit Policy Optimization) is a turn-level credit assignment method compatible with GRPO-style policy optimization. It leaves the base multi-turn rollout pipeline unchanged and requires no additional labels or learned critic. It converts verifier score traces into turn-level advantages via three reference comparisons:
1. Retrospective credit compares each turn's score against the best prior score, capturing immediate progress, success preservation, and regression.
2. Hindsight delayed credit, applied to eligible non-improving turns before success, compares their realized future-best score against eligible trajectories of the same prompt and turn index, identifying turns that lay groundwork for later success without immediate improvement.
3. Fixed-history counterfactual estimation, applied to high-surprisal eligible turns, samples alternative outputs under the same history and compares them to the original output via the verifier, resolving credit ambiguity for high-uncertainty turns.
A fixed-budget training protocol is used: rollouts continue to the maximum turn count even after early success, to observe preservation or regression after correct states are reached. The resulting turn-level advantages are broadcast to all tokens in the corresponding turn and optimized with a clipped GRPO-style objective.
summary_en.experiments: Effective across model scales, task domains, and verifier types. On math and code benchmarks, it achieves best or tied-best best-turn Pass@8 on both Qwen3-4B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, while usually reducing the number of turns to success. Compared to MT-GRPO, it improves Qwen3-4B by +4.4, +2.2, +1.6, and +0.6 points on MATH-500, AIME, LiveCodeBench, and HumanEval respectively, with larger gains on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B. It outperforms or matches GVPO. On the AppWorld multi-turn tool-use agent benchmark, it improves Dev and Test-N under both TGC and SGC settings, and improves Test-C under TGC. Additional training cost is modest.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a quick read, start with the score-to-credit conversion problem framing in the Introduction — this is the core conceptual contribution. Then review the design intuition and use cases of the three credit assignment mechanisms in the method section, without dwelling on detailed formulas. Skim the main cross-model, cross-task results and comparisons against MT-GRPO and GVPO in experiments. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 多轮 RL 信用分配的扎实方法工作，对推理时 RL / self-refine 训练 recipe 设计有参考，重点看 §3 信用构造与消融。
recommendation.en: A solid method paper on multi-turn RL credit assignment, relevant for reasoning-time RL and self-refine training recipe design; focus on §3 credit construction and ablations.

paper.title: Beyond On-Policy Exploration: Integrating External Policy Rollouts for Reinforcement Learning in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Recent reinforcement learning methods for diffusion large language models (dLLMs) commonly rely on on-policy rollouts generated by the target dLLM itself. When successful on-policy rollouts are scarce, however, on-policy training may receive little positive reward and make only limited progress. To mitigate this problem, we explore incorporating higher-reward rollouts generated by a stronger external policy alongside on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM. However, directly incorporating these

summary.core_problem: 该工作解决 diffusion language model 做 RLVR 时的探索瓶颈：目标 dLLM 依赖 on-policy rollout，但在数学、约束求解等任务上早期很难采到正奖励样本，导致 group-based policy optimization 几乎没有可学习信号。单纯改进 dLLM 的 likelihood estimator 或 surrogate objective，不能解决正奖励 rollout 稀缺的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇对新型语言建模范式的后训练接口有参考价值。dLLM 的 RL 目前主要难点不只是序列 likelihood 不可精确计算，还包括非自回归生成策略下的探索质量。引入强外部策略 rollout 类似用 teacher policy 提供高奖励轨迹，但作者指出不能直接混用：长度分布和 reward normalization 都会影响训练稳定性。这个结论对 diffusion LM、masked LM、any-order LM 的 RL 训练都有迁移意义。
summary.technical_approach: ERILS 将目标 dLLM 的 on-policy rollout 与强外部策略生成的 external rollout 放入同一训练流程，外部策略在实验中由更强的 autoregressive LM 承担。核心有两个处理。第一是 Rollout Length Control：外部模型往往生成更长答案，而 dLLM RL 的生成长度通常固定或受限；如果直接使用长答案，虽然 verifier reward 高，但训练收益有限。长度控制把外部 completion 调到接近目标 dLLM 的生成长度，同时尽量保留可验证质量。第二是 Source-Specific Reward Processing：on-policy 和 external rollout 的 reward 分布不同，如果放在同一组里用一个均值做相对优势，会导致优化不稳定甚至 collapse；因此分别处理两个来源的 reward，再合并用于更新。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Sudoku、Countdown 和 MATH500，采用 zero-shot evaluation，并报告 stochastic multi-sample 指标。Sudoku 上，ERILS 的所有 best-of-k completion accuracy 都超过 90%，而复现的最强 on-policy baseline 在 best-of-4 只有 40.3%。Countdown 上，ERILS 的 Pass@4 为 87.5%，SPG 为 76.6%。MATH500 也有提升，但给定内容未提供完整数值。消融信息显示，直接加入外部 rollout 收益有限；不做长度控制会浪费外部样本质量；把两类 rollout 放在一起做统一 reward processing 会造成训练不稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30–40 分钟。先看 Introduction 和 Fig. 1，那里把三个现象讲得最清楚：on-policy 正奖励稀缺、外部 rollout 长度不匹配、联合 reward processing 导致 collapse。方法部分重点看 Rollout Length Control 的具体实现，以及 Source-Specific Reward Processing 如何计算 advantage 或 reward-normalized signal。实验部分优先看 Sudoku 和 Countdown 的消融，因为这两个任务最能暴露探索和稳定性问题。MATH500 结果可作为泛化参考，但不要只看最终准确率，应看外部策略质量、长度分布和训练曲线是否匹配。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses an exploration bottleneck in RLVR for diffusion language models. Existing dLLM RL methods usually rely on on-policy rollouts from the target model. When the model rarely solves the task, the verifier returns few positive rewards, and group-based policy optimization receives little useful signal. Better diffusion likelihood estimators alone do not fix this shortage of successful rollouts.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the post-training interface of non-autoregressive language models. For dLLMs, RL is hard not only because exact sequence likelihood is intractable under denoising, but also because the model may not explore successful solutions early in training. Using a stronger external policy as a source of high-reward trajectories is a natural idea, but the paper shows that naive mixing is fragile. Length mismatch and reward processing are training signals, not implementation details. The same issue is likely to appear in masked, any-order, and other non-AR language-modeling regimes.
summary_en.technical_approach: ERILS mixes on-policy rollouts from the target dLLM with external rollouts generated by a stronger fixed policy, instantiated as an autoregressive LLM. It adds two mechanisms. Rollout Length Control adjusts external completions so that their lengths are closer to the generation length used by the target dLLM, while trying to preserve verifier-assessed correctness. This matters because external answers are often much longer; directly training on them gives less benefit than their reward would suggest. Source-Specific Reward Processing avoids normalizing on-policy and external rewards with a single group mean. Since the two sources have different reward distributions, joint processing can create unstable advantages and lead to collapse. ERILS processes the sources separately before using them in the policy update.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers Sudoku, Countdown, and MATH500 under zero-shot settings with stochastic multi-sample metrics. On Sudoku, all ERILS best-of-k completion accuracies exceed 90%, while the strongest reproduced on-policy baseline reaches only 40.3% at best-of-4. On Countdown, ERILS reaches 87.5% Pass@4, compared with 76.6% for SPG. The supplied text also reports gains on MATH500, but does not include the full number. The ablations are the important part: uncontrolled external rollouts give limited gains despite high verifier rewards, length control improves their usefulness, and joint reward processing across sources destabilizes optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30–40 minutes. Read the introduction and Fig. 1 first; they isolate the three core phenomena: sparse on-policy successes, length mismatch of external rollouts, and collapse from joint reward processing. In the method section, focus on the exact form of Rollout Length Control and how Source-Specific Reward Processing computes the training signal. In the experiments, prioritize the Sudoku and Countdown ablations because they most clearly expose exploration and stability effects. Treat MATH500 as a transfer check, and look beyond final accuracy to rollout length distributions, external-policy quality, and training curves.

recommendation.zh: 读外部rollout混合和reward分流设计即可；结论依赖外部策略强度，适合作为dLLM RL接口的消融种子。
recommendation.en: Read the rollout-mixing and reward-splitting design; the claim depends on external-policy strength but is a good ablation seed for dLLM RL.

paper.title: HindSearch: Trajectory-Level Hindsight Critique for Search-Augmented Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Search-augmented LM agents are typically trained with a binary exact-match reward, which throws away most of what a failed trajectory tells us about why it failed. We introduce HindSearch, a hindsight self-distillation procedure for GRPO: after each rollout, a frozen judge writes a short critique of every failed trajectory using the gold answer, and the critique supplies an auxiliary on-policy distillation signal on the student's search actions. On the standard seven-benchmark suite with Qwen2.5

summary.core_problem: 搜索增强 LM agent 用 GRPO 训练时，二值 EM reward 只告诉整条轨迹成没成功，不告诉为什么失败；失败轨迹里的 query、检索片段和训练时可见的 gold answer 包含大量可利用的信息，却被 outcome-only 目标丢弃，导致信用分配延迟和训练不稳。
summary.importance: 属于 post-training / agent RL 方向，对预训练本身的直接启发有限，但对理解 pretrain→posttrain 接口有间接价值：它展示了如何把稀疏 outcome reward 用 hindsight 信息稠密化成 per-token 监督，且不依赖在线 process reward model。这种「训练时可见答案 → 事后批评 → 蒸馏到动作 token」的思路，对思考搜索型/工具型后训练数据合成和 RL 信号质量有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 trajectory-level hindsight critique (TLHC)，叠加在 GRPO 上。每次 rollout 后，把失败轨迹连同 gold answer 一起发给冻结的 judge（Qwen3.6-27B），生成 1–2 句关于「应该怎么搜」的批评。该批评作为前缀注入到冻结 teacher（即学生初始化，同时也是 GRPO 的 KL anchor），在学生失败轨迹的 search-action token 上计算 on-policy distillation (OPD) loss。OPD 用 clamp 系数（对 teacher-student logprob 差做 stop-gradient）只在 teacher 比 student 更自信的 token 上提梯度，下 clamp 限制梯度流向、上 clamp 防止 outlier 主导；answer token 留给 GRPO。总目标 = GRPO + λ_OPD·L_OPD，λ=0.01。关键设计是 judge 能看到 gold answer，所以批评是 directive（告诉你该做什么）而非 evaluative（打分），且事后生成无需在线 PRM。
summary.experiments: 在七个 QA benchmark（NQ、TriviaQA、PopQA、HotpotQA、2WikiMultihopQA、MuSiQue、Bamboogle）上评测，共 51,713 验证样本；训练数据为 NQ+HotpotQA 训练集（169k），其余五个 zero-shot。Backbone 为 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，retriever 为 E5-base-v2 over Wikipedia-18，top-3，最多 4 轮。HindSearch 平均 EM 39.4%，超过 Search-R1 PPO/GRPO、ZeroSearch 等搜索-RL baseline，300 步训练稳定。关键消融：去掉 judge 对 gold answer 的访问权后大部分增益消失，说明 hindsight（而非批评本身）是增益来源。OPD 每步增加约 15% 墙钟时间，2×H200 训练。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读。重点看 Method 中 TLHC 的流程和 OPD loss 的 clamp 设计——这是把自然语言批评转成 per-token 梯度且不破坏 GRPO 稳定性的关键。再看消融中「judge 看不到 gold answer 则增益消失」这一条，它直接验证了 hindsight 信号的必要性。对预训练研究员，可快速浏览，重点想这种事后稠密信号能否迁移到其他长信用分配链的 RL 场景。预计 15–20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Search-augmented LM agents trained with GRPO receive only a binary EM reward that signals whether a whole trajectory succeeded, not why it failed. A failed trajectory contains the issued queries, retrieved snippets, and—at training time—the gold answer, but an outcome-only objective discards all of this, causing long credit-assignment delays and instability.
summary_en.importance: This is post-training / agent RL work with limited direct relevance to pretraining itself, but it has indirect value for understanding the pretrain-to-posttrain interface. It shows how to densify a sparse outcome reward into per-token supervision using hindsight information, without an online process reward model. The train-time-answer → post-hoc critique → distillation-into-action-tokens pattern is relevant to reasoning/search/tool-use post-training data synthesis and RL signal quality.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory-level hindsight critique (TLHC) is added on top of GRPO. After each rollout, every failed trajectory is sent to a frozen judge (Qwen3.6-27B) together with the gold answer, producing a 1–2 sentence critique of what should have been searched differently. The critique is broadcast as a prefix to a frozen teacher (the student's initialization, also the GRPO KL anchor), whose log-probabilities supply an on-policy distillation (OPD) loss on the student's search-action tokens within failed trajectories. The OPD loss uses a clamp coefficient with a stop-gradient on the teacher-student logprob gap, so gradients flow only on tokens where the teacher is more confident than the student; a lower clamp restricts gradient flow and an upper clamp prevents outliers from dominating. Answer tokens are left to GRPO. Total objective is GRPO + λ_OPD·L_OPD with λ=0.01. The key design choice is that the judge sees the gold answer, making the critique directive rather than evaluative, and post-hoc generation removes the need for an online PRM.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on seven QA benchmarks (NQ, TriviaQA, PopQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, Bamboogle), 51,713 validation samples total; training uses NQ+HotpotQA train splits (169k), the other five are zero-shot. Backbone is Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, retriever E5-base-v2 over Wikipedia-18, top-3, up to 4 turns. HindSearch reaches 39.4% average EM, outperforming Search-R1 PPO/GRPO, ZeroSearch, and other search-RL baselines, with stable training over 300 steps. The key ablation: removing the judge's access to the gold answer erases most of the gain, isolating hindsight (rather than critique style) as the source of improvement. OPD adds ~15% wall-clock per step; trained on 2×H200.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on the Method section's TLHC procedure and the OPD clamp design—that is the mechanism that turns natural-language critique into per-token gradients without destabilizing GRPO. Then look at the ablation showing that gains vanish when the judge cannot see the gold answer, which directly validates hindsight as the causal signal. For pretrain researchers, a quick pass suffices; the transferable idea is whether such post-hoc dense signals can apply to other RL settings with long credit-assignment chains. Estimated 15–20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 本质是用 gold answer 做 hindsight relabeling 的 RL 变体，增益来源清晰，只看 ablation 部分（移除 gold answer 那组）即可。
recommendation.en: Essentially hindsight relabeling for search RL with gold answers; gain source is cleanly isolated. Read only the ablation where gold answer access is removed.

paper.title: TaPR: Test-Aware Policy Refinement for Feedback-Conditioned Code Generation
paper.abstract: Multi-turn code agents rely on execution feedback to repair incorrect programs, yet standard reinforcement learning paradigms optimize and evaluate policy performance primarily using single-shot outcome rewards. This misalignment conflates initial code generation with feedback-driven refinement, discards granular execution signals across intermediate turns, and fails to evaluate whether the policy actually acquires self-repair capabilities. We propose Test-aware Policy Refinement (TaPR), a frame

summary.core_problem: 解决多轮代码生成代理中训练目标与真实交互不一致的问题：模型需要根据执行反馈修复代码，但常规 RL 主要优化单轮最终结果。
summary.importance: 这是代码代理后训练方法的增量改进。价值在于把 execution feedback 转成逐轮 dense reward，并用一致的多轮协议衡量 self-repair，而不是只看初始生成能力。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Test-aware Policy Refinement，使用每轮测试通过率作为 dense reward，在多轮代码生成和修复过程中持续给策略反馈。方法重点不是新模型架构，而是 reward 设计和训练/评测协议对齐。
summary.experiments: 在 LiveCodeBench 的 219 个代码生成问题上，跨 6 个模型评估。TaPR 将 pooled 三轮成功率 Pass@3 提升 2.44 个百分点；在预定义的 7B/8B high-headroom 子集上，pooled accuracy 从 30.25% 提升到 33.56%，提升 3.31 个百分点，并报告 42 个 paired improvements 和 13 个 regressions。摘要还提到对 Qwen3-8B 做了 dense reward ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch in multi-turn code agents: the policy is expected to repair code from execution feedback, while standard RL often optimizes single-shot outcome rewards.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental but relevant post-training method for coding agents. Its main value is converting execution feedback into dense per-turn rewards and evaluating actual self-repair behavior under a consistent interaction protocol.
summary_en.technical_approach: TaPR uses per-turn test-pass ratio as a dense reward during feedback-conditioned code generation. The contribution is not a new architecture, but a reward design and protocol that better align training with multi-turn repair.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on 219 LiveCodeBench code-generation problems across six models. TaPR improves pooled three-turn Pass@3 by 2.44 percentage points. On a predefined 7B/8B high-headroom slice, pooled accuracy rises from 30.25% to 33.56%, a 3.31-point gain, with 42 paired improvements and 13 regressions. The abstract also mentions a matched Qwen3-8B dense-reward ablation.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和 reward 设计即可；提升不大，但它把“会修复”从单轮 pass rate 里拆出来，这点干净。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and reward design; the gains are modest, but separating repair ability from one-shot pass rate is the useful part.

paper.title: ThinkReset: Learnable Intermediate Interface Construction for Bounded-Context Long-Horizon Reasoning
paper.abstract: Long chain-of-thought reasoning improves performance on complex problems, but it also introduces redundancy accumulation, context overflow, and error anchoring. We argue that under bounded context windows, the core bottleneck is not trajectory compression or test-time control, but the absence of a reusable intermediate interface that can replace discarded history and support continued solving. We further identify a key failure mode of outcome-reward-driven long-chain reinforcement learning: when

summary.core_problem: ThinkReset 讨论的是固定上下文窗口下的长程推理状态管理问题。长 CoT 会积累冗余、保留错误假设，并在窗口接近耗尽时截断未完成的解题过程。作者认为核心问题不是简单压缩轨迹或控制生成长度，而是模型缺少一个可复用的中间接口，用来替换被丢弃的历史并继续求解。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对预训练的直接影响有限，更接近 post-train 和推理训练目标设计。但它对长推理模型的训练接口有启发：如果 RL 只给 final-answer reward，在固定窗口下，当模型还没解完题但上下文快用完时，奖励会推动模型尽快猜答案，而不是构造可继续推理的状态。这个观察对长 CoT RL、过程监督、memory compaction、latent reasoning 都有参考意义，因为训练目标需要评价“重置后还能不能继续解”，而不只是最终答案是否正确或摘要是否忠实。
summary.technical_approach: ThinkReset 是一个 text-space 的 interface writeback/reset 框架。系统在上下文使用达到阈值时触发 reset，生成一个新的中间状态，用它替换此前冗长的推理轨迹，然后从该状态继续解题。与轨迹压缩方法不同，它不把目标设为复原原始推理链、压短长度或保持局部 fidelity，而是直接优化 post-reset continuation success，也就是重置后的状态是否足以支持后续求解。方法的关键转向是把中间状态当成可训练对象，而不是把它当成历史摘要。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文内容主要是问题定义和方法动机，未列出具体 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练数据规模或数值结果。可确认的实验结论是：作者声称在多个 long-horizon reasoning benchmarks 上，固定上下文窗口内学习可复用中间接口能稳定提升 success rate 和 reasoning stability。更细的数字、消融和对比方法需要查阅实验章节；特别应关注 ThinkReset 与普通摘要压缩、无 reset、长度控制、trajectory retention、final-answer-only RL 的差异。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 15–20 分钟。先看引言中对 bounded-context long-horizon reasoning 的重新定义，以及 outcome-reward-driven long-chain RL 的失败模式分析。然后看方法部分如何定义 interface writeback、触发阈值、reset 后的 continuation objective。如果有实验章节，优先看三类消融：中间接口是否直接优化 continuation success、不同 reset threshold 的影响、与摘要压缩或轨迹保留方法的比较。对基座训练研究者来说，最值得保留的是训练信号设计，而不是具体的文本改写模板。

summary_en.core_problem: ThinkReset studies long-horizon reasoning under a bounded context window. Long chain-of-thought traces accumulate redundancy, preserve wrong hypotheses, and can be truncated before the solution is complete. The paper frames the main bottleneck as the absence of a reusable intermediate interface that can replace discarded history while still allowing the model to keep solving.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training and reasoning-objective design than to base pretraining directly. Its useful point is about the training signal: with final-answer-only RL under a fixed context budget, an unfinished trajectory near window exhaustion may be rewarded for guessing quickly rather than preserving a state that supports continued reasoning. This matters for long-CoT RL, process supervision, memory compaction, and latent-reasoning interfaces. The objective should test whether the rewritten state remains solvable, not only whether it is short, faithful to the original trace, or followed by a correct final answer.
summary_en.technical_approach: ThinkReset instantiates the idea in text space. When context usage reaches a threshold, the system writes back a new intermediate state, discards the preceding long trace, and continues reasoning from that state. The interface is treated as a trainable object. The optimization target is post-reset continuation success rather than local reconstruction fidelity, length reduction, or trajectory scheduling. This separates ThinkReset from standard summarization-style compression: the rewritten state does not need to reproduce the old chain token by token; it needs to preserve enough problem-solving state for the next phase.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full text mainly contains the problem formulation and motivation, not the detailed experimental section. It does not specify benchmark names, model sizes, training data, or numeric gains. The reported high-level result is that learning reusable intermediate interfaces under fixed context windows improves success rate and reasoning stability across multiple long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. The important missing details to inspect are comparisons against no-reset baselines, summary compression, trajectory-retention methods, length-control heuristics, and final-answer-only RL.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 15–20 minutes. Read the introduction carefully for the reformulation from trajectory retention to intermediate-interface learning, and for the analysis of final-answer reward under context exhaustion. Then inspect the method section for the reset trigger, interface writeback format, and continuation-success objective. If the experimental section is available, focus on ablations over the objective, reset threshold, and comparisons with compression or trajectory-control baselines. The main reusable idea is the training objective for continued solvability, not the particular text template used for rewriting.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是它对长链 RL 失败模式的诊断，不是结果表；先读“premature guessing”那段，再看 interface writeback 是否能迁移到 latent/stateful reasoning 设定。
recommendation.en: What matters here is the failure diagnosis of long-chain RL, not the headline numbers; read the premature-guessing argument first, then ask whether the writeback interface transfers to latent or stateful reasoning.

paper.title: Learning Stateful Predictive Knowledge From Experience
paper.abstract: As large language model (LLM) agents increasingly learn from experience, they primarily rely on trajectory-level reflection to extract insights. Viewed through the lens of predictive knowledge, we argue that this approach operates on episodic hindsight rather than predictive foresight, yielding brittle, path-dependent heuristics. To address this, we propose Stateful Knowledge Learning (SKL). SKL shifts the agent's focus from trajectory-level summarization to maintaining Stateful Knowledge: expli

summary.core_problem: 论文解决 LLM agent 从交互经验中学习时过度依赖 trajectory-level reflection 的问题。传统反思把一整条轨迹事后总结成经验，容易把环境规律和偶然路径混在一起；作者主张把知识表示为 state-grounded predictive knowledge，即每个状态下对未来结果、转移风险、子目标距离或机会窗口的显式预测。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近 agent learning / RL-style post-training，对基座预训练的启发在于经验数据应如何组织成可学习信号。它强调训练样本不应只是“成功/失败轨迹 + 反思文本”，而应把状态、动作、后继结果和预测性声明绑定起来。这对构造 agent SFT/RL 数据、长期记忆、环境交互式持续学习有参考意义。它也提示一个更一般的问题：LLM 从经验中学到的不是越长的总结越好，而是要能在相同或相似状态上复用的预测。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Stateful Knowledge Learning（SKL）。agent 维护一个按状态索引的知识表 {z_s}，每个 z_s 是对当前状态未来结果的显式声明。与 Reflexion 类方法不同，SKL 不在完整 trajectory 结束后生成全局 critique，而是在多次 trial 中收集同一状态附近的后续片段 {τ_n^H(s)}，再聚合这些 state-specific evidence 更新 z_s。决策时，policy 以当前状态 s 和对应知识 z_s 为条件选择动作。作者还提出两个可扩展训练版本：SKL-SD 用 self-distillation 训练模型从经验中抽取和更新 stateful knowledge；SKL-RL 用强化学习进一步训练 agent 通过状态级经验聚合和 predictive bootstrapping 改进策略。predictive bootstrapping 的含义是，后继状态已经学到的预测可以反向传播到前序状态，形成更细粒度的经验复用。
summary.experiments: 论文用一个 stochastic FrozenLake 例子解释机制：在带滑动随机性的环境里，“早期不要向右走”这类轨迹级经验不稳定，而“当坑在相邻位置时，向右有风险”这类状态绑定预测更容易泛化。规模化实验覆盖 WebShop、ScienceWorld 和 contamination-free ChessPuzzles。正文片段给出的结论是，SKL 系列方法相较 reflection-based training paradigms 有更好的表现，尤其体现为更细粒度的泛化和知识自举能力；所给内容未包含完整表格中的具体提升数字，因此不应额外推断幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。优先看 Section 2 的 motivating example 和 Figure 1，因为那里最清楚地区分了 trajectory hindsight 与 stateful foresight。随后看 Section 3 中 SKL-SD、SKL-RL 的训练目标和数据构造方式，重点判断状态表示如何归一化、相同状态如何聚合、多步后继证据如何截断。实验部分建议看 WebShop、ScienceWorld、ChessPuzzles 三类任务的差异：前两者偏交互环境，ChessPuzzles 更能检查是否只是记忆轨迹模板。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a structural weakness in experience-based LLM agents: most reflection methods summarize whole trajectories after the fact, which mixes reusable environment dynamics with path-specific accidents. The proposed alternative is to learn explicit predictive knowledge tied to states, so that the agent can reason about what the current state implies for future outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent-learning and post-training paper, but it is relevant to pretraining researchers interested in experience data and continual learning. It argues that interaction traces should not be reduced to global reflections such as “avoid this strategy early.” A better training signal binds state, action context, successor evidence, and predictive statements. That framing is useful for designing agent SFT data, RL environments, memory systems, and synthetic experience corpora.
summary_en.technical_approach: Stateful Knowledge Learning maintains a state-indexed table of declarative knowledge z_s. For each visited state, the agent asks what that state predicts about future outcomes. During later updates, it aggregates multiple local future snippets around the same state, rather than summarizing a single full trajectory. The policy then conditions on both the current state and z_s when choosing actions. The paper also introduces two scalable variants. SKL-SD uses self-distillation to train the model to extract and update stateful knowledge from experience. SKL-RL uses reinforcement learning so the agent learns to aggregate state-level evidence and bootstrap predictive knowledge backward from successor states.
summary_en.experiments: A stochastic FrozenLake example illustrates why state-level predictive knowledge can generalize better than trajectory-level hindsight. In a slippery transition setting, a reflection such as “do not move right early” is brittle, while a statement such as “moving right is hazardous when a pit is adjacent” is tied to the actual state and can transfer. Larger experiments are reported on WebShop, ScienceWorld, and contamination-free ChessPuzzles. The provided text states that SKL variants outperform reflection-based training paradigms and show benefits from finer granularity and predictive bootstrapping, but it does not provide the detailed numerical gains needed to quantify the margin.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 25–35 minutes. Start with the motivating example and Figure 1, since they contain the main conceptual distinction between trajectory-level hindsight and state-level foresight. Then read the algorithm section for SKL-SD and SKL-RL, paying attention to how states are represented, how multiple visits to a state are aggregated, and how far into the future each local trajectory snippet extends. In the experiments, compare WebShop and ScienceWorld with ChessPuzzles: the latter is useful for checking whether the method learns reusable predictive structure rather than memorizing interaction scripts.

recommendation.zh: 读方法定义和 RL 训练接口即可；若实验干净，它会影响 agent memory 该存轨迹还是存状态预测。
recommendation.en: Read the method definition and RL interface; if the experiments are clean, it shifts agent memory from trajectory logs to state-conditioned predictions.

institutions: Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences
AI Lab, The Yangtze River Delta

paper.title: SVR: Self-Verifying Refinement via Joint Verdict-Confidence Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Test-Time Compute
paper.abstract: Scaling test-time computation can improve language-model reasoning, but uniform budgets waste computation on easy inputs, while verifier-guided refinement relies on external feedback. We introduce Self-Verifying Refinement (SVR), an oracle-free multi-turn reinforcement learning framework that learns to use self-verification as a compute-control policy. At each turn, the model produces a solution together with a discrete correctness verdict and a confidence score; it retains the current answer on

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多轮推理 refinement 中的计算分配问题：模型什么时候应该保留当前答案，什么时候应该继续修改。关键约束是推理时不能依赖外部 verifier、执行器或真实正确性信号，只能用模型自己生成的判断和置信度来控制停止。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning post-train 和 test-time compute 设计有参考价值。它把 self-verification 从一个事后解释信号，变成了控制推理预算的策略信号。这个角度值得注意，因为后续预训练或中训练如果要培养可控推理能力，不能只看最终答案正确率，还要看模型能否识别当前状态是否值得继续计算。论文也提醒一个实际问题：置信度校准错误会直接变成计算分配错误。低估会浪费 refinement，高估会提前停止在错误答案上。
summary.technical_approach: SVR 让模型在每一轮同时输出三类内容：解答、离散 verdict，以及一个表示当前答案正确概率的 confidence。verdict 包括 Correct、Incorrect、Unsure。推理时，如果 verdict 是 Correct 且 confidence 超过阈值，就停止并返回当前答案；否则把原题、上一轮解答和模型自己的 self-verification 一起放入下一轮 prompt，继续 refinement。训练使用固定 horizon 轨迹，不在训练阶段直接优化实际 token 用量。奖励来自真实正确性，但真实标签只用于构造 reward，不进入 refinement prompt，也不在推理时使用。优化目标基于 GRPO，把每轮的解题得分、self-verification 得分和格式得分合成 trajectory return。一个细节是：中间轮参与 return 计算并作为后续上下文，但不是独立优化样本；被监督的是最终 completion tokens。confidence 部分使用类似 Brier score 的校准目标，并额外惩罚高置信错误，鼓励模型识别错误状态和可停止的正确状态。和固定预算 refinement 相比，SVR 的差别不在于多生成几轮，而在于把“是否继续”变成了模型内部策略。和外部 verifier 方法相比，它把部署时的信息边界收紧到模型自身输出。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3.5-2B，在 7 个数学推理 benchmark 上评估，覆盖算术搜索、小学数学应用题、竞赛数学和多步推理。SVR 的 All-7 macro-average accuracy 为 0.563，平均推理轮数为 2.99。相对最强 non-oracle 多轮 baseline 提升 7.5 个百分点；在完整系统比较中，比论文评估的 fixed-budget oracle-guided reference 高 4.4 个百分点。固定预算 sweep 显示，同一个训练后 policy 如果强制所有样本在同一轮停止，没有任何一个共享停止轮能匹配自适应 SVR，说明收益主要来自按样本保留答案，而不是简单增加 refinement 轮数。论文还报告 SVR 在总准确率上接近 10-sample GRPO majority voting，但 token 消耗大约只有一半。这个结果支持 self-verification 作为内部 compute-control signal 的可行性，但也要注意实验集中在数学推理和 2B 规模模型，结论还不能直接外推到更大模型、代码执行类任务或开放式任务。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 Introduction、方法部分的 Joint Verdict–Confidence RL、推理时 stopping rule，以及 Table 1 / Figure 1 附近的主结果。重点看两个问题：第一，reward 如何同时约束答案正确性、verdict 和 confidence；第二，固定 horizon 训练为什么仍能在推理时产生计算节省。消融部分如果完整可见，应优先看 confidence 阈值、verdict 类型、去掉校准项、固定停止轮 sweep。预计阅读 20–30 分钟即可把主要设计和局限看清。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets adaptive refinement for reasoning models: when should a model keep its current answer, and when should it spend another refinement turn? The key constraint is that inference cannot rely on an external verifier, executor, or correctness oracle. The stopping decision must be driven by signals produced by the policy itself.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to reasoning post-training and inference-time compute than to base pretraining directly. Its useful contribution is to treat self-verification as a control signal, not merely as a post-hoc uncertainty statement. That distinction matters because confidence calibration errors become compute-allocation errors: underconfidence wastes refinement on already-correct answers, while overconfidence can terminate incorrect trajectories too early. For pretraining researchers interested in trainable reasoning behavior, the paper points to a concrete interface between answer quality, calibration, and compute control.
summary_en.technical_approach: SVR makes the model emit, at every turn, a solution, a discrete verdict, and a confidence estimate. The verdict is one of Correct, Incorrect, or Unsure. At inference, the trajectory stops only when the verdict is Correct and the confidence exceeds a threshold; otherwise, the next prompt includes the original problem, the previous solution, and the model’s own self-verification. Correctness labels are used during training to build rewards, but they are never inserted into refinement prompts and are not available to the inference controller. Training uses fixed-horizon trajectories with a GRPO-style objective. Per-turn solve, verification, and format scores are averaged into a trajectory return, while optimization is applied to the final completion tokens rather than treating intermediate turns as separate samples. The confidence reward uses a Brier-style calibration term, penalizes confident mistakes, and encourages recognizing both error states and correct states that are eligible for stopping. Compared with fixed-budget refinement, the main change is not longer reasoning but learned answer retention. Compared with verifier-guided methods, the deployment-time information boundary is reduced to the model’s own outputs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3.5-2B on seven mathematical reasoning benchmarks, including arithmetic search, grade-school word problems, competition math, and multi-step reasoning. SVR reaches an All-7 macro-average accuracy of 0.563 with 2.99 inference turns on average. It improves over the strongest non-oracle multi-turn baseline by 7.5 percentage points and is reported to exceed the evaluated fixed-budget oracle-guided reference by 4.4 points in the complete-system comparison. Fixed-budget sweeps with the same trained policies show that no single shared stopping turn matches adaptive SVR, which supports the claim that the gain comes from instance-level retention rather than simply generating more turns. SVR also matches the aggregate accuracy of 10-sample GRPO majority voting while using roughly half as many tokens. The scope is still bounded: the evidence is mainly mathematical reasoning with a 2B-scale model, so transfer to larger models, code execution tasks, or open-ended generation remains an open question.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction, the Joint Verdict–Confidence RL objective, the inference-time stopping rule, and the main results around Table 1 and Figure 1. The highest-value details are how the reward couples correctness, verdict, and confidence, and why fixed-horizon training can still yield token savings at inference. If the ablations are available, check threshold sensitivity, removal of calibration terms, verdict variants, and fixed-turn stopping sweeps. A focused read should take about 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 自验证+RL实现自适应测试时计算的思路很实用，校准感知的奖励设计可直接引入内部RL后训练ablation，重点看§3的奖励定义
recommendation.en: Self-verification + RL for adaptive test-time compute is practical; the calibration-aware reward design can be directly introduced into internal RL post-training ablations, focus on §3 reward formulation.

paper.title: TAPO: Transition-Aware Policy Optimization for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Recently, Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a crucial paradigm for the post-training of Large Language Model (LLM) agents. However, existing methods predominantly rely on sparse task rewards for policy optimization, failing to fully exploit another class of inherently dense supervisory signals naturally present during online interaction: environmental feedback following action execution. Recent theoretical studies suggest that generalization in multi-step, goal-oriented tasks hinges on

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是 LLM agent 强化学习过度依赖稀疏任务奖励、没有显式利用每一步动作后的环境反馈，导致长程任务中规划和泛化不稳定的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于 post-train / agentic RL 方法，但对预训练研究也有启发。它强调 rollout 中的环境转移反馈是一种密集、动作条件化的训练信号，可以约束模型对“动作会怎样改变状态”的内部表征。这个思路和预训练里的 next-token loss 有相似点：不是只优化最终答案，而是让模型在交互轨迹中学习局部因果结构。对后续做 RL pretrain、交互式数据合成、world-model-style LM 训练有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: TAPO 是一个交替训练框架。常规阶段使用现有 agentic RL 算法做 policy optimization，例如基于 group relative advantage 的方法；辅助阶段复用同一批在线 rollout 数据，把每个 transition 转成监督样本，让共享 backbone 根据当前观察状态和已执行动作预测环境返回的后续反馈。这样做有两个取舍。第一，它不单独训练一个外置 world model，而是把转移预测作为共享模型的辅助目标，避免测试时增加额外推理模块。第二，它不额外采集专家数据或环境数据，而是复用标准 RL rollout，因此成本主要来自训练阶段的额外监督 loss。和先预训练 transition model 再做 RL 的方法相比，TAPO 把 transition supervision 放进 RL 过程内部，用来持续校准策略模型对环境动态和动作后果的敏感性。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个长程 agent benchmark：WebShop 和 ALFWorld。论文声称 TAPO 在不同模型规模和不同 policy optimization 算法上都带来稳定提升，说明转移监督不是依赖某一个具体 RL 实现。分析部分的主要结论是，加入 transition supervision 后，模型对环境反馈更敏感，长程决策更有效。给定内容没有提供具体参数规模、训练步数、奖励提升幅度或消融表数字，因此不宜夸大定量结论；读结果表时应重点看 TAPO 相对原始 RL baseline 的提升、不同辅助 loss 权重的消融、以及是否存在 transition prediction 与 task reward 不一致时的退化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 到 35 分钟。优先看方法图和训练流程，确认 policy optimization 与 transition supervision 如何交替、transition target 具体预测的是环境 observation 还是更结构化的 feedback。然后看 WebShop / ALFWorld 的主结果表，判断提升是否跨环境、跨模型规模、跨 RL 算法成立。消融部分比主表更重要：需要看去掉 transition supervision 后的差距、不同采样数据量下的效果、辅助目标权重对最终 reward 的影响。若关注预训练，可重点思考这种 transition prediction 是否能扩展到大规模交互语料，成为 agent LM 的持续预训练目标。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a weakness in RL training for LLM agents: standard methods rely heavily on sparse task rewards and do not explicitly use the dense environmental feedback observed after each executed action.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and agentic RL paper, but it has clear relevance to pretraining-oriented research. It treats transition feedback from rollouts as a dense, action-conditioned learning signal that can shape the model’s internal understanding of how actions change the environment. This connects to broader questions in RL pretraining, interactive data generation, and world-model-like objectives for language models: the model should not only optimize final success, but also learn local consequence structure along a trajectory.
summary_en.technical_approach: TAPO is an alternating training framework. One stage performs ordinary policy optimization with existing agentic RL methods, such as group-based relative-advantage algorithms. The other stage reuses the same online rollout data as supervised transition data: given the current observation and the executed action, the shared backbone is trained to predict the subsequent environmental feedback. The design avoids training a separate external world model and adds no inference-time module. It also avoids extra expert data or additional environment sampling, since the supervision is extracted from standard RL trajectories. Compared with approaches that pretrain a transition model before RL, TAPO injects transition supervision inside the RL loop, so the policy model is repeatedly nudged to represent action consequences while its policy is being optimized.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses two long-horizon agent benchmarks, WebShop and ALFWorld. The paper reports consistent gains across model scales and policy optimization algorithms, suggesting that the benefit is not tied to a single RL implementation. The analysis claims that transition supervision increases the model’s sensitivity to environmental feedback and improves long-horizon decision making. The provided content does not include exact parameter sizes, rollout budgets, reward numbers, or ablation values, so the quantitative strength should be checked directly in the result tables. Important evidence would include gains over the corresponding RL baseline, robustness across environments, auxiliary-loss weight ablations, and cases where transition prediction may conflict with reward optimization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the method figure and training loop to see how policy optimization alternates with transition supervision, and clarify whether the target is raw observation text or a more structured feedback signal. Then inspect the WebShop and ALFWorld result tables to verify whether the gains hold across environments, model sizes, and RL algorithms. The ablations matter more than the headline numbers: look for the effect of removing transition supervision, changing the amount of rollout data, and tuning the auxiliary loss weight. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is whether transition prediction can scale into a continual pretraining objective for agent-oriented language models.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 pretrain 论文，但它把 rollout 里的环境反馈重新解释成密集建模信号，值得看方法节和 ablation；若增益只出现在小环境，就当作 agent world-model 的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it usefully reframes environment feedback as dense modeling signal; read the method and ablations, and treat it as weak evidence unless gains hold beyond toy agent setups.

paper.title: RLPF: Reinforcement Learning from Performance Feedback for Code Generation
paper.abstract: Code models are increasingly trained with execution feedback, but most training signals still stop at correctness. This leaves an important gap for systems code: two programs can pass the same tests while differing greatly in runtime. We study how to train code agents to prefer faster correct implementations, rather than treating efficiency only as an evaluation metric. The key difficulty is that runtime is a fragile reward. It is meaningful only after a program is correct, varies across tasks,

summary.core_problem: 代码模型的执行反馈训练大多只用到正确性信号，忽略了运行时性能；而直接把 runtime 作为 reward 又很脆弱——只有在程序正确时才有意义，跨任务量纲不一致，且当一组 rollout 全部失败时 GRPO 拿不到任何有效排序。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train 范畴的 RL 奖励设计工作，对预训练研究的间接启发在于：把稀疏、异质、依赖前置条件的执行信号拆成分阶段 reward，是一种可迁移的 reward shaping 思路；对关心 RLVR、代码 RL、可验证奖励设计的研究者有参考价值，但不触及基座预训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 RLPF，用 GRPO 训练代码 agent。reward 分两段：失败段按执行管线进度排序（可抽取 → 可编译 → 可执行 → 通过 oracle），给失败样本提供 progress 信号；成功段按相对性能排序，用 (baseline_runtime − candidate_runtime)/(baseline_runtime − reference_runtime) 衡量候选实现相对 baseline 与专家参考的性能差距闭合比例，从而把不同任务的 runtime 归一化到可比尺度。
summary.experiments: 在 PerfCodeBench 的 family-disjoint 测试集上，基于 Qwen3-32B，correct-and-runnable 率从 11.1% 提升到 54.6%，CGRE 从 8.1% 提升到 38.6%；多数正确输出同时快于 baseline。在 EffiBench-X 上有一定迁移。消融显示完整 staged reward 优于 correctness-only 和 runtime-only；用 GPT-5.4 生成的性能参考有帮助但稳定性不如人工专家实现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，约 15–20 分钟。重点看 reward 公式与两段式设计的衔接逻辑，以及 GRPO 在全失败组场景下的处理；消融表和 EffiBench-X 迁移结果可快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: Execution-feedback training for code models mostly stops at correctness, ignoring runtime; yet using runtime directly as a reward is fragile—it is only meaningful after correctness, has task-dependent scale, and provides no useful ordering under GRPO when an entire group of rollouts fails.
summary_en.importance: A post-training RL reward-design paper. Its indirect relevance to pretraining research is the staged shaping of a sparse, heterogeneous, precondition-dependent execution signal into a comparable reward—a pattern transferable to RLVR and verifiable-reward design. It does not touch base-model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: RLPF trains a code agent with GRPO using a two-regime reward. In the failure regime, rollouts are ordered by progress through the execution pipeline (extractable → compilable → runnable → oracle-passing), giving partial credit before correctness. In the success regime, correct programs are ranked by relative performance: (baseline_runtime − candidate_runtime)/(baseline_runtime − reference_runtime), normalizing runtime across tasks against a task-specific baseline and an expert reference.
summary_en.experiments: On the family-disjoint split of PerfCodeBench, Qwen3-32B improves correct-and-runnable rate from 11.1% to 54.6% and CGRE from 8.1% to 38.6%; most correct outputs also beat the baseline. Modest transfer to EffiBench-X. Ablations show the full staged reward beats correctness-only and runtime-only variants; GPT-5.4-generated performance references help but are less stable than curated expert references.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the reward formulas and how the two regimes connect, plus the handling of all-failure groups under GRPO. The ablation table and EffiBench-X transfer results can be scanned quickly.

recommendation.zh: 将代码执行效率引入 RL 奖励函数，设计了分阶段的 reward 机制解决 runtime reward 稀疏和脆弱的问题，对做 Code RL 和后训练对齐的研究员有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Introduces code execution efficiency into the RL reward function, designing a staged reward mechanism to solve the sparsity and fragility of runtime rewards. Valuable reference for researchers working on Code RL and post-training alignment.

paper.title: Group-Reflective Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is effective for training large language model agents. However, terminal rewards provide only coarse trajectory-level supervision, leaving successful behaviors, recurring mistakes, and incidental choices entangled in the same outcome signal. Existing agentic self-distillation methods enrich sparse supervision with natural-language skills, but skills retrieved externally or extracted from a single trajectory by stronger models may mismatch cur

summary.core_problem: 现有基于可验证奖励的Agent强化学习（RLVR）仅依赖粗粒度的轨迹级终局奖励，成功行为、重复错误、偶然选择被纠缠在同一个结果信号中；已有的Agent自蒸馏方法存在三类缺陷：外部检索的技能与当前同策略经验不匹配、强外部模型提取的技能超出当前策略的能力边界、单轨迹独立提取的技能仅捕捉路径特定细节而非区分成败的核心行为模式。
summary.importance: 属于Agent后训练强化学习方向的方法改进，对预训练研究的可迁移启发包括三点：自蒸馏监督信号必须与当前模型能力对齐，不能使用能力超配的外部教师；正负样本的群体对比思路可迁移到预训练合成数据筛选、偏好信号构造场景；粗粒度终局奖励拆解为细粒度步骤级信用的机制，可为RL预训练的奖励设计提供参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出群体反思自蒸馏（GRSD），核心流程为：1）对每个prompt采样G条同策略rollout，通过验证器分配任务奖励和二元成败标签；2）用stop-gradient冻结的当前策略对每条轨迹做自反思，识别影响结果的关键决策、解释其对成败的贡献、总结需强化或规避的具体行为；3）用同策略的stop-gradient快照对比成功与失败轨迹的反思结果，合成紧凑的群体反思指导，既保证指导与当前策略能力对齐，又能捕捉区分成败的行为模式；4）优化阶段将群体反思指导作为特权上下文输入自教师，调制GRPO的轨迹级优势得到turn级信用分配，同时保留验证器决定的优势符号、不改变学习方向，最终联合优化任务目标与反思目标。
summary.experiments: 在多类Agent环境、多个模型规模上完成评测，GRSD取得领先的综合性能，对未见过的任务具备更强泛化能力；现有公开全文片段未披露具体性能数值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先阅读第1节最后两段明确两个核心研究挑战，再重点看第3.2节（群体反思指导构造逻辑）和第3.3节（turn级信用分配机制），实验部分扫读主表了解性能趋势即可，预计阅读时间20-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agentic reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) relies solely on coarse trajectory-level terminal rewards, which entangle successful behaviors, recurring errors, and incidental choices in a single outcome signal. Prior agentic self-distillation methods have three key limitations: externally retrieved skills mismatch current on-policy experience, skills extracted by stronger external models exceed the current policy's capability boundary, and skills extracted independently from single trajectories capture only path-specific details rather than outcome-discriminative core behavioral patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is a methodological improvement in post-training agent RL, with three transferable insights for pretraining research: self-distillation supervision must be aligned with the current model's capability instead of using an overqualified external teacher; group-level contrast between positive and negative samples can be applied to synthetic pretraining data filtering and preference signal construction; the mechanism for decomposing coarse terminal rewards into fine-grained step-level credit provides reference for reward design in RL pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRSD (Group-Reflective Self-Distillation) follows four core steps: 1) For each prompt, sample G on-policy rollouts and assign task rewards plus binary success/failure labels via a verifier; 2) A stop-gradient frozen copy of the current policy performs self-reflection on each trajectory, identifying outcome-critical decisions, explaining their contribution to success or failure, and summarizing concrete behaviors to reinforce or avoid; 3) A stop-gradient snapshot of the same policy contrasts reflections from successful and failed rollouts to synthesize compact group-reflective guidance, which is both capability-aligned and outcome-discriminative; 4) During optimization, group-reflective guidance is fed to a self-teacher as privileged context to modulate trajectory-level GRPO advantages into turn-specific credit, while preserving the verifier-determined sign of advantages to avoid altering learning direction. A joint objective optimizes both task performance and reflection quality.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluations across diverse agentic environments and multiple model scales show GRSD delivers leading aggregate performance and stronger generalization to unseen tasks; no specific numeric performance results are included in the available full text excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: First read the last two paragraphs of Section 1 to clarify the two core research challenges, then focus on Section 3.2 (group-reflective guidance construction) and Section 3.3 (turn-level credit assignment mechanism). Scan main experiment tables for performance trends. Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: RLVR训练信号增强的实用方法，组级对比反思的设计可迁移到推理模型的RL训练中，重点看§3.2的特权指导构建逻辑。
recommendation.en: Practical method for RLVR training signal enhancement; the group-level comparative reflection design can be migrated to RL training of reasoning models, focus on §3.2 privileged guidance construction logic.

paper.title: SkillMentor: LLM Agent Self-Evolution via Learning Blind-Spot Diagnosis
paper.abstract: Agent self-evolution has primarily focused on learning how to act, while overlooking an equally important capability: learning to discover what an agent does not know. Existing approaches typically assume that failure discovery is given, focusing on how to repair failures once they are identified. We ask whether blind-spot diagnosis itself can be learned. We thus study diagnosis as an agent capability separate from execution, and exclude two alternative sources of progress: executor adaptation a

summary.core_problem: 现有agent自进化研究默认失败发现是给定的，忽略了「发现自身未知」的核心能力，且性能提升多依赖执行器适配或人工监督，而非诊断能力本身。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将盲点评诊作为独立于执行的agent能力研究，在严格排除执行器更新和人工监督的约束下，验证了诊断能力可独立驱动性能提升。
summary.technical_approach: 提出SkillMentor框架，通过强化学习训练Mentor策略，自动生成诊断任务、识别重复失败模式、整理为可复用的纠正技能；所有性能提升仅来自诊断能力改进，不涉及执行器微调或人工标注。
summary.experiments: 在AppWorld和BFCLv3两个agent基准上测试，相比基线平均提升44.2%的执行器性能，验证了独立诊断能力的有效性。
