paper.title: UniVR: Thinking in Visual Space for Unified Visual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Learning broad world knowledge directly from raw visual data is a fundamental capability of intelligence. We introduce UniVR, the first investigation into simultaneously learning complex reasoning, fine-grained physical dynamics, and long-term planning from pure visual demonstrations. At its core, UniVR features VR-GRPO, a reinforcement learning paradigm with complementary global and step-level rewards. This approach enforces logical coherence and physical consistency throughout the reasoning pr

summary.core_problem: 探索模型能否仅从纯视觉 demonstrations 中学习复杂推理、物理动态和长程规划，而不依赖图文配对数据。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是视觉推理训练范式和评测套件。它关心的是视觉空间中的 reasoning，而不是传统图像分类或检测；对 native multimodal pretraining 和 RL 后训练接口有弱相关启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 UniVR 及 VR-GRPO。VR-GRPO 使用全局奖励和 step-level 奖励的互补设计，分别约束最终逻辑一致性和中间过程的物理一致性，避免为每个任务手写规则或依赖 image-text pairs。论文还构建 VR-X，汇集 16 个来源，覆盖长程操作、空间谜题和物理推理。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 UniVR 在 VR-X 上最高提升 25%，并且纯视觉推理能力还能迁移提升若干多模态任务表现。未提供模型参数量、视觉数据规模、baseline 名称和各子任务细分结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether complex reasoning, physical dynamics, and long-horizon planning can be learned directly from pure visual demonstrations without image-text supervision.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a visual reasoning training paradigm plus a benchmark suite. It is relevant to native multimodal training because it treats visual sequences as a reasoning substrate rather than as inputs to be captioned first.
summary_en.technical_approach: UniVR introduces VR-GRPO, which combines global rewards with step-level rewards to enforce both final logical coherence and intermediate physical consistency. It avoids task-specific heuristics and image-text pairs. The paper also builds VR-X from 16 sources spanning long-horizon manipulation, spatial puzzles, and physical reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports up to a 25% improvement on VR-X and claims transfer benefits to several multimodal tasks. It does not specify model size, amount of visual demonstration data, baseline list, or detailed per-domain gains.

recommendation.zh: 只看 VR-GRPO 奖励分解和 VR-X 任务组成；纯视觉 reasoning 的方向有意思，但摘要信息不足以信服。
recommendation.en: Read only the VR-GRPO reward decomposition and VR-X task mix; pure-visual reasoning is interesting, but the abstract is not enough to trust the claim.

paper.title: When Does Reward Teach State? A Hidden-Automaton Instrument and the Group-Language Boundary
paper.abstract: Does a reinforcement-learning agent that earns high reward represent its task's latent state, or only a reward-correlated shortcut? The question is usually unanswerable: the "true state" is undefined. We make it exactly answerable with a white-box instrument: express the task as a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA), let the agent observe a symbol stream and intermittently choose the next symbol under partial control, and grant one sparse terminal reward for acceptance. Knowing the autom

summary.core_problem: 无法可测量地区分高奖励RL智能体是学到了任务隐状态，还是仅利用了与奖励相关的捷径
summary.importance: 原理分析类贡献，首次提出白盒隐藏自动机（DFA）工具，将奖励获得与隐状态学习解耦为可独立测量的指标
summary.technical_approach: 将任务建模为确定性有限自动机，智能体观测符号流并间歇选择下一个符号，仅在自动机接受时给予稀疏终端奖励；利用DFA已知的最优回报和精确隐状态真值，分别测量奖励得分和状态表示学习情况
summary.experiments: 实验发现弱on-policy RL设置下，无论采用何种架构，智能体都能获得高奖励但隐状态探测结果处于随机水平

summary_en.core_problem: There is no measurable way to distinguish whether high-reward RL agents learn the task's latent state or only exploit reward-correlated shortcuts.
summary_en.importance: Theoretical analysis contribution, first proposing a white-box hidden DFA instrument to decouple reward acquisition and latent state learning into independently measurable metrics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Models the task as a deterministic finite automaton, where the agent observes a symbol stream and intermittently selects the next symbol, receiving only a sparse terminal reward upon acceptance; uses the DFA's known optimal return and exact latent state ground truth to measure reward score and state representation learning separately.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments show that under weak on-policy RL, regardless of architecture, agents achieve high reward while latent state probe performance remains at chance level.

recommendation.zh: RL基础机制分析，对RLHF奖励信号设计有弱参考价值，仅看摘要和§4实验结论即可
recommendation.en: Basic RL mechanism analysis with weak reference value for RLHF reward design; only read the abstract and §4 experiment conclusions.

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Physics: Post-training LLMs with Continuous Rewards
paper.abstract: Partial differential equations (PDEs) are foundational to modeling in science and engineering, but constructing reliable numerical solvers remains labor-intensive, demanding expert knowledge of discretization schemes, stability conditions, and boundary treatments. Recent work has begun to frame PDE solving as a code-generation task for large language models (LLMs), yet existing approaches operate primarily at inference time: relying on prompting, debugging, self-refinement, and test-time scaling

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的问题是：如何把 PDE 求解器代码生成中的连续物理误差，转成可验证的 RL 训练信号，而不是只在推理时用 prompt、debug loop 或测试时搜索来补救。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的启发主要在 post-train 训练信号设计。它不是通用预训练论文，但提供了一个清晰例子：可验证奖励不一定只能是二值的 pass/fail，也可以来自确定性仿真环境中的连续函数空间误差。这个方向对代码模型、科学计算模型、以及更一般的 RLVR 都有参考价值。关键点在于，PDE solver 的好坏不是“能运行”就够了，代码可能形状正确、无 NaN，却违反稳定性条件、边界条件或物理残差。因此，连续奖励能给模型更密的学习信号，也更接近真实任务的质量结构。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 RLVP，核心流程是先用教师 solver bank 做 SFT，再用 GRPO 做强化学习。模型的动作是生成 solver 程序；环境执行代码；verifier 给出奖励。奖励由三部分组成：第一是硬门控的执行有效性，例如代码能否运行、输出是否有限、格式和接口是否满足要求；第二是轨迹误差奖励 R_traj，把模型生成的数值解和隐藏参考解在函数空间中比较；第三是物理残差一致性奖励 R_phys，用 PDE residual 约束解是否符合方程结构。这个设计和常见 RLVR 的差别在于，它没有把 verifier 简化成单元测试通过与否，而是保留数值模拟任务中的连续质量差异。训练覆盖 8 类 PDE，包括双曲输运、抛物型反应扩散、稳态椭圆方程、不可压 Navier-Stokes 等，目标是让同一个 policy 学到可迁移的数值编程模式，而不是为单个方程记模板。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 3B、7B、14B 模型规模，并使用包含 8 个 PDE family、71 种标准数值格式的 solver-code 数据库。数值格式包括有限差分 stencil、守恒更新、CFL substepping、稀疏线性求解、投影步骤、边界条件处理等。关键结果是，混合 binary-continuous verifier 相比只用二值执行有效性的 baseline，提高 8–13 个百分点，同时 nRMSE 降低 38%。论文还报告了一个有意思的现象：较小的 RLVP post-trained 模型，在相同 direct-generation 设置下，可以达到或超过更大静态 prompting baseline。held-out PDE 上也有选择性的 zero-shot transfer，主要体现在模型能复用 CFL、边界处理、离散格式、projection 等数值结构，而不是只复述训练中的 solver。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Methodology 中 verifier 的定义，尤其是硬门控、R_traj、R_phys 如何组合；再看实验表中 binary-only reward 与 hybrid reward 的对比，这是论文最有信息量的部分。solver bank 的构成也值得看，能判断训练数据是否真的覆盖了不同数值模式。zero-shot cross-PDE transfer 部分适合快速浏览，重点看失败和成功样例，而不是只看平均分。对 LLM 预训练研究员来说，最值得带走的是连续 verifier 如何降低 RLVR 的稀疏奖励问题，以及这种设计能否迁移到代码、工具调用、长链推理等其他可执行任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to turn continuous physical errors in PDE solver generation into verifiable RL feedback, instead of relying only on prompting, debugging loops, or test-time search.
summary_en.importance: Its main relevance to foundation-model training is reward design for post-training. The task is not a general pretraining setup, but it gives a concrete example of RL with verifiable rewards beyond binary pass/fail signals. PDE solvers have graded quality: a program may run, return arrays of the right shape, and still be unstable, overly diffusive, inconsistent with boundary conditions, or far from the reference trajectory. The paper shows that deterministic continuous rewards from a simulator can provide denser and more task-aligned training signals than execution validity alone.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework, RLVP, starts with supervised fine-tuning on a curated bank of teacher solvers and then applies GRPO. The model generates solver code; the environment executes it; a verifier assigns the reward. The reward has three components: hard validity gates for executable and finite programs, a trajectory reward R_traj based on function-space error against hidden numerical references, and a physics residual reward R_phys that checks consistency with the governing PDE. This differs from standard RLVR for code and math, where the verifier is often reduced to compilation or unit-test success. A single policy is trained across eight PDE families, including hyperbolic transport, parabolic reaction-diffusion systems, steady elliptic problems, and incompressible Navier-Stokes, with the goal of learning reusable numerical-programming patterns rather than equation-specific templates.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 3B, 7B, and 14B models. The solver-code bank spans 8 PDE families and 71 numerical schemes, including finite-difference stencils, conservative updates, CFL substepping, sparse linear solves, projection steps, and boundary-condition handling. The hybrid binary-continuous verifier improves over a binary-validity-only baseline by 8–13 percentage points and reduces nRMSE by 38%. The paper also reports that smaller RLVP-trained models can match or outperform larger static prompting baselines under the same direct-generation protocol. On held-out PDEs, the model shows selective zero-shot transfer, mainly by recombining numerical structures such as stability handling, boundary treatment, and discretization patterns.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus first on the methodology section that defines the verifier, especially the interaction between validity gates, R_traj, and R_phys. Then read the ablations comparing binary-only rewards with the hybrid reward, since that is the central evidence. The construction of the solver bank is also worth checking to assess whether the training data covers genuinely different numerical motifs. For transfer experiments, inspect qualitative examples and failure cases rather than only average scores. The most useful takeaway for LLM training work is how continuous deterministic verifiers can reduce reward sparsity in RLVR-style post-training.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“连续可验证奖励”这个接口，不是 PDE 应用本身；若你在想 RL 如何反哺 pretrain，先读奖励定义和 failure case，别急着看主结果。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the continuous-verifiable-reward interface, not the PDE application itself; if you care about how RL can feed back into pretraining, read the reward design and failure cases before the headline numbers.

paper.title: To Answer or to Abstain: Mitigating Search-Agent Hallucinations via Abstention-Aware Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Recent advances in equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with search tools and outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL) have achieved new state-of-the-art results on open-domain QA tasks. However, we argue that current training paradigms harbor a critical vulnerability: they predominantly reward correct answers but fail to penalize fabricated ones when retrieval fails, thereby implicitly exacerbating hallucinations. To address this, we propose Abstention-Aware Reinforcement Learning (AWA-RL),

summary.core_problem: 搜索增强 LLM 在检索失败时仍倾向编造答案，现有 outcome-reward RL 主要奖励答对，却没有足够惩罚应当拒答的场景。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是后训练方法和可靠性度量：论文把 abstention 纳入搜索 agent 的 RL 奖励设计，并提出 RA-F1 衡量能力与可靠性的权衡。对基座预训练的直接价值有限，但对 post-train reward 设计和训练信号质量有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Abstention-Aware Reinforcement Learning。核心是动态塑造拒答奖励：一方面利用模型对具体 query 的先验能力估计，另一方面结合 on-policy 训练过程中的连续观测，避免固定拒答惩罚导致模型过度保守或过度冒险。同时引入 RA-F1，把回答正确性、拒答合理性和错误编造风险放在一个指标下评估。
summary.experiments: 实验面向 open-domain QA 的搜索 agent。与不能拒答的 baseline 相比，AWA-RL 将 precision 最高提升 10.3 个百分点，RA-F1 提升 2.9 个百分点，同时 raw accuracy 仅有小幅下降。摘要未提供底座模型规模、检索器配置和训练数据规模细节。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 City University of Hong Kong。

summary_en.core_problem: Search-augmented LLM agents often fabricate answers when retrieval fails, because outcome-reward RL mainly rewards correct answers and under-penalizes unsupported responses.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method and a reliability metric. It introduces abstention-aware reward shaping for search agents and RA-F1 for measuring the capability-reliability tradeoff. The direct relevance to base pretraining is limited, but the reward design is useful for thinking about signal quality in RL training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes Abstention-Aware Reinforcement Learning. The abstention reward is dynamically shaped using the model's query-specific prior capability and continuous observations from on-policy training. This is meant to avoid both excessive conservatism and reckless answering. RA-F1 is introduced to evaluate correct answering, appropriate abstention, and hallucination risk jointly.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments target open-domain QA search agents. Compared with non-abstaining baselines, AWA-RL improves absolute precision by up to 10.3 points and RA-F1 by 2.9 points, with only a small loss in raw accuracy. The abstract does not specify model size, retriever setup, or training data scale.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from City University of Hong Kong.

recommendation.zh: 看奖励构造和 RA-F1 即可；这是 search agent 的可靠性补丁，不是会迁移到基座训练的强信号。
recommendation.en: Read the reward shaping and RA-F1 definition only; this is a reliability patch for search agents, not a strong signal for base-model training.

paper.title: STAMP: Provenance-Guided Credit Assignment for Deep Search Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for deep-search agents has largely focused on trajectory-level scoring -- outcome correctness, citation-aware rewards, and evidence coverage. Yet the actions that expose supporting documents receive no targeted credit, a gap we call the reward-credit mismatch. We propose STAMP, in which a reference-based verifier judges whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in a training-time evidence graph, and first-exposure attribution traces each supported citation

summary.core_problem: 深度搜索Agent的RL训练普遍采用轨迹级评分，无法为找到关键支持文档的动作分配针对性信用，存在奖励-信用不匹配问题。
summary.importance: 提出溯源引导的步级信用分配方法STAMP，在不改变轨迹级奖励和排名的前提下提升搜索Agent RL训练效率，属于Agent RL训练方法改进。
summary.technical_approach: 1）训练时用基于引用的验证器判断每个被引文档是否支持证据图中的实体或关系；2）首次曝光归因机制将每个有效引用追溯到首次发现它的搜索动作；3）符号保持优势调制，在步级重新分配优势，不改变轨迹总奖励和组内轨迹相对排名。
summary.experiments: 在BrowseComp、BrowseComp-ZH、xbench-DS基准上，相同SFT初始化、训练数据和搜索工具配置下，STAMP相比GRPO基线分别提升2.0/5.5/3.0个点，可与结果奖励、引用评分奖励叠加使用。

summary_en.core_problem: RL for deep-search agents relies heavily on trajectory-level scoring, failing to assign targeted credit to actions that surface critical supporting documents, leading to a reward-credit mismatch.
summary_en.importance: Proposes STAMP, a provenance-guided step-level credit assignment method that improves RL training efficiency for search agents without altering trajectory-level rewards or rankings, as an RL training improvement for agentic systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Uses a reference-based verifier at training time to judge whether each cited document supports an entity or relation in the evidence graph; 2) Applies first-exposure attribution to trace each valid citation back to the search action that first surfaced it; 3) Uses sign-preserving advantage modulation to redistribute step-level advantages without changing total trajectory reward or relative ranking of trajectories within a batch.
summary_en.experiments: On BrowseComp, BrowseComp-ZH, and xbench-DS, STAMP outperforms the GRPO baseline by +2.0/+5.5/+3.0 points under matched SFT initialization, training data, and search tools, and composes with both outcome-only and citation-rubric base rewards.

recommendation.zh: 针对搜索Agent的GRPO步级信用分配改进，场景绑定较强，可快速扫过方法部分了解优势调制思路，无需深入读。
recommendation.en: Step-level credit assignment improvement for GRPO tailored to search agents, highly scenario-specific; skim the method section for the advantage modulation idea, no deep read needed.

paper.title: VINE: Taming Generative Control Policies for Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Flow-matching policies have emerged as an effective policy parameterization for robot learning. They iteratively generate actions from noise, enabling highly expressive modeling of complex and multimodal action distributions. However, prior works observed that scaling these policies with value-gradient reinforcement learning (RL) often leads to training instability. Existing methods attribute this instability to iterative generation and therefore avoid end-to-end value-gradient optimization by s

summary.core_problem: 解决 flow-matching 生成式策略在 value-gradient 强化学习下训练不稳定的问题，并重新定位不稳定性的来源。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练研究员的价值不在机器人本身，而在训练信号与采样过程耦合导致不稳定这一点：它提供了一个与 diffusion/flow 生成模型训练动态相关的反例，属于后训练/RL 侧的可迁移经验。
summary.technical_approach: 论文反驳“迭代生成本身导致 RL 不稳定”的常见解释，认为问题主要来自为 behavior cloning 设计的 vanilla sampling strategy 在 value-gradient RL 下变脆。作者提出 VINE，一种面向 RL 的采样方法，使 flow-matching policy 可以稳定进行端到端 value-gradient 优化，同时保留迭代生成和高表达性。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体参数量与数据规模，场景应为机器人控制基准。核心实验结论是：VINE 相比先前避免端到端 value-gradient 的方案更稳定，并在 flow-matching policy 上实现有效 RL 优化。对 LLM 研究的直接证据有限，更多是训练机制类旁证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses instability when training flow-matching generative policies with value-gradient reinforcement learning.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model researchers is indirect: it offers a clean training-dynamics lesson about instability arising from the interaction between sampling strategy and RL signal, rather than from iterative generation per se.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors argue against the prior belief that iterative generation is the root cause of instability. Instead, they attribute the issue to a vanilla sampling strategy inherited from behavior cloning, and propose VINE, an RL-oriented sampler that enables stable end-to-end value-gradient optimization for flow-matching policies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes or dataset scales, but claims stable end-to-end RL training for flow-matching policies on robot-learning tasks, outperforming prior approaches that gave up iterative generation, expressiveness, or value-gradient optimization.

recommendation.zh: 和 LLM 不直接，但“问题不在生成范式而在采样器与训练信号失配”这个判断值得记住；只看动机段和稳定性消融即可。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but the key lesson is transferable: instability may come from sampler–training-signal mismatch, not the generative paradigm itself; read the diagnosis and ablations only.

paper.title: Tool-Adaptive LLM Reranker
paper.abstract: Generative Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized information retrieval, yet their strictly parametric nature frequently leads to severe factual hallucinations when confronted with complex queries beyond their epistemic boundaries. While external tool-calling can mitigate this, indiscriminately invoking search tools for every document during reranking incurs prohibitive latency overheads, creating an intractable accuracy-efficiency dilemma. To address this challenge, we propose TALRank

summary.core_problem: LLM重排序器中，为每个文档调用搜索工具会导致过高延迟，而完全依赖参数化知识则幻觉严重，存在准确率-效率的两难
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出工具自适应的LLM重排序框架，将重排序建模为agentic MDP，通过RL优化准确率与效率的tradeoff
summary.technical_approach: 提出TALRanker，将点式相关性评分建模为马尔可夫决策过程，采用两阶段训练：1）预热阶段用语言保留混合损失防止生成能力遗忘；2）RL阶段用非对称成本感知奖励，让模型自信时跳过工具，不确定时调用外部证据
summary.experiments: 论文摘要未完整披露实验细节，核心验证重排序准确率与效率的平衡效果，对比全工具调用和无工具的基线方法
summary.authors_note: 卡内基梅隆大学、华中科技大学联合研究团队

summary_en.core_problem: LLM rerankers face an accuracy-efficiency dilemma: invoking search tools for every document incurs prohibitive latency, while relying solely on parametric knowledge causes severe factual hallucinations
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation; proposes a tool-adaptive LLM reranker framework that formulates reranking as an agentic MDP, optimizing accuracy-efficiency tradeoff via RL
summary_en.technical_approach: TALRanker formulates pointwise relevance scoring as a Markov decision process, trained with a two-stage paradigm: 1) Warm-up with a language-preserving hybrid loss to prevent catastrophic forgetting of generative capabilities; 2) RL with asymmetric cost-aware reward to encourage tool bypass when confident and tool use when uncertain
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; experiments are expected to validate accuracy-efficiency balance in reranking, comparing against full-tool and no-tool baselines
summary_en.authors_note: Joint research team from Carnegie Mellon University and Huazhong University of Science and Technology

recommendation.zh: 成本感知奖励的自适应工具调用设计有小参考，看摘要即可，属于检索领域特定应用，对基座预训练启发有限
recommendation.en: Cost-aware reward design for adaptive tool use is marginally interesting; read abstract only, as it is a niche IR application with limited pretraining insights.

institutions: Huazhong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Prompt-Driven Exploration
paper.abstract: Exploration is essential to RL since a policy cannot improve by repeatedly sampling the behaviors it already prefers. Standard methods inject stochasticity in the action space, but such jitter only yields rollouts close to the original. Escaping a weak policy often requires global perturbations that action noise cannot produce. Large language models (LLMs) and vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a pathway: they condition the policy on a natural language prompt, and since the rollout follow

summary.core_problem: 解决弱策略在稀疏奖励环境中难以探索的问题：传统动作噪声只能产生局部扰动，无法让 VLA/LLM 条件策略跳出已有行为模式。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent/RL 探索方法创新。它把自然语言 prompt 当作全局行为扰动变量，用 VLM 从 rollout 视频中诊断失败并改写 prompt，连接了语言条件策略和经典 posterior sampling 探索框架。
summary.technical_approach: 方法不是在动作空间加噪声，而是在 prompt 空间迭代搜索。系统观察一次 rollout 视频，用 VLM 判断策略如何响应当前 prompt、失败在哪里，再生成新的 prompt 来诱导下一轮更有用的行为变化。核心技术点是把 rollout 反思转化为 prompt posterior update。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务数量、模型规模、训练数据或提升幅度。可确认的是实验面向弱策略、稀疏奖励、LLM/VLA 条件控制场景，主要比较对象应是标准动作噪声式探索或固定 prompt 策略。
summary.authors_note: Pulkit Agrawal 代表性工作集中在机器人学习、强化学习和具身智能；该论文更接近 embodied agent/RL，而不是 LLM 预训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses exploration for weak policies under sparse rewards, where action-space noise only produces local perturbations and fails to escape entrenched behaviors.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent/RL exploration contribution. It treats natural-language prompts as global behavioral perturbations for LLM/VLA-conditioned policies and connects prompt refinement from rollouts to posterior sampling.
summary_en.technical_approach: Instead of injecting noise into actions, the method iterates in prompt space. A VLM inspects rollout videos, diagnoses how the policy reacted to the current prompt, and rewrites the prompt to elicit more useful behavior in the next trial.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete task counts, model sizes, training data, or numeric gains. The setup targets weak policies, sparse rewards, and LLM/VLA-conditioned control, likely against action-noise exploration and fixed-prompt baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: Pulkit Agrawal is known for robotics, reinforcement learning, and embodied intelligence; this work is closer to embodied agent/RL than to LLM pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 不是主线；只看 prompt-space exploration 的设定，作为 RL 后训练里“语言变量当全局扰动”的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper; skim the prompt-space exploration setup as a weak signal for using language variables as global perturbations in RL.

paper.title: Principled Analysis of Deep Reinforcement Learning Evaluation and Design Paradigms
paper.abstract: Starting from the utilization of deep neural networks to approximate the state-action value function that led to winning one of the most challenging games, to algorithmic advancements that allowed solving problems without even explicitly stating the rules of the challenge at hand, reinforcement learning research has been the center of remarkable scientific progress for the past decade. In this paper, we focus on the key ingredients of this research progress and we analyze the canonical evaluatio

summary.core_problem: 深度强化学习领域普遍隐含一个未经验证的假设：算法性能排序在不同样本复杂度 regime（低数据与高数据/渐近 regime）下保持单调一致。这一假设主导了当前的评估与设计范式，可能导致研究方向的误判。
summary.importance: 对LLM预训练与对齐阶段的RL应用有直接参考价值。当前RLHF、RL pretrain等工作常基于有限数据量的实验选型算法，该研究提示小数据 regime 下的结论无法直接外推到大规模训练场景，需关注不同数据量下的性能排序变化，避免评估偏差。其关于RL缩放定律的理论分析也为理解训练动态提供了新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 理论层面，建立深度RL缩放定律的基础框架，证明算法性能曲线在低数据 regime 与渐近高数据 regime 之间存在非单调关系，即性能排名会随数据量提升发生反转。方法论层面，系统梳理当前深度RL研究中的评估范式、隐含假设与经典设计选择，分析这些选择如何受单调性假设影响，进而得出有偏结论。实验层面，在ALE基准上针对多种经典深度RL算法，分别在低数据（10万次环境交互）和高数据（2亿帧训练）两个 regime 下开展大规模对比实验，验证非单调性的存在。
summary.experiments: 在Arcade Learning Environment（ALE）基准上测试多种深度RL基线算法，结果显示低数据（100K环境交互）regime 下的算法性能排名，与高数据（2亿帧训练）渐近 regime 下的排名存在显著差异，证实性能与样本复杂度之间的非单调关系，说明仅基于低数据 regime 的评估会产生系统性偏差，导致对算法优劣的错误判断。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点关注引言提出的核心隐含假设、理论分析中关于非单调性能曲线的证明逻辑，以及实验部分的跨regime性能对比结论。若关注RL缩放定律的理论推导，可深入阅读背景与理论章节。预计阅读时间25-30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: A pervasive unvalidated assumption in deep reinforcement learning research holds that algorithm performance rankings remain monotonically consistent across different sample complexity regimes (low-data vs. high-data/asymptotic regimes). This assumption dominates current evaluation and design paradigms, and may misdirect research efforts.
summary_en.importance: This work has direct implications for RL applications in LLM pretraining and alignment. Current RLHF and RL pretrain pipelines often select algorithms based on limited-data experiments; this study shows that conclusions from small-data regimes cannot be directly extrapolated to large-scale training scenarios, highlighting the need to account for performance ranking shifts across data scales to avoid evaluation bias. Its theoretical analysis of RL scaling laws also offers new perspectives for understanding training dynamics.
summary_en.technical_approach: Theoretically, the paper establishes a foundational framework for scaling laws in deep RL, and proves that algorithm performance profiles exhibit a non-monotonic relationship between the low-data regime and the asymptotic high-data regime — meaning performance rankings can reverse as data volume grows. Methodologically, it systematically reviews evaluation paradigms, implicit assumptions, and canonical design choices in deep RL research, analyzing how these choices are shaped by the monotonicity assumption and lead to biased conclusions. Experimentally, it runs large-scale comparative tests on the ALE benchmark across multiple classic deep RL algorithms, evaluating both the low-data regime (100k environment interactions) and the high-data regime (200 million training frames) to verify non-monotonicity.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on the ALE benchmark with multiple deep RL baselines show that performance rankings in the low-data (100k environment interaction) regime differ significantly from those in the high-data (200 million training frame) asymptotic regime. This confirms the non-monotonic relationship between performance and sample complexity, and demonstrates that evaluation relying solely on the low-data regime introduces systematic bias, leading to incorrect judgments about algorithm effectiveness.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the core implicit assumption introduced in the introduction, the proof logic of non-monotonic performance curves in the theoretical analysis, and the cross-regime performance comparison conclusions in the experiments section. Readers interested in RL scaling law derivations can dive deeper into the background and theory sections. Estimated reading time: 25-30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 指出了 RL 算法性能排名随数据规模变化的非单调性，对当前依赖 RLHF/PPO 的 LLM 后训练评估有一定警示作用，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Points out the non-monotonicity of RL algorithm performance rankings with data scale, serving as a warning for current LLM post-training evaluations relying on RLHF/PPO. Worth a skim.

paper.title: Latent Memory Palace: Reasoning for Control as Autoregressive Variational Inference
paper.abstract: Human decision-making is highly flexible -- some actions are taken immediately; others require longer deliberation. Language models have exhibited a similar capacity for adaptive "reasoning." However, transferring this capability to continuous control policies has been challenging, as directly reasoning in language space may lack the granularity for spatial understanding and precise motions. In this work, we show that reasoning for control policies can emerge by organizing information in an auto

summary.core_problem: 让连续控制策略具备类似“按需多步思考”的能力，而不依赖语言 token 作为推理空间。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 latent reasoning 方法探索。它把控制中的推理建模为自回归 latent space 上的变分推断，对研究 latent computation、非语言 CoT 和 test-time adaptive computation 有间接参考价值，但不是 LLM 预训练论文。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Latent Memory Palace，将策略的内部推理写成自回归 latent distribution，并把逐步检索/组织信息解释为 memory palace。训练上推导 latent-space reinforcement learning 技术，用可优化的变分下界来学习 LMP-π；方法核心是让策略在 latent 空间中自适应分配推理步数和信息访问。
summary.experiments: 摘要称 LMP-π 在仿真和真实世界控制任务上表现强，并展示可解释的、自适应的推理分配；未给出任务名称、网络规模、baseline、训练步数或具体提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper aims to give continuous-control policies an adaptive multi-step reasoning mechanism without using language as the reasoning medium.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a latent reasoning formulation for control. It is indirectly relevant to latent computation, non-linguistic chain-of-thought, and adaptive test-time computation, but it is not an LLM pretraining paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: Latent Memory Palace formulates reasoning as variational inference over an autoregressive latent distribution. The resulting LMP-π policy is trained with a latent-space reinforcement learning procedure that optimizes a tractable variational lower bound and allows adaptive allocation of latent reasoning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims strong results in simulation and real-world domains with interpretable adaptive reasoning allocation, but it does not disclose task names, model sizes, baselines, training budget, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 可把它当 latent reasoning 旁证读摘要；没有 LLM setup，别把控制任务上的结论外推到预训练。
recommendation.en: Treat it as weak evidence for latent reasoning; without an LLM setup, do not extrapolate the control results to pretraining.

paper.title: Single-Rollout Asynchronous Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is becoming increasingly important for post-training large language models (LLMs). Previous RL pipelines for LLMs were mostly synchronous and batch-interleaved, which is inefficient for long-horizon agentic tasks. Recently, asynchronous RL has emerged as a more efficient alternative by updating the model as rollouts arrive. However, existing asynchronous RL systems often emphasize throughput, while leaving training stability and task effectiveness largely underexplore

summary.core_problem: 面向长horizon智能体任务的LLM异步强化学习（RL），在提升GPU利用率的同时，面临策略滞后引发的off-policy偏差大、训练不稳定，以及GRPO等组式采样方法与异步机制、单轨迹反馈的智能体场景不匹配的问题。
summary.importance: 对预训练后长轨迹智能体任务的RL对齐有实际参考价值，解决了异步RL训练的稳定性与组采样不兼容问题，为提升RL阶段的GPU利用率与训练效率提供了可落地方案。
summary.technical_approach: 提出单轮异步优化（SAO），核心有四点：1）采用token级重要性采样，结合更严格的双边裁剪与掩码，缓解不同策略滞后下的off-policy偏差；2）用单轮采样替代GRPO的组式采样，从根源上避免组内等待带来的策略滞后，也适配单轨迹反馈的在线/智能体场景；3）优化价值模型训练流程——critic更新频率高于actor，且采用冻结注意力的方式微调价值模型，降低训练开销；4）针对多轮智能体轨迹（含环境反馈观测），推导跳过观测token的token级GAE估计器，避免观测token引入的噪声传播。
summary.experiments: 在SWE-Bench Verified、AIME2025、BeyondAIME、HMMT、IMOAnswerBench等编程和数学推理基准上测试，SAO可稳定训练约1000步，性能优于改进版GRPO；单轮采样策略适配模拟在线学习场景，可适应动态环境变化。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注核心方法部分的SAO设计，尤其是token级裁剪、单轮采样、skip-observation GAE三个创新点；实验部分关注异步训练的稳定性曲线和与GRPO的性能对比，预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) for long-horizon agentic LLM tasks improves GPU utilization but suffers from severe off-policy drift due to policy lag, and existing group-wise sampling methods like GRPO are incompatible with asynchronous pipelines and single-trajectory feedback in agentic settings.
summary_en.importance: Provides practical insights for stable and efficient agentic RL in LLM post-training, addressing key pain points of asynchronous training stability and group-sampling incompatibility for long-horizon coding and reasoning workloads.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Single-rollout Asynchronous Optimization (SAO) with four key components: 1) Token-level importance sampling with strict double-sided clipping and masking to mitigate off-policy drift under varying policy lag; 2) Single-rollout sampling per prompt to replace group-wise GRPO sampling, eliminating intra-group wait latency and fitting single-trajectory agent/online settings; 3) Improved value model training with more frequent critic updates than actor, plus frozen-attention fine-tuning for the value model to reduce overhead; 4) A skip-observation token-level GAE estimator for multi-turn agent trajectories that excludes environment observation tokens from advantage computation to avoid noise propagation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on agentic coding and math benchmarks including SWE-Bench Verified, AIME2025, BeyondAIME, HMMT, and IMOAnswerBench. SAO stably trains for ~1000 steps and consistently outperforms improved GRPO. The single-rollout design also performs well in simulated online learning with dynamic environment changes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core method section for SAO design, especially token-level clipping, single-rollout sampling, and skip-observation GAE. Skim experimental results for stability curves and GRPO comparison. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 单rollout采样打破GRPO组归一化的常规思路，对做agent RL训练的人有启发，重点看方法和稳定性分析部分。
recommendation.en: Single-rollout sampling challenges the group-normalization convention in GRPO; relevant for researchers working on agentic RL training stability.

paper.title: Entropy Pacing Policy Optimization for Multi-Task Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Recent breakthroughs of Reinforcement Learning (RL) have highlighted its potential for complex agentic Large Language Model (LLM) tasks. However, existing efforts largely focus on single-task settings, whereas real-world deployment necessitates a generalist agent capable of solving multiple tasks simultaneously. In this work, we identify a critical yet underexplored phenomenon in multi-task agentic RL: different tasks can exhibit exploration-exploitation pace mismatch. Specifically, easier tasks

summary.core_problem: 多任务智能体强化学习（RL）联合训练中，不同难度任务存在探索-利用节奏不匹配现象：简单任务过早坍缩到低熵策略，抑制难任务探索；仍处于探索阶段的难任务产生的梯度会扰动已收敛的简单任务。这种相互作用表现为训练中频繁的任务间熵交叉和晚期熵尖峰，现有GRPO方法的全局固定裁剪范围无法同时适配异质任务的差异化节奏需求。
summary.importance: 揭示了多任务智能体RL中一个被忽视的训练动态问题（熵节奏不匹配），提出的EPPO是轻量的即插即用改进，仅需修改裁剪机制即可接入现有训练管线，对多任务RL后训练（尤其是统一智能体的联合训练）有实用参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 熵节奏策略优化（EPPO）将GRPO的全局固定裁剪范围替换为基于任务相对熵节奏的逐任务动态裁剪机制，核心包含三部分：1）逐任务追踪策略熵，锚定初始参考值计算熵坍缩率，使异质任务间的学习节奏具有可比性；2）将标准化后的熵坍缩率映射到有界的裁剪调整量——对探索不足的任务放大裁剪范围以允许更大更新，对过度自信的任务缩小裁剪范围以保留探索空间，平衡各任务学习节奏；3）加入稳定性感知趋势约束，当熵上升时缩小裁剪范围，抑制训练振荡和策略突变。EPPO仅需替换固定裁剪模块即可接入现有多任务GRPO训练管线，额外计算开销极低。
summary.experiments: 在智能体基准测试集上，EPPO相比多任务基线提升了平均成功率，同时减少了任务间熵交叉现象，抑制了训练晚期的熵尖峰，提升了训练稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计15-20分钟。重点关注多任务RL中熵节奏不匹配现象的观察与刻画，以及EPPO的动态裁剪机制设计；实验部分只需了解核心性能与稳定性结论即可。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-task agentic RL joint training, tasks of varying difficulty suffer from exploration-exploitation pace mismatch: easier tasks collapse early to low-entropy policies that suppress exploration of harder tasks, while gradients from still-exploring hard tasks perturb already-converged easy tasks. This interaction manifests as frequent inter-task entropy crossovers and late-stage entropy spikes during training, and GRPO's global fixed clipping range cannot simultaneously accommodate the differentiated pace needs of heterogeneous tasks.
summary_en.importance: It identifies an underexplored training dynamic issue in multi-task agentic RL (entropy pace mismatch). The proposed EPPO is a lightweight, plug-and-play improvement that only requires modifying the clipping mechanism to integrate into existing training pipelines, providing practical reference for multi-task RL post-training, especially for joint training of unified agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: EPPO (Entropy Pacing Policy Optimization) replaces GRPO's global fixed clipping range with a task-wise dynamic clipping mechanism guided by each task's relative entropy pace. Three core components: 1) Track per-task policy entropy, anchor an initial reference to compute entropy collapse ratio for comparable learning pace across heterogeneous tasks; 2) Map the standardized entropy collapse ratio to bounded clip adjustments — enlarge clip range for under-explored tasks to allow larger updates, and shrink it for over-confident tasks to preserve exploration space, balancing learning pace across tasks; 3) Add a stability-aware trend constraint that downscales clip range when entropy rises, damping training oscillations and abrupt policy shifts. EPPO integrates into existing multi-task GRPO pipelines by only replacing the fixed clipping module, with negligible additional computational overhead.
summary_en.experiments: On agentic benchmarks, EPPO improves average success rate over multi-task baselines, reduces inter-task entropy crossovers, suppresses late-stage training entropy spikes, and improves training stability.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim-level reading, ~15-20 minutes. Focus on the observation and characterization of the entropy pace mismatch phenomenon in multi-task RL, and EPPO's dynamic clipping mechanism design. For experiments, only core performance and stability conclusions need to be noted.

recommendation.zh: 指出了多任务 RL 中不同难度任务导致的熵失衡问题，提出的动态熵正则化方法对 LLM 的多任务 RLHF/PPO 训练有一定参考价值，可关注其机制分析。
recommendation.en: Identifies the entropy imbalance issue caused by tasks of varying difficulty in multi-task RL; the proposed dynamic entropy regularization method offers reference value for multi-task RLHF/PPO training of LLMs, worth skimming for its mechanism analysis.

paper.title: Mathematical methods of reinforcement learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is increasingly grounded in tools from probability, optimization, and operator theory. This survey organizes the mathematical structures that underpin the design and analysis of modern algorithms in RL. We begin from Markov decision processes (MDPs) and the Bellman operators, emphasizing contraction mappings, monotonicity, and fixed-point theory that yield convergence guarantees and rates for value and policy iteration, and temporal-difference schemes. We then develop

summary.core_problem: 系统梳理强化学习的数学基础，包括 MDP、Bellman 算子、随机逼近、优化、函数逼近、离策略学习和约束 RL。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是综述和理论整理。它不直接提出 LLM RLHF/RLVR 方法，但对理解后训练中的策略优化、正则化、收敛性和约束优化有背景价值。
summary.technical_approach: 文章从 MDP 和 Bellman fixed point 出发，连接 contraction、monotonicity、value/policy iteration、TD 学习；随后用随机逼近、鞅方法、凸对偶、mirror/proximal optimization 解释现代 RL 算法，并讨论线性与非线性函数逼近、off-policy evaluation 和 CMDP。
summary.experiments: 这是数学综述，不以实验为核心。摘要未报告模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或性能提升。

summary_en.core_problem: The survey organizes the mathematical foundations of reinforcement learning, covering MDPs, Bellman operators, stochastic approximation, optimization, function approximation, off-policy learning, and constrained RL.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is expository and theoretical. It does not propose an LLM-specific RLHF or RLVR method, but it is useful background for reasoning about policy optimization, regularization, convergence, and constraints in post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper starts from MDPs and Bellman fixed points, connects contraction and monotonicity to value iteration, policy iteration, and TD methods, then develops optimization views via stochastic approximation, martingales, convex duality, mirror/proximal methods, function approximation, off-policy evaluation, and CMDPs.
summary_en.experiments: This is a mathematical survey rather than an experimental paper. The abstract reports no model scale, dataset, baseline, or performance numbers.

recommendation.zh: 适合作 RLVR/RLHF 理论背景索引，不必通读；需要 CMDP 或 mirror descent 细节时查对应章节。
recommendation.en: Useful as a theory index for RLVR/RLHF, not a read-through item; consult the CMDP or mirror-descent sections when needed.

paper.title: RLVP: Penalize the Path, Reward the Outcome
paper.abstract: Agents acting on our behalf in the real world (e.g. placing phone calls) must learn online from costly, often irreversible interactions rather than cheap simulator steps. Two things follow. First, deployability depends on the path, not only the outcome. An agent must respect outcome-neutral constraints such as not repeatedly calling an unresponsive user, respecting business hours, or completing required authentication constraints that outcome-based rewards cannot express, since violating them fr

summary.core_problem: 真实世界Agent在线学习中，现有RLVR方法仅优化最终结果，无法表达结果中立的路径约束，且在全失败样本组中浪费昂贵的交互rollout。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出“路径惩罚+结果奖励”的RL范式，同时提升在线学习的样本效率，为真实世界Agent的合规部署提供新思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出RLVP方法，在可验证结果奖励基础上引入低成本的路径约束惩罚项；针对全失败组设计更高效的优势估计机制以减少样本浪费（摘要截断，细节不全）。
summary.experiments: 针对真实世界Agent交互场景设计，具体实验设置、模型及量化结果摘要未完整披露。

summary_en.core_problem: In online learning for real-world agents, existing RLVR methods only optimize final outcomes, cannot express outcome-agnostic path constraints, and waste expensive interaction rollouts on all-failure sample groups.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation proposing an RL paradigm of "path penalization + outcome reward", while improving sample efficiency of online learning, providing new ideas for compliant deployment of real-world agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes RLVP (Reinforcement Learning with Path Penalization), which introduces low-cost path constraint penalties on top of verifiable outcome rewards; designs more efficient advantage estimation for all-failure groups to reduce sample waste (abstract truncated, details incomplete).
summary_en.experiments: Designed for real-world agent interaction scenarios; specific experimental setup, model, and quantitative results not fully disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 路径惩罚+结果奖励的思路可迁移到LLM推理/Agent的后训练RL设计中，看摘要了解核心思路即可。
recommendation.en: The path penalization + outcome reward idea can be transferred to RL design for LLM reasoning/agent post-training; read only the abstract for core intuition.

paper.title: Information Gain-based Rollout Policy Optimization: An Adaptive Tree-Structured Rollout Approach for Multi-Turn LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a promising paradigm for improving large language model (LLM) agents on long-horizon search tasks, where the agent must make a sequence of intermediate decisions before receiving a final outcome. However, existing methods still face a key limitation: the rollout budget is often allocated without explicitly assessing the utility of intermediate states. As a result, substantial computation may be spent on low-value states, even though different branches can vary d

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多轮检索型 LLM agent 的 rollout 预算分配问题。现有 RL 训练常把计算均匀或启发式地花在不同中间状态上，但许多前缀对最终答案没有帮助，导致长程搜索训练中的采样效率低。
summary.importance: 这属于 post-train / agent RL 方法，对基座预训练的间接启发在于训练信号质量和采样分布设计。它把 rollout collection 从“多采一些轨迹”改成“优先扩展能提高答案概率的中间状态”。这个思路可以迁移到更一般的推理训练：中间状态是否值得继续采样，应由它对目标答案或最终奖励的信息增量决定，而不是只由不确定性、随机分支或固定宽度决定。
summary.technical_approach: IGRPO 定义了一个操作化的信息增益：到达某个中间检索状态后，策略对 ground-truth answer 的归一化 likelihood 增加多少。rollout 不再沿单链生成，也不做简单均匀树扩展，而是在树结构中维护多个 active prefixes，并根据每个前缀的信息增益派生出的 informativeness 以概率选择扩展对象。高信息增益节点获得更多 rollout 预算，低信息增益节点仍可被采样但概率较低。作者还给出理论刻画：这种信息增益驱动的采样过程会诱导一个 limiting teacher distribution，策略优化目标可以看作向这个分布靠拢。相比 GRPO 只比较同题多条完整轨迹，IGRPO 更强调中间状态的价值评估；相比 Tree-GRPO 或 AEPO 这类树扩展方法，它用答案似然变化来组织扩展，而不是主要依赖随机或硬阈值规则。
summary.experiments: 实验在七个 search-augmented QA benchmark 上进行，使用 3B 和 7B backbone。结果显示，在相同 rollout budget 下，IGRPO 相比强基线平均提升 3.1%（3B）和 0.9%（7B）。这说明信息增益分配预算在小模型上收益更明显；7B 上提升较小，可能因为更强的初始策略减少了无效分支比例，也可能因为 likelihood-based 信息增益对强模型的区分度下降。提供内容未给出各数据集逐项分数、检索预算、树宽、最大轮数和训练 token 规模。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 40 分钟。重点看 information gain 的精确定义、树式 rollout 的采样规则、limiting teacher distribution 的理论部分，以及 3B/7B 在七个 QA benchmark 上的分项结果。若关注 RL for reasoning，可细读它如何把中间状态评分转成 rollout policy；若只关注预训练，可主要吸收“采样预算应跟训练信号信息量绑定”这一点。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses rollout-budget allocation for multi-turn search agents trained with reinforcement learning. In long-horizon retrieval tasks, different intermediate states can have very different value for reaching the final answer, but existing methods often spend rollout computation uniformly or through coarse heuristics.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training and agent-RL paper, with indirect relevance to pretraining research through the lens of sampling efficiency and training-signal quality. Its useful idea is to treat intermediate-state informativeness as the object that controls exploration. For reasoning-oriented training, this is a cleaner framing than simply increasing the number of rollouts or expanding a search tree with fixed-width or random branching.
summary_en.technical_approach: IGRPO defines information gain as the increase in the policy’s normalized likelihood of the ground-truth answer after reaching an intermediate search state. The rollout process is tree-structured: multiple active prefixes are maintained, and prefixes with higher information gain are selected for further expansion with higher probability. Low-informativeness branches are not necessarily discarded, but they consume less budget. The paper also characterizes the limiting distribution induced by this sampling process and interprets it as a teacher distribution for policy optimization. Relative to GRPO-style outcome comparison, the method uses intermediate states to guide data collection. Relative to existing tree-based rollout methods, it replaces random or threshold-based expansion with answer-likelihood information gain.
summary_en.experiments: The method is evaluated on seven search-augmented QA benchmarks with 3B and 7B backbones. Under the same rollout budget, IGRPO improves over the strongest baseline by 3.1% on average for the 3B model and 0.9% for the 7B model. The larger gain on the smaller model suggests that adaptive allocation is most helpful when the base policy produces more low-value branches. The provided content does not include per-benchmark scores, exact rollout budgets, tree depths, or training-set sizes.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–40 minutes. Read the definition of answer-likelihood information gain, the tree rollout policy, the theorem describing the induced teacher distribution, and the main result table for the seven QA benchmarks. For readers focused on reasoning RL, the most relevant part is how the method turns intermediate-state utility into a rollout collection policy. For pretraining-oriented readers, the reusable lesson is that compute allocation during data generation should be tied to information content rather than trajectory count alone.

recommendation.zh: 关注RLHF/RLVR中长序列任务的rollout效率问题，提出的基于信息增益的树搜索策略对优化后训练数据收集有启发，值得一看方法设计。
recommendation.en: Focuses on rollout efficiency in long-horizon tasks for RLHF/RLVR. The proposed information gain-based tree search strategy offers insights for optimizing post-training data collection. The method design is worth a skim.

paper.title: Bridging Interleaved Multi-Modal Reasoning as a Unified Decision Process
paper.abstract: Unified multi-modal models (UMMs) have shown promising interleaved text-image reasoning capabilities, yet effectively optimizing such multi-turn generation via reinforcement learning (RL) remains an open challenge. Existing approaches apply RL exclusively to text steps, relegating image generation to supervised surrogates, preventing policy gradients from propagating through the full interleaved trajectory across heterogeneous modalities. This leaves the potential of RL for UMMs largely untapped

summary.core_problem: BRAID 解决的是统一多模态模型中交错 text-image-text 推理无法端到端 RL 优化的问题：现有方法多只对文本 token 做策略梯度，图像生成分支仍靠监督替代目标，导致视觉中间步骤不能被任务奖励直接塑形。
summary.importance: 这篇工作对基座研究的价值在于，把 AR 文本生成和 flow-matching 图像生成放进同一个决策过程里优化。它不是常规预训练论文，但对 native multimodal model 的 post-train 目标设计有参考意义。尤其是统一模型里不同模态的 likelihood 尺度不兼容，不能简单相加；BRAID 的处理方式说明了异构生成器共享任务奖励、但保留各自训练算子的可行路径。对 Chameleon、BAGEL、Show-o、Transfusion 这类统一建模路线，启发主要在训练目标接口，而不是模型结构本身。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把多轮 text → image → text → answer 轨迹建模为统一 MDP。每一轮生成被视为 macro-action：文本分支仍使用自回归 token likelihood 和类似 GRPO 的 clipped policy objective；图像分支不强行构造 token-level likelihood，而是沿用 flow matching 的 velocity-field 形式，用 likelihood-free 的策略优化信号更新图像生成过程。关键点是共享 trajectory-level advantage：同一条交错推理轨迹获得统一奖励，再把 advantage 分发给两类模态原生的优化目标。这样避免了直接混合文本 log-prob 和连续扩散/flow 路径概率带来的尺度崩坏。为缓解长轨迹 credit assignment，BRAID 还加入 vision-thinking process reward，由 VLM judge 对中间图像是否帮助后续推理打分，给视觉分支提供 turn-level 反馈。和 COOPER 的分阶段监督优化不同，BRAID 试图让图像生成直接进入 RL loop；和 DeepEyes 这类只优化视觉工具调用的方式不同，它更新的是图像生成过程本身。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 BAGEL，模型规模为 7B。作者报告在 7 个 benchmark 上平均提升 +5.73，相比基线在 SAT 上提升 +14.00，在 V*Bench 上提升 +10.76，并声称整体结果超过 GPT-4o。Maj@n 结果显示，随着采样预算增加，BRAID 的候选解空间收益继续增长，而对照方法较早进入平台期。案例分析显示，RL 后的中间图像更贴近题目中的几何、空间或物理约束，也能改善最终文本回答。另一个观察是图像分支的指令跟随能力有迁移：优化交错推理后，text-to-image 生成在遵循文本条件方面也变好。需要注意，摘要和正文片段没有给出完整训练 batch、rollout 数、KL 系数、VLM judge 细节和各 benchmark 原始分数，复现实验仍需看方法和附录。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–45 分钟。重点看 MDP formulation、text/image 两类 policy gradient 如何写在同一目标下，以及 shared advantage 如何进入 flow-matching 分支。实验部分优先看 7 个 benchmark 的总表、SAT 和 V*Bench 的分项、Maj@n 曲线、vision-thinking process reward 的消融。如果时间有限，可以跳过多模态推理动机的长背景，直接看 objective derivation 和 ablation。值得深挖的是两个问题：一是图像分支 reward 是否主要来自 VLM judge 的偏好，而不是任务 reward；二是 trajectory-level advantage 在不同模态长度差异很大时是否会带来 credit dilution。

summary_en.core_problem: BRAID targets a concrete gap in interleaved multimodal reasoning: current RL pipelines mostly optimize text tokens, while intermediate image generation remains trained through supervised surrogates, so task rewards do not directly shape the visual reasoning steps.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to foundation-model training because it studies how to optimize a native multimodal generator whose branches use different generative formalisms. The main lesson is not a new pretraining recipe, but an interface between unified AR-plus-flow models and RL. A single scalar task reward cannot be naively applied by adding text log-probabilities and continuous image-generation losses; their scales and semantics differ. BRAID gives a practical design: share the trajectory-level advantage, but route it through modality-specific optimization operators. This is useful for unified models in the Chameleon, BAGEL, Show-o, and Transfusion family.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method casts a text → image → text → answer rollout as one Markov decision process. Each generation turn is treated as a macro-action. For text, BRAID uses an autoregressive policy-gradient objective in the GRPO style, with group-normalized advantages, clipping, and KL regularization. For images, it does not force a token-likelihood formulation. The image branch is modeled with flow matching, where the policy parameterizes a conditional velocity field along the denoising trajectory, and the shared advantage is injected through a likelihood-free objective native to the flow generator. The central design choice is to compute one trajectory-level advantage and then apply it through modality-compatible gradients. To improve credit assignment over long interleaved trajectories, BRAID adds a vision-thinking process reward: a VLM judge scores whether each intermediate image is useful for the reasoning path. This differs from staged supervised optimization such as COOPER and from methods that only learn when to call a visual tool rather than optimizing the image generator itself.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments are built on BAGEL with a 7B model. BRAID improves the BAGEL baseline by +5.73 on average across seven benchmarks, with large reported gains on SAT (+14.00) and V*Bench (+10.76), and is reported to outperform GPT-4o in the evaluated setting. Maj@n curves suggest that additional sampling continues to improve BRAID, while baselines saturate earlier. Qualitative examples indicate that the optimized image branch produces more faithful intermediate visual states for geometry, spatial, and physical reasoning tasks, which then improves the final text answer. The authors also report transfer to text-to-image instruction following. The provided content does not expose enough details on rollout count, KL strength, judge calibration, reward composition, or full per-benchmark scores, so the reproducibility-critical parts are in the method and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 30–45 minutes. Focus on the MDP formulation, the joint objective, and the way the same advantage is passed into autoregressive text generation and flow-matching image generation. In the experiments, prioritize the seven-benchmark table, SAT and V*Bench breakdowns, Maj@n scaling curves, and ablations on the vision-thinking process reward. The most important technical questions are whether the visual branch is learning from task reward or mostly from the VLM judge, and whether a trajectory-level advantage becomes too diffuse when text and image branches have very different action granularities.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是它把 interleaved multimodal RL 从“文本有梯度、图像没梯度”改成统一 MDP；先盯 advantage 如何进 denoising path，若这块不干净，结论要打折。
recommendation.en: The interesting part is the shift from text-only RL to a unified MDP over interleaved multimodal generation; inspect exactly how the advantage enters the denoising path, because that determines whether the claim is real or cosmetic.

paper.title: LLM-as-a-Tutor: Policy-Aware Prompt Adaptation for Non-Verifiable RL
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) for non-verifiable instruction following increasingly relies on LLM judges with prompt-specific rubrics as reward signals. While recent methods adapt these rubrics to the evolving policy during training, the training prompts themselves remain static, drawn from fixed corpora. This static approach often results in a critical misalignment between prompt difficulty and policy capability, leaving the judge unable to recover a discriminative reward signal when prompts fail

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论非可验证任务 RL 中的训练提示词失配问题：如果 prompt 对当前 policy 太简单或太难，即使 LLM judge 和 rubric 质量不错，也无法在 rollout 之间产生有用的奖励差异。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 训练信号质量有参考意义。关键启发是：非可验证 RL 的瓶颈不只在 reward model 或 judge，也在 prompt 是否处在当前模型能力边界附近。这个问题和课程学习、数据难度调度、RL 数据合成有关，也会影响后续把 RL 信号反哺到 mid-train 或 continual pretrain 的设计。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 LLM-as-a-Tutor。一个 tutor LLM 同时承担 examiner 和 generator 两个角色。每个 seed prompt 先由 tutor 生成 base rubric，后续训练中保持 seed prompt 和 base rubric 的主体稳定。每轮迭代时，examiner 从当前 policy 对同一 prompt 的两个 rollout 中做 pairwise comparison，判断它们是否存在质量差异。如果两个回答质量不可区分，说明该 prompt 对当前 policy 不够有训练信号；generator 就给 prompt 追加一个原子约束，并同步给 rubric 追加对应评价标准。设计上选择追加而不是重写，是为了保持原始数据分布和任务语义，同时单调提高要求数量。它和只做 policy-adaptive rubric 的方法不同：当 prompt 本身无法激发质量方差时，再细的 rubric 也难以恢复奖励信号，必须改变 prompt。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen3-1.7B 作为 policy，Qwen3-8B 作为 tutor，在 FollowBench、AdvancedIF 和 InfoBench 三个复杂指令遵循 benchmark 上评估。方法平均分高于固定 prompt 训练基线，包括 base rubrics、WildChecklists 和 policy-adaptive rubrics；也高于会修改 prompt 的基线，如 Evol-Instruct 和 EVA。消融显示，policy-aware 的定向追加约束优于无条件追加、随机追加，以及基于更强模型回答来判断是否追加；追加约束也优于整体重写 prompt。分析还显示，tutor 的 pairwise judgment 与经验难度相关，每个追加约束都会放大奖励可区分性，且随着 policy 规模增大，需要修改的 prompt 比例单调上升。给出的材料没有包含具体分数表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20 到 30 分钟。重点看 Introduction 中对 policy-prompt mismatch 的定义，Method 中 examiner/generator 的调用流程，以及 Ablation 部分。若关注 RLHF/RLAIF 数据构造，可以重点看为什么 policy-adaptive rubric 不够，以及追加约束为什么比重写 prompt 稳定。若只关注基座预训练，可快速浏览实验，把它当作 post-train 奖励方差和课程数据选择的一个案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies prompt-policy mismatch in RL for non-verifiable instruction following. If a prompt is too easy or too hard for the current policy, rollouts have little quality variation, so even a capable LLM judge with a prompt-specific rubric cannot produce a useful reward signal.
summary_en.importance: The work is more relevant to post-training than to base pretraining, but it is useful for understanding training-signal quality. Its main lesson is that non-verifiable RL can fail because of the prompt distribution, not only because of reward-model weakness. Prompts need to stay near the policy’s competence frontier. This connects to curriculum design, synthetic instruction generation, and future attempts to feed RL-derived signals back into mid-training or continual pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: LLM-as-a-Tutor uses a single tutor model in two roles. As an examiner, it performs pairwise comparison between two rollouts from the current policy and decides whether their quality is distinguishable. As a generator, it modifies a non-challenging prompt by appending an atomic constraint and adding the corresponding rubric criterion. Each seed prompt receives a base rubric once, and the method keeps the seed prompt and base rubric largely intact while adding constraints when needed. The choice of appending rather than rewriting is deliberate: it preserves the source task distribution while increasing difficulty in a controlled way. Compared with policy-adaptive rubrics, the method changes the prompt itself when the original prompt cannot elicit reward variance.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use Qwen3-1.7B as the policy and Qwen3-8B as the tutor. Evaluation is conducted on FollowBench, AdvancedIF, and InfoBench. LLM-as-a-Tutor outperforms fixed-prompt baselines such as base rubrics, WildChecklists, and policy-adaptive rubrics, as well as prompt-modification baselines such as Evol-Instruct and EVA. Ablations indicate that targeted policy-aware constraint appending is better than unconditional appending, random appending, or adapting prompts based on a stronger model’s responses. Appending constraints also works better than rewriting prompts. The analysis shows that the tutor’s pairwise judgments correlate with empirical difficulty, that appended constraints increase reward discriminativeness, and that the prompt modification rate rises with policy scale. The provided material does not include the full numerical score table.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim read should take about 20 to 30 minutes. Focus on the problem formulation in the introduction, the examiner-generator loop in the method section, and the ablations comparing targeted appending with random, unconditional, and rewrite-based variants. For researchers working on RLHF or RLAIF data pipelines, the most useful part is the argument that rubric adaptation alone cannot rescue prompts that fail to induce rollout variance. For base-model pretraining, it is mainly a case study in curriculum construction and reward-signal selection.

recommendation.zh: RL训练中prompt难度自适应的思路对后训练课程设计有参考价值，重点看奖励信号区分度的测量方法与消融。
recommendation.en: The adaptive prompt difficulty idea in RL training is useful for post-training curriculum design; focus on reward discriminability measurement and ablations.

paper.title: Progress- and Reliability-Oriented Group Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning (RL) has become an effective paradigm for improving large language model agents on long-horizon interactive tasks. To obtain finer-grained policy updates than trajectory-level optimization, recent work has moved toward step-level group-based RL, where intermediate steps are grouped and compared within a rollout batch. However, step-level advantage estimation is sensitive to how groups are formed: grouping by broad state keys improves coverage but may compare ac

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理长程 Agent RL 里的 step-level credit assignment：如果按当前状态粗粒度分组，动作比较不公平；如果要求历史前缀一致，组会被切碎，很多步骤没有可用的组内比较信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，但对 post-train 与 agentic RL 的训练信号设计有参考价值。它关注的是无 critic 的 group-based RL 如何在多轮交互任务中获得更密的步骤级优势信号。这个问题和 GRPO/DAPO 在推理任务中的成功有关，也和长程任务中如何避免只用终局 reward 更新整条轨迹有关。值得关注的点不是 benchmark 提升本身，而是它把“公平的动作比较”和“状态进展估计”拆开，给稀疏奖励场景提供了一种不训练 value model 的折中方案。
summary.technical_approach: ProGPO 保留 prefix-consistent grouping，只在相同历史前缀下比较动作，避免把不同上下文中的动作放在一起算 advantage。这样做会造成许多小组或 singleton，论文用额外的 transition credit 补足信号。具体做法是从同一批 rollout 中估计状态势能 V(s)，再用 V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t) 表示当前动作带来的进展。动作相对优势仍来自历史一致的组内比较，状态进展则来自 rollout return 的统计估计。为避免训练参数化 critic，论文把 value lookup 设计成多分辨率估计：浅层前缀样本多但混杂，深层前缀更精确但方差大；方法按样本量和 return 方差做 inverse-variance fusion，让更可靠的深度贡献更大。另有 semantic expansion，用相近状态补充证据，但动作比较本身不放松历史一致性约束。和 GiGPO 这类 step-level grouping 方法相比，核心区别在于不通过放宽分组来换取信号密度，而是额外估计状态进展。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，在 WebShop 和 ALFWorld 上评估。论文报告 ProGPO 将 ALFWorld 最强匹配 baseline 的 success 从 87.8% 提到 90.1%，WebShop success 从 67.6% 提到 71.5%。训练轨迹分析显示，在加入 transition credit 前，WebShop 有 33.7% 的步骤、ALFWorld 有 44.5% 的步骤在 prefix-consistent peer comparison 下拿不到非零 advantage，这支持了“严格分组导致信号稀疏”的动机。额外的 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct ALFWorld 实验显示，ProGPO 在训练后期相对 GiGPO 和 HGPO 有更好的验证 success 与测试得分。消融重点应关注多分辨率势能估计、semantic expansion、transition credit 三部分各自对稳定性和最终 success 的贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 到 35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 grouping trade-off 的定义，以及 Figure 2 对零 advantage 步骤比例的统计。方法部分重点看 advantage 如何拆成 prefix-consistent action comparison 与 transition credit，两者是否有尺度归一化和权重控制。实验部分只需看 WebShop、ALFWorld 主表和消融表，判断提升是否来自更密的训练信号，而不是 rollout 数、prompt、环境配置差异。若关心 Agent RL，可细看多分辨率 value lookup；若只关心基座预训练，可快速略过任务细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses step-level credit assignment in long-horizon agent RL. Coarse state grouping gives denser comparisons but can compare actions taken under different histories. Prefix-consistent grouping is fairer, but it fragments the batch and leaves many steps without a usable peer-comparison advantage.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to post-training than to foundation-model pretraining, but it is useful for understanding how GRPO-like, critic-free RL can be adapted beyond single-turn reasoning. The main lesson is the separation between fair action comparison and progress estimation. This matters for long-horizon environments where terminal rewards are sparse and trajectory-level updates waste much of the interaction signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: ProGPO keeps action comparisons prefix-consistent: actions are compared only when they share the same historical prefix. Instead of relaxing this rule to obtain larger groups, it adds a transition-credit term based on rollout-derived state potentials, using V(s_{t+1}) - V(s_t) as a progress signal. The method does not train a value network. It estimates potentials from the same rollout batch through multi-resolution lookup: shallow prefixes provide more samples but mix different histories, while deeper prefixes are more specific but noisier. Eligible depths are fused with inverse-variance weights based on sample count and return variance. Semantic expansion adds nearby evidence for small groups, while the action-comparison path remains exact. Compared with GiGPO-style step grouping, the design choice is to preserve comparability and recover density through a separate progress estimator.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct on WebShop and ALFWorld. ProGPO improves ALFWorld success from the best matched baseline of 87.8% to 90.1%, and WebShop success from 67.6% to 71.5%. The paper reports that before transition credit is added, 33.7% of WebShop steps and 44.5% of ALFWorld steps have zero prefix-consistent peer-comparison advantage, which directly supports the sparse-signal diagnosis. Additional ALFWorld runs with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct show a late-training advantage over GiGPO and HGPO in validation success and test score. The key ablations to check are the transition-credit term, semantic expansion, and inverse-variance multi-resolution fusion.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 to 35 minutes. Read the motivation and grouping analysis first, especially the statistics behind zero peer-comparison advantage. Then inspect the method section for the exact decomposition of action-relative advantage and transition credit. In the experiments, focus on the WebShop and ALFWorld main tables plus ablations, and check whether rollout budget, environment setup, and prompt format are controlled. For agent-RL work, the multi-resolution potential estimator is the main technical component worth reading carefully; for pretraining-focused readers, the task-specific environment details can be skipped.

recommendation.zh: 针对Agent RL中step-level advantage估计的改进，提出了一种无需Critic的组策略优化方法，关注RLHF/Agent训练的可以一读。
recommendation.en: An improvement on step-level advantage estimation in Agent RL, proposing a critic-free group policy optimization method. Relevant for those working on RLHF/Agent training.

paper.title: CompactionRL: Reinforcement Learning with Context Compaction for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agentic LLMs are increasingly limited by finite context windows, as extended interaction trajectories can exceed the maximum context length before a task is completed. Context compaction offers a natural solution by summarizing previous interaction states and continuing the rollout under a compressed context, but incorporating compaction into reinforcement learning remains underexplored. We propose CompactionRL, a reinforcement learning strategy to train long-horizon agentic LLMs wi

summary.core_problem: CompactionRL 解决的是长程 agent RL 中的上下文瓶颈：交互轨迹会超过固定 context window，但简单扩大上下文代价高，推理时做摘要又没有被训练目标约束。核心问题是，如何在固定工作上下文预算下，把“执行任务”和“压缩历史”一起纳入 RL，让模型学会生成会影响后续决策的摘要。
summary.importance: 这篇属于 post-train 与 pretrain 接口上的重要方法工作。它不是单纯做长上下文推理技巧，而是把 context compaction 变成策略的一部分，并把摘要 token 放进同一个任务奖励优化回路。对基座研究的启发有三点。第一，长程能力不一定只靠更长 context，也可以靠可训练的状态压缩。第二，agent RL 的训练单位不再天然是完整 rollout；压缩会把一条轨迹切成长度不同、时间位置不同的 segment，损失归一化和 credit assignment 会直接影响训练信号质量。第三，summary 不是外部 memory 组件，而是模型要学习的中间状态表示，这与持续预训练、长程记忆和 latent state modeling 都有联系。
summary.technical_approach: 方法基于 PPO，而不是沿用 GRPO 式的 group-relative 完整 rollout 优化。原因是 compaction 会让每个任务产生数量可变的轨迹段，固定 group normalization 很难处理段长、压缩次数和时间距离的差异。CompactionRL 在 rollout collection 中加入压缩机制：当历史长度接近上下文预算 C，剩余空间低于阈值 T_comp 时，系统追加固定 summarization instruction，由当前可训练 policy 生成 summary；随后用 summary 加最近一小段交互历史重建 context，agent 继续执行任务。assistant action 和 summary generation 都作为 policy 产生的 token，被同一个最终任务奖励优化。两个技术细节很关键。第一是 token-level loss normalization，用来减少长 summary 或长 action 在 PPO loss 中获得过大权重的问题。第二是 cross-trajectory GAE，用 critic 在压缩边界之外传播 advantage，避免把压缩后的 segment 当成独立样本而切断时间信用分配。这样，摘要质量对后续成功的影响可以通过最终奖励回传到生成摘要的 token。
summary.experiments: 实验在长程 agentic coding 任务上验证，模型包括 GLM-4.7-Flash 和 GLM-4.5-Air。对比基线是带 inference-time compaction 的基础模型，即只在推理阶段做压缩而不通过 RL 学习压缩策略。CompactionRL 在 GLM-4.7-Flash 上使 SWE-bench Verified 提升 5.5 分，Terminal-Bench 2.0 提升 6.8 分；在 GLM-4.5-Air 上分别提升 7.0 分和 3.1 分。这个结果说明，收益不只是来自“能继续跑更长轨迹”，还来自训练期间让模型学会生成对后续决策有用的压缩状态。由于摘要和执行共享最终任务奖励，实验更接近真实长程 agent 的训练约束：任务成功通常只有稀疏反馈，中间摘要没有人工标签。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读。先看 introduction 中对 GRPO/完整 rollout 假设失效的分析，这是理解方法动机的关键。然后看 Figure 1 和 Figure 2，确认 compaction 何时触发、summary 如何进入重建 context、哪些 token 参与 PPO 更新。方法部分重点读三块：compaction rollout collection、token-level loss normalization、cross-trajectory GAE。实验部分优先看 SWE-bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2.0 主结果表，再看是否有去掉 learned compaction、去掉 token normalization、去掉 cross-trajectory GAE 的消融。最值得深挖的是 credit assignment：summary token 距离最终奖励很远，critic 与 GAE 的设计是否稳定，决定了方法能否扩展到更长 horizon 和更多工具调用场景。

summary_en.core_problem: CompactionRL addresses a training problem in long-horizon agentic RL: interaction histories can exceed a fixed context window, while inference-time summarization is not optimized by the task reward. The goal is to train the model to execute the task and to generate the compacted state that later decisions will depend on.
summary_en.importance: This is a strong post-training method with clear implications for foundation-model training. It treats context compaction as a learned policy action rather than an external memory heuristic. The contribution matters because long-horizon ability does not have to come only from larger context windows; it can also come from trained state compression under a fixed context budget. It also exposes a training issue that is easy to miss: once a rollout is split by compaction, segment length, segment position, and delayed reward all affect the quality of the RL signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method is built on PPO. The choice is deliberate: group-relative methods such as GRPO assume groups of comparable complete rollouts, while compaction creates a variable number of segments per task. During rollout collection, when the remaining context budget falls below a threshold, the model receives a fixed summarization instruction and samples a summary using the current policy. The next context is reconstructed from that summary plus a short tail of recent interaction, and the agent continues the task. Both ordinary action tokens and summary tokens are optimized under the same final task reward. Two design choices carry most of the method. Token-level loss normalization reduces bias from segments or summaries with different lengths. Cross-trajectory GAE preserves temporal credit assignment across compaction boundaries, so that the final outcome can still assign credit or blame to summary tokens generated much earlier.
summary_en.experiments: The reported experiments focus on long-horizon agentic coding. On GLM-4.7-Flash, CompactionRL improves over a base model with inference-time compaction by 5.5 points on SWE-bench Verified and 6.8 points on Terminal-Bench 2.0. On GLM-4.5-Air, the gains are 7.0 and 3.1 points on the same two benchmarks. These numbers indicate that training the compaction behavior is better than adding summarization only at inference time. The setup is also realistic for agent RL: the summary has no separate supervision, and its usefulness is learned through sparse task-level reward.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read carefully. Start with the motivation explaining why complete-rollout group optimization breaks under compaction. Then inspect Figures 1 and 2 to follow the compaction trigger, reconstructed context, and the tokens included in the PPO update. In the method section, focus on rollout collection with compaction, token-level loss normalization, and cross-trajectory GAE. In the experiments, prioritize the main SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.0 tables, then check ablations for learned compaction, normalization, and cross-boundary advantage estimation if provided. The deepest point is credit assignment: summary tokens are far from the final reward, and the stability of the critic and GAE determines whether the method can scale to longer horizons and more complex tool-use tasks.

recommendation.zh: 把“总结=推理技巧”改成“总结=可学习动作”这点值得立刻复现；重点看 token-level 归一化与 cross-trajectory GAE，别被单点 Pass@1 吸走注意力。
recommendation.en: Worth reproducing for the shift from “summarization as inference hack” to “summarization as a learnable action”; focus on token-level normalization and cross-trajectory GAE, not the headline Pass@1.

paper.title: VideoSearcher: Empowering Video Deep Research with Multi-Tool Agentic Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Video understanding is moving beyond closed-context perception toward open-world evidence exploration, a paradigm formalized as Video Deep Research (VDR). However, existing multimodal search agents primarily target static images, and the current VDR benchmark relies on text-centric retrieval that discards crucial visual information. To address these limitations, we propose VideoSearcher, a closed-loop agentic framework that empowers Vision-Language Models with multi-tool reasoning for VDR. Video

summary.core_problem: 现有视频深度研究基准依赖文本中心检索丢失视觉信息，且多模态搜索agent多针对静态图像，缺乏视频场景的多工具闭环推理能力。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出面向视频深度研究的多工具agent框架及双分支RL优化算法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出VideoSearcher闭环agent框架，统一时间定位、空间聚焦和多模态搜索于单条推理轨迹；提出BiSPO强化学习算法，解耦工具调用优化与答案准确性优化，提供更稳定的学习信号。
summary.experiments: 在视频深度研究任务上验证效果，未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing video deep research benchmarks rely on text-centric retrieval that discards visual information, and most multimodal search agents target static images, lacking closed-loop multi-tool reasoning capability for video scenarios.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposing a multi-tool agent framework for video deep research and a dual-branch RL optimization algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VideoSearcher closed-loop agent framework that unifies temporal localization, spatial focusing, and multimodal search in a single reasoning trajectory; proposes BiSPO reinforcement learning algorithm that decouples tool invocation optimization from answer accuracy optimization to provide more stable learning signals.
summary_en.experiments: Effectiveness verified on video deep research tasks; specific model parameters and training data scale not disclosed.

recommendation.zh: 视频领域agent的增量工作，双分支RL解耦设计可做弱参考，无需深读。
recommendation.en: Incremental video domain agent work; the dual-branch RL decoupling design can be used as weak reference.

paper.title: Incentivizing Vision Language Models to Search for Long Video Question Answering
paper.abstract: We introduce VSeek, an agentic framework that transforms long-video question answering (LVQA) from a passive, single-pass perception task into a multi-turn retrieval process. VSeek utilizes a natural language-driven search to identify relevant context within long videos and is post-trained with reinforcement learning (RL) to jointly formulate targeted search queries and reason over retrieved clips for LVQA. While RL post-training has revolutionized reasoning in symbolic domains such as mathemati

summary.core_problem: 现有长视频问答方法依赖单轮被动感知，难以高效定位长视频中的相关上下文，且RL训练缺乏可验证的视觉奖励信号
summary.importance: 方法创新，将长视频QA重构为多轮检索的agent任务，提出神经符号奖励机制，为多模态agent的RL训练提供新思路
summary.technical_approach: 提出VSeek agent框架，用自然语言驱动的多轮搜索定位相关视频片段；通过RL后训练联合优化查询生成与答案推理；设计神经符号奖励模块，将自然语言问题编译为时序逻辑规范，分解为原子视觉原语以验证检索相关性，提供可靠奖励
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体实验设置、所用模型与数据集、对比基线及量化性能提升，详细结果需参见正文
summary.authors_note: 作者包括德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的Kristen Grauman（知名多模态与计算机视觉研究者）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-video QA methods rely on single-pass passive perception, which fails to efficiently locate relevant context in long videos, and RL training lacks verifiable visual reward signals
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: reframes long-video QA as an agentic multi-turn retrieval task and proposes a neuro-symbolic reward mechanism, offering new ideas for reward design in multimodal agent RL training
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes VSeek, an agent framework that uses natural language-driven multi-turn search to locate relevant video clips; jointly optimizes query generation and answer reasoning via RL post-training; designs a neuro-symbolic reward module that compiles natural language questions into temporal logic specifications decomposed into atomic visual primitives to verify retrieval relevance and provide reliable rewards
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not disclose specific experimental settings, models, datasets, baselines, or quantitative performance improvements; detailed results require reading the full paper
summary_en.authors_note: Authors include Kristen Grauman (renowned researcher in multimodal learning and computer vision) from the University of Texas at Austin

recommendation.zh: 多模态agent与RL结合的任务级探索，神经符号奖励设计有一定参考性，对预训练研究员价值有限，看摘要即可
recommendation.en: Task-level exploration of multimodal agent combined with RL; neuro-symbolic reward design has some reference value, limited value for pretraining researchers, just read the abstract

paper.title: Optimizing Visual Generative Models via Distribution-wise Rewards
paper.abstract: Conventional reinforcement learning strategies for visual generation typically employ sample-wise reward functions, yet this practice frequently results in reward hacking that degrades image diversity and introduces visual anomalies. To address these limitations, we present a novel framework that finetunes generative models using distribution-wise rewards, ensuring better alignment with real-world data distributions. Unlike rewards that evaluate samples individually, distribution-wise reward acc

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉生成模型用逐样本 reward 做 RL 微调时容易 reward hacking、损害多样性并产生异常图像的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是生成模型后训练方法。它把 reward 从单样本评价改成分布级评价，目标是让生成样本整体更接近真实数据分布，而不是让每个样本独立朝同一奖励方向塌缩。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 distribution-wise reward finetuning 框架。核心是用一组生成样本的分布统计来给奖励信号，并用 subset-replace 策略降低分布奖励估计成本：只替换参考生成集合中的小子集来近似奖励变化。还尝试用 RL 优化 post-hoc model merging 系数，以缓解训练和推理目标不一致。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集和具体数值。实验应以视觉生成模型为对象，对比常规 sample-wise reward RL 微调，关注图像质量、多样性、mode collapse 和视觉异常；作者声称 distribution-wise reward 能改善对真实数据分布的对齐并减轻多样性退化。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses reward hacking and diversity collapse when visual generative models are fine-tuned with sample-wise RL rewards.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a post-training method for generative models. It shifts the reward signal from individual samples to the generated distribution, aiming to match real data statistics instead of pushing every sample along the same reward gradient.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed framework uses distribution-wise rewards for fine-tuning. A subset-replace strategy makes reward estimation cheaper by updating only a small subset of a generated reference set. The paper also applies RL to post-hoc model-merging coefficients, targeting train-inference mismatch.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, datasets, or exact numbers. The comparisons appear to be against conventional sample-wise reward optimization for visual generators, with evaluation centered on visual quality, diversity, mode collapse, and artifacts.

recommendation.zh: 可扫 reward 设计部分；对 LLM RLHF 的借鉴是“分布级信号抗塌缩”，但视觉生成 setup 不能直接外推。
recommendation.en: Skim the reward formulation; the useful prior is distribution-level signals against collapse, but the visual-generation setup should not be over-transferred to RLHF.

paper.title: Decomposer: Learning to Decompile Symbolic Music to Programs
paper.abstract: Musical performance involves executing a set of high-level musical instructions, yet recovering those instructions from the performance is a challenging inverse problem. We present Decomposer, a post-training framework for symbolic music decompilation: the task of recovering executable, editable music programs from symbolic music. We instantiate the task as MIDI-to-Strudel decompilation, where the model takes symbolic MIDI as input and produces a program in Strudel, a music programming language,

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是低资源程序语言下的“符号音乐反编译”：给定 MIDI，生成可执行、可编辑的 Strudel 程序，并且执行后能尽量还原原始音乐。难点不只是匹配音符，而是在 faithful reconstruction 和 readable program abstraction 之间取平衡；简单逐音符转写很准，但代码不可读、不可编辑。
summary.importance: 这不是通用 LLM 预训练论文，但对 post-training 有清楚启发：当目标可以通过执行器验证时，SFT 可以提供语法和结构 warm start，RL 可以用无标注执行反馈继续提升 grounding。它展示了一个低资源代码/DSL 场景中的训练闭环：先用合成 paired data 学会输出合法程序，再用 execution-based reward 适配真实输入分布。对代码模型、工具调用、程序合成类 RL 数据构造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: DECOMPOSER 将 MIDI-to-Strudel 建成两阶段后训练框架。第一阶段用合成的 MIDI–Strudel paired data 做 SFT，让模型先学会 Strudel 语法、常见音乐结构和可执行输出格式。第二阶段做 execution-based RL：模型生成 Strudel 程序，执行渲染回 MIDI，再用渲染结果和输入 MIDI 的匹配程度给 faithfulness reward；同时加入 readability reward，避免模型退化为逐音符列表。奖励中显式处理两个目标：一边用 onset/frame/instrument 等指标约束音乐还原，一边用可读性 rubric 鼓励抽象结构。与直接让 frontier LLM zero-shot/ few-shot 生成代码不同，它把“执行后是否还原”变成训练信号；与 heuristic converter 不同，它不追求机械转写，而是用可读性奖励限制不可编辑输出。
