Start with the introduction and the main collapse figures. Do not focus only on task success rate; also track malformed tool calls, error-response frequency, and the probability trajectories of control tokens.

Then move to the analysis section and understand why the authors claim the capability is preserved but hidden by structural failure. If the paper includes prompt-variation or format-relaxation case studies, those are worth close reading because they determine the right remedy. If the issue were capability loss, one would redesign rewards or exploration. If it is structural collapse, one needs behavioral constraints.

Next, study the taxonomy of supervisory signals and the comparison between synchronous and interleaved training. Pay particular attention to what hint-based guidance and Process Reflection Supervision are each fixing. Training-timeline diagrams, if present, are likely useful here.

Finish with the OOD, learning-rate, and transfer analyses. The easy takeaway is “supervision stabilizes RL,” but the useful takeaway is finer-grained: which supervision mainly repairs structure, which harms generalization, and which is more hyperparameter-robust. Around 35–50 minutes should be enough for the main thread; if you want to adapt the ideas to code agents, function calling, or long-chain reasoning, also read the failure cases and appendix details.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫 §分析和监督信号消融；“能力没丢、格式 token 崩了”是可复现实验的好假设。
recommendation.en: Skim the failure analysis and supervision ablations; “capability intact, format tokens collapsed” is a clean hypothesis to test internally.

paper.title: Learning with a Single Rollout via Monte Carlo Pass@k Critic
paper.abstract: Estimating token-level advantages in reinforcement learning (RL) for language models remains challenging because scaling up episodic experience collection is expensive. The difficulty intensifies for baseline advantage estimation methods, where repeated sampling causes trajectories to diverge into substantially different reasoning prefixes. In this context, RL algorithms such as GRPO prove limited: an outcome reward is too sparse to be attributed to specific actions like intermediate steps, and

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是单条 rollout 条件下的 token 级信用分配。数学推理和代码任务常用可验证终局奖励，但终局正确性只告诉模型答案对不对，不能稳定说明中间哪些 token 或步骤应被强化。GRPO 这类多样本方法依赖同一 prompt 下多条 completion 的比较，但长推理、工具调用或 agent 轨迹会让不同 rollout 走向差异很大，采样成本也高。论文希望在每个 prompt 只采一条轨迹时，仍然得到可用于 PPO 更新的稠密优势信号。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 reasoning model 的 RL 训练信号有启发。核心价值在于把“终局奖励”转成“前缀可达性/成功概率”的 critic，而不是只依赖 outcome reward 或 TD bootstrap。这个方向适合思考 RL pretrain、长链推理、工具型 agent 训练中的信号质量问题：当重复采样昂贵且轨迹不可比时，训练算法需要在单条轨迹内部做信用分配。Pass@k critic 也提供了一个有用视角：训练目标不一定只估计当前策略一次采样成功率，也可以估计某个前缀是否仍保留通向正确解的可行 continuation。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 SR-PPO，即 single-rollout proximal policy optimization。它用 Monte Carlo 标注训练一个前缀级 credit model，作为 PPO 的 value/critic。给定一个 partial solution，critic 预测从该前缀继续采样 k 次时至少一次成功的概率，也就是 Pass@k value。训练时不再主要依赖 GAE 中的 TD 误差和 bootstrapped value，而是用与最终成功直接相关的 Monte Carlo 标签来学习前缀价值。优势信号由相邻前缀的价值变化给出：如果某段 continuation 让 Pass@k 估计上升，对应 token 得到正信用；如果让成功可达性下降，则得到负信用。终止位置再加入 correction term，使稠密信用信号与真实终局 outcome 对齐。论文特别强调 Pass@4，而不是只用 Pass@1。Pass@1 更接近当前策略单次成功率，容易把已较容易解决的前缀也纳入更新；Pass@k 更偏向“还有没有多条机会能解出来”，会弱化已经容易的状态，把训练压力放到仍可挽救但尚不稳定的前缀上。k 趋大时，Pass@k 接近 reachability：该前缀是否存在成功 continuation。这把“状态是否可解”和“当前策略一次是否解出”区分开来。
summary.experiments: 给定正文中明确的信息包括：实验面向数学推理；训练设定为每个 prompt 单条 rollout；主 critic 使用 Pass@4；比较对象围绕 outcome-only RL、GRPO 式多 rollout 信号和 PPO/GAE 式 TD critic。可见的实验主张是，Pass@k critic 能在单 rollout 下提供比终局奖励更细的 token 级训练信号，并减少多 rollout 采样带来的计算成本和异质轨迹比较噪声。消融重点应包括 Pass@1 与 Pass@4 的差异、是否加入 terminal correction、Monte Carlo prefix critic 与 TD/GAE critic 的差异、以及不同推理长度下信用分配稳定性。提供的正文片段没有给出完整表格、模型参数量、数据规模或具体提升数字，因此不应从片段外推数值结论。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20–30 分钟。先看方法部分中 Pass@k value 的定义，以及 SR-PPO 如何把相邻前缀 value difference 转成 token advantage；这是主要创新。其次看 terminal correction 的公式，它决定稠密奖励是否会偏离真实终局奖励。再看 Pass@1、Pass@4 和 reachability 解释，重点理解为什么 k 增大会让 critic 更关注“可解性”而不是“当前策略一次采样概率”。实验部分优先看三类消融：critic 训练标签、k 的选择、与 GRPO/PPO-GAE 的采样效率对比。若关心长上下文 agent RL，可以重点看作者如何描述多 rollout 轨迹异质性，因为这部分比数学任务本身更有迁移价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies token-level credit assignment when only one rollout is available per prompt. Verifiable-reward training for math and code usually provides a delayed binary outcome, but that signal cannot identify which intermediate tokens or reasoning steps helped. Multi-sample methods such as GRPO become costly and noisy when different completions follow very different reasoning paths. The goal is to make PPO work in this single-rollout regime by extracting a dense training signal from the realized trajectory itself.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to reasoning post-training and RL signal design than to base pretraining directly. Its useful idea is to replace a sparse outcome reward, or a TD-bootstrapped value estimate, with a prefix-level success critic trained from Monte Carlo outcome labels. For researchers working on RL pretraining, long-horizon reasoning, or tool-using agents, the paper points to a practical issue: additional rollouts may be too expensive, and heterogeneous trajectories may not be comparable. A Pass@k critic also separates two notions that are often mixed together: whether a prefix still has a path to success, and whether the current policy will succeed with one sample.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is single-rollout PPO with a Monte Carlo Pass@k critic. For each partial solution, a credit model predicts the probability that at least one of k continuations will end with a correct answer. This predicted Pass@k value is used as the critic for policy optimization. Instead of using GAE with temporal-difference bootstrapping, the critic is trained against Monte Carlo outcome labels tied to eventual success. Token-level advantages are obtained from value changes along the trajectory: a continuation receives positive credit if it increases the estimated chance of future success, and negative credit if it lowers that estimate. A terminal correction term keeps the dense credit signal aligned with the observed final reward. The paper emphasizes Pass@4 as the main operating point. Compared with Pass@1, it gives a more selective signal: easy prefixes are downweighted, while prefixes that remain solvable but uncertain receive more training pressure. As k grows, the value approaches a reachability question: whether any successful continuation exists from the prefix.
summary_en.experiments: The visible experimental setup targets mathematical reasoning, uses one rollout per prompt, and centers the main critic on Pass@4. The relevant baselines are outcome-only reinforcement learning, group-based multi-rollout methods such as GRPO, and PPO with GAE-style TD value estimation. The main experimental claim is that a Pass@k prefix critic can provide denser token-level credit under a single-rollout budget, while avoiding the cost and trajectory mismatch of repeated sampling. The most important ablations are expected to be Pass@1 versus Pass@4, terminal correction on versus off, Monte Carlo prefix critic versus TD critic, and robustness as reasoning traces become longer. The provided full-text excerpt does not include complete result tables, model sizes, data scale, or numeric gains, so numeric conclusions should not be inferred beyond the stated setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Focus first on the formal definition of the Pass@k value and the way SR-PPO converts value differences between adjacent prefixes into token advantages. Then read the terminal correction term, since it controls whether the dense signal remains consistent with the final outcome. The Pass@1, Pass@4, and reachability discussion is also worth reading carefully, because it explains why increasing k shifts the critic from single-sample success probability toward solvability. In the experiments, prioritize ablations on the critic label, the choice of k, and sample-efficiency comparisons against GRPO and PPO-GAE. For long-horizon agent training, the discussion of heterogeneous rollouts is likely more transferable than the math benchmark details.

recommendation.zh: 针对 LLM RLHF 中 GRPO 采样成本高的问题，提出用单次 rollout 训练 token-level critic，值得关注其 critic 训练的稳定性和实际效果对比。
recommendation.en: Addresses the high sampling cost of GRPO in LLM RLHF by proposing a token-level critic trained with a single rollout; worth checking the stability of critic training and empirical comparisons.

paper.title: MiniOpt: Reasoning to Model and Solve General Optimization Problems with Limited Resources
paper.abstract: Achieving strong optimization generalization across diverse optimization problems while requiring limited training resources remains a challenging problem for optimization-oriented large language models (LLMs). Existing approaches typically rely on large-scale supervised datasets, costly reasoning annotations, and expensive intermediate step verification, resulting in substantial training overhead. To address these challenges, we propose MiniOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that learns to

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是小参数模型在自然语言优化问题上的泛化训练问题：如何在少量标注、有限训练成本和较低推理开销下，让模型把问题描述转成可执行的数学建模与求解代码，而不是依赖大规模 SFT 数据、人工 CoT 标注或昂贵的逐步验证。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在基座预训练本身，而在 post-train 与 verifiable reasoning 的接口设计。MiniOpt 把优化建模任务改造成适合 RLVR 的结构化生成问题，说明在高验证成本任务上，奖励设计和中间表示比单纯增加 CoT 数据更关键。对小模型能力注入、领域推理数据效率、可执行反馈训练有参考价值，但贡献主要限于优化建模垂类，不应外推为通用推理训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: MiniOpt 采用 reasoning-to-model-and-solve 范式，将传统“建模并求解”的流程显式拆成结构化优化建模和可执行 solver 生成。核心做法是把 CoT 改写成五元素 tuple 的结构化表示，使中间推理更容易验证。训练流程分为三段：先用少量标注数据做 mid-training，缓解早期 RL 的奖励稀疏和训练坍塌；随后第一阶段 RL 使用较低难度数据，让模型学会固定的建模—求解轨迹；第二阶段 RL 切到更难数据，提升跨类型优化问题的泛化。奖励函数 OptReward 是分层结构，重点不是逐字验证建模内容，而是检查建模完整性、可执行性和最终求解结果，同时把生成轨迹约束在正确建模附近，降低 reward hacking 风险。论文还对 GPRO 算法做了面向小样本训练的调整，以提高有限数据下的 RL 利用率。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 MiniOpt-3B，在 8 个覆盖不同优化类型和问题场景的 benchmark 上评估。论文报告称，在 10B 参数以下模型中 MiniOpt-3B 平均表现最好；与更大模型相比，它接近 LLMOPT-14B，并比 GPT-5 这类通用 thinking model 高 2.11 个百分点。与 DeepSeek-R1 相比，MiniOpt-3B 的平均 SA 指标具有竞争力，同时平均只使用 DeepSeek-R1 约 24.40% 的输出 token。消融结论集中在三点：reasoning-to-model-and-solve 的结构化轨迹能提升 RLVR 稳定性；mid-training 能缓解稀疏奖励下的小模型训练失败；分层 OptReward 比只看最终答案更利于保持建模正确性和泛化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25–35 分钟。重点看 Methodology 中五元素 tuple、OptReward 的分层奖励定义、两阶段 RL 训练流程，以及实验中的 ablation 表。最有信息量的部分是它如何把一个难验证的自然语言建模任务改造成可验证 RL 任务。对基座预训练研究员来说，不需要细读优化问题 benchmark 的全部设定，重点关注奖励可验证性、结构化中间表示和小模型 RL 稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train a small language model to generalize across natural-language optimization problems under tight data and compute budgets. The target capability is not just producing an answer, but converting a problem statement into a structured mathematical model and executable solver code without relying on large SFT corpora, expensive reasoning annotations, or costly step-by-step verification.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect but concrete. The useful signal is in the post-training interface: how to turn a hard-to-verify reasoning task into a structured RLVR problem. MiniOpt shows that, for executable reasoning domains, intermediate representation and reward design can matter more than collecting long annotated CoT traces. The contribution is best read as a case study in data-efficient small-model specialization and verifiable reasoning, not as a general pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: MiniOpt introduces a reasoning-to-model-and-solve pipeline. It decomposes optimization reasoning into structured optimization modeling and solver-code generation. The main technical device is a five-element tuple representation embedded into the reasoning trace, which makes the intermediate modeling process easier to check. Training is progressive: a small mid-training stage on annotated data first stabilizes the policy and reduces collapse from sparse rewards; a first RL stage on easier examples teaches the model the modeling-and-solving protocol; a second RL stage on harder data improves generalization. The reward, OptReward, is hierarchical. It checks modeling completeness, executability, and solution quality, while avoiding full semantic verification of every modeling statement. This design also constrains trajectories near valid formulations to reduce reward hacking. The paper further modifies GPRO for limited-sample RL training.
summary_en.experiments: The main model is MiniOpt-3B, evaluated on 8 benchmarks covering multiple optimization types and scenarios. The paper reports that MiniOpt-3B outperforms all baselines below 10B parameters, remains competitive with LLMOPT-14B, and exceeds GPT-5 by 2.11 percentage points on the reported aggregate metric. Compared with DeepSeek-R1, it reaches competitive average SA while using about 24.40% of DeepSeek-R1's output tokens. The ablations attribute the gains to three components: the structured reasoning-to-model-and-solve format, the mid-training stage for stabilizing sparse-reward RL, and the hierarchical OptReward design.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the methodology section defining the five-element tuple, the OptReward hierarchy, the progressive RL schedule, and the ablation tables. The main transferable idea is how the authors reshape an optimization-modeling task into a verifiable RL problem. The benchmark-specific details are less important unless one works directly on LLM-based optimization modeling.

recommendation.zh: 将复杂推理任务（运筹优化）分解为建模和求解，并设计了分层 Reward 进行 RL 训练，对如何用 RL 提升 LLM 特定领域推理能力有启发。
recommendation.en: Decomposes complex reasoning tasks (operations research) into modeling and solving, and designs a hierarchical Reward for RL training, inspiring how to use RL to enhance LLM domain-specific reasoning.

paper.title: Transferability for General Reasoning: An Automated Curriculum for Multi-Domain RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has been extended from single-domain training to multi-domain reasoning suites spanning mathematics, programming, and science. However, the training curriculum (how often each domain is sampled) is typically fixed or hand-tuned, even though reasoning skills transfer unevenly across domains. Existing learnability-based curricula adapt to where the policy is currently improving, but are blind to whether a gradient step on the selected domain be

summary.core_problem: 多领域带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）训练中，现有采样课程要么固定、手工调参，要么仅基于单领域当前可学习性选择采样域，完全忽略某一域的梯度更新对其余领域的跨域迁移收益，导致训练算力过度投入局部增益高但全局迁移价值低的领域，浪费多领域联合训练的潜力。
summary.importance: 为LLM推理能力的多领域RL后训练提供了低开销的课程优化方案，其核心思路——将跨域迁移性作为采样优先级的核心信号——可直接迁移到预训练数据课程设计中，为通用能力导向的域间数据配比提供可落地的量化依据。
summary.technical_approach: 提出迁移感知课程（TAC），将多领域采样建模为多臂老虎机问题。每个域对应的臂反馈由两部分通过系数β加权融合：一是基于GRPO优势值计算的单领域当前可学习性项，衡量策略在该域的即时优化空间；二是自监督跨域迁移性项，维护每个域投影梯度的指数移动平均（EMA），每Kc步计算各域梯度EMA的两两余弦相似度作为迁移强度信号，该信号完全复用RL训练已产生的梯度，无需额外探针、采样 rollout 或人工标注。
summary.experiments: 在覆盖数学、编程、逻辑、仿真、表格、STEM的6领域推理套件上，使用Qwen3-1.7B和Llama3.2-3B测试。TAC相比比例采样、手工设计的数学优先调度、仅考虑可学习性的老虎机课程，在14个评测基准上的宏平均准确率提升1.6–2.8个绝对点（相对提升最高10%），额外时钟开销不到1%。消融实验验证了迁移性项的独立贡献；在数据预算倾斜的场景下，TAC不会像仅可学习性课程那样过度投入占主导的领域，鲁棒性更强。额外分析显示，RLVR最常用的数学领域迁移性排名靠后，TAC会自动降低其采样权重。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看第1章图1，直观了解跨域迁移的非对称性和TAC的初步效果；再读第3章的梯度迁移性信号设计和老虎机建模逻辑；最后看第4章核心实验结果、消融表和附录C的开销数据。预计阅读时间20–30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: In multi-domain Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) training for LLM reasoning, existing sampling curricula are either fixed/hand-tuned or only prioritize a domain based on its current learnability, ignoring whether gradient updates on that domain deliver transfer benefits to other domains. This leads to over-allocation of compute to domains with high local gains but low global transfer value, leaving the potential of multi-domain joint training underutilized.
summary_en.importance: Delivers a low-overhead curriculum optimization method for multi-domain RL post-training of reasoning capabilities. Its core principle — using cross-domain transferability as a first-class sampling priority signal — can be directly extended to pretraining data curriculum design, providing a quantifiable, actionable metric for domain-level data mixture targeting general capability improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Transfer-Aware Curriculum (TAC), which formulates multi-domain sampling as a multi-armed bandit problem. Per-arm feedback is a weighted combination (controlled by coefficient β) of two terms: 1) an on-policy learnability term derived from GRPO advantages, capturing the immediate optimization space of the policy on a given domain; 2) a self-supervised transferability term, which maintains exponential moving averages (EMA) of projected gradients per domain, and computes pairwise cosine similarities between these EMAs every K_c steps as the cross-domain transfer signal. This signal fully reuses gradients already generated during standard RL training, requiring no held-out probes, extra rollouts, or manual annotations.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on a 6-domain reasoning suite covering math, programming, logic, simulation, tables, and STEM, using Qwen3-1.7B and Llama3.2-3B models. TAC improves macro-averaged accuracy across 14 evaluation benchmarks by 1.6–2.8 absolute points (up to 10% relative) over proportional sampling, hand-designed math-first schedules, and learnability-only bandit curricula, with <1% additional wall-clock overhead. Ablations confirm the independent contribution of the transferability term. Under skewed data budgets, TAC is more robust than learnability-only curricula and avoids over-commitment to dominant domains. Additional analysis shows math, the most commonly used domain in RLVR pipelines, ranks among the least transferable, and TAC automatically down-weights its sampling rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, start with Figure 1 in Section 1 to visualize the asymmetry of cross-domain transfer and preliminary TAC gains. Then read Section 3 for the gradient-based transferability signal design and bandit formulation. Finally, review core experimental results, ablation tables in Section 4, and overhead measurements in Appendix C. Estimated reading time: 20–30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 梯度几何对齐估计跨域迁移性的思路可直接迁移到预训练动态数据配比实验，重点看§3的TAC算法与梯度投影细节
recommendation.en: The gradient-alignment based cross-domain transfer estimation can be directly adapted to dynamic pretraining data mixture experiments, focus on §3 for TAC algorithm details

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems

paper.title: Semantic Consistency Policy Optimization for Reinforcement Learning of LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning effectively post-trains LLM agents for long-horizon, sparse-reward tasks by deriving step-level credit from trajectory outcomes. However, this ties a step's credit to its rollout's final outcome: semantically near-identical intermediate steps receive opposite credit depending on whether their trajectory eventually succeeded or failed. Such semantic credit inconsistency sends conflicting gradients to similar actions and wastes the partially-correct progress insi

summary.core_problem: 解决基于分组的LLM智能体强化学习中，语义相近的中间步骤因轨迹最终成败不同而获得相反信用、导致梯度冲突与失败轨迹中部分正确进展被浪费的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出无价值函数的奖励塑形思路，缓解分组RL中的语义信用不一致问题，为长程稀疏奖励任务的后训练提供新方向。
summary.technical_approach: 提出语义一致性策略优化（SCPO），属于改进型方法；核心是在同一rollout分组内，用成功的兄弟轨迹为失败步骤打分，对沿兄弟轨迹取得的新进展赋予正向步骤级信用，无需额外价值网络。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld和WebShop两个长程智能体基准上测试，与强分组RL基线对比，SCPO达到或超过基线性能，ALFWorld上成功率为93.7±4.1%。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses semantic credit inconsistency in group-based RL for LLM agents: semantically similar intermediate steps receive opposite rewards depending on their rollout's final outcome, wasting partial progress in failed trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes a value-free reward shaping approach to mitigate credit misalignment, offering a new direction for post-training agents on long-horizon sparse-reward tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Semantic Consistency Policy Optimization (SCPO), an improved RL method that scores failed steps against successful sibling trajectories within the same rollout group and assigns positive step-level credit to new progress along the sibling path, without a separate value network.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ALFWorld and WebShop long-horizon agent benchmarks; SCPO matches or outperforms strong group-based baselines, achieving 93.7±4.1% success rate on ALFWorld.

recommendation.zh: 信用分配思路对RLHF/RL智能体训练有弱启发，重点看§3的兄弟轨迹打分规则即可，实验规模偏小，结论当参考信号。
recommendation.en: The credit assignment idea offers weak signal for RLHF and agent training; focus on §3 sibling scoring rules, treat small-scale results as reference only.

paper.title: TRUSTMEM: Learning Trustworthy Memory Consolidation for LLM Agents with Long-Term Memory
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents rely on long-term memory to support extended interactions and personalized assistance beyond finite context windows. Existing memory agents actively update external memory through generated write, revise, and delete operations, but these updates may omit important information, corrupt existing memory, or introduce unsupported hallucinated content. Once stored, such errors become persistent system-state failures that can affect future reasoning and generation. In

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent长期记忆的更新操作易丢失关键信息、篡改已有记忆或引入幻觉内容，导致持久系统错误影响后续推理
summary.importance: 通用Agent方法创新，首次结合记忆迁移验证与偏好引导RL优化记忆更新的可信性，解决长期记忆的持续错误问题
summary.technical_approach: 提出TrustMem框架：1）Memory Transition Verifier从覆盖度、保留度、忠实度三维评估记忆更新的迁移过程；2）同记忆状态下构造候选更新的偏好对，通过偏好引导RL直接优化记忆更新行为
summary.experiments: 未披露具体LLM参数量与训练数据规模，仅说明在多组LLM Agent长期记忆任务基准上完成对比实验，完整效果数据未披露

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent long-term memory updates tend to lose critical information, corrupt stored memory, or introduce hallucinations, leading to persistent system errors that degrade subsequent reasoning
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation for general LLM agents, first combining memory transition verification with preference-guided RL to optimize memory update trustworthiness
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose TrustMem framework: 1) Memory Transition Verifier evaluating updates via coverage, preservation, and faithfulness; 2) Preference pair construction for RL-guided memory update optimization
summary_en.experiments: No specific LLM parameter or training data scale disclosed, only comparative experiments on LLM agent long-term memory benchmarks mentioned, full results undisclosed

recommendation.zh: 属于LLM Agent记忆优化的增量工作，仅对研究Agent记忆与预训练结合的人员有参考，扫摘要即可
recommendation.en: Incremental LLM agent memory optimization work, only relevant for researchers combining memory mechanisms with pretraining, skim the abstract

paper.title: Holistic Data Scheduler for LLM Pre-training via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: The composition of training data, governed by the diversity of sources and their mixing strategy, is a cornerstone of Large Language Model (LLM) pre-training. Online Data Mixing (ODM), the technique of adaptively adjusting data mixtures during training, has emerged as a promising direction to improve efficiency. However, existing methods are constrained by their reliance on a singular optimization perspective, which fundamentally overlooks the need for complex LLM pre-training to consider the dy

summary.core_problem: 论文研究在线数据配比：预训练过程中如何根据模型状态动态调整不同数据域的采样概率，而不是使用固定 mixture 或只优化单一信号。
summary.importance: 对预训练数据研究的启发在于，它把 data mixture 当作连续控制问题，并把 reward 从单一 loss 或梯度对齐扩展到多信号组合。这个方向值得泛读，但要关注成本和可扩展性。在线调度如果需要频繁计算跨域梯度影响、维护 actor-critic、调 reward 权重，在大规模训练中可能比静态 recipe 或 proxy-based 方法更难落地。
summary.technical_approach: HDS 将预训练过程形式化为 MDP。环境是正在训练的 LLM；状态向量包含当前性能、学习速度和内部稳定性；动作是下一阶段各数据域的采样概率。优化算法使用 Soft Actor-Critic，适合连续动作空间，并通过熵正则鼓励探索。actor 和 critic 使用紧凑的 Transformer-like 网络来编码状态和数据域重要性。核心设计是 multi-objective reward：一部分来自数据质量，一部分来自梯度驱动的 inter-domain influence，延续 AC-ODM 中的 gradient alignment 思路；另一部分来自模型侧信号，例如特定层的 weight norm，用来鼓励收敛和稳定。相较 DoReMi、DoGE、RegMix 这类静态配比方法，HDS 允许配比随训练状态变化；相较 ODM 的 bandit loss reward 和 AC-ODM 的 DDPG gradient alignment，它试图同时使用数据、梯度和模型内部状态。
summary.experiments: 主要结果来自 Pythia-1B 在 The Pile 上的预训练实验。论文报告 HDS 达到先前最佳在线方法的最终 validation perplexity 时，所需 iterations 减少 22%；相比静态 The Pile Weights baseline，iterations 减少 57%。在 MMLU 0-shot 上，HDS 相比先前最佳方法提升 7.2%。这些结果说明多信号在线调度可能改善收敛速度和下游泛化。泛读时需要检查消融：三个 reward 分量各自贡献多少、SAC 相比 DDPG 或 bandit 的收益是否来自算法本身、是否控制了额外计算开销、调度策略是否在不同模型规模和数据域划分下稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 20 到 30 分钟泛读。优先看 MDP formulation、state/action/reward 的具体定义，以及 Figure 1 的收敛曲线。然后看 reward ablation 和数据域权重随训练变化的图。最后检查训练成本：每次更新 scheduler 是否需要额外 forward/backward，gradient alignment 的计算频率是多少，actor-critic 的训练是否会引入不稳定。若只关心大规模预训练 recipe，重点看方法是否能转化为低频调度或离线蒸馏出的 mixture schedule。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses online data mixing for LLM pretraining: how to adapt domain sampling probabilities during training based on the model’s current state, instead of relying on a fixed mixture or a single optimization signal.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea is to frame data mixture scheduling as a continuous-control problem with multiple feedback signals. This is relevant to pretraining data research because mixture quality often determines convergence speed and capability allocation. The paper is worth skimming rather than reading in full unless the implementation details are needed. The open question is operational cost. A scheduler that depends on gradient influence signals, actor-critic training, and tuned reward weights may be harder to deploy in large-scale training than static recipes or proxy-model approaches.
summary_en.technical_approach: HDS formulates LLM pretraining as an MDP. The environment is the training run. The state vector represents current performance, learning velocity, and internal stability. The action is a probability distribution over data domains for future sampling. The policy is trained with Soft Actor-Critic, which fits the continuous action space and uses entropy regularization for exploration. The actor and critic are compact Transformer-like networks. The main design choice is the reward: it combines a data-quality term, a gradient-driven inter-domain influence term inspired by gradient alignment in AC-ODM, and a model-centric stability term based on layer weight norms. Compared with static approaches such as DoReMi, DoGE, and RegMix, HDS changes the mixture throughout training. Compared with ODM-style bandit rewards or AC-ODM’s narrower gradient-alignment reward, it uses a broader set of signals.
summary_en.experiments: The reported main experiment pretrains Pythia-1B on The Pile. HDS reaches the final validation perplexity of the best reported online baseline with 22% fewer iterations, and with 57% fewer iterations than the static The Pile Weights baseline. On MMLU 0-shot, it reports a 7.2% gain over the best reported baseline. The important checks are the ablations: how much each reward component contributes, whether SAC itself matters compared with DDPG or bandit-style policies, whether the extra scheduler cost is included, and whether the learned schedule remains stable across model sizes and domain partitions.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is enough for most pretraining readers. Focus on the MDP definition, especially the exact state features, action parameterization, and reward equations. Then inspect Figure 1 for convergence behavior and look for reward ablations and domain-weight trajectories. The practical question is whether the scheduler can be converted into a low-frequency controller or distilled into an offline mixture schedule. If the method requires frequent extra gradient computations, its usefulness at larger scale will depend on careful systems accounting.

recommendation.zh: 用 SAC 做在线 data mixture 思路新，但奖励设计决定成败；先看 §3 reward 定义和 ablations，再判断能否在内部复现。
recommendation.en: Using SAC for online data mixing is a fresh angle, but the reward design is make-or-break; read §3 and the ablations first before deciding whether to replicate internally.

paper.title: video-SALMONN-R$^3$: Learning to ReWatch, ReAsk, and ReAnswer for Efficient Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Video large language models (LLMs) are often constrained by computation and memory budgets, leading them to use reduced frame rates and spatial resolutions, which may cause them to miss critical information for question answering (QA). A practical and efficient solution is a two-stage paradigm: first perform coarse video understanding to localize relevant segments, and then re-watch these segments at higher temporal or spatial fidelity. In this paper, we present video-SALMONN-R$^3$, the first en

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是视频大模型在算力受限下如何获得“先粗看、再回看”的能力，而且不依赖昂贵的 CoT 冷启动标注。更具体地说，现有视频 LLM 往往只能低帧率、低分辨率地看完整视频，因此容易错过关键细节；两阶段 re-watch 是合理方向，但已有方法要么拆成多个模型，信息传递损失大、开销高，要么依赖带动作轨迹的 CoT SFT，数据成本高，而且会破坏原有视频理解能力。论文想做的是：从一个已经 instruction-tuned 的视频 LLM 出发，直接用 RL 学会 temporal localization 和二次观看，再把这项新能力接到原模型已有的答题能力上，而不是用大量 CoT 监督重塑整个行为模式。
summary.importance: 它和狭义预训练距离较远，更接近 post-train / RL for multimodal reasoning，但对基座研究仍有两个启发。第一，论文明确展示了一个常见问题：新行为模式如果和预训练/指令调优形成的先验冲突，直接 SFT 往往会伤到原能力；因此更稳的做法是把新能力设计成对旧能力的增量接口，而不是整体覆盖。这里的 re-answer 就是这种接口设计。第二，论文指出 causal attention 下两阶段输入的结构性限制：第一次提问的 query 无法直接与第二次回看的新视觉证据交互，所以需要 re-ask。这个观察对长上下文、多轮感知、工具调用后的再推理都有参考价值。贡献量级主要在视频 LLM 的 RL 行为学习范式，不属于预训练核心论文，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口设计有现实意义。
summary.technical_approach:
方法可以概括成一个两遍处理框架，加上两个关键行为设计。第一遍是 watch：模型以较低时空分辨率处理整段视频，输入是交错的视觉 token 和音频 token，再加上问题 Q。输出不是单一答案，而是一个结构化结果 O^(1)，包含初始答案 A^(1)、简短 reasoning trace R^(1) 和时间定位区间 T=[t_start,t_end]。这里的定位相当于一个动作，决定第二遍去哪里高保真重看。

第二遍是 re-watch：模型只对 T 指向的片段以更高帧率或更高分辨率重新编码，同时保留第一遍的全局上下文 V^(1) 以及交互轨迹 (Q, O^(1))。在这个基础上再输出最终答案。论文的两个关键设计都服务于“如何不破坏已有能力地接入 re-watch”。

其一是 re-answer。作者认为预训练后的视频 LLM 已经形成了 answer-first 倾向：看到问题和粗粒度视频后，会先给出一个尽可能合理的答案。如果强行要求模型先做显式定位、再做推理，行为顺序和原先先验不一致，RL 或 SFT 都容易不稳。于是他们让模型第一遍先按原有习惯回答，再在第二遍基于回看结果修正答案。这样新学到的 temporal localization 是附着在已有答题能力上的，而不是替代它。

其二是 re-ask。由于 causal attention 的方向限制，第一遍中的问题 token 不能回头 attend 到第二遍新看到的高保真帧，这会削弱“问题—新证据”的对齐。论文的做法是在第二遍重新注入 query，让问题与新观察到的局部视频片段直接交互。这个改动很简单，但从机制上是必要的，否则第二遍更多只是延续第一遍的 hidden state，而不是重新基于新证据做条件化。

训练上，论文强调不做 CoT cold-start，也不做 CoT-based SFT，而是从 instruction-tuned base model 直接用基于 DAPO 的 RL 优化 re-watch 行为。也就是说，时间定位区间的选择和最终回答质量共同构成策略优化对象。这里最值得注意的不是 RL 算法名字，而是它把“看哪里”视为可学习策略，而不是监督标签驱动的中间任务。
summary.experiments:
从正文可确认的主结果是：video-SALMONN-R^3 在六个 benchmark 上取得了更好的结果，同时计算成本更低；而且这一切是在不依赖 CoT 冷启动标注的前提下完成的。论文把收益归因于三点：RL 学到的 re-watch 行为、re-answer 对原有答题先验的保护、以及 re-ask 对第二遍问题对齐的修复。

实验上最关键的比较对象应当包括：1）单遍视频 LLM 基线，验证两阶段回看是否必要；2）多模型或 CoT-SFT 驱动的 re-watch 方法，验证不用 CoT 也能学到有效定位；3）去掉 re-answer 的版本，观察是否会出现原能力退化或训练不稳；4）去掉 re-ask 的版本，验证第二遍 query 重注入的增益。若论文做得完整，还应有 temporal localization 质量、不同视频长度/分辨率下的成本收益、以及 first-pass 与 second-pass token budget 分配的消融。

当前提供的全文片段没有给出具体 benchmark 名称、绝对分数、模型参数量、视频采样率、RL 训练步数等硬数字，因此无法在这里准确复述提升幅度。能确定的是，作者把“lower computational cost”作为核心卖点之一，所以阅读原文时需要重点核对：总视觉 token 数是否下降、第二遍高保真处理覆盖的视频比例是多少、相对单遍高分辨率处理节省了多少 FLOPs 或 wall-clock 时间，以及 RL 训练本身的额外成本是否被计入。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合带着问题去读。先看 Introduction，重点不是任务背景，而是作者对两类现有 re-watch 路线的批评：多模型通信损失和 CoT 监督副作用。然后直接看方法总图，确认第一遍和第二遍各自输入什么、输出什么。理解这张图后，再看 re-answer 和 re-ask 两个设计，它们是全文最有信息量的部分。

如果时间有限，优先读三处。第一，RL 目标和奖励设计，弄清楚 temporal localization 与最终 QA reward 如何耦合，是否有格式奖励、区间合法性奖励或 answer correctness reward。第二，ablation 表，尤其是去掉 re-answer / re-ask 后的变化，这能判断方法是不是靠真正的机制改进，而不是单纯增加第二遍算力。第三，成本分析，确认所谓 efficient 是不是成立。泛读大约 35-45 分钟；若想评估它对 pretrain-posttrain 接口的启发，建议额外看 failure cases，特别是第一遍答案错误时，第二遍是否真的能纠正，还是只是强化原先偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical video-LLM problem: how to give a model a coarse-to-fine re-watch capability under tight compute budgets, without relying on expensive chain-of-thought cold-start annotations. Existing video LLMs usually process full videos at reduced frame rate and resolution, which misses fine-grained evidence needed for QA. Two-stage re-watch is a natural solution, but prior approaches either split the process across multiple models, which is costly and lossy, or train a single model with interleaved reasoning-and-action CoT supervision, which is expensive to build and can damage the pretrained model’s original video understanding. The paper asks whether temporal localization and revisiting behavior can be learned directly with RL on top of an instruction-tuned video LLM.
summary_en.importance: This is closer to post-training than pretraining, but it is still relevant to foundation-model research for two reasons. First, it shows a common interface problem: when a new behavior pattern conflicts with the model’s existing prior, direct supervised reshaping can hurt the original capability. The proposed re-answer design is an example of adding a new capability as an incremental interface rather than overwriting the old behavior. Second, the paper identifies a structural limitation of causal attention in multi-pass perception: the original question tokens cannot directly interact with newly observed evidence in the second pass, which motivates re-asking the query. That observation is useful beyond video, including long-context reasoning, tool use, and multi-stage perception pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is a two-pass video understanding framework with two key behavioral designs. In the first pass, the model watches the full video at low temporal and spatial fidelity. Visual and audio tokens are interleaved and fed to the LLM together with the question. The output is structured: an initial answer A^(1), a short reasoning trace R^(1), and a temporal localization prediction T = [t_start, t_end]. The localization acts as a policy decision that determines which segment will be revisited at higher fidelity.

In the second pass, the model re-encodes only the localized segment using higher frame rate or resolution, while retaining the first-pass global context and the interaction trace from the first pass. It then produces a refined final answer. The two main design choices are there to make this new re-watch behavior compatible with the pretrained model’s existing answering prior.

The first is re-answer. The authors argue that an instruction-tuned video LLM has an answer-first tendency: given a question and a coarse video view, it naturally tries to answer immediately. Forcing the model into a strict locate-then-reason pattern creates a mismatch with that prior and can destabilize learning. Re-answer avoids this by letting the model answer first in the initial pass, then revise the answer after re-watching. This makes temporal localization an add-on capability attached to the existing QA behavior rather than a replacement for it.

The second is re-ask. Under causal attention, question tokens from the first pass cannot directly attend to newly observed high-fidelity frames in the second pass. That weakens question adherence exactly when the model is supposed to use the new evidence. The fix is simple: inject the query again during the second pass so the question can directly interact with the revisited segment. Mechanistically, this matters because otherwise the second pass mostly extends the first-pass hidden-state trajectory instead of re-conditioning on fresh evidence.

Training-wise, the paper avoids CoT cold-start and CoT-based SFT. It starts from an instruction-tuned base model and directly optimizes re-watch behavior with DAPO-based RL. The important point is not the specific RL label, but the framing: 'where to look' is treated as a learnable policy, not as an intermediate supervised label sequence.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the main empirical claim is that video-SALMONN-R^3 achieves stronger results on six benchmarks at lower computational cost, while avoiding CoT cold-start annotations. The gains are attributed to three pieces working together: RL-learned re-watch behavior, re-answer preserving the base model’s original answering prior, and re-ask restoring question-to-evidence interaction in the second pass.

The most important comparisons should include: a single-pass video-LLM baseline, prior re-watch systems that depend on multiple models or CoT-SFT, an ablation without re-answer to test whether the base capability degrades, and an ablation without re-ask to measure the value of query reinjection. A complete experimental section should also report temporal localization quality, cost-benefit trade-offs across video lengths and resolutions, and token-budget allocation between the first and second pass.

The excerpt does not include benchmark names, absolute scores, model size, sampling rates, or RL training scale, so the exact improvement margins cannot be reproduced here. What should be checked in the original paper is whether the claimed efficiency is measured in total visual tokens, FLOPs, or wall-clock latency; what fraction of the video is revisited at high fidelity; how much compute is saved relative to processing the full video at high fidelity; and whether RL training cost is accounted for separately.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read this one with a specific lens. Start from the introduction, but focus on the critique of the two existing re-watch routes: multi-model communication overhead and the side effects of CoT supervision. Then inspect the overall method figure to understand exactly what enters and exits each pass. Once that is clear, the most informative parts are the re-answer and re-ask designs.

If time is limited, prioritize three things. First, the RL objective and reward design: how temporal localization and final QA quality are coupled, and whether there are auxiliary rewards for formatting or valid time spans. Second, the ablation table, especially removing re-answer and re-ask, because that reveals whether the gains come from real mechanism design or simply from spending more compute in a second pass. Third, the cost analysis, since the efficiency claim is central. A skim should take around 35-45 minutes. If the goal is to extract lessons for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, also inspect failure cases, especially whether the second pass truly corrects wrong first-pass answers or mostly reinforces the initial bias.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 引入多模态长视频理解的端到端训练，无需 CoT 数据即可实现 dynamic resolution/frame rate，对 VLM post-training 很有启发，值得关注其 RL setup 和 reward 设计。
recommendation.en: Introduces RL for end-to-end training in multimodal long-video understanding, achieving dynamic resolution/frame rate without CoT data. Highly inspiring for VLM post-training; the RL setup and reward design are worth checking.

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning Towards Broadly and Persistently Beneficial Models
paper.abstract: As AI systems are deployed across increasingly diverse and high-stakes settings, model alignment must generalize beyond the tasks and domains seen during training. This is especially important for reinforcement learning (RL), which can introduce unexpected misalignment through reward hacking, deception, or other unintended strategies. We study whether RL on beneficial behavior, instantiated in realistic domains, can produce broad and persistent alignment generalization beyond the training distri

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究一个 alignment generalization 问题：如果用 RL 训练模型表现出有益特质，例如诚实、公平、风险意识、可纠正性和元认知透明度，这些行为是否会迁移到训练分布之外，并且在有害 prompt steering 或后续有害微调下保持稳定。
summary.importance: 这不是预训练方法论文，但对 pretrain 与 posttrain 的接口有直接启发。它把 RL 信号从单任务正确性转向更高层的行为特质，并检验这些特质是否像近期 emergent misalignment 工作中的“有害 persona”一样跨领域泛化。对基座研究员有用的点在于：后训练奖励并不只是局部补丁，它可能选择出较稳定的模型行为模式；如果这种模式可以跨任务泛化，那么预训练阶段的数据、拒答边界、推理风格和自我表述方式都会影响后续 RL 的可塑性和风险。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造了一个多领域的 realistic conversation 数据集，用来训练和评测有益特质。领域覆盖健康、科学、教育、法律、商业等，奖励维度包括 truthfulness、fairness、risk awareness、corrigibility、metacognitive transparency 等。训练上使用 RL，并与 compute-matched baseline 对比。实验设计的关键不是单个 benchmark 提升，而是两个泛化控制：第一，只在 5% 训练计算中把标准 RL 数据替换为健康相关有益行为数据，其余 95% 相同，然后评估非健康领域；第二，在 5% 数据分配中排除健康和科学内容，再评估健康与心理健康任务。这两个设置试图排除“训练集和测试集主题重叠”这一解释。论文还测试 persistence：模型在有害提示诱导下是否更难被带偏，以及经过有害医疗回答微调后是否退化更少。
summary.experiments: 主实验使用超过 50 个训练分布外的 alignment、safety 和 benefits 评测。多领域 beneficial trait RL 模型相对 compute-matched baseline，在超过 80% 的评测上提升，平均提升超过 9 个百分点。健康-only 的 5% 数据替换实验中，模型在 17 个非健康评测上提升，覆盖代码 reward hacking、chain-of-thought deception、alignment questions 和 general misalignment。反向控制中，去掉健康和科学对话的模型仍在 10 个健康和心理健康评测上提升，其中包括由医生专家 rubric 评分的评测。persistence 实验显示，多领域有益特质 RL 模型对有害 prompt steering 更稳，同时仍能被引导到有益行为；在被微调去生成不准确或不安全医疗回答后，它的 alignment 评测保持得更好，退化幅度小于基线。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精读，预计 40 到 50 分钟。重点看 Section 2 的数据集和 reward rubric 设计，因为这决定了所谓 beneficial traits 是否只是表面风格；看 Section 3.1 的 50+ OOD 评测汇总，但不要只看平均值，要看哪些类别没有提升；看 Section 3.2 和 3.3 的健康领域控制实验，这是判断泛化是否可信的关键；看 Section 4 的 prompt steering 和 harmful finetuning，因为这部分更接近真实后训练风险。预训练研究者可以重点思考 reward 数据的 trait 结构是否能反哺 pretraining data mixture，例如在预训练或 mid-training 中提高能支持诚实校准、风险表达和可纠正性的语料比例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether reinforcement learning on beneficial behavioral traits can generalize beyond the training distribution and persist under adversarial pressure. The traits include honesty, fairness, risk awareness, corrigibility, and metacognitive transparency. The central question is whether RL can select for broadly beneficial model behavior, analogous to how recent work has shown narrow misalignment training can induce broader harmful behavior.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily a post-training and alignment paper, but it has a meaningful interface with pretraining research. It treats reward signals as selectors of relatively stable behavioral patterns rather than narrow task-level corrections. If such patterns generalize, then pretraining data composition, model calibration, refusal behavior, and self-representation may affect how easily RL can shape aligned or misaligned behavior. The paper is also useful because it evaluates persistence, not only immediate benchmark gains.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors build a multi-domain dataset of realistic conversations for both training and evaluation of beneficial traits. The domains include health, science, education, law, and business, and the reward criteria cover truthfulness, fairness, risk awareness, corrigibility, and metacognitive transparency. Models are trained with RL and compared against compute-matched baselines. The strongest design choice is the use of domain-control experiments. In one setting, only 5% of training compute is changed: standard RL data is replaced with health-related beneficial behavior data, while the other 95% remains identical; the model is then evaluated on non-health alignment tasks. In the complementary setting, health and science conversations are excluded from the 5% allocation, and the model is evaluated on health and mental-health tasks. The paper also tests persistence under harmful prompt steering and harmful finetuning.
summary_en.experiments: The main evaluation suite contains more than 50 out-of-distribution alignment, safety, and benefits evaluations. The multi-domain beneficial-trait RL model improves on over 80% of these evaluations relative to a compute-matched baseline, with average gains above 9 percentage points. In the health-only 5% intervention, the model improves on 17 non-health evaluations, including reward hacking in code, chain-of-thought deception, alignment questions, and broader misalignment measures. In the complementary control, the model trained without health and science conversations in that 5% allocation still improves on 10 health and mental-health evaluations, including expert physician-rubric evaluations. Persistence tests show greater resistance to harmful prompt steering while retaining steerability toward beneficial behavior, and less regression after harmful medical finetuning.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with selective deep reading in about 40 to 50 minutes. Read the dataset and reward-rubric construction carefully, because the credibility of the results depends on whether the trait labels capture behavior rather than style. Then inspect the over-50-evaluation summary and, more importantly, the categories that do not improve. The health-only and no-health/no-science controls are the key evidence for generalization beyond topic overlap. The prompt-steering and harmful-finetuning sections are especially relevant for understanding whether RL-induced traits are stable enough to matter in later training stages.

recommendation.zh: 对齐泛化是pretrain-posttrain闭环的核心痛点，重点看其训练数据的特质标注框架和OOD评测集的选择逻辑。
recommendation.en: Alignment generalization is a core pain point in the pretrain-posttrain loop; focus on the trait annotation framework for training data and OOD benchmark selection logic.

paper.title: VisCritic: Visual State Comparison as Process Reward for GUI Agents
paper.abstract: GUI agents powered by vision-language models show strong potential for automating digital tasks, yet frequently fail in long-horizon scenarios due to the absence of step-level verification. Existing process reward models verify actions through textual reasoning alone, missing the visual nature of GUI state changes. We introduce VisCritic, a visual process reward framework that verifies agent actions by directly comparing pre-action and post-action screenshots in visual feature space. VisCritic e

summary.core_problem: 现有GUI智能体的过程奖励模型仅依赖文本推理，忽略GUI状态变化的视觉本质，导致长时序任务中步骤级验证失效。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出视觉过程奖励范式，为GUI智能体提供即插即用的步骤级验证模块，同时给出弱监督数据构造管线。
summary.technical_approach: 设计VisCritic框架，采用孪生视觉Transformer提取动作前后截图的变化感知特征，结合动作感知批评头联合评估动作成功率、任务进度与错误类型，无需额外人工标注即可从已有轨迹构造弱监督训练数据。
summary.experiments: 在5个GUI智能体基准上进行离线分析与集成实验，验证其作为即插即用增强模块对多种智能体的通用性，未披露具体模型参数量与训练数据规模。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing process reward models for GUI agents rely solely on textual reasoning and ignore the visual nature of GUI state changes, causing step-level verification failures in long-horizon tasks.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation introducing a visual process reward paradigm with a plug-and-play step verifier and a weakly supervised data construction pipeline for GUI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: VisCritic uses a Siamese vision transformer to extract change-aware representations from pre/post-action screenshots, paired with an action-aware critic head that jointly evaluates action success, task progress, and error type; critic training data is built from existing trajectories without extra human labels.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated as a plug-and-play enhancement across five GUI agent benchmarks with offline analyses; no specific model sizes or training data scales disclosed.

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent的视觉奖励建模属于垂直Agent方法创新，对预训练研究员仅作弱信号参考，看摘要和实验结论即可。
recommendation.en: Visual reward modeling for GUI agents is a vertical agent innovation; only weak signal for pretraining researchers, read abstract and results only.

paper.title: An Introduction to Causal Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Causal inference provides a set of principles and tools that allow one to combine data and knowledge about an environment to reason with questions of counterfactual nature, i.e., what would have happened had reality been different, even when no data of this unrealized reality is currently available. Reinforcement learning provides methods to learn a policy that optimizes a specific measure (e.g., reward, regret) when the agent is deployed in an environment and pursues an exploratory, trial-and-e

summary.core_problem: 介绍因果推断与强化学习如何在反事实关系这一共同基础上结合。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是教程式综述。它对 LLM 预训练本身不直接相关，但对 RLHF、agent 环境建模、反事实评估、离线策略学习中的偏差控制有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文从因果推断处理反事实问题、强化学习通过试错优化策略这一差异出发，尝试把 RL 环境分解为可因果建模的组件，并讨论如何用因果结构补充纯交互数据，以支持迁移、干预推理和更稳健的策略学习。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示这是 introduction 性质的文章，未给出具体模型规模、训练数据或 benchmark 结果；重点应是概念框架和方法分类。
summary.authors_note: Elias Bareinboim 是因果推断领域知名研究者，代表性工作集中在因果层级、可识别性和因果 AI。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper introduces how causal inference and reinforcement learning can be connected through counterfactual relations.
summary_en.importance: This is a tutorial-style contribution. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant as background for RLHF, agent environment modeling, counterfactual evaluation, and bias control in offline policy learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper contrasts causal inference, which formalizes counterfactual reasoning, with reinforcement learning, which optimizes policies through interaction. It then frames RL environments as decomposable causal systems where structural knowledge can support transfer, intervention reasoning, and more robust policy learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract suggests an introductory article rather than an empirical paper. No model sizes, datasets, baselines, or benchmark improvements are reported.
summary_en.authors_note: Elias Bareinboim is a well-known researcher in causal inference, with influential work on causal hierarchies, identifiability, and causal AI.

recommendation.zh: 作为 RL/agent 因果背景备查即可；对 pretrain 没有直接动作项，别投入精读时间。
recommendation.en: Useful as causal-RL background for agent and RL work, but it gives no direct pretraining action item.

paper.title: CogniRoute: Learning to Route Social Evidence in Omni-Modal Models
paper.abstract: Omni-modal models can ingest video, audio, and text, but unified access to multiple modalities does not guarantee that a model uses the right evidence. This gap is especially pronounced in social video question answering, where the answer may hinge on a gesture, vocal tone, temporal cue, or mismatch between what is said and what is visually expressed. We introduce CogniRoute, a schema-guided Mixture-of-Experts framework for social omni reasoning. CogniRoute uses a training-only cognitive schema

summary.core_problem: 全模态（Omni-modal）模型在处理复杂的社交视频问答时，难以准确判断应该依赖哪种模态（视觉、听觉或其组合）以及关键线索在时间上的位置，现有的 MoE 路由机制缺乏针对这种多模态推理结构的显式监督。
summary.importance: 提出了一种针对全模态 MoE 模型的模式引导（schema-guided）训练框架和路由感知强化学习方法，为解决多模态模型中的“证据选择”和“时间定位”问题提供了有效的解决方案，并构建了专门的评测基准。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CogniRoute 框架。核心创新：1) 模式对齐预测路由（Schema-Aligned Predictive Routing）：在 SFT 阶段，利用仅在训练时可见的“认知模式”（包含模态关系、推理需求、时间范围）来指导 MoE 专家的路由选择；2) 路由感知 MoE 强化学习（Route-Aware MoE RL）：在 RL 阶段，结合答案正确性、模态一致性推理和认知时间定位的 rollout 级别奖励，联合优化 token 生成和专家分配。此外，构建了 OmniSocialBench 数据集提供结构化监督。
summary.experiments: 在 OmniSocialBench 上，CogniRoute 达到 59.38% 的平均准确率，大幅超越闭源（+15.33%）和开源（+26.77%）基线模型，尤其在需要协调音视频线索的社交推理任务上提升显著。在 8 个公共音视频基准上也取得了提升。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注“认知模式”的设计及其如何指导 MoE 路由（Method 部分），以及路由感知 RL 的奖励函数设计。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Omni-modal models struggle to determine which modality (visual, audio, or a combination) to rely on and where the key cues are located in time when processing complex social video QA. Existing MoE routing mechanisms lack explicit supervision for this multimodal reasoning structure.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a schema-guided training framework and route-aware reinforcement learning method for omni-modal MoE models, providing an effective solution to the 'evidence selection' and 'temporal grounding' problems in multimodal models, and constructs a dedicated benchmark.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the CogniRoute framework. Core innovations: 1) Schema-Aligned Predictive Routing: during SFT, uses a training-only 'Cognitive Schema' (containing modality relations, reasoning demands, and temporal scope) to guide MoE expert routing; 2) Route-Aware MoE RL: during RL, jointly optimizes token generation and expert allocation using rollout-level rewards that combine answer correctness, modality-consistent reasoning, and cognitive temporal grounding. Additionally, constructs the OmniSocialBench dataset to provide structured supervision.
summary_en.experiments: On OmniSocialBench, CogniRoute achieves 59.38% average accuracy, significantly outperforming proprietary (+15.33%) and open-source (+26.77%) baselines, especially on social reasoning tasks requiring audio-visual coordination. It also shows improvements on 8 public audio-visual benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the design of the 'Cognitive Schema' and how it guides MoE routing (Method section), as well as the reward function design in Route-Aware RL. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将MoE路由与多模态证据选择结合，并引入RL联合优化路由和生成，对多模态大模型的架构设计和后训练有一定启发，可扫读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Combines MoE routing with multimodal evidence selection and introduces RL to jointly optimize routing and generation. Offers some inspiration for multimodal LLM architecture and post-training. Skim the method section.

paper.title: Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching: Autonomous Trajectory Optimization via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Consistency distillation has significantly accelerated the inference of diffusion models. In this work, we reveal an intriguing asymmetry: while Logit-Normal sampling priors are highly efficacious for standard iterative generation, consistency distillation exhibits a distinctly different difficulty profile (e.g., U-shaped). We identify that the primary optimization bottlenecks reside at the boundary stages (initialization or final refinement) rather than the intermediate steps. To address the li

summary.core_problem: 解决 diffusion / flow matching 模型做 consistency distillation 时，采样时间步或轨迹课程难以手工设定的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把 diffusion distillation 的时间步选择从静态先验改成动态决策。它不是 LLM 预训练工作，但对研究 flow / diffusion 生成模型的训练信号分配有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching，将 distillation 过程建模为动态决策过程，用轻量级强化学习 agent 主动探索 Probability Flow ODE 轨迹，并自动构造偏向关键区域的训练 curriculum；同时引入 Flow Distribution Matching Distillation 来改进蒸馏目标。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集和数值结果。主要实验结论是：Logit-Normal sampling prior 在标准迭代生成中有效，但在 consistency distillation 中呈现不同难度分布；瓶颈更多出现在初始化或最终细化等边界阶段。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to choose sampling stages or trajectory curricula for consistency distillation in diffusion and flow-matching models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is to replace a static time-sampling prior with an adaptive decision process. It is not directly about LLM pretraining, but it is relevant to training-signal allocation in flow or diffusion generative models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed Curvature-Adaptive Consistency Flow Matching formulates distillation as a dynamic decision process. A lightweight reinforcement-learning agent probes Probability Flow ODE trajectories and builds an efficiency-oriented curriculum that emphasizes critical regions; the method also introduces Flow Distribution Matching Distillation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, or exact numbers. The main reported finding is that Logit-Normal sampling works well for standard iterative generation but shows a different difficulty profile under consistency distillation, with bottlenecks concentrated near boundary stages such as initialization and final refinement.

recommendation.zh: 只看动机和难度曲线即可；RL 调度 ODE 轨迹有意思，但离语言建模还远，先当 diffusion distillation 的弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read only the motivation and difficulty profile; RL-based ODE scheduling is interesting, but it remains a weak signal for language-model pretraining.

paper.title: Curriculum Reinforcement Learning Can Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is widely viewed as a promising path toward continuously improving large language models. Recent works, however, suggest that mainstream RLVR often reallocates sampling probabilities among trajectories already present in the base model: it can improve sampling efficiency, reflected by higher pass@1 scores, but yields limited gains, and can even decrease pass@k scores when k is large, and therefore may fail to expand the base model's reasoning

summary.core_problem: 当前主流基于rollout的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）仅在基座模型已有的推理轨迹分布中重新分配采样概率，通常只提升pass@1，无法甚至会降低大k的pass@k，不能突破基座模型的推理能力边界；核心原因是边界外的难题在rollout时全部失败，形成零优势组，无法给策略更新提供有效梯度信号。
summary.importance: 这是RL后训练领域的重要范式推进，首次给出了明确突破基座推理边界的可操作路径，打通了RL与局部教师引导的课程化结合机制；对预训练-后训练闭环的启发是，后训练阶段可通过课程化RL引入基座预训练未覆盖的推理模式，不必完全依赖预训练注入所有能力，重新定义了RLVR的能力上限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出边界感知的课程RL框架，每轮迭代分三步：1）用大采样量的pass@k评估定位当前模型的推理能力边界，将样本划分为已解决、边界附近（少量采样可解）、完全未解决（大采样仍无解）三类；2）仅针对边界附近和之外的样本，引入小剂量教师结构化推理轨迹，将原本零优势的样本转化为具备正奖励信号的可训练样本；3）用GRPO等常规RL算法巩固新引入的推理模式，使其成为模型稳定行为。每轮迭代后重新定位新边界，逐步推进能力外扩。与现有方法的差异在于，不采用纯RL或全量蒸馏，仅在能力边界处做局部引导，既避免全量蒸馏的灾难性遗忘，又解决纯RL的零梯度盲点。
summary.experiments: 当前公开章节未包含完整实验与消融结果，引言部分明确了三类核心验证维度：pass@k全曲线变化（重点是大k区间）、边界外样本的解决率、与纯RL基线和全量蒸馏基线的对比；核心观测指标为固定大采样预算下的新增可解问题数量。
summary.reading_guide: 精读第1节关于推理能力边界的定义与pass@k曲线的解读逻辑（核心评估标准）、方法章节的三步课程RL算法细节、实验章节的消融实验（重点关注教师引导的剂量阈值、边界划分的pass@k参数选择）、附录中的课程调度策略；值得深挖的方向包括：将范式迁移到无可验证奖励的开放域任务、边界定位的采样效率优化、是否可反向指导预训练阶段的数据课程设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Mainstream rollout-based Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) only reallocates sampling probabilities among reasoning trajectories already supported by the base model distribution. It typically improves pass@1 but fails to expand, and sometimes reduces, large-k pass@k, leaving the base model's reasoning capacity boundary untouched. The root cause is that out-of-bound hard samples produce all-failed rollouts, forming zero-advantage groups that deliver no valid gradient signal for policy updates.
summary_en.importance: This work represents a key paradigm advance in RL post-training. It provides the first actionable pipeline to explicitly expand the base model's reasoning capacity boundary, and establishes a structured integration path between RL and localized teacher guidance. For the pretrain-posttrain closed loop, it demonstrates that RL post-training can introduce reasoning patterns not covered in base pretraining, reducing the requirement to inject all capabilities during pretraining and redefining the upper bound of RLVR.
summary_en.technical_approach: A boundary-aware Curriculum RL framework is proposed, with three steps per curriculum round: (1) Large-sample pass@k evaluation locates the current reasoning capacity boundary, partitioning samples into three tiers: already solved, near-boundary (solvable with few samples), and fully unsolved (unsolvable even with large sample budget); (2) Targeted teacher guidance injects a small volume of structured reasoning traces only for near-boundary and out-of-bound samples, converting originally zero-advantage samples into trainable samples with positive reward signal; (3) Standard RL algorithms such as GRPO consolidate the newly introduced reasoning patterns into stable model behavior. The boundary is re-estimated after each round to progressively target harder samples. Unlike pure RL or full-scale distillation, the design limits teacher guidance to the capacity boundary only, avoiding catastrophic forgetting from full distillation while fixing the zero-gradient blind spot of pure RL.
summary_en.experiments: The publicly available sections do not include complete empirical or ablation results. The introduction specifies three core validation dimensions: full pass@k curve changes (especially the large-k regime), solve rate for out-of-bound samples, and comparison against pure RL and full distillation baselines. The core metric of interest is the count of newly solvable problems under fixed large sampling budgets.
summary_en.reading_guide: Prioritize Section 1 for the definition of reasoning capacity boundary and the interpretation logic of pass@k curves (the core evaluation criterion), method sections for the detailed three-step algorithm pipeline, experiment sections for ablation studies (focus on teacher guidance dose threshold and pass@k parameter selection for boundary partitioning), and appendix sections for curriculum scheduling details. Worth digging into: migration of the paradigm to open-domain tasks without verifiable rewards, sampling efficiency optimization for boundary localization, and whether the framework can inversely guide data curriculum design during pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 修正了“RLVR仅能优化采样效率”的共识，边界定位+教师引导的组合值得立刻在内部RL后训练ablation中复现。
recommendation.en: Revises the consensus that RLVR only optimizes sampling efficiency; the combination of boundary localization and teacher guidance is worth immediate reproduction in internal RL post-training ablations.

paper.title: SPIRAL: Learning to Search and Aggregate
paper.abstract: Language model reasoning can be substantially improved at test time via scaffolds that scale inference compute across different primitives -- sequential reasoning within a trace, independently sampled parallel traces, and aggregation of multiple reasoning traces into a final response. During post-training, however, language models are optimized only for sequential reasoning within a single trace. We introduce Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning (SPIRAL), a framework in which a

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是推理模型训练和测试时 compute 使用方式不一致的问题。现有 RL 主要训练模型生成一条高质量 reasoning trace，但实际部署时常用并行采样、多候选搜索、候选聚合、验证和修订。模型在训练中没有见过这些 compute primitive，因此不会主动分配顺序计算、并行探索和聚合计算。
summary.importance: 这篇论文和预训练的关系不在数据或模型结构，而在 pretrain-posttrain 接口。它把 test-time scaling 中常见的并行采样和聚合纳入 RL 训练目标，试图让模型学会使用推理预算，而不是靠外部 scaffold 手写调度。对基座研究的启发在于：模型能力不只由单条轨迹的 token-level reasoning 决定，还受训练时暴露的 compute topology 影响。若结果成立，后续 reasoning pretrain、RL pretrain 或长思维训练需要考虑把多样化搜索、候选互补性和聚合能力作为训练对象，而不是只奖励单个 final answer。
summary.technical_approach: SPIRAL 即 Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning。它同时训练三类推理计算：单条 trace 内的顺序计算，例如 reasoning tokens 和工具调用；同一 prompt 下多条独立 trace 的并行计算；以及把多条候选 trace 合成为最终答案的聚合计算。聚合 trace 可用标准 RL 算法训练，例如 GRPO，因为它仍然是生成一个最终输出并接受 reward。并行 trace 的训练更难，因为单条 trace 可能本身不正确，却包含对聚合有用的局部思路。论文用 set reinforcement learning 处理这种 credit assignment：把同一 prompt 下采样得到的一组 generations 当成集合，用集合级 reward 对它们联合赋分，并通过低方差 marginal advantage 给每条 trace 分配学习信号。这个设计区别于常规 GRPO：GRPO 优化单条响应的相对优势，SPIRAL 优化一组候选和一个聚合器共同产生最终正确答案的能力。
summary.experiments: 论文在数学推理上微调 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507，并与标准 GRPO 在相同训练 compute 预算下比较。测试时扩展不同维度的 inference compute。给出的结果包括：在 parallel compute scaling 下，pass@k 的 scaling efficiency 最高提升到 11 倍；在同时扩展 parallel 和 aggregative compute 时，测试集性能最高高出 15%。这些数字说明改进主要来自更有效地使用多样本和聚合，而不只是单条 chain-of-thought 变强。实验最需要关注的是等训练预算是否严格、parallel sample 数和 aggregator 调用数如何计费、以及提升是否集中在需要搜索的题目而非普通算术题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 30 到 45 分钟。先看 introduction 中对 sequential、parallel、aggregative compute 三类瓶颈的定义。然后看 set RL preliminaries 和 SPIRAL objective，重点理解集合级 reward 为什么不能退化成单样本 reward，以及 marginal advantage 如何给并行 trace 做 credit assignment。实验部分优先看训练 compute 对齐、test-time compute scaling 曲线、pass@k scaling efficiency 的定义，以及 GRPO 对照。若时间有限，可以跳过一般 RL 背景，集中读算法目标和 ablation。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a mismatch between how reasoning models are trained and how they are used at inference time. Standard RL trains a model to produce one strong reasoning trace. In deployment, however, practitioners often use parallel sampling, search over multiple candidates, aggregation, verification, and revision. The model is not trained to coordinate these compute primitives, so additional inference compute is often wasted on redundant traces or weak aggregation.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the pretrain-posttrain interface rather than to tokenizer, data mixture, or architecture. It treats test-time scaling behavior as a trainable object. The key implication is that reasoning ability depends not only on the quality of a single chain of thought, but also on whether the model has learned the topology of inference compute: sequential thinking, parallel exploration, and cross-trace aggregation. This is a useful direction for RL pretraining and reasoning-oriented mid-training, especially if future training recipes aim to optimize models for the way they will actually be served.
summary_en.technical_approach: SPIRAL stands for Sequential-Parallel-Aggregative Reinforcement Learning. It exposes the model to three forms of inference compute during training: sequential compute inside one trace, parallel compute across independently sampled traces, and aggregative compute that synthesizes a set of traces into a final output. Aggregation traces can be optimized with standard RL algorithms such as GRPO because they generate a final answer that receives a reward. Parallel traces require a different credit assignment scheme: an individual trace may be wrong, but still contain an idea that helps the aggregator solve the problem. SPIRAL uses set reinforcement learning, where a set of generations from the same prompt receives a joint learning signal. A low-variance marginal advantage is then used to assign credit to individual traces under the set-level objective. This differs from standard GRPO, which optimizes the relative advantage of individual responses rather than the utility of a candidate set plus an aggregator.
summary_en.experiments: The paper fine-tunes Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 on mathematical reasoning and compares SPIRAL against GRPO under an equal training compute budget. At test time, it scales different axes of inference compute. The reported results include up to 11x higher scaling efficiency for pass@k under parallel compute scaling, and up to 15% higher performance when both parallel and aggregative compute are scaled. The main empirical claim is that SPIRAL improves the model’s ability to use multiple samples and aggregation, rather than only improving single-trace reasoning. The most important details to inspect are the compute accounting, the number of sampled traces, the aggregation budget, and whether gains are concentrated on problems that genuinely require search.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30 to 45 minute skim is appropriate. Start with the definitions of sequential, parallel, and aggregative compute in the introduction. Then read the set RL preliminaries and the SPIRAL objective carefully, especially why the set-level reward cannot be reduced to a single-sample reward and how marginal advantage handles credit assignment. In the experiments, focus on the test-time compute scaling curves, the definition of pass@k scaling efficiency, compute-matched GRPO comparisons, and ablations over aggregation and parallel sampling.

recommendation.zh: 训练-测试推理范式对齐的新思路，集合RL的目标设计值得在内部后训练ablation中参考，重点看§3的损失定义。
recommendation.en: Novel alignment between training and test-time reasoning paradigms; the set RL objective design in §3 is worth referencing in internal post-training ablations.

paper.title: The Two-Hump Problem: Bridging the Difficulty Gap in Mathematical Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Mathematical search problems present a unique challenge for Reinforcement Learning (RL) due to vast search spaces and sparse rewards. In previous works, the Andrews-Curtis (AC) conjecture was established as an illustrative example of such problems. In this work, we identify a critical structural barrier in the AC landscape: a "Two-Hump" distribution, where problem instances are either trivially solvable or effectively impossible, with a scarcity of intermediate "hard-but-solvable" instances requ

summary.core_problem: 在数学推理（如 Andrews-Curtis 猜想）等具有庞大搜索空间和极度稀疏奖励的强化学习（RL）环境中，模型难以获得有效的学习信号，导致探索失败。
summary.importance: 揭示了数学 RL 任务中普遍存在的“双峰”（Two-Hump）难度分布问题，并提供了一套结合领域知识、架构改进和数据生成的解决方案，为解决稀疏奖励下的硬探索问题提供了启发。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 识别出问题难度的“双峰”分布：大量简单样本和大量极难样本，缺乏中间难度的“垫脚石”。2. 引入替换超步（Substitution supermoves）：将多个基础动作组合成一个宏动作，大幅缩短求解路径，但扩大了动作空间。3. 设计 Dual-Ring Transformer：针对群表示的循环对称性设计的特殊架构，用于处理扩大的动作空间。4. 目标数据生成：通过穷举和自同构生成中间难度的训练数据（AC-19 和 AC-1M 数据集），填补难度鸿沟。
summary.experiments: 在 Miller-Schupp 家族的基准测试中，成功解决了 100 多个以前未解决的表示。PPO 智能体在寻找更短求解路径方面持续优于经典搜索方法，特别是在较难的表示上。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读关于“双峰”分布的分析（Figure 1）以及 Dual-Ring Transformer 的架构设计，这部分对于理解如何将数学结构先验注入模型架构很有价值。预计阅读时间 15 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Reinforcement Learning (RL) agents struggle in mathematical reasoning environments (like the Andrews-Curtis conjecture) due to vast search spaces and extremely sparse rewards, lacking effective learning signals.
summary_en.importance: Identifies the 'Two-Hump' difficulty distribution common in mathematical RL tasks and provides a comprehensive solution combining domain knowledge, architectural improvements, and data generation, offering insights for hard exploration with sparse rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. Identified a 'Two-Hump' difficulty distribution: a mass of easy instances and a mass of extremely hard instances, lacking intermediate 'stepping stones'. 2. Introduced substitution supermoves: combining multiple primitive moves into a macro-move, shortening solution paths but expanding the action space. 3. Designed Dual-Ring Transformer: a specialized architecture exploiting the cyclic symmetry of group presentations to handle the expanded action space. 4. Targeted data generation: created intermediate-difficulty training data (AC-19 and AC-1M datasets) via exhaustive enumeration and automorphisms to bridge the difficulty gap.
summary_en.experiments: Successfully trivialized over 100 previously unsolved presentations from the Miller-Schupp benchmark. The PPO agent consistently found shorter solution paths than classical search methods, especially on harder presentations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the analysis of the 'Two-Hump' distribution (Figure 1) and the design of the Dual-Ring Transformer. This is valuable for understanding how to inject mathematical structural priors into model architectures. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 揭示了数学 RL 任务中缺乏'中等难度'数据的结构性问题，对当前用 RL 训练 LLM 推理能力（如 R1 范式）中的数据课程设计有直接启发。
recommendation.en: Reveals the structural issue of lacking 'medium-difficulty' data in math RL tasks, directly inspiring data curriculum design in current RL-based LLM reasoning training (e.g., R1 paradigm).

paper.title: Inverting the Bellman Equation: From $Q$-Values to World Models
paper.abstract: Model-based and model-free reinforcement learning are traditionally viewed as separate paradigms: instead of learning a model of the transition kernel $P$, model-free agents typically estimate value functions tied to a specific policy and reward. In this paper, we challenge this dichotomy by proving that value-based agents trained on a sufficiently rich set of reward functions, e.g. using goal-conditioned RL, implicitly encode a unique and accurate world model. To extract this model in practice,

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是一个很基础、也很少被讲透的问题：一个看起来“纯 model-free”的 value-based agent，到底有没有在内部学到环境动力学，也就是 world model。传统看法把 model-free 和 model-based 分成两条路，原因在于 value equivalence：不同的转移核可能导出相同的 value function 和最优策略，所以仅凭单一任务上的 Q 值，通常无法唯一恢复环境。作者要解决的核心问题是：如果 agent 不是只为一个 reward 训练，而是在足够丰富的一组 goals 或 reward functions 上训练，那么这些 Q-values 是否已经隐式编码了唯一且准确的转移模型 P；如果是，怎样把它从 Q 中反推出去。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不属于 LLM 预训练主线，但在“从训练信号中恢复隐式世界知识”这个层面有方法论意义。它把 model-free / model-based 的边界重新画了一遍：当训练覆盖足够丰富的目标时，goal-conditioned RL 可能已经是隐式混合范式，而不是纯 model-free。这个结论对做 foundation model 的人有间接启发，尤其是那些关心 latent world model、implicit planning、reward-conditioned pretraining、以及“模型内部到底学到了什么结构”的研究者。贡献量级主要在理论与概念统一：一方面给出可识别性条件，说明什么时候 Q 足以确定 P；另一方面给出一个实际可运行的反演算法 P-learning，把 Bellman 方程从“已知 P 求 Q”改成“已知 Q 反求 P”。
summary.technical_approach:
技术主线有两条：一个算法，一个可识别性理论。

算法部分提出 P-learning，可以看成 Q-learning 的逆问题。普通 Q-learning 在固定环境转移核 P 下，通过 Bellman 更新逼近 Q；P-learning 则把一组固定的 (Q^g, π^g, r^g) 当作观测，迭代更新候选 world model，使它与这些 value functions 的 Bellman 关系越来越一致。作者在 tabular 情形下把这个过程写成线性方程组，并证明收敛到一个由 Moore–Penrose 伪逆给出的解。直观上，Q、policy 和 reward 提供了关于“从状态动作对出发，后继状态分布必须满足什么约束”的大量线性条件；当这些条件足够丰富时，P 就能被唯一识别。文中也说明在很多实际设置里，π 往往由 Q 通过 argmax 或 softmax 导出，因此输入可以近似理解为一组 goal-conditioned Q 和 reward。

理论部分是全文更核心的内容。作者系统分析了在不同 MDP 类型下，什么样的 goal set 能打破 value equivalence。结论分四类。第一，有限状态、确定性 MDP 中，一个“generic” goal 就可能足够识别真实 P。这里 generic 的意思不是任意 goal，而是能让不同后继状态在回报结构上被区分开。第二，有限状态、随机 MDP 中，goals 需要张成状态空间；换句话说，reward family 必须足够丰富，才能把随机转移分布的自由度约束住。第三，确定性连续状态情形里，有限个 goals 有时也足够，这一点有些反直觉，因为连续空间通常让人预期需要无限监督。第四，随机连续 MDP 中，关键不再是 goal 的个数，而是 coverage：对 Gaussian rewards，需要 goal set 有非空内点；对 indicator rewards，需要覆盖状态空间。作者还给出当 Q 只有 ε 近似精度时，恢复出的 P 的误差界，说明 world model 的准确性会随 value 误差平滑退化，而不是脆弱崩掉。

这套方法与传统 world model learning 的区别在于，它不直接拟合转移样本，而是从 agent 已经学到的价值结构中反演环境。与 successor features、forward-backward learning、一般 goal-conditioned RL 的关系则是：这些方法原本被视为多目标 value learning，这篇论文说明在目标集足够丰富时，它们携带的信息量其实接近显式动力学模型。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕两个问题展开：P-learning 能不能真的恢复 world model；恢复出的模型是否对训练目标之外的规划有用。

在有限 MDP 上，作者用 FourRooms 的三个版本验证理论：确定性、windy 和 teleporting。随着环境随机性增加，所需 goals 数量也增加，文中给出的代表数字是 |G|=1、|G|=4、|G|=20 分别足以实现接近完美的恢复。这和理论判断一致：确定性环境中少量目标即可打破歧义，随机环境则需要更丰富的 reward basis。

在连续控制上，作者考察 Reacher。一个很有意思的结果是，只用 |G|=4 个 goals，就能恢复出相当准确的隐式 world model，而且这种准确性不仅体现在 reward 直接依赖的变量上，还扩展到 reward 从未直接约束的变量。更进一步，基于恢复出的 world model 做规划，可以在一批 out-of-distribution goals 上接近最优，包括训练时只用 position-based goals、测试时却要求到达特定 angular velocity 的设定。这说明 agent 学到的不是狭义的 reward-specific shortcut，而是更完整的动力学结构。

作者还在 MountainCar 上研究这种“隐式泛化能力”。一个关键观察是，如果把训练目标反过来，只用 velocity-based goals 训练，恢复出的 world model 与 position-goal 训练得到的模型几乎相同。这说明不同目标族训练出的 agent，内部可能收敛到相近的环境模型，只是外层 policy/value 读出不同。最后，文中报告 agent 性能与恢复 world model 准确性之间有很强相关性，Spearman ρ=0.98。这个结果不能证明因果，但至少说明在这些设置里，学得更好的 goal-conditioned value function，通常也意味着更准确的隐式环境建模。
summary.reading_guide: 如果时间有限，先读 Introduction，把问题设定和四类理论结论的地图建立起来。然后直接看 Section 3 的 P-learning，重点理解“逆 Bellman”到底在解什么方程、为什么需要 (Q, π, r) 而不是只靠 Q。接着看 Section 4 的 identifiability theorems，不必一开始就抠完所有证明，先抓住 deterministic/stochastic、finite/continuous 四种情形下 goal richness 的差异：有限随机情形讲 span，连续随机情形讲 coverage。实验部分优先看 FourRooms、Reacher、MountainCar 三组结果，它们分别对应理论验证、连续空间恢复、以及 OOD 规划与隐式泛化。若要深挖，值得细看误差界和伪逆解的推导，因为这里决定了方法对近似 Q 的稳健性。作为 skim 级阅读，30–45 分钟可以把主要思想和结论读明白；若想真正吃透理论，需要更长时间跟证明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a precise version of a long-standing question in reinforcement learning: when does a seemingly model-free, value-based agent actually encode a world model of the environment? The usual separation between model-free and model-based RL is justified by value equivalence: different transition kernels can induce the same value functions and optimal policies, so a single-task Q-function generally does not identify the true dynamics. The paper asks whether this changes once the agent is trained over a sufficiently rich family of goals or reward functions, and if so, how to recover the latent transition kernel from the learned values.
summary_en.importance: This is not directly a foundation-model pretraining paper, but it matters conceptually for anyone interested in implicit world models, latent planning, or what training signals force a model to internalize environment structure rather than just task-specific behavior. The main contribution is to weaken the standard model-free/model-based dichotomy. Under rich enough goal-conditioned training, the collection of Q-functions can become informationally equivalent to the transition kernel. That is a meaningful theoretical result, and the paper backs it with a practical recovery algorithm. The contribution is strongest as a theory-and-methods bridge rather than as a new high-performance RL recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper has two technical pillars: P-learning as an inversion algorithm, and identifiability results that characterize when inversion is possible.

P-learning is introduced as an inverse analogue of Q-learning. In standard Q-learning, the transition kernel is fixed and Bellman updates are used to estimate values. Here the values, policies, and rewards are treated as given, and the transition model is updated so that the Bellman equations become increasingly consistent with those fixed quantities. In the tabular setting, this becomes a structured linear inverse problem, and the paper proves convergence to a solution expressed through the Moore–Penrose pseudoinverse. Intuitively, each tuple (Q^g, pi^g, r^g) imposes constraints on what the next-state distribution must be for every state-action pair. If the goal family is rich enough, those constraints pin down the true kernel.

The more fundamental part is the identifiability theory. The paper characterizes when value equivalence can be broken in four regimes. In deterministic finite MDPs, a single generic goal can be sufficient to identify the true dynamics. In stochastic finite MDPs, the reward family must span the state space; otherwise the stochastic degrees of freedom remain hidden behind equivalent values. In deterministic continuous MDPs, somewhat surprisingly, a finite number of goals can still suffice in some cases. In stochastic continuous MDPs, the key notion is coverage rather than cardinality: for Gaussian rewards, the goal set needs non-empty interior; for indicator rewards, it must cover the state space. The paper also provides error bounds showing that if the Q-functions are only epsilon-accurate, the recovered model degrades gracefully rather than catastrophically.

This differs from standard world-model learning because the method does not fit transitions directly from rollouts. Instead, it extracts dynamics from the value structure already learned by the agent. It also reframes goal-conditioned RL, successor-feature style methods, and related approaches as potentially implicit model-learning procedures when the goal family is sufficiently expressive.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments ask two main questions: can P-learning recover accurate world models in practice, and are the recovered models useful beyond the training goals?

For finite MDPs, the paper validates the theory on three FourRooms variants: deterministic, windy, and teleporting. As stochasticity increases, the number of goals needed for near-perfect recovery also increases. The headline numbers are that |G| = 1, 4, and 20 goals are sufficient, respectively, for quasi-perfect recovery in those three settings. This aligns well with the theory: deterministic environments need much less reward diversity than stochastic ones.

In continuous control, the paper studies Reacher and finds that only |G| = 4 goals are enough to recover an accurate implicit world model. A notable result is that the recovered model is accurate even on variables that the reward never directly depends on. Planning inside the recovered model then transfers to out-of-distribution goals, including angular-velocity targets despite training only on position-based goals. That is a strong sign that the agent has internalized more than a narrow reward-specific shortcut.

The MountainCar experiments probe this implicit generalization further. Training on velocity-based goals instead of position-based goals yields an almost identical recovered world model, suggesting that agents optimized for very different objectives may still internalize similar dynamics. Finally, the paper reports a very strong correlation between agent performance and recovered world-model accuracy, with Spearman rho = 0.98. This does not establish causality, but it supports the view that successful goal-conditioned value learning is often accompanied by accurate implicit dynamics learning.
summary_en.reading_guide: If reading selectively, start with the introduction to get the problem framing and the four-regime map of the theory. Then read the P-learning section carefully enough to understand what is being inverted in the Bellman equation and why the method uses (Q, pi, r) rather than Q alone. After that, go to the identifiability section and focus on the distinctions between deterministic vs. stochastic and finite vs. continuous settings. The main conceptual split is that finite stochastic settings are about spanning the state space, while continuous stochastic settings are about coverage.
