The method is shown to maintain diversity without sacrificing expected reward. Specific numerical results are not fully detailed in the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: Focus on Chapter 1 (motivation and conceptual framework - this is where the core insight lives), Chapter 3 (ROSA core method), and Chapter 4 (theoretical analysis, especially hyperparameter guidance). Chapter 5 experiments can be browsed quickly. Estimated reading time: 15-25 minutes. For LLM post-training researchers, the key takeaway is the theoretical framework connecting reward uncertainty to diverse behavior, which informs thinking about reward hacking in RLHF.
summary_en.authors_note: Author and institution information not available in the provided excerpt.

recommendation.en: Novel approach for diversity optimization in RLHF; alignment and post-training researchers should focus on the objective reformulation in §3

paper.title: On Effectiveness and Efficiency of Agentic Tool-calling and RL Training
paper.abstract: Tool-calling is a central component of modern large language model (LLM) agents, equipping them with skills beyond their parametric knowledge. This paper studies tool-calling along two complementary axes: effectiveness, i.e., how this capability is measured, and efficiency, i.e., how it is learned. On effectiveness, we systematically analyze tool-calling evaluation pipelines and show that results can be highly sensitive to seemingly minor, often undocumented implementation choices including the

summary.core_problem: 两个核心问题：一是Agent工具调用的评测结果高度依赖未标准化的实现细节，导致结果不可复现、排名不可靠；二是基于RL的工具调用训练存在严重的计算效率瓶颈，包括大量零方差prompt产生无效梯度、策略更新阶段耗时远高于轨迹生成阶段。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练闭环研究有两方面具体影响：第一，指出了当前工具调用能力评测的系统性漏洞，为基座工具调用能力的标准化评估提供了校验基准；第二，提出的两个RL训练加速方法可直接推广到通用RLHF/GRPO训练流程，评测部分修正了领域普遍存在的评估偏差，效率部分可带来3-5倍的端到端训练墙钟时间加速，且不损失最终性能，属于RL后训练范式的实用级效率优化。
summary.technical_approach: 研究分为两部分：第一是评测有效性分析，以BFCL基准为案例，控制变量分析随机种子、系统提示词、多轮模板构造、交互历史处理方式等变量对最终性能的影响；第二是训练效率优化，提出两个互补的加速方法：1）在线预轨迹过滤，跳过前k个epoch中轨迹全部正确的prompt，避免冗余采样；2）方差感知的轨迹下采样，仅选择奖励方差最大的子集轨迹用于策略更新，在保留梯度信息量的前提下减少更新阶段的计算量。与现有方法的区别：预过滤方法之前仅在数学推理RL训练中尝试，在工具调用场景下仅需跳过1-2个epoch的正确prompt即可生效；方差感知下采样的现有研究没有专门针对工具调用RL中更新阶段占比极高的特性做适配。
summary.experiments: 评测部分测试了Qwen3-4B、Qwen3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama3.1-8B-Instruct、Llama3.2-3B-Instruct共5个主流模型，发现不同实现细节下的性能波动最高可达20%以上，多轮场景下波动幅度远高于单轮，甚至会导致模型排名反转。训练效率部分训练了Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct（单轮）和Qwen3-4B（多轮）两个模型，发现RL训练中最高80%的prompt属于零方差prompt，即所有轨迹奖励相同、无梯度贡献，策略更新阶段的计算成本是轨迹生成阶段的3-5倍；两个加速方法结合可带来3-5倍的端到端墙钟时间加速，最终工具调用性能与全量训练无统计差异，消融实验显示仅预过滤即可带来约2倍加速，仅方差感知下采样即可带来约1.5-2倍加速。
summary.reading_guide: 精读重点关注第3节的评测变量控制实验，特别是图2-4的性能波动和排名反转结果、第4节的RL训练效率瓶颈分析，即图5-6的零方差比例和时间占比统计、第5节的两个加速方法的消融实验；核心创新点一是对工具调用评测脆弱性的系统性量化，二是针对RL训练中零梯度和更新高成本问题的极简有效优化；值得深挖的点包括：评测脆弱性的结论是否可以推广到其他Agent能力评测、零方差prompt的分布特性是否可以用于训练数据的预处理、方差感知下采样的最优比例是否和任务类型相关。
summary.authors_note: Amazon，作者为Amazon Nova团队研究人员，该团队开发了Nova-1模型，是本次评估的模型之一。

summary_en.core_problem: Two core problems are addressed: first, agent tool-calling evaluation results are highly sensitive to unstandardized implementation details, leading to non-reproducible results and unreliable leaderboard rankings; second, RL-based tool-calling training suffers from severe computational efficiency bottlenecks, including a large share of zero-variance prompts that produce no valid gradients, and policy update stages that take far more time than rollout generation.
summary_en.importance: It delivers two concrete impacts on pretrain-posttrain closed-loop research: first, it identifies systematic flaws in current tool-calling capability evaluation, providing a validation baseline for standardized assessment of foundation model tool-calling capabilities; second, the two proposed RL training acceleration methods can be directly generalized to general RLHF/GRPO training pipelines. The evaluation analysis corrects widespread assessment biases in the field, and the efficiency optimizations deliver 3-5x end-to-end wall-clock speedup without sacrificing final performance, representing a practical efficiency improvement for RL post-training paradigms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Research is split into two parts. For evaluation effectiveness, controlled variable analysis is conducted on the BFCL benchmark to measure the impact of random seeds, system prompts, multi-turn template construction, and interaction history handling on final performance. For training efficiency, two complementary acceleration methods are proposed: 1) Online pre-rollout filtering, which skips prompts whose rollouts were all correct in the previous k epochs to avoid redundant sampling; 2) Variance-aware rollout down-sampling, which selects only the subset of rollouts with the highest reward variance for policy update, reducing update-stage computation while retaining gradient information. Differences from prior work: Pre-filtering was previously only tested on math reasoning RL training. For tool-calling scenarios, skipping correct prompts for just 1-2 epochs is sufficient to deliver gains. Variance-aware down-sampling was not previously adapted to the unique characteristic of tool-calling RL where the update stage dominates wall-clock time.
summary_en.experiments: For evaluation analysis, 5 mainstream models are tested: Qwen3-4B, Qwen3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, Llama3.1-8B-Instruct, and Llama3.2-3B-Instruct. Performance fluctuations can exceed 20% across different implementation choices, with far larger fluctuations in multi-turn settings than single-turn, even leading to reversed model rankings. For training efficiency, two models are trained: Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct for single-turn tool-calling and Qwen3-4B for multi-turn tool-calling. Up to 80% of prompts in RL training are zero-variance prompts with identical rewards across all rollouts and no gradient contribution, and the policy update stage costs 3-5x more computation than rollout generation. The combination of the two acceleration methods delivers 3-5x end-to-end wall-clock speedup with no statistically significant difference in final tool-calling performance compared to full training. Ablation studies show pre-filtering alone delivers ~2x speedup, and variance-aware down-sampling alone delivers ~1.5-2x speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for controlled evaluation variable experiments, especially Figures 2-4 for performance fluctuation and ranking reversal, Section 4 for RL training efficiency bottleneck analysis, specifically Figures 5-6 for zero-variance share and time breakdown, and Section 5 for ablation studies of the two acceleration methods. Core innovations include the systematic quantification of tool-calling evaluation fragility, and simple, effective optimizations for zero-gradient and high update cost issues in RL training. Worth further exploration: whether evaluation fragility findings generalize to other agent capability evaluations, distribution characteristics of zero-variance prompts for training data preprocessing, and whether optimal down-sampling ratio correlates with task type.
summary_en.authors_note: Amazon, authors are researchers from the Amazon Nova team, which developed Nova-1, one of the evaluated models.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接改你做 tool-use/RL 的实验习惯：先别信 leaderboard，先复查 prompt、history carry-over 和无效 rollout 比例；至少把评测协议和 token waste 统计补上。
recommendation.en: This should change how you run tool-use/RL experiments: trust no leaderboard before auditing prompt templates, history carry-over, and wasted-rollout ratios; at minimum, add protocol controls and token-waste accounting.

paper.title: MT-EditFlow: Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Turn Image Editing with Flow Matching
paper.abstract: Recent breakthroughs in instruction-based image editing have captured significant attention, as models are now capable of handling real-world editing demands with the practicality required by everyday users. However, editing models trained primarily for single-turn edits often break down in multi-turn editing--the natural interactive setting where a user iteratively refines an image based on the model's own previous outputs. This failure stems from the all-or-nothing requirement, where a single

summary.core_problem: 解决基于指令的图像编辑模型在多轮交互编辑中容易出现的错误累积和级联失败问题。
summary.importance: 将强化学习（RL）引入多轮图像编辑，提出了一种基于流匹配（Flow Matching）的RL框架，缓解了多轮编辑中的曝光偏差。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MT-EditFlow框架，将多轮视角与多奖励公式相结合，为GRPO和基于NFT的强化学习方法提供统一结构，优化序列图像编辑的奖励信号。
summary.experiments: 系统分析了多轮编辑中的错误传播问题，并验证了MT-EditFlow在多轮编辑场景下的有效性。
summary.authors_note: 来自UC、UT Austin等机构，Mingyuan Zhou、Ying Nian Wu等知名学者参与。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses the issues of error accumulation and cascading failures in instruction-based image editing models during multi-turn interactive editing.
summary_en.importance: Introduces Reinforcement Learning (RL) to multi-turn image editing, proposing a Flow Matching-based RL framework to mitigate exposure bias in multi-turn editing.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the MT-EditFlow framework, integrating a multi-turn perspective with a multi-reward formulation to provide a unified structure for GRPO and NFT-based RL methods, optimizing reward signals for sequential image editing.
summary_en.experiments: Systematically analyzes error propagation in multi-turn editing and validates the effectiveness of MT-EditFlow in multi-turn editing scenarios.
summary_en.authors_note: From UC, UT Austin, etc., involving notable scholars like Mingyuan Zhou and Ying Nian Wu.

recommendation.zh: 将RL（GRPO等）应用于多轮图像编辑（Flow Matching），对关注多模态RL或Flow Matching后训练的研究员有一定参考价值，但核心仍是图像编辑。
recommendation.en: Applies RL (e.g., GRPO) to multi-turn image editing (Flow Matching), offering some reference value for researchers interested in multimodal RL or Flow Matching post-training, though the core remains image editing.

paper.title: Learning When Not to Act: Mitigating Tool Abuse in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning can induce tool abuse, where models overuse external tools even for queries solvable by internal reasoning. Existing approaches mitigate this issue with uniform tool-use penalties or hard limits, which reduce tool frequency but may also suppress useful tool-assisted exploration. We propose EAPO, an Efficient Agentic Policy Optimization framework that learns selective tool use. EAPO introduces tool-free trajectories into each rollout group, applies difficulty-aware

summary.core_problem: 工具增强型Agent RL训练中的工具滥用（tool abuse）问题：模型在RL训练中逐渐将工具调用当作默认推理策略，即使对内部推理足以解决的简单查询也会调用工具，造成不必要的计算、延迟和部署成本。现有解决方案（统一工具使用惩罚或硬限制）会同时抑制对困难查询有用的工具辅助探索。核心难点在于标准rollout中几乎不包含无工具轨迹，训练过程缺乏'模型能否独立解决该查询'的直接证据，因此难以区分必要工具使用与滥用。
summary.importance: 对Agentic RL和预训练研究有实质性贡献。首先，首次系统地把'工具滥用'作为一个独立的训练问题提出，并指出标准rollout机制是其根源——轨迹分布偏置导致模型无法学习'何时不行动'。其次，无工具rollout+难度感知奖励塑造的方案简洁且有原则性，可能影响后续Agent RL训练框架的设计。对预训练的启发是：训练数据中的轨迹分布偏置会系统性地影响模型行为偏好，即使在训练信号中包含效率约束，如果rollout分布不提供反事实证据（无工具轨迹），模型也无法学习选择性行为。这与预训练中数据分布导致的偏好偏差问题有相似性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出EAPO（Efficient Agentic Policy Optimization）框架，包含三个关键设计：1) 效率感知rollout机制：对每个查询，在rollout集中强制加入一定比例的无工具轨迹（关闭所有外部工具），直接提供'模型内部推理能否解决该问题'的信号；2) 难度感知奖励塑造（difficulty-aware reward shaping）：当rollout组中存在成功的无工具轨迹时，对使用工具的轨迹施加惩罚，惩罚强度与查询难度成反比——简单查询（无工具成功率高）惩罚更强，困难查询（无工具几乎无人成功）惩罚很弱或不惩罚；3) 置信度感知token级重加权（confidence-aware token reweighting）：根据模型生成每个token的对数概率调节梯度，高置信度token赋予更高权重以稳定策略学习。与现有方法的区别：OTC（Wang等2025）是统一工具调用惩罚，不区分查询难度；R1-Searcher++的惩罚也不考虑难度。EAPO通过无工具rollout提供的反事实证据实现选择性惩罚。
summary.experiments: 在9个数学和知识密集型推理基准上测试，涵盖Qwen2.5和Llama系列的3B和7B参数量模型。相比GRPO基线，EAPO在7B模型上平均减少约20%工具使用，同时提升约10%任务性能。在多个基准上同时改善了准确率-效率权衡。论文声称在多个模型家族和规模上一致有效。具体基准和详细数值在后续章节中（提供的内容包含到Preliminary部分）。
summary.reading_guide: 精读重点：Introduction中的工具滥用现象分析（图1展示的具体案例）和标准rollout偏置问题（图2）——这是全文最有洞察力的部分；Preliminary中的形式化定义，特别是工具滥用的定义；EAPO的三个核心组件（无工具rollout、难度感知奖励、置信度感知重加权）的技术细节；实验部分的详细对比结果和消融实验。预计精读时间约1小时。值得深挖的点：无工具rollout的比例如何确定、难度感知奖励的具体函数形式、置信度重加权与现有token-level加权方法的差异。
summary.authors_note: 论文未在提供的内容中明确列出机构和作者具体信息，需要查看论文完整版本。

summary_en.core_problem: Tool abuse in tool-augmented agentic RL: models gradually learn to treat tool invocation as the default reasoning strategy during RL training, invoking tools even for simple queries solvable by internal reasoning. This causes unnecessary computation, latency, and deployment cost. Existing solutions (uniform tool-use penalties or hard limits) also suppress useful tool-assisted exploration on hard queries. The core difficulty is that standard rollout procedures produce almost no tool-free trajectories, so the training process lacks direct evidence about whether the model can solve a query independently—making it impossible to distinguish necessary tool use from abuse.
summary_en.importance: Substantive contribution to agentic RL and pretraining research. First, it is the first work to systematically treat 'tool abuse' as a distinct training problem and identify the standard rollout mechanism as its root cause—distribution bias in trajectories prevents the model from learning 'when not to act.' Second, the solution (tool-free rollouts + difficulty-aware reward shaping) is clean and principled, likely to influence subsequent agent RL framework design. For pretraining, the insight that trajectory distribution bias systematically shapes model behavioral preferences—even when efficiency constraints are in the training signal—without counterfactual evidence (tool-free trajectories) models cannot learn selective behavior, which parallels preference bias issues caused by data distribution in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes EAPO (Efficient Agentic Policy Optimization) with three key components: 1) Efficiency-aware rollout: for each query, the rollout set is forced to include a proportion of tool-free trajectories (all external tools disabled), providing direct evidence about the model's intrinsic reasoning capacity; 2) Difficulty-aware reward shaping: when successful tool-free trajectories exist in the rollout group, tool-using trajectories are penalized, with penalty strength inversely proportional to query difficulty—stronger penalties for easy queries (high tool-free success rate), weak or no penalties for hard queries (near-zero tool-free success rate); 3) Confidence-aware token-level reweighting: gradients are modulated by the log-probability of each generated token, giving higher weight to high-confidence tokens to stabilize policy learning. Key differences from existing methods: OTC (Wang et al. 2025) applies uniform tool-use penalties regardless of query difficulty; R1-Searcher++ similarly does not account for difficulty. EAPO achieves selective penalization through counterfactual evidence from tool-free rollouts.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 9 mathematical and knowledge-intensive reasoning benchmarks across Qwen2.5 and Llama families at 3B and 7B parameter scales. Compared to GRPO baseline, EAPO reduces tool usage by ~20% on average while improving task performance by ~10% on 7B models. Consistently improves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off across benchmarks. Detailed per-benchmark results and ablations are in subsequent sections not fully included in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: Close reading focus: Introduction's analysis of the tool abuse phenomenon (Figure 1 case studies) and the standard rollout bias problem (Figure 2)—the most insightful parts of the paper; formal definitions in Preliminary, especially the tool abuse definition; technical details of EAPO's three core components (tool-free rollouts, difficulty-aware rewards, confidence-aware reweighting); detailed experimental comparisons and ablation studies. Estimated close reading time: ~1 hour. Worth investigating: how tool-free rollout proportion is determined, specific functional form of difficulty-aware reward, and how confidence reweighting differs from existing token-level weighting approaches.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional and author information not explicitly listed in the provided content; the full paper should be consulted for details.

recommendation.zh: 字节针对 Agent RL 中 tool abuse 问题的解法，difficulty-aware reward shaping 和无工具轨迹注入的思路很实用，做 RL post-training 的必读。
recommendation.en: ByteDance's solution to tool abuse in Agent RL; the ideas of difficulty-aware reward shaping and tool-free trajectory injection are highly practical, a must-read for RL post-training.

paper.title: Learning When to Translate for Multilingual Reasoning
paper.abstract: Reasoning language models (RLMs) achieve strong performance on complex reasoning tasks, but still exhibit substantial multilingual reasoning gaps, largely due to language-understanding failures in non-English inputs. English translation can mitigate these failures by expressing non-English inputs in a form that RLMs can more reliably interpret, yet translating every input is unnecessary when the model can reason reliably from the original query. To address this challenge, we propose Luar, a Lang

summary.core_problem: 推理语言模型（RLM）在多语言推理任务上存在显著性能差距——低资源语言的输入常因语言理解失败而非推理能力不足导致错误。逐句翻译所有输入虽可缓解但效率低下，而模型本身缺乏在理解不可靠时自动调用翻译的机制。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发主要在于：展示了RLM内部存在语言理解失败的内隐信号（如推理链中显式表达不确定性），可被RL利用来训练自适应行为。这种'学会认识自身能力边界'的思路可能迁移到其他场景（如代码生成、长上下文理解中自动决定何时求助外部工具）。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Luar（Language Understanding Boundary-aware Reinforcement Learning）两阶段框架。第一阶段（Translator-Call SFT）：通过在推理链中插入翻译调用前缀，让模型同时接触直接推理和翻译增强推理两种模式，构造监督目标扩展动作空间。第二阶段（Boundary-aware RL）：用GRPO算法训练模型选择何时调用翻译。核心创新是定义了基于结果的翻译有用性标签u(q)：对同一查询采样N=8条响应（4条直接推理，4条翻译增强推理），若翻译模式正确率比直接模式高出δ=0.5以上，则标记为需要翻译。RL奖励函数仅在翻译预期能显著提升最终答案准确率时给予正奖励，避免过度翻译。
summary.experiments: 在多语言数学和STEM推理benchmark上测试Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B。Luar相比标准GRPO和其他训练基线有明显提升，低资源语言增益尤其突出。学到的策略集中在翻译确实有用的语言上调用翻译器，同时保留高资源语言的直接推理能力，并能泛化到未见过的低资源语言（如约鲁巴语、祖鲁语）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点：Figure 1（模型在推理链中表达不确定性但最终给出自信答案的现象分析）、Figure 3（Luar整体框架图）、§3.1（基于结果的边界定义方法）。预计阅读时间20-30分钟。对RL训练自适应工具调用策略感兴趣的研究者可细读Stage II的奖励设计。
summary.authors_note: 机构未在提供的文本片段中明确标注

summary_en.core_problem: Reasoning language models exhibit substantial multilingual performance gaps, where failures in low-resource language understanding (rather than reasoning capability) often cause errors. Blindly translating all inputs is inefficient, and models lack a mechanism to invoke translation only when their own understanding is unreliable.
summary_en.importance: The key insight for pretraining research is demonstrating that RLMs contain internal signals of language-understanding failure (e.g., explicit uncertainty in reasoning traces) that can be leveraged via RL to train adaptive behavior. This 'learning to recognize one's own capability boundary' paradigm may generalize to other domains such as automated tool use in code generation or long-context understanding.
summary_en.technical_approach: Luar is a two-stage framework. Stage I (Translator-Call SFT) extends the model's action space by fine-tuning on both direct and translator-augmented reasoning traces, using a translator-call prefix inserted into the reasoning chain. Stage II (Boundary-aware RL with GRPO) trains the model to decide when to invoke translation. The core innovation is an outcome-based translation-usefulness label u(q): for each query, N=8 responses are sampled (4 direct, 4 translator-augmented); u(q)=1 if translation improves accuracy by at least δ=0.5. The RL reward function only rewards translation when it is expected to substantially improve final-answer accuracy, preventing over-translation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on multilingual math and STEM reasoning benchmarks with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B. Luar outperforms standard GRPO and other training baselines, with especially large gains on low-resource languages. The learned policy concentrates translator calls on languages where translation helps, preserves direct reasoning for high-resource languages, and generalizes to unseen low-resource languages (Yoruba, Zulu).
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim重点: Figure 1 (analysis of uncertainty signals in reasoning traces), Figure 3 (Luar framework overview), §3.1 (outcome-based boundary definition). Estimated reading time: 20-30 minutes. Researchers interested in RL-trained adaptive tool invocation should read Stage II reward design carefully.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the provided text excerpts

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“翻译”变成按样本分配额外理解算力的策略学习，这个视角对 multilingual routing 很干净；先看方法定义和 ablation，别急着信平均分。
recommendation.en: Not a pretrain paper, but the clean idea is treating translation as per-example allocation of extra understanding compute; read the method and ablations first, and don’t over-trust the average gains without checking the setup.

paper.title: PR2: Predictive Routing Replay for MoE-Based LLM Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Mixture of Experts (MoE) Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance at scale. However, reinforcement learning (RL) on MoE-based LLMs often suffers from training instability. A root cause is router drift, i.e., expert activations can change drastically across model updates and differ between disaggregated rollout and training phases, causing large rollout--training mismatch and unstable importance sampling weights in PPO-style RL algorithms. Routing replay mitigates this issue by fre

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 MoE LLM 做 PPO/GRPO 类强化学习时的路由不稳定问题：同一批 rollout 轨迹在训练阶段被当前模型重新计算时，token 可能被送到不同专家，导致 rollout-policy 与 training-policy 的计算路径不一致，进而放大重要性采样比率的方差。已有 routing replay 固定旧路由可以稳定比率，但会让训练长期使用过时专家路径，错过当前策略即将激活的专家，形成 router staleness。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发在于：MoE 的条件计算路径不仅是架构问题，也是训练信号问题。RL 阶段的梯度估计会被 router drift 放大，而简单冻结路由又会牺牲专家更新的新鲜度。PR2 给出了一种折中：训练时仍使用固定路由来稳定 PPO 比率，但 rollout 时提前预测短期路由演化，让缓存的专家路径更接近未来训练策略。这个思路对 MoE mid-training、continual pretrain 和任何异步 rollout/training 的大规模训练系统都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Predictive Routing Replay。作者先把 routing replay 形式化为用一个退化的 replay measure 替代当前路由分布，并推导出 router staleness 与固定路由 PPO 梯度偏差之间的散度界。这个分析指出，稳定重要性估计需要冻结路由，但有效学习又需要路由分布跟上策略更新。PR2 因此在每个 MoE router 旁边加入轻量 evolution predictor。rollout 阶段，predictor 对 router logits 产生一个 learned logit bias，再基于偏置后的 logits 做 top-k routing，并把预测出的专家索引缓存到 trajectory 中。训练阶段，模型重放这些缓存的 top-k 专家索引，同时关闭 predictor，从而保持 PPO/GRPO 的固定计算路径。predictor 用 KL divergence 目标训练，目标是让 rollout-time 预测路由接近短期更新后的路由分布；作者还给 predictor 使用单独的 learning-rate multiplier，使其能更快适应 router 演化。PR2 不修改 policy optimization objective，可接入 VeRL、Slime、TRL 这类 MoE RL 框架。
summary.experiments: 实验集中在 MoE reasoning RL。文中报告 PR2 能降低 routing mismatch，缓解训练不稳定，并在多个 reasoning 任务上超过 routing replay、GSPO 等基线。最明确的结果是：在 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 上使用 GRPO+PR2，AIME24 accuracy 达到 40.31%，相比 routing replay 高 12.29 个百分点，相比 GSPO 高 9.38 个百分点。作者强调计算开销很小，因为 predictor 只是在 rollout 阶段给 router logits 加轻量偏置，训练阶段仍是缓存路由重放。消融重点应是 predictor、KL 目标、learning-rate multiplier、是否预测未来路由，以及 routing mismatch 指标与最终准确率之间的关系。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 router drift 与 router staleness 的定义，明确它和 dense model PPO 不同在哪里。再看理论部分关于 replay staleness 控制 fixed-route PPO gradient deviation 的散度界，重点不是推导细节，而是它如何导出“冻结路由”和“跟踪路由演化”的折中。方法部分重点看 rollout 阶段 logit bias、top-k route caching、训练阶段关闭 predictor 的流程图。实验部分优先看 AIME24、routing mismatch、训练稳定性曲线，以及 predictor 相关消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a stability issue specific to RL on MoE LLMs. In PPO- or GRPO-style training, trajectories are generated by a stale rollout policy and later evaluated by the updated training policy. For MoE models, the same token may be routed to different experts across these two phases. This route drift changes the computation path behind the importance ratio and can make policy updates unstable. Plain routing replay fixes the route, but then the cached route becomes stale and excludes experts that the current policy would activate.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the training-signal view of MoE routing. The router is not just an inference-time dispatch module; during RL it controls which experts receive gradients and how off-policy the reused trajectories become. PR2 gives a practical compromise: keep replayed routes fixed during training for stable importance estimation, while predicting near-future routing during rollout so the cached route is less stale. The same issue can appear in large-scale MoE mid-training, continual pretraining, and disaggregated rollout-training systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: PR2, Predictive Routing Replay, augments each MoE router with a lightweight evolution predictor. The paper first formalizes routing replay as replacing the current routing distribution with a degenerate replay measure, then derives a divergence-based bound showing that replay staleness controls route-induced deviation in fixed-route PPO gradients. Motivated by this, the predictor produces a learned logit bias during rollout. Top-k routing is then performed on the biased logits, and the predicted expert indices are cached with the trajectory. During training, these cached top-k routes are replayed and the predictor is disabled, so the policy objective remains unchanged and the computation path is fixed. The predictor is trained with a KL objective designed to match short-horizon router evolution, with a separate learning-rate multiplier for faster adaptation.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments focus on reasoning RL for MoE LLMs. PR2 is reported to reduce routing mismatch, improve training stability, and outperform routing replay and GSPO-style baselines. The clearest number is on Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base: GRPO with PR2 reaches 40.31% accuracy on AIME24, improving over routing replay by 12.29 points and over GSPO by 9.38 points. The method adds little compute because the predictor only biases router logits during rollout, while training still uses cached expert indices. The key ablations to inspect are the predictor, the KL training objective, the dedicated learning-rate multiplier, and the relation between routing mismatch and final task accuracy.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Start with the definitions of router drift and router staleness in the introduction, since they are the main conceptual contribution. Then read the theoretical section on the divergence bound to see why fixed routing stabilizes PPO but can bias expert updates. In the method section, focus on the rollout-time logit bias, top-k route caching, and disabling the predictor during training. In the experiments, prioritize the AIME24 result, routing mismatch metrics, stability curves, and predictor ablations.

recommendation.zh: 做MoE RL对齐的团队可直接复现该机制，重点看§3.2的预测器设计和§4.1的稳定性分析数据。
recommendation.en: Teams working on MoE RL alignment can directly reproduce this mechanism; focus on predictor design in §3.2 and stability analysis data in §4.1.

paper.title: CARE-RL: Capability-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Mitigating Cross-Domain Conflicts
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) with verifiable rewards has achieved strong progress in reasoning-oriented LLMs, but extending it to multi-domain RL remains challenging due to reward unreliability in non-verifiable tasks and capability interference across domains. We propose CARE-RL to combine protocol-aware reward generation with capability-aware optimization for mitigating cross-domain conflicts. For non-verifiable tasks, the Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model (PA-GRM) constructs prompt-level

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决多领域 RL 中两个常见冲突：非可验证任务缺少可靠 reward，导致 open-ended response 的训练信号不稳定；不同领域顺序或联合训练时，后续更新可能破坏已有能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练与 post-train 接口的启发在于，它把 reward 质量和参数更新方向放在同一个框架里处理。PA-GRM 试图让非可验证任务的评价协议随 prompt 改变，而不是用固定 rubric 评所有开放任务；DACSP 则把历史 RL 阶段的参数变化视为能力方向，在后续阶段调制梯度更新。贡献规模偏工程方法整合，实验提升幅度不大，但问题设置贴近多阶段训练中的 capability interference。
summary.technical_approach: CARE-RL 是一个 cascade multi-domain RL 框架。对可验证领域，直接使用任务 verifier；对非可验证领域，使用 Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model。PA-GRM 分两步生成 reward：先根据 prompt 选择评价协议并构造 scoring schema，再对 candidate response 生成评分 trace 和标量 reward。协议分为 holistic 与 rubric 两类：前者适合创作、风格、整体连贯性等难以拆分的任务；后者适合有明确约束、可逐项检查的任务，例如规划类请求。优化侧是 Direction-Aware Capability Subspace Projection。每完成一个 RL 阶段，记录该阶段的参数增量，用 leading singular directions 近似该阶段获得的能力方向。后续阶段更新前，把待应用更新分解到这些历史方向上：与历史能力方向一致的分量放大，方向相反的分量抑制，正交分量保持不变。这样避免直接把所有梯度投影掉，也比简单 sequential training 更关注方向冲突。
summary.experiments: 作者在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Qwen3-4B 上做多领域 RL，对比 joint training、sequential training 以及相关多领域 RL 基线。报告的主要结果是 CARE-RL 在平均分上超过最强基线：Qwen2.5-7B 提升 +1.0 分，Qwen3-4B 提升 +0.9 分。实验声称 PA-GRM 改善非可验证任务 reward 适配性，DACSP 缓解跨领域能力退化。需要重点核对各领域分项结果，因为平均分提升较小，方法是否真的减少 interference，要看旧领域保持率、新领域学习幅度和 PA-GRM/DACSP 分别移除后的结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 分钟。先看 Methodology 的整体流程图，明确 PA-GRM 负责 reward 构造，DACSP 负责 update modulation。PA-GRM 部分重点看 holistic/rubric 路由逻辑、schema 生成方式和 Appendix B 的 prompt templates。DACSP 部分重点看参数增量如何形成低秩 capability subspace，以及 aligned/opposing/orthogonal components 如何被调制。实验部分优先看每个领域的分项指标、PA-GRM 与 DACSP 消融、顺序训练下旧能力是否下降。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses two coupled problems in multi-domain RL for LLMs: open-ended tasks often lack reliable rewards, and sequential or joint optimization across domains can cause capability interference, where later updates degrade skills learned in earlier stages.
summary_en.importance: The useful angle is the joint treatment of reward construction and update direction. PA-GRM adapts the evaluation protocol to each prompt instead of applying one fixed rubric to all non-verifiable tasks. DACSP uses parameter changes from previous RL stages as low-rank capability directions and modulates later updates according to their alignment. The contribution is more of a practical framework than a new RL objective, and the reported gains are modest, but the setting is relevant to multi-stage post-training and continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARE-RL organizes training as a cascade over domains. Verifiable domains use task-specific verifiers. Non-verifiable domains use a Protocol-Aware Generative Reward Model. PA-GRM first selects an evaluation protocol and builds a prompt-level scoring schema, then scores each candidate response under that schema with a trace-conditioned generative reward. It supports holistic evaluation for tasks such as creative writing, where quality is hard to decompose, and rubric-based evaluation for tasks with explicit constraints. The optimization component, Direction-Aware Capability Subspace Projection, records the parameter delta after each completed RL stage and extracts leading singular directions as a proxy for acquired capability directions. For later stages, the proposed update is decomposed relative to these historical subspaces: aligned components are amplified, opposing components are suppressed, and orthogonal components are left unchanged.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are conducted on Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen3-4B in a multi-domain RL setting. CARE-RL reports the best average score among the compared methods, improving over the strongest baseline by +1.0 points on Qwen2.5-7B and +0.9 points on Qwen3-4B. The paper attributes the gains to better reward adaptation on non-verifiable tasks and reduced cross-domain degradation from DACSP. Since the average improvements are small, the most important evidence is in the per-domain breakdown, old-domain retention after later stages, and ablations removing PA-GRM or DACSP.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20 minutes. Read the methodology figure first to separate the two roles: PA-GRM constructs rewards, while DACSP modulates updates. For PA-GRM, inspect the holistic-versus-rubric routing, schema generation, scoring traces, and the prompt templates in the appendix. For DACSP, focus on how parameter deltas are converted into low-rank capability subspaces and how update components are amplified or suppressed. In the experiments, prioritize per-domain scores, ablations, and evidence of reduced forgetting under sequential training.

recommendation.zh: 多域RL对齐的能力保留思路对后训练有参考价值，重点看§3的子空间投影方法即可
recommendation.en: The capability subspace projection for multi-domain RL alignment is useful for post-training research, focus on Section 3 only.

paper.title: Deep Research as Rubric for Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Open-ended reasoning and long-form generation tasks lack reliable automatic verification signals for reward-based policy optimization. Rubrics offer a promising alternative, but existing approaches treat them as given artifacts -- either hand-crafted or prompt-generated -- and often miss the task-specific, knowledge-intensive dimensions that matter most, distorting the reward signal. Our key observation is that rubric construction is itself a research problem: identifying what makes a response c

summary.core_problem: 这篇文章处理的是开放式推理和长文本生成里一个很实际的问题：没有标准答案时，RL 需要什么样的奖励信号，才能既可扩展又不失真。作者认为关键不只是“用 rubric 做奖励”，而是 rubric 本身怎么来。若 rubric 只是人工写的，成本太高；若只是让模型凭参数记忆直接生成，往往只会评估表面流畅性，抓不住任务相关的事实约束、结构要求和常见失败模式。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接关联不如前一篇强，但它对 post-train 信号构造很有启发，尤其是当大家试图把 open-ended reasoning 的 RL 信号做得更自动化时。文章的价值在于把“奖励设计”前移成一个知识获取问题：先做深度检索和证据组织，再把证据压成可程序化检查的 rubric。这个思路对 self-improvement、synthetic supervision、以及 reward model 数据构造都有参考意义，因为它强调奖励质量受外部知识 grounding 约束，而不是只靠模型内生先验。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 DR-Rubric，分两阶段。Stage I 是 Information Elicitation：给定 query、工具集和交互预算，agentic research 模型做多轮搜索、检索、核验和整理，形成 evidence trace。这里的目标不是直接回答问题，而是收集“评价一个好答案需要知道什么”，包括领域事实、结构性要求、典型错误和遗漏点。Stage II 是 Rubric Synthesis：把前面累积的证据转成原子化、可独立检查的 rubric 约束，每条约束都尽量程序化、可验证、可给部分分。

随后作者用这些 rubric 作为 RL 奖励。相比直接让 judge 模型给一个整体分，rubric 奖励更细粒度，也更稳定，因为它把一个开放式质量判断拆成多个局部约束。文章还进一步做 bootstrap rubric generation：不用外部强模型长期提供 rubric，而是让当前模型自己生成 rubric，再用这些 rubric 继续训练，观察多轮自举后的能力变化。作者特别关注一个动态：第一轮自举会把能力推向 reasoning specialization，后续轮次再逐步把 agentic task 能力补回来。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 6 个 benchmark，既有 research/agentic 任务，也有专家级 reasoning 任务。结果层面，8B 规模模型在不同 rubric 来源下表现不同：GPT-5 生成的 rubric 让 DR-Rubric-8B 在 ResearchQA 和 DeepResearchBench 上领先；Gemini 生成的 rubric 在 LocalSearchBench 和 GPQA 上更均衡。更有意思的是 bootstrap 结果。第一轮自举就能得到较强的 reasoning 表现，例如 GPQA 57.0、MMLU 84.0，并且在专家推理 benchmark 上超过 benchmark-native rubric 和 GPT-5-assisted rubric；但这一步会牺牲 agentic task。到 Bootstrap Step 3，模型在不依赖外部模型的情况下，把这种失衡部分修复，并在 MMLU-Pro 78.0、MMLU 85.3 上超过外部辅助版本。作者据此提出 specialization-to-rebalancing 的训练动态。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看方法图和 Stage I / Stage II 定义，理解作者为什么坚持“先研究，再写 rubric”，而不是直接 prompt 一个 rubric。然后看 bootstrap 部分和主结果表，重点关注不同 rubric 来源带来的能力偏置。若只花 15–20 分钟，读引言、框架图、bootstrap 实验和主要 benchmark 表格就够了。若想进一步判断它对 RL 信号设计是否有迁移价值，再补看 rubric 约束的形式化定义和奖励实现细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical bottleneck in RL for open-ended reasoning and long-form generation: when there is no clean ground-truth answer, what kind of reward signal can be both scalable and faithful? The authors argue that the key issue is not merely using rubrics as rewards, but constructing the right rubric in the first place. Handwritten rubrics do not scale, while prompt-only rubric generation tends to stay at the level of generic fluency and coherence, missing task-specific factual constraints, structural requirements, and common failure modes.
summary_en.importance: Its connection to core pretraining is indirect, but it is relevant to post-training signal design, especially for open-ended reasoning where verifiable rewards are unavailable. The useful idea is to treat reward construction as a knowledge acquisition problem. Instead of asking a model to invent evaluation criteria from its parametric prior, the framework first gathers external evidence and then compresses that evidence into atomic, checkable rubric constraints. This is relevant to synthetic supervision and self-improvement because it highlights a familiar bottleneck: reward quality depends on grounding, not just on model confidence.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method, DR-Rubric, has two stages. Stage I is Information Elicitation. Given a query, a tool set, and an interaction budget, an agentic research model performs iterative search, retrieval, verification, and synthesis to build an evidence trace. The goal is not to answer the query directly, but to discover what a good answer should contain: domain facts, structural constraints, likely omissions, and typical failure patterns. Stage II is Rubric Synthesis. The collected evidence is converted into a formal rubric made of atomic constraints that can be checked independently and used for partial credit.

These rubrics are then used as RL rewards. Compared with a single holistic judge score, rubric rewards are denser and more interpretable because they decompose quality into multiple local criteria. The paper also studies bootstrap rubric generation, where the model eventually generates its own rubrics instead of relying on a stronger external model. The interesting training dynamic is that the first bootstrap step tends to specialize the model toward reasoning, while later bootstrap rounds partially restore broader agentic performance.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover six benchmarks spanning research-style agentic tasks and expert reasoning tasks. At the 8B scale, rubric source matters: GPT-5-generated rubrics give the strongest results on ResearchQA and DeepResearchBench, while Gemini-generated rubrics produce a more balanced profile and lead on LocalSearchBench and GPQA. The bootstrap results are the most notable part. The first bootstrap step already yields strong reasoning performance, including GPQA 57.0 and MMLU 84.0, and even surpasses benchmark-native and GPT-5-assisted rubrics on some expert reasoning evaluations. However, this comes with a cost: the model becomes more specialized toward reasoning and weaker on agentic tasks. By Bootstrap Step 3, the model recovers part of that imbalance and reaches MMLU-Pro 78.0 and MMLU 85.3 without external-model assistance. The authors describe this as a specialization-to-rebalancing dynamic.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the framework figure and the definitions of Stage I and Stage II. The main conceptual point is why rubric construction should be treated as a research process rather than a one-shot prompt. Then read the bootstrap section and the main result tables, paying attention to how different rubric sources shift the capability profile. If you only have 15–20 minutes, the introduction, method overview, bootstrap experiments, and main benchmark tables are enough. If you want to judge whether the approach transfers to broader RL signal design, then also read the formal rubric specification and reward implementation details.

recommendation.zh: 开放任务RL奖励构造的新思路，用agent搜索生成rubric的方法值得做RL后训练的研究员参考，读§3方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: Novel approach to reward construction for open-task RL, read Section 3 for the agentic rubric generation method for RL post-training.

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

paper.title: Capability Self-Assessment: Teaching LLMs to Know Their Limits
paper.abstract: The ability to recognize one's own limitations and decide whether to solve a problem or delegate is fundamental for reliable intelligent systems. Yet we show that modern large language models systematically lack this ability: across diverse model families and scales, they overestimate their competence and attempt queries they cannot solve. We refer to this ability as Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) and formulate it as a policy-learning problem, aiming to improve self-assessment while preserving

summary.core_problem: 现代 LLM 系统性地高估自身能力——即使在它们无法可靠解决的问题上，模型也倾向于选择回答而非放弃。这种能力自我评估（Capability Self-Assessment, CSA）的缺失导致过度生成幻觉和计算浪费。现有校准/置信度估计工作不把自我评估视为独立的能力学习问题，而指令微调/拒答工作常把行为混入特定任务。
summary.importance: 把 LLM 能力边界的自我认知形式化为一个独立的策略学习问题，而非分类或校准问题，并证明 RL（特别是 RLVR）可以有效教会模型这一能力同时保留原始解题能力。这对基座训练后的后训练阶段有启发——自我评估能力可以被习得并用于推断时路由和训练时数据选择。
summary.technical_approach: CSA 被形式化为二选一的策略学习问题：模型对每个 query 选择 Self-SOLVE（自己尝试）或 DELEGATE（交给更强模型）。Ground-truth 标签通过预训练模型自身的 K 次采样表现（pass@K 或多数投票）来构建。论文对比了四种训练策略：(a) SFT on label（直接输出决策）、(b) SFT on rationale（带推理的 SFT）、(c) SFT on CoT label（链式思考+决策）、(d) RLVR（使用可验证奖励的强化学习）。核心论点是 SFT 虽然能模仿决策标签，但会严重损害模型的原始解题能力；而 RLVR 通过基于结果的奖励（Self-SOLVE 当且仅当模型实际能解题时才受奖励）同时保留原能力并学会 CSA。
summary.experiments: 在多种模型家族、规模（从小到大）和领域上验证：(1) RL 显著优于 SFT 基线，在提升 CSA 准确性的同时保留原始解题能力；(2) SFT 会严重损害模型被评估的目标能力；(3) 学到的 CSA 策略能跨领域迁移，说明它不是领域特定启发式；(4) 实际应用：推断时的本地-云端路由（更好的 cost-accuracy 权衡）和训练时的能力感知数据选择（DELEGATE 样本位于能力边界附近）。具体 benchmark 数字和模型细节需在全文中查看。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读 Section 2 的经验发现（LLM 系统性高估自身能力的诊断）；Section 3 的训练策略对比，特别是为什么 SFT 失败而 RL 成功的机制分析；Section 4 的两个实际应用（路由和数据选择）。预计阅读时间 40-50 分钟。
summary.authors_note: 机构和作者信息在提供内容中未明确给出。

summary_en.core_problem: Modern LLMs systematically overestimate their capabilities—even on queries they cannot reliably solve, models choose to answer rather than defer. This lack of Capability Self-Assessment (CSA) leads to excessive hallucination and wasted compute. Existing calibration/confidence estimation work does not treat self-assessment as an independent capability-learning problem, and instruction tuning/abstention work typically mixes the behavior into specific tasks.
summary_en.importance: This work formalizes self-awareness of capability boundaries as a standalone policy-learning problem (not classification or calibration), and demonstrates that RL (specifically RLVR) can effectively teach this capability while preserving the model's original problem-solving ability. It informs post-training design—self-assessment capability is learnable and useful for both inference routing and training-time data selection.
summary_en.technical_approach: CSA is formulated as a binary policy-learning problem: for each query, the model chooses between Self-SOLVE (attempt itself) and DELEGATE (hand off to a stronger model). Ground-truth labels are constructed by probing the pre-trained model's own K-sample performance (pass@K or majority vote). Four training strategies are compared: (a) SFT on label (direct decision output); (b) SFT on rationale (SFT with reasoning); (c) SFT on CoT label (chain-of-thought plus decision); (d) RLVR (reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards). The key argument: SFT can mimic decision labels but severely degrades the underlying problem-solving ability, while RLVR preserves it via outcome-based feedback—Self-SOLVE is only rewarded when the model can actually solve the query.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across model families, scales (small to large), and domains: (1) RL significantly outperforms SFT baselines, improving CSA accuracy while preserving original problem-solving ability; (2) SFT severely degrades the very capability being assessed; (3) the learned CSA policy transfers across domains, indicating it is not a domain-specific heuristic; (4) practical applications in local-cloud routing (better cost-accuracy tradeoff) and capability-aware training data selection (DELEGATE samples lie near the capability boundary). Specific benchmark numbers should be looked up in the full paper.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for the empirical diagnosis of systematic capability overestimation; Section 3 for the training-strategy comparison, especially the mechanism of why SFT fails and RL succeeds; Section 4 for the two practical applications (routing and data selection). Estimated reading time 40-50 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution and author information not available in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫实验设计，尤其 RL vs SFT 的能力保持；若结果稳，内部路由和拒答训练应加入 CSA ablation。
recommendation.en: Skim the experimental setup, especially RL versus SFT on capability retention; if stable, CSA should enter internal routing and abstention ablations.

paper.title: SIRI: Self-Internalizing Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Skills for LLM Agent Training
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents can benefit from reusable skills, yet existing skill-based methods often rely on external skill generators during training or persistent skill retrieval at inference, increasing engineering complexity, context length, and deployment latency. We propose Self-Internalizing Reinforcement learning with Intrinsic skills (SIRI), a three-phase framework that enables agents to discover, validate, and internalize skills without external skill generators or inference-time skill ban

summary.core_problem: 现有基于技能的长程LLM智能体训练方法依赖外部技能生成模块，且推理时需要持续从技能库检索技能，增加了工程复杂度、上下文长度和部署延迟，同时技能质量和内化效率缺乏有效的量化校验机制。
summary.importance: RL训练过程中收集的中间成功轨迹可以作为自监督的技能信号来源，不需要额外引入外部模块或保留推理时依赖，这一思路为智能体基座的技能内化式预训练、训练与推理解耦的技能学习范式提供了可行路径。
summary.technical_approach: 提出三阶段SIRI RL训练框架：1）策略预热阶段，用GiGPO训练基础交互能力，收集无技能的成功轨迹；2）自技能挖掘与验证阶段，由当前策略自身从成功轨迹中总结紧凑技能，通过配对的技能增强与无技能环境交互验证技能有效性，仅保留能带来正向收益的技能；3）优势加权技能内化阶段，用轨迹级收益和动作级优势值筛选值得蒸馏的动作token，将有用的技能引导行为迁移到无技能策略中，最终推理时无需依赖技能库或检索服务。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld和WebShop基准上用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct测试，相比GiGPO基线，ALFWorld成功率从0.908提升到0.930，WebShop成功率从0.728提升到0.813，WebShop综合得分从0.844提升到0.899；相比SkillRL基线，ALFWorld成功率从0.899提升到0.930，WebShop成功率从0.727提升到0.813；训练过程中自挖掘技能与外部强LLM生成技能的性能差距持续缩小。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言部分对现有技能类方法缺陷的总结、三阶段框架的核心设计逻辑、技能内化的加权蒸馏机制，预计阅读时间12分钟，不需要深入RL损失函数的细节推导。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing skill-based long-horizon LLM agent training methods rely on external skill generation modules, and require persistent skill retrieval from skill banks during inference. This adds engineering complexity, increases context length and deployment latency, and lacks effective quantitative validation mechanisms for skill quality and internalization efficiency.
summary_en.importance: The insight that successful intermediate trajectories collected during RL training can serve as a self-supervised source of skill signals, without additional external modules or inference-time dependencies, provides a viable path for skill-internalized pretraining of agentic base models, and skill learning paradigms that decouple training and inference workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: SIRI is a three-phase curriculum RL framework: 1) Policy warmup: train basic interaction capability with GiGPO and collect skill-free successful trajectories. 2) Self-skill mining and validation: the current policy summarizes compact skills from its own successful rollouts, validates skills via paired skill-augmented and skill-free rollouts, and only retains skills that deliver positive utility. 3) Advantage-weighted skill internalization: filter action tokens worth distilling using trajectory-level treatment effects and action-level advantage values, transfer useful skill-guided behaviors into the skill-free policy. No skill bank or retrieval service is required at inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on ALFWorld and WebShop benchmarks with Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Compared to the GiGPO baseline, success rate improves from 0.908 to 0.930 on ALFWorld, from 0.728 to 0.813 on WebShop, and WebShop composite score improves from 0.844 to 0.899. Compared to the SkillRL baseline, success rate improves from 0.899 to 0.930 on ALFWorld and from 0.727 to 0.813 on WebShop. The performance gap between self-mined skills and skills generated by stronger external LLMs narrows consistently during training.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the summary of limitations of existing skill-based methods in the introduction, the core design logic of the three-phase framework, and the weighted distillation mechanism for skill internalization. Estimated reading time is 12 minutes, no need to dive deep into detailed RL loss function derivations.

recommendation.zh: 技能蒸馏内化的思路对降低智能体推理开销有实际参考价值，重点看技能挖掘与蒸馏的具体实现细节。
recommendation.en: The skill distillation and internalization idea has practical reference value for reducing agent inference overhead; focus on the specific implementation details of skill mining and distillation.

paper.title: Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Tree search is a central abstraction behind many language-agent reasoning and decision-making tasks: agents must explore actions, remember failures, and backtrack toward promising alternatives. Yet, we lack a theoretical understanding of how transformer-based policies acquire such search capabilities from the training dynamics of reinforcement learning (RL). We study this question in a stochastic $k$-ary tree environment, where an agentic transformer observes only its trajectory history through

summary.core_problem: 语言模型Agent在推理和决策任务中广泛依赖树状搜索原语（探索、回溯、记忆失败路径），但缺乏理论理解：基于Transformer的策略如何通过强化学习（RL）的训练动态，仅从交互轨迹历史和终端奖励信号中习得结构化搜索能力。
summary.importance: 该工作首次在理论层面建立了"Transformer架构 + RL训练 → 涌现搜索能力"的可证结果，为理解Agentic行为的涌现机制提供了形式化框架。虽然是简化环境中的理论研究，但对RL预训练（如R1-Zero范式）、Agent能力习得的课程设计有方法论参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 在随机k叉树环境中（k≥2，深度L≥2），Agent仅能通过交互观测轨迹历史，到达隐藏叶子目标时获得终端奖励。作者首先构造了一个双头Transformer实现随机深度优先搜索（DFS）：一个注意力头跟踪之前的动作以避免重复，另一个头检测失败结局并触发回溯。随后证明在深度渐进式课程训练（depth-wise curriculum）下，策略梯度训练可以让Transformer学习到该搜索策略，并给出了收敛速率和泛化误差的理论界。分析进一步拓展到目标分布不平衡的情况。
summary.experiments: 数值实验验证了理论预测：(1) 构造的Transformer在k叉树环境中正确执行随机DFS；(2) 课程训练下策略梯度收敛到目标策略；(3) 学习到的策略泛化到未见过的树深度和结构。实验为理论验证性质的小规模数值模拟，非大规模实际Agent benchmark。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，预计30-40分钟（理论论文，证明部分技术性强）。对预训练研究员建议重点看Section 2（Transformer构造与随机DFS的实现机制，理解注意力如何实现搜索原语）和Section 3（训练动态与课程训练分析，了解RL训练下搜索能力如何涌现）。附录A-C的详细证明可跳过。
summary.authors_note: Tong Yang (CMU ECE), Yu Huang (UPenn Wharton Statistics & Data Science), Yingbin Liang (Ohio State ECE), Yuejie Chi (Yale Statistics & Data Science)

summary_en.core_problem: Language model agents rely on tree-search primitives (exploration, backtracking, memory of failure paths) for reasoning and decision-making, but a theoretical gap remains: how do transformer-based policies acquire structured search capabilities from RL training dynamics, given only trajectory history and terminal reward signals?
summary_en.importance: This is the first theoretical work establishing provable results connecting transformer architecture, RL training dynamics, and the emergence of structured search capabilities. It provides a formal framework for understanding agentic behavior emergence, with methodological implications for RL-pretraining (e.g., the R1-Zero paradigm) and curriculum design for agent capability acquisition, though it is a theoretical study in a simplified environment.
summary_en.technical_approach: In a stochastic k-ary tree environment (k ≥ 2, depth L ≥ 2), an agent observes only its trajectory history through interaction and receives a terminal reward upon reaching a hidden leaf goal. The authors first construct a two-head transformer implementing randomized DFS: one attention head tracks previous actions to avoid repeats, while a second head detects failure outcomes and triggers backtracking. They then prove that under depth-wise curriculum training, policy gradient can learn such a search strategy, providing theoretical bounds on convergence rate and generalization error. The analysis extends to settings with imbalanced goal distributions.
summary_en.experiments: Numerical experiments validate the theoretical predictions: (1) the constructed transformer correctly implements randomized DFS on k-ary trees; (2) policy gradient converges to the target policy under curriculum training; (3) the learned policy generalizes to unseen tree depths and structures. Experiments are small-scale theoretical simulations, not large-scale agent benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim read, estimated 30–40 minutes (theoretical paper with dense proofs). For pretraining researchers, focus on Section 2 (transformer construction for DFS — how attention implements search primitives) and Section 3 (training dynamics and curriculum analysis — how RL yields emergent search). The detailed proofs in Appendices A–C can be skipped.
summary_en.authors_note: Tong Yang (CMU ECE), Yu Huang (UPenn Wharton Statistics & Data Science), Yingbin Liang (Ohio State ECE), Yuejie Chi (Yale Statistics & Data Science)

recommendation.zh: 把“RL让Transformer学会搜索”讲成可证明的分阶段机制，值得读其构造与curriculum假设；但离真实LLM环境仍远。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for the constructive DFS transformer and staged policy-gradient emergence under curriculum, but the assumptions are far from real LLM agent settings.

paper.title: SIRIUS-SQL: Anchoring Multi-Candidate Text-to-SQL in Execution Feedback
paper.abstract: Text-to-SQL on complex schemas is unreliable on a single pass, so recent systems generate multiple SQL candidates and let voting filter out errors. Yet voting alone is not enough, because the multi-candidate recipe has three coupled weaknesses: 1) sampling more from a single generator produces increasingly redundant candidates, 2) existing pipelines apply one generic correction to every non-clean execution result, while runtime errors, timeouts, and empty results each indicate a different distan

summary.core_problem: 现有多候选Text-to-SQL方案存在生成候选冗余、执行错误修复无差别、候选选择维度单一三个耦合问题，复杂schema下可靠性不足
summary.importance: 针对Text-to-SQL全流程痛点提出系统性优化方案，属于任务专属的方法与工程系统创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出SIRIUS-SQL全流程pipeline：用困难平滑RL训练32B专用模型生成多样化可执行SQL候选，搭配通用LLM补全能力缺口；基于执行结果生命周期分类做定向修复，再进行多维度候选筛选
summary.experiments: 基于32B专用模型与通用LLM组合实现，未披露完整基线对比与量化提升数据
summary.authors_note: 腾讯TEG、北京大学联合团队，无公开知名作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: Existing multi-candidate Text-to-SQL pipelines suffer from three coupled flaws: redundant candidates from single generators, one-size-fits-all error correction, and single-dimensional candidate selection, leading to low reliability on complex schemas
summary_en.importance: Presents a systematic end-to-end optimization for Text-to-SQL, a task-specific methodological and engineering innovation
summary_en.technical_approach: SIRIUS-SQL uses a difficulty-smoothing RL recipe to train a 32B specialist model for diverse executable SQL generation, paired with a generalist LLM to fill capability gaps; execution outcomes are classified into lifecycle stages for targeted repair, followed by multi-dimensional candidate selection
summary_en.experiments: Built on a 32B specialist and generalist LLM combination, full baseline comparison and quantitative improvement results are not disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from TEG, Tencent Inc. and Peking University, no publicly known prominent authors

recommendation.zh: Text-to-SQL任务的工程化优化方案，困难平滑RL训练recipe可做后训练参考，基座预训练无需深入
recommendation.en: Engineering optimization for Text-to-SQL, the difficulty-smoothing RL training recipe can be referenced for post-training, no deep dive needed for base pretraining

paper.title: Policy and World Modeling Co-Training for Language Agents
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model (LLM) agents by teaching them which actions lead to high rewards, but provides little supervision on what those actions do to the environment. World modeling (WM) can fill this gap, yet existing approaches often require separate simulators, extra training stages, or additional inference-time computation. We observe that on-policy RL rollouts already contain the needed signal: each transition pairs an action with its resulting next observa

summary.core_problem: 现有语言智能体的RL训练仅优化动作的奖励最大化，不学习动作对环境的实际影响，导致长周期任务中鲁棒性差；而已有世界建模方法需要额外模拟器、独立训练阶段或推理时额外计算，显著增加了训练与部署成本。
summary.importance: 证明了同策略RL滚动采样的轨迹中天然包含世界建模的监督信号，无需额外数据或独立模块即可在RL训练过程中同时学习世界建模能力，为智能体后训练的多目标联合优化提供了低成本方案，也为后续将世界建模目标融入基座预训练提供了可行思路。
summary.technical_approach: 提出PaW（策略与世界建模联合训练）框架，在同一次同策略RL训练过程中复用采样得到的轨迹，在原有RL损失基础上增加辅助的下一个观测预测损失，通过因果注意力机制保证辅助损失不会影响动作logits的计算，推理时与普通策略模型完全一致，无额外开销。为提升辅助监督的有效性与训练稳定性，引入三项设计：基于动作熵的世界建模数据筛选、针对带噪观测的裁剪MAE损失、奖励自适应的损失权重平衡。该框架是首个在单一RL训练流程中联合优化策略与世界建模的方案，无需额外模型、独立训练阶段或推理时计算开销。
summary.experiments: 在三类智能体任务上完成验证：交互式决策（ALFWorld、WebShop）、搜索增强QA，在不同模型规模和RL算法（包括GRPO、GIGPO）上均稳定超过强RL基线，新增训练开销可忽略。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第1节的核心观察（同策略RL轨迹自带世界建模监督信号）、第3节的三项稳定性核心设计、第4节的跨任务跨算法性能结果。消融实验细节可快速浏览。预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard RL training for language agents only optimizes actions for reward maximization without learning action consequences, leading to brittleness in long-horizon tasks. Existing world modeling (WM) methods for agents require separate simulators, extra training stages, or additional inference-time computation, incurring unnecessary overhead.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that on-policy RL rollouts natively contain world modeling supervision signals, enabling joint policy and WM learning without extra data or modules. Offers a low-cost multi-objective optimization scheme for agent post-training, and provides a reference for integrating world modeling objectives into base pretraining pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes PaW, a policy and world modeling co-training framework that reuses on-policy RL rollouts to add an auxiliary next-observation prediction loss alongside the standard RL objective, updating the same set of model parameters. Causal attention ensures the auxiliary WM loss does not interfere with action logit computation, so inference remains identical to standard policy models with no extra overhead. Three stabilizer designs are included: action-entropy-based WM data selection, clipped MAE loss for noisy observations, and reward-adaptive loss weight balancing. PaW is the first scheme to jointly optimize policy and world modeling within a single RL training pipeline, requiring no separate models, extra training stages, or inference-time computation.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on three agent task categories: interactive decision-making (ALFWorld, WebShop) and search-augmented QA. Consistent improvements over strong RL baselines are observed across multiple model sizes and RL algorithms (including GRPO and GIGPO), with negligible additional training overhead.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1 for the core insight of native WM supervision in RL rollouts, Section 3 for the three key stability designs, and Section 4 for cross-task cross-algorithm performance results. Ablation details can be skimmed. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得从 signal design 角度看，不是 agent 套壳；若你关心 RL 对 pretrain 的反哺，重点读 auxiliary WM loss 和 reward-adaptive balancing，看看能否迁到 continual pretrain。
recommendation.en: Worth reading for signal design rather than agent hype; if you care about RL feeding back into pretraining, focus on the auxiliary WM loss and reward-adaptive balancing.

paper.title: Distilling LLM Feedback for Lean Theorem Proving
paper.abstract: Post-training for reasoning models typically combines supervised fine-tuning with reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards, most commonly with GRPO. However, this algorithm suffers from sparse rewards, limited exploration, and mode collapse. Building upon recent works on self-distillation, we propose Feedback Distillation, a training method where the model is trained to match, at the token level, its own distribution conditioned on privileged feedback produced by a language model. Feedback

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作针对的是可验证推理任务里常见的 SFT+GRPO 路线的几个老问题：奖励稀疏、探索不足、容易模式坍缩，以及 trajectory-level reward 带来的弱 credit assignment。作者关心的不是再做一个更复杂的 RL 变体，而是能否用一种 on-policy、token-level 的训练方式，把“带反馈的搜索过程”蒸馏回模型参数里，从而在 formal theorem proving 这类大搜索空间任务上保留更多策略熵和解题多样性。
summary.importance: 它属于 post-train，但对基座研究也有启发，尤其是在“RL 是否真的带来新能力”以及“如何把外部反馈转成更密集训练信号”这两个问题上。论文给出的答案是：与其只靠 verifier 的成败信号做 trajectory-level 优化，不如让模型在自己采样的轨迹上，去匹配一个看过尝试结果和反馈后的 teacher 分布。这样既保留 on-policy 特性，又把监督细化到 token 级。对预训练研究者，这个思路和 self-distillation、latent reasoning、test-time feedback internalization 有明显接口；它提示一种更一般的方向：把昂贵的外部推理过程、反馈过程、甚至 judge 过程，蒸馏成模型内部条件分布，而不是只把最终 reward 当标量回传。
summary.technical_approach: 方法名叫 Feedback Distillation。训练时维护 student 和 teacher 两个同架构模型，初始都来自同一个预训练 LM。对一个问题 x，先由 student 采样一个尝试 y。然后构造 teacher 的条件输入：它不仅看到 x，还看到针对 y 的文本反馈 F(y)。这个反馈可以来自冻结的同模型副本，也可以来自更强的外部 LLM；在 theorem proving 场景里，反馈会结合模型尝试和 verifier 输出，指出失败原因、可用 lemma、策略修正等信息。接着，student 在自己采样出的轨迹上，最小化 teacher 与 student 的逐 token KL。因为 teacher 分布对 student 参数不反传，这个目标在梯度上等价于 teacher 分布对 student 的 token-level cross-entropy。作者采用 EMA 更新 teacher 权重，每 5 个梯度步做一次 μ ← αμ + (1-α)θ，这一点对稳定性很关键。为降低计算量，KL 只在 teacher 概率最高的 top-K token 上近似，实验里 K=25。和 GRPO 相比，这个方法有几个实质差异：第一，它不依赖多样本间 reward ranking，而是直接学习“如果看到了反馈，下一步更该怎么写”；第二，它在所有失败轨迹上也有学习信号，不会因为 reward 全零而完全学不到；第三，它更像一种 on-policy knowledge transfer，把 test-time feedback 变成 train-time teacher condition。作者也讨论了它与纯 self-feedback、外部强模型反馈、以及后续再接 GRPO 的关系，结论是二者互补而不是替代。
summary.experiments: 实验平台是 Lean 4 theorem proving，数据集是 LeanWorkbook。核心结果有两层。第一层是单独训练效果：Feedback Distillation 比 GRPO 保持更高的 policy entropy，pass@k 随 k 增长更好，说明它学到的不是单一路径上的 reward hacking，而是更丰富的证明轨迹分布。第二层是与 GRPO 结合后的效果：在 LeanWorkbook test split 上，Qwen3.5-9B 用 GRPO alone 的 pass@1 是 59%，而先做 Feedback Distillation 再接 GRPO 可以到 75%。这个提升幅度很大，说明蒸馏阶段提供的不是简单 warm start，而是更好的探索起点和更密的局部学习信号。论文还分析了不同反馈来源的差异，以及 EMA 系数对训练稳定性的影响。作者明确指出 α 对性能和稳定性都很敏感，这意味着方法虽然有效，但 recipe 还没有“随便训都行”那么稳。另一个值得注意的观察是，Feedback Distillation 在多样性指标上优于 GRPO，这与近期一些关于 GRPO 倾向于收缩到已有高奖模式的结论是一致的。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议先看 Introduction，把作者为什么不满足于 SFT+GRPO 讲得很清楚。然后直接看方法部分的 loss 定义，重点理解 teacher 看到的 privileged feedback 是什么、student 在什么轨迹上学、以及为什么这是 token-level credit assignment。实验部分优先看性能主表和 policy entropy / pass@k 的分析图，这两处最能体现它和 GRPO 的差异。再看 Section 5 里关于 feedback source 和 EMA 稳定性的讨论，能帮助判断方法的可迁移性与工程难点。预计 30 分钟左右可以完成一次有效泛读；如果你关心 RL for reasoning 或 verifier-based training，值得细看 appendix 里的 loss 推导和训练细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a familiar weakness of the standard SFT+GRPO recipe for verifiable reasoning tasks: sparse rewards, weak exploration, mode collapse, and poor credit assignment from trajectory-level rewards. Instead of proposing yet another RL variant, it asks whether one can train the model on-policy with token-level supervision by distilling a feedback-conditioned policy back into the model. The intended benefit is better exploration and higher trajectory diversity in formal theorem proving, where success depends on searching large libraries and not just exploiting a narrow set of already-known proof patterns.
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it speaks to two broader questions. First, does RL actually create new reasoning behavior, or mostly amplify modes that already exist? Second, how can external feedback be converted into a denser and more learnable training signal? The paper's answer is to replace pure reward optimization with a self-distillation style objective: let the model imitate a version of itself, or a stronger model, that has access to privileged textual feedback about its own attempt. That makes the signal token-level, on-policy, and potentially more informative than a scalar verifier reward. For pretraining-oriented readers, the interesting part is the interface to self-distillation, internalizing test-time feedback, and learning richer conditional distributions rather than only optimizing end rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method, Feedback Distillation, maintains a student and a teacher with the same architecture, both initialized from the same pretrained LM. For a problem x, the student first samples an attempted proof y. The teacher is then conditioned not only on x but also on textual feedback F(y), which is generated from the attempt and, in this setting, can incorporate verifier output. The feedback may come from a frozen copy of the same model or from a stronger external LLM. Training minimizes the per-token KL divergence between the teacher and student distributions along trajectories sampled from the student. Since gradients do not flow through the teacher distribution, this is equivalent in practice to token-level cross-entropy from the teacher to the student on the student's own rollouts. The teacher weights are updated by EMA every five gradient steps, using μ ← αμ + (1-α)θ, and the paper emphasizes that α is critical for stability. To reduce cost, the KL is approximated using only the teacher's top-K tokens, with K=25 in the reported experiments. Compared with GRPO, the method differs in three important ways. It does not rely on ranking multiple sampled trajectories by reward. It provides learning signal even when all sampled attempts fail. And it can be viewed as on-policy knowledge transfer: the model learns what it would do if it had access to richer feedback at generation time, then absorbs that behavior into its parameters.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on Lean 4 theorem proving using LeanWorkbook. The main empirical result is twofold. First, Feedback Distillation alone maintains higher policy entropy than GRPO and shows better pass@k scaling, indicating a broader and more diverse proof distribution rather than collapse onto a small set of high-reward modes. Second, the method combines well with GRPO instead of replacing it. On the LeanWorkbook test split, Qwen3.5-9B reaches 59% pass@1 with GRPO alone, while Feedback Distillation followed by GRPO reaches 75% pass@1. That is a large gain, and it suggests the distillation stage is doing more than providing a mild warm start. It appears to improve exploration and local credit assignment before reward optimization takes over. The paper also studies different feedback sources and training stability. A notable practical point is that the EMA coefficient α strongly affects both performance and stability, so the method is promising but not yet a plug-and-play recipe. The diversity findings also align with recent critiques that GRPO often sharpens pre-existing successful modes rather than expanding the search distribution.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction. It gives a clear motivation for moving beyond the usual SFT+GRPO pipeline. Then read the loss definition carefully: what privileged feedback the teacher sees, why the student learns on its own sampled trajectories, and how this yields token-level credit assignment. In the experiments, prioritize the main performance table and the analyses of policy entropy and pass@k. Those are the clearest evidence for the claimed advantage over GRPO. After that, read the section on feedback sources and EMA stability, since that is where the practical limitations and transfer questions show up. A solid skim takes about 30 minutes. If you work on RL for reasoning or verifier-based training, the appendix derivations and implementation details are worth the extra time.

recommendation.zh: 核心 insight：feedback distillation 比纯 GRPO 保持更高策略多样性，两者组合优于单独使用。对 reasoning 模型 post-training recipe 设计有直接参考，看 §3 方法和 §4 pass@k scaling 曲线。
recommendation.en: Key insight: feedback distillation preserves higher policy diversity than GRPO alone, and combining both is better. Directly relevant for reasoning model post-training recipe design—read §3 method and §4 pass@k scaling curves.

paper.title: EchoRL: Reinforcement Learning via Rollout Echoing
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards is an effective route for post-training to strengthen the reasoning capability of large language models. However, as training proceeds, the learning signal can collapse thus makes the training gain become marginal and ineffective. Specifically, a growing fraction of prompts' rollouts become advantage-degenerated: all the self-generated rollouts show verified-success, making the standard deviation over their rewards be zero; accordingly each rollout'

summary.core_problem: 在基于可验证奖励的 RL（RLVR）训练中，随着模型推理能力提升，越来越多 prompt 的所有 rollout 都能通过验证（奖励全为 1），导致组内奖励标准差为零，GRPO 的优势函数（advantage）退化为零，梯度消失——这一现象被称为优势退化（advantage degeneration）。标准 GRPO 因此浪费了大量已生成的 rollout，且丢弃了其中蕴含的高质量推理路径学习信号（例如用更巧妙方法解题的轨迹）。
summary.importance: 指出了 GRPO 范式在 RLVR 训练后期的一个根本性局限：相对优势依赖组内奖励方差，而可验证奖励天然是二元的（0/1），当模型能力足够强时必然出现优势退化。这一问题的提出本身就对 RL 后训练的算法设计有重要启发。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 EchoRL，核心思想是从优势退化的 rollout 中挖掘可用学习信号。即使所有 rollout 奖励相同（均为 1），不同推理路径的质量也有差异——例如有的用暴力代数、有的用对数导数技巧。EchoRL 的关键技术包括：(1) 引入超越奖励的额外信号（如推理路径的熵、步骤效率、方法新颖性）来构建细粒度优势；(2) 设计 rollout echoing 机制，将高质量推理路径的信号回传（echo）以强化学习。论文尚未完整展示全部技术细节（正文仅给出 introduction 和部分 motivation），但核心方向是打破「奖励唯一决定优势」的束缚。
summary.experiments: 论文主体仅给出了 motivation 和问题定义，完整实验部分未在当前文本中呈现。从介绍看，实验基于 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 模型在数学推理任务上进行。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 1 节中对优势退化现象的刻画和图 1 的示意（特别是右半部分展示的同一奖励下不同推理路径的质量差异）。由于正文仅给出 introduction 和部分 preliminaries，建议关注后续完整版本中的方法章节和实验验证。核心创新点在于对「奖励之外的学习信号」的定义和利用方式。
summary.authors_note: 未在正文中明确标注机构。

summary_en.core_problem: In RL with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR), as model reasoning capability improves, all rollouts for an increasing number of prompts pass verification (all rewards = 1), causing the within-group reward standard deviation to collapse to zero. The GRPO advantage function degenerates to zero and gradients vanish—a phenomenon termed advantage degeneration. Standard GRPO thus wastes大量 generated rollouts and discards the learning signals embedded in high-quality reasoning paths (e.g., trajectories using more elegant problem-solving methods).
summary_en.importance: Identifies a fundamental limitation of the GRPO paradigm in late-stage RLVR training: relative advantage depends on within-group reward variance, but verifiable rewards are inherently binary (0/1), so advantage degeneration is inevitable once model capability is sufficiently strong. The problem formulation itself is an important contribution to RL post-training algorithm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: EchoRL's core idea is to mine usable learning signals from advantage-degenerated rollouts. Even when all rollouts share the same reward (= 1), different reasoning paths vary in quality—some use brute-force algebra while others employ the log-derivative trick. Key techniques include: (1) introducing additional signals beyond reward (such as reasoning path entropy, step efficiency, or method novelty) to construct fine-grained advantages; (2) a rollout echoing mechanism that echoes signals from high-quality reasoning paths back to reinforce learning. The full technical details are not yet complete in the current text (only introduction and partial motivation are provided), but the core direction is breaking the constraint that 'reward alone determines advantage'.
summary_en.experiments: The paper body only provides motivation and problem definition; the full experimental section is not present in the current text. Based on the introduction, experiments are conducted on math reasoning tasks using the Qwen2.5-Math-7B model.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 1's characterization of advantage degeneration and Figure 1's illustration (especially the right panel showing quality differences among reasoning paths with identical rewards). Since only the introduction and partial preliminaries are available, look for the methodology and experimental validation in the complete version. The core innovation lies in how learning signals beyond reward are defined and utilized.
summary_en.authors_note: Institution not explicitly stated in the main text.

recommendation.zh: RLVR梯度消失是当前推理增强后训练的普遍痛点，可重点看方法中黄金轨迹熵模式分析的具体设计
recommendation.en: Gradient vanishing in RLVR is a common pain point in reasoning-enhanced post-training; focus on the specific design of entropy pattern analysis for golden trajectories in the method section

paper.title: Task-Focused Memorization for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents to build coherent experience, accumulate world knowledge, and achieve continual learning. However, constructing effective memory goes beyond memory module design and basic requirements such as accuracy and fidelity; the key challenge lies in determining what to memorize. Multimodal agents, such as embodied agents, continuously perceive, reason, and act in real or virtual environments, receiving an unbounded stream of multimodal observations. Fr

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是多模态智能体长期记忆中的“选择性写入”问题：面对连续的视频、空间、声音和交互信息，智能体不应把记忆生成当作固定摘要，而要学会根据未来任务效用决定什么内容值得存。现有多模态记忆系统多关注存储、检索、整合和纠错，记忆内容生成仍主要依赖 prompt 或模板化微调，缺少对“写什么”的显式优化。
summary.importance: 对基座和后训练研究的价值在于，它把长期记忆从外部工程模块推进到可学习策略，并把记忆质量与任务反馈连接起来。贡献不在于提出新的预训练目标，而在于给出了一个可训练的 memory-writing interface：先学习通用记忆规范，再用环境任务反馈调整记忆选择。这对持续学习、长上下文压缩、多模态 agent 的在线适配都有参考意义。尤其值得注意的是，论文没有直接把所有历史压进上下文，而是学习一个低成本写入策略，符合真实部署中上下文、延迟和更新成本受限的条件。
summary.technical_approach: TaskMem 将记忆生成建模为 memorization policy。输入是流式多模态观测和近期记忆历史，输出是当前应写入长期记忆的内容。训练分两阶段。第一阶段学习“如何记忆”，通过多目标强化学习优化基础记忆质量，包括正确性、非冗余性和格式合规性。这一阶段更接近记忆写入的通用能力对齐，目标是避免 hallucination、重复写入和不可检索格式。第二阶段学习“记什么”，在真实或模拟环境中根据任务反馈进行在线优化。这里的难点是反馈稀疏、在线更新可能遗忘第一阶段能力、同时不能影响 serving。论文采用只含 2048 个参数的轻量 adapter 进行更新，并用 reward model 将稀疏任务级信号转成更密的 pairwise preference 数据。这个设计的取舍比较清楚：不动大模型主体，降低在线更新风险；不用固定摘要模板，而让策略根据任务分布改变写入偏好；不用直接依赖单次任务准确率，而通过偏好增强缓解 sparse reward。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B。作者将 VideoMME、EgoLife、EgoTempo 三个视频问答 benchmark 重构为顺序任务流：按问题类型分组，每组作为一个任务环境；视频依次输入，模型先为每个视频生成 episodic memory；问题在视频处理后才出现；回答时只能使用生成的 memory，不能访问原视频。这个设置较好地隔离了记忆写入质量，而不是测试原始视觉理解能力。结果显示，第一阶段 memory learning 相对 base model 已能提升 VQA accuracy；第二阶段在线任务对齐继续带来增益。总体相对 base model 分别在 VideoMME、EgoLife、EgoTempo 上提升 6.3%、7.0%、5.3%。从提供内容看，关键消融是 Phase One 与 Phase Two 的分离：Phase One 主要提升记忆的基础可用性，Phase Two 则让记忆内容贴合当前任务环境。
summary.reading_guide: 精读应先看方法部分中 policy formulation 和两阶段 RL objective，重点判断 reward 是否真正约束了 memory utility，而不是只奖励格式化摘要。其次看 Phase Two 的 reward model 和 pairwise preference augmentation，这是论文最有工程含义的部分：它决定了稀疏任务反馈如何变成可学习信号。实验部分建议重点看三类内容：一是 sequential VQA protocol，确认它是否避免了原视频泄漏；二是 Phase One/Phase Two 的消融，区分通用记忆质量与任务聚焦记忆的贡献；三是不同问题类型下的收益差异，这能反映策略是否真的学到了任务条件化写入。若时间有限，优先读 introduction、method 的两阶段训练、online adaptation 细节和主结果表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets selective memory writing for multimodal agents. In a continuous stream of visual, spatial, auditory, and interaction signals, an agent should not treat memory generation as generic summarization. It needs to decide which observations are worth storing because they are useful for future tasks. Existing multimodal memory systems mostly focus on storage, retrieval, consolidation, and correction, while the memory content itself is usually produced by prompting or template-based post-training.
summary_en.importance: The main value is the formulation of memory writing as a learnable policy connected to task feedback. This is not a pretraining objective paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface: long-term memory becomes an adaptive policy rather than a passive context buffer. The two-stage design is also useful for continual learning systems: first learn general memory quality constraints, then adapt the write policy to the task distribution of the deployment environment. The low-parameter online adapter is an important practical choice because full-model updates would be too expensive and could interfere with serving.
summary_en.technical_approach: TaskMem defines a memorization policy that takes streaming multimodal inputs and recent memory history, then decides what should be written into long-term memory. Training has two phases. Phase One learns how to write memory by optimizing basic quality requirements, including correctness, non-redundancy, and format compliance, formulated as a multi-objective RL problem. Phase Two learns what to write in an online environment. This stage has sparse feedback, risk of forgetting the Phase One behavior, and serving-time compute constraints. The paper addresses these issues by updating a lightweight adapter with only 2,048 parameters on top of the base MLLM, and by using a reward model to convert sparse task-level signals into denser augmented pairwise preference data. The distinction from heuristic memory generation is clear: the policy is optimized for future task utility, not just local summarization quality.
summary_en.experiments: The implementation uses Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B. The evaluation recasts VideoMME, EgoLife, and EgoTempo into sequential task streams. Video-question pairs are grouped by question type, each group is treated as an environment, and videos are processed sequentially. The agent must generate episodic memory before seeing the question. At answer time, it can only use the generated memory and cannot access the original video. This protocol directly measures memory usefulness. Phase One alone improves VQA accuracy over the base model, and Phase Two further aligns memory with the task environment. Overall gains over the base model are 6.3%, 7.0%, and 5.3% on the three benchmarks respectively.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the policy formulation and the two-stage RL setup carefully. The most useful part is how the paper separates generic memory quality from task-focused memory selection. The Phase Two reward model and pairwise preference augmentation deserve close attention because they explain how sparse online feedback is turned into trainable supervision. In the experiments, focus on the sequential VQA protocol, the Phase One versus Phase Two ablations, and results broken down by task or question type if available. A focused read should cover the introduction, method, online adaptation details, and main result tables.

recommendation.zh: 读方法设定即可：把 memory 写入当策略学习，比又加一个向量库更接近可训练 agent。
recommendation.en: Skim the formulation: treating memory writes as a learned policy is more useful than another vector-store wrapper.

paper.title: Learning Agent-Compatible Context Management for Long-Horizon Tasks
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly face long-horizon tasks such as web search and deep research in real-world applications, where accumulated context can cause long-context degradation and reasoning failures. Prior work mitigates this through context management with agent-side context control or fixed strategies such as summarization, which require training the agent itself for adaptation - making it impractical for closed-source agents and ignoring that different agents may require different strategies. W

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决长程 Agent 中的上下文管理问题：轨迹、工具结果和中间推理不断累积后，长上下文退化会导致约束遗忘、过早放弃和重复探索。传统做法多让 Agent 自己总结或调用上下文工具，但这要求 Agent 具备相应协议能力，也不适合闭源模型。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，它把“长上下文可用性”从窗口长度问题转成了 Agent 兼容的上下文分布问题。同样的原始轨迹，对不同能力模型未必都是有益输入；弱模型可能需要更强压缩来降低推理负担，强模型则能保留更多原始证据以维持 fidelity。这个观察对长上下文预训练和 Agent 后训练都有意义：训练目标不能只奖励装入更多 token，还要奖励模型在被裁剪、压缩、重排后的上下文上稳定执行。
summary.technical_approach: AdaCoM 使用一个外部 context manager 管理上下文，任务 Agent 保持冻结。基础流程是 ReAct Agent 在第 t 轮基于 managed context 生成动作，环境返回 observation 后，manager 接收当前上下文并输出结构化修改动作，得到下一轮 managed context。方法有两个关键设计。第一是架构解耦：manager 可以是较小 LLM，不需要训练或修改闭源 Agent。第二是操作灵活：不预设只做摘要，而是允许 manager 对上下文任意部分进行编辑、保留、压缩或重组。manager 通过端到端强化学习训练，奖励来自最终任务表现，因此学到的是某个冻结 Agent 真正能用好的上下文形态，而不是人工规定的摘要格式。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 web search 和 deep research 类型长程任务，并在多种 Agent 上测试。论文报告 AdaCoM 能明显改善任务表现，主要通过减少约束遗忘、过早放弃和冗余探索来取得收益。分析部分提出 Fidelity–Reliability Trade-off：以 vanilla ReAct 表现衡量 Agent 能力时，强 Agent 的 manager 倾向保留更多原始轨迹以减少信息损失；弱 Agent 的 manager 更倾向激进压缩，以降低长上下文干扰并提高执行可靠性。迁移实验显示，训练好的 manager 更容易在能力相近的 Agent 之间迁移，而跨能力层级迁移效果较弱。给定内容未提供具体提升数字，精读时需要回到主实验表格核对各 benchmark 和各 Agent 的增益幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看 AdaCoM 方法部分，特别是 managed context 的递推定义、manager 的结构化修改动作空间和强化学习训练流程。实验部分优先看三个信息：不同 Agent 上 AdaCoM 相对 vanilla ReAct 和固定摘要策略的提升；manager 学到的上下文长度和压缩比例；跨 Agent 迁移矩阵。最值得带走的是 Fidelity–Reliability Trade-off，因为它解释了为什么单一摘要策略很难适配所有模型，也解释了为什么长上下文能力评估应同时看信息保真和推理稳定性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses context management for long-horizon LLM agents. As actions, observations, tool outputs, and intermediate reasoning accumulate, the growing context can hurt later decisions. Existing approaches often ask the agent itself to summarize or manage context, which is fragile for frozen or closed-source agents and assumes a single management strategy works across models.
summary_en.importance: The useful insight is that long-context performance is not only about context-window size. It is also about whether the presented context distribution is compatible with a particular agent. Stronger agents can often use more raw trajectory evidence, while weaker agents may need more aggressive compression to avoid distraction and instruction drift. This has implications for long-context pretraining and agent post-training: models should be trained not just to accept many tokens, but to operate reliably under edited, compressed, and reorganized contexts.
