summary_en.technical_approach: AdaCoM introduces an external context manager while keeping the task agent frozen. In a ReAct-style workflow, the agent acts on a managed context; after the environment returns an observation, the manager receives the updated context and emits a structured modification action; applying this action produces the next managed context. The design has two important choices. First, context management is architecturally decoupled from the task agent, so it can be used with closed-source or otherwise untrainable agents. Second, the manager is not restricted to a fixed summarization operation. It can flexibly edit, retain, compress, or reorganize different parts of the trajectory. The manager is trained with end-to-end reinforcement learning using task success signals, so the learned policy is optimized for what the frozen agent can actually use.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers long-horizon web search and deep research tasks across multiple agents. AdaCoM is reported to improve performance by reducing constraint forgetting, premature abandonment, and redundant exploration. The analysis identifies a Fidelity–Reliability trade-off: managers paired with stronger agents preserve more raw trajectory content to maintain evidence fidelity, while managers paired with weaker agents compress more aggressively to keep reasoning reliable. Transfer experiments show that a trained manager transfers best between agents of similar capability, and less reliably across different capability tiers. The provided text does not include exact performance numbers, so the main tables should be checked for benchmark-level gains and ablations.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the AdaCoM workflow, the managed-context recurrence, the action space for structured context modification, and the reinforcement learning setup. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against vanilla ReAct and fixed summarization, the learned context-length or compression behavior, and the transfer matrix across agents. The most relevant part for foundation-model researchers is the Fidelity–Reliability trade-off, because it connects long-context degradation to model capability and suggests why a single context-management heuristic is unlikely to fit all agents.

recommendation.zh: 重点看第5节的Fidelity-Reliability Trade-off实验结论，对长上下文Agent的后训练与策略设计有实际参考价值
recommendation.en: Focus on the Fidelity-Reliability Trade-off results in Section 5, which has practical reference value for post-training and strategy design of long-context agents

institutions: Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications

paper.title: GUI-C$^2$: Coarse-to-Fine GUI Grounding via Difficulty-Aware Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Existing agentic reinforcement learning methods for GUI grounding have limitations at two levels. At the data level, current approaches typically treat all training samples equally, although their training value to the baseline model varies with difficulty. Overlooking this can greatly reduce training efficiency or even cause collapse. At the strategy level, existing frameworks struggle to balance the trade-off between cropping larger regions for sufficient context and smaller ones for reduced r

summary.core_problem: 提升 GUI grounding agent 在屏幕元素定位中的训练效率和 coarse-to-fine 区域选择能力。
summary.importance: 贡献是 GUI agent 训练方法：用样本难度挖掘和加权 RL 处理训练样本价值不均的问题，并设计粗到细的区域定位策略。它属于通用 GUI agent 的一个子问题，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 GUI-D 数据挖掘和难度评分流程，通过测试基线模型识别值得训练的样本并分配 difficulty score；提出 GUI-C2，让 agent 先选择较大上下文区域，再逐步缩小到目标区域，以平衡上下文充分性和冗余。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据集名称、baseline 和提升幅度。可确认实验关注小参数模型在 GUI grounding 中的训练稳定性、推理时间和定位表现。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 The Hong Kong Polytechnic University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper improves GUI grounding agents by addressing sample difficulty and coarse-to-fine region selection.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a training and policy design for GUI agents: difficulty-aware sample mining and weighted reinforcement learning, plus a coarse-to-fine grounding strategy. It is relevant to GUI agents but only indirectly connected to foundation pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: GUI-D scores and mines training-worthy examples by probing a baseline model and assigning difficulty weights. GUI-C2 then uses an area-guided coarse-to-fine strategy, first retaining sufficient context and then narrowing the crop to reduce redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model size, dataset names, baselines, or exact gains. The visible evaluation focuses on GUI grounding stability, inference cost, and localization quality, especially for small models.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.

recommendation.zh: 可作 GUI agent 训练材料备查；重点看 difficulty scoring，RL 框架本身不像通用后训练信号。
recommendation.en: Keep it as GUI-agent training reference; read the difficulty scoring idea, while the RL setup itself does not look like a general post-training signal.

paper.title: iVGR: Internalizing Visually Grounded Reasoning for MLLMs with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: While visually grounded Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has emerged as a promising paradigm to enhance fine-grained perception in multimodal large language models (MLLMs), its efficacy during the inference phase remains underexplored. In this work, we empirically find that mandating explicit object boxes in visually grounded CoT during inference often degrades performance compared to standard textual CoT, which reasons without explicit visual grounding. We hypothesize that the visual localization capabil

summary.core_problem: iVGR 研究的是多模态大模型中的视觉落地推理是否应该在推理期显式输出框或调用裁剪工具。论文的核心发现是：显式 grounding 能训练出定位能力，但推理期强制输出框往往会干扰答案生成；更好的方式可能是把定位能力内化到文本 CoT 中。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对 post-train 和 multimodal pretrain/post-train 接口有启发。它指出视觉 grounding 不一定要以显式坐标形式出现在最终推理轨迹里。坐标、裁剪、框监督可以作为训练信号，用来塑造模型的注意和局部感知能力；但推理期目标仍应围绕答案质量和稳定性。这个结论对构造 MLLM 的 RL 训练信号很有用：辅助能力可以通过奖励和一致性约束迁移到主轨迹，而不是让模型在部署时同时承担辅助任务和主任务。
summary.technical_approach: iVGR 采用双流强化学习训练。对同一个图文问题，策略模型生成两类 rollout：grounded stream 输出带 bounding box 的视觉落地 CoT，textual stream 输出普通文本 CoT。训练中先从 grounded stream 中筛选高质量轨迹，再用 consistency reward 约束 textual stream，使文本 CoT 与高质量 grounded 推理保持一致。这样模型在训练期利用显式定位信号学习“看哪里”，但在测试期可以不输出坐标，减少格式负担和错误框带来的噪声。论文还保留了与 crop tool 的兼容性：在细粒度 VQA 中，模型仍可在需要时调用裁剪流程，但默认推理不被强制绑定到显式框输出。
summary.experiments: 论文先做了一个诊断实验：对 DeepEyes 和 TreeVGR 这类已训练过视觉落地 CoT 的模型，只改变推理 prompt，不重新训练，比较 grounded CoT 与普通 textual CoT。结果显示，grounded CoT 虽然优于基础 Qwen2.5-VL-7B，但 textual CoT 在多数 VQA benchmark 上更好。进一步的 HR8K IoU 分组分析显示：对 crop-based 方法，只有定位质量较高时 grounded CoT 才占优；定位差时，错误裁剪会引入视觉噪声。对 box-based 方法，显式框输出在各个 IoU 区间都不如 textual CoT，说明坐标生成本身可能抢占了推理预算。随后，iVGR 在 Qwen2.5-VL 和 Qwen3-VL 上训练，并在多个 VQA benchmark 上取得一致提升。可见内容没有给出完整分数表，具体涨幅应查看实验表和消融。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中关于 grounded CoT 与 textual CoT 的对照实验，以及 Figure 2 的 IoU-accuracy 分析，这是论文最有信息量的动机部分。方法部分重点看 dual-stream rollout、grounded trajectory 选择标准、consistency reward 的定义。实验部分建议看三组消融：没有 consistency reward、只用 grounded stream、只用 textual stream。若关注 MLLM RL 训练，还应看 reward 是否依赖答案正确性、定位质量、格式约束，以及这些奖励之间是否存在冲突。

summary_en.core_problem: iVGR asks whether multimodal models should explicitly output boxes or use crop tools during inference for visually grounded reasoning. The main observation is that explicit grounding can be useful as a training signal, but forcing the model to emit boxes at inference often interferes with answer prediction. The paper argues that localization ability should be internalized into textual chain-of-thought.
summary_en.importance: The paper is useful for understanding the interface between multimodal post-training and inference behavior. It separates auxiliary supervision from the final reasoning format. Box prediction, cropping, and grounding can teach the model where to look, but the deployed reasoning trace does not need to expose these intermediate coordinates. This is a practical lesson for RL training of MLLMs: auxiliary capabilities can be transferred into the main textual trajectory through rewards and consistency constraints, instead of making the model solve the auxiliary task and the answer task at the same time during inference.
summary_en.technical_approach: iVGR uses a dual-stream reinforcement learning setup. For each image-question pair, the policy model produces two types of rollouts: a grounded stream with explicit bounding boxes in the reasoning trace, and a textual stream with ordinary natural-language reasoning. High-quality grounded trajectories are selected and used as references for a consistency reward. This reward encourages the textual stream to align with grounded reasoning without requiring explicit coordinates at test time. The model therefore learns localization behavior during training, but avoids coordinate-format burden and noisy localization errors during inference. The method also remains compatible with crop-tool workflows for fine-grained VQA when tool use is beneficial.
summary_en.experiments: The paper first presents a diagnostic study on existing grounded-reasoning models such as DeepEyes and TreeVGR. Without retraining, the authors change only the inference prompt and compare grounded CoT with textual CoT. Grounded CoT improves over the base Qwen2.5-VL-7B model, but textual CoT performs better on most VQA benchmarks. An IoU-based analysis on HR8K further explains the pattern. For crop-based reasoning, grounded CoT helps only when localization is accurate; poor crops introduce visual noise. For box-based reasoning, explicit box generation underperforms textual CoT across IoU groups, suggesting that coordinate prediction itself can distract from answer prediction. iVGR is then trained on Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL and reports consistent gains across multiple VQA benchmarks. The visible content does not include the full numeric tables, so exact improvements should be checked in the experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25–35 minutes. Start with the diagnostic comparison between grounded CoT and textual CoT in the introduction, then inspect the IoU-accuracy analysis around Figure 2. These parts carry the main insight. In the method section, focus on dual-stream rollout generation, the selection of high-quality grounded trajectories, and the definition of the consistency reward. In the experiments, look for ablations removing the consistency reward, using only grounded trajectories, or using only textual trajectories. For readers interested in MLLM RL, the key point is how answer rewards, localization rewards, and format constraints interact.

recommendation.zh: 这篇值得看的是那个负结果：显式 grounding 可能干扰 answer objective；先看主表和 ablation，若 setup 干净，会直接影响你设计 MLLM RL 信号。
recommendation.en: The useful part is the negative result: explicit grounding may interfere with answer prediction; check the main table and ablations first, because if the setup is clean it changes how you design RL signals for MLLMs.

paper.title: Meta-Cognitive Memory Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory-augmented LLM agents tackle complex long-horizon tasks by recursively summarizing interaction trajectories into compact memory. However, existing approaches typically train these memory policies using outcome-based reinforcement learning, failing to localize where intermediate memory quality degrades. As interactions unfold, ambiguous recursive summaries progressively discard task-relevant information and introduce semantic noise. This exacerbates belief deviation, obscuring the agent's e

summary.core_problem: 记忆增强LLM Agent使用基于最终结果的RL训练记忆策略，存在严重的credit assignment问题：无法定位中间记忆退化位置，不能显式抑制递归摘要中的噪声积累，导致信念偏差（belief deviation）随交互长度加剧。
summary.importance: 对pretrain-posttrain接口有间接启发。核心贡献是提出了一种自监督的中间监督信号（Belief Entropy），通过元认知探针估计模型对任务状态的内在不确定性，替代稀疏的最终结果信号。这一思路与预训练中设计密集自监督信号的理念有共通之处。
summary.technical_approach: 将长程推理建模为POMDP，其中隐藏任务状态需要agent根据信念状态（belief state）行动。递归摘要积累的语义噪声表现为摘要诱导信念的偏差。由于潜在任务状态不可观测，无法直接测量信念不确定性，因此采用元认知探针（受认知科学启发），通过锚定问题（anchor question）估计模型对当前记忆中任务状态的内在不确定性，产生Belief Entropy作为自监督中间信号。基于此提出MMPO（Meta-Cognitive Memory Policy Optimization），在中间记忆状态增加Belief Entropy奖励，补充稀疏的最终结果RL信号。
summary.experiments: 在多个长程Agent基准上进行了实验，证明MMPO有效提升了长程记忆Agent的性能，降低了信念不确定性，提高了长程推理稳定性。（注：全文中实验详细数字未在提供的内容中充分展开）
summary.reading_guide: 重点看Belief Entropy的定义和元认知探针的设计（Section 3），以及POMDP建模框架的推导。预计阅读时间40分钟。核心价值在于中间监督信号的设计思路，而非具体的Agent实验。
summary.authors_note: 未提供作者信息

summary_en.core_problem: Memory-augmented LLM agents trained with outcome-based RL suffer from severe credit assignment: they cannot localize intermediate memory degradation or explicitly suppress noise accumulation during recursive summarization, causing belief deviation to worsen as interactions extend.
summary_en.importance: Indirectly relevant to pretrain-posttrain interface design. The core contribution is a self-supervised intermediate supervision signal (Belief Entropy) that estimates the model's intrinsic uncertainty about task state via a metacognitive probe, offering a dense alternative to sparse final-outcome signals. This aligns with the broader goal of designing dense self-supervised signals in pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Long-horizon reasoning is modeled as a POMDP where hidden task states require agents to act on belief states. Semantic noise from recursive summarization manifests as deviation in the summary-induced belief. Since latent task states are unobservable, direct measurement of belief uncertainty is infeasible. The solution adopts a metacognitive probe inspired by cognitive science, using a dedicated anchor question to estimate the model's intrinsic uncertainty about the task state from current memory. This yields Belief Entropy as a self-supervised intermediate signal. MMPO augments outcome-based RL with Belief Entropy rewards at intermediate memory states, providing dense memory-specific supervision beyond sparse final outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: Extensive experiments on multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks demonstrate that MMPO improves long-horizon memory agent performance, reduces belief uncertainty, and enhances long-horizon reasoning stability. (Note: detailed experimental numbers were not fully provided in the available content)
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Belief Entropy definition and metacognitive probe design (Section 3), and the POMDP modeling framework. Reading time: ~40 minutes. The core value lies in the intermediate supervision signal design, not the specific agent experiments.
summary_en.authors_note: Author information not provided

recommendation.zh: 阿里提出的用 Belief Entropy 作为 dense reward 来优化 Agent 记忆的方法，思路很 clean，对解决长上下文/长周期任务中的 reward sparsity 问题有启发，值得看其 RL setup 和 reward 设计。
recommendation.en: Alibaba's method of using Belief Entropy as a dense reward to optimize Agent memory is conceptually clean. It offers inspiration for solving reward sparsity in long-context/long-horizon tasks; worth reading for its RL setup and reward design.

paper.title: De-attribute to Forget for LLM Unlearning
paper.abstract: The rapid development of large language models (LLMs) has raised concerns on the use of inappropriate data for training, which has led to a growing interest in LLM unlearning. Many existing LLM unlearning approaches rely on optimizing prediction loss(es), such as maximizing the loss on the forget set, but often face critical issues like over-forgetting and poor model utility. To address them, this paper novelly frames the optimization objective for LLM unlearning as one of zeroing out data attri

summary.core_problem: 现有基于预测损失优化的LLM遗忘方法（如通过梯度上升最大化遗忘集损失）普遍存在过度遗忘、保留集性能显著下降的问题，缺乏精准的遗忘优化目标。
summary.importance: 首次将数据归因与LLM遗忘两个研究方向结合，提供了区别于传统梯度上升的新优化视角，对预训练后的数据合规、版权移除等场景有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出DareU框架，主要面向微调后的任务特定LLM，将LLM遗忘的优化目标转化为将生成回复对遗忘数据所有者的归因分降为0；采用PPO强化学习算法，以转换后的归因分数作为奖励信号更新模型，在降低归因的同时保留模型原有能力；预训练模型的适配方案放在附录中。
summary.experiments: 对比现有主流遗忘基线，DareU在遗忘效果与保留集性能的平衡上表现更优；即使用轻量分类器作为归因的低成本近似计算方案，仍能达到有效效果。
summary.reading_guide: 重点看第3节对现有损失类遗忘方法缺陷的分析、第4节的问题定义与DareU框架设计，实验部分关注不同基线的对比结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing prediction loss-based LLM unlearning methods (such as maximizing loss on the forget set via gradient ascent) commonly suffer from over-forgetting and severe performance degradation on the retain set, lacking a precise optimization target for unlearning.
summary_en.importance: It connects data attribution and LLM unlearning research for the first time, provides a new optimization perspective alternative to traditional gradient ascent, and offers reference for post-pretraining scenarios including data compliance and copyright removal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed DareU framework, targeting fine-tuned task-specific LLMs, reframes LLM unlearning as reducing the attribution score of generated responses to forget set data owners to zero. It uses PPO reinforcement learning, with transformed attribution scores as reward signals to update the model, balancing unlearning effect and retention of original model utility. Adaptation for pre-trained models is discussed in the appendix.
summary_en.experiments: Compared with existing mainstream unlearning baselines, DareU achieves a better balance between unlearning quality and retain set performance. It remains effective even when a lightweight classifier is used as a low-cost approximation of attribution calculation.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for analysis of limitations of loss-based unlearning methods, Section 4 for problem formulation and DareU framework design, and baseline comparison results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 目标函数值得看；若 attribution proxy 不稳，结论会塌，重点读 reward 定义和消融。
recommendation.en: The objective is worth skimming; if the attribution proxy is brittle, the result collapses, so read the reward definition and ablations.

paper.title: Source-Grounded Semantic Reinforcement Learning for Low-Resource Target-Language Generation
paper.abstract: Low-resource target-language generation is often limited by scarce parallel data, while high-resource source-language monolingual data is abundant but difficult to use with standard supervised fine-tuning. We propose Source-Grounded Semantic Reinforcement Learning (SG-SRL), a resource-utilization framework that converts source-language monolingual data into cross-lingual semantic supervision for target-language generation. SG-SRL performs reference-free reinforcement learning (RL) on source-lang

summary.core_problem: 低资源目标语言生成缺少平行数据，如何利用高资源源语言单语数据形成可用训练信号而不依赖参考答案。
summary.importance: 把“语义对齐 reward + reference-free RL + 反 reward hacking 修复”串成可落地流程；对 RL 信号质量、verbosity hacking、以及小量并行数据做恢复的接口设计有借鉴意义。
summary.technical_approach: SG-SRL：在源语言单语数据上做 reference-free RL，用跨语义 reward model（以 cross-lingual reranker 实现）评估源输入与目标语言输出的语义相关性；观察到 verbosity 型 reward hacking 后，引入轻量 recovery stage，用少量平行语料恢复流畅度/简洁性/格式，同时尽量保留语义增益。
summary.experiments: 任务为中→泰生成；对比标准监督微调与其它利用单语数据方案；报告语义 grounding 与 factual coverage 提升（摘要未给出具体指标与幅度）。

summary_en.core_problem: Low-resource target-language generation lacks parallel data; how to exploit abundant source-language monolingual data without references.
summary_en.importance: A practical recipe combining semantic-reward RL and an explicit anti-reward-hacking recovery stage; useful mainly as a case study on reward signal quality and verbosity hacking.
summary_en.technical_approach: SG-SRL performs reference-free RL on source monolingual data using a cross-lingual semantic reward model (implemented via a cross-lingual reranker). It then applies a lightweight recovery stage with a small parallel corpus to fix verbosity/fluency/format while retaining semantic gains.
summary_en.experiments: Chinese-to-Thai generation; compares against supervised fine-tuning and other baselines; claims improved semantic grounding and factual coverage (no concrete numbers in the abstract).

recommendation.zh: 把它当“reward hacking 实例教材”：只看 reward 设计与 recovery stage，结论别外推到通用 RLHF。
recommendation.en: Treat it as a reward-hacking case study: read the reward design and the recovery stage; don’t over-generalize it to generic RLHF.

paper.title: Destruction is a General Strategy to Learn Generation; Diffusion's Strength is to Take it Seriously; Exploration is the Future
paper.abstract: I present diffusion models as part of a family of machine learning techniques that withhold information from a model's input and train it to guess the withheld information. I argue that diffusion's destroying approach to withholding is more flexible than typical hand-crafted information withholding techniques, providing a rich training playground that could be advantageous in some settings, notably data-scarce ones. I then address subtle issues that may arise when porting reinforcement learning

summary.core_problem: 现有对扩散模型的理解多局限于噪声注入的具体实现，未从信息论的通用视角建立其与其他生成式建模范式的统一框架，也未明确扩散范式在数据稀缺场景的优势来源和未解决的探索问题。
summary.importance: 为LLM预训练范式对比提供了新的信息论视角：将扩散、自回归、掩码语言建模统一归为“隐藏信息+预测被隐藏内容”的家族，明确了扩散范式的差异化优势来自结构化、可调节的破坏过程，而非单纯的噪声注入，为低数据场景下的生成式建模、扩散-强化学习融合方向提供了启发。
summary.technical_approach: 重新定义生成式扩散模型：不限制破坏过程为噪声注入，而是任意可逐步销毁样本信息的预设过程；将扩散模型与监督学习、自回归LM、BERT、去噪自编码器等范式归为同一类“信息隐藏-预测”技术；从训练目标密度、数据增强、任意顺序建模三个角度解释扩散在低数据场景的性能优势；提出将强化学习的探索技术迁移到扩散范式时存在的适配问题，以及扩散原生探索方法的可能研究方向。此外还引入了生成交换图这一新型概率图模型，用于直观解释扩散过程的概率关系。
summary.experiments: 本文为观点类博客论文，无原创实验，主要引用已有的扩散语言模型与自回归模型的对比结果：低数据场景下扩散语言模型可通过训练更多epoch持续超过自回归模型，该交叉点随数据质量/数量提升后移，随模型规模增大前移。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第1章的观点部分，第1.1节的统一框架和第1.2节的低数据优势分析是核心内容；第2章的教程适合非扩散领域研究者快速建立认知，扩散领域研究者可快速浏览其中的生成交换图部分；预计阅读时间30分钟，纯预训练研究者可跳过教程后半部分的数学推导。
summary.authors_note: ServiceNow AI Research, Pierre-André Noël

summary_en.core_problem: Existing understandings of diffusion models are mostly limited to the specific implementation of noise injection, failing to establish a unified framework with other generative modeling paradigms from a general information-theoretic perspective, nor clarifying the source of diffusion paradigm's advantages in data-scarce scenarios and unsolved exploration problems.
summary_en.importance: It provides a new information-theoretic perspective for comparing LLM pre-training paradigms: unifying diffusion, autoregressive, and masked language modeling into the family of 'withholding information + predicting withheld content', and clarifies that the differentiated advantage of the diffusion paradigm comes from a structured, adjustable destruction process rather than simple noise injection, providing inspiration for generative modeling in low-data scenarios and the fusion direction of diffusion and reinforcement learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: Generative diffusion models are redefined: the destruction process is not limited to noise injection, but any preset process that can gradually destroy the information of samples; diffusion models are classified into the same 'information withholding-prediction' technology category as supervised learning, autoregressive LM, BERT, denoising autoencoders, etc.; the performance advantages of diffusion in low-data scenarios are explained from three perspectives: training target density, data augmentation, and any-order modeling; adaptation problems when migrating reinforcement learning exploration techniques to the diffusion paradigm are proposed, as well as possible research directions for diffusion-native exploration methods. In addition, a new type of probabilistic graphical model called generative commutative diagram is introduced to intuitively explain the probabilistic relationships of the diffusion process.
summary_en.experiments: This paper is an opinion blog post with no original experiments. It mainly cites existing comparison results between diffusion language models and autoregressive models: diffusion language models can consistently outperform autoregressive models by training for more epochs in low-data scenarios. This crossover point shifts later with improved data quality/quantity and earlier with larger model size.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the opinion part of Chapter 1. The unified framework in Section 1.1 and the low-data advantage analysis in Section 1.2 are the core content. The tutorial in Chapter 2 is suitable for non-diffusion researchers to quickly establish cognition, and diffusion researchers can quickly browse the generative commutative diagram part. Estimated reading time: 30 minutes. Pure pre-training researchers can skip the mathematical derivation in the latter half of the tutorial.
summary_en.authors_note: ServiceNow AI Research, Pierre-André Noël

recommendation.zh: 一篇 conceptual 的文章，将 Diffusion 视为比 Masking 更 general 的信息隐藏/重建机制，对思考 next-token 之外的预训练范式（如 Diffusion LM）有启发。
recommendation.en: A conceptual paper viewing Diffusion as a more general information withholding/reconstruction mechanism than Masking, inspiring for thinking about pretraining paradigms beyond next-token (e.g., Diffusion LM).

paper.title: GDSD: Reinforcement Learning as Guided Denoiser Self-Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can be used to improve the policy (denoiser) of diffusion large language models (dLLMs), while being hindered by the intractability of the policy likelihood. A dominant and efficient family of methods replaces the likelihood in standard RL with its evidence lower bound (ELBO), estimated from randomly masked sequences. Despite being well aligned with pre-training, these approaches introduce bias through training--inference mismatch by using the ELBO as a likelihood sur

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型（dLLM）的RL微调受到策略似然不可计算的阻碍。主流方法用ELBO（证据下界）替代似然，虽然高效且与预训练对齐，但因训练-推断不匹配（TIM）引入偏差，导致性能下降甚至训练崩溃。论文提出GDSD（引导去噪器自蒸馏）来解决这一问题。
summary.importance: 对扩散LLM的RL微调范式有方法学贡献。将RL问题重新表述为自蒸馏问题，从根本上绕过了ELBO替代似然带来的TIM偏差，为dLLM的后训练对齐提供了更稳定的方案。这一思路可能影响非AR模型（扩散/掩码语言模型）的RL对齐技术路线。
summary.technical_approach: 核心创新是在反向KL正则化的RL框架下，推导出闭式最优策略对应一个“优势引导去噪分布”（advantage-guided denoising distribution），即一个自教师去噪器。然后通过自蒸馏将当前dLLM的去噪器logits匹配到这个自教师的logits上。具体实现为平方logit蒸馏损失（squared-logit distillation loss），通过logit中心化消除配分函数，无需显式归一化。这种蒸馏方式天然支持off-policy更新，完全绕过了TIM偏差。论文还在统一框架下分析了现有ELBO方法（wd1、DMPO、SPG、UniGRPO、ESPO）与不同散度选择的对应关系，阐明GDSD既避免了加权ELBO的低效，又避免了策略梯度方法的TIM偏差。
summary.experiments: 与现有ELBO方法相比，GDSD训练奖励动态更稳定。在规划任务上，GDSD+Dream-7B取得最高+19.6%的测试准确率提升。在LLaDA-8B上，GDSD在规划、数学、编程基准上均一致提升性能，增益幅度在+0.6%到+5%之间。实验未报告模型参数量以外的具体训练细节（如数据规模）。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：§1（引言）清晰梳理了dLLM RL的两类方法和TIM偏差问题；§3.1是核心理论推导（RL→自蒸馏的降维）；§3.2-3.3是GDSD的具体实现。§4的统一框架分析（将现有方法归入同一框架）有助于理解各方法的关系。§5是实验结果。建议阅读时间：20-25分钟。数学基础好的读者可以关注§3.1的反向KL正则化RL闭式解推导。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息未在全文中标注。

summary_en.core_problem: RL fine-tuning of diffusion language models (dLLMs) is hindered by the intractability of the policy likelihood. The dominant approach uses ELBO (evidence lower bound) as a surrogate, which is efficient and aligned with pre-training but introduces training-inference mismatch (TIM) bias, degrading performance and potentially causing training collapse. The paper proposes Guided Denoiser Self-Distillation (GDSD) to address this.
summary_en.importance: Methodological contribution to RL fine-tuning paradigms for diffusion LLMs. Recasting RL as self-distillation fundamentally bypasses TIM bias from ELBO likelihood surrogates, providing a more stable approach for post-training alignment of dLLMs. This line of thinking may influence RL alignment techniques for non-autoregressive models (diffusion/masked LMs).
summary_en.technical_approach: The core innovation derives that under reverse-KL regularized RL, the closed-form optimal policy corresponds to an 'advantage-guided denoising distribution' — a self-teacher denoiser. GDSD then distills the current dLLM's denoiser logits to match this self-teacher via a squared-logit distillation loss with logit centralization, eliminating the partition function without explicit normalization. This distillation naturally supports off-policy updates, completely bypassing TIM bias. The paper also provides a unifying framework showing how existing ELBO methods (wd1, DMPO, SPG, UniGRPO, ESPO) correspond to different divergence choices, positioning GDSD as avoiding both the data inefficiency of weighted ELBO variants and the TIM bias of policy gradient variants.
summary_en.experiments: GDSD shows more stable training reward dynamics compared to prior ELBO-based methods. On planning tasks, GDSD+Dream-7B achieves test accuracy gains of up to +19.6%. With LLaDA-8B, GDSD consistently improves performance across planning, math, and coding benchmarks with gains ranging from +0.6% to +5%. No detailed training statistics (e.g., data size) beyond model parameter counts are reported.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim recommendation: §1 (introduction) clearly maps the two families of RL-for-dLLM methods and the TIM bias problem; §3.1 contains the core theoretical reduction (RL → self-distillation); §3.2-3.3 cover the concrete GDSD implementation. §4's unifying framework analysis helps understand relationships between methods. §5 contains experimental results. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes. Readers with strong math backgrounds may appreciate the closed-form reverse-KL regularized RL derivation in §3.1.
summary_en.authors_note: Institutional affiliation not explicitly stated in the provided text.

recommendation.zh: 扩散语言模型RL对齐的核心参考，无似然自蒸馏的设计可直接用于内部dLLM对齐pipeline的消融测试
recommendation.en: Core reference for diffusion LLM RL alignment; the likelihood-free self-distillation design can be directly used for ablation tests in internal dLLM alignment pipelines

paper.title: When Should Models Change Their Minds? Contextual Belief Management in Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Long-horizon interactions require language models to manage accumulating information: when to update their state, when to preserve their state, and what to ignore. We study this challenge as \textbf{Contextual Belief Management (CBM)}: maintaining a predicted belief state aligned with formal evidence while isolating task-irrelevant noise. To make CBM measurable, we introduce BeliefTrack, a closed-world benchmark spanning Rule Discovery and Circuit Diagnosis, where a finite belief space and symbo

summary.core_problem: 在长上下文和多轮交互中，LLM 难以准确管理其“信念状态”（即根据新证据更新、保持或忽略信息），导致在复杂推理任务中出现信念漂移或被无关信息劫持。
summary.importance: 将长上下文推理中的“信念管理”问题形式化并可量化，揭示了当前前沿模型在处理多轮逻辑更新时的底层缺陷，并证明了基于信念状态的 RL 训练可以有效缓解这一问题，为提升 LLM 的长程推理稳定性提供了新视角。
summary.technical_approach: 提出了 Contextual Belief Management (CBM) 框架和 BeliefTrack 闭源评测基准。BeliefTrack 包含规则发现和电路诊断两个环境，具有有限的信念空间和符号验证器，允许在每轮进行精确的信念状态评估。通过定义三种失败模式（Failed Stay、Failed Update、Failed Isolation），精确定位模型在信念保持、更新和抗噪方面的缺陷。此外，探索了使用基于信念状态奖励的强化学习（RL）来改善 CBM 能力。
summary.experiments: 在 135 个包含无关噪声的规则发现样本上评估了 Qwen3.5-Plus、DeepSeek-V3.2 和 GPT-5.2。结果显示，所有前沿模型均存在严重的 CBM 失败，显式的信念跟踪提示词带来的提升有限。相比之下，使用信念状态奖励进行 RL 训练显著降低了失败率，提升了跨环境泛化能力和对无关噪声的鲁棒性。探针分析揭示了信念状态漂移、回溯失败和上下文劫持等潜在动态。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注第 3 节对 CBM 和 BeliefTrack 的形式化定义，以及第 5 节中 RL 训练对降低失败率的显著效果。第 6 节的探针分析提供了关于模型内部信念动态的有趣见解，值得深入阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: In long-context and multi-turn interactions, LLMs struggle to accurately manage their "belief states" (i.e., updating, maintaining, or ignoring information based on new evidence), leading to belief drift or hijacking by irrelevant information in complex reasoning tasks.
summary_en.importance: Formalizes and quantifies the "belief management" problem in long-context reasoning, revealing underlying flaws in current frontier models when handling multi-turn logical updates. It demonstrates that RL training based on belief states can effectively mitigate this issue, providing a new perspective for improving the stability of long-horizon reasoning in LLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the Contextual Belief Management (CBM) framework and the BeliefTrack closed-world benchmark. BeliefTrack includes Rule Discovery and Circuit Diagnosis environments with finite belief spaces and symbolic verifiers, enabling exact turn-level belief state evaluation. By defining three failure modes (Failed Stay, Failed Update, Failed Isolation), it precisely pinpoints model deficiencies in belief maintenance, updating, and noise resistance. Furthermore, it explores the use of reinforcement learning (RL) with belief-state rewards to improve CBM capabilities.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated Qwen3.5-Plus, DeepSeek-V3.2, and GPT-5.2 on 135 Rule Discovery examples containing task-irrelevant noise. Results show that all frontier models exhibit severe CBM failures, and explicit belief-tracking prompts provide limited gains. In contrast, RL training with belief-state rewards significantly reduces failure rates, improves cross-environment generalization, and enhances robustness to irrelevant noise. Probing analysis reveals latent dynamics such as belief-state drift, backtracking failure, and contextual hijacking.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 3 for the formal definition of CBM and BeliefTrack, and Section 5 for the significant impact of RL training on reducing failure rates. The probing analysis in Section 6 provides interesting insights into the model's internal belief dynamics and is worth a deep dive.

recommendation.zh: 只看任务构造和错误分解即可；70.9% RL 增益说明 long-horizon state 需要显式训练信号，不是 prompt 能补平。
recommendation.en: Read the task design and failure taxonomy; the 70.9% RL gain is a clean reminder that long-horizon state tracking needs trained signals, not just better prompts.

paper.title: EvoRubric: Self-Evolving Rubric-Driven RL for Open-Ended Generation
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly advanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in verifiable domains, but aligning models for open-ended generation remains profoundly challenging due to the lack of definitive rewards. Current rubric-based RL methods mitigate this by employing explicit criteria; however, they rely heavily on static, human-annotated rubrics that inevitably cause policy lag, or expensive external proprietary models for dynamic updates. In this paper, we propose EvoRubric, a no

summary.core_problem: 解决开放式生成 RL 中奖励标准不明确、静态 rubric 滞后、动态 rubric 又依赖昂贵外部模型的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是一个单策略自演化 rubric-driven RL 框架，把回答生成和 rubric 生成放进同一个参数化 policy。它关注 reward signal 质量和 reward hacking，对 post-train 与 pretrain 闭环有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: EvoRubric 让同一策略在 Reasoner 与 Rubric Generator 两种角色之间动态交替，生成回答也生成评价标准。为降低自我奖励带来的 hacking，加入多级验证流程，包括 meta-verifier、zero-variance pruning 和 Leave-One-Out peer consistency，用于过滤低质量或可被利用的 rubric 信号。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出底座模型、参数规模、任务集、baseline 或具体提升幅度；可确认比较对象包括静态人工 rubric 方法和依赖外部专有模型生成动态 rubric 的方法。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles open-ended generation RL, where rewards are hard to define, static rubrics become stale, and dynamic rubrics often require expensive proprietary external models.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a single-policy, self-evolving rubric-driven RL framework that unifies response generation and rubric generation. The work is relevant to reward-signal quality and reward hacking, which are important for post-training and its feedback into pretraining decisions.
summary_en.technical_approach: EvoRubric alternates one parameterized policy between a Reasoner role and a Rubric Generator role, so the model produces both answers and evaluation criteria. To reduce self-rewarding failure modes, it adds a multi-level verification pipeline with a meta-verifier, zero-variance pruning, and Leave-One-Out peer consistency.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide base model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The implied comparisons are against static human-written rubric methods and approaches that rely on external proprietary models for dynamic rubric generation.

recommendation.zh: 读 reward 过滤设计即可；单 policy 产 rubric 的 setup 风险很高，但若验证链有效可省掉外部 judge。
recommendation.en: Read the reward-filtering design; single-policy rubric generation is risky, but a working verifier chain could reduce dependence on external judges.

paper.title: PRO-CUA: Process-Reward Optimization for Computer Use Agents
paper.abstract: Computer use agents (CUAs) have shown strong potential for automating complex digital workflows, yet their training remains constrained by costly live environment interaction and limited high-quality supervision. Existing filtered behavior cloning pipelines suffer from imitation bottlenecks, including distribution shift from the expert demonstration and the absence of negative learning signals. Meanwhile, standard trajectory-level reinforcement learning struggles with sparse rewards, ambiguous c

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 computer use agents 的训练问题：GUI 交互成本高、长程任务奖励稀疏、专家演示有限，导致 filtered behavior cloning 容易过拟合演示分布，而标准轨迹级 RL 又难以做信用分配和系统扩展。
summary.importance: 它属于 agent post-training 方法，对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对多模态 agent 的训练闭环有参考价值。主要启发是把昂贵的在线环境交互与高吞吐的策略优化拆开，并把轨迹级稀疏奖励改成步骤级过程奖励。这类设计对训练 GUI agent、web agent、长程工具使用模型都有借鉴意义，也会影响后续如何构造 agent 训练数据和过程奖励模型。
summary.technical_approach: PRO-CUA 是一个迭代式 on-policy self-evolvement 框架。每轮训练分两阶段：第一阶段让当前策略在真实 GUI 环境中以较高采样温度执行任务，收集自身会到达的状态，从而减少离线专家轨迹带来的分布偏移；第二阶段停止环境交互，只在收集到的状态上采样 G 个 thought-action 候选，由 Process Reward Model 给出二值步骤奖励，再用 GRPO 更新策略。这个拆分把慢速、状态ful 的浏览器或桌面交互，与可批处理的模型训练分离。模型输入遵循 ReAct 格式，状态包含任务指令、历史 thought/action，以及最近的视觉观察；为控制多模态上下文成本，视觉窗口设为 w=1，即只保留最新截图。相对 FBC，它能利用负反馈并允许多样化动作；相对轨迹级 RL，它用步骤奖励缓解长程信用分配；相对离线 step-level RL，它用 on-policy 状态缓解 compounding distribution shift。
summary.experiments: 实验在 WebVoyager、Mind2Web-Live 和 Online Mind2Web 等 live web benchmark 上进行。作者声称 PRO-CUA 相比过滤行为克隆和既有 step-level 方法有更好的任务成功表现，并额外验证了 PRM 评分流程的可靠性与训练数据利用效率。提供的正文片段没有包含完整数值表，因此不宜给出具体提升幅度。可以确认的实验设计重点是 live environment、on-policy state collection、step-level PRM grading 和 GRPO 训练之间的组合效果，而不是单纯扩大演示数据。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对 FBC、trajectory-level RL、off-policy step-level RL 的失败模式拆解；这部分决定方法动机。再看方法章节的两阶段系统设计、PRM 标注规则和 GRPO 更新目标。实验部分重点看三类消融：是否 on-policy 收集状态、是否使用 PRM 步骤奖励、环境交互与优化解耦后数据复用效率如何。如果只关心基座训练，可跳过具体 web benchmark 细节，保留对过程奖励和长程交互训练系统的理解。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses training for computer use agents. Live GUI interaction is slow and expensive, expert demonstrations are scarce, filtered behavior cloning suffers from imitation bottlenecks, and trajectory-level RL gives sparse rewards with difficult credit assignment over long action sequences.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent post-training paper rather than a pretraining paper. Its relevance is in the training interface for long-horizon multimodal agents: separate expensive environment interaction from scalable policy optimization, and replace sparse task-level rewards with step-level process rewards. The same pattern is useful for web agents, GUI agents, tool-use agents, and future data pipelines that train models from their own execution traces.
summary_en.technical_approach: PRO-CUA is an iterative on-policy self-evolvement framework. Each iteration has two stages. First, the current policy interacts with live GUI environments at an elevated sampling temperature to collect states from its own execution distribution. Second, without further environment interaction, the system samples G thought-action candidates for each collected state, scores them with a Process Reward Model using binary step-level rewards, and updates the policy with GRPO. This design decouples slow stateful environment rollout from batched model optimization. The agent follows a ReAct-style format, conditioning on the task instruction, previous thoughts and actions, and recent visual observations. The visual window is set to w=1, keeping only the latest screenshot to reduce multimodal context cost. Compared with filtered behavior cloning, the method introduces negative learning signals and does not force exact imitation of demonstrations. Compared with trajectory-level RL, it provides denser credit assignment. Compared with offline step-level RL, it trains on on-policy states and therefore reduces distribution shift.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on live web benchmarks including WebVoyager, Mind2Web-Live, and Online Mind2Web. The reported findings are that PRO-CUA improves over filtered behavior cloning and related step-level training pipelines, while also showing that the PRM grading pipeline is reliable and that collected states can be reused efficiently during optimization. The provided text does not include the complete result tables, so exact success rates and improvement margins should not be inferred. The important experimental axis is the combination of on-policy state collection, PRM-based step rewards, and GRPO optimization under live-environment constraints.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Read the introduction for the taxonomy of failure modes: filtered behavior cloning, trajectory-level RL, and off-policy step-level learning fail for different reasons. Then inspect the method section for the two-stage infrastructure, PRM grading, and GRPO objective. In the experiments, look for ablations on on-policy state collection, PRM rewards, and data reuse after decoupling rollout from optimization. If your focus is base-model training, skip most benchmark-specific details and retain the lessons about process rewards and long-horizon interaction training systems.

recommendation.zh: 将 PRM (Process Reward Model) 引入 GUI Agent 的 RL 训练，解耦了昂贵的在线交互，对探索复杂环境下的 RL 训练配方有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Introduces PRM to RL training for GUI Agents, decoupling expensive online interactions; offers valuable reference for exploring RL recipes in complex environments.

paper.title: AgentCVR: Active Multi-Agent Cross-Video Reasoning via Script-Simulated Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Cross-Video Reasoning (CVR) has emerged as a critical frontier in multimodal intelligence, requiring models to retrieve, align, and aggregate evidence distributed across multiple videos. Current Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) often struggle with CVR, as simple single-pass strategies encode multiple videos into a shared compressed context, potentially obscuring rare but critical evidence. In this paper, we propose AgentCVR, a multi-agent framework that treats CVR as an active evidence-a

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型在跨视频推理（CVR）任务中，单次前向传递容易丢失关键证据的问题。
summary.importance: 将跨视频推理建模为主动证据获取任务，并提出了一种基于脚本模拟的强化学习方法来高效训练多智能体策略。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AgentCVR 多智能体框架，Master Agent 协调 Visual 和 Audio Agents 提取证据。引入 Script-Simulated RL，利用 LLM 生成语义脚本和轻量级文本模拟器优化策略，避免了在线探索时昂贵的多模态推理。
summary.experiments: 在 CVR benchmark 上优于单次前向 baseline，并实现了高效训练。
summary.authors_note: 清华大学与阿里巴巴团队合作。

summary_en.core_problem: Addressing the issue of Multimodal Large Language Models losing critical evidence during single-pass forward propagation in Cross-Video Reasoning (CVR) tasks.
summary_en.importance: Models cross-video reasoning as an active evidence-acquisition task and proposes a script-simulated reinforcement learning method to efficiently train multi-agent policies.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces the AgentCVR multi-agent framework, where a Master Agent coordinates Visual and Audio Agents to extract evidence. Employs Script-Simulated RL, using LLM-generated semantic scripts and a lightweight text simulator to optimize policies, bypassing costly multimodal inference during online exploration.
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms single-pass baselines on a CVR benchmark and achieves efficient training.
summary_en.authors_note: Collaboration between Tsinghua University and Alibaba.

recommendation.zh: 用纯文本模拟器（Script-Simulated RL）来代替昂贵的多模态环境做 RL 训练，这种降维打击的训练 trick 对多模态 Agent/RL 训练有启发，可看其 RL setup。
recommendation.en: Using a pure text simulator (Script-Simulated RL) to replace expensive multimodal environments for RL training is a clever dimensionality-reduction trick; the RL setup is inspiring for multimodal Agent/RL training.

paper.title: GAPD: Gold-Action Policy Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning in Knowledge Base Question Answering
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a natural fit for agentic knowledge base question answering (KBQA), where a model must issue executable actions, observe knowledge-base feedback, and eventually return an answer. However, current RL-based KBQA systems mainly optimize sparse rewards from the final answer, leaving intermediate action errors weakly supervised. This is especially limiting for logical-form annotated KBQA benchmarks: gold logical forms can be converted into executable action sequences, b

summary.core_problem: KBQA中基于RL的方法主要优化最终答案的稀疏奖励，中间动作错误缺乏监督；而gold逻辑形式通常仅用于预热数据构造而非在线RL更新。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出训练时的Gold-Action Policy Distillation框架，为结果驱动的RL添加稠密token级指导。
summary.technical_approach: GAPD通过MID-ANCHOR MATCHING将学生探索和gold执行中到达的中间实体作为状态锚点，将学生状态与gold状态匹配，实现稠密token级监督。
summary.experiments: 在KBQA基准上进行实验，具体模型、基准和结果未在摘要中详述。

summary_en.core_problem: RL-based KBQA systems optimize sparse final-answer rewards, leaving intermediate action errors weakly supervised; gold logical forms are underutilized beyond warm-start data construction.
summary_en.importance: Method innovation: a training-time Gold-Action Policy Distillation framework adding dense token-level guidance to outcome-based RL for KBQA.
summary_en.technical_approach: GAPD uses MID-ANCHOR MATCHING: intermediate entities reached during student and gold execution serve as state anchors to align student rollouts with gold action sequences for dense supervision.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments on KBQA benchmarks; specifics not fully detailed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: KBQA特定任务的RL方法改进，将gold动作序列用于稠密监督的思路自然但增量。对通用agent或预训练研究有限。
recommendation.en: Incremental RL improvement specific to KBQA task. Using gold action sequences for dense supervision is natural but not paradigm-changing for general agent or pre-training research.

paper.title: Scaling, Benchmarking, and Reasoning of Vision-Language Agents for Mobile GUI Navigation
paper.abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown rapid progress in mobile GUI navigation. This paper presents a systematic study of data scaling, benchmarking, and reasoning for VLM-based agents in this domain. To facilitate rigorous evaluation, we introduce HyperTrack, a large-scale dataset with over 16000 real-world tasks across more than 650 Chinese mobile applications, along with GUIEvalKit, an open-source toolkit for unified benchmarking of VLMs on offline GUI navigation tasks. Using HyperTrack, we

summary.core_problem: 现有移动端GUI导航的视觉语言智能体缺乏大规模中文场景数据集、统一评测工具，且训练数据规模对监督微调、强化微调的影响，以及推理能力对任务表现的作用均缺乏系统性研究。
summary.importance: 提供了中文移动端GUI领域的大规模评测资产和数据缩放规律结论，对多模态智能体的后训练数据配比、训练范式选择有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 1）构建HyperTrack数据集，包含674款中文安卓应用的16080条真实任务轨迹，覆盖分层UI文档、动作 bounding box、屏幕描述等多维度标注，支持域内、未见应用、未见设备等多维度泛化评测；2）开发开源统一评测工具包GUIEvalKit；3）基于数据集系统性对比监督微调（SFT）和DAPO增强的GRPO强化微调范式的缩放规律，评测主流开源VLM的GUI导航表现。
summary.experiments: 强化微调在所有数据规模下均优于监督微调，尤其是域外泛化场景，体现了数据规模与RL的协同效应；交互历史完整性、模型推理能力对GUI任务成功率有显著正向影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读数据集统计与对比表格，数据缩放实验的SFT与RL性能对比曲线，预计阅读时间20分钟。
summary.authors_note: 武汉大学、小米，通讯作者高鹏志（小米）

summary_en.core_problem: Existing vision-language agents for mobile GUI navigation lack large-scale Chinese scenario datasets and unified evaluation tools. There is also no systematic research on the impact of training data scale on supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement fine-tuning, as well as the effect of reasoning ability on task performance.
summary_en.importance: It provides large-scale evaluation assets and data scaling law conclusions for the Chinese mobile GUI domain, and has reference value for post-training data ratio selection and training paradigm selection for multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1) Construct the HyperTrack dataset, which contains 16080 real task trajectories from 674 Chinese Android apps, covering multi-dimensional annotations such as hierarchical UI documents, action bounding boxes, and screen descriptions, supporting multi-dimensional generalization evaluation including in-domain, unseen app, and unseen device settings. 2) Develop the open-source unified evaluation toolkit GUIEvalKit. 3) Systematically compare the scaling laws of SFT and DAPO-augmented GRPO reinforcement fine-tuning paradigms based on the dataset, and evaluate the GUI navigation performance of mainstream open-source VLMs.
summary_en.experiments: Reinforcement fine-tuning outperforms supervised fine-tuning across all data scales, especially in out-of-domain generalization scenarios, demonstrating the synergy between data scale and RL. Completeness of interaction history and model reasoning ability have significant positive effects on GUI task success rate.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the dataset statistics and comparison tables, and the SFT vs RL performance scaling curves in data scaling experiments. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Wuhan University, Xiaomi; corresponding author: Pengzhi Gao (Xiaomi)

recommendation.zh: 提供了一个大规模的 GUI Agent 数据集和评测基准，其关于 RL 在 OOD 泛化上优于 SFT 的结论对 Agent 训练有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Provides a large-scale GUI agent dataset and benchmark; the conclusion that RL outperforms SFT in OOD generalization is valuable for agent training.

paper.title: OmniVerifier-M1: Multimodal Meta-Verifier with Explicit Structured Recalibration
paper.abstract: Visual outcomes are increasingly central to multimodal large language models, making reliable and fine-grained verification essential for scaling generalist foundation models. In this work, we investigate multimodal meta-verification, which leverages verifier-generated rationales rather than decision-only signals, and explore how to effectively incorporate meta-verification feedback into multimodal verifier training. We identify two key findings. First, symbolic verifier outputs (e.g., bounding

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型中视觉结果验证不可靠、反馈信号粗糙的问题，尤其是如何把 verifier 生成的结构化理由有效用于训练更强的通用视觉 verifier。
summary.importance: 这项工作更像是多模态后验校验与评测信号设计的研究。价值不在于提出新的基座预训练范式，而在于给出一个较干净的结论：结构化、可规则化的 verifier rationale 比自由文本解释更适合作为训练反馈，且二分类判断与元验证反馈应解耦优化。这对多模态 RL 信号设计、judge/verifier 训练和后训练接口都有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上提出 OmniVerifier-M1，一个 multimodal meta-verifier。核心做法有两点：一是把 verifier 的输出从纯 decision 扩展到带显式结构的 meta-verification rationale，例如边界框等符号化输出；二是将 binary judgment 与 meta-verification 分开建模和强化，而不是做联合 reward 优化。作者强调符号化 rationale 可以直接转成规则式 RL reward，减少对额外 judge model 的依赖，也避免文本解释带来的高噪声和奖励不稳定。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，实验主要比较了两类 rationale 形式（symbolic vs textual）以及两种训练策略（decoupled RL vs joint reward optimization），任务是通用视觉 verifier 训练。结论是符号化输出优于文本解释，解耦式优化优于联合优化。摘要未给出明确模型规模、训练数据规模和具体提升幅度，因此目前更适合把它当作训练信号设计的方向性证据，而不是可直接复现的 recipe。

summary_en.core_problem: It studies how to make visual verification for multimodal LLMs more reliable by turning verifier rationales into effective training signals for a stronger general-purpose visual verifier.
summary_en.importance: The main value is not a new foundation-model pretraining paradigm, but a cleaner lesson on supervision design: structured, rule-friendly verifier rationales are more useful than free-form textual explanations, and binary judgment should be optimized separately from meta-verification. This matters for multimodal RL signals, verifier/judge training, and the pretrain-to-posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces OmniVerifier-M1, a multimodal meta-verifier. Two design choices are central: extending verifier outputs from decision-only labels to explicit structured rationales such as symbolic outputs or bounding boxes, and decoupling reinforcement learning objectives for binary judgment versus meta-verification instead of optimizing a single joint reward. The symbolic rationale can be converted into rule-based rewards, reducing dependence on auxiliary judge models and avoiding noisy text-based reward signals.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, the empirical study compares symbolic versus textual rationales and decoupled RL versus joint reward optimization in training a generalist visual verifier. The reported conclusion is that symbolic outputs outperform textual explanations, and decoupled optimization beats joint reward learning. The abstract does not provide model size, data scale, or exact gains, so this is better treated as directional evidence on supervision design than as a ready-to-copy recipe.

recommendation.zh: 对做多模态 verifier/judge 或 RL 信号设计的人有用，核心只看“结构化 rationale + 解耦奖励”这两个结论；若你只关心纯 pretrain，可降级处理。
recommendation.en: Useful if you work on multimodal verifiers or RL signal design; the only parts worth keeping are the structured-rationale and decoupled-reward findings, not the full system.

paper.title: ABot-OCR Technical Report
paper.abstract: We introduce ABot-OCR, an end-to-end vision-language model that transcribes a page image directly into clean Markdown in a single forward pass. By doing so, our approach completely eliminates the need for brittle modular orchestration. To maximize parsing fidelity, we develop a dedicated data engine to provide large-scale, structurally consistent supervision. Furthermore, we propose Decoupled Heterogeneous Document Optimization, a structure-constrained reinforcement learning method that sharpens

summary.core_problem: 解决复杂文档 OCR 依赖多模块流水线、端到端 VLM 难以同时保证文本准确性和 Markdown 结构合法性的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是文档理解方向的端到端 VLM 系统报告，包含大规模结构化监督数据引擎和结构约束 RL；对预训练研究员的价值主要在多模态数据构造、结构化输出约束和 SFT 后 RL 接口，而不是基座训练本身。
summary.technical_approach: ABot-OCR 将页面图像直接转写为 clean Markdown，避免检测、版面分析、OCR、后处理等模块级编排。方法包含专用数据引擎，用于生成大规模、结构一致的监督样本；后续提出 Decoupled Heterogeneous Document Optimization，通过结构约束强化学习提升文本准确率并约束 markup well-formedness。
summary.experiments: 在 OmniDocBench v1.5 和 v1.6 上，ABot-OCR 在端到端系统中达到 92.81 和 93.30 分，缩小了与强 pipeline baseline 的差距；还报告了十种语言的多语种文本识别结果。摘要未披露模型参数量、训练 token/image 数量或 RL 细节消融。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the brittleness of modular document OCR pipelines and the difficulty of making an end-to-end VLM produce both accurate text and well-formed Markdown.
summary_en.importance: This is a technical report on an end-to-end document VLM. Its useful signal for pretraining researchers lies in multimodal data construction, structured-output supervision, and the SFT-to-RL interface, rather than in foundation-model pretraining itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: ABot-OCR transcribes a page image directly into clean Markdown in one forward pass, removing detection, layout analysis, OCR, and post-processing orchestration. It builds a data engine for large-scale structurally consistent supervision and introduces Decoupled Heterogeneous Document Optimization, a structure-constrained RL method for textual accuracy and markup validity.
summary_en.experiments: On OmniDocBench v1.5 and v1.6, ABot-OCR reports scores of 92.81 and 93.30 among end-to-end systems, narrowing the gap to strong pipeline baselines. It also evaluates multilingual text recognition across ten languages. The abstract does not disclose parameter count, training data scale, or detailed RL ablations.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据引擎和结构约束 RL 设计；端到端 OCR 结论偏任务化，不应外推到通用 VLM 预训练。
recommendation.en: Read the data engine and structure-constrained RL pieces; the end-to-end OCR results are task-specific and should not be overextended to VLM pretraining.

paper.title: Joint Training of Multi-Token Prediction in Reinforcement Learning via Optimal Coefficient Calibration
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as the standard paradigm for improving reasoning capability of large language models, while Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) has been a widely adopted module in pretraining. Combining them is a natural approach, yet current RL practices detach MTP gradients because joint training degrades the performance. We revisit this failure from an optimization perspective. We show that the per-step effect of MTP on the RL objective can be decomp

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是 MTP 模块在 RLVR 阶段为何不能直接和主模型联合训练的问题。MTP 在预训练中常用，可以让模型学习多步预测表示，也能作为 speculative decoding 的草稿头；但在 RL 推理训练中，工程实践通常会 detach MTP 对主干的梯度，因为直接联合优化会损害主模型的推理性能。论文把这个现象从“经验不稳定”改写为一个优化问题：MTP 梯度对 RL 目标的单步影响，什么时候是有益的，什么时候会变成扰动。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口有直接价值。很多基座模型在预训练阶段带 MTP 或类似多 token 预测头，但 RL 阶段为了稳定性往往把它隔离，导致预训练结构和后训练目标之间断开。这篇工作给出一个可操作的解释框架：MTP 的收益不取决于它是否提供更多监督，而取决于它的梯度方向是否和 RL 梯度一致，以及二阶扰动是否可控。贡献量级不在于提出新 RL 算法，而在于为“带辅助头的预训练模型如何进入 RL 阶段”提供了一个清楚的校准原则。这个问题会影响 MTP、draft head、multi-token head、甚至多头辅助目标在 RL 后训练中的使用方式。
summary.technical_approach: 技术核心是把联合 MTP-RL 更新放到 L-smooth 目标的单步改进下界里分析。设 RL 梯度为 g_RL，MTP 梯度为 g_MTP，MTP 系数为 λ。把联合更新代入平滑性不等式后，MTP 对 RL 目标的影响可以拆成两部分：一阶相关项和二阶扰动惩罚。一阶项由 g_RL 与 g_MTP 的内积决定，表示 MTP 是否沿着提高 RL reward 的方向更新；二阶项总是非正，表示额外 MTP 梯度带来的更新扰动。这个分解解释了三种训练方式。Detach 让主干看不到 MTP 梯度，相当于 Δ_MTP 为 0，稳定但放弃联合收益。CE MTP 把所有样本按 token 似然同等处理，而 RL 会强调高 reward 样本并压低低 reward 样本，两者目标不一致，所以相关项弱，通常抵不过扰动惩罚。Policy loss MTP 用与主模型一致的 RL 目标，早期梯度方向更一致，因此会有初始收益；但随着训练进入较平坦区域，一阶对齐减弱，二阶扰动仍存在，于是出现先升后降。基于这个分析，OCC 不是固定 MTP 系数，而是在线估计当前最合适的 λ。理论上最优 λ 来自上述二次形式的闭式解；工程上不直接计算全模型梯度内积，而用小步更新下 log probability 变化作为代理量，近似跟踪梯度相关和扰动强度。这个设计重点在于避免大规模分布式 RL 中额外的全模型梯度计算，使 MTP 系数校准可以嵌入现有训练系统。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖多个竞赛级数学推理 benchmark，并在不同模型和 RL 算法设置下比较 Detach、CE loss、Policy loss 和 OCC。给出的主要现象很一致：CE MTP 往往低于 Detach，说明单纯加多 token 交叉熵监督不能改善 RL 推理训练；Policy loss 早期能带来提升，但后期出现性能回落，对应理论中的相关项衰减和扰动项持续存在；OCC 在各 benchmark 上稳定达到或超过 Detach，说明动态系数比固定系数更适合 MTP-RL 联合训练。给定内容没有列出具体模型参数量、训练 token 数、各 benchmark 的逐项分数和提升幅度，因此不应把结论解读为某个规模上的绝对性能突破；更可靠的读法是，OCC 改善了训练曲线形态和不同设置下的稳健性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读优化分析和 OCC 推导部分。重点看联合更新代入 L-smooth 下界后的 Δ_MTP 分解，这是理解全文的主线。第二个重点是三种 MTP 训练 regime 的解释：Detach、CE、Policy loss 分别对应什么梯度结构，为什么 CE 不只是“弱一点”，而是目标权重和 RL 不匹配。第三个重点是 Policy loss 的先升后降曲线，建议结合训练曲线和梯度相关性指标看。OCC 部分需要关注两个问题：闭式最优 λ 的推导假设是什么，以及 log-probability proxy 如何近似梯度内积。实验部分优先看 ablation：固定 λ 与 OCC 的对比、CE 与 policy loss 的对比、不同 RL 算法或模型上的一致性。如果只看一个创新点，就是“辅助目标的系数应该跟随梯度相关性变化，而不是在 RL 阶段固定”。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses why multi-token prediction heads, useful during pretraining, often hurt the main model when jointly optimized during RLVR. In current practice, MTP gradients are usually detached from the backbone during RL. The paper reframes this engineering failure as an optimization question: under what conditions does the MTP gradient improve the RL objective, and when does it become a harmful perturbation?
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between pretraining and post-training. Many pretrained models include MTP-style auxiliary heads for representation learning or speculative decoding, but RL training often isolates these heads for stability. The paper provides a concrete criterion for when such auxiliary objectives can be allowed to update the backbone: their gradients must remain aligned with the RL gradient, and the second-order perturbation must stay controlled. The contribution is not a new general-purpose RL algorithm; its value is a principled recipe for carrying pretraining-time auxiliary structures into RL without degrading the base policy.
summary_en.technical_approach: The main analysis uses the one-step improvement bound of an L-smooth RL objective. Let g_RL denote the gradient of the reward objective and g_MTP the gradient induced by the MTP loss, scaled by a coefficient λ. After substituting the joint update into the smoothness bound, the MTP effect decomposes into a first-order correlation term and a second-order penalty. The correlation term is governed by the inner product between g_RL and g_MTP; it measures whether the MTP update moves in a reward-improving direction. The second-order term is always non-positive and captures the extra perturbation introduced by the auxiliary gradient. This decomposition explains three regimes. Detach sets the MTP gradient to zero with respect to the backbone, so it is stable but cannot exploit joint learning. Cross-entropy MTP treats all samples through token likelihood, while RL upweights high-reward trajectories and suppresses low-reward ones; the resulting gradient correlation is weak and usually cannot compensate for the perturbation. Policy-loss MTP initially aligns with the RL objective, but as optimization moves toward flatter regions, the alignment decays while the perturbation remains, producing a rise-and-fall training curve. Optimal Coefficient Calibration then chooses λ online from the closed-form optimum suggested by the quadratic bound. To avoid full-model gradient inner products in distributed RL, it uses a small-step log-probability-change proxy, making the calibration inexpensive enough for large-scale training.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare Detach, cross-entropy MTP, policy-loss MTP, and OCC on multiple competition-level mathematical reasoning benchmarks, across different model and RL settings. The reported pattern is consistent: cross-entropy MTP underperforms Detach; policy-loss MTP improves early but later degrades; OCC matches or exceeds Detach across benchmarks and avoids the late-stage decline. The supplied text does not include exact model sizes, data scale, per-benchmark scores, or numerical gain margins, so the safest interpretation is about training behavior and robustness rather than a specific absolute performance level.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the optimization decomposition carefully. The key object is the Δ_MTP term in the one-step improvement bound, because it connects gradient alignment, perturbation, and the choice of λ. Then read the section that maps Detach, CE loss, and Policy loss to this decomposition; it gives the practical explanation for why existing recipes behave differently. The OCC derivation is the main technical part: focus on the closed-form coefficient, the assumptions behind it, and the log-probability proxy used to avoid full gradient computation. In the experiments, prioritize plots or tables comparing fixed coefficients with OCC, and look for ablations over training stage, model, and RL algorithm. The central idea worth carrying forward is that auxiliary-head training during RL should be calibrated by online gradient agreement, not by a fixed loss weight.

recommendation.zh: 直接解释了预训练MTP任务与RL后训练联合掉点的核心机制，应立刻在内部多任务联合训练的ablation中验证OCC方案。
recommendation.en: Directly explains the core mechanism of performance drop when combining pretrained MTP with RL post-training; validate the OCC scheme in internal multi-task joint training ablations immediately.

paper.title: DenoiseRL: Bootstrapping Reasoning Models to Recover from Noisy Prefixes
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for advancing reasoning in large language models, yet most existing methods still depend on stronger teacher models or heavily curated difficult datasets, limiting scalable capability improvement. In this paper, we introduce DenoiseRL, a reinforcement learning framework that substitutes external supervision with recovery-oriented optimization over failures from weak models. Instead of relying on stronger supervision or carefully engineered dat

summary.core_problem: 在没有更强教师模型或人工构建的高难度数据集的情况下，如何通过强化学习（RL）持续提升大语言模型的推理能力？
summary.importance: 提出了一种不依赖外部强监督信号的 RL 范式，将弱模型的错误转化为训练信号，为解决 RL 训练中数据扩展性和教师模型依赖问题提供了一条新路径，对 self-correction 机制的训练有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DenoiseRL 框架，将弱模型生成的错误推理轨迹作为“结构化噪声前缀”注入到策略模型的生成过程中。模型被要求从这些错误的中间状态中恢复，并继续推理出正确答案。这种方法将推理 RL 转化为一个去噪问题，通过强制模型在训练中面对并纠正错误，隐式地增加了训练难度，并显式地将自我纠错（self-correction）作为训练目标，而非仅仅是涌现能力。
summary.experiments: 在数学和通用推理基准测试中，DenoiseRL 稳定提升了 GRPO 和 DAPO 的性能。消融实验揭示了两个关键设计原则：1. 噪声强度需适中，过长或过错的前缀会导致模型陷入过度思考（overthinking）和训练不稳定；2. 在 PPO 风格的优化中，对 off-policy 的前缀进行更新会导致训练不稳定，应进行掩码处理。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Introduction 中对 weak-to-strong 范式局限性的分析，以及 Method 部分关于如何将错误前缀转化为去噪目标的具体实现。实验部分关注前缀长度对模型 overthinking 现象的影响分析。

summary_en.core_problem: How to continuously improve the reasoning capabilities of LLMs via Reinforcement Learning (RL) without relying on stronger teacher models or manually curated hard datasets?
summary_en.importance: Introduces a novel RL paradigm that eliminates the need for external strong supervision by repurposing weak model errors as training signals. This offers a scalable solution to the data bottleneck and teacher dependency in RL, providing direct insights into training self-correction mechanisms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes DenoiseRL, a framework that injects erroneous reasoning trajectories generated by a weak model as 'structured noisy prefixes' into the policy model's rollouts. The model is trained to recover from these corrupted intermediate states and deduce the correct answer. This casts reasoning RL as a denoising problem, implicitly increasing training difficulty and explicitly targeting self-correction as a training objective rather than relying on it as an emergent behavior.
summary_en.experiments: DenoiseRL consistently improves the performance of GRPO and DAPO across math and general reasoning benchmarks. Ablation studies reveal two critical design principles: 1. Noise intensity must be controlled; overly long or severely corrupted prefixes induce overthinking and training instability. 2. Updating off-policy prefixes in PPO-style optimization leads to instability and should be masked.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Introduction for the critique of the weak-to-strong paradigm, and the Method section for the mechanics of converting error prefixes into denoising targets. In the experiments, pay attention to the analysis of how prefix length affects the overthinking phenomenon.

recommendation.zh: 用模型自身错误轨迹做RL恢复训练的思路值得关注，减少对强教师的依赖，但实验细节未完整展示，建议关注后续完整版本。
recommendation.en: The idea of using a model's own error trajectories for RL recovery training is interesting for reducing teacher model dependence, but experimental details are incomplete—watch for the full version.

paper.title: ADWIN: Adaptive Windows for Horizon-Aware On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers reasoning behavior by training a student on teacher feedback along student-generated trajectories, but standard full-rollout training ties every update to a costly completion and can over-allocate supervision to late positions with low marginal value for the current student. We revisit this assumption through the useful supervision horizon: student-induced rollouts can drift from teacher-preferred continuations, while aligned prefixes may already preserve t

summary.core_problem: 标准同策略蒸馏（OPD）需要基于学生生成的完整轨迹执行参数更新，存在两个核心缺陷：一是每次更新都被完整轨迹的生成阻塞，训练效率低；二是学生自回归生成的轨迹后半段往往偏离教师偏好的合理分布，后半段的监督信号边际价值很低，甚至会引入噪声。
summary.importance: 为同策略蒸馏类后训练方法提供了可落地的效率优化思路，其核心观察——轨迹前缀的梯度方向已经能代表完整轨迹的优化方向——对所有需要生成完整轨迹的RL类后训练流程都有参考价值，可直接降低推理类蒸馏的计算成本。
summary.technical_approach: 提出ADWIN自适应窗口框架，将轨迹生成长度转化为在线可决策的前缀有效性问题：同步执行基于短前缀的参数更新，保证训练不被长轨迹生成阻塞；同时异步抽取少量前缀扩展为完整轨迹作为探针，校验前缀更新的梯度方向与完整轨迹更新的一致性，根据校验结果动态调整下一轮同步更新的前缀窗口长度，在保证优化效果的前提下选择最短的可用窗口。
summary.experiments: 在数学、代码基准的单任务、多任务、强到弱蒸馏场景下进行了测试，与标准完整轨迹OPD相比，端到端训练FLOPs最多降低4.1倍，同时精度持平或更优，效果优于固定前缀长度或外部调度的前缀基线。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读引言部分的问题分析和方法概述，以及核心算法流程图；不需要深究公式推导的细节，整体阅读时间约30分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard on-policy distillation (OPD) requires parameter updates based on full student-generated trajectories, with two core drawbacks: first, each update is blocked by the generation of complete trajectories, leading to low training efficiency; second, the latter segments of student autoregressive trajectories often deviate from the reasonable distribution preferred by the teacher, resulting in low marginal value of supervision signals in later positions, and even introducing noise.
summary_en.importance: It provides a practical efficiency optimization idea for on-policy distillation post-training methods. Its core observation that the gradient direction of trajectory prefixes can already represent the optimization direction of full trajectories has reference value for all RL post-training processes that require generating complete trajectories, and can directly reduce the computational cost of reasoning distillation.
summary_en.technical_approach: The ADWIN adaptive window framework is proposed, which transforms trajectory generation length into an online decidable prefix admissibility problem: parameter updates based on short prefixes are executed synchronously to ensure training is not blocked by long trajectory generation; meanwhile, a small number of prefixes are asynchronously extended to complete trajectories as probes to verify the consistency between the gradient direction of prefix updates and full trajectory updates. The prefix window length for the next round of synchronous updates is dynamically adjusted according to the verification results, selecting the shortest available window while ensuring optimization effect.
summary_en.experiments: Tested in single-task, multi-task, and strong-to-weak distillation scenarios on math and code benchmarks. Compared with standard full-trajectory OPD, end-to-end training FLOPs are reduced by up to 4.1×, while accuracy is comparable or better, outperforming fixed prefix length or externally scheduled prefix baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the problem analysis and method overview in the introduction, as well as the core algorithm flow chart; there is no need to delve into the details of formula derivation, and the total reading time is about 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: ADWIN在OPD中引入自适应滚动窗口的思路对优化RL训练计算效率有实际启发，建议看核心方法§3和实验对比图表。
recommendation.en: ADWIN's adaptive rollout window approach for OPD offers practical insights for optimizing RL training compute efficiency; read §3 (core method) and experimental comparison figures.

paper.title: Confidence-Orchestrated Self-Evolution against Uncertain LLM Feedback
paper.abstract: Self-evolving large language models (LLMs) learn by generating their own training tasks and solutions, reducing reliance on human-curated supervision. However, in many reasoning domains, the model must also validate generated tasks and judge generated answers to obtain training signals. This creates a training-signal challenge: erroneous self-judgments become erroneous gradient updates. Existing approaches either rely on external verifiers, which limits generality, or treat noisy self-generated

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是自演化 LLM 中的训练信号噪声问题。模型自己生成题目、验证题目、解答题目、判断答案时，Validator 和 Judge 的错误反馈会直接变成奖励、过滤条件或 replay 优先级，进而形成错误梯度。论文的核心问题不是如何生成更多自训练数据，而是如何降低不确定反馈对策略更新的影响。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于，它把自生成反馈从“可用或不可用”的二值问题，改写成 per-sample training control 问题。这个视角适合连接 self-training、RLVR、continual pretrain 和后训练数据闭环。贡献量级属于方法型增量，但问题定义比较准确：当 verifier 不能外置、任务又不可执行验证时，LLM-as-judge 的不确定性需要进入优化过程，而不是只在数据过滤阶段处理。
summary.technical_approach: COSE 使用同一个 backbone，通过 prompt 扮演 Proposer、Validator、Solver、Judge 四个角色。Proposer 生成候选题，Validator 给出题目质量分数 v(q) 和置信度 cV(q)；Solver 生成答案，Judge 给出正确性分数 p(q,a) 和置信度 cJ(q,a)。置信度来自生成反馈时 token-level 分布的熵，熵越低表示模型对该判断越确定。训练时只优化 Proposer 和 Solver，Validator 与 Judge 只作为 inference-time feedback module 提供分数和置信度。COSE 在两处使用置信度：一是 confidence-weighted PPO，让低置信反馈对应的样本在 PPO 更新中权重更小；二是 confidence-prioritized replay，让 replay buffer 更偏向有效、判断较确定、且处在当前 Solver 能力边界附近的问题。它与依赖外部 verifier 的路线不同，目标是保留任务通用性；也不同于直接把自判结果当监督信号，COSE 不假设自判一定正确，而是控制其训练影响。
summary.experiments: 论文在 19 个 held-out benchmarks 和 4 个 Qwen/Llama backbone 上评估 COSE。报告结果显示，COSE 相比 base model 有稳定提升，并且相对已有 self-evolving baseline 通常更好或相当。实验设置覆盖不同模型族，说明方法不是只依赖某一个 backbone 的校准特性。关键消融应关注两类机制的独立贡献：confidence-weighted PPO 是否降低错误反馈造成的更新污染，confidence-prioritized replay 是否改善训练样本分布。文中给出的框架数字包括 19 个评测集、4 个 Qwen/Llama backbone；提供内容中未出现具体逐项分数和提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读优先看 Introduction 和 Method。Introduction 对“自生成反馈是优化问题”讲得比较清楚，适合判断这篇工作的研究定位。Method 重点看四角色共享 backbone 的训练边界、Validator/Judge 为什么不直接优化、置信度如何从 token entropy 转成 PPO 权重和 replay 优先级。实验部分建议快速扫主表和消融表，确认提升是否来自置信度控制，而不是简单的数据量或 replay 策略变化。预计阅读时间 25–35 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses noisy training signals in self-evolving LLMs. In this setting, the model proposes tasks, validates them, solves them, and judges its own answers. Errors from the Validator or Judge are not just evaluation errors; they become rewards, filters, replay priorities, and ultimately gradient updates. The central question is how to limit the optimization impact of uncertain LLM-generated feedback.
summary_en.importance: The useful idea for pretraining and post-training research is to treat self-generated feedback as a per-sample training-control signal rather than a binary accept-or-reject label. This is relevant to self-training, RL with weak verifiers, continual training loops, and synthetic reasoning data pipelines. The contribution is method-level rather than a new training paradigm, but the problem framing is sound: when external verifiers are unavailable, uncertainty in LLM-as-judge feedback has to be handled inside the optimization loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: COSE uses one shared backbone prompted into four roles: Proposer, Validator, Solver, and Judge. The Proposer generates candidate reasoning questions. The Validator assigns a quality score v(q) and a confidence score cV(q). The Solver answers accepted questions. The Judge assigns a correctness score p(q,a) and a confidence score cJ(q,a). Confidence is estimated from the entropy of the token-level output distribution when the Validator or Judge produces feedback. Low entropy is treated as higher confidence. Only Proposer and Solver trajectories receive optimization losses; Validator and Judge are used as inference-time feedback modules. COSE uses confidence in two places: confidence-weighted PPO, which downweights uncertain feedback during policy updates, and confidence-prioritized replay, which samples more from questions that are valid, confidently judged, and close to the Solver’s current capability boundary. This differs from external-verifier methods by keeping the loop more general, and differs from naive self-training by not treating all self-judgments as equally reliable supervision.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates COSE on 19 held-out benchmarks and four Qwen/Llama backbones. The reported trend is consistent improvement over the base models, with performance better than or competitive with prior self-evolving baselines. The multi-backbone setup is important because entropy-based confidence can be model-calibration dependent. The key experimental evidence to inspect is the ablation of confidence-weighted PPO and confidence-prioritized replay, since these determine whether the gain comes from uncertainty-aware optimization rather than from additional generated data alone. The provided content specifies the number of benchmarks and model families, but does not expose detailed per-benchmark scores or exact improvement margins.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the Introduction and Method first. The Introduction gives the cleanest statement of why noisy self-feedback is an optimization bottleneck. In the Method, focus on the four-role shared-backbone setup, the decision to optimize only Proposer and Solver, the entropy-based confidence estimate, and how confidence enters PPO and replay. For experiments, check the main result table and ablations to see whether both confidence mechanisms are necessary. Estimated reading time: 25–35 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 探讨了 RL 阶段如何利用模型自身 confidence 来 reweight PPO 更新，缓解自我评估的噪声问题，对 post-training 数据合成和 RL 训练有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Explores using intrinsic confidence to reweight PPO updates during self-evolution, mitigating noisy self-evaluation; offers insights for post-training data synthesis and RL.

paper.title: StepOPSD: Step-Aware Online Preference Distillation for Agent Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning for multi-turn agents suffers from a credit-assignment mismatch: rewards are sparse and trajectory-level, while success often hinges on a few local decisions. Existing online policy distillation (OPD) provides denser token-level supervision, but typically treats heterogeneous agent trajectories as monolithic strings rather than causal interaction units. We present StepOPSD, a post-rollout preference self-distillation framework that takes the agent step as the unit of credi

summary.core_problem: 多轮智能体强化学习存在信用分配错配问题：奖励稀疏且仅在整条轨迹维度发放，而任务成败往往取决于少数局部决策；现有在线策略蒸馏方法将异质的智能体轨迹视为整体字符串，忽略交互的因果单元边界，在环境观测等模型不可控的token上浪费监督信号。
summary.importance: 为智能体后训练阶段的RL与蒸馏信号融合提供了轻量的信用重分配思路，在不改变在线交互逻辑的前提下优化RL的优势估计，对GRPO类RL训练流程的改进有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出以智能体交互步为单位的事后偏好自蒸馏框架StepOPSD。首先将完整轨迹拆解为以行动为中心的步段，过滤掉环境观测等模型不可控的token；为每个步段构造加入事后信息的教师上下文，对比师生模型的token对数概率差，基于标准化的每步信用预算，转换为保留符号的优势塑形项，注入GRPO更新流程。与RLSD对全序列token重加权、SDAR对全序列做软token门控的方法不同，StepOPSD将监督限定在实际驱动智能体行为的行动段内，是现有GRPO pipeline的可插拔模块，完全不改动在线rollout逻辑。
summary.experiments: 在ALFWorld的Heat、PickTwo子集和Search-QA的TriviaQA、HotpotQA子集上取得最优或次优成绩；消融实验发现更小的局部裁剪阈值α_clip能普遍提升训练稳定性，全局混合强度λ_mix则具有任务依赖性：具身控制任务适合更弱的塑形，检索类QA适合更强的塑形。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读方法章节的步段拆分规则和优势塑形公式，实验部分的双参数调优结论，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Multi-turn agent reinforcement learning faces a credit assignment mismatch: rewards are sparse and distributed only at the full trajectory level, while task success usually depends on a small number of local decisions. Existing online policy distillation methods treat heterogeneous agent trajectories as monolithic strings, ignoring causal interaction unit boundaries and wasting supervision on tokens that the model cannot control, such as environment observations.
summary_en.importance: It provides a lightweight credit redistribution approach for integrating RL and distillation signals in agent post-training, optimizing RL advantage estimation without modifying online interaction logic, and has direct reference value for improving GRPO-based RL training pipelines.
summary_en.technical_approach: StepOPSD is a hindsight preference self-distillation framework centered on agent interaction steps. It first decomposes full trajectories into action-centered step segments, filtering out uncontrollable tokens such as environment observations. For each step segment, it constructs a teacher context augmented with hindsight information, compares the token log-probability gap between teacher and student, and converts it into a sign-preserving advantage shaping term based on a normalized per-step credit budget, which is injected into the GRPO update process. Unlike RLSD which reweights all tokens in the full sequence, or SDAR which applies soft token gating over the entire sequence, StepOPSD restricts supervision to action segments that actually drive agent behavior. It is a drop-in module for existing GRPO pipelines and does not change online rollout dynamics at all.
summary_en.experiments: It achieves top-1 or top-2 performance on ALFWorld Heat, PickTwo subsets and Search-QA TriviaQA, HotpotQA subsets. Ablation studies show that smaller local clipping threshold α_clip generally improves training stability, while global mixing strength λ_mix is task-dependent: weaker shaping works better for embodied control tasks, and stronger shaping works better for retrieval QA tasks.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the step segmentation rules and advantage shaping formula in the method section, and the two-parameter tuning conclusions in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 RL 奖励分配细化到 step 级别，对长序列 agent 训练的 credit assignment 有启发，值得关注其 advantage shaping 的具体实现。
recommendation.en: Refining RL reward assignment to the step level offers insights for credit assignment in long-horizon agent training; the advantage shaping implementation is worth checking.

paper.title: Off-Policy Learning to Reason Works Because It Is More Pessimistic Than You Think
paper.abstract: Large scale reinforcement learning has become a central tool for improving reasoning in large language models. At this scale, generation is often lagged or asynchronous, so updates are performed on data collected by older policies. This makes learning inherently off-policy.
