Most existing approaches nevertheless remain rooted in PPO-style trust-region objectives, treating training as approximately on-policy and using importance weights to correct distribution mismatch. These corrections can intro

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论大规模推理 RL 中不可避免的 off-policy 训练：rollout 往往来自旧策略，而去掉 importance weight 的 ratio-free 方法为什么反而稳定。
summary.importance: 启发点在于把 A⋆-PO、OAPL 这类 off-policy reasoning RL 的稳定性解释为一种隐式保守更新，而不是简单的“忽略分布偏移”。这对大规模 RL 系统有实际意义，因为异步采样、策略滞后、旧 checkpoint rollout 都会让严格 on-policy 假设失效。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，论文分析一类不使用 importance ratio 的 off-policy 目标，指出它们诱导的目标策略不是常见 KL-regularized policy optimization 中的指数倾斜分布，而是 Lambert-tempered target policy。这个目标会对高 advantage 样本做温和放大，避免少数旧策略采样到的高 reward completion 过度主导更新。关键控制量来自 advantage normalization。论文把目标行为分成三个区域：正区域是保守的 Lambert regime；边界退化到指数更新；负区域比指数更新更激进，更容易导致 entropy collapse。基于这个分析，作者解释了 OAPL 实现中为什么要把 advantage 计算温度和 regularization 温度解耦：这会把 advantage 推回更保守的区域。进一步提出 β-shifted mean advantage，即在 group-centered reward advantage 上加一个 β shift，使诱导目标直接落在保守区域，减少对温度解耦启发式的依赖。
summary.experiments: 实验重点是鲁棒性而不是单点分数。相较 OAPL，β-shifted mean advantage 对 regularization strength 更不敏感，在更大的 policy lag 下也更稳定；训练中 entropy 保持得更好，减少了 OAPL 在激进正则或 stale rollout 下出现的 collapse 或不稳定。给定内容没有提供具体 benchmark、模型规模和数值提升，因此适合作为机制分析和训练 recipe 参考，而不是按最终榜单性能阅读。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 30 到 45 分钟。先看 ratio-free off-policy objective 到 Lambert-tempered target 的推导，理解为什么去掉 importance weight 后不是无校正训练，而是改变了目标分布形状。然后看 advantage normalization 的三种 regime，这是最有用的诊断工具。实验部分重点看 policy lag、regularization strength 和 entropy 曲线，不必过度关注单个任务分数。若已经熟悉 PPO/GRPO/OAPL，可以直接读理论分析和 β-shifted mean advantage 的实现规则。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why ratio-free off-policy RL can work for LLM reasoning when rollouts are generated by stale or asynchronous behavior policies.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is a clearer explanation of off-policy reasoning RL at scale. Large RL systems rarely operate in a purely on-policy regime: generation is expensive, workers are asynchronous, and updates often consume samples from older policies. The paper argues that removing importance weights is not merely ignoring distribution mismatch; under suitable advantage normalization, it induces a conservative update that can be more stable than ratio-corrected PPO-style objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: The analysis covers ratio-free off-policy objectives related to A⋆-PO and OAPL. Instead of deriving another trust-region surrogate, it asks what target policy these objectives actually optimize toward when the data come from an older behavior policy. The induced target is shown to be Lambert-tempered rather than the usual exponential target from KL-regularized policy optimization. This matters because Lambert tempering can damp high-advantage samples, preventing a few stale completions from dominating the update. The behavior depends on the advantage baseline and normalization. In the positive regime, the target is pessimistic and conservative; at the boundary, it recovers the exponential update; in the negative regime, it becomes more aggressive than the exponential update and is more prone to entropy collapse. The paper uses this lens to explain the temperature decoupling used in practical A⋆-PO/OAPL implementations, then proposes a simpler β-shifted mean advantage that pushes the target into the conservative Lambert regime by construction.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical results focus on stability under different regularization strengths and policy lags. Compared with OAPL, the β-shifted mean advantage is reported to be less sensitive to regularization, more stable under stale rollouts, and better at maintaining entropy. The provided text does not include exact model sizes, benchmark names, or numerical margins, so the empirical claim should be read as a robustness result rather than a detailed performance comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with attention to the derivation of the Lambert-tempered target and the three regimes induced by advantage normalization. These sections are the useful part for RL training design. Then check the implementation rule for the β-shifted mean advantage and the stability plots over policy lag, regularization strength, and entropy. Estimated reading time is 30 to 45 minutes for readers already familiar with PPO, GRPO, and OAPL.

recommendation.zh: 从隐式悲观角度解释off-policy RL训练LLM推理的核心机制，做RL与预训练融合的可重点看目标函数推导部分
recommendation.en: Explains the core mechanism of off-policy RL for LLM reasoning via implicit pessimism; researchers working on RL-pretraining integration should focus on objective derivation

paper.title: Knowing When to Ask: Segment-Level Credit Assignment for LLM Tool Use
paper.abstract: Humans know when to reach for help e.g. $347 \times 28$ warrants a calculator while $2+2$ does not. Language models do not. Prompt-based approaches can instruct a model when to invoke tools, but this scaffolding does not teach it to recognize the boundary of its own knowledge. RL approaches that assign a single outcome reward to the whole trajectory fare no better: trajectory-level credit cannot isolate which tool call in a successful episode actually helped, nor penalize unnecessary calls. We p

summary.core_problem: 训练 LLM 判断何时需要调用工具、何时应依赖参数知识，解决 trajectory-level reward 无法给单个工具调用分配责任的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是工具使用 RL 的信用分配方法。它把“是否该问工具”从提示规则转成可学习的 competence boundary，对后训练和 agent 训练信号设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 CARL，即 Competence-Aware Reinforcement Learning。它用模型自身 rollouts 训练 critic，在自然工具使用边界处分段，例如 code fence delimiter 和 context block transition；再从单个二元 outcome 中为每个 segment 分配独立 credit，不需要外部 judge 或 step-level annotation。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、任务集、baseline 数值和提升幅度。已知比较对象包括 prompt-based tool-use scaffolding 和单一 outcome reward 的 trajectory-level RL；实验意图是减少错误工具调用和不必要调用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper trains LLMs to decide when to call a tool and when to rely on parametric knowledge, addressing the failure of trajectory-level rewards to assign credit to individual tool calls.
summary_en.importance: This is a credit-assignment method for RL-based tool use. It turns the boundary between internal competence and external assistance from a prompt heuristic into a learned signal, making it relevant to post-training and agent training design.
summary_en.technical_approach: CARL, or Competence-Aware Reinforcement Learning, trains a critic on the model's own rollouts. It decomposes trajectories at natural tool-use boundaries such as code fence delimiters and context block transitions, then assigns independent segment-level credit from a single binary outcome without external judges or step-level annotations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, task suites, baseline numbers, or improvement magnitudes. The stated baselines are prompt-based tool-use scaffolds and trajectory-level RL with a single outcome reward; the intended effect is to reduce both missed and unnecessary tool calls.

recommendation.zh: 值得看 credit assignment 设计；若二元 outcome 真能稳定分段归因，可迁移到 RLVR 的过程信号构造。
recommendation.en: Read the credit-assignment design; if binary outcomes reliably yield segment credit, it can inform RLVR process-signal construction.

paper.title: WINDQuant: Weight-Informed Neural Decision-Making for Global Mixed-Precision LLM Quantization
paper.abstract: Quantization is an effective approach to reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), yet maintaining performance in the ultra-low-bit regime remains challenging. Existing post-training methods often suffer from severe accuracy degradation, while quantization-aware training requires costly retraining and additional resources. Moreover, most mixed-precision strategies rely on coarse-grained or heuristic sensitivity analysis that overlooks fine-grained variations

summary.core_problem: 在极低比特 LLM 量化中，如何在全局存储预算下自动决定不同权重块的 bit-width 和量化处理方式，减少性能退化。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的后训练量化方法。贡献不是新的量化算子，而是把 mixed-precision allocation 做成细粒度决策问题；对服务侧成本有意义，但对预训练方法论的直接信息较弱。
summary.technical_approach: WINDQuant 使用强化学习控制器，在 column-chunk 粒度为权重矩阵分配 bit-width 和量化 treatment。它避免只按层级或粗粒度敏感性启发式分配精度，在全局目标 bit-width 约束下搜索更灵活的混合精度方案。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明目标是 ultra-low-bit LLM post-training quantization，并声称相比现有 PTQ 方法可减少精度下降；但所给摘要未列出具体模型参数量、评测任务、baseline 名称或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how to automatically assign bit-widths and quantization treatments to different weight regions of an LLM under a global storage budget.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency contribution for post-training quantization. Its main idea is not a new quantization operator, but a fine-grained mixed-precision allocation policy; it is relevant for serving cost, but only indirectly informative for pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: WINDQuant trains a reinforcement-learning allocation controller that operates at the column-chunk level inside weight matrices. Under a global target bit-width, it chooses precision and quantization treatments more flexibly than layer-level or heuristic sensitivity-based mixed-precision schemes.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract frames the setting as ultra-low-bit LLM post-training quantization and reports reduced accuracy degradation relative to existing methods, but the provided text does not include model sizes, task suites, baselines, or numerical gains.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和消融就够；RL 分配 bit 的想法合理，但若没有跨模型迁移结果，容易只是搜索成本换精度。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations; RL-based bit allocation is plausible, but without cross-model transfer it may just trade search cost for accuracy.

paper.title: AdvantageFlow: Advantage-Weighted Least Squares for RL in Flow Models
paper.abstract: We introduce AdvantageFlow, a forward-process reinforcement learning algorithm for rectified flow models. Unlike Flow-GRPO, which optimizes the reverse process, we optimize an advantage-weighted forward-process prediction loss. This optimization problem is unstable when advantages are negative and the loss becomes non-convex. We stabilize it by rollout policy regularization, which reduces variance and arises from fitting a local reward-improving target distribution. We evaluate AdvantageFlow on

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 flow / rectified flow 图像生成模型在后训练阶段如何做更稳、更直接的 RL。已有主流做法如 Flow-GRPO，把反向去噪轨迹当作序列决策过程来做 policy gradient，但这一路线有两个结构性问题：一是原始采样是确定性 ODE，必须人为加噪改成 SDE 才能写出策略梯度；二是奖励只在最终图像上给出，中间去噪步骤的 credit assignment 很难。AdvantageFlow 试图绕开这两个问题：不在 reverse trajectory 上做 RL，而是在 forward training objective 上直接做 reward-weighted regression。更具体地说，它把 flow matching 里的 clean-image prediction loss 改写成 advantage-weighted least squares，用同 prompt 下 batch 内样本的相对优劣来重加权训练信号，同时引入 rollout policy regularization，解决负 advantage 导致的非凸与不稳定问题。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身的直接影响不大，因为它主要是图像生成模型的 post-training / preference optimization，而不是语言模型预训练 recipe。但它有两点值得关注。第一，它代表了一类“生成模型 RL 不一定要走 token-level / step-level policy gradient”的思路：如果预训练目标本身是回归式、去噪式或 flow matching 式，后训练也许可以尽量留在原训练目标附近，只改权重而不是改整个优化范式。第二，它把 reward optimization 写成局部 target distribution 拟合，并把 regularization 解释为方差缩减与凸性修复，这种推导方式对 diffusion LM、masked generative model、甚至部分非 AR 语言建模的 post-train 设计有启发。就量级看，这更像是一个方法论上的 clean-up 和统一解释，而不是会立刻改写 LLM 预训练主线的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是把 rectified flow 的 prediction loss从普通最小二乘，改成 advantage 加权的最小二乘。基础对象是 clean image predictor f_theta(x_t, t, c)，其中 x_t 是 clean image 与 Gaussian noise 的线性插值。标准训练时最小化 E||f_theta(x_t,t,c)-x_0||^2；AdvantageFlow 则对每个生成样本附上 advantage 权重，鼓励模型更贴近高奖励样本、远离低奖励样本。

难点在于 advantage 可以为负。若直接做负权最小二乘，单样本损失会变成非凸，优化容易发散。论文的处理不是简单截断负样本，而是引入 rollout regularization：用模型的 moving-average / rollout policy 构造一个 reward-independent 参考项，把原本高方差、带符号的目标分解成一个稳定的基准拟合项，加上 advantage 驱动的偏移项。文中把它解释为拟合一个局部线性倾斜的 target distribution：相当于在当前策略附近，按 exp 或一阶 tilt 的方式把概率质量向高奖励样本移动。regularization 对应于把 noisy sampled targets 替换成条件均值，从而降低方差，并保证每个样本上的目标函数严格凸。

从算法关系上看，作者还说明 negative-aware fine-tuning 这一类 forward-process RL baseline 可以被视为其方法在特定自适应 regularization 选择下的特例。这一点有价值，因为它把看似经验性的“负样本感知”技巧，纳入了统一的 advantage-weighted least-squares 框架。

和 reverse-process RL 相比，AdvantageFlow 的差异很明确：它不需要给采样过程额外注入随机性，不需要对每个去噪 step 做 credit assignment，也不需要显式 policy gradient estimator；训练对象仍然是 pretrain 时同一类 forward loss，只是样本权重发生变化。这使它在实现上更接近 supervised fine-tuning，而不是传统 RL。
summary.experiments:
实验基座是 Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium，任务是文本到图像生成的 reward optimization。论文比较了三类方法：AdvantageFlow、reverse-process 的 Flow-GRPO，以及 forward-process 的 negative-aware fine-tuning baseline。摘要和正文给出的结论是一致的：AdvantageFlow 在多个 reward model 下都优于两类基线，并且还能扩展到 multi-objective optimization。

从实验设计看，作者重点验证了四件事。第一，forward-process RL 是否真的能在不做 reverse credit assignment 的情况下提升 reward；答案是可以。第二，rollout regularization 是否只是工程稳定器，还是方法必要组成；消融显示它对稳定训练和最终效果都关键，尤其是在存在负 advantage 时。第三，方法是否会明显 reward hack；作者补充用了 GenEval 做外部评测，说明提升不只是 reward model 内部过拟合。第四，统一视角是否成立；通过把现有 forward baseline 写成特例，实验上也能解释不同 regularization 选择带来的性能差异。

当前公开内容里没有看到特别系统的 scaling 结果，也没有像 LLM 论文那样给出参数量、token budget、训练 FLOPs 与 loss 曲线的完整分析。它更像一篇算法论文：重点是目标函数、稳定性和 reward 指标，而不是大规模训练规律。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Algorithm 部分，抓住一个主线：为什么 reverse-process RL 在 flow model 上别扭，以及为什么 forward-process weighted regression 更自然。然后重点看作者如何从 local reward-improving target distribution 推出 advantage-weighted least squares，再看 rollout regularization 的两层作用：一层是 variance reduction，另一层是把负 advantage 带来的非凸问题修正为严格凸。

如果时间有限，建议优先看：1）方法推导里关于“negative advantages make the loss non-convex”的段落；2）把现有 negative-aware baseline 解释为特例的部分；3）主实验表和 regularization 消融；4）GenEval 结果，用来判断 reward hacking 风险。预计 20–30 分钟可以把主要思想看明白。若关心 diffusion LM / non-AR LM 的 RL 后训练，可以再细读理论推导，看这种 weighted denoising / weighted regression 是否能迁移到离散生成场景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to do RL-style post-training for rectified flow models without going through reverse-process policy gradients. Existing methods such as Flow-GRPO treat denoising as a sequential decision process, but that creates two awkward issues: the native sampler is a deterministic ODE, so extra stochasticity must be injected just to define policy gradients; and rewards are only available on the final image, making credit assignment across denoising steps difficult. AdvantageFlow avoids both by staying in the forward training view. It turns the standard clean-image prediction objective into an advantage-weighted least-squares problem, using within-prompt relative rewards to bias learning toward better samples while adding rollout regularization to stabilize optimization under negative advantages.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper for LLMs, and its direct impact on language-model pretraining is limited. Its value is more conceptual. First, it shows a broader pattern: for generative models trained with denoising or flow-matching objectives, post-training does not have to be framed as token-level or step-level policy gradient. One can often stay close to the original supervised objective and only change sample weighting. Second, the paper derives reward optimization from a local target-distribution fitting view and interprets regularization as both variance reduction and convexity repair. That perspective is relevant to diffusion LMs, masked generative models, and other non-AR paradigms where post-training may be easier to express as weighted regression than as trajectory RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method starts from the rectified-flow prediction objective for the clean image predictor f_theta(x_t, t, c), where x_t is a linear interpolation between a clean image x_0 and Gaussian noise. Standard training minimizes E||f_theta(x_t,t,c)-x_0||^2. AdvantageFlow replaces this with an advantage-weighted version so that higher-reward samples receive larger positive influence and lower-reward samples receive negative influence relative to the prompt-level batch average.

The main technical difficulty is that advantages can be negative. Naively using signed weights makes the per-sample least-squares objective non-convex and unstable. The paper addresses this with rollout policy regularization. Instead of directly fitting noisy signed targets, it introduces a reward-independent reference induced by a moving-average rollout policy. The derivation is framed as fitting a locally reward-improving target distribution, i.e., a linearly tilted distribution around the current policy that shifts mass toward better samples. The regularization term emerges naturally when replacing noisy sampled targets with their conditional means in the reward-independent part of the objective. This reduces variance and restores strict convexity at the sample level.

An additional useful point is unification. The paper shows that a recent negative-aware forward-process RL baseline can be recovered as a special case under a particular adaptive regularization choice. So the contribution is not only a new algorithm, but also a cleaner objective-level view that organizes several forward-process RL heuristics under one framework.

Compared with reverse-process RL, the difference is structural: no stochastic sampler is required for gradient estimation, no denoising-step credit assignment is needed, and the optimized loss remains the same type of forward prediction loss used in pretraining, only reweighted by reward-derived statistics. In practice this makes the method look closer to supervised fine-tuning than to conventional RL.
summary_en.experiments:
Experiments are built on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Medium for text-to-image reward optimization. The main comparisons are against Flow-GRPO on the reverse-process side and a negative-aware fine-tuning baseline on the forward-process side. The reported result is consistent throughout the paper: AdvantageFlow outperforms both baselines across several reward models and also extends to multi-objective optimization.

The empirical section mainly validates four claims. First, forward-process RL can improve reward without explicit reverse-process credit assignment. Second, rollout regularization is not just a training trick; it is central to both stability and final quality, especially when negative advantages are common. Third, gains are not purely reward-model overfitting: the paper includes GenEval as an external check against reward hacking. Fourth, the unifying view is meaningful in practice, since different regularization choices explain the behavior of prior forward-process baselines.

What is missing, from a pretraining-research perspective, is large-scale scaling analysis. The paper does not focus on model-size scaling, token budgets, or training-dynamics diagnostics in the style of LLM pretraining work. It is primarily an algorithm paper centered on objective design and optimization stability.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and Algorithm sections. The key question is why reverse-process RL is awkward for flow models and why forward-process weighted regression is a more natural alternative. Then read the derivation of the advantage-weighted least-squares objective from the local reward-improving target distribution. The most important technical point is the role of rollout regularization: it is doing two jobs at once, variance reduction and repair of the non-convexity caused by negative advantages.

If reading time is limited, focus on: (1) the discussion of why negative advantages break naive weighted least squares; (2) the section showing how negative-aware fine-tuning appears as a special case; (3) the main result tables and regularization ablations; and (4) the GenEval results, which are the main sanity check against reward hacking. Around 20–30 minutes should be enough for a solid skim. If your interest is diffusion LM or non-AR LM post-training, the derivation is the part worth reading carefully.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和稳定性推导即可；它对 diffusion LM 的 RL 训练有可迁移信号，结果数字要等正文细看。
recommendation.en: Read the method and stability argument; it offers transferable signal for RL on diffusion LMs, while the empirical strength needs the full tables.

paper.title: Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization
paper.abstract: Standard on-policy reinforcement learning relies on heuristic clipping to enforce trust regions, but this mechanism imposes a severe cost by indiscriminately truncating high-return yet high-divergence updates. We demonstrate that explicitly constraining the policy ratio variance provides a principled local approximation to trust-region constraints, eliminating the need for binary hard clipping. By acting as a distributional ``soft brake'', this approach preserves critical gradient signals from n

summary.core_problem: 在 PPO/GRPO 这类一阶 on-policy 策略梯度里，clip 用“逐样本硬截断”近似 trust region，导致两个直接问题：高回报但 ratio 偏大的样本梯度被一刀切抹掉；以及数据一旦稍微 off-policy 就几乎不能用。论文要解决的是：在不引入 TRPO 二阶开销的前提下，用一个更“分布式”的约束替代 pointwise clipping，同时允许一定程度的 stale/off-policy 复用。
summary.importance: 对 LLM 的 RLHF/RLAIF/可验证奖励 RL（含 GRPO 系）有直接启发：把“稳定性约束”从 clip 的启发式，改成可优化、可调节的统计量约束（importance ratio 的方差），理论上更贴近 KL trust region 的局部近似，工程上也更容易做成可控的软约束。更关键的是它把“稳定更新”和“复用旧数据”统一到同一个约束里：方差大就自动降权，方差小就允许继续吃旧数据。这类思路如果在大规模 RL 训练里成立，可能减少对严格 on-policy 的依赖，改善样本效率与训练吞吐。
summary.technical_approach:
核心替代物是“约束 importance ratio 的方差”。设 ρ_t(θ)=π_θ(a_t|s_t)/π_old(a_t|s_t)。PPO 的 clip 是对每个样本的 ρ_t 做区间截断；本文改为对一批样本的二阶统计量做约束：控制 Var(ρ_t)（以及与之相关的二阶矩），把它作为 trust-region（KL）在局部 regime 的近似。

实现上给出 R2VPO：把“最大化优势加权的 importance sampling 目标”与“ratio 方差不超过阈值”写成带约束优化，然后用拉格朗日乘子做 primal-dual 更新：
- primal：更新策略参数以提升回报（类似 PPO/GRPO 的 surrogate）；
- dual：自适应调节方差惩罚强度，使 ratio 方差维持在目标范围。

直观效果是一个 soft brake：ratio 偏离越大、对方差贡献越大，就被更强地惩罚/降权，但不会像 clip 那样把梯度直接置零；同时对 stale/off-policy 数据，ratio 分布往往更“散”，方差约束会自动把它们的有效权重压下去，从而在不显式 hard cutoff 的情况下实现“可控复用”。论文还给出 off-policy 变体 R2VPO-OFF，强调可以利用旧轨迹/旧 rollouts 做额外更新。
summary.experiments:
论文宣称覆盖 LLM 对齐/推理范式与连续控制两大类实验。
- LLM 侧：在 7 组不同 LLM scale/设置上，R2VPO 相对强 clipping baseline（含 GRPO）给出 macro-average 相对提升 +35%，小模型场景最高到 +138%；在 7 个设置里有 6 个优于 GRPO。并报告 R2VPO-OFF 能有效利用 stale 数据提升样本效率。
- 控制侧：在 DeepMind Control Suite 上显著优于 PPO，尤其在 sparse-reward 探索与动态任务中更不易崩。

从“预训练-后训练接口”的角度，更值得看的不是绝对分数，而是：方差约束是否减少了训练中 ratio 爆炸/崩溃的频率、是否允许更大的学习率或更少的 rollout 频率、以及 off-policy 复用在不同延迟(staleness)下的收益曲线。全文如果给了这些曲线/消融（阈值、dual 更新速率、与 KL/clip 的对照），信息量会很高。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1) 方法推导部分：他们如何把 KL trust region 的局部近似落到 Var(ρ) 上——这里决定了它是不是“换个正则项”的包装。
2) 算法框图/伪代码：primal-dual 的更新频率、dual 的稳定性技巧（是否需要 clamp、moving average、target schedule）。
3) LLM 实验：重点看与 PPO/GRPO 的对照是否控制了 rollout 数、batch、优势估计、KL penalty 等变量；以及 R2VPO-OFF 的 staleness 设置与收益。
4) 消融：方差阈值/惩罚系数自适应 vs 固定、是否仍需要 KL penalty、与 clip 同时用会怎样。

如果要判断能否迁移到大规模 RLHF 生产训练，优先找：ratio 分布统计、梯度范数/更新幅度、loss spike 频率、以及吞吐/样本效率的量化。

summary_en.core_problem: First-order on-policy methods (PPO/GRPO) approximate trust regions via per-sample hard clipping of the importance ratio. This stabilizes updates but discards gradients from high-return yet high-divergence samples, and effectively prevents reuse of slightly stale/off-policy data. The paper targets a replacement for pointwise clipping that (i) remains first-order and scalable, (ii) behaves like a trust-region surrogate, and (iii) enables controlled reuse of off-policy trajectories.
summary_en.importance: For LLM post-training (RLHF/RLAIF and verifier-based RL), the main value is reframing the stability constraint from a heuristic clip to an optimizable statistical constraint: controlling the variance of importance ratios. This is closer to a local trust-region view than binary truncation, and it naturally couples stability with off-policy reuse: stale data tends to inflate ratio dispersion, which the variance constraint down-weights automatically. If the reported gains hold under strict compute/data controls, this could reduce the “must be on-policy” pressure in large-scale RL pipelines and improve sample efficiency.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key idea is to constrain second-order statistics of the importance ratio ρ_t(θ)=π_θ(a_t|s_t)/π_old(a_t|s_t), rather than clipping ρ_t per token/step. The authors argue that, in a local regime, a KL trust-region constraint can be approximated by controlling the variance (and related second moment) of ρ.

They propose R2VPO (Ratio-Variance Regularized Policy Optimization): formulate policy optimization as maximizing an IS-style surrogate objective subject to a constraint on Var(ρ). The constraint is enforced via a Lagrangian primal–dual scheme:
- primal update improves the return surrogate (PPO-like objective without hard clipping);
- dual update adapts the penalty to keep ratio variance near a target.

This yields a “soft brake”: samples with extreme ratios are smoothly down-weighted (not zeroed), preserving gradient signal from rare but valuable trajectories. An off-policy variant (R2VPO-OFF) explicitly reuses stale trajectories; the same variance control acts as an automatic gate on how much those trajectories can influence updates.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports results in both LLM fine-tuning and continuous control.
- LLMs: across 7 model scales/settings, R2VPO shows a macro-average relative gain of +35% over strong clipping-based baselines (including GRPO), with up to +138% in smaller-model regimes; it beats GRPO in 6/7 settings. R2VPO-OFF is reported to improve sample efficiency by leveraging stale data.
- Control: on DeepMind Control Suite, R2VPO outperforms PPO, with stronger exploration in sparse-reward tasks and less collapse in dynamic tasks.

For an LLM training reader, the most diagnostic evidence is not the headline score but the training dynamics: ratio distribution statistics, update magnitude, instability/spike frequency, and performance vs staleness curves for off-policy reuse (if provided).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
1) The derivation connecting KL trust regions to Var(ρ): this determines whether the method is principled or just a different regularizer.
2) Algorithm details: primal–dual update schedule, how the dual variable is stabilized (clamps/EMA/targets), and whether additional KL penalties are still needed.
3) LLM experiments: check if rollouts, batch sizes, advantage estimation, and compute budgets are matched against PPO/GRPO; focus on the off-policy/staleness protocol.
4) Ablations: fixed vs adaptive penalty, sensitivity to the variance target, combining with clipping/KL, and any reported training stability metrics.

If you care about production RLHF, prioritize sections that quantify throughput/sample-efficiency trade-offs and robustness to stale data.

recommendation.zh: PPO硬clip的有原则替代方案，正则化思路对LLM RL优化有参考价值，做RLHF的研究员可看§3的算法推导
recommendation.en: A principled alternative to PPO hard clipping, the regularization idea is informative for LLM RL researchers, focus on §3 algorithm derivation

paper.title: MechRL: Reinforcement Learning Agents Perform Circuit Discovery for Mechanistic Interpretability
paper.abstract: Mechanistic interpretability has identified small sets of attention heads that implement specific behaviours in transformer language models, but recovering these circuits typically requires a bespoke analytical pipeline for each new task. We recast circuit discovery as a reinforcement-learning problem. An agent operates over the 144 attention heads of GPT-2 small as a discrete action space; each action triggers a zero-ablation and a contrastive reward that subtracts the ablation's damage to gene

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：能否把 mechanistic interpretability 里高度依赖人工设计和单任务分析的 circuit discovery，改写成一个可学习、可迁移的强化学习问题。具体地说，作者希望训练一个策略，在冻结的 GPT-2 small 上通过逐步选择并消融 attention head，自动找出对某个行为最关键、但对一般语言建模损伤较小的头部子集。难点不在“做 ablation”，而在于如何定义一个足够稳定的奖励，让 agent 学到任务特异电路，而不是只学会破坏模型最脆弱的通用头。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏机制分析与自动化解释工具，因此放在 skim 是合适的。但它仍有两点启发。第一，它把 circuit discovery 从离线打分问题变成 sequential decision problem，说明解释工作也可以有可迁移策略，而不必每个任务重做一套 pipeline。第二，文中设计的 contrastive reward 很有意思：用目标任务损伤减去自然文本上的一般语言建模损伤，试图分离 task-specific heads 和 general-purpose heads。这个想法对训练信号设计有参考价值，尤其是在想从“有害但不专属”的因果因素里剥离出“真正任务相关”的因素时。若从 LLM 基座研究角度看，它更像是 mechanistic interpretability 的方法论文，而不是 pretrain recipe 论文。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上，作者把 GPT-2 small 的 144 个 attention heads 视为离散动作空间。每一步动作就是选择一个 head，在 hook_z 位置把该 head 输出置零，观察该消融对任务指标和控制指标的影响。环境是一个标准 Gymnasium MDP，episode 最多 50 步，且同一 episode 内不能重复选择同一 head。训练任务只有两个：induction 和 IOI。每次 reset 时随机采样任务并重新生成 batch，避免策略记住固定 head 排名。奖励设计是全文最关键的部分。对目标任务，使用 ablation 前后 logit difference 的下降作为损伤；对控制任务，使用自然英文文本上的 cross-entropy 上升作为一般语言建模损伤；最终 reward 是两者的差。这样，若某个 head 对所有任务都重要，消融它会同时伤害目标任务和一般文本，净奖励不会太高；若某个 head 主要服务于当前任务，reward 才会显著为正。观测包括三部分：当前任务 one-hot、已尝试 head 的 mask、已尝试 head 的归一化 reward 向量。后两者让策略能在单个 episode 内根据已获得反馈调整后续搜索。策略网络是一个小型 actor-critic MLP，输入 290 维，经过两层 256 隐层，输出 144 维动作分布和价值头。训练用 PPO，8 个并行环境，共 2e5 环境步。作者还加了一个 best-of-K 决策包装：策略先采样 K 个候选动作，环境并行评估后选 reward 最高者执行。K=1 是普通 PPO，K=5 则相当于给策略加了轻量规划/重采样。泛化测试使用训练中未见过的 docstring completion 任务，检查策略是否学到了可迁移的结构先验，而不是只记住 induction/IOI 的局部模式。
summary.experiments: 实验核心结论是：一个在 induction 和 IOI 上训练的 PPO 策略，能够在训练任务上接近每个 episode 的 oracle 选头表现，并在未见过的 docstring completion 上也有不错的迁移。摘要提到其偏好的 heads 与已有人工或半自动分析得到的已知电路有重合，这说明策略学到的不是纯噪声启发式。全文给出的关键设置包括：模型是 GPT-2 small，动作空间 144，episode 长度 50，8 个并行环境，训练总步数 2×10^5；best-of-K 评估报告 K∈{1,5}。从方法设计看，最重要的实验应包括四类：一是训练曲线，比较单环境 PPO 崩塌与多环境 PPO 稳定训练；二是 reward 设计消融，验证若去掉 control cross-entropy 项，策略会偏向通用脆弱头而不是任务电路；三是与 oracle、随机、可能还有简单贪心基线的比较；四是 held-out docstring 迁移。提供的全文片段没有完整结果表和具体百分比，因此不应虚构数值。但可以明确的是，作者把“泛化到未见任务”作为主要卖点，而不是只在单任务上复现已知头部。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读方法和实验，不必深究 RL 细节。先看 Introduction，明确它要替代的是 ACDC、EAP 这类单任务电路发现流程。然后直接看 Method 里的 reward 定义，这是整篇最有信息量的地方；如果 reward 不成立，后面的 PPO 只是实现细节。接着看 observation 设计和 best-of-K 包装，理解作者为什么把问题做成 sequential search，而不是一次性给 144 个头打分。实验部分优先看三类图表：reward 消融、训练任务与 held-out 任务上的 oracle gap、以及被选 heads 与已知 induction/IOI 电路的重合情况。若只想判断是否值得继续跟，可以用 20-30 分钟读完方法和主要结果。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 contrastive reward 是否真的隔离了 task-specific computation，还是只是偏好“对控制集伤害较小”的头；二是动作空间目前只覆盖 attention heads，若扩展到 MLP、residual stream 或 path-level intervention，RL 是否仍然可扩展。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks whether circuit discovery in mechanistic interpretability can be turned from a bespoke, task-by-task analysis pipeline into a learnable reinforcement-learning problem. Concretely, the goal is to train an agent that interacts with a frozen GPT-2 small by ablating attention heads one at a time and identifying heads that are causally important for a target behavior while being relatively unimportant for general language modeling. The hard part is not ablation itself, but reward design: the agent must discover task-specific circuitry rather than simply attack globally fragile heads.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, so skim is the right level. Still, it has two useful ideas. First, it reframes circuit discovery as a sequential decision problem, suggesting that interpretability procedures may admit transferable policies rather than requiring a fresh handcrafted pipeline for every task. Second, the contrastive reward is the main contribution: damage on the target task is offset by damage on a natural-text control objective, which is an attempt to separate task-specific heads from general-purpose heads. That reward construction is relevant beyond interpretability because it is a concrete example of how to isolate a specialized causal signal from a broader capability signal.
summary_en.technical_approach: The environment is built on frozen GPT-2 small with 12 layers and 12 heads per layer, giving 144 discrete actions. Each action selects one attention head and zero-ablates its output at hook_z. Episodes last up to 50 steps, and repeated selection of the same head within an episode is masked out. Training uses two tasks only, induction and IOI. At every reset, the environment samples one of these tasks and regenerates a fresh batch, so the policy cannot simply memorize a fixed ranking of heads. The reward is the key design choice. For the target task, the paper measures the drop in a task-specific logit-difference metric after ablation. For a control batch of natural English text from WikiText, it measures the increase in cross-entropy. The final reward is the difference between these two effects. Heads that are broadly useful to the model should hurt both the target task and ordinary language modeling, yielding a smaller net reward; heads that are disproportionately important for the target task should receive larger positive reward. The observation includes a one-hot task indicator, a binary mask of previously tried heads, and a vector of normalized rewards for heads already tested in the current episode. This lets the policy adapt its search online within an episode. The policy itself is a small feedforward actor-critic trained with PPO over 8 parallel environments for 2e5 environment steps. At inference time, the authors also add a best-of-K wrapper: the policy samples K candidate actions, the environment scores them in parallel, and the highest-reward action is executed. Generalization is tested on a held-out docstring-completion task never seen during training.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical claim is that a single PPO policy trained on induction and IOI can approach per-episode oracle performance on those tasks and also transfer to an unseen docstring-completion task. The abstract further states that the heads preferred by the learned policy overlap with known circuits identified by prior manual or semi-automated analyses, which is important because it suggests the policy is not merely exploiting noise. The key experimental setup is explicit: GPT-2 small, 144 actions, episode length 50, 8 parallel environments, 2×10^5 total environment steps, and evaluation with K in {1,5}. The most informative experiments are likely the reward ablations, comparisons against oracle and random baselines, training stability with vectorized PPO versus the collapsed single-environment variant, and transfer to the held-out docstring task. The provided text fragment does not include the full result tables, so exact gains should not be fabricated. The important point is that the paper is trying to demonstrate policy-level generalization in circuit discovery, not just recovery of known heads on one benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read as a methods paper with a focused empirical demonstration. Start with the introduction to place it relative to ACDC and EAP, then go straight to the reward definition in the method section. If the contrastive reward is not convincing, the PPO machinery is secondary. After that, read the observation design and the best-of-K decision wrapper to understand why the authors formulate the problem as sequential search rather than one-shot head scoring. In the experiments, prioritize reward ablations, the gap to oracle on train and held-out tasks, and the overlap between selected heads and known induction/IOI circuits. A 20-30 minute pass is enough to decide whether the idea is worth following. The main questions worth probing are whether the control-text subtraction truly isolates task-specific computation, and whether the approach would remain tractable if extended beyond attention heads to MLPs, residual stream components, or path-level interventions.

recommendation.zh: 可看方法和 reward 设计；结论还停在 GPT-2 small 头级搜索，但自动化 circuit discovery 的 setup 比单篇案例分析更可复用。
recommendation.en: Read the method and reward design; the evidence is still GPT-2-small head search, but the automated circuit-discovery setup is more reusable than another hand-built case study.

paper.title: Merge-Bench: Resolve Merge Conflicts with Large Language Models
paper.abstract: This paper applies machine learning to the difficult and important task of version control merging. (1) We constructed a dataset, Merge-Bench, of 7938 real-world merge conflict hunks from 1439 GitHub repositories. The ground truth is the merge resolution that developers committed to the repository. Our dataset construction methodology is scalable to arbitrary amounts of data since no manual labeling is required. (2) We trained a model, LLMergeJ, to resolve merge conflicts in Java programs. Our a

summary.core_problem: 如何构建一个可规模化、尽量抗 reward hacking 的真实世界 merge conflict 基准，并用在线 RL（GRPO）训练 LLM 自动解决代码合并冲突，同时给出可扩展的评测范式。
summary.importance:
对“预训练方法/数据/优化”本身的直接增量有限，因为核心贡献更偏向软件工程任务数据集与 RL 训练实例。但它提供了两个对基座研究仍有参考的点：
- 互联网规模、零人工标注的数据构造：从 VCS 历史自动抽取“问题-答案”（冲突块→开发者提交的解决方案），这类监督信号获取方式可迁移到其他代码编辑/修复类 pretrain 或 mid-train 任务。
- 训练信号设计与 reward hacking 规避：他们明确回避“跑测试套件当 reward”的常见陷阱，提出 test-free 的评测/训练范式与输出归一化流程，这对做 RL-on-code 的人是实用经验。
summary.technical_approach:
数据：Merge-Bench，7938 个真实 merge conflict hunks，来自 1439 个 GitHub 仓库；每个样本包含 diff3 形式的 left/base/right 以及前后各最多 20 行上下文，ground truth 是开发者最终提交的 resolution。构造流程通过回放历史 merge 来自动收集冲突与解决方案，不需要人工标注；并通过控制每仓库采样量提高多样性。
训练：LLMergeJ（14B）用 GRPO 做在线 RL 来生成冲突解决结果。论文把它定位为“human-filter-free SWE-RL”：不做人工筛选/手工规则修补，依赖可规模化的自动评测信号。
评测：提出 test-free 的评测范式，并对不同 merge 工具输出做 normalization，避免格式差异影响匹配；同时做跨语言的商业模型评测（11 种语言）。
summary.experiments: 在 Java 冲突上，LLMergeJ（14B）达到 49% exact match、59% source code match（按论文口径应是归一化后的文本/代码匹配）。论文还声称其表现优于 3 个商业 LLM（具体型号与设置需要在实验章节核对）。此外给出 6 个商业模型在 11 种语言上的对比评测，用于刻画任务难度与泛化差异。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 40–60 分钟）：
- 先看数据构建与过滤细节：如何回放 merge、如何抽取 hunk、如何控制泄漏与多样性，这是最可复用的部分。
- 再看 test-free 评测与 normalization：它决定了 RL reward/离线指标是否可信，也是论文声称“抗 reward hacking”的关键。
- 最后看 GRPO 训练设置与失败案例分析（如果有）：重点关注 reward 设计、采样策略、以及模型输出常见错误类型。
如果你的关注点是基座预训练 recipe，这篇更适合作为“代码领域可规模化监督信号与 RL 评测设计”的参考，而不是直接的 pretrain 方法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: Build a scalable, realistic benchmark for version-control merge conflicts and train an LLM (via online RL with GRPO) to resolve conflicts, using an evaluation paradigm designed to avoid test-suite reward hacking.
summary_en.importance: This is more SWE/RL-for-code than core pretraining methodology, but it offers two reusable ideas for foundation-model training pipelines: (1) scalable supervision mined from VCS history (conflict hunks paired with developer-committed resolutions) without manual labeling, and (2) explicit attention to reward design and reward-hacking avoidance by not relying on running project tests as the primary signal.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Dataset: Merge-Bench with 7,938 real-world conflict hunks from 1,439 GitHub repos. Each example is represented as a diff3-style left/base/right conflict plus up to 20 lines of surrounding context; the label is the resolution text developers actually committed. Collection is automated by replaying merges across branches and sampling to increase diversity.
Training: LLMergeJ (14B) trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in an online RL setup, positioned as a “human-filter-free SWE-RL” task.
Evaluation: a test-free evaluation paradigm plus output normalization to compare merge outputs robustly; additional cross-language evaluation of commercial LLMs across 11 languages.
summary_en.experiments: On Java conflicts, LLMergeJ (14B) reports 49% exact match and 59% source code match (per the paper’s matching/normalization protocol). The paper also reports LLMergeJ outperforming three commercial LLMs on Java (exact model identities and prompting need to be checked in the experiments section). It further benchmarks six commercial models across 11 programming languages.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (40–60 minutes):
- Focus on dataset construction and filtering: merge replay, hunk extraction, diversity controls, and leakage discussion.
- Read the test-free evaluation and normalization carefully; it underpins both the benchmark’s credibility and the RL reward signal.
- Then skim GRPO training details and error analysis (if provided) to understand what the RL signal is actually pushing the model to do.
Treat it as a reference for scalable code supervision and RL evaluation design rather than a pretraining-recipe paper.

recommendation.zh: 值得看数据构造与 GRPO 训练细节：把“开发者最终提交”变成可规模化监督很实用；但指标/判定口径可能偏脆，先当强 baseline+数据资产读。
recommendation.en: Read for the dataset construction and GRPO training signal: turning “final developer commits” into scalable supervision is genuinely useful, but the evaluation protocol may be brittle—treat it as a strong baseline + data asset.

paper.title: UnityMAS-O: A General RL Optimization Framework for LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems
paper.abstract: LLM-based multi-agent systems decompose complex tasks into interacting roles, but most remain manually orchestrated by prompts, tools, and control rules, while agents are rarely optimized through a unified reinforcement learning interface. Existing RL post-training frameworks mainly target single-policy optimization and lack abstractions for user-defined multi-agent workflows, structured interaction, role-specific credit assignment, and configurable parameter sharing.   We present UnityMAS-O, a

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 多智能体系统缺少统一 RL 优化接口的问题，尤其是工作流级优化、角色级 credit assignment 和参数共享配置难以统一表达。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是系统框架与抽象层设计，而不是新的预训练或后训练算法。对研究员的价值在于：它把多智能体 workflow 作为 RL 优化单元，提供了一个较清晰的实验接口，便于研究 role decomposition、共享参数与奖励分配。
summary.technical_approach: UnityMAS-O 用四个一等对象描述多智能体 RL：逻辑角色、图结构轨迹、用户定义奖励、agent-model 映射。它把逻辑 agent 与物理模型参数解耦，支持全共享、全分离和部分共享，并允许在角色、轮次和轨迹层面分配奖励。核心创新是 workflow-level RL abstraction，而非单一 policy 的 PPO/DPO 变体。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和提升幅度，只能确认其目标是覆盖用户自定义多 agent 工作流，并比较不同参数共享和奖励分配策略。缺少 clean setup、强 baseline 和规模信息，当前更像研究基础设施而非结论性算法论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the lack of a unified RL optimization interface for LLM-based multi-agent systems, especially for workflow-level optimization, role-specific credit assignment, and configurable parameter sharing.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is mainly a systems/framework abstraction rather than a new pretraining or post-training algorithm. Its value is that it treats the whole multi-agent workflow as the RL unit, which can help study role decomposition, parameter sharing, and reward allocation in a cleaner setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: UnityMAS-O models multi-agent RL with four first-class objects: logical roles, graph trajectories, user-defined rewards, and agent-model mappings. It decouples logical agents from physical model parameters, enabling full sharing, full separation, and partial sharing, with rewards assignable at role, turn, and trajectory levels. The novelty is the workflow-level RL abstraction, not a new PPO/DPO-style optimizer.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or gains. It appears designed to support user-defined multi-agent workflows and compare parameter-sharing and reward-allocation strategies. Without strong baselines, scale details, or clean ablations in the abstract, it reads more like research infrastructure than a definitive algorithmic result.

recommendation.zh: 更像多-agent RL 实验平台，不直接改 pretrain prior；若你在做 role-sharing 或 workflow credit assignment，只看抽象接口设计，效果数字先别太当真。
recommendation.en: This is closer to a multi-agent RL research scaffold than a result that changes pretraining priors; read it for the abstraction, not for headline gains.

paper.title: ProSR: Process-Shaped Spatial Reasoning for Reliable Chain-of-Thought in VLMs
paper.abstract: Reliable spatial reasoning remains a core bottleneck for vision-language models (VLMs). Existing mainstream training paradigms for spatial reasoning largely rely on outcome alignment or process imitation, lacking explicit constraints on the reasoning process, and therefore struggle to ensure genuine visual dependence and stable reasoning trajectories. In this paper, we construct a high-quality CoT dataset covering diverse spatial phenomena and diagnose the model's reasoning process, revealing tw

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注 VLM 空间推理中的一个老问题：模型即使答对，也不一定真的看图推理，更不一定有稳定的推理过程。作者把问题进一步拆成两个可诊断的过程缺陷。其一是 Spurious Grounding，模型在去掉图像后仍能给出相似 CoT，说明它可能主要依赖语言先验和数据偏置。其二是 Tail Instability，推理后段的不确定性反而上升，说明模型在接近答案时轨迹不稳。论文要解决的不是再做一个更大的空间数据集，而是如何把“过程可靠性”直接写进 RL 目标，而不是只优化最终答案正确率。
summary.importance: 对预训练主线来说，这不是核心论文，但有两个启发点。第一，它把 reasoning 训练中的过程退化现象显式量化了，说明只用 outcome reward 做 RL 很容易学到捷径，这和文本推理、工具使用、甚至代码推理中的 reward hacking 是同类问题。第二，它提出的约束方式不是监督 CoT 文本本身，而是约束推理过程中的不确定性轨迹与反事实行为，这比单纯 imitation 更接近“训练动力学约束”。如果以后把类似思想迁移到纯文本 LM 或多模态统一模型的 post-train，可能会比直接奖励长 CoT 更稳。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两段。先做数据和诊断，再做过程塑形 RL。作者先构建了一个覆盖多类空间现象的 CoT 数据集，用它对模型做 SFT，得到具备初始空间 CoT 能力的 VLM。然后在这个基础上用 vanilla GRPO 做 RL，并系统分析 rollout 行为，发现仅靠最终答案奖励会诱发两类退化：Spurious Grounding 和 Tail Instability。

围绕这两个问题，ProSR 在 GRPO 目标里加入两个过程约束。第一个是 Counterfactual Invariance Penalty，用来抑制伪视觉依赖。具体做法是在 rollout 时额外引入 blank-image 条件，比较真实图像与空白图像条件下的 normalized entropy trajectory。如果两种条件下的不确定性轨迹过于相似，就施加惩罚。直觉上，真正依赖视觉证据的推理过程，在去掉图像后应当明显改变；如果几乎不变，说明模型没有认真用视觉输入。

第二个是 Tail Drift Penalty，用来抑制推理后段的不稳定。作者观察到合理的推理过程中，不确定性应当随着证据积累逐步收敛；若在后半段再次抬升，往往意味着模型在临近答案时发生摇摆、补编理由或切换策略。因此他们对 reasoning tail 的异常熵上升施加惩罚，鼓励轨迹在接近答案时稳定收束。

这个方法和常见 process supervision 的区别在于，它不直接要求模型模仿某条标准 CoT，而是把“是否看图”和“是否稳定收敛”变成可优化的行为约束。这样做的好处是，约束的是过程性质，而不是某种固定表述模板，理论上更有利于泛化。
summary.experiments:
作者在多个复杂和 OOD 空间推理 benchmark 上评测，报告平均准确率比已有方法提升 3.7%。除了答案准确率，论文还专门设计了四个诊断指标来测过程质量：Blank-image Accuracy、Same-Answer Rate、Normalized Trajectory Similarity、Late-Rise Rate。前几项主要测 Spurious Grounding，最后一项主要测 Tail Instability。

实验结论有两层。第一，ProSR 在常规 benchmark 上确实提升了最终任务表现，说明过程约束没有和答案正确率冲突。第二，更关键的是诊断指标同步改善：blank-image 条件下的异常可答性下降，真实图像与空白图像下的轨迹相似度降低，后段不确定性异常上升的比例也下降。这说明模型不是单纯学会了另一种表面模式，而是在更大程度上依赖视觉证据，并且推理轨迹更稳定。

从论文叙述看，作者还做了 vanilla GRPO 与 ProSR 的对比，以及两个 penalty 的消融。预期结论是两个约束各自对应不同退化模式，联合使用效果最好。给出的全文片段没有展开模型规模、训练步数、数据量和每个 benchmark 的逐项数字，因此无法在这里复述更细的表格，但实验设计本身是完整的：先证明问题存在，再证明约束能定向修复问题。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看引言里的问题定义和 Fig.1，确认作者发现的两类退化是否有说服力。然后直接看方法部分关于两个 penalty 的公式和实现，重点理解为什么用 entropy trajectory，而不是直接比较 token 或 CoT 文本。这个选择决定了方法是否只是另一个 process reward engineering。

接着看诊断指标定义和主实验表。若时间有限，优先看 blank-image 相关指标和 late-rise 指标，因为这两组最能说明方法到底有没有改变推理机制。最后看消融，判断 Counterfactual Invariance Penalty 与 Tail Drift Penalty 是否各自解决了对应问题，还是只是共同提供了正则化。

预计 30 到 45 分钟可以完成有效阅读。更值得带着问题去看的点有两个：一是 blank-image 反事实是否会误伤某些强语言先验任务；二是 entropy trajectory 作为过程代理变量是否足够稳健，是否会被解码策略或温度设置影响。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar weakness in VLM spatial reasoning: a model can produce the correct answer without genuinely grounding its reasoning in the image, and even when it does reason, the trajectory may be unstable. The authors make this concrete with two diagnosed failure modes. Spurious Grounding means the model produces similar CoT behavior even when the image is removed, suggesting reliance on language priors or dataset bias. Tail Instability means uncertainty rises again late in the reasoning chain, indicating unstable convergence near answer generation. The goal is therefore not just better spatial accuracy, but process-level reliability under RL training.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to anyone thinking about reasoning optimization. The main lesson is that answer-only RL objectives can induce shortcut behavior even when benchmark accuracy improves. That is directly related to reward hacking in text reasoning, tool use, and code generation. A second useful idea is methodological: instead of supervising a canonical CoT string, the paper constrains process properties through uncertainty trajectories and counterfactual behavior. That is closer to shaping training dynamics than to plain imitation, and the idea could plausibly transfer beyond spatial VLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two stages: diagnosis and process-shaped RL.

First, the authors build a spatial CoT dataset covering diverse spatial phenomena and use it for SFT, producing a VLM with initial chain-of-thought capability. They then continue training with vanilla GRPO using only final-answer correctness and analyze rollout behavior. This reveals two systematic degradations: Spurious Grounding and Tail Instability.

ProSR adds two penalties to the GRPO objective. The first is the Counterfactual Invariance Penalty. During rollout, the model is evaluated not only on the real image but also on a blank-image condition. The method compares the normalized entropy trajectories under the two conditions and penalizes excessive similarity. The intuition is simple: if the reasoning process truly depends on visual evidence, removing the image should materially change the uncertainty profile. If the trajectories remain too similar, the model is likely exploiting non-visual shortcuts.

The second is the Tail Drift Penalty. The authors observe that a healthy reasoning trajectory should gradually become more certain as evidence accumulates. When uncertainty rises again in the later part of the chain, it often signals instability, hesitation, or post-hoc rationalization near the answer. The penalty discourages this late-stage entropy increase and pushes the trajectory toward smoother convergence.

What distinguishes ProSR from standard process supervision is that it does not force the model to imitate a specific reference CoT. Instead, it optimizes for two process properties: visual dependence and stable convergence. That makes the method less tied to a fixed reasoning template and potentially more robust under distribution shift.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports an average accuracy gain of 3.7% over prior methods on multiple challenging and out-of-distribution spatial reasoning benchmarks. More importantly, it introduces four diagnostic metrics to measure process quality: Blank-image Accuracy, Same-Answer Rate, Normalized Trajectory Similarity, and Late-Rise Rate.

The results support two claims. First, ProSR improves standard task accuracy, so the process penalties do not merely regularize at the expense of final performance. Second, the diagnostic metrics improve in the expected direction: the model becomes less answerable under blank-image conditions, the trajectory similarity between real-image and blank-image settings decreases, and late-stage uncertainty spikes become less frequent. That suggests the model is relying more on visual evidence and reasoning more stably, rather than just learning another superficial pattern.

From the paper structure, there are also comparisons against vanilla GRPO and ablations for the two penalties. The likely takeaway is that each penalty targets a different degradation mode and the combination works best. The provided excerpt does not include all benchmark-level numbers, model sizes, or training-budget details, so the summary here focuses on the experimental logic rather than reproducing every table.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a quick read, start with the introduction and the figure that visualizes the two failure modes. The paper is only worth attention if those diagnostics are convincing. Then go straight to the method section and inspect the two penalties, especially why entropy trajectories are used instead of token-level CoT matching. That design choice is central.

Next, read the definitions of the diagnostic metrics and the main results table. If time is limited, prioritize the blank-image diagnostics and the late-rise metric, because they most directly test whether the method changes the reasoning mechanism rather than only the answer distribution. Finally, check the ablations to see whether the Counterfactual Invariance Penalty and Tail Drift Penalty each fix their intended issue or merely act as generic regularizers.

A useful reading time budget is 30 to 45 minutes. Two follow-up questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the blank-image counterfactual could over-penalize tasks with strong language priors, and how sensitive entropy-trajectory diagnostics are to decoding settings such as temperature.

recommendation.zh: 可扫数据诊断和两个 penalty；若证据扎实，它会提醒 VLM RL 不应只盯 outcome reward。
recommendation.en: Skim the diagnostics and the two penalties; if the evidence is clean, it argues against optimizing VLM RL on outcome reward alone.

paper.title: Reinforcement Learning from Denoising Feedback
paper.abstract: Policy loss estimation remains a fundamental and long-standing challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) for diffusion language models (dLLMs). We introduce Reinforcement Learning from Denoising Feedback (RLDF), a novel training paradigm that leverages feedback obtained from rollout and training processes to facilitate accurate and efficient policy loss estimation. To balance the trade-off between computational efficiency and estimation effectiveness, RLDF optimizes the model toward the clipped c

summary.core_problem: 论文解决 diffusion language model 做强化学习时的 policy loss 估计问题。AR 模型可以用一次 causal forward 得到生成序列的 log-prob；dLLM 的生成是多步去噪，注意力是双向的，解码顺序也不固定，因此精确估计策略梯度既难又贵。RLDF 的目标是在估计质量和训练成本之间取得更好的折中。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对新型语言建模范式的 post-training 很关键。LLaDA、Dream 这类 dLLM 已经展示了双向注意力、任意解码顺序、多 token 并行生成的潜力，但 reasoning 能力的提升还缺少成熟 RL recipe。RLDF 给出的不是一个普通的 reward trick，而是针对 dLLM 生成过程重新定义 policy loss 的估计方式。它把 RL 信号接到去噪轨迹上，减少训练和推理之间的 mask pattern mismatch。这对 diffusion LM 能否进入可扩展的 reasoning training pipeline 有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: RLDF 使用两类反馈。第一类是 rollout feedback，记录推理去噪过程中每一步的 unmasking probability 和对应 timestep；这些信息描述了模型实际生成答案时哪些位置、哪些时刻影响更大。第二类是 training feedback，来自去噪训练阶段的预测概率；作者只保留更有信息量的位置，避免把大量低价值或噪声较大的 token 都放进 policy update。基于这些反馈，RLDF 对 timestep 做加权采样，优先选择预测不确定性高、对最终生成更敏感的去噪步骤。损失不是在所有 denoising step 上计算，也不是用 no-masking 或 random-masking 粗略近似，而是在采样到的中间 noisy state 上优化模型预测 clipped clean state \(\hat{x}_0\)。选择 clean state 而不是 next state 是一个重要设计：next-state 目标更贴近一步去噪转移，但容易放大局部误差和引入 loss spike；clean-state 目标把监督信号直接对齐到最终答案，更稳定，也更能利用 verifier reward 或 outcome reward。论文还开源 Drift，一个面向 dLLM 的模块化 RL 框架，用于承载这类算法。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两个代表性 dLLM 架构：LLaDA 和 Dream。任务集中在 math 和 code reasoning。论文报告 RLDF 在两个模型族上都带来稳定提升，并且收敛更快，policy gradient 估计更精确。关键消融包括：与 no-masking、random-masking、全 denoising-step loss 估计的比较；weighted timestep sampling 的作用；使用 clipped clean state \(\hat{x}_0\) 与 next state 作为优化目标的差异。作者特别指出 clean-state 目标能避免 loss spike，并提升训练信号利用率。给出的正文片段没有包含 Table 2 的具体数值，因此不应补写精确提升幅度；但从论文描述看，主要结论不是单点指标，而是 RLDF 在效率、稳定性和泛化上的共同收益。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读方法部分中 policy loss estimation 的推导，以及 rollout feedback、training feedback、weighted timestep sampling 三者如何连接。这里是论文的核心创新。再看 clean state 与 next state 的消融，因为它解释了为什么 dLLM 的 RL 目标不能简单照搬一步转移建模。实验部分重点看 Table 2、收敛曲线、loss spike 分析、timestep sampling 的消融。读的时候可以带着两个问题：第一，RLDF 的采样分布是否会偏向短答案或高置信模板；第二，它和 dLLM 预训练时的随机 masking objective 是否存在可统一的目标函数。如果未来要做 dLLM 的 reasoning mid-training 或 RL pretrain，这两个问题会影响 recipe 的可扩展性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses policy loss estimation for reinforcement learning on diffusion language models. In autoregressive models, sequence log probabilities can be obtained with a single causal forward pass. In dLLMs, generation is an iterative denoising process with bidirectional attention and flexible decoding order, making exact policy loss computation expensive and often intractable. RLDF aims to provide a more accurate and efficient estimator for RL training.
summary_en.importance: The paper is important for post-training diffusion language models. Models such as LLaDA and Dream have attractive modeling properties, including bidirectional attention, arbitrary decoding order, and potential multi-token parallel generation. Their reasoning training pipelines, however, are much less mature than those of autoregressive LLMs. RLDF is not just a reward modification. It reformulates how RL loss should be attached to the denoising trajectory. By reducing the mismatch between training-time masking patterns and inference-time denoising states, it offers a practical path toward scalable reasoning-oriented RL for dLLMs.
summary_en.technical_approach: RLDF uses two sources of denoising feedback. Rollout feedback records unmasking probabilities and timesteps along the actual inference trajectory, capturing which positions and denoising stages matter for the final response. Training feedback comes from predicted probabilities during denoising training, from which the method keeps the more informative positions for stable policy updates. Based on these signals, RLDF applies weighted timestep sampling, prioritizing denoising steps with high predictive uncertainty and larger influence on the final output. The policy loss is computed only on selected steps, rather than over all denoising steps or through coarse no-masking and random-masking approximations. A central design choice is to optimize from intermediate noisy states toward a clipped clean-state estimate \(\hat{x}_0\), instead of optimizing toward the next state. The clean-state target is more directly aligned with the final answer and is reported to reduce loss spikes while improving signal utilization. The paper also introduces Drift, a modular RL framework designed for dLLMs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover two representative diffusion language model families, LLaDA and Dream, with evaluations on math and code reasoning tasks. The paper reports consistent improvements across both architectures, faster convergence, and more precise policy gradient estimation. The key ablations compare RLDF against no-masking estimates, random-masking estimates, and loss computation across denoising steps. Additional ablations study weighted timestep sampling and the choice of clipped clean state versus next-state targets. The clean-state objective is reported to avoid loss spikes and make better use of training signals. The available text does not include the concrete numbers from Table 2, so exact improvement margins should not be inferred. The main experimental message is the joint gain in performance, stability, and training efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the policy loss estimation section carefully. The important mechanism is the connection among rollout feedback, training feedback, and weighted timestep sampling. The clean-state versus next-state ablation is also central, because it explains why RL for dLLMs cannot simply reuse one-step transition objectives. In the experiment section, focus on Table 2, convergence curves, loss spike analysis, and timestep sampling ablations. Two questions are worth keeping in mind: whether the weighted sampling distribution introduces biases toward short or high-confidence generations, and whether RLDF can be unified with the random masking objective used in dLLM pre-training. These questions matter if the method is extended to reasoning mid-training or RL-style pre-training for diffusion language models.

recommendation.zh: 应立刻看 loss 推导和 timestep ablation；它可能改变 dLLM 后训练不适合 RL 的默认判断。
recommendation.en: Read the loss derivation and timestep ablations first; it may weaken the default prior that dLLMs are awkward targets for RL.

paper.title: Hide to Guide: Learning via Semantic Masking
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become a powerful paradigm for improving language models on reasoning-intensive tasks, but its effectiveness is often limited by exploration. For example, models often fail on hard problems, leaving little useful reward signal. External expert traces offer a natural source of guidance, yet they may also expose reward-relevant content along the critical path to the verifier target, such as final answers, intermediate values, executable imp

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决的是 RLVR 中专家轨迹指导和奖励泄漏之间的冲突。完整专家轨迹能帮助探索，但也可能暴露最终答案、中间数值、可执行代码或搜索实体，使策略通过复制关键内容拿到 verifier 奖励，而不是学习可泛化的推理或搜索过程。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值主要在 post-train 与训练信号质量接口。RLVR 的有效性不仅取决于 verifier，也取决于模型在探索时看到了什么条件信息。论文把“专家轨迹不是纯正信号”讲得比较清楚：轨迹同时包含过程脚手架和可被奖励利用的内容。这个视角对构造 SFT/RL 数据、设计 reasoning trace、避免 reward hacking 都有启发，但方法本身是轻量的 guided RL 改造，不是新的预训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Semantic Masked Expert Policy Optimization，简称 SMEPO。它不改变 verifier、奖励函数或 GRPO-style RL 目标，而是在给策略的专家轨迹上做语义遮蔽。核心原则是保留过程结构，例如分解方式、子目标、推理流程和搜索路径；遮蔽与 verifier 目标强相关、位于关键路径上的内容。论文给出三个实例：数学中遮蔽数值内容，避免直接泄露最终答案和中间计算值；代码中遮蔽专家解法代码，避免直接复制可执行实现；agentic search 中遮蔽答案相关实体和 query pivots，减少通过实体匹配绕过搜索过程的机会。相比只给 partial prefix 或 adaptive hints，SMEPO 尝试保留更多专家过程信息，同时降低奖励泄漏。
summary.experiments: 主实验采用每个领域 1k 样本设置，在 Qwen3-8B-Base 上，数学从 47.6 提升到 50.3，代码从 56.5 提升到 59.0，agentic search 从 45.6 提升到 48.8。迁移实验中，Qwen2.5-7B 数学从 42.4 提升到 44.5，DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B 从 61.8 提升到 62.6。SMEPO 还使 hard-math 目标更早达到。在 GHPO 原始数据设置下，加入 SMEPO 将数学平均分从 44.0 提升到 45.6。诊断消融支持论文解释：随机遮蔽无效，固定前缀暴露不稳定，越针对 reward-relevant content 的遮蔽效果越好，说明问题不是简单的上下文长度或噪声，而是泄漏内容的结构性影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25 到 35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 对 failure mode 的定义，它把探索稀疏奖励和专家轨迹泄漏放在同一框架里。方法部分重点看不同领域如何定义 semantic masking target，这比算法公式更关键。实验部分建议看主结果表、hard-math 收敛曲线、GHPO 叠加实验和 masking ablation。若做 RLVR 数据构造，可以重点检查遮蔽规则是否依赖人工启发、是否可能误删必要推理信息，以及遮蔽 token 是否在训练和推理之间形成新的分布差异。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a tension in RL with verifiable rewards: expert traces improve exploration, but full traces can leak verifier-aligned content. A policy may obtain reward by copying final answers, intermediate values, executable code, or answer-related entities, rather than learning the reasoning or search behavior that produced them.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is to the interface between post-training and signal quality. RLVR is not only about the verifier and the RL objective; it also depends on what information the policy is conditioned on during exploration. The paper makes a useful distinction between procedural scaffolding and reward-relevant leakage inside the same expert trace. This is relevant for reasoning-trace design, SFT/RL data construction, and reward-hacking analysis, though the method itself is a lightweight guided-RL intervention rather than a new pretraining method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Semantic Masked Expert Policy Optimization, or SMEPO. It leaves the verifier, reward function, and GRPO-style objective unchanged, and instead modifies the expert trace provided to the policy. The rule is to preserve procedural structure such as decomposition, subgoals, reasoning flow, and search plans, while masking semantic spans that lie on the critical path to the verifier target. The instantiations are domain-specific: numerical content is masked in math traces, expert solution code is masked in coding traces, and answer-related entities are masked in agentic search traces. Compared with partial prefixes or adaptive hints, the method tries to keep more of the expert process while reducing direct reward leakage.
summary_en.experiments: In the main 1k-example-per-domain setting, SMEPO improves Qwen3-8B-Base from 47.6 to 50.3 on math, from 56.5 to 59.0 on code, and from 45.6 to 48.8 on agentic search. The gains also transfer to other math models: Qwen2.5-7B improves from 42.4 to 44.5, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B improves from 61.8 to 62.6. The method reaches hard-math targets earlier than vanilla GRPO. In a GHPO setup using the original GHPO data, adding SMEPO raises the math average from 44.0 to 45.6. Ablations support the leakage explanation: random masking fails, fixed-prefix exposure is unstable, and more targeted removal of reward-relevant content works best.
summary_en.reading_guide: A focused skim should take about 25 to 35 minutes. Start with the Introduction, where the failure mode is defined clearly: sparse exploration rewards on one side and expert-trace leakage on the other. In the method section, focus on how masking targets are chosen for math, code, and agentic search; those design choices matter more than the RL notation. In the experiments, read the main result table, the hard-math convergence analysis, the GHPO combination result, and the masking ablations. For RLVR data work, the key questions are whether the masking rules depend too much on hand-built heuristics, whether they remove useful reasoning information, and whether masked traces create a train-test conditioning mismatch.

recommendation.zh: 针对 RLVR 中引入专家轨迹导致的 reward hacking 问题，提出了语义掩码的解决方案，对关注 RL 训练稳定性和数据合成质量的研究员很有启发。
recommendation.en: Addresses reward hacking caused by expert traces in RLVR using semantic masking; highly insightful for researchers focusing on RL training stability and data synthesis quality.

paper.title: QUEST: Training Frontier Deep Research Agents with Fully Synthetic Tasks
paper.abstract: Deep research agents extend the role of search engines from retrieving keyword-matched pages to synthesizing knowledge, fundamentally changing how humans interact with information. However, frontier systems remain proprietary, while existing open agents often generalize poorly across different task types, leaving unclear how to train a broadly capable deep research agent. We release QUEST, a family of open models (ranging from 2B to 35B) that serve as general-purpose deep research agents designe

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是单点能力，而是“通用 deep research agent 怎么训练”这个配方问题。作者把任务拆成三类彼此相关但训练信号不同的能力：fact seeking、citation grounding、report synthesis。难点在于，这三类能力横跨客观可验证任务和开放式主观任务，现有开源工作通常只覆盖其中一类，或者只有 SFT，没有把中期训练、长轨迹上下文管理、rubric 驱动的 RL 放进同一套流程里。Quest 试图回答的是：在完全开源、且大量依赖合成任务的条件下，能否训练出一个在长时程检索、证据归因和报告写作上都比较均衡的研究代理。
summary.importance: 对预训练/后训练接口的启发大于对纯 pretrain 本身的直接推进。它的重要性主要有三点。第一，它把 deep research agent 的训练拆成可复现的 recipe：mid-training → SFT → RL，而不是只给一个 agent scaffold。第二，它强调“任务可验证性结构”本身就是训练信号设计的核心，尤其是 tree-structured rubric 这一层，把开放式报告任务也部分转成了可优化的分层奖励。第三，它给出一个比较清楚的结论：如果目标是长时程信息搜集与综合，单靠 instruction tuning 不够，模型需要在中期训练阶段先适应搜索式轨迹和外部证据读写，再用 rubric 奖励做能力整合。对做通用 agent pretraining、tool-use mid-training、以及 synthetic curriculum 的人，这篇比单纯 benchmark paper 更有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三根主线。第一是数据合成。作者构建 Quest-8K，一条样本不是简单的 query-answer，而是“复杂查询 + task-specific rubric tree”。这个 rubric tree 用来刻画完成任务需要覆盖的子问题、证据要求和输出结构，因此它既是监督信号，也是后续 RL 的奖励依据。相比只合成最终答案，这种做法更适合长时程任务，因为 agent 的中间行为和最终报告都能被分层评估。

第二是上下文管理。长轨迹 web research 的典型问题是上下文爆炸：搜索结果、网页片段、已发现事实、未解决子问题会迅速堆积。Quest 引入 compact summary 式的 context management，在轨迹推进过程中持续维护压缩后的信息状态，而不是把完整历史无差别塞回上下文。这个设计的意义不只是省 token，更是在训练时显式鼓励“记忆抽象”而不是“原文堆叠”。对 agent 来说，这比普通 RAG 式拼接更接近真实工作流。

第三是训练流程。论文强调完整配方是 MT、SFT、RL 三阶段，而不是任选其一。mid-training 用来让底座模型适应 deep research 相关分布和行为模式；SFT 负责把任务格式、工具调用、报告输出对齐到目标接口；RL 则利用 rubric-based signal 做最后的能力整合，尤其补 report synthesis 和 citation grounding 这类难以靠 exact match 学好的目标。与已有开源系统相比，Quest 的差异不在某个单独模块，而在于把三类能力放进统一训练目标，并且让客观任务和开放任务共享一套 rubric 驱动优化框架。
summary.experiments:
从文中给出的主结果看，Quest 覆盖 2B 到 35B 多个尺度，并在 8 个 benchmark 上评估三类能力。最关键的几个数字是：Quest-35B 在 BrowseComp 上 64.6%，在 Mind2Web 2 上 30.7%，在 DeepResearch Bench 上 48.2%，作者声称超过 OpenAI DeepResearch 等强闭源系统。这个结果如果按论文设定成立，说明统一 recipe 没有明显牺牲某一类能力来换另一类能力。

更有信息量的是训练阶段消融。图 2 和正文都在强调，已有开源方法往往只做 fact seeking 或 report synthesis，且常缺 mid-training 或 rubric RL。Quest 的对比意图很明确：只做 SFT 的系统能力覆盖不完整；加入 MT 后，模型对搜索式任务和长轨迹状态管理更稳；再加 RL，开放式报告和引用约束进一步提升。虽然当前给出的全文片段没有完整消融表数字，但作者明确把 controlled studies 作为主要贡献之一，并且指出小模型也能受益：Quest-2B-SFT、Quest-4B-SFT 已经有“impressive performance”。这说明收益不只来自大模型容量，也来自训练信号设计。

另一个值得注意的实验结论是 scaling。作者覆盖 2B、4B、9B 到 35B，意图展示 deep research agent 能力随模型规模提升，但不是只有大模型才可用。对隐私敏感场景，本地可部署的小模型 research agent 被单独点出，这意味着他们观察到 recipe 在小尺度上也有较好的 sample efficiency 或任务迁移性。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐段细抠。建议先看 Introduction 里对三类能力的定义，以及 Figure 2 的训练配方对比，先建立作者到底在补什么缺口。然后重点看数据合成部分，尤其 Quest-8K 和 rubric tree 的构造方式；这里决定了后面 RL 信号是否可信。再看 context management 章节，关注它维护了什么状态、压缩频率如何、是否会丢失证据链。最后看训练与消融，重点确认三件事：MT 到底喂了什么数据；RL 的 reward 如何从 rubric tree 落到可执行打分；不同能力上哪一阶段贡献最大。

如果时间只有 20–30 分钟，建议顺序是：Figure 1/2 → 数据合成章节 → 训练 recipe 章节 → 主结果表。若要深挖，优先看 rubric-based RL 的实现细节，因为这部分最接近可迁移的方法论；其次看小模型结果，判断这套配方到底是在“放大底座能力”，还是主要依赖大模型先验。
summary.authors_note: OSU NLP 团队；从正文页眉可见为 Ohio State University 相关工作。当前给出的全文片段未包含完整作者列表。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a recipe question rather than a single capability: how to train a broadly capable deep-research agent in an open and reproducible way. The authors frame the problem around three coupled abilities with different supervision regimes: fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. Existing open systems usually cover only one slice of this space, or rely on SFT alone, leaving unclear how to combine long-horizon search behavior, evidence tracking, and open-ended writing into one trainable pipeline. Quest is an attempt to build that unified recipe under fully synthetic task generation.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is at the pretrain/post-train boundary, not in core language-model pretraining alone. Three points matter. First, it turns deep-research-agent training into a concrete stack: mid-training, then SFT, then RL, instead of presenting only an agent framework. Second, it argues that task structure itself should be part of the training signal; the tree-structured rubric is not just an evaluator, but a way to make open-ended report writing partially optimizable. Third, it suggests that instruction tuning alone is insufficient for long-horizon evidence-seeking agents. Models benefit from an intermediate adaptation stage to search-style trajectories and external evidence handling, followed by rubric-based RL to integrate capabilities. That makes the paper relevant to tool-use mid-training, synthetic curricula, and agent-oriented continual adaptation.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. The first is synthetic data construction. Quest-8K is built as more than query-answer pairs: each instance couples a complex research query with a task-specific rubric tree. The rubric encodes subgoals, evidence requirements, and output structure, so it serves both as supervision and as the basis for downstream reward design. Compared with synthesizing only final answers, this is better aligned with long-horizon tasks because both intermediate behavior and final reports can be assessed in a structured way.

The second component is context management. Long web-research trajectories quickly run into context bloat: search results, snippets, discovered facts, unresolved subproblems, and partial drafts all accumulate. Quest maintains compact summaries of the evolving information state instead of naively replaying the full history into the context window. This is not only a token-saving trick. It pushes the model toward abstraction and state tracking, which is closer to how a practical research agent should operate than simple retrieval concatenation.

The third component is the training pipeline itself. The paper emphasizes a full MT → SFT → RL recipe. Mid-training adapts the base model to the distribution and behavior patterns of deep-research tasks. SFT aligns the model to the target interfaces for tool use, task formatting, and report generation. RL then uses rubric-based signals to improve the harder objectives, especially report synthesis and citation grounding, where exact-match supervision is weak or unavailable. The novelty is less about a single module and more about unifying objective and open-ended tasks under one rubric-driven optimization framework.
summary_en.experiments:
The reported results span model sizes from 2B to 35B and evaluate across eight benchmarks covering the three capability groups. The headline numbers are Quest-35B reaching 64.6% on BrowseComp, 30.7% on Mind2Web 2, and 48.2% on DeepResearch Bench, with the paper claiming it surpasses strong proprietary systems including OpenAI DeepResearch. If these results hold under the paper’s setup, the important point is that the unified recipe does not appear to trade away one capability class to gain another.

The more informative part is the stage-wise ablation story. Figure 2 and the surrounding discussion make a clear argument: prior open systems often support only fact seeking or only report synthesis, and many omit either mid-training or rubric-based RL. Quest is designed to show that SFT alone gives incomplete coverage; adding mid-training improves adaptation to search-style tasks and long-horizon state handling; adding RL further improves open-ended report quality and citation-constrained behavior. The excerpt provided here does not include the full ablation tables, but the paper explicitly positions controlled studies as a core contribution.

Another notable result is scaling behavior. The study covers 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B models, aiming to show that deep-research-agent capability scales with model size but is not exclusive to large models. The authors also highlight strong small-model results, including Quest-2B-SFT and Quest-4B-SFT, suggesting that the gains come not only from model capacity but also from better training signals and task structure.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, so read for recipe design rather than implementation minutiae. Start with the introduction and Figure 2 to understand the gap the authors are trying to fill: unified support for fact seeking, citation grounding, and report synthesis. Then read the synthetic data section carefully, especially how Quest-8K and the rubric trees are built, because that determines whether the later RL signal is meaningful. After that, inspect the context-management section and ask what state is preserved, how aggressively it is compressed, and whether evidence chains are lost. Finish with the training and ablation sections, focusing on three questions: what exactly is used in mid-training, how rubric trees are converted into executable rewards, and which stage contributes most to each capability.

If time is limited to 20–30 minutes, the best path is Figure 1/2, then the data synthesis section, then the training recipe, then the main result tables. If you want one part to study more deeply, choose the rubric-based RL design. That is the most transferable idea in the paper.
summary_en.authors_note: OSU NLP / Ohio State University. The provided excerpt does not include the full author list.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“全合成任务+可验证奖励”这条训练接口，不一定改变 agent prior，但很可能给 post-train 数据工厂和 mid-train 设计提供可复用模板；先看数据管线和 RL reward 定义。
recommendation.en: Read it for the synthetic-task plus verifiable-reward training interface; it may not change agent priors, but it is a plausible template for post-training data factories and mid-training design.

paper.title: CODESKILL: Learning Self-Evolving Skills for Coding Agents
paper.abstract: Coding agents produce rich trajectories while solving software-engineering tasks. To enable agent self-evolution, these trajectories can be distilled into reusable procedural skills that compactly encode experience to guide future behavior. However, existing skill construction and maintenance methods often rely on fixed prompts and heuristic update rules, leaving it unclear how knowledge should be selected, abstracted, and maintained to best serve downstream agents. We propose CODESKILL, an LLM-

summary.core_problem: CODESKILL 解决的是编码 Agent 如何从历史交互轨迹中学习可复用技能，并把这些技能维护成一个能持续服务后续任务的技能库。关键点不是再训练下游编码 Agent，而是学习一个“技能管理策略”：决定从哪些轨迹证据中抽取什么、抽象到什么粒度、何时合并或删除已有技能。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train 与 agent self-improvement 有参考价值。它把经验蒸馏、记忆维护、技能更新从固定 prompt 和启发式规则，改成可训练策略，并用下游任务反馈优化。这对构造长期可积累的 Agent 训练信号有启发：轨迹不是只用于 SFT，也可以被压缩成过程性知识，再反过来改善冻结策略的执行。
summary.technical_approach: 方法由三个部分组成。第一，维护一个技能库，每个技能是 markdown 形式的过程性指令，包含标题、触发条件和可执行建议。第二，给定历史轨迹和相关技能上下文，管理模型 Mθ 输出技能操作，包括生成新技能、基于新经验演化旧技能，以及维护技能库，例如添加、合并、删除。第三，训练这个管理模型。训练先用编码 Agent 轨迹和教师模型生成的技能操作做监督 warm start，再用 GRPO 优化。奖励由两类信号组成：一类是可验证的任务结果，检查技能是否帮助冻结的下游编码 Agent 解题；另一类是 rubric-based judge，评估技能质量以及技能与实际行为是否对齐。这个设计的取舍比较清楚：纯任务成功奖励太稀疏，纯 LLM judge 又容易偏离真实执行效果，两者结合能让管理策略同时学到可执行性和可复用性。
summary.experiments: 论文用 Qwen3.5-4B 实例化 CODESKILL，在 EnvBench、SWE-Bench Verified 和 Terminal-Bench 2 上评估。相对无技能基线，平均 pass rate 提升 9.69 个点；相对最强的 prompt-based 技能抽取或记忆构造基线，提升 4.01 个点。对应相对增益约为 33% 和 11%。结果覆盖域内和分布外软件工程任务，说明收益不只是来自记住训练任务细节。最有信息量的实验是冻结下游编码策略后，只改变技能库和技能管理方式，因为这能隔离“管理策略是否真的学会压缩和维护经验”这一问题。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对固定 prompt / heuristic memory 的问题定义，再看 CODESKILL 方法部分，重点是技能表示、操作空间、Update 机制和 GRPO 奖励设计。实验部分重点看三组对比：无技能、prompt-based 技能抽取、CODESKILL；如果有消融，优先看去掉任务奖励、去掉 rubric judge、去掉技能演化或维护操作后的变化。需要带着一个限制去读：该方法优化的是冻结下游 Agent 的外部技能库，不等价于模型权重层面的持续学习；技能是否能跨模型、跨工具栈迁移，需要额外验证。

summary_en.core_problem: CODESKILL studies how a coding agent can turn past software-engineering trajectories into reusable procedural skills, and how those skills should be updated over time. The main problem is skill-bank management: what evidence to extract, how abstract the skill should be, and when to add, revise, merge, or drop skills, without updating the downstream coding agent itself.
summary_en.importance: The paper is not a direct pretraining contribution, but it is useful for post-training and agent self-improvement research. It reframes memory construction as a learnable policy rather than a set of fixed prompts and hand-written update rules. For researchers thinking about trajectory reuse, it shows a concrete route from raw interaction traces to compact procedural knowledge, optimized with downstream execution feedback.
summary_en.technical_approach: CODESKILL maintains a bank of markdown-style skills. Each skill contains a title, a trigger condition, and actionable instructions. Given a trajectory and relevant skill-bank context, the management model Mθ emits an operation: generate a new skill, evolve an existing one with new or failed experience, or maintain the bank through adding, merging, or removing entries. Training has two stages. The model is first warm-started with supervised data built from coding-agent trajectories and teacher-generated skill operations. It is then optimized with GRPO. The reward mixes sparse verifiable task feedback from a frozen downstream coding agent with dense rubric-based judgments of skill quality and behavior-skill alignment. This is a reasonable compromise: task success is the right objective but sparse, while judge feedback is denser but needs grounding in execution outcomes.
summary_en.experiments: The authors instantiate CODESKILL with Qwen3.5-4B and evaluate it on EnvBench, SWE-Bench Verified, and Terminal-Bench 2. CODESKILL improves average pass rate by 9.69 points over the no-skill baseline and by 4.01 points over the strongest prompt-based skill extraction or memory-construction baseline, corresponding to relative gains of about 33% and 11%. The reported gains hold on both in-domain and out-of-distribution software-engineering tasks. The clean part of the setup is that the downstream coding policy is frozen, so improvements can be attributed to the learned skill-management layer rather than to model weight updates.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Read the introduction for the failure mode of prompt-based memory, then focus on the CODESKILL section: skill representation, operation types, the Update procedure, and the GRPO reward. In the experiments, prioritize comparisons against no-skill and prompt-based memory baselines. If ablations are included, the most informative ones are removing task feedback, removing rubric-based judgments, and disabling skill evolution or bank maintenance. A useful caveat to keep in mind is that the method learns an external memory layer for a frozen agent; transfer across base models, tool interfaces, and repository distributions remains the harder question.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法和实验设置；skill bank 的 RL 管理比 prompt 规则干净，但先看是否真跑真实仓库任务。
recommendation.en: Skim the method and setup; RL-managed skill banks are cleaner than prompt heuristics, but the value depends on whether the tasks are real repository work.

paper.title: ATOM: Instantiating Budget-Controllable Multi-Agent Collaboration via Nucleus-Electron Hierarchy
paper.abstract: Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems rely on optimized collaboration topologies to balance performance and communication costs. However, current methods struggle with the inherent stability-extensibility trade-off and often misalign computational budgets with query difficulty. We propose \textsc{ATOM}, an adaptive framework that generates budget-controllable collaboration graphs via a novel task-driven reinforcement learning paradigm. Inspired by atomic structures, \textsc{ATOM}

summary.core_problem: LLM多agent系统的协作拓扑优化中存在稳定性-扩展性权衡，且计算预算通常与查询难度不匹配
