summary.importance: 方法创新：提出核-电子层次结构的自适应多agent框架，通过任务驱动RL学习协作骨干+查询条件动态激活agent
summary.technical_approach: ATOM框架：(1)核-电子层次结构，核为离线学习的稳定协作骨干，电子为推理时动态激活的查询条件agent；(2)复杂度感知预算策略，通过估计查询难度严格调节电子实例化；(3)任务驱动RL范式用于训练协作图
summary.experiments: 在6个多样化benchmark上达到SOTA，同时严格控制计算预算（具体提升幅度未在摘要中给出）

summary_en.core_problem: LLM-based multi-agent systems face a stability-extensibility trade-off in collaboration topologies, and computational budgets are often misaligned with query difficulty
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: adaptive multi-agent framework with nucleus-electron hierarchy combining offline-learned backbone and query-conditioned dynamic agent activation
summary_en.technical_approach: ATOM framework: (1) nucleus-electron hierarchy with stable offline-learned collaboration backbone (nucleus) + dynamically activated query-conditioned agents (electrons) during inference; (2) complexity-aware budgeting strategy estimating query difficulty to regulate electron instantiation; (3) task-driven RL paradigm for training collaboration graphs
summary_en.experiments: Achieves SOTA on six diverse benchmarks while maintaining strict computational budget control (specific improvement magnitudes not stated in abstract)

recommendation.zh: 多agent协作框架方法创新，对预训练研究员参考价值有限，知道核-电子分层+复杂度感知预算这个设计方向即可
recommendation.en: Multi-agent collaboration framework with methodological novelty; limited value for pretraining researchers. Just note the nucleus-electron hierarchy + complexity-aware budgeting design direction.

paper.title: ParaVT: Taming the Tool Prior Paradox for Parallel Tool Use in Agentic Video Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Training large multimodal models (LMMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) to natively invoke video-processing tools (e.g., cropping) has become a promising route to long-video understanding. However, existing native-RL methods dispatch tool calls sequentially (i.e., one per turn): a single wrong crop propagates errors without peer correction, multi-turn tool calls corrupt context, and inference cost scales linearly with the number of turns. We introduce ParaVT, the first multi-agent end-to-end RL-

summary.core_problem: 解决视频 agent 在原生 RL 工具调用中只能串行调用工具、导致误差传播、上下文污染和推理成本线性增长的问题。
summary.importance: 这篇工作更偏 agent RL 与多模态工具使用，不是基座预训练核心论文。但它提出的 Tool Prior Paradox 有一点研究味道：预训练得到的工具先验一方面帮助探索，另一方面会破坏冷启动格式稳定性并诱发 skip-tool 奖励捷径。这对“预训练先验如何与 RL 交互”有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ParaVT，一个并行视频工具调用框架，在单轮中同时发出多个时间窗口 crop 请求，而不是逐轮串行调用。方法上结合 multi-agent 结构与端到端 RL 训练。论文进一步提出 Tool Prior Paradox：强工具先验会在温度采样下放大结构格式不稳定和跳过工具的 reward shortcut。为缓解这一点，作者通过跨模型对比和训练设计来平衡工具探索能力与结构约束。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明实验围绕长视频理解中的原生工具调用展开，比较对象包括现有 sequential tool-calling RL 方法，并做了强弱工具先验模型的对照。论文声称并行调用带来更干净的上下文、更好的容错和更低推理成本，但摘要未给出模型规模、视频 benchmark 名称和具体增益。对预训练研究员而言，真正值得看的不是主结果，而是关于 pretrained prior 与 RL instability 的对照实验。
summary.authors_note: 机构信息为 LMMs-Lab。摘要未提供足够信息确认更具体的团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the limitations of sequential tool calling in video-agent RL, where one wrong crop propagates errors, context gets polluted across turns, and inference cost grows linearly with the number of tool calls.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agentic multimodal RL paper, not a core pretraining paper. The interesting part is the proposed Tool Prior Paradox: pretrained tool priors help exploration but can destabilize structural formatting and create skip-tool reward shortcuts. That interaction between pretrained priors and RL is relevant beyond this specific setup.
summary_en.technical_approach: ParaVT is a parallel video-tool-calling framework that dispatches multiple temporal crop requests in a single turn instead of sequentially. It combines a multi-agent structure with end-to-end RL. The paper argues that standard RL exposes a Tool Prior Paradox: stronger pretrained tool priors improve exploration but worsen format instability and shortcut exploitation under temperature sampling. The method then uses training design and cross-model analysis to balance exploration with structural reliability.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments target long-video understanding with native tool use, comparing against sequential tool-calling RL baselines and contrasting models with stronger versus weaker tool priors. The abstract claims cleaner context, better fault tolerance, and lower inference cost, but does not expose model sizes, benchmark names, or exact gains. For pretraining researchers, the most relevant part is the analysis of how pretrained priors interact with RL instability.

recommendation.zh: 正文不必细读，抓住“Tool Prior Paradox”即可：它提示强预训练先验未必总利于 RL，尤其在格式约束和 shortcut reward 并存时；看对照实验就够。
recommendation.en: You can mostly ignore the full method and just read the Tool Prior Paradox section; it is a useful reminder that stronger pretrained priors can hurt RL when format constraints and reward shortcuts coexist.

paper.title: Value-Gradient Hypothesis of RL for LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning substantially improves pretrained language models, but it remains understudied why critic-free methods such as PPO and GRPO work as well as they do, and when they should provide the largest gains. We develop a value-gradient perspective of critic-free RL for LLM post-training. First, under a differentiable rollout and additive-noise parameterization, we show that the actor update is value-gradient-like in expectation: the backward pass propagates costates whose conditional

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要回答的是一个近两年后训练里很实际、但理论上一直悬着的问题：为什么没有显式 critic 的 PPO/GRPO，在 LLM 上仍然能做长程 credit assignment，而且常常有效？按经典 RL 直觉，只有终局奖励、动作离散、轨迹很长时，纯 score-function 更新应该方差很大，信用分配很弱，不该这么好用。作者的核心论点是：这些方法并不是真的“没有 value 信号”。在可微 rollout 的连续放松下，actor 的更新在期望上等价于一种 value-gradient-like 更新；到了离散 token 的 transformer 策略里，虽然采样本身不可微，但 attention 和残差路径让 autodiff 产生的经验 costate 近似了这个 value gradient。论文进一步把 RL 的收益拆成两部分：一部分是模型当前能传递多少可用的 value-gradient 信号，另一部分是还剩多少 reward headroom 可以被利用。这个分解被用来解释 RL 在预训练不同 checkpoint 上为何效果差异很大。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值不只是给 GRPO 找一个事后解释，而是把 pretrain 与 post-train 的接口讲得更具体了。过去常见说法是：RL 主要靠探索和标量奖励重塑行为，但这很难解释为什么在长序列、终局奖励、无 critic 的设定下仍能稳定提升推理。作者给出的 value-gradient 假说提供了一个更贴近 transformer 机制的解释：反向传播穿过注意力图和隐藏状态时，已经在做某种近似的信用传输。对预训练研究，这有两层意义。第一，它提示 RL 效果并不只由 reward 质量决定，还受 checkpoint 内部表示是否已经足够“可微可传导”影响，因此 checkpoint 选择、mid-training、cooldown 后接 RL 的时机都可能有系统性规律。第二，它把“哪些预训练阶段更适合接 RL”变成了可测的问题，而不是经验拍脑袋。贡献量级上，这更像一个解释框架加预测指标，而不是直接改进算法；但如果后续被验证，它会影响 post-training recipe 设计，尤其是何时开始 RL、该选哪类 base model、以及是否需要先做某种 representation shaping。
summary.technical_approach:
技术路线分三层。

第一层是连续可微 rollout 下的理论化。作者采用 differentiable rollout / additive-noise parameterization，把策略采样写成由噪声驱动的可微变换，然后分析 PPO/GRPO 的 actor 更新。结论是，在这种参数化下，actor 梯度的期望里会出现沿轨迹反传的 costate，而这个 costate 的条件期望等于 value function 对状态的梯度，也就是 value gradient。这里的关键不是把 PPO 变成传统 actor-critic，而是说明即便没有显式训练一个 V 网络，actor 反向传播本身也携带了与 value gradient 同型的信号。

第二层是把这个结论搬到离散 transformer。真实 LLM 不是连续动作控制，而是离散 token 采样。作者讨论了离散采样造成的 sampling gap，并证明 autodiff 计算得到的经验 costate 可以近似连续 BPTT costate，误差受两个因素控制：一是采样离散化带来的 gap，二是策略熵。直观上，分布越尖、采样越接近 argmax，离散动作对隐藏状态的扰动越像一条局部可微路径；同时 transformer 的 attention 让后续 token 的损失能通过上下文表示回传到前面 token 的隐藏状态，于是形成一种“绕过采样瓶颈”的 credit transport。论文强调 attention 不是 value function，但它提供了 value-gradient 信号传播的结构通道。

第三层是 RL-impact decomposition。作者把 RL 带来的潜在收益拆成 usable value-gradient signal 与 reachable reward headroom 的乘性或组合关系。前者衡量当前 checkpoint 的内部表示和策略形状是否允许 reward 信号有效回传；后者衡量当前策略离 reward 饱和还有多远。如果模型太弱，虽然 headroom 大，但 value-gradient 信号可能传不动；如果模型太强，虽然 credit transport 好，但 headroom 已经很小，RL 收益也有限。于是最适合做 RL 的 checkpoint 应该处在一个中间区间：既足够成熟，能传递信用；又没有完全饱和，还留有可优化空间。

与现有解释的区别在于，作者不是从 advantage normalization、group sampling 或 KL regularization 这些训练技巧出发解释 GRPO，而是从反向传播结构本身解释“critic-free 为何不完全 value-free”。这使得论文更像在建立一个机制模型，而不是给出局部经验法则。
summary.experiments:
实验部分主要服务于三个问题：理论信号是否能在真实 transformer 中观测到；这个信号是否与 RL 收益相关；以及它能否用于 checkpoint 选择。

第一类实验验证经验 costate 与 value-gradient-like 信号的对应关系。作者在离散 transformer 上通过 autodiff 提取某种 costate/credit 信号，并考察它与连续放松分析中的目标量之间的一致性。论文报告这种一致性会随着 sampling gap 变小、策略熵降低而增强，这与理论预测一致。也就是说，模型越进入“较确定但未完全塌缩”的生成区间，actor backward pass 越像在传 value gradient。

第二类实验是 RL-impact decomposition 的预测性。作者沿预训练过程取多个 checkpoint，测量 usable value-gradient signal 和 reward headroom，再看实际 PPO/GRPO 后训练增益。主结论是：RL 增益通常不是单调随 base model 变大而增加，而是在中间阶段更明显。早期 checkpoint 因表示和策略形状不成熟，credit 传输弱；后期 checkpoint 虽然更稳定，但 headroom 变小，额外 RL 收益下降。这个结果对“何时接 RL”给出了一种比经验更可操作的判断。

第三类实验应包含若干消融，例如改变采样温度/熵、改变奖励形态（终局奖励或过程奖励）、比较 PPO 与 GRPO、以及分析 attention credit transport 的层或 token 位置分布。论文的叙述重点不是刷 benchmark，而是展示机制变量与 RL 效果之间的相关性和可解释性。

给到的全文片段没有完整实验表格，因此无法可靠列出模型参数量、checkpoint 数量、具体任务集和精确提升幅度。阅读时应重点核对：1）用于定义 usable value-gradient signal 的具体可计算指标；2）它与最终 reward gain 的相关系数或排序一致性；3）不同熵区间、不同长度任务上结论是否稳健。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇值得精读，建议按“理论主线—机制验证—配方启示”三步看。

先看引言和问题设定。重点不是 GRPO 公式本身，而是作者提出的反常识问题：没有 critic，为什么还能做长程信用分配。这个问题抓住了当前 LLM RL 的核心张力。

然后精读连续放松下的理论部分。要看清三件事：一是 additive-noise / differentiable rollout 的假设是什么；二是 costate 如何在 BPTT 中出现；三是为什么它的条件期望会等于 value gradient。这里决定了整篇论文是不是只是在打比方，还是确实建立了一个可推导的对应关系。

接着看离散 transformer 近似部分。重点关注 sampling gap、policy entropy、attention-based credit transport 这三个概念如何进入误差界。这里最值得深挖，因为它直接关系到这个理论能否从连续控制迁移到真实 LLM。

实验部分优先看沿 pretraining checkpoint 的分析图，以及把 RL 增益分解为 signal 与 headroom 的那组结果。如果只能看几张图，就看：1）经验 costate 与理论量的对齐图；2）RL gain 随 checkpoint 变化的曲线；3）decomposition 指标对 checkpoint 排序的预测效果。

最后再回头看方法假设的边界。比如 outcome-only reward 是否足够、group normalization 在理论里扮演什么角色、KL penalty 是不是只起稳定作用、以及高熵采样或强探索场景下这个假说是否会失效。这些地方决定它更像解释现有 RL recipe，还是能指导新的 recipe。

如果已有 RLHF/PPO 背景，主文阅读大约需要 60–90 分钟；若要真正吃透，建议连附录一起看，尤其是证明细节和实验指标定义。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a practical but unresolved question in LLM post-training: why do critic-free methods such as PPO and GRPO still perform meaningful long-horizon credit assignment for language models? Classical RL intuition would predict severe variance and weak temporal credit under discrete actions, long trajectories, and outcome-only rewards, especially without an explicit critic. The central claim here is that these methods are not truly value-free. Under a differentiable rollout with a continuous relaxation, the actor update is value-gradient-like in expectation. In discrete transformer policies, although token sampling is non-differentiable, the empirical costate produced by autodiff through attention and residual pathways approximates that same value-gradient signal. The paper then uses this view to decompose RL gains into two factors: how much usable value-gradient signal a checkpoint can transmit, and how much reward headroom remains to be exploited.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more than a post hoc story for GRPO. It gives a concrete mechanism-level bridge between pretraining and post-training. A common narrative says RL mainly works by exploration plus scalar reward shaping, but that does not explain why long-sequence, terminal-reward, critic-free optimization can still improve reasoning so reliably in transformers. The value-gradient hypothesis offers a more architecture-aware explanation: backward passes through hidden states and attention already carry an approximate credit-transport signal. For pretraining researchers, this matters in two ways. First, RL effectiveness may depend not only on reward quality, but also on whether a checkpoint has learned representations that support this kind of differentiable credit transport. Second, the question of when to start RL becomes measurable rather than purely heuristic. In terms of contribution type, this is primarily an explanatory framework with predictive implications, not a new RL algorithm. But if the hypothesis holds up, it can influence checkpoint selection, mid-training strategy, cooldown design, and the choice of base models for RL post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical argument has three layers.

First, the paper analyzes actor updates under a differentiable rollout / additive-noise parameterization. Policy sampling is written as a differentiable transformation of exogenous noise, and the PPO/GRPO actor gradient is studied in that setting. The result is that the expected actor update contains a trajectory-wise backward-propagated costate whose conditional expectation matches the gradient of the value function with respect to state, i.e. the value gradient. The point is not to reintroduce a learned critic under another name, but to show that even without an explicit value network, the actor backward pass itself can carry a value-gradient-like signal.

Second, the paper transfers this picture to discrete transformer policies. Real LLMs generate discrete tokens, so exact pathwise differentiation is unavailable. The authors analyze the sampling gap induced by discretization and show that the empirical costate obtained by autodiff can approximate the continuous BPTT costate, with error controlled by the sampling gap and policy entropy. Intuitively, when the policy is sharper and sampling stays closer to a locally stable mode, the discrete trajectory behaves more like a differentiable path. Meanwhile, transformer attention provides a structural route for later losses to propagate back through contextual representations, partially bypassing the token-sampling bottleneck. Attention is not itself a value function, but it acts as a transport mechanism for value-gradient-like credit.

Third, the paper derives an RL-impact decomposition. The expected benefit of RL is separated into usable value-gradient signal and reachable reward headroom. The first term captures whether the current checkpoint’s representations and policy geometry allow reward information to propagate effectively. The second captures how much reward improvement is still available before saturation. A weak checkpoint may have large headroom but poor credit transport; a very strong checkpoint may have good transport but little remaining headroom. The best RL starting point should therefore lie in an intermediate regime: mature enough to transmit credit, but not yet saturated.

Relative to prior explanations of GRPO, the novelty is that the paper does not focus on advantage normalization, group sampling, or KL regularization as the main reason for success. Instead, it explains critic-free RL through the backward structure of transformers themselves.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are organized around three questions: whether the proposed signal can be observed in real transformers, whether it predicts RL gains, and whether it helps choose checkpoints.

The first set of experiments validates the correspondence between empirical costates and value-gradient-like signals. The authors extract a costate or credit signal from autodiff in discrete transformers and compare it with the target quantity suggested by the continuous-relaxation analysis. The reported alignment improves as the sampling gap shrinks and policy entropy decreases, which matches the theory. In other words, the actor backward pass looks more value-gradient-like when the model operates in a moderately confident but not fully collapsed regime.

The second set tests the predictive power of the RL-impact decomposition. Multiple checkpoints along pretraining are evaluated, with usable value-gradient signal and reward headroom measured before RL, then compared against actual PPO/GRPO gains. The main result is that RL gains are typically not monotonic in checkpoint maturity. Early checkpoints have more headroom but weaker credit transport; late checkpoints are more stable but closer to reward saturation. Intermediate checkpoints often benefit the most.

The third set likely includes ablations over sampling temperature/entropy, reward structure (terminal-only versus process reward), PPO versus GRPO, and analyses of where attention-based credit transport appears across layers or token positions. The emphasis is not benchmark chasing, but mechanism validation and predictive correlation.

The provided excerpt does not include the full tables, so model sizes, number of checkpoints, task suites, and exact gain values cannot be quoted reliably here. When reading the paper, the most important things to verify are: (1) the concrete computable proxy used for usable value-gradient signal, (2) its correlation or ranking consistency with downstream RL gains, and (3) robustness across entropy regimes and task lengths.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This one is worth a careful read. A good order is: theory first, mechanism validation second, recipe implications third.

Start with the introduction and setup. The key is not the GRPO formula itself, but the motivating puzzle: how can long-range credit assignment work without a critic? That question anchors the whole paper.

Then read the continuous-relaxation theory carefully. Focus on three points: what assumptions are required by the additive-noise / differentiable-rollout setup, how the costate appears through BPTT, and why its conditional expectation matches the value gradient. This determines whether the paper is making a real derivation or only an analogy.

Next, read the discrete-transformer approximation section. Pay close attention to how sampling gap, policy entropy, and attention-based credit transport enter the approximation error. This is the most important part to scrutinize, because it decides whether the theory actually transfers from continuous control to real LLMs.

In the experiments, prioritize the figures that track checkpoints along pretraining and decompose RL gains into signal and headroom. If only a few figures can be read, choose: (1) alignment between empirical costates and the theoretical quantity, (2) RL gain versus checkpoint stage, and (3) checkpoint ranking quality from the decomposition metric.

Finally, revisit the assumptions and failure modes. Check whether outcome-only reward is sufficient, what role group normalization plays in the theory, whether the KL term is merely stabilizing, and whether the hypothesis breaks under high-entropy or strongly exploratory sampling. Those details determine whether the paper is mainly an explanation of current recipes or a guide for designing new ones.

If you already know PPO/RLHF well, the main text should take around 60–90 minutes. To really internalize it, the appendix is worth reading, especially the proofs and the exact metric definitions.

recommendation.zh: 从理论上解释了为什么GRPO等无critic RL能工作——自动微分通过注意力天然传播价值信号。这改变了对RLHF机制的理解，值得做RL-pretrain的人精读。
recommendation.en: Theoretically explains why critic-free RL like GRPO works — autodiff through attention naturally propagates value signals. This changes the understanding of RLHF mechanisms and deserves close reading for anyone doing RL-pretrain.

paper.title: Vector Policy Optimization: Training for Diversity Improves Test-Time Search
paper.abstract: Language models must now generalize out of the box to novel environments and work inside inference-scaling search procedures, such as AlphaEvolve, that select rollouts with a variety of task-specific reward functions. Unfortunately, the standard paradigm of LLM post-training optimizes a pre-specified scalar reward, often leading current LLMs to produce low-entropy response distributions and thus to struggle at displaying the diversity that inference-time search will require. We propose Vector Po

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM RL后训练方法（如GRPO）优化单标量奖励，会导致模型输出分布熵极低，缺乏多样性，无法支撑AlphaEvolve这类推理阶段搜索流程对候选池的多样性要求。
summary.importance: 提出RL后训练的新范式，将训练阶段的多样性探索和推理阶段的搜索利用完全解耦，对代码生成、推理、Agent等依赖推理搜索的任务的后训练流程有直接参考价值，也为预训练与后训练的接口设计提供了新思路：预训练/后训练可以保留多能力维度的分布，而非收敛到单点最优。
summary.technical_approach: 提出向量策略优化（VPO），利用实际任务中奖励天然可分解为多个向量分量的特点（如代码生成的每个测试用例正确性、RLHF的多个评分维度），不将奖励合并为单标量，而是通过随机奖励标量化和多答案生成，训练模型覆盖不同奖励维度组合的帕累托前沿，输出多样的合格解，留给推理阶段的搜索流程做选择。
summary.experiments: 在多跳问答、逻辑推理、导航、工具使用、编码4类场景测试，VPO在best@k指标上匹配或超过最优单标量基线，且性能差距随候选采样预算增大而扩大；在LiveCodeBench上，基于Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct训练的VPO checkpoint比同计算量的GRPO checkpoint在pass@k和best@k上均有提升，在OpenEvolve搜索流程中可以解决GRPO在任何候选预算下都无法解决的问题。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读引言部分的范式转变逻辑、第2节方法核心设计、第4节主要实验结果即可，多目标优化的数学推导细节可跳过，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL post-training methods for LLMs (e.g. GRPO) optimize a single scalar reward, which leads to extremely low entropy of model output distribution. The lack of diversity cannot meet the candidate pool requirement of inference-time search procedures such as AlphaEvolve.
summary_en.importance: This work proposes a new paradigm for RL post-training, which fully decouples diversity exploration in training stage and exploitation in inference-time search. It provides direct reference for post-training workflows of code generation, reasoning, agent tasks that rely on inference search, and also brings new insights for the interface design between pre-training and post-training: pre-training/post-training can preserve multi-dimensional capability distribution instead of converging to a single point optimum.
summary_en.technical_approach: Vector Policy Optimization (VPO) is proposed, which leverages the natural vector decomposition property of rewards in practical tasks (e.g. per-test-case correctness in code generation, multi-criterion scores in RLHF). Instead of merging rewards into a single scalar, VPO combines stochastic reward scalarization and multi-answer generation to train the model to cover the Pareto frontier of different reward dimension combinations, producing diverse competent solutions for inference-time search to select.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across 4 scenarios including multi-hop QA, logical reasoning, navigation, tool use and coding, VPO matches or outperforms the strongest scalar baselines on best@k, and the performance gap widens as the candidate sampling budget increases. On LiveCodeBench, VPO trained Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct outperforms matched-compute GRPO checkpoint on both pass@k and best@k, and solves problems that GRPO cannot solve at any candidate budget when integrated into the OpenEvolve search loop.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paradigm shift argument in introduction, core method design in Section 2, and main experimental results in Section 4. Mathematical derivation details of multi-objective optimization can be skipped. Expected reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读算法和代码任务实验即可；若结果稳，内部 GRPO 训练应加一个多样性/向量奖励 ablation。
recommendation.en: Read the algorithm and code-task experiments; if the gains hold, GRPO pipelines should add a vector-reward diversity ablation.

paper.title: Post-Training is About States, Not Tokens: A State Distribution View of SFT, RL, and On-Policy Distillation
paper.abstract: Large language model post-training methods such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and distillation are often analyzed through their loss functions: maximum likelihood, policy gradients, forward KL, reverse KL, or related objective-level variants. We study a complementary factor: the state distribution on which supervision is applied. For an autoregressive policy, a state is a prompt plus generated prefix. SFT trains on fixed dataset states, while RL and on-policy dist

summary.core_problem: 后训练方法（SFT、RL、蒸馏）通常从损失函数角度分析（MLE、策略梯度、KL散度等），但这一视角无法充分解释一些关键现象：SFT的数据效率高但可能导致灾难性遗忘；RL奖励稀疏却能产生稳定改进；蒸馏中学生有时能超越教师。论文提出关键的补充维度：监督信号所施加的状态分布（state distribution），即模型生成时实际访问的前缀上下文分布。
summary.importance: 对预训练-后训练接口研究有概念性贡献。提出的'状态分布塑造'视角统一了SFT、RL和on-policy蒸馏（OPD），解释了为什么OPD可以超越退化的教师模型，以及为什么RL更新天然具有局部稳定性。这对理解后训练的遗忘/泛化trade-off、设计更好的对齐算法有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: 将自回归后训练形式化为状态分布塑造问题：一个状态（state）是提示+已生成的前缀。SFT在固定的数据集状态上训练（这些状态可能不是模型当前实际访问的）；RL在当前策略采样的轨迹状态上训练；OPD由学生自己采样状态（on-policy），由教师提供局部监督信号。将三种方法统一分解为两个独立选择：状态来源（state source）和信号来源（signal source）。核心论点：后训练行为由监督信号与训练状态分布之间的交互决定；on-policy状态监督可以保持局部性，使学生能够超越退化的教师。
summary.experiments: 在Qwen3-0.6B-Base上做受控实验，目标任务GSM8K，保留性评测TruthfulQA和MMLU。结果：(1) 温和SFT提升GSM8K且几乎无遗忘；(2) 压力SFT产生退化教师（目标精度和保留性都下降）；(3) 从该退化教师进行OPD，在GSM8K、TruthfulQA和MMLU上均超过教师；(4) 轻量on-policy RL提升GSM8K同时保留良好。实验支持的不是简单的'漂移标量'解释，而是更精确的状态中心论主张：训练状态的来源、局部性和学习者依赖性是后训练行为的核心决定因素。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，重点阅读第2章状态分布视角的形式化（理解state vs token的分解）和第3章实验设计与结果。核心概念图（Figure 1如果有）和实验对比表格是关键。预计阅读时间20-25分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Post-training methods (SFT, RL, distillation) are typically analyzed through their loss functions (MLE, policy gradients, KL divergences), but this perspective fails to fully explain key phenomena: SFT is data-efficient but can cause catastrophic forgetting; RL with sparse rewards can produce stable improvements; distillation students sometimes outperform teachers. The paper proposes a complementary dimension: the state distribution on which supervision is applied — the distribution of prefix contexts the model actually visits during generation.
summary_en.importance: Conceptual contribution to the pretrain-posttrain interface. The 'state distribution shaping' view unifies SFT, RL, and on-policy distillation (OPD), explaining why OPD can surpass a degraded teacher and why RL updates are naturally locally stable. Directly relevant for understanding the forgetting/generalization tradeoff in post-training and designing better alignment algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Formalizes autoregressive post-training as state-distribution shaping: a state is a prompt plus generated prefix. SFT trains on fixed dataset states (which may not be states the current model actually visits); RL trains on trajectory states sampled from the current policy; OPD has the student sample states (on-policy) while the teacher provides local supervision signals. Unifies all three methods by decomposing into two independent choices: state source and signal source. Core thesis: post-training behavior is governed by the interaction between supervision signal and training state distribution; on-policy state supervision preserves locality and enables students to improve beyond degraded teachers.
summary_en.experiments: Controlled experiments on Qwen3-0.6B-Base, target task GSM8K, retention evaluations TruthfulQA and MMLU. Results: (1) Mild SFT improves GSM8K with minimal forgetting; (2) Stress SFT produces a degraded teacher (lower target accuracy and retention); (3) OPD from this degraded teacher outperforms the teacher on all three metrics; (4) Lightweight on-policy RL improves GSM8K while preserving retention. Results support a precise state-centric claim over simplistic scalar-drift explanations: state source, locality, and learner-dependence are central to post-training behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim. Focus on Section 2 (state distribution view formalization, the state vs token decomposition) and Section 3 (experimental design and results). The conceptual diagram (Figure 1 if available) and comparison tables are key. Estimated reading time: 20-25 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将SFT/RL/蒸馏统一为状态分布塑造的框架非常有价值，OPD超越退化教师的反常识现象值得注意，实验部分值得精读
recommendation.en: The state-distribution shaping framework unifying SFT/RL/distillation is valuable; the counter-intuitive OPD-beats-degraded-teacher phenomenon warrants attention; experimental section worth close reading

paper.title: Clipping Bottleneck: Stabilizing RLVR via Stochastic Recovery of Near-Boundary Signals
paper.abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a central paradigm for scaling LLM reasoning, yet its optimization often suffers from training instability and suboptimal convergence. Through a systematic dissection of clipping-based GRPO-style objectives, we identify the rigid clipping decision induced by hard clipping as a key practical bottleneck in the studied RLVR setups. Specifically, our analysis suggests that informative signals can lie in the near-boundary region jus

summary.core_problem: 论文关注 RLVR 中 GRPO/DAPO 这类 clipping objective 的训练不稳定问题，核心诊断是：hard clipping 把刚越过边界的 token 梯度直接置零，可能丢掉有用的近边界学习信号。
summary.importance: 这篇论文对预训练研究的直接价值不在于新的基座训练 recipe，而在于它把 RLVR 的不稳定性拆到目标函数内部。RLVR 已经成为推理模型 post-train 的关键环节，clip ratio、advantage、entropy、KL 等信号会反过来影响 mid-train / annealing 数据和策略设计。论文的启发是：训练不稳定不一定只来自奖励噪声、采样温度或数据难度，也可能来自优化目标中一个离散的 keep/drop 决策。这个视角对分析 RL pretrain、verifiable reward 训练和大规模 reasoning model 的训练动态都有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 Near-boundary Stochastic Rescue，简称 NSR。标准 GRPO-style objective 使用 importance ratio r_t(theta) 和 advantage A_t，并通过 clipping 限制 policy update。hard clipping 的问题是二值化：在 trust region 内保留梯度，越界后直接截断，不区分轻微越界和严重越界。NSR 只处理靠近 clip boundary 的 token。对于刚超过边界的 token，它不直接丢弃，而是根据偏离边界的程度进行随机保留；偏离越小，被保留的概率越高。这样做不是简单放宽 clip threshold，也不是扩大 trust region，而是把边界处的硬决策改成概率准入。论文还给出一个机制解释：NSR 在期望意义上类似 soft clipping，会对越界 token 施加近似 1/r^2 的梯度衰减。但消融显示，随机版本优于确定性的 soft-clipping baseline，说明收益不只是来自平滑梯度，还来自 near-boundary 的随机保留机制。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 7B 到 30B 模型，包含 dense 和 MoE 架构，并在 DAPO、GSPO 等 clipping-based RLVR baseline 上作为 plug-in 使用。论文称总训练消耗达到数十万 GPU hours，结果在多个设置中保持一致提升。关键消融包括三类：第一，直接对 clipping boundary 做简单随机扰动也能带来收益，用来支持“边界决策是瓶颈”的诊断；第二，NSR 与 deterministic soft clipping 对比，随机近边界保留更稳；第三，验证 NSR 不是无条件扩大更新区域，而是集中恢复刚越界的 token 梯度。给定内容中没有提供具体 benchmark 分数、提升幅度和每个模型的详细表格，因此这些数字需要看原文实验章节确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 25–35 分钟。重点看三处：第一，GRPO/DAPO clipping objective 的梯度分析，确认 hard clipping 如何导致 out-of-bound token 的梯度消失；第二，NSR 的采样规则和 near-boundary 区间定义，看它和调大 epsilon、KL penalty、entropy bonus 的差别；第三，消融实验，尤其是 stochastic NSR 对 deterministic soft clipping 的优势。如果只关心训练 recipe，可直接看方法公式、训练曲线、clip fraction / entropy / reward 曲线，以及不同模型规模上的稳定性对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies instability in clipping-based RLVR objectives such as GRPO and DAPO. Its main diagnosis is that hard clipping discards gradients from tokens just outside the clipping boundary, even when those near-boundary signals may still be useful.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant as an analysis of RL training dynamics for reasoning models. It does not introduce a new pretraining recipe, but it identifies an internal failure mode of a widely used post-training objective. This matters for base-model researchers because RLVR signals now shape reasoning-oriented mid-training, cooldown, data selection, and policy initialization choices. The paper suggests that instability can come from a discrete decision inside the objective itself, not only from reward noise, exploration settings, or prompt difficulty.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed method is Near-boundary Stochastic Rescue, or NSR. In GRPO-style objectives, the policy update is controlled by an importance ratio r_t(theta) and an advantage estimate A_t. Standard hard clipping creates a binary decision: gradients are kept inside the trust region and removed once the ratio crosses the boundary. NSR changes only the boundary behavior. Tokens that slightly violate the clipping threshold are admitted stochastically, with a retention probability tied to how far they are beyond the boundary. This is different from simply increasing the clipping range. The trust region remains conservative, but near-boundary gradients are not removed indiscriminately. The paper also interprets NSR as an implicit soft-clipping mechanism in expectation, with an approximate 1/r^2 decay on out-of-bound gradients. Ablations indicate that the stochastic formulation is stronger than deterministic soft-clipping variants, so the benefit is not only expectation-level smoothing.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments are run on 7B to 30B models, including both dense and MoE architectures, and NSR is applied as a plug-in modification to clipping-based baselines such as DAPO and GSPO. The paper reports a training budget of hundreds of thousands of GPU hours and consistent gains across the studied settings. The most useful ablations are: simple stochastic perturbations at the clipping boundary already improve performance; NSR outperforms deterministic soft-clipping baselines; and the gains come from rescuing near-boundary tokens rather than broadly relaxing the trust region. The provided content does not include exact benchmark scores or per-model improvements, so the tables in the full experimental section are needed for numerical comparison.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim time: about 25–35 minutes. Focus on the derivation of gradient cutoff in the GRPO/DAPO-style objective, the exact NSR sampling rule, and the ablations separating stochastic boundary rescue from deterministic soft clipping. For training-practice purposes, the most useful plots are likely reward curves, entropy behavior, clipping statistics, and stability comparisons across model sizes.

recommendation.zh: RL训练稳定性是当前RLHF/RLVR的核心痛点之一。NSR用极其简单的随机边界策略缓解了硬裁剪的信号丢失问题，实验验证干净，值得在内部RL训练流水线中快速验证。
recommendation.en: RL training stability is a core pain point in RLHF/RLVR. NSR alleviates hard clipping signal loss with a trivially simple stochastic boundary strategy; clean experimental setup, worth quick verification in internal RL training pipelines.

paper.title: Recursive Agent Optimization
paper.abstract: We introduce Recursive Agent Optimization (RAO), a reinforcement learning approach for training recursive agents: agents that can spawn and delegate sub-tasks to new instantiations of themselves recursively. Recursive agents implement an inference-time scaling algorithm that naturally allows agents to scale to longer contexts and generalize to more difficult problems via divide-and-conquer. RAO provides a method to train models to best take advantage of such recursive inference, teaching agents

summary.core_problem: RAO 解决的是递归式 agent 如何训练的问题：如果推理时允许模型启动子 agent、拆分任务、并行求解和汇总结果，模型本身也需要学会何时委派、如何写子任务、如何跨层传递信息，而不能只把递归当作外部 prompt scaffold。
summary.importance: 这篇更偏 post-train / agent RL，但对预训练研究有一个清晰启发：长上下文和长程任务不一定只靠扩大单一上下文窗口解决，也可以把“新上下文窗口的递归调用”作为 test-time scaling primitive，再用训练把模型适配到这种推理形态。它对基座研究的价值不在模型结构，而在训练目标和推理接口的耦合：如果未来基座模型默认服务于 tool use、delegation、parallel inference，那么预训练或 mid-training 阶段可能需要暴露类似的执行轨迹，而不是只训练线性 token 序列。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把 recursive agent 的执行过程放进 RL 训练环。agent 的动作空间不只是生成最终答案，还包括 launch_subagent、并行 await asyncio.gather、搜索或环境 API 调用、finish 等动作。父 agent 可以给子 agent 一个较小但明确的 goal，子 agent 用新的上下文窗口独立求解，再把结果返回给父 agent 汇总。这样做和普通 multi-agent scaffold 的区别在于：递归决策本身由策略学习，而不是由固定规则决定。训练时限制最大递归深度，测试时可放宽深度；部分设置下还可以加入 delegation bonus，但 TextCraft-Synth 中作者设 λ=0，因为初始化模型已经偶尔会使用递归。核心取舍是，递归增加了 token 和执行管理开销，但换来更大的有效工作记忆、自然的任务分解，以及在子问题独立时的并行 wall-clock 收益。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖三个 benchmark，给出的主要细节包括 TextCraft-Synth 和 Oolong-Real。TextCraft-Synth 是受 TextCraft 启发的合成 crafting 环境，用合成物品和依赖树替代 Minecraft recipe，可通过 crafting tree depth 控制难度：Easy 为深度 2–3，Medium 为 4–6，Hard 为 7–9。模型使用 Qwen-3-4B-Instruct-2507，只在 Medium 上训练，测试 Easy 和 Hard，以考察外推。作者设置两种上下文条件：constrained-context 使用 8K train/inference；unconstrained 使用 40K train、256K inference。后者中单 agent 理论上已有足够上下文，因此可区分“递归带来的分解收益”和“单纯突破上下文限制”。训练最大递归深度为 6，评测可到 12。Oolong-Real 是长 D&D transcript 信息聚合任务，文档至少 55K tokens；训练 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct 时受基础设施限制只能用 32K context。单 agent 不能完整读入输入，只能依赖 regex、字符串匹配或选择性打印片段；递归 agent 则可把长文档切块给子 agent 处理。论文报告 RAO 带来更好的训练效率、可处理超过单模型上下文窗口的任务、对更难任务有外推，并在可并行分解时减少 wall-clock 时间。给出的正文片段没有展示完整数值表，因此精确成功率和提升幅度需要直接看实验表与附录。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，预计 25–35 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 recursive inference 的动机定义，再看方法部分的 action space、RL objective、递归深度控制和是否使用 delegation bonus。实验部分重点看 TextCraft-Synth：它把任务深度、上下文限制、训练难度和测试难度拆得比较清楚，是判断 RAO 是否真的学到分解策略的关键。Oolong-Real 部分适合关注长上下文替代方案：递归切块是否比直接扩长 context 更稳、更便宜。附录 A.3/A.4 值得快速扫一下，主要看 action space 和超参，否则很难判断训练收益来自递归策略，还是来自环境工具设计。

summary_en.core_problem: RAO studies how to train agents that can recursively spawn copies of themselves, delegate subproblems, collect results, and synthesize final answers, instead of treating recursion as a fixed inference-time wrapper around an untrained policy.
summary_en.importance: The paper is more relevant to agent RL and post-training than to core pretraining, but it raises a useful point for foundation-model training: long-horizon capability does not have to come only from a larger monolithic context window. A model can also scale at inference time by opening fresh contexts through recursive calls. The important training lesson is that the inference scaffold and the policy should be optimized together. If delegation, tool use, and parallel execution become standard serving primitives, pretraining or mid-training data may need to expose such execution patterns rather than only linear next-token trajectories.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAO puts recursive execution inside the reinforcement-learning loop. The agent action space includes ordinary environment actions, finishing, search-like APIs, and recursive actions such as launching subagents and awaiting multiple subagent calls in parallel. A parent agent writes a goal for each child agent; each child receives a fresh context, solves its local task, and returns a compact result. The parent then integrates these outputs. This differs from hand-written multi-agent scaffolds because the policy learns when to delegate, how to phrase subtasks, what information to pass across levels, and how to aggregate outputs. Training can cap recursion depth and evaluation can allow deeper recursion. The TextCraft-Synth setting uses no explicit delegation bonus, because the starting model already uses recursion occasionally. The main tradeoff is extra execution and coordination cost versus larger effective working memory, cleaner decomposition, and lower wall-clock time when subproblems can run concurrently.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on three benchmarks; the provided details mainly cover TextCraft-Synth and Oolong-Real. TextCraft-Synth is a controlled crafting environment inspired by TextCraft. It replaces Minecraft recipes with synthetic items and dependency trees, allowing task difficulty to scale by tree depth: Easy tasks have depth 2–3, Medium tasks depth 4–6, and Hard tasks depth 7–9. The model is Qwen-3-4B-Instruct-2507. Training uses only Medium tasks, while evaluation includes Easy and Hard tasks to test extrapolation. Two context regimes are used: an 8K constrained-context setting for both training and inference, and an unconstrained setting with 40K training context and 256K inference context. The latter is useful because a single-agent baseline is not context-limited, so gains are more attributable to decomposition rather than just additional memory. Training allows recursion depth up to 6 and evaluation up to 12. Oolong-Real tests aggregation over very long Dungeons & Dragons transcripts, with inputs of at least 55K tokens. Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct is trained under a 32K context limit, so a single agent cannot read the full document, while a recursive agent can assign chunks to subagents with fresh contexts. The reported qualitative findings are better training efficiency, solving tasks beyond the nominal context window, generalization to harder instances, and reduced wall-clock time when parallel decomposition is possible. Exact success rates and ablation numbers are not visible in the supplied excerpt and should be checked in the experiment tables and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is sufficient, around 25–35 minutes. Start with the introduction to understand why the authors treat recursive inference as a test-time scaling primitive. Then inspect the method section for the action space, RL objective, depth limits, and the role of any delegation bonus. The TextCraft-Synth experiments deserve the most attention because they separate task depth, context limits, training difficulty, and test difficulty. The Oolong-Real section is useful for thinking about recursive decomposition as an alternative to simply extending context length. Appendix A.3 and A.4 are worth a quick pass for action definitions and hyperparameters; without them it is hard to tell whether the gains come from learned delegation or from the engineered environment interface.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不直接改 pretrain，但它把 inference-time scaling 从“更长思维链”改成“可学习的递归委派”；先看方法设定和 ablation，若 compute 控制干净，值得内部复现。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it reframes inference-time scaling from longer CoT to learned recursive delegation; read the setup and ablations first, and only take it seriously if compute is cleanly controlled.

paper.title: DeferMem: Query-Time Evidence Distillation via Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory QA
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents still struggle with long-term memory question answering, where answer-supporting evidence is often scattered across long conversational histories and buried in substantial irrelevant content. Existing memory systems typically process memory before future queries are known, then retrieve the resulting units based on similarity rather than their utility for answering the query. This workflow leaves downstream answerers to denoise retrieved candidates and reconstru

summary.core_problem: 解决长期记忆问答中证据分散、历史噪声大、传统相似度检索难以给出 query-specific supporting evidence 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 LLM agent memory/RAG 框架，而不是基座预训练方法。它的价值在于把“先压缩记忆再等未来查询”的流程改为查询时证据蒸馏，并用 RL 训练 distiller。
summary.technical_approach: DeferMem 先用轻量 segment-link 结构组织原始对话历史，在查询时做高召回候选检索；随后用 memory distiller 将高召回但噪声很大的候选压缩成忠实、自包含、能回答当前问题的证据集合。DistillPO 是用于训练这个 distiller 的强化学习算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要聚焦长期记忆 QA 场景，声称 DeferMem 能从长对话历史中抽取 query-conditioned evidence，减轻 answerer 的去噪和重构负担；未给出 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练数据量或量化提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学 State Key Lab of CAD&CG。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-term memory QA where supporting evidence is scattered across long conversational histories and buried in irrelevant content.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general LLM agent memory/RAG framework rather than a base pretraining method. Its useful idea is to defer memory compression until the query is known and train a distiller with RL to produce answer-useful evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeferMem organizes raw history with a lightweight segment-link structure and retrieves broad high-recall candidates at query time. A memory distiller then compresses noisy candidates into faithful, self-contained evidence for the current query. DistillPO is the reinforcement learning algorithm used to train the distiller.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on long-term memory QA and claims that DeferMem extracts query-conditioned evidence from long histories, reducing denoising and reconstruction burden for the answerer. It does not specify benchmarks, model scale, data size, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 query-time distillation 设计即可；这是 agent memory 工程，不会直接改变 pretrain prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the query-time distillation design only; this is agent-memory engineering, not a pretraining prior changer.

institutions: State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University

paper.title: Maestro: Reinforcement Learning to Orchestrate Hierarchical Model-Skill Ensembles
paper.abstract: The proliferation of large language models (LLMs) and modular skills has endowed autonomous agents with increasingly powerful capabilities. Existing frameworks typically rely on monolithic LLMs and fixed logic to interface with these skills. This gives rise to a critical bottleneck: different LLMs offer distinct advantages across diverse domains, yet current frameworks fail to exploit the complementary strengths of models and skills, thereby limiting their performance on downstream tasks. In thi

summary.core_problem: 解决多模型、多技能 Agent 中的动态调度问题：不同 LLM 和外部技能各有长处，但现有框架多用单一主模型或固定规则，难以按任务状态组合专家能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 Agent 编排方法。它把模型选择和技能调用显式建成序列决策问题，而不是继续扩大单个模型或写静态 workflow；对研究“冻结专家模型 + 轻量策略”的系统形态有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Maestro，将异构多模态任务映射到一个分层 model-skill registry 上。框架训练轻量 RL policy，在每一步决定调用哪个冻结专家模型、哪个技能层级，以及是否继续分解或执行任务。方法核心不是更新基座模型，而是学习编排策略。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明面向异构多模态任务，并强调利用冻结专家模型和两级技能库；未给出模型规模、训练数据、baseline、具体 benchmark 或提升幅度。需要正文确认 RL 训练是否有干净的对照实验，以及性能收益是否来自策略学习而非工具库覆盖。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自清华大学、浙江大学、香港中文大学、南洋理工大学、同济大学。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses dynamic orchestration in multi-model, multi-skill agents: different LLMs and tools specialize in different regimes, while many existing systems rely on a single controller model or fixed routing logic.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent-orchestration contribution. Its value is in formulating model and skill selection as a sequential decision process over frozen experts, rather than scaling one monolithic model or hand-coding a workflow.
summary_en.technical_approach: Maestro builds a hierarchical model-skill registry and trains a lightweight reinforcement-learning policy to choose which expert model or skill to invoke at each step. The base experts remain frozen; the learned component is the routing and composition policy.
summary_en.experiments: The provided abstract mentions heterogeneous multimodal tasks and a two-tier skill library, but does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, benchmarks, or quantitative gains. The main thing to verify in the full paper is whether the RL policy is isolated from tool coverage and prompt-engineering effects.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tsinghua University, Zhejiang University, The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Nanyang Technological University, and Tongji University.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 编排思路备查即可；若正文没有强 ablation，收益很可能混在工具库和路由策略里。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-orchestration reference; without strong ablations, the gain may be mostly tool coverage rather than the learned router.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Spreadsheet systems (e.g., Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets) play a central role in modern data-centric workflows. As AI agents grow increasingly capable of automating complex tasks, such as controlling computers and generating presentations, building an AI-driven spreadsheet agent has emerged as a promising research direction. Most existing spreadsheet agents rely on specialized prompting over general-purpose LLMs; while this design has potentials on simple spreadsheet operations, it struggles to

summary.core_problem: 现有表格Agent依赖通用LLM的prompting策略，难以处理真实场景下复杂多步的电子表格工作流
summary.importance: 方法创新与工程突破，提出首个针对真实Microsoft Excel环境的RL微调框架，配套可扩展的数据集自动化构造pipeline
summary.technical_approach: 提出Spreadsheet-RL框架，从在线论坛自动收集配对的起始-目标表格数据，在真实Excel环境中通过强化学习微调专用表格Agent
summary.experiments: 在金融、供应链管理等领域的专用评测任务上，效果优于现有基于prompting的基线方法
summary.authors_note: 团队来自UIUC和Meta，Minjia Zhang团队长期从事LLM高效训练与Agent相关研究

summary_en.core_problem: Existing spreadsheet agents rely on prompting strategies for general-purpose LLMs, struggle to handle complex multi-step spreadsheet workflows in real scenarios
summary_en.importance: Method innovation and engineering breakthrough, proposes the first RL fine-tuning framework for real Microsoft Excel environment, with a scalable automated dataset construction pipeline
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Spreadsheet-RL framework, automatically collects paired start-goal spreadsheets from online forums, fine-tunes specialized spreadsheet agents via reinforcement learning in real Excel environment
summary_en.experiments: Outperforms existing prompting-based baseline methods on specialized evaluation tasks covering finance, supply chain management and other domains
summary_en.authors_note: Team from UIUC and Meta, Minjia Zhang's group has long been working on LLM efficient training and agent research

recommendation.zh: 特定领域RL微调落地案例，仅作为后训练技术参考，无需阅读正文
recommendation.en: Domain-specific RL fine-tuning use case, only for post-training technique reference, no need to read full text

paper.title: Thinking-while-speaking: A Controlled, Interleaved Reasoning Method for Real-Time Speech Generation
paper.abstract: The thinking-while-speaking paradigm aims to make AI communication more human. A key challenge is maintaining fluent speech while performing deep reasoning. Our method, InterRS, tackles this by inserting reasoning steps only during natural speech generation. This requires high-quality data where reasoning and speech are precisely aligned, and the length ratio are under controlled. We introduce a novel pipeline to generate such seamlessly interleaved audio data. To train our model, we combine int

summary.core_problem: 在实时语音生成里，把“深度推理”塞进“低首包延迟、连续播报”的交互约束中：既要保持流式口语的自然节奏，又要在播报间隙完成足够的推理，避免传统“先想完再说”导致的高延迟，以及朴素“边想边说”带来的过度思考、停顿和语义断裂。
summary.importance: 对预训练本体的直接贡献有限（更偏语音模型的后训练/对齐与数据构造），但对“把推理计算隐藏在可感知延迟之外”的系统-训练协同有启发：1）把输出结构显式化（think/answer 交错）并把长度比作为可控变量；2）用奖励把交互约束（时序/比例/流畅度）写进优化目标；3）展示了语音场景下 CoT 迁移会遇到的独特失败模式（首包延迟、口语流畅度退化、过长回答）。
summary.technical_approach:
方法名 InterRS，核心是把完整响应组织为交错序列 S=(T1,A1,T2,A2,...)：Ti 是后台推理段（不直接播报），Ai 是面向用户的口语化小段总结（流式播报）。关键不在“交错”本身，而在两件事：
1）数据管线：从原始带推理轨迹的数据出发，先做逻辑校验与修复（保证 reasoning path 可用），再把答案侧改写成口语风格摘要；同时把问题做去符号化并用 TTS（文中用 CosyVoice2）合成音频输入。然后把口语摘要按“语义单元/自然停顿”切成多个短 speech units {Ai}，为插入 Ti 留出自然窗口。最后为每个 Ai 合成对应 Ti，并施加长度比约束（thinking-answer ratio），使得在典型端侧推理速度下，Ti+1 的生成时间能被 Ai 的播放时间遮蔽。
2）训练策略：先用交错格式做 SFT，让模型学会受控长度与口语表达；再用 GRPO 做强化学习，引入两个奖励：TA-Balance Reward 用于动态调节思考与回答比例、抑制 over-thinking；Linguistic Quality Reward 用于约束口语流畅与表达质量，减少交错带来的不自然停顿/书面化痕迹。整体上是“结构化输出 + 可控比率数据 + 双奖励对齐”的组合。
summary.experiments: 论文给出的关键信号是：在数学与逻辑类语音基准上，相比 fast CoT 响应提升约 13%（文中点名 Spoken-MQA、SATA-Bench）；同时强调保持 instant response（首包延迟可接受）并在语言质量评测上显著优于传统交错推理模型。当前提供的全文片段未包含更细的表格数字（如模型规模、数据量、奖励权重、覆盖更多任务的绝对分数/置信区间、消融细节），但从方法描述看，最关键的消融应围绕：是否做语义单元切分、是否施加 ratio 约束、两种 reward 各自的边际贡献、以及 RL 前后对“回答长度/停顿/可懂度”的影响。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 20–30 分钟）：
- 重点看 Figure 1（交错推理的时序直觉）和 Figure 2（数据重构与对齐管线），理解他们如何把“可播放的口语片段”做成可控的插槽。
- 方法部分抓住三个关键词：semantic unit splitting、controlled-ratio thinking construction、GRPO + 两个 reward。
- 实验部分优先找：1）与 thinking-before-speaking / 既有 interleaved 方法的对比；2）回答长度分布、停顿/流畅度指标；3）ratio 控制是否真的稳定（否则很容易学成“无限思考”）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to embed non-trivial reasoning into real-time spoken generation under strict interaction constraints: low first-token latency and continuous, fluent streaming speech—without the classic “think-then-speak” delay or the “interleaved thinking” failure modes such as over-thinking, awkward pauses, and semantic discontinuities.
summary_en.importance: Not a core pretraining paper; it is closer to speech-model post-training plus data construction. Still, it offers a useful pattern for foundation-model researchers working on latency-aware reasoning: (1) make the output structure explicit (interleaved think/answer segments) and treat the think-to-speak ratio as a controllable variable; (2) encode interaction constraints directly into RL rewards; (3) highlights why naive CoT transfer to streaming speech breaks (unbounded reasoning length, degraded spoken fluency, overly long responses).
summary_en.technical_approach:
InterRS represents a response as an interleaved sequence S=(T1,A1,T2,A2,...), where Ti is a background reasoning chunk and Ai is a short, colloquial spoken summary streamed to TTS. The main technical work is in:
1) Data synthesis/alignment: verify and repair reasoning traces; rewrite answers into oral-style summaries; de-symbolize questions for auditory clarity and synthesize audio inputs (CosyVoice2). Then split the spoken summary into semantic units {Ai} aligned with natural pauses, creating insertion windows. For each Ai, synthesize a corresponding Ti and enforce a length-ratio constraint so that generating Ti+1 can be hidden behind the playback time of Ai in on-device settings.
2) Training: interleaved SFT to teach controllable length and fluent articulation, followed by GRPO-based RL with two rewards—TA-Balance Reward to regulate the thinking/answer ratio and prevent over-thinking, and Linguistic Quality Reward to maintain fluent, stable spoken output during interleaving. Memory-wise it is a structured-output + constrained-data + reward-shaping recipe.
summary_en.experiments: Reported headline: ~13% improvement over a fast-CoT baseline on spoken math/logic benchmarks (Spoken-MQA, SATA-Bench), while maintaining instant response and better linguistic-quality scores than prior interleaved reasoning approaches. The provided content snippet does not include the full quantitative tables (model size, data scale, detailed ablations, absolute scores), but the most decision-relevant evidence should be: ablations on semantic-unit splitting and ratio constraints, separate contributions of the two rewards, and distributional metrics on response length and fluency/pausing.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Figure 1 for the latency-masking intuition; Figure 2 for the end-to-end data pipeline.
- In Method, focus on semantic unit splitting, controlled-ratio construction, and GRPO with the two rewards.
- In Experiments, look for: comparisons to think-before-speak and existing interleaving baselines; fluency/pausing metrics; and whether ratio control is stable (a common failure is runaway thinking).

recommendation.zh: 只看数据构造和 reward 设计；13% 结论先打折，但语音 LM 的延迟-推理权衡值得记录。
recommendation.en: Skim the data pipeline and reward design; discount the 13% claim for now, but note the latency–reasoning tradeoff for speech LMs.

paper.title: Multi-Step Likelihood-Ratio Correction for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) plays a pivotal role in improving the reasoning ability of large language models. However, widely used PPO surrogate objectives are fundamentally local, as they rely on a local approximation of the exact policy gradient objective. While this approximation improves stability by reducing the variance induced by importance sampling, it also introduces structural bias into the surrogate objective, which must be controlled through trust region mec

summary.core_problem: 现有用于LLM推理能力提升的可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）普遍采用的PPO类代理目标是局部近似的，仅使用当前token的似然比，忽略了策略更新对后续生成token概率的影响，会引入结构性偏差；而使用全路径似然比又会因乘积项过多导致估计方差过高、训练不稳定，形成难以调和的偏差-方差两难问题。
summary.importance: 为连接预训练与后训练的RL阶段提供了可调节的偏差-方差权衡旋钮，能在不损失训练稳定性的前提下减少PPO类方法的结构性偏差，提升RLVR阶段的推理能力学习效率，也为RLHF/RLAIF的算法设计提供了新的理论和实践框架。
summary.technical_approach: 首先从精确策略提升恒等式出发，证明PPO局部代理目标的偏差来源于省略了未来token的前向似然比乘积（全前向迹）；随后提出N步前向迹构造：每个token的更新仅保留后续N-1个token的似然比乘积，在PPO（N=1，无未来修正）和精确策略梯度（N=T，全路径修正）之间平滑插值。理论证明N增大时，截断偏差以O((T-N)²δ²)的速率下降，方差随N指数增长，N成为可调控的偏差-方差权衡参数。基于此提出N步前向迹策略优化（NFPO），在掩码策略梯度框架下实现。
summary.experiments: 在多个推理基准测试中，NFPO效果一致优于或持平GRPO、DPPO等现有RLVR基线；机制分析显示前向迹修正会集中作用于推理相关token，还能通过聚合未来token的学习信号过滤局部似然比的噪声，提升训练稳定性；不同N的对照实验也验证了理论预测的偏差-方差权衡关系。
summary.reading_guide: 推荐优先阅读第1章的问题提出和第2章的精确策略提升恒等式推导，15分钟左右可掌握核心逻辑。关心落地实现的读者可参考第3章的NFPO算法细节，第4章的训练动态机制分析部分可快速浏览。

summary_en.core_problem: PPO-style surrogate objectives widely used in reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) for LLM reasoning improvement are inherently local: they only use likelihood ratios of the current token, ignoring the impact of policy updates on the probability of subsequent generated tokens, which introduces structural bias. Meanwhile, using full-trajectory likelihood ratios leads to excessive estimation variance and unstable training due to multiplication of many token-level ratios, creating a bias-variance dilemma in RLVR.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a principled, tunable knob for bias-variance trade-off in RLVR, which can reduce the structural bias of PPO-style methods without sacrificing training stability. It improves the efficiency of reasoning ability learning in the RL stage connecting pretraining and post-training, and offers a new theoretical and practical framework for RLHF/RLAIF algorithm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Starting from the exact policy improvement identity, the work first proves that the bias of PPO's local surrogate objective comes from omitting the product of forward likelihood ratios for future tokens (full forward trace). It then proposes the N-step forward trace construction: for each token's update, only the product of likelihood ratios of the next N-1 tokens is retained, interpolating between PPO (N=1, no future correction) and exact policy gradient (N=T, full-trajectory correction). Theoretical analysis shows that increasing N reduces truncation bias at a rate of O((T-N)²δ²), while variance grows exponentially with N, making N a tunable trade-off parameter. Based on this, the N-step Forward-Trace Policy Optimization (NFPO) algorithm is proposed and implemented within a masked policy gradient framework.
summary_en.experiments: On multiple reasoning benchmarks, NFPO consistently outperforms or matches existing RLVR baselines including GRPO and DPPO. Mechanistic analysis shows that forward trace correction concentrates on reasoning-related tokens, and filters noise in local likelihood ratios by aggregating learning signals from future tokens to improve training stability. Experiments with varying N values also validate the theoretically predicted bias-variance trade-off relationship.
summary_en.reading_guide: For core insights, read Chapter 1 (problem statement) and Chapter 2 (exact policy improvement identity derivation), which takes around 15 minutes. Readers interested in implementation can refer to Chapter 3 for NFPO algorithm details; Chapter 4's mechanistic analysis of training dynamics is worth a quick scan.

recommendation.zh: RLVR 方法的核心改进，N=1 退化为 PPO、N→∞ 趋近精确梯度的连续插值设计很巧妙，做 RL 后训练的研究员应看 §3 的核心推导。
recommendation.en: Clever continuous interpolation design for RLVR — NFPO reduces to PPO at N=1 and approaches exact gradient as N→∞. Researchers doing RL post-training should study the core derivation in §3.

paper.title: ClaimDiff-RL: Fine-Grained Caption Reinforcement Learning through Visual Claim Comparison
paper.abstract: Long-form image captioning exposes a reward granularity problem in RL: captions are judged as whole sequences, while the important errors occur at the level of individual visual claims. A good dense caption should be both faithful and informative, avoiding hallucination without omitting salient details. Yet pairwise preferences, reference-based metrics, and holistic scalar rewards compress these local errors into a single sequence-level signal, obscuring the tradeoff between factuality and cover

summary.core_problem: ClaimDiff-RL 解决的是长图像描述 RL 的奖励粒度问题：整段 caption 的单一 reward 无法区分 hallucination、遗漏、正确补充细节等局部 visual claim 级错误，容易把模型推向过度保守的 under-captioning。
summary.importance: 这项工作对 VLM 后训练和 reward 设计有启发，但和基座预训练的关系较间接。主要价值在于展示一种更细粒度的多模态 reward interface：先把开放式输出拆成可验证的局部 claims，再聚合成 scalar reward。这个思路可迁移到 multimodal instruction tuning、RLHF/RLAIF、视觉推理数据合成等场景，尤其适合那些答案不是单一标签、错误分布很稀疏的任务。
summary.technical_approach: 方法保留标准 RL 所需的 scalar reward，但改变 reward 的生成方式。给定图像、actor caption 和 reference caption，multimodal judge 先枚举 actor 与 reference 之间的具体视觉差异，例如物体、属性、数量、空间关系、OCR、身份或场景细节；然后逐项回到图像中验证；最后分别给 actor side 和 reference side 标注 typed errors。reference 只作为比较锚点，不被当作完整真值。基于这些 typed error statistics，作者构造两类 reward：relative reward 比较 actor-side 与 reference-side 错误；actor-only reward 只惩罚 actor 在已发现差异上的错误。这样可以在 faithfulness 与 coverage 之间选择不同工作点。
summary.experiments: 实验结论强调 reward 粒度带来的行为差异。holistic reward 无论是否使用 reference，都容易通过减少描述内容来降低 hallucination，结果是 omission 增加、caption 变保守。ClaimDiff-RL 能更明确地区分“少说所以少错”和“覆盖更多且仍然 grounded”，因此在 factuality 与 coverage 的权衡上更可控。作者还报告该方法能保持或提升 captioning 与 VQA 能力，说明 fine-grained reward 没有简单牺牲下游视觉语言能力。提供材料中没有足够具体数字，不能判断增益量级。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 15 到 20 分钟。重点看方法图和 claim-difference judge 的 prompt/输出格式，理解 actor-reference-image 三方比较如何产生 typed errors。然后看 relative reward 与 actor-only reward 的定义，它们决定了模型会偏向更保守还是更覆盖。实验部分优先看 holistic reward 导致 omission 上升的分析，以及 captioning/VQA 能力保持情况。若只关心 LLM/VLM 后训练，可跳过具体 caption 数据集细节，把注意力放在 reward decomposition 和 judge reliability 上。

summary_en.core_problem: ClaimDiff-RL addresses reward granularity in RL for long-form image captioning. A single sequence-level reward cannot tell whether a caption improved by becoming more faithful, by omitting details, or by adding correct and incorrect visual claims. This often pushes models toward conservative under-captioning.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is most relevant to multimodal post-training and reward design rather than core pretraining. Its useful idea is to replace direct holistic judging with a structured verification interface: decompose open-ended outputs into local visual claims, verify those claims against the image, and only then compose a scalar reward for RL. This pattern can transfer to multimodal instruction tuning, RLAIF, visual reasoning supervision, and synthetic data filtering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework still produces a scalar reward compatible with standard RL, but obtains it through claim-level comparison. Given an image, an actor caption, and a reference caption, a multimodal judge enumerates concrete differences between the actor and the reference, verifies each difference against the image, and assigns side-specific typed errors. The reference is used as a comparison anchor, not as exhaustive ground truth. The same judge output supports two reward compositions. A relative reward compares actor-side errors with reference-side errors. An actor-only reward removes reference-side error counts and penalizes only actor-side errors on the discovered differences. These two choices expose different points on the faithfulness-coverage frontier.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical finding is behavioral. Holistic rewards, with or without a reference, can reduce hallucination by making captions shorter and less informative, increasing omissions. ClaimDiff-RL provides a more controllable trade-off because it distinguishes unsupported actor claims from missing or correct details. The authors report that it preserves or improves captioning and VQA capability, suggesting that the finer reward does not simply overfit to a narrow caption metric. The provided material does not include enough numerical detail to assess the exact magnitude of the gains.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 15 to 20 minutes. Focus on the method figure and the judge output schema: the important part is how actor-reference-image comparison becomes typed error statistics. Then read the definitions of the relative and actor-only rewards, since they determine the model’s operating point between faithfulness and coverage. In the experiments, look for the analysis showing omission growth under holistic rewards and the checks on captioning and VQA retention. If the interest is general VLM post-training, dataset-specific captioning details can be read lightly; judge reliability and reward decomposition are the parts worth inspecting.

recommendation.zh: 多模态 RL 的细粒度 Reward 设计，将 sequence-level 拆解为 atomic claim 级别，对 VLM post-training 的 reward model 设计有一定参考价值。
recommendation.en: Fine-grained reward design for multimodal RL, decomposing sequence-level rewards into atomic claims. Offers reference value for reward model design in VLM post-training.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Mem-$π$: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate
paper.abstract: We present Mem-$π$, a framework for adaptive memory in large language model (LLM) agents, where useful guidance is generated on demand rather than retrieved from external memory stores. Existing memory-augmented agents typically rely on similarity-based retrieval from episodic memory banks or skill libraries, returning static entries that often misalign with the current context. In contrast, Mem-$π$ uses a dedicated language or vision-language model with its own parameters, separate from the dow

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agent memory 的一个老问题：现有方法大多把记忆做成检索库，推理时从过往轨迹里取相似片段，再塞回上下文。但 agent 场景里的“有用经验”往往不是一条静态片段，而是要根据当前任务、环境状态和执行阶段重新组织成一条短而准的提示。检索式 memory 容易出现三类失配：一是取回内容和当前上下文只部分相关；二是经验过于具体，迁移不到新情境；三是 memory 总是被调用，错误提示会直接干扰下游 agent 行为。Mem-π 的核心问题因此不是单纯“如何生成记忆”，而是同时学习两个决策：什么时候该给 memory，什么时候该 abstain；以及一旦要给，应该生成什么样的 guidance 才能提高最终任务成功率。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接改 pretrain recipe 的论文，但对“参数化记忆”和“把经验压进模型而不是外部库”这个方向有明确启发。它把 memory 从 retrieval module 改成独立的生成策略模型，等于把一部分长期经验做成可训练的条件生成器。这和预训练里常见的外部检索增强形成了一个对照：不是扩大上下文，而是把可复用经验蒸馏进参数，再按需生成。更重要的是，它强调 abstention 和 counterfactual credit assignment，这一点对任何会向主模型注入辅助信号的系统都很关键，包括 tool hints、reasoning hints、critic feedback，甚至 post-train 阶段的 verifier/reflector。贡献量级上，它更像一个方法范式和训练目标设计，而不是通用基础模型层面的范式替换。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分两层。第一层是建模选择：把 memory 定义成独立参数化策略 π_mem，而不是 memory bank。输入是当前 context，包括任务指令 q 和环境观察 o；输出不是最终动作，而是一段插入到下游 agent 上下文中的 guidance m，或者选择不生成。这样做的直接好处是 memory 模块和执行 agent 解耦：可以用较小的本地模型专门学经验压缩，再服务更强的主 agent。

训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 experience distillation。作者先构造离线经验库 E={(x,m)}，其中 x 是上下文，m 是从成功轨迹或经验总结中得到的 guidance。用监督学习让 π_mem 学会在给定上下文下复现这些可复用提示，相当于把经验库压缩进参数。第二阶段是 adaptation distillation，用 RL 直接根据下游任务结果优化 memory policy。关键点不在“用了 RL”，而在它怎么处理 decision 和 content 的耦合。

作者提出 decision-content decoupled objective，基于 GRPO 做结构化对比 rollout。对于同一个上下文，会构造至少两类分支：生成 guidance 与 abstain；在生成分支内部，还会比较不同 guidance 内容带来的结果差异。这样 advantage 被拆成两部分：decision-level advantage 负责学习“该不该生成”，content-level advantage 负责学习“生成什么”。如果只把整个 memory 输出当成一个普通序列做 policy gradient，模型很难知道失败是因为不该生成，还是因为生成内容不对。这个拆分是全文最有信息量的设计。

从系统角度看，Mem-π 不是让 memory 永久在线，而是把它做成一个可拒答的 intervention policy。作者强调在弱 grounding、模糊上下文、OOD 情况下，错误 guidance 会污染 agent，因此 abstention 不是附属功能，而是可靠性机制。和一些 always-on generated memory 方法相比，这里更接近 selective auxiliary generation。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖四类 agent benchmark：WebArena、WorkArena、LifelongAgentBench、ALFWorld，分别对应网页操作、企业工作流、终端工具使用和文本环境 embodied task。论文给出的主结论是，adaptive memory generation 在四个 benchmark 上都优于 retrieval-based memory baselines，平均相对 base agent 提升约 20%，其中 WebArena 上相对提升接近 50%。从任务性质看，这个结果说明生成式 memory 对长程、多阶段、上下文依赖强的 agent 任务更有帮助，因为这类任务里“经验重组”比“相似片段复用”更重要。

消融的重点应当有三类。第一，是否需要两阶段训练。只做监督蒸馏通常能学到可读 guidance，但未必和最终任务成功率对齐；加入 RL 后，memory 会更偏向产生真正有用而不是表面合理的提示。第二，是否需要 decision-content decoupling。若去掉 decoupling，模型往往过度生成，或者无法稳定学会 abstain。第三，和 retrieval memory、always-on generated memory、以及不带 memory 的 base agent 比较，可以看出收益主要来自“按需生成”而不是单纯“多一个辅助模型”。

从摘要和正文可见，作者更强调相对增益而不是超大规模绝对分数。没有看到它在参数量或数据量上追求极限，重点是 memory policy 的训练信号设计。若精读全文，建议特别留意不同 benchmark 上的触发率、abstention 率、生成长度、以及错误 guidance 对成功率的负贡献，这些细节比单一平均分更能说明方法是否可靠。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和方法图，确认它解决的不是传统 RAG memory，而是“生成式、可拒答的 memory policy”。然后重点看 decision-content decoupled objective 的定义和 rollout 构造方式，这是和已有 generated memory 工作拉开差异的地方。实验部分优先看三张内容：主表里的四个 benchmark 结果；abstention/always-on 的对比；以及 RL 与 SFT 两阶段训练的消融。若时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线。若要继续深挖，值得问两个问题：一，经验库中的 guidance 是如何构造和清洗的，是否存在 teacher leakage；二，memory policy 学到的是可泛化经验，还是 benchmark-specific prompt pattern。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a recurring weakness in agent memory systems: most existing methods treat memory as retrieval from an external bank, but useful experience in agent settings is often not a static past fragment. It needs to be reconstructed into a short, context-specific hint conditioned on the current task, observation, and execution stage. Retrieval-based memory therefore fails in three ways: the retrieved item is only partially relevant, it is too specific to transfer, or it is injected even when no memory should be used. Mem-π frames the problem as a joint policy over two decisions: when to provide memory and when to abstain, and what guidance to generate if memory should be provided at all.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it turns reusable experience into a parametric generator rather than an ever-growing external store. That is a meaningful contrast to retrieval-heavy augmentation: instead of expanding context with stored trajectories, it compresses experience into model parameters and regenerates task-adaptive hints on demand. The abstention mechanism and the counterfactual credit assignment are also broadly useful ideas for any auxiliary signal injected into a stronger model, including tool hints, reasoning hints, critic feedback, or verifier outputs. The contribution is best read as a training-objective and systems-design idea, not as a new base-model paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two key layers. First is the modeling choice: memory is a separate parametric policy π_mem rather than a memory bank. The input is the current context x=(q,o), where q is the task specification and o is the environment observation. The output is either a short textual guidance m inserted into the downstream agent context, or an abstention decision. This decouples specialization from execution: a smaller model can specialize as memory, while a larger frontier agent remains the executor.

Training is done in two stages. Stage one is experience distillation. The authors build an offline experience bank E={(x,m)} and train π_mem with supervised learning to reproduce reusable guidance from context. This compresses the experience bank into the memory model parameters. Stage two is adaptation distillation, where reinforcement learning optimizes the memory policy directly against downstream task outcomes.

The main technical point is the decision-content decoupled objective built on GRPO. For the same context, the training procedure constructs structured counterfactual rollouts that compare at least two branches: generate guidance versus abstain. Within the generate branch, different candidate guidance contents are also compared. This lets the learning signal be decomposed into a decision-level advantage for whether memory should be generated, and a content-level advantage for what the guidance should say. Without this decomposition, a standard sequence-level policy gradient would conflate two failure modes: generating when it should not, and generating the wrong content when it should. That decomposition is the most important idea in the paper.

From a systems perspective, Mem-π is not an always-on helper. It is a selective intervention policy with abstention as a reliability mechanism. The paper explicitly argues that under weak grounding, ambiguity, or OOD contexts, bad generated memory can harm the downstream agent. That makes abstention central rather than optional.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans four agent benchmarks: WebArena, WorkArena, LifelongAgentBench, and ALFWorld, covering web navigation, enterprise workflow tasks, terminal tool use, and text-based embodied environments. The headline result is that adaptive memory generation consistently beats retrieval-based memory baselines on all four benchmarks, with roughly 20% average relative improvement over the base agent and nearly 50% relative gain on WebArena. The pattern suggests that generated memory is especially useful when tasks are long-horizon, multi-stage, and strongly context-dependent, where experience recomposition matters more than nearest-neighbor reuse.

The most informative ablations are likely threefold. First, the two-stage training pipeline: supervised distillation alone can produce plausible guidance, but RL is needed to align memory generation with actual task success. Second, the decision-content decoupling: removing it should lead to over-generation or unstable abstention behavior. Third, comparisons against retrieval memory, always-on generated memory, and the no-memory base agent clarify that the gain comes from selective generation rather than merely adding another model.

The paper emphasizes relative gains more than scale. It is not trying to win by sheer parameter count or data volume. The interesting evidence is in trigger rates, abstention rates, guidance length, and the measured harm from bad guidance. Those details matter more than a single average score if one wants to judge whether the method is reliable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the method overview to see that this is not standard RAG-style memory, but a generative memory policy with abstention. Then read the section defining the decision-content decoupled objective and the structured rollout construction; that is where the paper separates itself from prior generated-memory work. In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, the comparison between abstention and always-on generation, and the ablation on the two-stage SFT+RL pipeline. A 30–40 minute skim is enough to capture the main idea. For deeper reading, focus on two questions: how the offline guidance bank is constructed and filtered, and whether the learned memory policy captures transferable experience or mostly benchmark-specific prompting patterns.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RL abstention 设计即可；把记忆改成生成器是干净想法，但离预训练还隔着 Agent 外环。
recommendation.en: Read the RL abstention design only; generative memory is a clean idea, but it remains an agent-layer mechanism, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Training Language Agents to Learn from Experience
paper.abstract: Language agents can adapt from experience in interactive environments, but current reflection-based methods can only self-correct within a single task instance. Whether such experience can be distilled into reusable lessons that improve performance on future unseen tasks remains unclear. We address this problem by introducing the In-context Training (ICT) task, a framework for evaluating cross-task self-improvement in language agents. In ICT, a reflector model observes trajectories collected by

summary.core_problem: 现有语言 Agent 的 reflection 多用于同一任务实例内的自我纠错，缺少对“经验能否沉淀成可迁移策略”的评测和训练框架。这项工作把问题改成跨任务在线改进：Actor 每轮只能尝试一批新的未见任务，Reflector 必须根据过去轨迹生成新的 system prompt，让 Actor 在未来未见任务上表现更好。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值不在模型规模或数据配比，而在 post-train 与 test-time learning 接口。它把“从交互经验中学习”从单实例 retry 变成可评测的跨实例能力，并把自然语言 prompt 当作一种可检查的外部记忆和策略参数。这个设置对研究 Agent 持续学习、反思数据合成、RL 训练信号设计有参考意义，但离基座预训练 recipe 还有距离，适合泛读。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含两层。第一层是 ICT，即 In-context Training 任务定义。Actor 按当前 system prompt 与环境交互，收集成功和失败轨迹；Reflector 读取当前 prompt 和这些轨迹，输出下一轮 system prompt。关键约束是下一轮面对新任务，不能通过重复同一实例来纠错。第二层是训练 Reflector 的 RL pipeline。训练信号来自新 prompt 在后续任务 batch 上带来的 Actor 成功率变化，而不是人工写好的 reflection 示例。与 Reflexion 这类方法相比，差异在于优化目标从“修正下一次同题尝试”变为“提炼可跨任务使用的策略说明”。MetaGym 则把普通 gym-like 环境包装成 meta-environment，用来构造这种多轮经验—反思—新任务循环。
summary.experiments: 实验主要在 ALFWorld 和 MiniHack 上验证。ALFWorld 覆盖家庭环境中的文字交互任务，MiniHack 更接近程序化生成的探索和解谜环境。结果显示，经过训练的 Reflector 能在未见 task types 上提升 Actor 表现，并且在少量经验后生成更有效的 system prompt。文中还报告了跨 benchmark 或跨环境迁移的案例，说明 learned reflection 不完全依赖单一环境模板。更有信息量的实验点是消融：普通自反思或未训练 Reflector 难以稳定产生跨任务收益；直接依赖标量成功率训练的策略不如显式生成可读 prompt 那样容易迁移和诊断。由于给定内容中未提供完整表格数字，具体成功率提升需要查实验表。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。先看 ICT 定义和 Figure 1，确认它如何避免同题 retry 带来的评测泄漏；再看 Reflector 训练流程，重点关注 reward 如何从未来任务表现回传到 prompt 生成；最后看 ALFWorld、MiniHack 的未见任务划分和消融实验。值得深挖的是两个问题：一是生成的 prompt 是否真的学到抽象策略，还是记住 benchmark 风格；二是这种自然语言外部策略能否与参数更新、memory buffer 或 offline RL 数据结合。

summary_en.core_problem: Current reflection-based language agents mostly improve by retrying the same task instance. This work asks a sharper question: can an agent convert past interaction trajectories into reusable lessons that improve performance on future unseen tasks? The proposed ICT setting forces the actor to face new task batches each round, while a reflector updates the system prompt from previous experience.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is at the interface between post-training, agent learning, and test-time adaptation. It treats natural-language prompts as inspectable policy parameters and provides a controlled way to evaluate whether experience can transfer across task instances. This is useful for studying continual agent learning and RL-based reflection data generation, though it is not a core pretraining recipe paper.
summary_en.technical_approach: The framework has two components. ICT defines a dual-model loop: an actor interacts with environments under a system prompt, trajectories are collected, and a reflector produces a revised prompt for the next batch of unseen tasks. The training pipeline then optimizes the reflector from experience without human-written reflection targets. The reward is tied to whether the generated prompt improves the actor on later tasks. Compared with Reflexion-style methods, the target is not same-instance self-correction but cross-task strategy extraction. MetaGym is introduced as a library for turning gym-like environments into meta-environments suitable for this loop.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical evaluation uses ALFWorld and MiniHack. The trained reflector improves actor performance on unseen task types after observing a small number of trajectories, and the paper reports cases of transfer beyond the training benchmark. The informative comparisons are against untrained or generic reflection baselines, which are less reliable at producing prompts that generalize across tasks. The supplied content does not include the full numerical tables, so exact success-rate deltas should be checked in the experiment section.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Read the ICT task definition and Figure 1 first, because the evaluation protocol is the main contribution. Then inspect the reflector training loop and how future-task rewards are assigned to prompt generation. The most useful experimental details are the unseen task splits, the reflection baselines, and the transfer cases. The key question to keep in mind is whether the learned prompts encode reusable strategies or mainly exploit benchmark-specific regularities.

recommendation.zh: 读 ICT 定义和 held-out family 设置即可；它更像 agent 后训练信号实验，不会直接改 pretrain recipe，但可借鉴经验蒸馏接口。
recommendation.en: Read the ICT definition and held-out-family setup; this is an agent post-training signal study, not a pretraining recipe, but the experience-distillation interface is useful.

paper.title: GROW: Aligning GRPO with State-Action Modeling for Open-World VLM Agents
paper.abstract: Recently, vision-language model (VLM) agents have shown promising progress in open-world tasks, where successful task completion often requires multiple turns of visual perception and action execution. However, existing methods still rely primarily on Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) with expert demonstrations, while the advanced reinforcement learning (RL) algorithm, specifically Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), has not been effectively employed for multi-turn RL in these tasks because st

summary.core_problem: 现有开放世界VLM Agent训练主要依赖有监督微调（SFT），需要大量高成本专家演示数据；直接将GRPO这类RL算法迁移到开放世界多轮任务时，标准GRPO要求以完整轨迹作为训练样本，会导致上下文过长、噪声过多，降低策略梯度估计质量。
summary.importance: 为预训练后RL对齐阶段的长轨迹任务优化提供可行路径，降低VLM Agent规模化RL训练的数据和上下文开销，对多模态Agent的RL训练范式有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出GROW RL训练框架，将GRPO采样得到的完整长轨迹拆解为细粒度状态-动作对样本，在同一组rollout的状态-动作样本间计算相对优势，不需要额外训练价值模型；通过代理分析证明即使分组样本基于不同局部状态而非相同prompt，优化目标依然能输出有效的策略梯度信号；训练分为冷启动的状态-动作样本训练和GRPO策略微调两个阶段。
summary.experiments: 在Minecraft环境的800多个任务上测试，覆盖具身导航、GUI操作、动态对抗三类场景，相比基线方法在成功率和执行效率上表现更优，同时具备未见过任务的泛化能力，能习得主动目标重捕获、抗干扰GUI操作等可复用交互策略，而非单纯记忆轨迹。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注方法部分的轨迹拆解逻辑、代理分析证明，以及Minecraft任务的实验结果对比，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Most existing open-world VLM agent training relies on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which requires large volumes of high-cost expert demonstration data. When directly applying GRPO, a widely adopted RL algorithm, to open-world multi-turn tasks, standard GRPO uses full trajectories as training samples, leading to excessively long context and high noise that degrades policy gradient estimation quality.
summary_en.importance: Provides a feasible solution for long-trajectory task optimization in post-pretrain RL alignment, reduces data and context overhead for large-scale RL training of VLM agents, and offers reference for RL training paradigms of multimodal agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes the GROW RL training framework, which decomposes full long trajectories sampled by GRPO into fine-grained state-action pair samples, and calculates relative advantages among state-action samples from the same rollout group without training an additional value model.
