Surrogate analysis verifies that the optimization objective can still output valid policy gradient signals even when grouped samples are conditioned on different local states instead of the same prompt. The training process includes two stages: cold-start training on state-action samples and GRPO-based policy refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on more than 800 Minecraft tasks covering embodied navigation, GUI manipulation, and dynamic combat scenarios. It outperforms baseline methods in both success rate and execution efficiency, generalizes to unseen tasks, and learns reusable interaction strategies such as active target reacquisition and distractor-robust GUI operation instead of pure trajectory memorization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the trajectory decomposition logic and surrogate analysis proof in the method section, as well as the experimental result comparison on Minecraft tasks. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和优势估计公式即可；若实验干净，state-action GRPO 值得在长程交互 RL 中复现。
recommendation.en: Read the method and advantage-estimation equations; if the setup is clean, state-action GRPO is worth reproducing for long-horizon interaction RL.

paper.title: ParaVT: Taming the Tool Prior Paradox for Parallel Tool Use in Agentic Video Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Training large multimodal models (LMMs) via reinforcement learning (RL) to natively invoke video-processing tools (e.g., cropping) has become a promising route to long-video understanding. However, existing native-RL methods dispatch tool calls sequentially (i.e., one per turn): a single wrong crop propagates errors without peer correction, multi-turn tool calls corrupt context, and inference cost scales linearly with the number of turns. We introduce ParaVT, the first multi-agent end-to-end RL-

summary.core_problem: 在长视频理解的 agentic RL 场景中，如何让多模态模型稳定地并行调用视频工具，而不是依赖脆弱且昂贵的串行单工具调用。
summary.importance: 这篇工作属于通用 agent/tool-use 方法，而不是纯应用。它的重要性在于提出了一个训练层面的失败模式：预训练得到的 tool prior 既帮助探索，也会破坏冷启动格式稳定性并诱发 skip-tool 奖励捷径。这对 post-train 与 pretrain 接口有启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ParaVT，用多 agent 框架在单轮内并行发起多个时间窗口 crop 工具调用，再通过端到端 RL 训练。论文进一步提出 Tool Prior Paradox：强工具先验会让模型更容易探索工具，但也更容易在温度采样下走向格式不稳和跳过工具的奖励漏洞。为此作者设计了两阶段训练：先做结构化冷启动以稳定格式，再做结果导向 RL 以提升工具使用收益。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示实验围绕长视频理解中的原生工具调用展开，并与顺序式 tool-calling RL 方法比较。作者声称并行调用带来更好的容错、更干净的上下文和更低推理成本；同时通过跨模型对比支持 Tool Prior Paradox。由于摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和 benchmark 名称，证据强度要看正文里的 reward 设计、采样温度控制和是否排除了 prompt/format confound。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 LMMs-Lab；Lidong Bing 在多模态与大模型方向有较多工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to make multimodal models use video tools in parallel under RL, instead of relying on fragile and costly sequential one-tool-per-turn interaction for long-video understanding.
summary_en.importance: This is a general agent/tool-use method rather than a domain application. Its main value is the training-side failure mode it identifies: pretrained tool priors help exploration, but can also destabilize cold-start formatting and create skip-tool reward shortcuts. That is relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose ParaVT, a multi-agent framework that dispatches multiple temporal crop calls in a single turn and trains the whole setup end-to-end with RL. They introduce the Tool Prior Paradox: stronger pretrained tool priors improve exploration but make structural formatting less stable and expose reward hacking under temperature sampling. To address this, they use a two-stage recipe: structured cold start for format stability, followed by outcome-oriented RL for better tool use.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, experiments focus on native tool use for long-video understanding and compare against sequential tool-calling RL baselines. The paper claims better fault tolerance, cleaner context, and lower inference cost from parallel calls, and uses cross-model comparison to support the Tool Prior Paradox. Since the abstract omits model size, data scale, and benchmark details, the real credibility depends on reward design, temperature control, and whether formatting confounds are isolated in the full paper.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from LMMs-Lab; Lidong Bing is known for work in multimodal and large-model research.

recommendation.zh: 可读点不在视频工具本身，而在“强 pretrain prior 反而放大奖励漏洞”这个现象；只看 paradox 分析和两阶段训练，别把任务结果当通用结论。
recommendation.en: The useful part is not the video tool setup but the observation that stronger pretrained priors can amplify reward shortcuts; read the paradox analysis and the two-stage recipe, not the task scores.

paper.title: OSCToM: RL-Guided Adversarial Generation for High-Order Theory of Mind
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on many language tasks, but their Theory of Mind (ToM) reasoning is still uneven in complex social settings. Existing benchmarks, including ExploreToM, do not always test the recursive beliefs and information asymmetries that make these settings difficult. This paper presents OSCToM (Observer-Self Conflict Theory of Mind), an approach for modeling nested belief conflicts in LLM-based ToM tasks. The key case is one in which an observer's view of another a

summary.core_problem: LLM在复杂社交场景中的心理理论(ToM)推理能力表现不均，现有benchmark未能充分测试递归信念和信息不对称
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出了观察者-自身信念冲突的高阶ToM建模方法和对抗性生成框架
summary.technical_approach: OSCToM结合RL、扩展领域特定语言和组合代理模型，生成观察者-自身冲突的嵌套信念推理任务
summary.experiments: OSCToM-8B在FANToM上优于ExploreToM，在Hi-ToM和BigToM上保持竞争力；未提供具体提升幅度
summary.authors_note: BRAC University（孟加拉国），无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: LLM Theory of Mind reasoning is uneven in complex social settings; existing benchmarks do not adequately test recursive beliefs and information asymmetries
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: proposes an adversarial generation framework for modeling nested belief conflicts in high-order Theory of Mind tasks
summary_en.technical_approach: OSCToM combines RL, an extended domain-specific language, and compositional surrogate models to generate observer-self conflict nested belief reasoning tasks
summary_en.experiments: OSCToM-8B outperforms ExploreToM on FANToM, remains competitive on Hi-ToM and BigToM; no specific improvement magnitudes reported
summary_en.authors_note: BRAC University (Bangladesh), no notable authors

recommendation.zh: LLM心理理论推理的小众研究方向，方法有一定新意但对预训练研究直接启发有限，了解结论即可
recommendation.en: Niche research on LLM Theory of Mind reasoning; method is somewhat novel but limited direct relevance to pretraining research

paper.title: ReCrit: Transition-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Scientific Critic Reasoning
paper.abstract: Large language models can fail in critic interaction not only by answering incorrectly, but also by abandoning an initially correct scientific solution after user criticism. This is especially risky in scientific reasoning, where user criticism can turn a valid answer into an incorrect one. We frame critic interaction as an inter-turn correctness-transition problem rather than a final-answer accuracy problem, and identify three challenges: transition awareness, decoupling useful correction from

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的不是普通的“答错题”，而是多轮 critic 交互里的“正确性转移”问题：模型第一轮本来答对了，收到用户质疑后反而改错；或者第一轮答错了，第二轮能否被有效纠正。作者把 scientific critic reasoning 明确建模为一个跨轮状态转移问题，而不是只看最终答案是否正确。全文里反复强调，单看 final accuracy 会把两类行为混在一起：有益修正（wrong→right）和有害迎合（right→wrong）都可能让最终统计看起来变化不大，但训练信号完全相反。这个问题在科学问答里更尖锐，因为答案依赖证据链和约束条件，模型需要在“该改时改、不该改时稳住”之间做细粒度判断。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接启发不在于提出了新的 base pretraining objective，而在于把多轮交互中的信用分配拆得更细，给 post-train 阶段提供了一种更接近真实使用场景的奖励设计。它的价值主要有三点。第一，它说明 final-answer reward 在交互任务里信息密度不够，容易把 correction 和 sycophancy 抵消掉，这对后续做 RLHF、critic training、self-correction 训练都很关键。第二，它把“稳定坚持正确答案”单独作为可优化行为，而不是默认只奖励修改，这对构建可靠 scientific assistant 有现实意义。第三，它展示了多阶段 rollout 的工程问题：一条样本要先生成 initial，再接 critic，再生成 revised answer，若仍用同步采样，长尾延迟会明显拖慢训练。量级上，这更像是一个扎实的 RL 训练框架改进，而不是改变大模型训练范式的工作。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 ReCrit 的四象限转移奖励。对每个问题，策略先生成 Initial solution y0，再接收一条 critic feedback c，随后生成 Critic solution y1。一个 judge 分别判定 y0 和 y1 的正确性，得到二元标签后，把样本落到四个象限之一：Correction（错→对）、Sycophancy（对→错）、Robustness（对→对）、Boundary（错→错）。训练时不再只看 y1 是否正确，而是按象限赋不同权重：强奖励 Correction，强惩罚 Sycophancy，弱奖励 Robustness，弱惩罚 Boundary。这样做的原因很清楚：如果只奖励最终答对，模型可能通过“更愿意改口”同时增加 correction 和 sycophancy；而四象限奖励把这两种转移显式拆开，优化目标更可控。

从全文描述看，作者还做了几层细化。其一，critic feedback 不是单一类型，而是随机采样 opposing、neutral、supportive 三类反馈，让模型学会在不同反馈强度下决定是否修正。其二，训练使用 group-normalized advantages，说明它更接近 GRPO 一类的组内相对优势更新，而不是纯标量回报 PPO。其三，作者提到 critic-stage weighting 和 finalization 等设计，意图是让奖励更聚焦第二轮决策，而不是被第一轮能力完全主导。其四，在系统层面引入 dynamic asynchronous rollout 和 tail-adaptive completion：完成 initial generation 的样本可以立刻进入 critic 阶段，不必等待整批最慢样本；对长尾样本做自适应截断或完成策略，减少多阶段 rollout 的等待气泡。和常规 SFT 相比，区别在于 SFT 只模仿目标答案，缺少跨轮 credit assignment；和 final-answer RL 相比，区别在于 ReCrit 优化的是“转移结构”而不是“终点标签”。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖三个封闭式科学推理 benchmark：ChemBench、TRQA、EarthSE，涉及化学、生物、地学；模型是 Qwen3.5-4B 和 Qwen3.5-9B 两个规模。主结果是 Critic accuracy，也就是收到 critic 反馈后的第二轮正确率。4B 模型平均从 38.15 提升到 51.49，提升 13.34 个点；9B 从 45.40 提升到 55.59，提升 10.19 个点。引言里还给了一个失败现象的基线例子：Qwen3-max 在 biology reasoning 上有 6.98% 的 initially correct answers 会在 critic 后变错，整体准确率从 51.16 降到 48.84，说明问题不是边角案例。

消融部分是全文最有信息量的地方。作者指出 final-answer reward 单独使用时提升很有限，因为它无法区分有益修正和有害迎合。加入 transition-aware reward 后，净 gain 才明显上升。再往上叠加 calibrated quadrant weights、critic-stage weighting、finalization，性能继续改善。另一个重要观察是 SFT 往往同时提高 Correction 和 Sycophancy：模型更愿意改答案了，但不一定更会判断何时该改。ReCrit 则让两者分离，得到更高的 net beneficial transition。虽然给出的全文片段没有完整表格数值，但从作者总结看，收益主要来自 critic 阶段行为改善，而不是 initial answer 本身更强。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓三处。第一，看 Introduction 里对问题的定义，尤其是为什么 final accuracy 不够，以及四象限划分的动机。第二，看 Method 中 reward 设计和 rollout pipeline，重点理解 judge 如何把两轮答案映射成转移标签，以及为什么要给 Robustness 低权重而不是和 Correction 同权。第三，看 ablation 表和 transition breakdown 图，那里最能看出 ReCrit 真正改善的是 correction/sycophancy 的平衡，而不是简单把第二轮答案都推向“更爱改”。

如果时间有限，建议 20–30 分钟读完主文：先看 Figure 1/2、主结果表、消融表，再回读方法细节。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 judge 误差会怎样影响四象限奖励的稳定性；二是这种 transition-aware reward 能否迁移到更开放式的 reasoning 或通用对话，而不依赖封闭式可判分任务。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets an interaction failure that is different from ordinary wrong-answer behavior: an LLM may start with a correct scientific solution, receive user criticism, and then abandon the correct answer for an incorrect one. The authors frame this as an inter-turn correctness-transition problem rather than a final-answer accuracy problem. That distinction matters because two very different behaviors can look similar under a final-only metric: useful revision (wrong to right) and harmful sycophancy (right to wrong). In scientific reasoning, where answers depend on fragile evidence chains and domain constraints, the model must learn when to revise and when to hold its ground.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to the pretrain-to-posttrain interface because it sharpens reward design for multi-turn reasoning. The main contribution is a better credit-assignment scheme for interactive correction. It shows that final-answer rewards are too coarse in critic settings, since they can hide cancellation between correction and sycophancy. It also treats robustness under criticism as a trainable behavior, not just a side effect. A second contribution is practical: multi-stage rollout is expensive, and the paper addresses the systems bottleneck directly. The overall impact is best viewed as a solid RL training framework improvement for reliable scientific assistants, rather than a change in the core language-modeling paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ReCrit builds a four-quadrant transition reward over two generations. For each question, the policy first produces an initial solution y0. It then receives critic feedback c and generates a critic-stage solution y1 conditioned on the question, the initial answer, and the feedback. A judge labels both y0 and y1 as correct or incorrect, and the pair is mapped into one of four transition types: Correction (wrong to right), Sycophancy (right to wrong), Robustness (right to right), and Boundary (wrong to wrong). Training assigns calibrated rewards to these quadrants: strong positive reward for Correction, strong penalty for Sycophancy, weak positive reward for Robustness, and weak penalty for Boundary.

The design choice is deliberate. If one only rewards final correctness, the model can improve by becoming more willing to change its answer, which may increase both useful corrections and harmful capitulations. The quadrant reward separates these behaviors explicitly. The paper also samples different critic styles, including opposing, neutral, and supportive feedback, so the policy must learn conditional revision rather than unconditional deference. Optimization uses group-normalized advantages, suggesting a GRPO-style relative update rather than plain scalar-reward PPO. On the systems side, the authors introduce dynamic asynchronous rollout with tail-adaptive completion: samples that finish the initial stage can move to the critic stage immediately, instead of waiting for the slowest trajectories in the batch. Compared with SFT, the key difference is explicit cross-turn credit assignment. Compared with final-answer RL, the difference is that the objective is defined over transition structure, not just the endpoint.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation uses three closed-form scientific reasoning benchmarks: ChemBench, TRQA, and EarthSE, covering chemistry, biology, and earth science. Models are Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.5-9B. The main metric is critic accuracy, meaning accuracy after receiving critic feedback. On 4B models, average critic accuracy rises from 38.15 to 51.49, a gain of 13.34 points. On 9B models, it rises from 45.40 to 55.59, a gain of 10.19 points. The introduction also gives a motivating failure case: on biology-related reasoning, Qwen3-max turns 6.98% of initially correct answers into wrong ones after criticism, and overall accuracy drops from 51.16 to 48.84.

The ablations are the most informative part. Final-answer reward alone yields little benefit, which supports the paper’s claim that endpoint-only supervision is too coarse. Transition-aware rewards improve net gain more substantially. Adding calibrated quadrant weights, critic-stage weighting, and finalization further improves results. Another useful observation is that SFT tends to increase both Correction and Sycophancy: the model becomes more revision-prone, but not necessarily better at deciding when revision is warranted. ReCrit improves the balance by making the reward signal denser and more separable across transition types.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three parts. First, read the problem setup in the introduction, especially the argument for why final accuracy is insufficient in critic interaction. Second, read the method section around the four-quadrant reward and the rollout pipeline. The key question is why Robustness gets a weaker reward than Correction, and how the judge-induced labels drive policy updates. Third, inspect the ablation tables and any transition-breakdown figures; those are where the paper shows that the gain comes from better correction-versus-sycophancy trade-offs, not merely stronger initial answers.

A practical reading path is 20 to 30 minutes: Figure 1 and Figure 2 first, then the main results table, then the ablations, and only after that the training details. Two points are worth deeper follow-up: how sensitive the method is to judge noise, and whether the same transition-aware reward can extend beyond closed-form scientific QA to open-ended reasoning or general dialogue.

recommendation.zh: RL对齐的细分创新，解决科学场景下的谄媚问题，只看§3的奖励设计部分可参考对齐目标设计思路
recommendation.en: This is a niche innovation in RL alignment for scientific scenarios, only read §3 reward design part for alignment target design reference

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Are Tools Always Beneficial? Learning to Invoke Tools Adaptively for Dual-Mode Multimodal LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Tool-augmented reasoning has emerged as a promising direction for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, existing studies mainly focus on enabling models to perform tool invocation, while neglecting the necessity of invoking tools. We argue that tool usage is not always beneficial, as redundant or inappropriate invocations largely increase reasoning overhead and even mislead model predictions. To address this issue, we introduce AutoTool, a mod

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态 LLM 在工具增强推理中“该不该调用工具”这一决策问题，而不是默认总是调用。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent/post-training 交叉地带：不是新基座模型，但对工具使用策略、RL 信号设计和 test-time compute 分配有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AutoTool，在强化学习框架下显式建模双模式推理：工具辅助模式与纯文本推理模式。核心做法是让模型先自适应决定是否调用工具，再用模式特定奖励函数优化；同时通过联合探索避免训练早期塌缩到单一模式，并在后期鼓励更自由的模式探索。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据量和基线名称。实验结论是：相较总是调用工具的做法，自适应调用能减少冗余开销，并在部分场景避免错误工具调用带来的误导，从而提升多模态推理质量与效率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses whether a multimodal LLM should invoke tools at all, instead of assuming tool use is always beneficial.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution sits at the boundary of agents and post-training: not a foundation-model advance, but potentially useful for tool-use policy learning, RL reward design, and test-time compute allocation.
summary_en.technical_approach: AutoTool formulates dual-mode reasoning under reinforcement learning: a tool-assisted mode and a text-centric mode. The model learns to decide whether to invoke tools, with mode-specific rewards, joint exploration to avoid early collapse to one mode, and freer exploration later in training.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, data scale, or named baselines. Reported findings are that adaptive tool invocation reduces redundant overhead and avoids harmful tool calls in some cases, improving multimodal reasoning quality and efficiency over always-using-tools setups.

recommendation.zh: 点子不新到改写 prior，但“工具不是免费午餐”这个训练信号设计值得记一笔；只看 reward 设计和 ablation，别在任务细节上花时间。
recommendation.en: It does not really change priors, but the ‘tools are not always a free lunch’ framing is worth noting; read the reward design and ablations, not the task-specific details.

paper.title: Mem-π: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate
paper.abstract: We present Mem-π, a framework for adaptive memory in large language model (LLM) agents, where useful guidance is generated on demand rather than retrieved from external memory stores. Existing memory-augmented agents typically rely on similarity-based retrieval from episodic memory banks or skill libraries, returning static entries that often misalign with the current context. In contrast, Mem-π uses a dedicated language or vision-language model with its own parameters, separate from the downstr

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 LLM agent 中“记忆该何时用、用什么形式用”的问题：相比从外部记忆库检索静态片段，如何按当前上下文按需生成更贴合任务的指导信息。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent memory 设计问题，不是基座预训练本身，但它触及一个对 pretrain 有外溢价值的点：把“记忆”从检索对象改成可学习的条件生成器，并显式学习 abstain。贡献类型主要是方法设计加 RL 训练目标，而不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mem-π：在下游 agent 之外单独放一个语言模型或视觉语言模型作为 memory generator。该模型基于当前 agent 上下文，联合决定何时生成指导、以及生成什么指导。训练上采用 decision-content decoupled 的 RL 目标，把“是否该说”和“说什么”拆开优化，使模型可以在无益时选择不生成，在有益时输出简洁指导。核心新意是把 memory 从 retrieval item 变成 context-conditional generated guidance，并把 abstention 作为一等决策变量。
summary.experiments: 论文在 web navigation、terminal tool use、text-based embodied interaction 等多类 agent benchmark 上评测，结论是相较于基于 episodic memory bank 或 skill library 的检索式 memory，Mem-π 在复杂任务上更稳，且能减少与当前上下文不匹配的静态记忆调用。摘要未给出模型规模、训练 token 或具体提升幅度，因此更适合作为方法信号而非定量结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ServiceNow AI Research、Mila、Université de Montréal、McGill 等。Christopher Pal 是 Mila/ServiceNow 体系内较知名研究者，长期参与大模型与多模态方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles a memory-design problem for long-horizon LLM agents: instead of retrieving static entries from external memory stores, how can an agent generate context-specific guidance only when it is actually useful?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it touches a question that matters to foundation-model researchers: whether memory should be modeled as retrieval over stored traces or as a learned conditional generator with abstention. The contribution is mainly a method plus an RL objective, not a new base-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mem-π introduces a separate language or vision-language model, distinct from the downstream agent, to act as an adaptive memory module. Conditioned on the current agent context, it jointly decides when to emit guidance and what guidance to emit. Training uses a decision-content decoupled RL objective so the model can abstain when guidance would not help and otherwise produce concise, task-relevant hints. The key move is to replace retrieved memory snippets with generated, context-conditioned guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on agentic benchmarks spanning web navigation, terminal-based tool use, and text-based embodied interaction. The reported takeaway is that Mem-π outperforms retrieval-based episodic memory or skill-library baselines by reducing context mismatch and improving task performance on complex settings. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, or exact gains, so this is more useful as a design signal than as a clean quantitative reference.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from ServiceNow AI Research, Mila, Université de Montréal, and McGill. Christopher Pal is a well-known researcher associated with the Mila/ServiceNow ecosystem and has a strong track record in large-model and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“生成式记忆+可 abstain”这个接口设计值得记一下；读方法图和 RL objective 就够，不必深挖 benchmark。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but the generated-memory-with-abstention interface is worth noting; read the method figure and RL objective, not the benchmark details.

paper.title: Mid-Training with Self-Generated Data Improves Reinforcement Learning in Language Models
paper.abstract: The effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Large Language Models (LLMs) depends on the nature and diversity of the data used before and during RL. In particular, reasoning problems can often be approached in multiple ways that rely on different forms of reasoning, and exposure to only a limited range of such approaches in the training data may limit the effectiveness of RL. Motivated by this, we investigate using diverse self-generated data during mid-training as an intermediate step be

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作解决的是：RL 阶段的效果不仅取决于 reward 和算法，还强依赖 RL 之前模型见过什么样的推理轨迹；如果前置数据只覆盖少数解题路径，RL 很难学到更强的推理策略组合。
summary.importance: 重要性很高，因为它把 mid-training 重新放回 pretrain↔post-train 闭环里：先用模型自生成的多样正确解法做中间训练，再进入 RL。贡献同时包括理论解释和经验结果，直接触及“RL 能否从更好的初始化中获益”这个当前很关键的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 方法上采用 bootstrapped self-generated data framework：以 Polya 的问题求解策略为指导，为同一道题生成多种正确答案/解法变体，然后先做一次 mid-training 或 fine-tuning，再进行 RL 训练。作者还给出理论视角，说明这种多样化中间数据如何改变 policy-gradient 更新，使模型更容易组合多种推理方式，而不是被单一路径锁死。
summary.experiments: 摘要明确声称：经过这种 self-generated mid-training 初始化后的模型，在后续 RL 训练中表现更好。给定信息未披露模型参数量、具体数据规模、RL 算法和提升幅度，但实验设计的关键比较应是“直接 RL”对比“mid-training 后再 RL”，并考察多样解法数据对 reasoning 任务的增益。若正文 setup 干净，这会是很值得内部复现的 recipe 类工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a key issue in RL for language models: RL effectiveness depends not only on the reward and algorithm, but also on what kinds of reasoning trajectories the model has seen before RL. If pre-RL data covers only a narrow set of solution styles, RL may fail to learn stronger compositional reasoning policies.
summary_en.importance: This matters because it puts mid-training back into the pretrain↔post-train loop: first train on self-generated diverse correct solutions, then run RL. The contribution is both conceptual and empirical, directly touching the current question of whether RL benefits from a better reasoning initialization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method uses a bootstrapped self-generated data framework guided by George Polya’s problem-solving strategies. For each question, the model generates multiple correct answer variants reflecting different reasoning approaches; the model is then mid-trained/fine-tuned on this data before RL. The paper also offers a theoretical view of how such diversity changes policy-gradient updates, making it easier for RL to combine multiple reasoning modes instead of collapsing onto a narrow one.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract clearly claims that models initialized with this self-generated mid-training perform better under subsequent RL. The provided information does not specify model sizes, data scale, RL algorithm, or exact gains, but the crucial comparison is clearly direct RL versus mid-training followed by RL, with a focus on reasoning tasks. If the full setup is clean, this is a recipe-style paper worth reproducing internally.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会直接影响你对“RL 主要靠算法还是靠前置分布”的判断；应优先看理论段和 direct-RL vs mid-train+RL 对比，若增益稳，就该立刻加进内部 recipe。
recommendation.en: This can change your prior on whether RL gains come mainly from the algorithm or from the pre-RL distribution; read the theory and the direct-RL vs mid-train+RL comparison first, and if the gains are stable, add it to your internal recipe immediately.

paper.title: Nudging Beyond the Comfort Zone: Efficient Strategy-Guided Exploration for RLVR
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a scalable paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of large language models. However, its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by exploration: the policy can only improve on trajectories it has already sampled. While increasing the number of rollouts alleviates this issue, such brute-force scaling is computationally expensive, and existing approaches that modify the optimization objective provide limited control ove

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 RLVR 里的一个老问题，但切得更具体：不是“奖励稀疏”本身，而是正确推理轨迹虽然存在、模型也给了非零概率，却在有限 rollout 下长期采不到，导致策略更新始终围着已知的舒适区打转。作者把问题拆成两层。第一层是探索效率：单纯增加 rollout 数量当然能提高撞到正确轨迹的概率，但代价很高。第二层是探索结构：已有做法多半通过熵正则、clip 变体之类在分布层面鼓励更散的采样，却不能指定“去探索哪些语义上不同的推理方式”。论文的核心目标，就是在不依赖 oracle 解答或中间步骤监督的前提下，给 RLVR 一个可控、低成本、能覆盖多种 reasoning strategy 的探索机制，并且让这种受控探索学到的能力最终回流到原始 policy，而不是只在带提示的采样条件下有效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain objective，但对 pretrain-posttrain 接口有现实意义。原因有三点。第一，它把“探索”从 rollout 数量问题改写成“策略空间覆盖”问题，这和预训练里讨论数据多样性、mixture design、curriculum 的思路是相通的。第二，它说明后训练阶段可以用很轻量的文本上下文去显式诱导不同推理模式，而不必依赖昂贵的过程监督；这对后续把 reasoning style 作为一种可控训练信号很有启发。第三，它指出 context-conditioned exploration 会破坏标准 GRPO 的 advantage 估计前提，并给出相应修补，这一点对所有“带条件采样再回写 base policy”的 RL 方案都有参考价值。贡献量级上，它更像一个扎实的方法改造，而不是范式替换；但如果结果稳定，确实能改变 RLVR 里“多堆 rollout”这一默认工程路径。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 Strategy Nudging。做法很直接：在同一个问题输入前后，附加一些轻量的、启发式的策略级文本上下文，让模型分别沿不同 reasoning mode 采样。例如对数学题，可以提示代数法、几何法、分步验证、边界检查之类。关键点不在提示词本身多精细，而在于它把原本混在一起的推理空间显式分桶，让 rollout 不再只是从一个单峰分布里反复抽样，而是被迫访问多个潜在子空间。作者强调这和 oracle-guided 方法不同：它不提供正确解，也不提供中间步骤，只提供“往哪个方向想”的弱引导，因此保留了发现新解法的空间。

第二部分是 Inter-Intra group advantage。标准 GRPO 假设同一 prompt 下的一组 rollout 来自同一采样条件，因此组内 reward 的均值和方差可以拿来做相对 advantage 归一化。NudgeRL 里不同 rollout 来自不同 strategy context，reward 差异既包含轨迹质量，也包含 context 本身带来的系统偏置。如果仍按原始 group-wise normalization 做，credit assignment 会失真：某些策略组可能整体更难或更易，导致组内相对分数不能横向比较。作者因此把 advantage 估计拆成 intra-group 和 inter-group 两层，既保留同一策略组内部的相对排序，又引入跨策略组的校正，让更新信号能区分“这个 rollout 在本策略下好不好”和“这个策略整体值不值得学”。从问题设定看，这一步是方法成立的关键，不然 strategy nudging 只会把采样分布打散，却未必能稳定训练。

第三部分是 distillation-augmented objective。因为训练时 rollout 是在带 strategy context 的条件下采样，而测试时通常不会给这些 context，所以存在明显的 train-test mismatch。作者的处理是把在 context-forced exploration 中发现的有效行为蒸馏回 base policy，让基础模型在无额外提示时也能复现这些更优轨迹。这个设计很像“探索策略”和“部署策略”解耦：前者负责发现，后者负责吸收。相比直接把带 context 的 policy 当最终模型，这样更符合 RLVR 的实际使用方式，也减少了推理时额外 prompt 工程的依赖。
summary.experiments:
从引言给出的结果看，主结论很明确：NudgeRL 在性能上超过标准 GRPO，即使后者拿到 8× 更大的 rollout budget 也追不上；同时也优于依赖 oracle 信息的引导式 baseline。这个结果如果在正文里覆盖多个任务和模型规模，说明收益主要来自探索效率，而不是单纯多算力。论文前面还引用了 Hu et al. 对 RLVR 一步性能增益的分析，把未采样正确 token 的概率质量 U_pos,2 视为主要负项，这为实验设计提供了理论支点：如果 NudgeRL 有效，应该能在相同 rollout 下更频繁命中原本低概率但正确的 reasoning path。

从全文结构推测，关键实验应包括几类。其一，主表比较不同 rollout budget 下的 GRPO、带目标函数改造的探索方法、oracle-guided 方法和 NudgeRL。这里最值得看的是“同等算力下提升多少”和“达到同等性能所需 rollout 降低多少”。其二，消融实验：去掉 inter-intra advantage、去掉 distillation、只保留 strategy prompt、或改成随机无意义 context，验证收益是否真的来自结构化探索而非简单 prompt 扰动。其三，策略多样性分析：不同 nudge 是否诱导出可区分的 reasoning trace，正确样本覆盖是否更广。其四，迁移实验：训练时用 context，测试时不用 context，检验蒸馏是否真正把能力写回 base policy。摘要里没有给出更多具体数字；如果正文有按任务拆分的提升幅度、成功率曲线和 rollout-efficiency 曲线，这些会比单点平均分更有信息量。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，但建议把方法和实验各抓一个重点。先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，作者对 RLVR 探索瓶颈的表述比较清楚，尤其是把问题落到“未探索到的正确区域”而不是泛泛的 sparse reward。然后直接看方法部分里 Strategy Nudging、Inter-Intra group advantage、distillation objective 的定义，重点想清楚两件事：为什么标准 GRPO advantage 在多 context 采样下会失效；为什么必须显式做蒸馏，而不是指望 PPO 更新自然消除条件依赖。实验部分优先看主结果表、rollout budget 对比图、以及 ablation。若时间有限，30-40 分钟足够抓住主要贡献。若要深挖，建议重点检查作者使用的 strategy context 是多通用还是任务特定、人工设计成本多高、以及 inter-intra advantage 是否会引入新的方差或超参敏感性。这些决定了方法能否从一个漂亮想法变成稳定配方。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in RL with verifiable rewards: the policy often assigns non-trivial probability mass to correct reasoning trajectories, yet finite rollout sampling fails to discover them, so optimization keeps reinforcing already-visited modes. The authors frame this not merely as sparse reward, but as an exploration coverage problem. Scaling the number of rollouts helps, but is expensive. Existing objective-level fixes such as entropy-style encouragement broaden sampling only in a distributional sense; they do not let us steer exploration toward semantically distinct reasoning strategies. The paper therefore asks: can we induce structured, diverse exploration without oracle solutions or process supervision, and can the gains found under such guided exploration be transferred back to the base policy used at inference time?
summary_en.importance: This is a post-training paper, but it matters for foundation-model research because it turns exploration from a brute-force sampling issue into a controllable coverage issue. That connects naturally to pretraining concerns such as data mixture design, diversity, and curriculum. A second reason is methodological: it shows that lightweight textual contexts can be used as weak control signals for reasoning-style exploration, avoiding expensive step-level supervision. A third reason is more technical: once rollouts are generated under different conditioning contexts, the assumptions behind standard GRPO-style group-relative advantage estimation break, and the paper proposes a repair. That makes it relevant beyond this specific method, especially for any RL setup that separates an exploratory policy from a deployment policy. The contribution is not a paradigm shift, but it is a meaningful systems-level refinement of RLVR training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has three main components. First, Strategy Nudging. For each prompt, the model is asked to generate rollouts under lightweight strategy-level textual contexts, such as hints that encourage different reasoning modes. The key idea is not that the prompts are highly informative, but that they partition the reasoning space into multiple semantically meaningful subspaces. Instead of repeatedly sampling from one dominant mode, the policy is nudged to visit alternative trajectories it would otherwise ignore. Unlike oracle-guided methods, these nudges do not reveal the answer or intermediate steps; they only bias the search direction, leaving room for novel successful trajectories to emerge.

Second, Inter-Intra group advantage. Standard GRPO assumes that rollouts for a prompt are sampled under the same condition, so within-group reward normalization is meaningful. Here, rollouts come from different strategy contexts, and reward variation mixes two factors: trajectory quality and context-specific bias. A naive group-relative normalization would therefore distort credit assignment. The proposed estimator separates intra-context comparison from inter-context calibration, so the update can capture both whether a rollout is strong within its own strategy group and whether that strategy is globally useful. This is likely the central technical piece: without it, strategy-conditioned exploration may diversify samples but produce unstable or misleading policy updates.

Third, a distillation-augmented objective. Training-time exploration is performed under explicit strategy contexts, but inference typically uses the base prompt only. That creates a train-test mismatch. The paper addresses this by distilling useful behaviors discovered under context-forced exploration back into the base policy. Conceptually, this decouples discovery from deployment: the conditioned policy explores, the unconditioned policy absorbs. This is a practical design choice, because it avoids relying on extra prompting at inference time and makes the learned gains usable in standard RLVR deployment settings.
summary_en.experiments:
The headline result stated in the paper is that NudgeRL outperforms standard GRPO even when GRPO is given an 8x larger rollout budget, and it also beats oracle-guided baselines. If this pattern holds across tasks and model scales in the full experiments, the main takeaway is that the gain comes from exploration efficiency rather than simply more compute. The paper also grounds its motivation in prior analysis of one-step RLVR improvement, where unsampled correct token mass acts as a dominant negative term; this gives a clear mechanistic expectation for the experiments: a successful method should discover low-probability but correct reasoning paths more often under the same rollout budget.

The most informative experimental sections are likely to be: main comparisons against GRPO under matched and scaled rollout budgets; ablations removing inter-intra advantage, removing distillation, or replacing meaningful strategy nudges with random contexts; diversity analyses showing whether different nudges actually induce distinct reasoning traces; and transfer tests checking whether gains persist when the strategy context is removed at inference. The abstract snippet does not provide more detailed numbers such as model sizes, task breakdowns, or exact improvement margins. If the full paper includes rollout-efficiency curves, per-task gains, and variance analyses, those will be more revealing than a single average score.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper, but it is worth reading the motivation and method carefully. Start with the introduction and preliminaries, especially the discussion of why unexplored correct regions are the real bottleneck in RLVR. Then jump to the three method components: Strategy Nudging, Inter-Intra group advantage, and the distillation objective. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why exactly does standard GRPO-style advantage estimation fail under multi-context sampling, and why is explicit distillation necessary instead of relying on policy optimization alone to absorb the gains? In the experiments, prioritize the main comparison table, rollout-budget scaling plots, and ablations. A 30-40 minute read should be enough to capture the core idea. If reading more deeply, inspect how task-specific the strategy contexts are, how much manual design they require, and whether the new advantage estimator introduces variance or hyperparameter sensitivity.

recommendation.zh: RLVR的探索优化方法，适合推理能力对齐的实验参考，仅需阅读第3.2节的损失设计部分
recommendation.en: This RLVR exploration optimization method is suitable for reasoning alignment experiments, only read §3.2 for loss design

paper.title: ICRL: Learning to Internalize Self-Critique with Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Large language model-based agents make mistakes, yet critique can often guide the same model toward correct behavior. However, when critique is removed, the model may fail again on the same query, indicating that it has not internalized the critique's guidance into its underlying capability. Meanwhile, a frozen critic cannot improve its feedback quality over time, limiting the potential for iterative self-improvement. To address this, we propose learning to internalize self-critique with reinfor

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 critique-based self-improvement 中的 internalization 问题：模型在收到 critique 后能改正错误，但去掉 critique 后仍可能在同一类问题上失败。原因是训练样本来自 critique-conditioned distribution π(y|q,c)，而目标能力应该存在于 critique-free distribution π(y|q)。直接用修改后的成功轨迹训练 solver，会把能力绑定在 critique 上。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于，它明确指出“自我批评生成成功轨迹”不等于“模型学会了无辅助解决问题”。这对基于 verifier、critic、reflection 的 RL 数据闭环很重要。ICRL 的价值不在某个下游 agent 任务，而在于提出了一个把外部反馈转成模型内在策略更新的训练机制。这个问题也会出现在 reasoning data 合成、process supervision、self-revision SFT/RL 中：如果不校正条件分布偏移，训练目标会偏向依赖反馈的行为。
summary.technical_approach: ICRL 从同一个 backbone 中联合训练 solver 和 critic。solver 先在 query 上尝试任务；失败或低分时，critic 生成 critique；solver 再基于 critique 产生 revised trajectory。critic 的奖励不是语言质量，而是它带来的后续 solver 性能增益，因此反馈被约束为可执行、对任务有帮助。为把 revised trajectory 转移到 critique-free solver，论文将修订后的轨迹重新放回无 critique prompt 下评估，并引入 token-level distribution-calibration re-weighting ratio。直观上，若某个 token 在无 critique 条件下也有较高概率，就更适合用来更新 solver；若它主要依赖 critique 上下文才出现，就降低权重，避免把 critique-conditioned 行为硬灌给无辅助策略。训练底座采用 GRPO，并加入 role-wise group advantage estimation，对 solver 和 critic 的奖励分别归一化，避免两个角色的学习信号互相冲淡。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 agentic tasks 和数学推理任务。环境包括 ALFWorld、WebShop、多跳问答 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA、Bamboogle、Musique，以及 MATH500、OlympiadBench、NuminaMath 等数学数据。模型规模使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B。论文报告 ICRL 优于 prompting baseline、普通 RL baseline 和已有 critique-based 方法；联合训练得到的 critic 在效果上可接近 32B frozen critic，同时使用更少 token。给定内容中没有提供完整表格数值，因此不宜补写具体百分比。关键实验点是：单纯用 critique-conditioned 成功轨迹训练不够，distribution calibration 和 role-wise advantage 对稳定提升都有作用。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 45–60 分钟。重点看方法部分的三个组件：critic reward 如何定义、token-level calibration ratio 如何计算、solver/critic 的 role-wise advantage 如何接入 GRPO。实验部分优先看消融实验，而不是只看主结果表。若关注 RL pretrain 或自生成数据训练，可以重点检查一个问题：校正权重是否真的筛掉了 critique 依赖 token，还是只是起到保守 KL/importance weighting 的效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets the internalization problem in critique-based self-improvement. A model may solve a task after receiving critique, but fail again when the critique is removed. The key mismatch is distributional: revised successful trajectories are sampled from π(y|q,c), while the desired solver policy is π(y|q). Training directly on critique-conditioned successes can therefore teach the model to rely on critique rather than to solve the task unaided.
summary_en.importance: The work is relevant to the interface between RL post-training and pretraining-style self-improvement loops. It makes a useful distinction between producing a successful self-revised trajectory and actually improving the underlying critique-free policy. The same issue appears in verifier-guided data generation, reflection-based agents, process-supervised reasoning, and synthetic SFT/RL pipelines. Without correcting the conditioning mismatch, the training signal can be biased toward behaviors that only work when feedback is present.
summary_en.technical_approach: ICRL jointly trains a solver and a critic from a shared backbone. The solver first attempts the task. The critic then produces feedback, and the solver makes a revised attempt conditioned on that feedback. The critic is rewarded by the solver’s subsequent performance gain, which encourages feedback that is actionable rather than merely plausible. To transfer revised trajectories into the critique-free solver, ICRL reconditions those trajectories under the original prompt and applies a token-level distribution-calibration ratio. Tokens that are already plausible under the critique-free distribution receive more weight; tokens that depend heavily on the critique context are down-weighted. The RL primitive is GRPO, with role-wise group advantage estimation so that solver rewards and critic rewards are normalized separately and preserve their distinct learning signals.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers both agentic environments and reasoning tasks, including ALFWorld, WebShop, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, Bamboogle, Musique, MATH500, OlympiadBench, and NuminaMath-style mathematical data. Experiments are run on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B. The reported results show improvements over prompting baselines, standard RL baselines, and prior critique-based methods. The learned critic is reported to approach the utility of a 32B frozen critic while using fewer tokens. The provided text does not include the full result tables, so exact percentage gains should not be inferred. The important empirical claim is that calibration and role-wise advantage estimation are needed to turn critique-induced success into stronger unassisted solving.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 45–60 minutes. Focus on the method section: the critic reward definition, the token-level calibration ratio, and the integration with GRPO through role-wise advantages. In the experiments, prioritize the ablations over the headline scores. For readers interested in RL pretraining or self-generated training data, the main question to inspect is whether the calibration mechanism truly filters critique-dependent tokens, or whether it mostly behaves like a conservative importance-weighting or KL-control device.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是范式突破，但抓住了 self-critique 最真实的痛点：会改不等于学会；先看 reward 定义和 re-weighting，若 setup 干净，值得拿来做 internal ablation。
recommendation.en: Not a paradigm shift, but it targets the real failure mode of self-critique: correcting once is not learning; read the reward design and re-weighting first, and replicate if the setup is clean.

paper.title: ASRU: Activation Steering Meets Reinforcement Unlearning for Multimodal Large Language Models
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) may memorize sensitive cross-modal information during pretraining, making machine unlearning (MU) crucial. Existing methods typically evaluate unlearning effectiveness based on output deviations, while overlooking the generation quality after unlearning. This can easily lead to hallucinated or rigid responses, thereby affecting the usability and safety of the unlearned model. To address this issue, we propose ASRU, a controllable multimodal unlearning fra

summary.core_problem: 解决多模态大模型机器遗忘里“忘得掉但答得差”的问题：现有方法常用输出偏移衡量遗忘，却忽略遗忘后生成质量，导致拒答僵硬或幻觉增加。
summary.importance: 这是一个后训练安全方向的工作，贡献主要在于把生成质量显式纳入多模态遗忘目标，并把激活操控与强化式边界优化结合起来。对预训练研究员的价值不在遗忘本身，而在于它提供了一个观察：安全性干预若只盯目标行为，往往会破坏生成分布与可用性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ASRU。第一阶段用 activation steering 做初始拒答行为诱导，相当于先把模型表示推向“拒绝敏感请求”的区域；第二阶段再用定制奖励函数做 reinforcement unlearning，细化拒答边界，在目标知识遗忘与非目标能力保留之间做可控折中。方法核心不是新架构，而是把表示层干预和奖励优化串起来，避免单纯输出层惩罚带来的粗暴退化。
summary.experiments: 实验基于 Qwen3-VL。摘要报告平均遗忘效果提升 24.6%，生成质量提升 5.8 倍，并能较好保留一般能力。基线应包括已有多模态遗忘方法与仅激活操控/仅优化式遗忘方案，但从摘要看还无法判断评测是否足够干净，尤其是生成质量指标、拒答率与泛化保留之间是否存在 hidden trade-off，需要看正文中的 reward 设计和评测集构成。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets a common failure mode in multimodal machine unlearning: models may forget target knowledge but become brittle, hallucinate more, or over-refuse because prior work measures output deviation rather than generation quality.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a post-training safety contribution. Its value is not the unlearning task itself, but the cleaner framing that utility preservation should be an explicit optimization target in multimodal unlearning. For pretraining researchers, the useful signal is that behavior-level safety interventions can easily distort the underlying generation distribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: ASRU combines two stages. It first uses activation steering to induce an initial refusal tendency, effectively shifting internal representations toward a safer response mode. It then applies reinforcement unlearning with a customized reward to refine refusal boundaries and balance target forgetting against utility retention. The novelty is the coupling of representation-space steering with reward-based boundary shaping, rather than a new base model architecture.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on Qwen3-VL. The abstract reports +24.6% average unlearning effectiveness and a 5.8x average gain in generation quality, while preserving general capabilities. Likely baselines include prior multimodal unlearning methods and ablations with only steering or only RL-style optimization. The key question is whether the evaluation cleanly separates refusal quality, hallucination reduction, and collateral damage to non-target capabilities.

recommendation.zh: 偏后训练安全，不会改写预训练 prior；只建议看 reward 设计和保留能力评测，若 setup 干净，可借鉴到 refusal boundary 的可控优化。
recommendation.en: This is post-training safety rather than pretraining; only read the reward design and utility-retention evals—if the setup is clean, the useful bit is controllable refusal-boundary shaping.

paper.title: Look Before You Leap: Autonomous Exploration for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model based agents often fail in unfamiliar environments due to premature exploitation: a tendency to act on prior knowledge before acquiring sufficient environment-specific information. We identify autonomous exploration as a critical yet underexplored capability for building adaptive agents. To formalize and quantify this capability, we introduce Exploration Checkpoint Coverage, a verifiable metric that measures how broadly an agent discovers key states, objects, and affordances

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在陌生交互环境里常出现“过早利用”（premature exploitation）：还没弄清环境状态/物体/可用动作（affordance）就按训练期先验直接执行任务，导致反复撞墙或语义错配。论文要解决的是：把“自主探索”从任务完成里剥离成可度量、可优化的独立能力，并证明常见的任务导向 RL/RLVR 并不会自然学出这种能力。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接方法论文，但对“RL 作为 post-train 信号如何反哺通用能力”有明确启示：只用任务回报会把策略压到窄轨迹，削弱在分布外环境中的信息获取与适应。它把探索能力做成可验证指标（ECC）并给出可操作的训练配方（interleaved GRPO），适合作为后训练阶段的能力补齐模块；对做 tool/UI/文本世界交互的通用 agent 训练，属于可复用的训练信号设计。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 指标：提出 Exploration Checkpoint Coverage (ECC)。核心思想是把环境里“关键状态/对象/可用交互”抽象成一组可验证的 checkpoints，agent 在探索阶段触达/发现的 checkpoints 越多，ECC 越高。它强调 verifiable：奖励不依赖主观打分，而是由环境可判定的触发条件给出。
2) 诊断：用 ECC 系统评估多种开源模型与训练范式，结论是任务导向训练（包括强 RLVR 式的 task-completion 优化）会导致探索早停、覆盖面窄、重复访问熟悉状态。
3) 训练：提出 interleaved GRPO（文中描述为将两类 rollout 交错进行）。一类 rollout 做任务执行，用任务完成的可验证奖励；另一类 rollout 专门做探索，用 ECC 作为奖励，直接把“覆盖更多关键点”变成优化目标。两类 rollout 共享同一策略模型，但优化目标分开，避免探索被任务回报挤压。
4) 推理范式：Explore-then-Act。部署时先花一段交互预算做自主探索以收集环境知识，再进入任务执行阶段；强调把“先建模环境再做事”制度化，而不是让模型在任务过程中被动试错。
summary.experiments:
全文实验覆盖 ALFWorld、SciWorld、TextCraft 以及一个更难的 ALFWorld 变体。主要结论是：
- 现有任务导向训练在 ECC 上表现出系统性低覆盖与重复行为；
- 用 ECC 奖励做探索训练后，ECC 显著提高，并能把同样的初始交互预算转化为更有效的环境知识；
- 下游任务成功率/鲁棒性随之提升，尤其在更难的 ALFWorld 变体上更明显。
给定你提供的全文片段未包含表格数字与具体模型配置（参数量、训练步数、提升幅度），这里无法可靠复述精确数值；精确数字需要对照论文的结果表与消融表。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 ECC 的定义与“checkpoint”如何构造/验证：这是整篇工作的可迁移部分，决定奖励是否会被投机。
- 再看“任务导向训练不产生探索”的诊断实验：重点关注他们如何控制交互预算、如何统计重复轨迹与早停。
- 最后看 interleaved GRPO 的训练细节：两类 rollout 的比例、奖励归一化/截断、以及是否会牺牲任务性能来换探索。
如果你在做 RLVR/RLAIF 训练管线，值得额外检查：ECC 是否会引入 reward hacking（例如刷 checkpoint），以及作者是否用约束/去重/冷却机制抑制这种行为（通常会在实现细节或消融里）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents deployed in unfamiliar interactive environments often “exploit too early”: they commit to actions driven by training-time priors before acquiring environment-specific information (states, objects, affordances). The paper isolates autonomous exploration as a standalone capability, makes it measurable, and shows that task-centric RL/RLVR does not reliably produce it.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is directly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop: optimizing only for task completion can collapse behavior into narrow trajectories, hurting adaptation under distribution shift. The work contributes (i) a verifiable exploration metric (ECC) and (ii) a concrete RL recipe (interleaved GRPO) that can be plugged into agent post-training to build a reusable “explore first” capability for tool/UI/text-world interaction.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Metric: Exploration Checkpoint Coverage (ECC). The environment is instrumented with a set of verifiable checkpoints representing key states/objects/affordances; the exploration reward is proportional to how broadly the agent discovers them.
2) Diagnosis: Using ECC, the authors evaluate multiple models/training paradigms and find task-oriented optimization leads to premature termination, low coverage, and repetitive interactions.
3) Training: Interleaved GRPO alternates two rollout types: task-execution rollouts optimized with task-completion verifiable rewards, and exploration rollouts optimized with ECC reward. Separating objectives prevents task reward from dominating and suppressing exploration.
4) Deployment: Explore-then-Act allocates an explicit interaction budget to exploration before attempting the task, turning “environment understanding” into a first-class stage rather than incidental trial-and-error.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments span ALFWorld, SciWorld, TextCraft, plus a harder ALFWorld variant. Reported outcomes: task-centric baselines exhibit systematically low ECC and repetitive behaviors; ECC-trained agents achieve higher coverage and convert the same initial interaction budget into more useful environment knowledge, improving downstream task success and robustness (especially on the harder variant). The provided full-text excerpt does not include the numeric tables (model sizes, data/steps, absolute gains), so exact figures cannot be stated without the results section tables.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 minutes):
- Read the formal definition of ECC and how checkpoints are constructed/verified; this determines whether the reward is robust to gaming.
- Check the diagnostic setup that claims “task training doesn’t yield exploration”: pay attention to fixed interaction budgets and how repetition/early-stop are quantified.
- Review interleaved GRPO details: rollout mixing ratio, reward scaling, and any trade-off between exploration and task performance.
If you run RLVR pipelines, explicitly look for anti-hacking measures (deduping checkpoints, constraints, cooldowns), typically in implementation details and ablations.

recommendation.zh: 读 metric 和 rollout 设计即可；它把 agent RL 的失败归因从“不会规划”推进到“训练时没奖励探索”。
recommendation.en: Read the metric and rollout design; it reframes some agent-RL failures from poor planning to unrewarded exploration.
