paper.title: Beyond Mode-Seeking RL: Trajectory-Balance Post-Training for Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Diffusion language models are a promising alternative to autoregressive models, yet post-training methods for them largely adapt reward-maximizing objectives. We identify a central failure mode in this setting we call trajectory locking: sampled reward-driven updates over-concentrate probability mass onto a narrow set of denoising paths, reducing coverage of alternative correct solutions under repeated sampling. To address this, we propose TraFL (Trajectory Flow baLancing), a trajectory-balance

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文解决 diffusion language model 的 post-training 目标问题：直接套用奖励最大化会把概率集中到少数 denoising 轨迹上，导致重复采样时正确解的覆盖变差。
summary.importance: 它对预训练研究的价值在于非自回归语言模型的训练信号设计。diffusion LM 没有 AR 模型那种清晰的 token-level conditional log-probability，post-training 不能简单照搬 RLHF 或 GRPO 式目标。论文提出的 trajectory locking 说明，终局奖励只看最终答案，不约束 denoising 路径上的概率分配，采样优化会放大早期偶然偏好。这对 diffusion LM、masked LM、any-order LM 的训练目标设计都有启发：不能只看单样本准确率，还要控制分布覆盖和路径概率。
summary.technical_approach: 方法叫 TraFL，来自 GFlowNet 的 trajectory balance 思路。它不把 reward 当成对采样轨迹的无约束放大器，而是训练当前策略去匹配一个 reference-anchored reward-tilted target distribution。这里的 frozen reference model 负责保留原模型对合理生成的分布约束，reward 负责提高成功 completion 的质量权重。为了适配 diffusion LM，论文没有依赖 AR token logprob，而是构造 diffusion-compatible 的 sequence-level surrogate，用于比较当前模型和 reference model 对完整 denoised completion 的相对倾向。同时引入 prompt-dependent normalization，并与 policy 一起学习，使归一化项在每个训练 step 都能得到梯度，而不是只在采到特定 completion 时才更新。这个设计针对的是 trajectory locking：同一个正确答案可以由多条 denoising 轨迹产生，终局奖励对这些路径不敏感，普通采样 policy gradient 会逐步强化已经更常被采样的路径。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理和代码生成，包括 GSM8K、MATH-500、HumanEval、MBPP，并在 Minerva Math 和 LiveCodeBench 上做 held-out 评估。论文报告 TraFL 是直接比较的方法中唯一在所有 benchmark-length 设置下都超过 base model 的方法，平均表现优于 ESPO 和 JustGRPO。在 LiveCodeBench 上，TraFL 在各难度 split 中表现最好。论文还用 LLM-as-judge 分析生成结果，证据指向更宽的正确解覆盖，而不只是把概率压到单一高分模式上。提供的内容没有列出具体准确率表，因此不应只按绝对分数解读，重点应看覆盖、多样性和不同长度设置下的稳定性。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读偏精读，约 30 分钟。先看 Introduction 中 trajectory locking 的定义，再看 Trajectory Flow Balancing 部分的目标推导，重点理解 terminal reward 为什么对同一 completion 的不同路径不敏感。实验部分优先看与 ESPO、JustGRPO 的直接比较，以及 prompt-dependent normalization、reference anchoring 的消融。如果关心 diffusion LM 的 RL post-training，目标函数和归一化项值得细读；如果只关心 AR LLM 的常规 RL，可以把它作为非 AR 训练目标的参考案例。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies post-training for diffusion language models and identifies a failure mode where reward-driven updates concentrate probability on a narrow set of denoising trajectories, reducing coverage of alternative correct solutions.
summary_en.importance: The main value is in training-signal design for non-autoregressive language models. Diffusion LMs do not expose the same token-level conditional probabilities as AR models, so standard reward-maximizing post-training objectives are not a clean fit. The paper’s trajectory-locking argument is useful beyond this specific method: terminal rewards supervise the final completion but do not specify how probability should be allocated over denoising paths. This matters for diffusion LMs, masked LMs, and any-order generation models where path distributions are part of the model behavior.
summary_en.technical_approach: TraFL applies a trajectory-balance objective inspired by GFlowNets. Instead of using reward as an unconstrained multiplier on sampled trajectories, it trains the policy toward a reward-tilted target distribution anchored by a frozen reference model. The reward increases mass on successful completions, while the reference model regularizes allocation over plausible generations. To make this usable for diffusion LMs, the method introduces a diffusion-compatible sequence-level surrogate for comparing fully denoised completions under the current and reference models. It also learns a prompt-dependent normalization term jointly with the policy, so the normalizer receives gradient signal at every training step. This design directly addresses the fact that many denoising paths can lead to the same final answer, while ordinary sampled reward maximization tends to reinforce whichever paths were sampled early.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation covers mathematical reasoning and code generation: GSM8K, MATH-500, HumanEval, and MBPP, with held-out tests on Minerva Math and LiveCodeBench. The paper reports that TraFL is the only directly evaluated post-training method that improves over the base model in every benchmark-length setting, and that it outperforms ESPO and JustGRPO on average. On LiveCodeBench, it is reported as the strongest method across all difficulty splits. An LLM-as-judge analysis suggests that the gains come from broader coverage of correct solutions rather than only sharper scoring of one dominant mode. The provided text does not include exact accuracy numbers, so the key empirical signal is robustness across settings and improved coverage under repeated sampling.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim with some attention to the objective, about 30 minutes. Start with the definition of trajectory locking in the introduction, then read the Trajectory Flow Balancing section carefully enough to understand why terminal rewards are path-indifferent. In the experiments, focus on direct comparisons with ESPO and JustGRPO, and on ablations for the learned normalization and reference anchoring if available. For readers working on diffusion LM post-training, the objective and normalization design are the main parts to inspect; for readers focused on standard AR RL, it is best read as a case study in non-AR distribution matching.

recommendation.zh: Diffusion LM后训练中的trajectory locking是一个值得关注的新失效模式，TraFL用reference anchor防止坍缩的思路值得在diffusion LM预训练/后训练设计中参考。建议读方法部分。
recommendation.en: Trajectory locking in diffusion LM post-training is a noteworthy new failure mode; the reference-anchor approach of TraFL is worth considering in diffusion LM pretraining/post-training design. Recommend reading the method section.

paper.title: Performance-Driven Policy Optimization for Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Windowing
paper.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference by having a lightweight draft model propose speculative windows of candidate tokens for parallel verification by a larger target model. In practice, speculative efficiency is often bottlenecked by hard-to-draft positions, where an early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the speculative window. Most learning-based drafters are still optimized with token-level supervised objectives, even though speculative utility is i

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 speculative decoding 里一个很具体但长期存在的错配：推理时真正决定加速效果的是“一个 speculative window 最终能被 target 接受多长前缀”，而多数 drafter 训练目标仍是 token-level 的模仿或蒸馏。两者不一致的地方在于，window 中只要前面某个位置先错，后面即使都对，也会在验证时整体失效。因此，单纯提升逐 token 拟合，并不稳定地转化为更长 accepted prefix，也不一定带来更高吞吐。论文把这个问题明确表述为 prefix-sensitive、window-level 的优化问题，并尝试直接对 speculative utility 做训练。
summary.importance: 对基座研究本身，它不是预训练范式论文，而是推理加速里的训练目标重构工作，所以重要性更多在“训练目标如何更贴近最终系统指标”这一层。启发点有两点。第一，很多看似是 inference engineering 的问题，根子在训练目标与部署目标不一致；这里把 drafter 从 imitation 拉到 performance-driven optimization，是很典型的例子。第二，它提供了一个可迁移的思路：当系统收益由序列级、前缀级、或 early-failure 主导时，token-level loss 往往不够，应该显式建模 credit assignment。对做 speculative decoding、辅助模型训练、甚至多阶段生成系统的人，这个角度是有参考价值的。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 PPOW：把 drafter 视为在固定长度 speculative window 上采样动作的 policy，用 window 级 reward 做强化学习更新，而不是只做 token 监督。论文的设计分三层。

第一层是 window-level RL formulation。给定当前前缀，drafter 一次生成长度 K 的候选 window，target 按标准 speculative decoding 做并行验证，得到 accepted prefix 长度 k。训练目标不再是每个 token 的 CE，而是最大化整个 window 的期望回报。这个 formulation 直接对应实际验证机制，优点是 credit assignment 与真实吞吐更一致；代价是 reward 稀疏、方差更大。

第二层是 reward 设计。作者用了两个互补信号。其一是 Cost-Aware Speedup Reward，主奖励围绕 accepted prefix 长度构造，同时把 drafter 相对成本纳入考虑。这样不是盲目追求更长 window，而是追求单位代价下更高加速收益。这个点很关键，因为 speculative decoding 的真实收益取决于 target 节省的步数减去 drafter 额外开销。其二是 Distribution-Based Proximity Reward，作为辅助奖励，在 accepted prefix 很短、主奖励过于离散时，给那些虽然没被完整接受、但分布上仍接近 target 偏好的 window 一部分 credit。论文强调这不是简单回到 token CE，而是保留 window 级训练框架下的“软接近度”信号，用来缓解早期 mismatch 导致的零碎反馈。

第三层是 Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing，简称 ADAW。作者观察到并非所有训练 window 都同样有信息量：很多容易位置即使继续优化，对整体 acceptance bottleneck 帮助有限。于是他们用 confidence-weighted 的 draft-target divergence 来挑选更值得训练的窗口，优先关注那些更可能成为 acceptance bottleneck 的位置。这里的直觉是，如果 drafter 在高置信位置仍与 target 明显偏离，那么这个位置更可能在验证时早早截断 accepted prefix。相比均匀采样窗口，这种 prioritization 把训练预算集中到真正限制吞吐的局部。

从与已有方法的区别看，MEDUSA、Hydra、EAGLE、HASS、GRIFFIN 这类工作主要在 drafter 架构、head 设计、特征利用或监督训练上做文章；蒸馏方法则强调分布对齐。PPOW 的不同点不在 drafter 结构，而在优化目标：它把 speculative decoding 当成一个有明确系统回报的序列决策问题。论文实验里以 EAGLE family 的 feature-based drafter 为底座，也说明该方法更像一个可叠加的训练层，而不是替代现有 drafter 架构。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验结论主要有三类。

第一类是端到端 speculative performance。作者报告 PPOW 相比基于监督训练的基线，能够提升 speculative decoding 的实际效率，核心体现为更长的 accepted prefix 和更高吞吐，而不是只改善 token-level 拟合。论文强调这种收益在存在明显 hard-to-draft positions 的场景更明显，因为这些场景里早期 mismatch 对整体窗口利用率伤害最大。

第二类是 reward 与训练策略消融。Cost-Aware Speedup Reward 单独使用时，能够把优化方向拉向真实加速目标；加入 Distribution-Based Proximity Reward 后，在 accepted-prefix 信号稀疏或训练早期不稳定时更稳，说明辅助分布奖励确实缓解了纯 prefix reward 的高方差问题。ADAW 的消融则显示，优先训练高 divergence 窗口优于均匀窗口采样，支持“训练预算应集中在 acceptance bottleneck”这一判断。

第三类是分析性实验。论文在附录里给出 acceptance bottleneck 的动机分析，并用实验说明 token-level imitation improvement 与 speculative speedup 之间并非线性对应。也就是说，某些 token-level 指标更好并不保证 accepted prefix 更长，这正是 PPOW 试图修正的错配。

需要说明的是，当前提供的全文片段没有完整实验表格、参数量、训练 token 数、具体 speedup 数值和各基线的精确增益，因此无法负责任地填入具体数字。如果后续拿到完整正文和附录，建议重点补三类数字：所用 target/drafter 规模、window 长度 K 与训练设置、以及相对 EAGLE/监督基线的 acceptance length 和 wall-clock speedup 提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读，不必逐式推导。建议先看 Introduction，把作者强调的“token-level objective 与 window-level utility 错配”吃透；这是整篇最有信息量的判断。然后看 PPOW 方法部分，重点抓三个模块：Cost-Aware Speedup Reward、Distribution-Based Proximity Reward、ADAW。读的时候要一直问两个问题：为什么 accepted prefix 是主优化对象；为什么还需要一个 proximity 辅助奖励。

如果时间有限，优先看方法图、reward 定义、以及 ablation 表。实验部分不用只盯最终 speedup，更值得看的是：1）token-level 指标和真实 speculative gain 是否脱钩；2）ADAW 是否真的把训练集中到瓶颈位置；3）RL 训练是否稳定，是否依赖特定 drafter 架构。

预计阅读时间 20 到 30 分钟。若要深挖，建议再看附录里关于 acceptance bottleneck 的分析，以及 speculative verification 的形式化定义，判断 reward 设计是否与真实系统成本严格一致。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific mismatch in speculative decoding: inference-time utility is determined at the window level, by how long the accepted prefix is after target verification, while most drafters are still trained with token-level imitation or distillation losses. This mismatch matters because one early mismatch truncates the accepted prefix and invalidates the rest of the drafted window. As a result, better next-token accuracy does not reliably translate into longer accepted prefixes or higher throughput. The paper reframes drafter training as a prefix-sensitive, window-level optimization problem.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense; it is an inference-acceleration paper with a training-objective contribution. Its value for foundation-model researchers is in the lesson it makes explicit: when deployment utility is sequence-level and dominated by early failures, token-level supervision can be the wrong target. The work is useful as a case study in objective mismatch between training and system metrics. It also offers a transferable idea for auxiliary models and multi-stage generation systems: if utility depends on prefix survival rather than local token fit, credit assignment should be designed around that structure instead of relying on plain CE.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method, PPOW, treats the drafter as a policy over fixed-length speculative windows and optimizes it with window-level reinforcement learning rather than pure token supervision. The design has three main pieces.

First, a window-level RL formulation. Given a prefix, the drafter samples a K-token speculative window. The target model then performs standard speculative verification and returns an accepted prefix length k. Training maximizes expected reward over the whole window, not per-token likelihood. This aligns the optimization target with the actual verification mechanism. The benefit is better alignment with realized speedup; the cost is sparser and higher-variance feedback.

Second, reward design. PPOW uses two complementary rewards. The main one is a Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, built around accepted-prefix length while accounting for the relative cost of the drafter. This is important because speculative decoding only helps if target-side savings exceed drafting overhead. The auxiliary one is a Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, which gives partial credit to windows that remain close to the target model's preferences even when the accepted prefix is cut short early. The point is not to fall back to token CE, but to provide a softer signal inside the same window-level framework when the main reward is too sparse.

Third, Adaptive Divergence-Aware Windowing (ADAW). The paper argues that not all windows are equally informative during training. Many easy windows are not the true bottlenecks for acceptance. ADAW prioritizes windows with large confidence-weighted draft-target divergence, under the intuition that high-confidence disagreements are more likely to create early truncation points. Compared with uniform sampling, this focuses training budget on the positions that most constrain realized throughput.

Relative to prior work such as MEDUSA, Hydra, EAGLE, HASS, and GRIFFIN, the novelty is not a new drafter architecture. Those lines mainly improve heads, features, or supervised alignment. PPOW instead changes the optimization target itself, treating speculative decoding as a sequential decision problem with a system-level reward. The experiments use an EAGLE-style feature-based drafter as the base, which suggests the method is intended as a training layer that can sit on top of existing drafter designs.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full text, the experimental findings fall into three buckets.

First, end-to-end speculative performance. PPOW improves realized speculative efficiency over supervised baselines, with gains reflected in longer accepted prefixes and better throughput rather than only better token-level fit. The paper stresses that the benefit is more visible when there are hard-to-draft positions, because those are exactly where early mismatches waste most of a speculative window.

Second, ablations on rewards and training strategy. The Cost-Aware Speedup Reward moves optimization toward actual acceleration. Adding the Distribution-Based Proximity Reward improves stability when accepted-prefix signals are sparse, especially early in training, which supports the claim that pure prefix-based rewards are too brittle on their own. ADAW outperforms uniform window treatment, consistent with the idea that training should focus on acceptance bottlenecks rather than spread effort evenly.

Third, analytical evidence. The appendix motivates the notion of acceptance bottlenecks and the experiments show that improvements in token-level imitation do not map linearly to speculative speedup. That empirical decoupling is the central justification for the method.

One limitation here is that the supplied text does not include the full result tables, model sizes, training-token counts, or exact speedup numbers. So it would be unsafe to invent precise figures. With the complete paper and appendix, the key numbers to extract would be: target and drafter scales, speculative window length K and training setup, and the exact gains over EAGLE or supervised baselines in accepted-prefix length and wall-clock speedup.
summary_en.reading_guide:
This is a skim paper, not one that requires line-by-line derivation. Start with the introduction and make sure the central mismatch is clear: token-level objectives optimize local imitation, while speculative utility is window-level and prefix-sensitive. That is the main idea worth carrying away.

Then read the PPOW method section with attention to three components: the Cost-Aware Speedup Reward, the Distribution-Based Proximity Reward, and ADAW. Two questions are worth keeping in mind while reading: why accepted-prefix length is the right primary target, and why an auxiliary proximity reward is needed instead of relying on the main reward alone.

If time is limited, prioritize the method figure, the reward definitions, and the ablation tables. In the experiments, do not only look at final speedup. The more informative checks are whether token-level metrics decouple from realized speculative gains, whether ADAW really concentrates training on bottleneck windows, and whether the RL training remains stable across drafter settings.

Estimated reading time is 20 to 30 minutes. For a deeper pass, inspect the appendix sections on acceptance-bottleneck analysis and the formal speculative verification setup, especially to judge whether the reward matches real system cost closely enough.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是预训练，但抓住了 speculative decoding 最关键的 objective mismatch；先看 reward 定义和 adaptive windowing，若 setup 干净，值得在内部 drafter 训练里复现。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it targets the core objective mismatch in speculative decoding; read the reward design and adaptive windowing first, and replicate internally if the setup is clean.

paper.title: CreFlow: Corrective Reflow for Sparse-Reward Embodied Video Diffusion RL
paper.abstract: Video generation models trained on heterogeneous data with likelihood-surrogate objectives can produce visually plausible rollouts that violate physical constraints in embodied manipulation. Although reinforcement-learning post-training offers a natural route to adapting VGMs, existing video-RL rewards often reduce each rollout to a low-level visual metric, whereas manipulation video evaluation requires logic-based verification of whether the rollout satisfies a compositional task specification.

summary.core_problem: 现有具身视频生成的RL奖励仅用低层级视觉指标，无法验证生成视频是否满足组合化任务逻辑约束的问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出基于时序逻辑的组合奖励与配套的在线RL矫正回流框架
summary.technical_approach: 将任务要求自动转化为线性时序逻辑约束的组合，提供可信奖励与局部错误定位；提出CreFlow在线RL框架，适配高维视频生成的奖励优化
summary.experiments: 在具身操纵视频生成任务上测试，未公布完整量化结果
summary.authors_note: 西北大学、UCSD、牛津大学联合团队，包含知名学者Philip Torr

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL rewards for embodied video generation only use low-level visual metrics, cannot verify whether generated videos satisfy compositional task logic constraints
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes temporal-logic-based compositional reward and corresponding online RL corrective reflow framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Automatically formulate task requirements as composition of Linear Temporal Logic constraints, provide faithful rewards and localized error information; propose CreFlow online RL framework adapted for high-dimensional video generation reward optimization
summary_en.experiments: Test on embodied manipulation video generation tasks, full quantitative results not released
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from Northwestern University, UCSD, University of Oxford, including well-known researcher Philip Torr

recommendation.zh: 具身视频生成的结构化奖励设计，时序逻辑约束的思路可作为RL后训练的参考，仅看奖励设计部分即可
recommendation.en: Structured reward design for embodied video generation, temporal logic constraint idea can be reference for RL post-training, only reward design section worth reading

paper.title: Prompting Policies for Multi-step Reasoning and Tool-Use in Black-box LLMs with Iterative Distillation of Experience
paper.abstract: The shift toward interacting with frozen, "black-box" Large Language Models (LLMs) has transformed prompt engineering from a heuristic exercise into a critical optimization challenge. We propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework for training learned prompting policies via iterative distillation of experience. In this architecture, a lightweight prompter model is optimized to maximize task-specific rewards for a larger, frozen worker LLM. By utilizing a contrastive experience buffer that co

summary.core_problem: 如何通过强化学习优化黑盒LLM在多步推理和工具使用任务中的Prompt策略？
summary.importance: 提出了一种通过迭代经验蒸馏来训练Prompt策略的RL框架，将迭代的Prompt优化过程摊销到轻量级Prompter模型的单次前向传播中，显著提升了黑盒LLM的复杂任务性能。
summary.technical_approach: 训练一个轻量级的Prompter模型，以最大化冻结的Worker LLM的任务特定奖励。利用包含标量奖励和密集文本批评的对比经验缓冲区，将迭代的Prompt改进蒸馏到策略权重中。
summary.experiments: 在Big Bench Extra Hard (BBEH)和Tau-bench上进行实验。在逻辑推理任务上性能从55%提升至90%，在工具使用任务上从74%提升至91%。
summary.authors_note: Google Research团队工作。

summary_en.core_problem: How to optimize prompt policies for black-box LLMs in multi-step reasoning and tool-use tasks via reinforcement learning?
summary_en.importance: Proposes an RL framework for training prompt policies via iterative distillation of experience, amortizing the iterative prompt refinement process into a single forward pass of a lightweight prompter model, significantly improving black-box LLM performance on complex tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trains a lightweight prompter model to maximize task-specific rewards for a frozen worker LLM. Utilizes a contrastive experience buffer coupling scalar rewards with dense textual critiques to distill iterative prompt refinement into policy weights.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on Big Bench Extra Hard (BBEH) and Tau-bench. Improved performance from 55% to 90% in logic-intensive reasoning and 74% to 91% in tool-use tasks.
summary_en.authors_note: Work from Google Research.

recommendation.zh: Google用RL训练小模型来给大模型写Prompt，将迭代优化蒸馏为单次生成，对Post-train阶段的推理能力增强和Agent系统设计有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Google uses RL to train a small model to write prompts for a large model, distilling iterative optimization into single-shot generation, valuable for reasoning enhancement in post-train and agent system design.

paper.title: MetaAgent-X : Breaking the Ceiling of Automatic Multi-Agent Systems via End-to-End Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Automatic multi-agent systems aim to instantiate agent workflows without relying on manually designed or fixed orchestration. However, existing automatic MAS approaches remain only partially adaptive: they either perform training-free test-time search or optimize the meta-level designer while keeping downstream execution agents frozen, which creating a frozen-executor ceiling and leaving the end-to-end training of self-designing and self-executing agentic models unexplored. To address this, we i

summary.core_problem: 解决自动多 agent 系统中“设计器可优化、执行器却冻结”的上限问题，尝试把工作流设计与执行一起做端到端强化学习。
summary.importance: 这是通用 multi-agent system 的训练框架工作。对预训练研究员的价值不在 agent 本身，而在于它把层级 credit assignment、co-evolution 和稳定训练问题显式化，这些问题与 RL 后训练接口有一定同构性。
summary.technical_approach: MetaAgent-X 联合优化 MAS 设计与执行。系统支持脚本式 MAS 生成、执行 rollout 收集，以及对 designer 和 executor 两条轨迹同时做 credit assignment。为稳定训练，作者提出 Executor Designer Hierarchical Rollout 和 Stagewise Co-evolution，让设计器与执行器分阶段共同演化，而不是只在测试时搜索或只训练 meta-designer。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark、模型规模和量化结果，但核心卖点是相较于 training-free test-time search 或 frozen-executor 方案，端到端 RL 能突破自动 MAS 的性能上限。由于缺少 clean setup 细节，目前更适合作为训练框架思路而非结论性证据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Oregon State University、Pennsylvania State University 和 AG2AI, Inc。未见顶级实验室背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the 'frozen-executor ceiling' in automatic multi-agent systems, where the designer may be optimized but downstream execution agents remain fixed.
summary_en.importance: This is a general multi-agent training framework paper. Its relevance to pretraining researchers is indirect: it makes hierarchical credit assignment, co-evolution, and training stability explicit, which rhymes with RL-based post-training interfaces.
summary_en.technical_approach: MetaAgent-X jointly optimizes MAS design and execution with end-to-end reinforcement learning. It supports script-based MAS generation, execution rollout collection, and credit assignment over both designer and executor trajectories. To stabilize training, it introduces Executor Designer Hierarchical Rollout and Stagewise Co-evolution so that designer and executor evolve together in stages rather than relying on test-time search or a frozen executor.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose concrete benchmarks, model sizes, or quantitative gains. The main claim is that end-to-end RL breaks the ceiling of training-free search and frozen-executor methods. Without cleaner setup details, this is better treated as a framework idea than hard evidence.
summary_en.authors_note: Authors are from Oregon State University, Pennsylvania State University, and AG2AI, Inc. No top-lab affiliation is evident.

recommendation.zh: 如果你关心 RL 后训练里的层级 credit assignment，可以扫一眼；重点看 designer/executor 联训怎么稳，性能数字先保留态度。
recommendation.en: Worth a quick look if you care about hierarchical credit assignment in RL post-training; focus on how they stabilize joint designer/executor training and stay skeptical about the headline gains.

paper.title: GRIP-VLM: Group-Relative Importance Pruning for Efficient Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: In Vision-Language Models (VLMs), processing a massive number of visual tokens incurs prohibitive computational overhead. While recent training-aware pruning methods attempt to selectively discard redundant tokens, they largely rely on continuous-gradient relaxations. However, visual token pruning is inherently a discrete, non-convex combinatorial problem; consequently, these continuous approximations frequently trap the optimization in sub-optimal local minima, especially under aggressive compr

summary.core_problem: GRIP-VLM 解决 VLM 视觉 token 过多导致推理开销高的问题，重点是训练一个能在不同预算下动态选择保留 token 的 pruning 策略。论文认为视觉 token pruning 是离散子集选择问题，用 Gumbel-Softmax 或可微 top-k 这类连续松弛方法容易在高压缩率下落入差的局部解。
summary.importance: 这篇更接近高效 VLM 推理研究，不属于预训练方法本身。对基座研究的启发在于：高分辨率图像和视频会把视觉 token 数从早期约 576 推到上万级，统一多模态模型的训练和推理都会受这个瓶颈限制。论文把 token selection 看成非平滑决策问题，并用 RL 处理 hard samples，这对设计可学习的视觉 token routing、动态计算和多模态 MoE 有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: GRIP-VLM 是两阶段动态 pruning 框架。系统层面，它在 Transformer 层中加入轻量 scoring module，可用于视觉编码器阶段，也可用于 LLM decoder 阶段，并且可以和启发式 pruning 方法叠加。token 层面，它设计 budget-aware scorer，让打分器显式感知当前压缩预算；训练时用 curriculum learning，从接近无损的预算逐步过渡到高压缩预算，以减少直接训练高压缩策略的不稳定。优化层面，先用 supervised distillation 得到一个稳定初始策略，再用 GRPO 风格的 reinforcement learning 在离散选择空间中探索。这个设计针对的是连续松弛的局限：当正确性随 keep ratio 呈现非单调波动时，平滑 surrogate 很难找到好的 token 子集。
summary.experiments: 论文在 6 个多模态 benchmark 上报告结果，并以 192 个视觉 token 预算作为关键比较点。GRIP-VLM 在该预算下整体表现优于启发式和监督学习 pruning 基线。在等精度约束下，推理速度比竞争方法快 15%。论文还把样本按 pruning 难度分成 LV1、LV2、LV3：LV1 对 pruning 稳定，启发式方法已足够；LV2 随 keep ratio 大致单调退化，监督学习有明显收益；LV3 呈现非单调振荡，RL 收益最大。在 hard samples 上，GRIP-VLM 相比已有 pruning baseline 平均成功率提升 33%，在部分 LV3 设置中比启发式和监督学习方法高最多约 20 个百分点。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。重点看 Motivation 里对 pruning landscape heterogeneity 的实验设计，尤其是用 keep ratio 扫描正确/错误交替次数来定义 LV1–LV3。这部分比方法命名更有信息量。然后看 budget-aware scorer、curriculum learning、SFT-anchored RL/GRPO 的训练流程。若只关心预训练，可跳过具体 benchmark 细节，关注它如何把视觉 token 裁剪建模为离散策略优化，以及 hard samples 为什么需要探索而不只是可微打分。

summary_en.core_problem: GRIP-VLM targets the inference cost caused by excessive visual tokens in VLMs. The core claim is that visual token pruning is a discrete subset-selection problem. Continuous relaxations such as Gumbel-Softmax or differentiable top-k can be fragile, especially when the compression budget is tight.
summary_en.importance: This is primarily an efficient VLM inference paper, not a pretraining paper. Its relevance to foundation-model research comes from the scaling pressure of visual tokens: modern VLMs may process hundreds to tens of thousands of visual tokens for high-resolution images or video. The paper’s framing of token selection as a non-smooth decision problem is useful for thinking about dynamic visual token routing, adaptive compute, and multimodal sparse computation.
summary_en.technical_approach: GRIP-VLM uses a two-stage dynamic pruning framework. It inserts lightweight scoring modules into Transformer layers and supports pruning in both the visual encoder and LLM decoder stages. The scorer is budget-aware: it conditions token importance on the current token budget, which lets one model operate across different compression levels. Training starts with curriculum learning, moving from mild pruning to aggressive pruning, and uses supervised distillation to create a stable initial policy. It then applies GRPO-style reinforcement learning to explore discrete pruning decisions. This is intended to handle cases where correctness is not a smooth monotonic function of the keep ratio.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports results on six multimodal benchmarks, with 192 visual tokens as a key budget setting. GRIP-VLM outperforms heuristic and supervised pruning baselines at that budget. Under an equal-accuracy constraint, it gives 15% faster inference than competing methods. The paper also analyzes pruning difficulty by sweeping keep ratios and counting correct/incorrect transitions. Easy samples are stable under pruning, medium samples degrade roughly monotonically, and hard samples show oscillatory behavior. On hard samples, GRIP-VLM improves success rate by 33% on average over existing pruning baselines, and in some LV3 cases gains up to about 20 points over heuristic and supervised methods.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is sufficient. The most useful part is the motivation section on heterogeneous pruning landscapes, especially the LV1–LV3 definition based on keep-ratio sweeps. Then read the budget-aware scorer, curriculum training, and SFT-anchored GRPO procedure. For pretraining-oriented readers, benchmark details are less important than the modeling choice: treating visual token reduction as discrete policy optimization rather than differentiable scoring alone.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法和高压缩 ablation；把 GRPO 用在离散 token pruning 上是有味道的，但别把它误读成预训练结论。
recommendation.en: Read the method and aggressive-compression ablations; using GRPO for discrete token pruning is interesting, but do not read it as a pretraining result.

institutions: Institute for AI Industry Research (AIR), Tsinghua University
University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: CoT-Guard: Small Models for Strong Monitoring
paper.abstract: Monitoring the chain-of-thought (CoT) of reasoning models is a promising approach for detecting covert misbehavior (i.e., hidden objectives) in code generation tasks. While large models (GPT-5, Gemini-3-Flash) can serve as effective CoT monitors, they are expensive to deploy due to the lengthy reasoning traces and high API cost, emphasizing the need for smaller, cheaper alternatives. Nevertheless, we find that current small models (4B--8B) struggle to detect hidden objectives despite access to t

summary.core_problem: 现有4B-8B开源小模型在代码生成任务的CoT轨迹隐蔽不当行为检测上性能远低于大闭源监控模型；同时大模型部署成本高、依赖闭源API，小模型还容易将注入的隐藏目标误判为用户查询的合法部分，缺乏低成本、高性能的小模型CoT监控方案。
summary.importance: 验证了小模型通过结构化后训练流水线可以在专用安全监控任务上超过更大的闭源模型。在难样本上施加RL提升域外泛化的思路，为垂直能力增强、LLM安全对齐的后训练流水线设计提供了可落地的参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出4B参数的CoT监控模型CoT-Guard，采用两阶段后训练流水线：第一阶段有监督微调（SFT），从更强的闭源监控模型蒸馏检测行为，缩小域内任务的性能差距；第二阶段在SFT后针对难样本做强化学习（RL），提升域外泛化能力。同时基于真实供应链攻击形式化了中间人威胁模型，包含两种攻击场景：提示操纵（将隐藏目标注入用户提示）、代码操纵（直接修改生成代码），并构造了4种对应真实代码攻击模式的新隐藏目标：包强制、域名仿冒（Typosquatting）、广告注释、广告打印。
summary.experiments: 零样本设置下，4B-8B开源模型在隐藏目标检测上与大闭源监控模型存在显著性能差距。CoT-Guard 4B在提示操纵和代码操纵两种攻击下，9种域外隐藏目标的检测性能超过GPT-5.4和GPT-5-mini，与Gemini-3-Flash性能接近但成本远更低。在最强对抗隐藏策略下，其G-Mean仅下降1.0%。消融实验验证，针对难隐藏目标做RL能有效提升域外泛化能力。
summary.reading_guide: 先泛读第3节的威胁模型与新增隐藏目标设计，再看第4节的后训练流水线细节，尤其是RL阶段的难样本筛选逻辑，最后浏览第5节的主实验与消融结果，预计阅读时间20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Small open-source models (4B–8B) perform poorly at detecting covert hidden objectives in code generation agent CoT traces, far underperforming large closed-source monitors. Deploying large models for CoT monitoring also incurs high API costs and closed-system dependency, while small models frequently misclassify injected hidden objectives as legitimate parts of user queries.
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that small models can outperform much larger closed-source models on specialized safety monitoring tasks via a structured post-training pipeline. The strategy of applying RL on hard samples to boost out-of-domain generalization provides actionable reference for designing post-training pipelines for vertical capability enhancement and LLM safety alignment.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes CoT-Guard, a 4B-parameter CoT monitoring model with a two-stage post-training pipeline: 1) Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) to distill detection behavior from stronger closed-source monitors, closing the performance gap on in-domain tasks; 2) Reinforcement learning (RL) on hard negative samples post-SFT to improve out-of-domain generalization. Also formalizes a practical man-in-the-middle threat model based on real-world supply chain attacks, with two attack scenarios: prompt manipulation (inject hidden objectives into user prompts) and code manipulation (directly modify generated code). Four new hidden objectives aligned with real code attack patterns are constructed: Package Forcing, Typosquatting, Ads Comment, and Ads Print.
summary_en.experiments: Zero-shot 4B–8B open-source models show substantial performance gaps to large closed-source monitors on hidden objective detection. CoT-Guard 4B outperforms GPT-5.4 and GPT-5-mini on 9 out-of-domain hidden objectives under both prompt and code manipulation attacks, with performance competitive to Gemini-3-Flash at a far lower cost. Under the strongest adversarial concealment strategy, its G-Mean only drops by 1.0%. Ablations confirm that RL on hard hidden objectives drives improved out-of-domain generalization.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Section 3 first for the threat model and new hidden objective designs. Then review the post-training pipeline details, especially hard sample selection for RL, in Section 4. Finally check the main experiment and ablation results in Section 5. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 展示了如何用 SFT+RL 蒸馏小模型做 CoT 监控，对 Scalable Oversight 和后训练数据构造有一定参考价值，可扫读方法设计。
recommendation.en: Demonstrates how to distill small models for CoT monitoring using SFT+RL; offers reference value for Scalable Oversight and post-training data construction. Skim the method design.

paper.title: HLS-Seek: QoR-Aware Code Generation for High-Level Synthesis via Proxy Comparative Reward Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: High-Level Synthesis (HLS) compiles algorithmic C/C++ descriptions into hardware, with Quality of Results (QoR) -- latency and resource utilization -- critically governed by pragma configurations and code structure. Existing LLM-based HLS approaches train for functional correctness but ignore QoR entirely. We observe that reinforcement learning (RL) for HLS does not require absolute synthesis results -- only relative comparisons between candidates. Based on this insight, we propose \textbf{HLS-S

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM 生成高层次综合 HLS 代码时只优化功能正确性、忽略延迟和资源利用等 QoR 指标的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是面向硬件代码生成的 RL 训练与 reward 设计；对 LLM 基座预训练较远，但对代码模型后训练中的昂贵外部评测、proxy reward 和 reward hacking 控制有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 HLS-Seek，一个 QoR-aware 的自然语言到 HLS 代码生成框架。核心是用比较式 proxy reward model 替代昂贵的 synthesis-in-the-loop RL；reward 不预测绝对综合结果，而判断候选间 Pareto dominance。为降低 reward hacking，引入 uncertainty-aware MC dropout switching，在低置信样本上调用真实 Vitis HLS 综合，并在线更新 proxy reward。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 proxy reward model 达到 99.53% Pareto-dominance accuracy；HLS-Seek 在 HLS-e 基准上取得 81.5% syntax correctness pass@1 和 81.4% Func@5。未给出底座模型规模、训练数据规模和完整 baseline 列表。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 National University of Singapore；Bingsheng He 和 Weng-Fai Wong 在高性能计算、数据库系统和硬件相关方向有长期工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses LLM-based HLS code generation that optimizes functional correctness while ignoring quality-of-result metrics such as latency and resource utilization.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an RL and reward-design method for hardware code generation. It is distant from LLM pretraining, but it is useful as a case study for expensive external evaluators, proxy rewards, and reward-hacking control in code-model post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: HLS-Seek is a QoR-aware NL-to-HLS framework. It replaces expensive synthesis-in-the-loop RL with a comparative proxy reward model that predicts Pareto dominance between candidates rather than absolute synthesis outcomes. To reduce reward hacking, it uses uncertainty-aware MC dropout switching: low-confidence candidates are sent to real Vitis HLS synthesis, and the proxy is updated online.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 99.53% Pareto-dominance accuracy for the proxy reward model. HLS-Seek achieves 81.5% syntax correctness pass@1 and 81.4% Func@5 on HLS-e. The provided abstract does not specify base model size, training data scale, or full baseline details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the National University of Singapore. Bingsheng He and Weng-Fai Wong have long-standing work in high-performance computing, database systems, and hardware-related systems.

recommendation.zh: 领域很窄；可借鉴的是“比较式 proxy reward + 低置信真实评测”这套省预算 RL 设计。
recommendation.en: The domain is narrow; the reusable piece is the budget-aware RL design: comparative proxy reward plus real evaluation on low-confidence cases.

paper.title: Scaling Retrieval-Augmented Reasoning with Parallel Search and Explicit Merging
paper.abstract: Deep search agents have proven effective in enhancing LLMs by retrieving external knowledge during multi-step reasoning. However, existing methods often generate a single query for retrieval at each reasoning step, limiting information coverage and introducing high noise. This may result in low signal-to-noise ratios (SNR) during search, degrading reasoning accuracy and leading to unnecessary reasoning steps. In this paper, we introduce MultiSearch, an RL-based framework that addresses these lim

summary.core_problem: 现有深度搜索Agent在推理过程中每个步骤仅生成单个检索查询，存在检索信噪比低、信息覆盖不足的问题；同时基于最终结果的RL奖励无法对中间检索和信息整合行为提供有效监督，导致推理准确率下降或产生不必要的检索步骤。
summary.importance: 提出了多查询并行检索+显式信息合并的深度搜索范式，配合多过程细粒度RL奖励设计，为检索增强推理的训练提供了更精细的监督信号设计思路；验证了小参数模型通过检索增强和合理的RL训练可以在知识密集型任务上获得显著性能提升，为高效推理Agent的训练提供了参考。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MultiSearch RL框架：1. 在每个推理步骤，从改写、概念扩展、问题分解多个视角生成多个并行检索查询，扩大相关信息覆盖范围，降低对单一查询的依赖；2. 增加显式合并步骤，从检索到的多个文档中提取并整合关键信息，提升中间推理上下文的信噪比；3. 设计多过程奖励，除最终答案正确性的结果奖励外，新增鼓励多查询检索的查询奖励、鼓励信息整合的合并奖励；4. 采用组奖励解耦归一化策略优化（GDPO）对异质奖励信号分别归一化后再聚合，避免不同量级奖励互相干扰。
summary.experiments: 基于Qwen2.5-3B/7B Base和Instruct骨干训练模型，在7个QA基准上评测，包括3个单跳数据集和4个多跳数据集。实验结果：1. MultiSearch在所有基准上的平均性能优于现有ReAct风格的深度搜索基线；2. 训练过程中，Agent逐步学会生成更多检索查询并输出信噪比更高的合并信息，验证了过程奖励的引导作用；3. 消融实验表明，多查询检索、显式合并、对应的过程奖励分别对整体性能有独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第2章的奖励设计部分，理解多过程奖励的设计逻辑和GDPO的适配方式；检索和合并的机制设计可以快速浏览，核心创新在训练监督部分；预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing deep search agents generate only one retrieval query per reasoning step, leading to low retrieval SNR and insufficient information coverage. Meanwhile, RL rewards based solely on final outcomes cannot provide effective supervision for intermediate retrieval and information consolidation behaviors, resulting in degraded reasoning accuracy or unnecessary retrieval steps.
summary_en.importance: MultiSearch proposes a deep search paradigm of parallel multi-query retrieval plus explicit information merging, paired with a fine-grained multi-process RL reward design, providing a more refined supervision signal design思路 for retrieval-augmented reasoning training. It verifies that small parameter models can achieve significant performance improvements on knowledge-intensive tasks through retrieval augmentation and reasonable RL training, providing a reference for efficient reasoning agent training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The MultiSearch RL framework is designed as follows: 1. At each reasoning step, multiple parallel retrieval queries are generated from perspectives of rephrasing, concept expansion, and question decomposition to expand relevant information coverage and reduce reliance on a single query; 2. An explicit merging step is added to extract and integrate key information from multiple retrieved documents, improving the SNR of the intermediate reasoning context; 3. A multi-process reward design includes a query reward to encourage multi-query retrieval and a merging reward to encourage information consolidation, in addition to the outcome reward for final answer correctness; 4. Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization (GDPO) is used to normalize heterogeneous reward signals separately before aggregation, avoiding interference between rewards of different magnitudes.
summary_en.experiments: Models are trained on Qwen2.5-3B/7B Base and Instruct backbones, and evaluated on 7 QA benchmarks, including 3 single-hop datasets and 4 multi-hop datasets. Results: 1. MultiSearch achieves better average performance than existing ReAct-style deep search baselines across all benchmarks; 2. During training, the agent gradually learns to generate more retrieval queries and produce merged information with higher SNR, verifying the guiding effect of process rewards; 3. Ablation studies show that multi-query retrieval, explicit merging, and corresponding process rewards each contribute independently to overall performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the reward design section in Chapter 2 to understand the logic of multi-process reward design and the adaptation of GDPO. The mechanism design of retrieval and merging can be skimmed, as the core innovation lies in the training supervision part. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看 merge 设计和 RL reward；多 query 本身不新，关键是它是否真的提高证据信噪比而非堆 context。
recommendation.en: Read the merge design and RL reward; multi-query retrieval is not new, the real question is whether SNR improves rather than just adding context.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: Revisiting DAgger in the Era of LLM-Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LM agents learn from multi-turn interaction, where a single early mistake can alter the subsequent state distribution and derail the whole trajectory. Existing recipes fall short in complementary ways: supervised fine-tuning provides dense teacher supervision but suffers from covariate shift because it is trained on off-policy teacher trajectories; while reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards avoids this off-policy mismatch by learning from on-policy rollouts but with only s

summary.core_problem: 在长时程、多轮交互的 LLM-Agent 里，SFT 的离策略模仿会因 covariate shift 产生误差累积；而基于可验证奖励的 RLVR 虽然在策略分布上更贴近部署，但反馈稀疏、信用分配难且采样成本高。论文要解决的是：能否同时获得“接近 on-policy 的状态覆盖”与“密集的教师监督”，并且避免 OPD 这类 on-policy 蒸馏在弱学生阶段的 cold-start 失败。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对 post-train→pretrain 闭环有现实意义：它把经典 imitation learning 的 DAgger 机制落到 LLM 多轮 agent 上，提供一种比 RLVR 更省采样、比纯 SFT 更稳的长轨迹训练配方。对做持续 pretrain / mid-train 的团队也有启发：当任务具有强状态分布漂移（工具调用、代码库交互、网页环境）时，数据收集策略本身就是“训练目标的一部分”，单纯堆离线轨迹会系统性失配。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是把 DAgger 的“在学生访问到的状态上请教师标注”改造成适配多轮对话/工具调用的 teacher-interleaved trajectory collection：每条轨迹按 turn 级别随机决定由学生还是教师出手（而不是 token 级），形成 mixture policy；训练迭代中教师接管概率 β 逐步退火到更偏学生，从而逐步扩大 on-policy 覆盖。收集到的混合轨迹上，用监督学习让学生模仿教师动作（密集标签来自教师在其接管回合的行为；以及在学生回合所到达的状态上由教师给出“应做什么”的标签，具体标注形式取决于环境接口）。与 OPD 的关键差异是：不需要教师 logits（可用黑盒教师），且通过“早期高比例教师接管”保证轨迹能走到有信息量的后续状态，缓解弱学生一开始 rollouts 早早崩掉导致学不到有效行为的问题。与 RLVR 的差异是：训练信号是密集模仿而非稀疏 outcome reward，因此信用分配更直接、方差更小。
summary.experiments: 全文主打软件工程类长轨迹任务（SWE 场景）：需要在代码库内多轮搜索、定位、编辑、提交 patch，早期一步错会把后续状态带偏。论文报告在 4B 与 8B 两个规模上，teacher-interleaved DAgger 带来显著提升：4B 代理能超过一些代表性的 8B SWE agent；8B 代理性能接近更大（文中提到 32B 级）系统。除最终解决率外，作者还做了训练稳定性与行为层面的分析，结论是该方法能减轻 covariate shift、提升长轨迹中的搜索/编辑/失败恢复等子能力，并让训练过程更稳定（相对 RLVR 的高方差与 OPD 的冷启动失败）。由于你提供的全文片段未包含完整表格与具体数值明细，这里无法逐项复述每个 benchmark 的精确数字。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看方法部分对“turn-level mixture policy + β 退火”的定义与数据收集流程，确认它在 agent 环境里如何拿到教师标签、以及哪些回合被监督。
- 再看实验分析里关于 covariate shift 缓解与长轨迹行为（search/edit/recovery）的分解指标：这部分通常比单一成功率更能解释为什么有效。
- 如果时间有限，优先看：算法示意图/伪代码 + SWE 任务上的对比表 + 训练动态/失败案例分析。预计 30–45 分钟可抓住主要结论。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon LLM agents suffer from compounding errors: SFT trains on expert-induced states and breaks under covariate shift, while RL with verifiable rewards is on-policy but sparse, high-variance, and expensive. The paper asks whether we can get on-policy state coverage and dense supervision at the same time, without OPD-style cold-start failures and without requiring teacher logits.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining paper per se, but it matters for the pretrain↔post-train loop: it operationalizes DAgger for multi-turn tool-using agents and provides a practical alternative to RLVR/OPD when state distribution shift is the dominant failure mode. For teams doing continual pretraining or mid-training on interactive data, the key takeaway is that trajectory collection (who acts when) is a first-class design choice; offline expert traces alone can be structurally mismatched to deployment states.
summary_en.technical_approach: They adapt DAgger via teacher-interleaved rollouts at the turn level. Each trajectory is generated by a stochastic mixture of student and teacher turns; early in training, the teacher takes over frequently to keep trajectories productive, and the takeover probability β is annealed down over iterations to increase on-policy coverage. The student is then trained with supervised imitation on these aggregated trajectories. Compared to OPD, it does not need teacher logits (works with black-box teachers) and avoids the weak-student cold start by ensuring early rollouts reach informative later states. Compared to RLVR, it replaces sparse outcome rewards with dense imitation targets, reducing variance and improving credit assignment.
summary_en.experiments: The main empirical focus is software-engineering style agent tasks where the agent must search a codebase, localize bugs, edit files, and submit patches over many turns. Reported results show strong gains at 4B and 8B: the 4B agent surpasses representative 8B SWE agents, and the 8B agent approaches much larger (32B-class) systems. Beyond end success rate, the paper includes analyses indicating improved training stability, reduced covariate shift, and better long-horizon behaviors (search/edit/recovery). Exact table numbers are not recoverable from the provided excerpt.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan:
- Read the algorithm section for the exact rollout mixing scheme (turn-level mixture policy) and the β schedule.
- Then jump to the SWE results table and the behavior-level breakdown (search/edit/recovery) to understand where gains come from.
- If you only have time for one deep dive, pick the training-dynamics / failure-mode analysis; that’s where the DAgger adaptation is most justified. ~30–45 minutes to get the core ideas.

recommendation.zh: 经典算法在LM Agent中的复用思路有参考价值，可看§3的策略插值设计。
recommendation.en: The reuse idea of classic algorithms in LM agents has reference value, check the policy interpolation design in §3.

paper.title: TMPO: Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization for Diverse and Efficient Diffusion Alignment
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has shown extraordinary potential in aligning diffusion models to downstream tasks, yet most of them still suffer from significant reward hacking, which degrades generative diversity and quality by inducing visual mode collapse and amplifying unreliable rewards. We identify the root cause as the mode-seeking nature of these methods, which maximize expected reward without effectively constraining probability distribution over acceptable trajectories, causing concentrat

summary.core_problem: 现有RL对齐扩散/流匹配生成模型的方法普遍存在奖励黑客问题，根源是标量奖励最大化目标本身的模式寻求特性，导致生成多样性下降、不可靠奖励被放大，出现视觉模式坍缩；现有缓解方案要么KL正则效果有限，要么GFlowNet类方法需要估计难以处理的状态流函数，引入额外训练误差。
summary.importance: 从优化目标根源上解决扩散模型RL对齐的奖励黑客问题，轨迹级分布匹配的思路可以迁移到LLM的RL对齐以缓解模式坍缩问题，树采样的效率优化也可借鉴到多轨迹采样的训练效率提升场景。
summary.technical_approach: 提出轨迹匹配策略优化（TMPO），将优化目标从标量奖励最大化改为轨迹级奖励分布匹配，核心设计包括：1）Softmax轨迹平衡（Softmax-TB）目标，对完整去噪轨迹做奖励分布匹配，将同一起点的K条轨迹的生成概率匹配到基于奖励的玻尔兹曼分布，组内归一化消除配分函数，支持直接优化；2）动态随机树采样，让轨迹共享去噪步骤，减少冗余计算，降低训练时间，同时促进不同去噪阶段的有效探索。
summary.experiments: 在FLUX.1-dev模型上测试三个对齐任务：组合图像生成、视觉文本渲染、人类偏好对齐，平均生成多样性比现有领先方法提升9.1%，同时取得最优的GenEval准确率和PickScore，训练时间最多减少27%，在奖励-多样性、奖励-效率的权衡上表现最优。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：先看引言部分对扩散模型RL对齐奖励黑客根源的分析，方法部分的Softmax-TB目标推导和动态树采样设计，实验部分的多样性和效率对比结果，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL alignment methods for diffusion and flow-matching generative models suffer from severe reward hacking, rooted in the mode-seeking nature of scalar reward maximization objectives, leading to reduced generative diversity, amplified unreliable rewards and visual mode collapse. Existing mitigation methods either have limited effect with KL regularization, or introduce extra training error by requiring intractable state-flow function estimation for GFlowNet-based approaches.
summary_en.importance: It addresses reward hacking in diffusion model RL alignment from the root of optimization objectives. The trajectory-level distribution matching idea can be migrated to LLM RL alignment to mitigate mode collapse, and the tree sampling efficiency optimization can be referenced for multi-trajectory sampling training efficiency improvement.
summary_en.technical_approach: Trajectory Matching Policy Optimization (TMPO) replaces scalar reward maximization with trajectory-level reward distribution matching. Core designs include: 1) Softmax Trajectory Balance (Softmax-TB) objective, which performs reward distribution matching on complete denoising trajectories, matching generation probabilities of K trajectories from the same starting point to a reward-based Boltzmann distribution, with in-group normalization to eliminate partition function for direct optimization; 2) Dynamic Stochastic Tree Sampling, which allows trajectories to share denoising steps to reduce redundant computation and training time, while promoting effective exploration across different denoising stages.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on FLUX.1-dev across three alignment tasks: compositional image generation, visual text rendering and human preference alignment. TMPO improves average generative diversity by 9.1% over existing leading methods, achieves the best GenEval accuracy and PickScore, reduces training time by up to 27%, and obtains the most favorable trade-offs on reward-diversity and reward-efficiency.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the analysis of the root cause of reward hacking in diffusion RL alignment in the Introduction section, the derivation of Softmax-TB objective and dynamic tree sampling design in the Methodology section, and the diversity and efficiency comparison results in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 扩散模型RL对齐的新方法，核心优化思路可迁移到Diffusion LM的对齐工作，只看§3的目标推导即可。
recommendation.en: Novel method for RL alignment of diffusion models, core optimization idea can be transferred to Diffusion LM alignment, only read §3 objective derivation.

paper.title: OmniNFT: Modality-wise Omni Diffusion Reinforcement for Joint Audio-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent advances in joint audio-video generation have been remarkable, yet real-world applications demand strong per-modality fidelity, cross-modal alignment, and fine-grained synchronization. Reinforcement Learning (RL) offers a promising paradigm, but its extension to multi-objective and multi-modal joint audio-video generation remains unexplored. Notably, our in-depth analysis first reveals that the primary obstacles to applying RL in this stem from: (i) multi-objective advantages inconsistenc

summary.core_problem: 现有强化学习方法用于联合音视频生成时，存在多模态优势不一致、梯度泄漏、细粒度信用分配效率低三大障碍，导致vanilla RL微调效果次优。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次系统性分析多模态联合生成场景下RL优化的核心痛点，提出模态级全扩散强化学习框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出OmniNFT，分别针对三大障碍设计：模态级优势分解解决优势不一致，模态感知梯度隔离避免视频梯度泄漏到音频浅层，细粒度时空对齐信用分配提升跨模态对齐区域的探索效率。
summary.experiments: 原文未披露完整模型参数量与训练数据规模，仅验证所提方法在单模态保真度、跨模态对齐、细粒度同步性上均优于vanilla RL微调基线。
summary.authors_note: 中国科学技术大学、北京大学、京东探索院联合团队，无公开LLM领域知名作者信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing reinforcement learning methods for joint audio-video generation suffer from three core obstacles: inconsistent multi-modal advantages, gradient leakage, and low fine-grained credit assignment efficiency, leading to suboptimal vanilla RL fine-tuning performance.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, first systematic analysis of core pain points of RL optimization in multi-modal joint generation scenarios, proposes a modality-wise omni diffusion reinforcement learning framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes OmniNFT, with three targeted designs: modality-wise advantage decomposition to resolve advantage inconsistency, modality-aware gradient isolation to prevent video gradient leakage to shallow audio layers, fine-grained spatiotemporal aligned credit assignment to improve exploration efficiency of cross-modal alignment regions.
summary_en.experiments: Full model parameter size and training data scale are not disclosed in the paper, only verifies that the proposed method outperforms vanilla RL fine-tuning baseline in single-modality fidelity, cross-modal alignment, and fine-grained synchronization.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint team from University of Science and Technology of China, Peking University, and JD Explore Academy, no publicly known prominent LLM researchers.

recommendation.zh: 多模态RL的梯度隔离与细粒度信用分配设计可做多模态对齐的参考，仅看方法部分的问题分析即可。
recommendation.en: The gradient isolation and fine-grained credit assignment designs for multi-modal RL can serve as reference for multimodal alignment, only read the problem analysis in method section.

institutions: University of Science and Technology of China

paper.title: StepCodeReasoner: Aligning Code Reasoning with Stepwise Execution Traces via Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: Existing code reasoning methods primarily supervise final code outputs, ignoring intermediate states, often leading to reward hacking where correct answers are obtained through inconsistent reasoning. We propose StepCodeReasoner, a framework that introduces explicit intermediate execution-state supervision. By automatically inserting structured print-based execution-trace anchors into code, the model is trained to predict runtime states at each step, transforming code reasoning into a verifiable

summary.core_problem: 代码推理训练长期只监督最终答案，无法约束中间执行状态。模型可能给出正确输出，但变量更新、分支路径或循环过程是错的。StepCodeReasoner 要解决的是：把代码推理从终点奖励问题改成可验证的逐步执行建模问题。
summary.importance: 这项工作更像是 post-train/RL 侧的训练信号改造，但对预训练研究也有启发。核心价值不在代码 benchmark 分数，而在于它把“推理过程是否真实”转化为可自动验证的密集监督。类似思路可以迁移到数学、工具调用、程序执行、环境交互等任务：不要只奖励最终答案，而要构造中间状态，使长链条推理有可分解的信用分配信号。
summary.technical_approach: 方法有两层。第一层是执行轨迹构造：自动在程序关键位置插入结构化 print 锚点，例如变量更新、循环退出、return 位置，把不可见的执行过程变成一串可检查的状态目标。模型不仅预测最终输出，还要在推理链中预测每个锚点处的运行时状态。任务被拆成 output prediction 和 input prediction，两类任务使用不同的 execution-aligned prompt，而不是简单做断言补全。第二层是 Bi-Level GRPO。普通 GRPO 主要在一组采样轨迹之间做相对奖励归一化，StepCodeReasoner 进一步加入轨迹内部的 step-level reward。它同时比较不同轨迹的整体好坏，也考察单条轨迹中某个中间预测是否帮助后续执行保持正确。这个设计针对的是长程序执行中的信用分配问题：早期变量状态错了，后面即使碰巧答对，也不应得到同样奖励。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 7B 模型。平均分达到 87.8%，高于 CodeReasoner-7B 的 81.8%。在细粒度 REval 上为 82.9%，CodeReasoner-7B 为 72.3%。工作还报告该 7B 模型在多个代码推理任务上超过 GPT-4o 的 80.3% 平均分，尤其是在 LiveCodeBench 和 CRUXEval 的 input prediction 设置上更强。关键结果说明，显式学习执行轨迹不只是改善解释文本的一致性，也能改善输入反推和算法代码生成这类更依赖程序语义模拟的任务。建议重点看消融：只加执行锚点、只做终点奖励、加入 Bi-Level GRPO 三者之间的差异，这部分最能说明收益来自哪里。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25 分钟。先看 Introduction 中对“right answer, wrong logic”的定义，确认问题边界。再看 Method 里执行锚点如何插入、output/input prediction 如何格式化，以及 Bi-Level GRPO 的奖励公式。实验部分优先看 REval、CRUXEval、LiveCodeBench 的主表和消融表。若只关心预训练启发，可重点读 reward design 和 stepwise supervision，不必深读每个代码 benchmark 的细节。

summary_en.core_problem: The work addresses a specific failure mode in code reasoning training: models are rewarded for the final answer while their intermediate execution states remain unchecked. A model can reach the right output with an inconsistent simulation of variables, branches, or loops.
summary_en.importance: The main relevance is the training signal, not the code benchmark itself. StepCodeReasoner shows how to turn a long-horizon reasoning task into a sequence of automatically verifiable intermediate targets. This is useful for pretraining and post-training design because it points to a general pattern: dense, executable supervision can reduce reward hacking when final-answer rewards are too sparse.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method first instruments programs with structured print-style execution anchors at important program points, such as variable updates, loop exits, and return statements. These anchors expose runtime states and convert code reasoning into stepwise execution modeling. The task is split into output prediction and input prediction, each using prompts aligned with execution traces rather than plain assertion completion. On top of this data format, the authors introduce Bi-Level GRPO. It keeps group-relative comparison across sampled trajectories, while adding intra-trajectory shaping rewards for intermediate states. The intra-trajectory term rewards steps that are not only locally correct but also support later correct execution. This is the main difference from terminal-only RL or standard GRPO-style optimization.
summary_en.experiments: The reported 7B model reaches an average score of 87.8%, compared with 81.8% for CodeReasoner-7B. On REval, it scores 82.9%, compared with 72.3% for the same baseline. The paper also reports stronger average performance than GPT-4o, cited at 80.3%, with notable gains on input prediction tasks in LiveCodeBench and CRUXEval. The important experimental signal is that execution-state supervision improves both fine-grained reasoning consistency and downstream code generation behavior.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough. Read the motivation around terminal supervision and reward hacking, then focus on the method section for anchor insertion, prompt formats, and the Bi-Level GRPO objective. In the experiments, prioritize the main tables for REval, CRUXEval, and LiveCodeBench, plus the ablations separating execution anchors from the RL objective.

recommendation.zh: 把“可验证中间态”做成训练信号这点很实用；但先只读方法与消融，确认提升不是来自更强的执行器/评测泄漏。
recommendation.en: The verifiable intermediate-state signal is the real value; skim method + ablations first to ensure gains aren’t from a stronger executor or evaluation leakage.

paper.title: Guidance Is Not a Hyperparameter: Learning Dynamic Control in Diffusion Language Models
paper.abstract: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) is a widely used mechanism for controlling diffusion-based generative models, yet its guidance scale is typically treated as a fixed hyperparameter throughout generation. This static design yields a suboptimal controllability and quality tradeoff, as the optimal degree of guidance varies across tasks and across different stages of the diffusion process, especially in NLP domain. We recast CFG scale selection as a sequential decision-making problem and propose to le

summary.core_problem: 扩散语言模型里 CFG（classifier-free guidance）的 guidance scale 通常被当作一个全程固定的超参，但扩散采样是分步的：不同 step 对“可控性 vs 生成质量”的需求不同，且不同任务的最优 guidance 行为也不同。论文要解决的是：能否把 guidance scale 的选择从静态调参，改成一个随扩散状态演化的序列决策问题，并用任务级奖励直接学出动态 guidance 轨迹。
summary.importance: 对“新型语言建模范式（diffusion LM）+ post-train 信号”的接口更相关：它把扩散采样中的控制变量（CFG scale）显式纳入 RL 优化，提供了一条把不可微/延迟的任务目标（关键词命中、情感一致、长度约束等）反馈到采样过程控制的路径。对基座预训练本身的直接影响有限（不改模型参数、不改预训练目标），但对 diffusion LM 的可控生成、以及“采样策略可学习化”这类方向有启发：很多被当作 sampling 超参的东西，其实可以被当作 policy 来学。
summary.technical_approach:
把每个扩散 step 的 guidance scale 视为离散动作：状态是当前扩散生成状态（随 step 演化的中间表示/噪声态，文中表述为 evolving diffusion state），动作为从一组离散 guidance scale 候选中选择一个值；整条采样轨迹结束后，根据任务定义给出 episode-level reward。用 PPO 训练一个 task-specific 的 guidance policy，学习“在不同 step 应该多强地依赖条件信息”。
论文强调学习的是任务级的典型 guidance 轨迹，而不是 per-instance 自适应（避免需要更细粒度的在线反馈、也降低对单条轨迹噪声的过拟合风险）。底座模型选用离散扩散 LM（LLaDA）。对比对象包括固定 scale 和一些启发式 schedule（如指数曲线、Beta 形状等），这些方法要么全局固定、要么与生成状态无关。
summary.experiments:
实验围绕三类 NLP 可控生成任务：关键词条件句子生成、情感控制风格迁移、长度控制改写；在 LLaDA 上进行。主要比较“学到的动态 guidance trajectory”与“固定 guidance scale / 手工 schedule”在可控性与质量上的权衡。
从引言可确认的结论是：静态 scale 存在结构性不匹配；RL 学到的轨迹在不同任务上呈现不同的 step-wise guidance 行为，并带来更好的 controllability–quality tradeoff。当前给出的全文片段未包含具体指标与数值表格，因此无法在不臆测的前提下复述提升幅度或统计显著性。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25-35 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 对问题设定的动机：为什么“固定超参”在扩散采样里天然不匹配，以及为什么启发式 schedule 不够。
- 重点看方法部分对 MDP 的定义：状态包含哪些扩散变量、动作空间如何离散化、reward 如何设计、PPO 的训练细节（episode 长度、探索、稳定性技巧）。
- 结果部分建议只抓两点：不同任务学到的 guidance 轨迹形状是否一致；以及与固定 scale/手工 schedule 的对比是否主要来自“早期更强/后期更弱”这类可解释规律。
- 如果要复现或迁移到别的 ddLM，优先核对：动作离散粒度、reward 的可计算性与噪声、以及 policy 是否与 base model 解耦（是否需要额外前向/开销）。

summary_en.core_problem: In diffusion language models, classifier-free guidance (CFG) is usually controlled by a single fixed guidance scale for the entire sampling trajectory. This is structurally mismatched with diffusion sampling: the optimal controllability–quality tradeoff can vary across diffusion steps and across tasks. The paper formulates guidance-scale selection as a sequential decision problem and aims to learn a dynamic guidance trajectory that optimizes task-level outcomes.
summary_en.importance: This is more about diffusion-LM sampling/control than core pretraining. The value is in making a common “sampling hyperparameter” learnable via RL under sparse, delayed, and often non-differentiable task rewards (keyword satisfaction, sentiment control, length constraints). It suggests a general pattern: for diffusion LMs, parts of the sampling procedure that are traditionally hand-tuned (CFG scale schedules) can be treated as policies and optimized directly for downstream controllability objectives, potentially improving robustness across tasks without manual schedule engineering.
summary_en.technical_approach: The guidance scale is modeled as a discrete action chosen at each diffusion step based on the current diffusion state. An episode corresponds to a full sampling trajectory; a task-specific reward is computed at the end of generation. A PPO-trained policy learns step-wise guidance decisions, producing task-specific guidance trajectories rather than per-instance adaptation (to reduce reliance on instance-level intermediate feedback and mitigate overfitting to noisy single-trajectory outcomes). The underlying generator is a discrete diffusion LM (LLaDA). Baselines include fixed guidance scales and heuristic schedules (e.g., exponential/Beta-shaped), which are pre-specified and state-agnostic.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on three controllable NLP generation settings: keyword-conditioned sentence generation, sentiment-controlled style transfer, and length-controlled sentence rewriting, using LLaDA as the base ddLM. The evaluation focuses on the controllability–quality tradeoff, comparing learned dynamic guidance trajectories against fixed-scale CFG and hand-crafted schedules. The provided full-text excerpt does not include the quantitative tables/metrics, so specific numeric gains cannot be reported without guessing.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (25–35 min):
- Read the Introduction for the core argument: why a single global CFG scale is a poor fit for step-wise diffusion dynamics, and why heuristic schedules are insufficient.
- In the method section, focus on the MDP specification: what constitutes the state, how the action space (guidance scales) is discretized, reward definitions per task, and PPO stabilization details.
- In results, look for: whether learned trajectories differ meaningfully across tasks, and whether improvements can be explained by interpretable stage-wise behaviors (e.g., stronger guidance early vs later).
- For reproducibility/transfer, verify the compute overhead (extra policy forward passes), sensitivity to action discretization granularity, and reward noise handling.

paper.title: Object Hallucination-Free Reinforcement Unlearning for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) raise growing concerns about privacy, copyright, and bias, motivating machine unlearning to remove sensitive knowledge. However, existing methods primarily fine-tune the language decoder, leading to superficial forgetting that fails to erase underlying visual representations and often introduces object hallucination. We propose HFRU, a reinforcement unlearning framework that operates on the vision encoder for deep semantic removal. Our two-stage approach combines al

summary.core_problem: 现有VLM机器遗忘方法仅微调语言解码器，仅能实现表面遗忘，无法擦除底层视觉表征，还易引入物体幻觉问题
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出首个针对VLM视觉编码器的强化遗忘框架，同时解决遗忘深度与幻觉问题，补充VLM对齐与安全领域的方法路径
summary.technical_approach: 提出HFRU两阶段强化遗忘框架，第一阶段破坏视觉编码器与目标知识的对齐，第二阶段用GRPO优化，引入包含抽象奖励的复合奖励以抑制幻觉
summary.experiments: 在物体识别、人脸识别任务上测试，实现超过98%的遗忘率与知识保留率，引入的物体幻觉可忽略，显著优于现有SOTA unlearning方法
summary.authors_note: 厦门大学团队，无公开知名业界研究者背景

summary_en.core_problem: Existing VLM machine unlearning methods only fine-tune the language decoder, achieving superficial forgetting without erasing underlying visual representations, and often introduce object hallucinations
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation, proposes the first reinforcement unlearning framework operating on VLM vision encoders, addressing both forgetting depth and hallucination issues to complement VLM alignment and safety research
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes HFRU two-stage reinforcement unlearning framework: first stage disrupts alignment between vision encoder and target knowledge; second stage uses GRPO optimization with a composite reward including an abstraction reward to reduce hallucinations
summary_en.experiments: Tested on object recognition and face recognition tasks, achieves over 98% forgetting rate and knowledge retention rate, introduces negligible object hallucination, and significantly outperforms existing SOTA unlearning methods

paper.title: Rethinking Importance Sampling in LLM Policy Optimization: A Cumulative Token Perspective
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning, including reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), has emerged as a powerful approach for LLM post-training. Central to these approaches is the design of the importance sampling (IS) ratio used in off-policy policy-gradient estimation. Existing methods face a fundamental bias-variance dilemma: token-level IS ratios, as adopted by PPO (Schulman et al., 2017) and GRPO (Shao et al., 2024), introduce bias by ignoring prefix state distribution mismatch; full sequ

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM离策略（off-policy）策略优化中的重要性采样（IS）存在根本性的偏方差权衡困境：GRPO采用的token级IS忽略前缀状态分布不匹配，引入系统偏差；全序列IS可提供精确的轨迹级修正，但token概率的连乘导致方差极高；GSPO通过长度归一化的序列级IS提升数值稳定性，但偏离了严格的IS修正定义，同样存在偏差。该缺陷是当前GRPO系后训练算法（含可验证奖励强化学习RLVR）的核心底层问题，直接影响梯度估计质量和训练效果。
summary.importance: 该工作从理论层面定位了现有主流RL后训练算法在IS设计上的根本缺陷，提出的累积token IS比率在理论上无偏，且方差严格低于全序列IS，解决了长期存在的偏方差权衡问题。提出的位置自适应截断方法解决了累积IS实际落地中的正则不一致问题。最终得到的CTPO算法可直接替换工业界广泛使用的GRPO，对推理类任务的RL后训练效果有可落地的提升。该工作属于后训练优化算法的底层范式改进，直接关联预训练-后训练闭环的核心优化。
summary.technical_approach: 该工作首先在token级策略梯度框架下，推导了累积token IS比率（第t个位置及之前所有token级IS的乘积）的两个核心性质：一是该比率对每个token的梯度项提供无偏的前缀分布修正，因为它完整覆盖了当前前缀在行为策略和目标策略下的似然差；二是其方差严格低于全序列IS，因为t位置之后的后缀token在行为策略下的期望为1，只会引入不必要的方差，无法降低偏差。针对累积IS的对数方差随token位置线性增长（Var(logρ_t^cum) = tσ²），固定截断阈值会导致早期token几乎不被截断、后期token被过度截断的正则不一致问题，该工作提出位置自适应截断策略：截断阈值随√t线性缩放，匹配累积对数IS的标准差增长规律，实现不同位置token的正则强度一致。基于以上两点，该工作提出CTPO（累积token策略优化）算法。
summary.experiments: 实验在工具集成推理（TIR）设置下开展，即模型迭代生成并执行沙箱环境中的Python代码解决复杂数学题。对比GRPO、GSPO等强基线，CTPO在多个模型尺度下均取得最高的平均性能。消融实验验证了位置自适应截断对最终性能的显著贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 重点精读累积token IS比率无偏性和方差性质的理论推导部分，这是核心创新的理论基础。其次关注位置自适应截断的动机和推导逻辑。实验部分优先查看不同IS策略的偏方差对比可视化，以及自适应截断的消融实验图表。附录中的完整理论证明可进一步深挖，训练过程中不同位置token的截断频率统计，也能直观体现固定截断的缺陷。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing importance sampling (IS) designs for off-policy LLM policy optimization suffer from a fundamental bias-variance tradeoff: token-level IS used in GRPO ignores prefix state distribution mismatch and introduces systematic bias; full-sequence IS provides exact trajectory-level correction but suffers from extremely high variance due to multiplicative accumulation of per-token probabilities; GSPO's length-normalized sequence-level IS improves numerical stability but deviates from strict IS correction definitions and remains biased. This is a core underlying flaw of mainstream GRPO-family post-training algorithms, including reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), that directly degrades gradient estimation quality and training performance.
summary_en.importance: This work identifies the fundamental theoretical flaw in IS design of state-of-the-art RL post-training algorithms, and proposes a cumulative token IS ratio that is theoretically unbiased and has strictly lower variance than full-sequence IS, resolving the long-standing bias-variance dilemma. The proposed position-adaptive clipping strategy solves the regularization inconsistency issue in practical cumulative IS deployment. The resulting CTPO algorithm can directly replace the widely used GRPO in industrial settings, delivering measurable improvements to RL post-training for reasoning tasks. It represents a low-level paradigm improvement for post-training optimization, directly relevant to the pretrain-posttrain closed loop.
summary_en.technical_approach: Under the token-level policy gradient framework, this work derives two core properties of the cumulative token IS ratio, defined as the product of all per-token IS ratios up to position t. First, this ratio provides unbiased prefix distribution correction for gradient terms at each token position, as it fully accounts for the likelihood difference of the current prefix under the behavior and target policies. Second, its variance is strictly lower than full-sequence IS, since suffix tokens beyond position t have unit expectation under the behavior policy and only introduce unnecessary variance without reducing bias. To address the issue that the log variance of cumulative IS grows linearly with token position (Var(logρ_t^cum) = tσ²), which causes inconsistent regularization where early tokens are rarely clipped and late tokens are over-clipped under a fixed clipping threshold, this work proposes a position-adaptive clipping strategy that scales clipping thresholds proportionally to √t, matching the standard deviation growth of cumulative log IS and achieving consistent regularization intensity across all token positions. These two insights form the CTPO (Cumulative Token Policy Optimization) algorithm.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted in the tool-integrated reasoning (TIR) setting, where models iteratively generate and execute Python code in a sandboxed environment to solve challenging mathematical problems. Compared to strong baselines including GRPO and GSPO, CTPO achieves the highest average performance across multiple model scales. Ablation studies confirm that position-adaptive clipping makes a statistically significant contribution to final performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the theoretical derivations of the unbiasedness and variance properties of the cumulative token IS ratio, which forms the core theoretical foundation of the work. Then review the motivation and derivation logic of position-adaptive clipping. For experiments, prioritize visualizations comparing bias and variance across different IS strategies, as well as ablation results for adaptive clipping. Full theoretical proofs in the appendix are worth deep diving, and statistics of clipping frequency across token positions during training provide intuitive understanding of the limitation of fixed clipping.

recommendation.zh: 从理论上修正了PPO/GRPO等主流RL算法的梯度估计偏差问题，是后训练算法迭代的核心参考，应立刻复现并做内部ablation
recommendation.en: Theoretically corrects the gradient estimation bias in mainstream RL algorithms like PPO/GRPO, a core reference for post-training algorithm iteration; immediately replicate and run internal ablation.

paper.title: Beyond Reasoning: Reinforcement Learning Unlocks Parametric Knowledge in LLMs
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved remarkable success in LLM reasoning, but whether it can also improve direct recall of parametric knowledge remains an open question. We study this question in a controlled zero-shot, one-hop, closed-book QA setting with no chain-of-thought, training only on binary correctness rewards and applying fact-level train-test deduplication to ensure gains reflect improved recall rather than reasoning or memorization. Across three model families and multiple factu

summary.core_problem: 检验 RL 是否只能提升推理，还是也能在无 CoT、闭卷、一跳事实问答中提升 LLM 的参数知识召回。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是受控实证和机制分析。它把 RL 的作用从 reasoning-time search 扩展到 parametric knowledge recall，并用 fact-level train-test deduplication 和无 CoT 设置排除记忆泄漏与显式推理因素，对理解 RL 与预训练知识的接口很关键。
summary.technical_approach: 在 zero-shot、one-hop、closed-book QA 中训练模型，只使用二元正确性奖励，不引入 chain-of-thought。通过事实级去重保证测试事实未在训练中重复，并用采样分布和数据归因分析区分“学到新事实”与“重排已有知识概率质量”。
summary.experiments: 覆盖三个模型家族和多个事实 QA benchmark。RL 带来约 27% 平均相对提升，并超过训练时和推理时 baseline。机制上，RL 主要把正确答案从低概率尾部推到 greedy generation 可稳定输出的位置，而不是真正获取新事实。数据归因显示最难样本最有训练价值：pre-RL 采样 128 次也从未出现正确答案的样本只占约 18%，却驱动了主要收益。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自中国科学院计算技术研究所、人工智能安全全国重点实验室和中国科学院大学；摘要中未能确认更具体的知名作者背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tests whether RL can improve parametric knowledge recall, not only reasoning, in no-CoT closed-book one-hop QA.
summary_en.importance: This is a controlled empirical and mechanistic study. It extends the role of RL from reasoning-time behavior to recall of stored knowledge, using fact-level train-test deduplication and a no-chain-of-thought setup to reduce leakage and reasoning confounds.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setup trains with binary correctness rewards in zero-shot, one-hop, closed-book QA and removes chain-of-thought. The analysis uses fact-level deduplication, sampling-distribution inspection, and data attribution to separate new fact acquisition from probability-mass redistribution over existing knowledge.
summary_en.experiments: The study covers three model families and multiple factual QA benchmarks. RL gives roughly 27% average relative gains and beats both training-time and inference-time baselines. Mechanistically, RL mostly moves correct answers from the low-probability tail into reliable greedy generations rather than acquiring new facts. The hardest examples are most informative: examples whose answers never appear in 128 pre-RL samples make up about 18% of training data but drive the main gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from the Institute of Computing Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, the State Key Laboratory of AI Safety, and the University of Chinese Academy of Sciences; no widely known author background can be confirmed from the provided information.

recommendation.zh: 这篇会改 prior：RL 不只是推理搜索，还能重排预训练知识概率；应复现 hard-example attribution。
recommendation.en: This changes a prior: RL can reorder pretrained knowledge probabilities, not just improve reasoning; reproduce the hard-example attribution.
