paper.title: ExpThink: Experience-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Chain-of-Thought Compression
paper.abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve strong performance via extended chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, yet suffer from excessive token consumption and high inference latency. Existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches for CoT compression rely on uniform, static length penalties that neglect model capability dynamics and problem-level difficulty variation. We propose \textbf{ExpThink}\xspace, an RL framework that addresses both dimensions through two complementary mechanisms. First, \emph{e

summary.core_problem: 现有基于RL的思维链（CoT）压缩方法采用静态统一的长度惩罚，会丢弃训练过程中积累的历史轨迹信息，未随模型能力提升、问题难度差异动态调整压缩目标，导致模型即使能生成更短的正确解，平均输出长度仍远高于最优下界，存在严重的token浪费和推理延迟问题。
summary.importance: 为RL驱动的CoT压缩训练提供了自适应目标构造的可行路径，其复用训练过程中自发产生的最优样本信号构建课程的思路，可迁移到其他需要动态调整优化目标的RL后训练场景。
summary.technical_approach: 在DAPO RL框架基础上做两处轻量化修改：1）维护全局经验缓冲区，记录每个问题历史上出现过的最短正确解长度，作为自适应奖励阈值，随模型能力提升自动收紧；2）设计三层奖励机制：简洁正确的响应得全额奖励，冗长正确的得折扣奖励，错误的得0奖励；3）引入基于计数的优势归一化，根据问题难度动态调整梯度权重，减少在已掌握的简单问题上浪费的梯度预算。
summary.experiments: 在DeepScaleR数据集上训练，相比基线模型，平均响应长度最多降低77%，同时精度无下降甚至略有提升，每token智能度（IPT，正确率与生成长度的比值）最高为基线的3倍，优于所有现有RL类CoT压缩方法，训练过程稳定。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读先看第1章引言和图1，理解现有方法的结构性缺陷，再看第2章的初步观测和图2，验证方法的核心动机，最后看第4章的核心实验结果即可，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL-based Chain-of-Thought (CoT) compression methods adopt static, uniform length penalties, discard historical trajectory information accumulated during training, and fail to adjust compression targets dynamically with model capability improvement and problem difficulty variations. Even when the model can generate shorter correct solutions, its average output length remains far above the optimal lower bound, leading to severe token waste and high inference latency.
summary_en.importance: It provides a feasible path for constructing adaptive objectives in RL-driven CoT compression training. The idea of reusing optimal sample signals spontaneously generated during training to build curriculum can be transferred to other RL post-training scenarios that require dynamic adjustment of optimization objectives.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two lightweight modifications are made based on the DAPO RL framework: 1) Maintain a global experience buffer to record the shortest correct solution length of each problem in history as an adaptive reward threshold, which automatically tightens as model capability improves; 2) Design a three-tier reward mechanism: full reward for concise correct responses, discounted reward for verbose correct responses, and 0 reward for incorrect responses; 3) Introduce count-based advantage normalization to dynamically adjust gradient weights according to problem difficulty, reducing gradient budget wasted on mastered simple problems.
summary_en.experiments: Trained on the DeepScaleR dataset, compared with the baseline model, the average response length is reduced by up to 77% with no accuracy drop or even slight improvement. The intelligence per token (IPT, ratio of accuracy to generation length) is up to 3 times that of the baseline, outperforming all existing RL-based CoT compression methods, with stable training dynamics.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, first read Chapter 1 Introduction and Figure 1 to understand the structural defects of existing methods, then read Chapter 2 Preliminary Observation and Figure 2 to verify the core motivation of the method, and finally read the core experimental results in Chapter 4. Estimated reading time is 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 RLHF/RLVR 优化 CoT 长度的必读，其 '记录历史最短正确路径作为动态 baseline' 的思路非常实用，比粗暴的长度惩罚更优雅。
recommendation.en: A must-read for those optimizing CoT length with RLHF/RLVR; the idea of 'tracking the historical shortest correct path as a dynamic baseline' is highly practical and more elegant than brute-force length penalties.

paper.title: Signal Reshaping for GRPO in Weak-Feedback Agentic Code Repair
paper.abstract: Code-agent RL often receives weak feedback: rollout-time signals are reliable and executable, but capture only necessary or surface conditions for task success rather than the target semantic predicate. Using agentic compile-fix as the setting, we study signal reshaping for standard GRPO under such feedback. Our central claim is that GRPO's within-group comparison is meaningful only after three kinds of signals are reshaped: outcome rewards recover semantic ranking, process signals localize intr

summary.core_problem: 这项工作处理的是弱反馈代码智能体训练中的 GRPO 信号失真问题。编译反馈可执行、稳定，但只验证必要条件，不能直接代表语义修复成功；如果直接用作组内相对奖励，GRPO 可能优化表面可编译性、工具调用噪声或基础设施异常，而不是修复质量。
summary.importance: 它对预训练方向的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train 阶段的代码智能体 RL 训练研究。但对基座研究员有一个清晰提醒：RL 目标能否工作，常常不取决于算法形式是否更复杂，而取决于同一 prompt 下样本之间是否真的可比较。这个问题也会反向影响预训练与中训练的数据设计，例如模型是否学到稳定的工具使用、长轨迹修复行为，以及是否容易被弱奖励诱导到短路策略。
summary.technical_approach: 方法没有改写 GRPO，而是围绕 GRPO 的输入信号做三类 reshaping。第一，结果奖励从二值编译奖励改为分层奖励：不可执行、仅编译通过、语义正确分别给 0、0.5、1，用中间层保留“有进展但未完成”的排序信息。第二，引入 step-level process scores，把过程信号转成 token-level loss weights，将更新强度集中到更有修复意义的步骤上，缓解长轨迹只有终局奖励时的信用分配稀释。第三，做 failure-cause-aware rollout governance，对容器初始化失败、编译队列异常、无工具调用、灾难性重复等不可比较样本进行屏蔽或局部处理，避免这些样本和真实修复失败混在同一个零奖励桶里。它和常见做法的区别在于：不把问题归因于 GRPO 公式本身，而是先修复组内比较所依赖的奖励语义、过程信用和执行可比性。
summary.experiments: 端到端结果显示，完整 signal-reshaped GRPO 将 strict compile-and-semantic accuracy 从 base model zero-shot 的 0.385 提升到 0.535。只使用纯编译奖励时，编译率会早期上升，随后回落，并没有带来语义正确率提升，说明二值弱反馈会诱导表面策略。固定 rollout governance 后，保留 0.5 中间奖励层能维持约 0.30 的样本质量分布；移除该层会同时损害轨迹控制和终止行为。使用同一个 post-fork checkpoint 对比时，step-level process scores 将 accuracy 从 0.48 提升到 0.53，并把平均评测步数从 23.50 降到 17.02，说明过程信用主要提升了修复效率，而不是靠更长探索换成功率。训练-only privileged prompt 的 π-Distill 和 on-policy self-distillation 都弱于稳定 GRPO baseline：π-Distill 保留了工具使用但更容易过早 finish，OPSD 出现低熵、更大梯度和工具层退化。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 25 分钟。重点看 introduction 中对三类信号条件的定义：outcome-semantics failure、diffuse process credit、broken within-group comparability。方法部分主要看分层奖励、process score 到 token loss weight 的映射，以及 rollout governance 如何判定不可比较失败。实验部分优先看三组消融：纯编译奖励对比、去掉 0.5 中间层、加入 step-level process scores。Appendix D.2 值得扫一遍，它给出 distillation 路径失败的负例，对判断“密集 token 监督能否替代过程信用”有参考价值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how GRPO can fail in weak-feedback code-agent repair. Compilation feedback is executable and reliable, but it only checks a necessary condition. If used directly for within-prompt ranking, GRPO may optimize compilability, tool noise, or infrastructure artifacts instead of semantic repair progress.
summary_en.importance: The work is closer to post-training for code agents than to foundation-model pretraining. Its main value for pretraining researchers is the training-signal lesson: relative-policy optimization only works when samples within a group are genuinely comparable. This matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, especially for tool-use data, long-horizon repair behavior, and models that may be sensitive to weak or shortcut-prone rewards.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method keeps the GRPO objective unchanged and reshapes the signals fed into it. First, it replaces a binary compilation reward with a layered outcome reward: 0 for non-executable repairs, 0.5 for compile-only repairs, and 1 for semantically correct repairs. This restores a partial ordering among trajectories. Second, it uses step-level process scores as token-level loss weights, concentrating updates on repair-relevant parts of long trajectories. Third, it applies failure-cause-aware rollout governance, masking or localizing non-learnable exceptions such as container failures, compilation-queue issues, no-tool-call rollouts, and catastrophic repetition. The key design choice is to repair the semantics and comparability of GRPO’s group comparison rather than introduce a new RL objective.
summary_en.experiments: The full signal-reshaped GRPO setup improves strict compile-and-semantic accuracy from 0.385 for the base model in zero-shot evaluation to 0.535. A pure compilation reward causes the compile rate to rise early and then fall back, without improving semantic correctness. With rollout governance fixed, retaining the intermediate reward tier keeps roughly 0.30 probability mass at R = 0.5; removing this tier degrades both trajectory control and termination. From the same post-fork checkpoint, step-level process scores raise accuracy from 0.48 to 0.53 and reduce average evaluation steps from 23.50 to 17.02. The distillation alternatives are negative results: privileged-prompt π-Distill tends toward premature finish, while OPSD shows low entropy, larger gradients, and degraded tool use.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 25 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s three signal conditions: outcome-semantics failure, diffuse process credit, and broken within-group comparability. In the method section, read the layered reward design, the mapping from process scores to token-level loss weights, and the rollout-governance rules. In the experiments, prioritize the ablations on pure compilation reward, removal of the 0.5 reward tier, and step-level process scoring. Appendix D.2 is useful for the negative comparison with KL-style distillation.

recommendation.zh: 针对代码任务中 reward 信号稀疏/弱的问题，对 GRPO 的 reward shaping 进行了系统性拆解（分层奖励、过程奖励、可比性治理），对做 Code RL 的研究员有很强的实操参考价值。
recommendation.en: Systematically dissects reward shaping for GRPO in code tasks with sparse/weak signals (layered rewards, process rewards, comparability governance), offering strong practical reference for Code RL researchers.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Rubric-Grounded RL: Structured Judge Rewards for Generalizable Reasoning
paper.abstract: We argue that decomposing reward into weighted, verifiable criteria and using an LLM judge to score them provides a partial-credit optimization signal: instead of a binary outcome or a single holistic score, each response is graded along multiple task-specific criteria. We formalize \emph{rubric-grounded reinforcement learning (RL)}: a framework in which the policy is optimized against a structured, multi-criterion reward produced by a frozen LLM judge that conditions on auxiliary grounding the

summary.core_problem: 在 LLM 的 RL 对齐/强化学习阶段，如何把“多维质量标准”从一个整体标量奖励拆开，提供更稳定、更可泛化的部分信用（partial credit）训练信号，并在不让策略看到证据材料的情况下实现 grounded 的评估与优化。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain 不是直接改目标函数，但对“post-train 信号质量如何反哺模型能力”很相关：它把 reward 设计从单一偏好分数推进到结构化 rubric，并用信息不对称（judge 见证据、policy 不见）降低策略投机取巧的空间。对做持续预训练/中期训练的人，rubric 也可以被看作一种可规模化生成的训练监督结构：把文档转成可验证的细粒度约束，再用 RL 聚合成优化信号。贡献量级更像工程化可落地框架，而不是新的 RL 算法。
summary.technical_approach:
提出 rubric-grounded RL：每个样本是 (x, g, R)。x 给策略；g 是 grounding（如原文段落/参考解/代码仓库/病历等）只给 judge；R 是由多个 criterion 组成的 rubric，每个 criterion 带权重 w、描述、required elements、关键词、验证方法等。冻结的 LLM judge 在看到 (x,g,y,R) 后输出每条 criterion 的得分 s_j（结构化 JSON），总奖励是加权和并做归一化/裁剪。
优化用 GRPO：每步对同一 x 采样一组 responses（group），用 rubric 的分项得分构造 advantage，保留 partial-credit 结构而不是只用一个整体分。实现上强调 judge 低温解码（0.1）降方差；rubric 生成与在线 judging 解耦（rubric 可离线用更强模型生成，在线用便宜 judge 反复打分）；并给出并行 judge workers 来承受 B×G 次调用的吞吐瓶颈。
数据构造：从约 10 万篇 OSTI 科技文档离线生成 question–rubric 对；训练时策略回答问题但看不到 passage，judge 用 passage+rubric 打分，形成信息不对称的 grounded reward。
summary.experiments:
训练对象是 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct，RL 算法用 GRPO。作者报告：
- 在 held-out rubric 任务上，RL 后的策略获得更高的 rubric reward，并优于仅做监督 warm-start 的版本；
- 在若干外部推理基准上，相对 base instruct 模型有提升（具体基准名与提升幅度需要结合正文/表格逐项核对）。
- 训练/验证 reward dynamics：展示 rubric 分项信号在训练中如何变化，用来支持“partial credit 更可学”的论点。
从方法可信度角度，最需要核查的是：judge 的一致性与偏差（rubric+passage 是否让 judge 过拟合格式）、以及外部基准提升是否来自更好的推理还是更强的写作/模板化。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议：
- 先看 Method 里 (x,g,R) 的信息不对称设定，以及 rubric 的字段设计（required elements / verification cues）——这是它区别于普通 LLM-as-a-judge 的关键。
- 再看 3.1–3.3：reward 如何从分项分数进入 GRPO advantage，是否真的保留了分项结构，还是最终又退化成单标量。
- 实验部分优先看：held-out rubric 评估协议（judge 是否同源、是否有泄漏）、外部基准列表与提升幅度、以及消融（无 rubric 分解/无 grounding/不同 judge 温度等）。
预计阅读时间：30 分钟可理解框架；若要复现，主要时间会花在 rubric 生成与 judge 吞吐工程细节（Appendix D 的 prompt 与实现）。

summary_en.core_problem: How to turn multi-faceted response quality into a structured, partial-credit reward for RL on LLMs—rather than a single holistic scalar—while keeping evaluation grounded in evidence that the policy does not observe at rollout time.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop via reward-signal quality: rubric decomposition provides denser supervision, and the policy/judge information asymmetry (judge sees evidence, policy doesn’t) is a concrete attempt to reduce shortcutting. The contribution is mainly a practical framework for scalable structured rewards (plus data synthesis from documents), not a new RL optimizer.
summary_en.technical_approach: Rubric-grounded RL defines each instance as (x, g, R): x is shown to the policy, g is auxiliary grounding shown only to a frozen LLM judge, and R is a weighted rubric with multiple criteria (weights, required elements, keywords, verification method). The judge outputs per-criterion scores in a strict JSON schema; rewards are aggregated, normalized, and clipped. The policy is optimized with GRPO using group-sampled responses, aiming to preserve partial-credit structure in the advantage signal. Engineering choices include low-temperature judging (0.1) to reduce variance, decoupling offline rubric synthesis from online judging cost, and parallel judge workers to handle the B×G judge-call bottleneck. The concrete instantiation builds ~100k question–rubric pairs from OSTI technical documents; during RL the policy answers without the passage, while the judge grades with passage+rubric.
summary_en.experiments: They train Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with GRPO. Reported results include higher reward on held-out rubric tasks versus a supervised warm-start baseline, and gains on several external reasoning benchmarks relative to the base instruct model (exact benchmark names and deltas should be verified in the main tables). They also present training vs held-out reward dynamics to argue that criterion-level signals are learnable and provide better optimization guidance. Key validity checks to look for are judge bias/format overfitting and whether external gains reflect reasoning rather than templated responses.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim path:
- Method for the (x,g,R) asymmetry and the rubric schema (required elements + verification cues).
- Sections 3.1–3.3 for how criterion scores are converted into GRPO advantages (does it truly leverage structure or collapse to a scalar?).
- Experiments for held-out evaluation protocol (judge leakage), external benchmark list/deltas, and ablations (no rubric decomposition, no grounding, judge temperature).
Time: ~30 minutes for the core idea; more if you need the prompting/throughput details in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 结构化评分标准的RL训练思路对后训练有借鉴意义，建议关注评分标准提取方法和多维度奖励设计，可用于内部RL训练ablation。
recommendation.en: The structured rubric-grounded reward approach is a useful direction for post-training optimization — study the rubric extraction method and multi-criterion reward design for internal RL ablation reference.

paper.title: Convergence and Emergence of In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Chain of Thought
paper.abstract: In-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) refers to the ability of RL agents to adapt to new tasks at inference time without parameter updates by conditioning on additional context. Recent empirical studies further demonstrate that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation can amplify this ICRL capability. This paper is the first to provide a theoretical understanding on how CoT interacts with ICRL. We conduct our analysis in a policy evaluation setup with linear Transformer. We prove that with specific

summary.core_problem: 在上下文强化学习（ICRL）中，思维链（CoT）生成过程如何从理论上等效于强化学习算法（特别是时序差分学习 TD learning）的迭代更新。
summary.importance: 首次为 CoT 如何增强 ICRL 能力提供了理论解释。在策略评估（policy evaluation）设定下，证明了线性 Transformer 的 CoT 生成过程与 TD 学习的等效性，并给出了有限样本收敛性分析，连接了序列建模与经典 RL 算法。
summary.technical_approach: 在策略评估设定下分析线性 Transformer。构造性地证明了在特定参数下，线性 Transformer 中的逐步 CoT 生成等效于在上下文数据上迭代执行 TD 更新。进一步证明了这些特定参数是基于 TD 的预训练算法的全局极小值，解释了这种能力是如何通过强化预训练涌现的。
summary.experiments: 提供了有限样本收敛性分析，证明策略评估误差随 CoT 长度呈几何级数下降，最终达到由上下文长度控制的统计下界。在受控环境中进行了实证验证，观察到所需参数的涌现。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点关注 Introduction 中对 ICRL 和 CoT 结合的背景介绍，以及 Background 中对策略评估和线性 Transformer 的设定。核心在于理解 CoT 步骤如何映射到 TD 更新迭代。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: How the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) generation process in In-Context Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) is theoretically equivalent to the iterative updates of RL algorithms, specifically Temporal Difference (TD) learning.
summary_en.importance: Provides the first theoretical explanation for how CoT amplifies ICRL capabilities. Under a policy evaluation setup, it proves the equivalence between the CoT generation process of linear Transformers and TD learning, and provides finite-sample convergence analysis, bridging sequence modeling and classical RL algorithms.
summary_en.technical_approach: Analyzes linear Transformers in a policy evaluation setup. Constructively proves that under specific parameters, stepwise CoT generation in a linear Transformer is equivalent to iterating TD updates on the context data. Further proves that these specific parameters are a global minimizer for a TD-based pretraining algorithm, explaining how this capability emerges through reinforcement pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: Provides finite-sample convergence analysis, showing that the policy evaluation error decreases geometrically with CoT length, eventually saturating at a statistical floor controlled by the context length. Empirically validates the emergence of the desired parameters in controlled environments.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the background of combining ICRL and CoT in the Introduction, and the setup for policy evaluation and linear Transformers in the Background section. The core is understanding how CoT steps map to TD update iterations. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 将 CoT 生成等价于 TD 学习更新的理论工作，为理解 '为什么 CoT 能提升上下文学习' 提供了一个非常漂亮的 RL 视角解释，值得一读。
recommendation.en: Theoretical work equating CoT generation to TD learning updates, providing a beautiful RL perspective on 'why CoT enhances in-context learning'; highly recommended.

paper.title: Learning CLI Agents with Structured Action Credit under Selective Observation
paper.abstract: Command line interface (CLI) agents are emerging as a practical paradigm for agent-computer interaction over evolving filesystems, executable command line programs, and online execution feedback. Recent work has used reinforcement learning (RL) to learn these interaction abilities from verifiable task feedback, yet few methods exploit the native structured attributes of CLI actions as learning signals. Beyond this underused action structure, CLI learning also couples two bottlenecks for coding a

summary.core_problem: CLI agent学习存在两大瓶颈：从部分观测的大型代码库中定位任务相关证据，以及将稀疏终端奖励分配给长轨迹中的关键动作。
summary.importance: 方法创新：提出利用CLI动作的原生结构化属性作为学习信号，设计了选择性观察机制和结构化信用分配方法，填补了CLI agent中信用分配研究的空白。
summary.technical_approach: 提出σ-Reveal推理时选择机制（按token预算选上下文）和Action Advantage Assignment信用分配方法（利用CLI动作的结构化属性分配奖励），通过shell驱动的信息抽取和文件编辑任务进行研究。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要被截断，完整实验结果未显示，未报告具体模型参数量、基线对比或量化效果。
summary.authors_note: 来自复旦大学、上海交通大学等机构，未发现知名作者。

summary_en.core_problem: CLI agent learning faces two bottlenecks: locating task-relevant evidence in large codebases from partial observations, and assigning sparse terminal rewards to critical actions in long multi-turn trajectories.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: Exploits native structured attributes of CLI actions as learning signals, designing selective observation and structured credit assignment mechanisms for CLI agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes σ-Reveal (inference-time context selection mechanism with token budget) and Action Advantage Assignment (credit assignment using CLI action structural attributes), studied through shell-driven information extraction and file editing tasks.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract truncated; full experimental results including model sizes, baselines, and quantitative metrics not available.
summary_en.authors_note: Fudan University, Shanghai Jiao Tong University; no notably recognizable authors.

recommendation.zh: CLI agent的信用分配有一定方法新意，但属于特定领域agent研究，对预训练无直接启示，摘要了解即可。
recommendation.en: Structured credit assignment for CLI agents has methodological merit but is domain-specific agent work with no direct pretraining implications.

paper.title: Policy-Guided Stepwise Model Routing for Cost-Effective Reasoning
paper.abstract: Inference-time computation has greatly enhanced the performance of large language models (LLMs) on challenging reasoning tasks, but this strategy can incur high inference costs. One solution is to route intermediate chain-of-thought (CoT) states to language models of different sizes; however, existing approaches rely on handcrafted routing strategies that limit performance, or on training large process reward models that may be infeasible in many applications. We formulate stepwise model routing

summary.core_problem: 解决推理时 CoT 逐步路由到不同大小模型时，如何在不训练大型过程奖励模型的前提下优化准确率-成本权衡的问题。
summary.importance: 这是推理效率方向的工作，不直接推进预训练，但对 test-time compute、分层模型协作和小控制器替代大 PRM 的思路有参考价值。贡献类型属于推理策略优化与系统层方法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者把 stepwise model routing 形式化为带约束的决策问题，用强化学习训练一个小型控制策略，在每个中间 CoT 状态决定调用哪种规模的模型；再通过 threshold calibration 调节性能与成本的 trade-off。方法试图避免手工规则路由，也避免训练昂贵的大型 process reward model。
summary.experiments: 在 GSM8K、MATH500、OmniMath 三个数学推理 benchmark 上，覆盖开源和闭源模型。摘要声称相较手工路由 consistently 改善 accuracy-cost tradeoff，并与需要大型 PRM 的方法达到可比权衡，但未给出控制器规模、底座模型列表和具体增益数字。
summary.authors_note: 宾夕法尼亚大学团队，作者包括 Osbert Bastani，长期做程序化推理、验证与 LLM 推理控制相关研究。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles how to optimize the accuracy-cost tradeoff in stepwise CoT routing across models of different sizes without training a large process reward model.
summary_en.importance: This is an inference-efficiency paper rather than a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to test-time compute, hierarchical model orchestration, and the idea of replacing large PRMs with lightweight controllers. The contribution is mainly a routing and systems-level optimization.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors formulate stepwise model routing as a constrained decision-making problem. A small control policy is trained with reinforcement learning to choose which model size should handle each intermediate CoT state, and threshold calibration is used to tune the performance-efficiency tradeoff. The method aims to outperform handcrafted routing while avoiding expensive PRM training.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on GSM8K, MATH500, and OmniMath, using both open and closed models. The abstract claims consistent improvements over handcrafted routing and comparable tradeoffs to methods requiring large PRMs, but does not report controller size, exact base models, or concrete gains.
summary_en.authors_note: From the University of Pennsylvania. Osbert Bastani is known for work on reasoning, verification, and control-oriented methods around LLMs.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但若你在想 test-time compute 能否替代部分规模扩张，可只看问题建模和 calibration；别把数学集上的收益外推得太远。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but worth a skim if you're thinking about test-time compute as a substitute for scale; read the formulation and calibration, and don't overgeneralize from math benchmarks.

paper.title: 4DThinker: Thinking with 4D Imagery for Dynamic Spatial Understanding
paper.abstract: Dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video is essential for bridging visual intelligence and the physical world, yet remains challenging for vision-language models (VLMs). Prior approaches either verbalize spatial-temporal reasoning entirely as text, which is inherently verbose and imprecise for complex dynamics, or rely on external geometric modules that increase inference complexity without fostering intrinsic model capability. In this paper, we present 4DThinker, the first framework that

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是：现有 VLM 在单目视频上的动态空间推理很弱，尤其分不清相机自运动、物体运动以及两者叠加后的 4D 时空关系；而已有改进路线要么把推理过程全部写成文本，表达冗长且几何精度差，要么外挂 3D/几何模块，推理链路变重，而且能力不真正长在模型内部。作者想做的是一种模型内生的 4D latent reasoning：让模型在隐藏空间里形成“动态心像”，用连续 latent 去承载时空演化，而不是只靠文字描述运动。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接意义不在于视频问答本身，而在于它把 latent reasoning 从静态图像推进到了动态视频，并且给出了一套可扩展的数据生成、监督和 RL 训练闭环。这里有两个值得注意的点。第一，它在训练目标上把“文本 CoT + 连续 latent 轨迹”联合起来，属于对纯 token-level reasoning 的一次补充。第二，它明确处理了 latent token 不适合直接做 policy gradient 的问题，只在文本 token 上做 GRPO，这对以后做混合离散-连续推理训练有参考价值。贡献量级更像是一个方向性原型：它证明了动态 latent supervision 可以带来稳定收益，但离通用预训练范式还有距离。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由三部分组成。第一部分是 annotation-free 的 4D 数据合成。作者从 SpatialVID 原始视频出发，只使用自动估计的几何标注，不引入人工标注。流程上先做视频预处理和关键帧采样，再基于规则和高层模型识别显著 landmark/object，提取 mask，并围绕两类核心因素构造问题：相机运动和物体运动。之后再把这些信息组织成带 CoT 的 QA 样本，关键是 CoT 不是纯文本，而是交织了“动态 mental imagery”。这些 imagery 不是额外输出图像，而是训练时对若干 latent position 施加目标，让模型学会在隐藏状态里模拟被高亮 landmark 随时间的变化。

第二部分是 DIFT，Dynamic-Imagery Fine-Tuning。它本质上是一个联合监督目标：文本部分仍然用标准 cross-entropy；latent imagery 部分则对指定 latent positions 施加 cosine-similarity loss，让模型在生成推理序列时，某些隐藏状态贴近由高亮帧得到的目标表征。这样做的关键取舍是：不把动态几何显式离散成文本，也不要求模型额外解码 3D 结构，而是在内部状态上对齐“应该想象到什么”。和已有静态 latent reasoning 方法相比，它扩展到了时间维，并且不依赖人工参考图或强教师模型蒸馏。

第三部分是 4DRL。作者在 DIFT 之后再做基于结果奖励的强化学习，目标是提升复杂复合运动推理。这里最重要的设计是：policy gradient 只作用在文本 token 上，不作用在 latent positions 上。原因是连续 hidden-state 的传播与离散 token log-prob 并不对齐，若强行把 RL 信号打到 latent 位置，训练会失真甚至不稳定。这个设计很务实，也说明作者把 latent 视为内部推理载体，而不是可直接采样的动作空间。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文片段看，实验结论是 4DThinker 在多个动态空间推理 benchmark 上稳定优于强基线，且优势主要体现在相机运动、物体运动以及复合运动这三类任务上。作者把收益拆成两段：DIFT 先带来基础的 4D latent grounding，4DRL 再进一步改善难例，尤其是 compound motion。消融重点应包括三类：一是去掉 imagery latent supervision，只保留文本 CoT，性能会明显回落，说明纯文本不足以承载复杂动态；二是去掉 4DRL，复杂运动题的正确率下降，说明 outcome-based refinement 主要作用在困难样本；三是比较是否需要外部几何模块，4DThinker 在不加外挂模块的前提下仍有更好或相近表现，支持“内生能力”这个主张。

不过，当前可见内容没有给出完整的参数量、训练 token/video 数量、各 benchmark 的具体分数和提升幅度，因此没法负责任地填写精确数字。若做正式收录，建议回到实验章节核对：基座 VLM 是哪一档规模、DIFT/4DRL 各自用了多少数据、奖励函数具体定义、以及每个 benchmark 上相对最佳文本 CoT 或几何增强基线的绝对提升。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议是先抓三件事。第一，看 Introduction 里作者如何界定问题：它不是一般视频理解，而是把动态空间推理拆成 ego-motion 和 object-motion 两条线。第二，看方法图和数据合成流程，重点理解 imagery supervision 到底监督了什么 latent、这些 latent 在序列中的位置如何安排、mask overlay 为什么能作为可扩展代理信号。第三，看 4DRL 的实现细节，尤其是为什么 RL 只更新文本 token，这里涉及连续 latent 与离散策略梯度的接口问题。

如果时间有限，优先看 Fig.1、Fig.2、DIFT/4DRL 的 loss 定义、以及消融表。预计 25-35 分钟可以抓住主线。更值得深挖的点有两个：一是 latent imagery 是否真的学到了可迁移的时空表征，而不只是训练分布内的 shortcut；二是这种“文本+连续 latent”混合推理，未来能否自然并入更通用的多模态预训练，而不是停留在 post-training 技巧。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode of current VLMs: dynamic spatial reasoning from monocular video. Strong models still struggle to disentangle camera ego-motion, object motion, and their composition over time. Prior fixes are unsatisfying in two different ways. Pure text-based reasoning is too verbose and too imprecise for fine-grained geometry, while external 3D or geometric modules improve performance at the cost of extra inference machinery and without making the capability intrinsic to the model. The proposed solution is to let the model reason with internal 4D latent imagery, so temporal scene evolution is represented in hidden space rather than only in text.
summary_en.importance: Its value to foundation-model research is not the benchmark itself, but the training recipe it proposes for latent reasoning in dynamic settings. The work extends latent reasoning from static images to videos, and it does so with a scalable data pipeline plus a two-stage supervision-and-RL loop. Two aspects matter. First, it treats reasoning as a hybrid object: textual CoT plus continuous latent trajectories. That is a meaningful departure from purely token-level supervision. Second, it explicitly avoids applying policy gradients to latent positions, acknowledging the mismatch between continuous hidden-state propagation and discrete token log-probabilities. That design choice is useful for future mixed discrete-continuous reasoning systems. The contribution feels more like a strong prototype for a new direction than a mature pretraining paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has three components. The first is an annotation-free 4D data synthesis pipeline. Starting from raw videos in SpatialVID and using only automatically estimated geometric annotations, the pipeline samples frames, identifies salient landmarks or objects with rules plus a high-level model, extracts masks, and constructs motion-centric QA pairs along two axes: camera motion and object motion. The resulting supervision is not plain text CoT. Instead, the chain of thought is interleaved with dynamic mental imagery, meaning some latent positions are trained to represent how highlighted landmarks evolve over time.

The second component is DIFT, Dynamic-Imagery Fine-Tuning. This is a joint objective: standard cross-entropy on text tokens, plus a cosine-similarity loss on selected latent positions. Those latent states are encouraged to match target representations derived from highlighted frames. The key idea is to supervise what the model should internally imagine, without forcing explicit 3D decoding or reducing everything to language. Compared with earlier latent reasoning work on static scenes, this extends the idea to temporal dynamics and removes the need for manually annotated reference images or heavy teacher distillation.

The third component is 4DRL, a reinforcement-learning stage built on top of DIFT for harder compound-motion reasoning. The important implementation detail is that policy gradients are applied only to text tokens, not to latent positions. The paper argues that latent hidden-state propagation is not aligned with discrete action log-probabilities, so directly optimizing latent positions with GRPO-style updates would be ill-posed and unstable. In effect, latent imagery acts as an internal reasoning substrate, while the RL signal is attached only to the textual decision surface.
summary_en.experiments:
From the available full-text excerpt, the main empirical claim is that 4DThinker consistently outperforms strong baselines on multiple dynamic spatial reasoning benchmarks, with gains spanning ego-motion, object-motion, and compound-motion tasks. The improvement appears to come in two stages: DIFT provides the initial grounding of 4D latent imagery, and 4DRL further improves difficult cases, especially compound motion.

The most informative ablations are likely the following. Removing latent imagery supervision and keeping only textual CoT should hurt performance, showing that text alone is a weak carrier for complex dynamics. Removing 4DRL should mainly reduce performance on hard motion compositions, indicating that outcome-based RL is doing targeted refinement rather than broad capability creation. Comparisons against methods with external geometric modules are also important, because the paper’s central claim is intrinsic capability without extra inference modules.

That said, the visible content does not include the full numeric tables, model sizes, training scale, or exact benchmark deltas. A careful read of the experiment section is needed to verify the base VLM size, the amount of DIFT and RL data, the reward definition, and the absolute gains over the strongest text-CoT and geometry-augmented baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, focus on three things. First, read the problem framing in the introduction: the paper is not about generic video understanding, but about decomposing dynamic reasoning into ego-motion and object-motion. Second, inspect the method figures and the data-generation pipeline to understand what exactly is supervised in the latent imagery branch, how those latent positions are inserted into the sequence, and why mask overlays are used as scalable proxy signals. Third, read the 4DRL section carefully, especially the rationale for applying RL only to text tokens. That is the most relevant systems-level design choice.

If time is limited, prioritize Fig. 1, Fig. 2, the DIFT and 4DRL loss definitions, and the main ablation tables. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough to capture the main idea. The deeper questions are whether the learned latent imagery transfers beyond the training distribution, and whether this text-plus-latent reasoning interface can become part of general multimodal pretraining rather than remaining a task-specific post-training trick.

recommendation.zh: 用统一隐空间做多模态内在推理的思路对预训练建模范式有启发，重点看方法部分的数据合成和DIFT微调设计。
recommendation.en: The unified latent space for intrinsic multimodal reasoning is informative for pretraining paradigm design; focus on the data synthesis and DIFT fine-tuning in the method section.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Internalizing Outcome Supervision into Process Supervision: A New Paradigm for Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning
paper.abstract: The central challenge of reinforcement learning for reasoning lies not only in the sparsity of outcome-level supervision, but more fundamentally in how to transform feedback provided only at the end of a sequence into fine-grained learning signals that can guide intermediate reasoning steps. Existing approaches either rely on outcome-level rewards for sequence-level optimization, which makes precise credit assignment difficult, or depend on externally constructed process supervision, which is co

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 reasoning RL 里一个更具体、也更难绕开的点：只有最终答案对错这种 outcome reward 时，怎么把序列级反馈变成能作用到中间推理步骤的训练信号。作者认为问题不只是 reward sparse，而是 credit assignment 粒度太粗。长链推理里，一条失败轨迹通常不是全错，而是大部分步骤可用、少数关键步骤出错；如果整条轨迹统一惩罚，模型会把正确局部推理也一起压掉。已有 process supervision 路线通常依赖外部标注、PRM、verifier 或搜索构造的伪标签，成本高，而且会随着策略模型变强而逐渐失配。这里提出的核心问题是：能不能只靠 outcome supervision，让模型在 RL 过程中自己把失败轨迹修复、对齐，再从修复前后差异里提炼出内部的 process supervision。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究本身，它不是直接改 pretrain objective，但对 pretrain 到 post-train 的接口有现实意义。原因有两点。第一，它把“结果监督如何内化成过程监督”明确成一个训练范式，而不是把 PRM 当成外部组件，这对 reasoning model 的持续强化、在线自举、以及减少人工过程标注依赖都有启发。第二，它强调 repair capability 和 policy capability 的联动：策略更强，错误更集中，修复更精确，反过来又给策略更细粒度的更新信号。这种闭环思路和近来的 self-improvement、R1-Zero 类工作是同一条线上的，只是这里把重点放在 credit assignment，而不是单纯增加 rollout 或做 rejection sampling。贡献量级上，更像是一个值得记住的训练框架，而不是已经定型的通用标准件；它对 reasoning RL 研究者有参考价值，对纯 pretrain 研究者的直接影响中等。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 IOP，核心是把 failed trajectory 变成可利用的局部监督。整体分两阶段。Stage 1 先给模型一个基础 repair 能力。作者构造了一个很小的 cold-start repair 数据集，规模是 500 个样本，用 SFT 训练同一个模型的 repair mode。输入是问题 x、失败推理轨迹 y、参考正确轨迹 a，再加一条修复指令；输出是修复后的正确推理。这里的设计重点不是训练一个独立修复器，而是让 policy mode 和 repair mode 共享参数，这样不会引入额外模型，也让修复能力随主策略一起提升。

Stage 2 是联合 RL。模型先以 policy mode 生成 reasoning trajectory，并拿到二值 outcome reward。对失败样本，不是直接当负样本丢掉，而是先筛选“可修复失败轨迹”，再进入 repair mode 生成修复版本。之后做 repair–alignment，把原失败轨迹和修复轨迹对齐，找出关键差异区域。作者这里的关键机制有三个：
1. audit gating：把修复前后差异映射成 token-level 或 span-level 的 gating signal，只在怀疑出错的局部区域上加强更新，而不是对整条链统一处理。
2. minimum-edit repair：鼓励修复尽量少改动，目标是让修复轨迹保留原轨迹中正确的部分，只改关键错误步骤。这样提炼出来的差异更接近真正的 error locus，而不是整段重写后的噪声差分。
3. verification-based adaptive truncation：利用验证结果决定从哪里截断或重加权，把后续建立在错误前缀上的推理部分视为低可信区域，避免错误传播污染监督。

外层优化器与 gating 机制解耦。作者用 GSPO 做实例化，得到 IOP-GSPO，但声称这套 gating 可以嵌到 GRPO、GSPO、RLOO 这类 group-comparison RL 算法里。和 exogenous process supervision 的区别在于，这里没有单独训练 PRM，也不依赖人工步骤标签；和纯 outcome RL 的区别在于，更新信号不再是整条序列同奖同罚，而是通过 repair 差异内生出局部过程信号。
summary.experiments:
实验结论比较清楚：IOP-GSPO 相比原始 GSPO 在三个 reasoning benchmark 上稳定提升，幅度大约是 4.9% 到 6.9%；同时相对依赖外部过程监督的方法也更强。作者还强调 sample efficiency，大约达到 2.3×，意思是在相近效果下需要更少采样，或者在相近采样预算下达到更高性能。

从文中给出的叙述看，最重要的实验观察不是单点分数，而是两类机制性结果。第一，repair capability 和 policy improvement 之间存在正反馈：随着策略变强，失败样本更像“局部出错而非整体崩坏”，修复模块更容易做最小改动；修复更准后，gating 更聚焦，RL 更新也更有效。第二，内生过程监督优于外生过程监督的一个原因，是它和当前策略分布更匹配。外部 PRM 或静态过程标签往往来自旧分布，策略一变，监督就可能失配；IOP 的监督来自当前 rollout 的失败样本，因此更在线。

不过从全文可见信息看，实验部分仍有几个边界需要注意。其一，repair cold-start 只用了 500 条样本，这说明方法对启动成本要求不高，但也意味着初始修复能力可能是瓶颈。其二，收益主要在 reasoning benchmark 上展示，尚未看到更广泛任务如代码、工具使用或长上下文规划上的验证。其三，文中强调 binary reward 场景，如果 reward 更稠密或 verifier 更强，IOP 的边际收益可能会变化，这部分还需要更多消融来定量说明。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合泛读但要抓住方法骨架。先看 Introduction，重点不是背景铺陈，而是作者对问题的重述：reasoning RL 的关键矛盾是把 outcome supervision 内化成 process supervision。这个 framing 比具体算法更重要。

然后看 Method 里 IOP 的三步：repairable failure selection、repair generation、truncation/gating feedback。需要重点理解 minimum-edit repair 和 adaptive truncation 为什么能改善 credit assignment。读的时候可以问两个问题：第一，修复前后差异为什么能近似错误步骤，而不是引入新的生成噪声；第二，共享参数的 repair mode 为什么不会和 policy mode 相互干扰，反而形成正反馈。

实验部分建议重点看三类内容：一是 IOP-GSPO 对 GSPO 的主结果；二是 sample efficiency 曲线；三是消融，尤其是去掉 repair、去掉 gating、去掉 truncation 后性能怎么掉。预计 25 到 35 分钟能读完主要信息。如果要深挖，值得追问的是：这种内生过程监督能否在没有 reference correct trajectory a 的情况下工作得同样稳定，以及它是否能和 PRM 结合，而不是二选一。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific bottleneck in reasoning RL: how to turn end-of-sequence outcome feedback into learning signals that act on intermediate reasoning steps. The authors argue that the issue is not only reward sparsity. The deeper problem is coarse credit assignment. In long-chain reasoning, a failed trajectory is usually not entirely wrong; many local steps are valid, while a small number of critical errors derail the final answer. Sequence-level reward treats all tokens in that trajectory too uniformly. Existing process-supervision approaches improve this, but they usually depend on external annotations, process reward models, verifiers, or search-generated pseudo-labels. Those signals are costly to build and can become mismatched as the policy improves. The paper asks whether a model can derive its own process supervision during RL using only outcome supervision.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper in the narrow sense, but it matters for the pretrain-to-post-train interface. The main value is conceptual and procedural. It reframes reasoning RL as internalizing outcome supervision into process supervision, rather than attaching an external PRM-like component. That is useful for online self-improvement, continual reasoning training, and reducing dependence on manually curated step-level labels. A second contribution is the closed-loop view between policy quality and repair quality: a stronger policy produces more localized errors, which makes repair easier; better repair then yields sharper local supervision for policy updates. That idea is closely related to recent self-improvement and zero-style reasoning RL work, but the emphasis here is on credit assignment rather than simply scaling rollouts or filtering trajectories. The contribution looks more like a promising training framework than a settled standard recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method is called IOP, short for Internalizing Outcome Supervision into Process Supervision. Its core idea is to convert failed trajectories into usable local supervision. The training pipeline has two stages.

Stage 1 gives the model a basic repair capability. The authors build a small cold-start repair dataset with 500 examples and fine-tune the same model in a repair mode. The input contains the problem x, a failed reasoning trajectory y, a reference correct trajectory a, and a repair instruction. The output is a corrected trajectory. A notable design choice is parameter sharing: the policy mode and repair mode use the same model parameters. This avoids training a separate repair model and lets repair ability co-evolve with the policy.

Stage 2 performs joint RL. The model first generates reasoning trajectories in policy mode and receives binary outcome rewards. Instead of discarding failed samples as uniformly negative, IOP first selects repairable failed trajectories, then invokes the repair mode to produce corrected versions. A repair-alignment step compares the original failed trajectory with the repaired one and extracts localized difference regions. Three mechanisms are central here:
1. Audit gating: converts repair differences into token- or span-level gating signals, so updates focus on suspicious local regions rather than the whole chain.
2. Minimum-edit repair: encourages the repaired trajectory to stay close to the original and only modify critical errors. This is important because a full rewrite would make the difference signal noisy and less useful for credit assignment.
3. Verification-based adaptive truncation: uses verification outcomes to decide where to truncate or reweight supervision, reducing contamination from downstream reasoning that was built on an earlier mistake.

The gating mechanism is decoupled from the outer RL optimizer. The paper instantiates IOP with GSPO, yielding IOP-GSPO, but claims the same idea can be plugged into GRPO, GSPO, or RLOO-style group-comparison RL algorithms. Relative to exogenous process supervision, the method does not require a separately trained PRM or human step labels. Relative to pure outcome RL, it replaces uniform sequence-level updates with internally generated local process signals derived from repair differences.
summary_en.experiments:
The main empirical result is straightforward: IOP-GSPO consistently improves over vanilla GSPO by about 4.9% to 6.9% on three reasoning benchmarks, and it also outperforms methods that rely on external process supervision. The paper further reports roughly 2.3x sample efficiency, suggesting that the method reaches similar quality with fewer samples or achieves better quality under the same sampling budget.

The more interesting findings are mechanistic. First, the paper reports a positive feedback loop between policy quality and repair quality. As the policy improves, failures become more localized rather than globally broken, which makes minimum-edit repair easier. Better repair then produces more precise gating signals, which in turn improves RL updates. Second, internally generated process supervision appears to be better matched to the current policy distribution than static external supervision. A PRM or fixed process labels may lag behind the evolving policy, while IOP derives supervision directly from current failed rollouts.

There are also clear boundaries. The cold-start repair stage uses only 500 examples, which is encouraging from a cost perspective but also suggests that initial repair quality may be a bottleneck. The evaluation is centered on reasoning benchmarks; broader validation on code, tool use, or long-horizon planning is not yet shown. The method is also presented mainly in a binary-reward setting, so its marginal benefit under denser rewards or stronger verifiers remains to be quantified more carefully.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim read, focus on the framing first. The Introduction is worth reading because the key contribution is the reformulation: reasoning RL should be viewed as converting outcome supervision into process supervision. That framing is more important than the specific GSPO instantiation.

Then read the Method section with attention to the three steps: selecting repairable failures, generating repairs, and feeding back localized signals through gating and truncation. The two ideas to watch closely are minimum-edit repair and verification-based adaptive truncation. They are the main reasons the method can improve credit assignment instead of just adding another self-correction loop.

In the experiments, prioritize three things: the main comparison against GSPO, the sample-efficiency results, and the ablations that remove repair, gating, or truncation. A practical reading question is whether repair differences truly isolate error locations or merely introduce another layer of generation noise. Another useful question is whether the shared-parameter repair mode helps because of representation reuse or because it regularizes the policy toward self-consistency. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main ideas.

recommendation.zh: 将结果监督内化为过程监督的概念框架值得关注，这与当前DeepSeek/OpenAI等关注的推理增强训练方向高度相关。重点阅读第3章的方法框架。
recommendation.en: The conceptual framework of internalizing outcome supervision into process supervision is noteworthy and highly relevant to ongoing reasoning-enhanced training directions at DeepSeek/OpenAI. Focus on Chapter 3's methodological framework.

paper.title: On the Implicit Reward Overfitting and the Low-rank Dynamics in RLVR
paper.abstract: Recent extensive research has demonstrated that the enhanced reasoning capabilities acquired by models through Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) are primarily concentrated within the rank-1 components. Predicated on this observation, we employed Periodic Rank-1 Substitution and identified a counterintuitive phenomenon: RLVR may exhibit implicit reward overfitting to the training dataset. Specifically, the model can achieve satisfactory performance on the test set even when it

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文研究 RLVR 到底在参数空间里学到了什么。核心问题不是奖励函数如何设计，而是 RL 产生的权重更新 ΔW 中，哪些方向对应可泛化的推理能力，哪些方向只是提高训练集 reward。作者把问题落在低秩结构上：如果 RLVR 的推理增益主要集中在 rank-1 分量，那么非 rank-1 分量的作用、风险和几何含义是什么。
summary.importance: 对预训练和 post-train 接口的启发在于：RLVR 可能主要改变模型的采样分布，而不是给模型注入全新的推理算法。论文把这个判断具体化到参数更新的奇异谱结构上，并提出 implicit reward overfitting 的证据：训练 reward 更高的更新方向，不一定带来测试集推理增益。这个结论会影响 RL 数据选择、reward 设计、LoRA rank 选择，以及如何评估 reasoning RL 是否真的提升了泛化能力。贡献量级偏机制分析和诊断工具，不是一个可直接替代现有 RLVR 的训练算法。
summary.technical_approach: 作者对 RL 后的权重更新 ΔW 做 SVD 分解，取最大奇异值对应的 rank-1 分量，并用 Frobenius norm 重新缩放，使其更新强度与原始 ΔW 可比。关键实验设计是 Periodic Rank-1 Substitution：在 RL 训练过程中周期性地把完整更新替换成 rescaled rank-1 更新，等价于持续删除非 rank-1 分量。这样可以区分两类效果：rank-1 分量是否足以承载数学推理提升，非 rank-1 分量是否只是提高训练 reward。论文还分析了 RL 更新的奇异谱，观察到一个 leading spike 加 heavy-tailed tail 的模式。对 LoRA 的解释也落在几何上：RLVR 更新在 output space 上高度 rank-1，容易对齐左奇异向量；input space 需要更复杂的上下文特征重组，低秩矩阵更难完整捕获。这个解释把“低 rank LoRA 做 RL 也能工作”的经验现象，与 RL 更偏向调整输出采样效率联系起来。
summary.experiments: 论文比较了 Full RL Fine-tuning 与 Periodic Rank-1 Substitution，在 GRPO、DAPO、GSPO 等 RLVR 设置下观察到相似现象：删除大量非 rank-1 分量后，训练 reward 通常更低，但部分数据集上的测试集推理表现仍可接近完整 RL。这支持了一个诊断结论：非 rank-1 分量能提高训练集 reward，却未必转化为可泛化推理能力。作者还测试了非推理能力，发现只保留 rank-1 分量会削弱世界知识、指令遵循、安全性等 out-of-domain 能力，说明非 rank-1 分量并非无用，而是更多维持模型整体能力。奇异谱实验显示，RL-tuned 模型的线性层更新常呈现最大奇异值尖峰和重尾分布。LoRA 动态分析显示 output-side 更新更容易形成强 rank-1 对齐，input-side 更新更分散。给出的材料没有包含完整表格数值、模型规模和每个 benchmark 的具体分数，精读时需要回到实验表和附录核对。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30 到 45 分钟。先看 rank-1 分解和 Frobenius 重新缩放的定义，确认作者比较的是更新方向而不是更新范数差异。然后看 Periodic Rank-1 Substitution 的训练流程，这是区分 reward fitting 与泛化推理增益的核心设计。实验部分重点看三类结果：训练 reward 与测试性能是否脱钩；rank-1-only 模型在数学推理之外损失了哪些能力；各层奇异谱是否稳定呈现 leading spike 加 heavy tail。LoRA 几何分析可以作为第二优先级阅读，重点关注 input/output subspace asymmetry，因为它解释了为什么 RL 低秩适配看起来足够有效，同时也指出了低秩更新可能覆盖不到的能力区域。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks what RLVR actually changes in the model parameters. The focus is not reward design, but the structure of the weight update ΔW: which directions carry generalizable reasoning gains, and which directions mainly improve training-set reward. The authors frame the question through low-rank dynamics, especially the observation that much of the reasoning improvement appears to concentrate in the rank-1 component of RL updates.
summary_en.importance: The main value for pretraining and post-training research is a sharper diagnosis of reasoning RL. The results suggest that RLVR may often improve the efficiency of eliciting latent correct answers rather than implanting new reasoning procedures. By tying this claim to singular-vector structure, the paper gives a concrete way to inspect reward overfitting, LoRA rank choices, and the gap between training reward and test-time generalization. The contribution is mainly mechanistic and diagnostic rather than a new RL algorithm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors decompose RL-induced weight updates ΔW with SVD and extract the leading rank-1 component. They rescale this component by Frobenius norm so that its update magnitude is comparable to the full update. The key intervention is Periodic Rank-1 Substitution: during RL training, the update is periodically replaced by its rescaled rank-1 component, removing non-rank-1 directions while preserving the dominant update strength. This separates the role of the leading singular direction from the rest of the update. The paper also studies the singular spectra of linear layers and reports a consistent pattern: one leading spike followed by a heavy-tailed spectrum. For LoRA, the proposed explanation is geometric. RLVR updates are strongly rank-1 on the output side and align easily with the dominant left singular vector, while the input side involves more complex contextual feature reorganization that is harder to capture with very low-rank matrices.
summary_en.experiments: The paper reports experiments under RLVR variants including GRPO, DAPO, and GSPO. With Periodic Rank-1 Substitution, training rewards can remain lower than full RL fine-tuning, while test-set reasoning performance remains comparable on a substantial subset of datasets. This supports the claim that some non-rank-1 directions improve training reward without producing corresponding generalization gains. The authors also evaluate capabilities outside mathematical reasoning. Rank-1-only updates preserve much of the reasoning gain but degrade broader abilities such as world knowledge, instruction following, and safety, indicating that the removed directions still help maintain the model’s general competence. Spectral analysis shows a leading singular-value spike plus a heavy-tailed tail across many linear layers. The provided content does not include full numerical tables, model sizes, or per-benchmark scores, so those should be checked directly in the experimental section and appendices.
summary_en.reading_guide: A useful skim takes about 30 to 45 minutes. Start with the definition of the rank-1 update and the Frobenius-norm rescaling, since the comparison only makes sense if update magnitude is controlled. Then read the Periodic Rank-1 Substitution procedure and the tables comparing training reward against test performance. The most important figures are the training-reward/test-performance gap, the capability degradation outside math reasoning, and the singular-spectrum plots. The LoRA analysis is worth a second pass if the goal is to understand why small-rank LoRA can work for RL while still being limited in preserving broader model behavior.

recommendation.zh: RL训练低秩动态结论可复用在预训练权重微调的 ablation 中，重点看第3节奇异值分布分析部分
recommendation.en: Low-rank dynamics findings of RL training can be reused in ablation studies of pre-trained weight fine-tuning, focus on singular value distribution analysis in Section 3

paper.title: Transformers Provably Implement In-Context Reinforcement Learning with Policy Improvement
paper.abstract: We investigate the ability of transformers to perform in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL), where a model must infer and execute learning algorithms from trajectory data without parameter updates. We show that a linear self-attention transformer block can provably implement policy-improvement methods, including semi-gradient SARSA and actor-critic, via explicit parameter constructions. Beyond existence, we design a teacher-mimicking training procedure, analyze its gradient-flow dynamics, and

summary.core_problem: 上下文强化学习（ICRL）领域存在两个未解决的核心理论问题：一是现有理论仅证明Transformer可实现策略评估，未证明其可实现更核心的策略改进算法；二是现有分析仅验证了目标参数集的不变性，未证明梯度训练能将参数驱动到该集合中，缺乏训练收敛的理论保证。
summary.importance: 首次为Transformer实现ICRL策略改进算法提供了完整的存在性与收敛性理论证明，填补了ICRL领域的理论空白；为预训练过程中LLM涌现出上下文强化学习能力的机制提供了理论解释，也为RL预训练、上下文推理能力的定向优化提供了理论基础。
summary.technical_approach: 1. 针对单头线性自注意力块，构造了显式的闭式参数配置，可精确实现批量半梯度SARSA和批量演员-评论家两种经典在策略更新，输出直接是更新后的策略/价值参数，可闭环完成上下文策略迭代，区别于之前仅输出价值估计的策略评估构造。2. 针对最优参数为连续流形而非单点的特性，在流形的管状邻域上证明了局部Polyak-Łojasiewicz不等式，结合训练MDP分布的丰富性条件，证明了模仿教师更新的梯度流会以指数速度局部收敛到流形上的某一点，是ICRL领域首个收敛性保证。
summary.experiments: 1. 分别设计了SARSA和演员-评论家场景的ICRL训练算法，训练后的Transformer的注意力参数可恢复理论构造的目标结构，验证了理论存在性的可实现性。2. 将训练好的Transformer部署在未见过的MDP上，其策略更新效果与理论教师算法高度一致，最终策略收益接近最优Oracle水平。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第3章的核心理论证明部分，包括存在性定理3.1、3.3和收敛性定理3.2，理解参数构造的核心逻辑以及收敛性条件的设计；第4章的实证部分可快速浏览验证理论结论；预计完整阅读时间约1.5小时，仅关注核心结论可在30分钟内完成。

summary_en.core_problem: Two core open theoretical problems exist in the in-context reinforcement learning (ICRL) domain: first, existing theories only prove that transformers can implement policy evaluation, but not the more central policy improvement algorithms; second, existing analyses only verify the invariance of the target parameter set, without proving that gradient training can drive parameters into this set, lacking theoretical guarantees for training convergence.
summary_en.importance: This work provides the first complete existence and convergence theoretical proof for transformers to implement ICRL policy improvement algorithms, filling a theoretical gap in the ICRL field. It also provides a theoretical explanation for the mechanism of in-context reinforcement learning ability emerging in LLMs during pre-training, and lays a theoretical foundation for RL pre-training and targeted optimization of in-context reasoning ability.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. For a single-head linear self-attention block, an explicit closed-form parameter configuration is constructed, which can accurately implement two classic on-policy updates: batch semi-gradient SARSA and batch actor-critic. The output is directly the updated policy/value parameters, which can close the loop of in-context policy iteration, different from previous policy evaluation constructions that only output value estimates. 2. Aiming at the characteristic that the optimal parameter is a continuous manifold rather than a single point, a local Polyak-Łojasiewicz inequality is proved on the tubular neighborhood of the manifold. Combined with the richness condition of the training MDP distribution, it is proved that the gradient flow imitating teacher updates converges exponentially locally to a point on the manifold, which is the first convergence guarantee in the ICRL literature.
summary_en.experiments: 1. ICRL training algorithms for SARSA and actor-critic scenarios are designed respectively. The attention parameters of the trained transformers can recover the target structure of the theoretical construction, verifying the realizability of the theoretical existence conclusion. 2. When the trained transformers are deployed on unseen MDPs, their policy update effects are highly consistent with the theoretical teacher algorithm, and the final policy returns are close to the optimal oracle level.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the core theoretical proofs in Chapter 3, including existence theorems 3.1, 3.3 and convergence theorem 3.2, to understand the core logic of parameter construction and the design of convergence conditions; the empirical part in Chapter 4 can be quickly browsed to verify the theoretical conclusions; the expected full reading time is about 1.5 hours, and only focusing on the core conclusions can be completed within 30 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不会直接教你怎么训更大的模型，但它把“transformer 是隐式学习器”往 RL 一侧推了一步；读定理和 tabular setup 就够，别把外推到真实 LLM 当结论。
recommendation.en: It won’t tell you how to train a better frontier model tomorrow, but it does push the 'transformer as a latent learner' story into RL; read the constructions and tabular setup, not as evidence for real LLM behavior.

paper.title: Recursive Agent Optimization
paper.abstract: We introduce Recursive Agent Optimization (RAO), a reinforcement learning approach for training recursive agents: agents that can spawn and delegate sub-tasks to new instantiations of themselves recursively. Recursive agents implement an inference-time scaling algorithm that naturally allows agents to scale to longer contexts and generalize to more difficult problems via divide-and-conquer. RAO provides a method to train models to best take advantage of such recursive inference, teaching agents

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作关注的是：如果递归式 agent 会成为一种重要的 test-time scaling 机制，那么模型不应只在推理时被外部脚手架“包起来”，而应该在训练中学会何时拆分任务、如何委派子任务、如何在层级之间传递信息，以及如何汇总子结果。
summary.importance: 它对基座预训练本身不是直接贡献，更偏 post-train / agent training，但有两个启发点。第一，递归 delegation 可以被看成一种结构化的 inference-time compute 分配方式，和长上下文、外部记忆、树搜索属于同一类问题。第二，论文强调“把推理时脚手架放进训练回路”，这与近来的 scaffold-aware training、tool-use training、reasoning-time optimization 是一致方向。对做基座的人来说，价值在于理解：模型能力上限不只由参数和上下文长度决定，还受是否学会使用外部计算结构影响。
summary.technical_approach: RAO 的核心是用 RL 训练 recursive agents。agent 在执行过程中可以 launch subagent，把子目标交给新的自身实例处理；子 agent 拥有 fresh context，因此递归天然扩展有效工作记忆，并支持 divide-and-conquer 与并行。训练目标不是单纯学会完成任务，而是学会使用递归：什么时候值得 delegate，子任务该如何表述，父子节点之间传什么信息，以及何时停止递归并汇总答案。论文在合成环境 TextCraft-Synth 和真实长文档环境 Oolong-Real 上训练，重点比较单 agent 与 recursive agent，以及受限上下文和非受限上下文两种设定。方法上的关键不是新模型结构，而是把递归执行树视作 policy 的一部分，用 RL 直接优化。
summary.experiments: 实验主要覆盖三个场景。TextCraft-Synth 是可控合成 benchmark，任务难度由 crafting tree depth 控制：Easy 深度 2–3，Medium 4–6，Hard 7–9。作者只在 medium 难度上训练，然后测试向 easy 和 hard 的泛化；模型使用 Qwen-3-4B-Instruct-2507。在 constrained-context 设定中，训练和推理都限制在 8K context，用来检验递归是否能弥补上下文不足；在 unconstrained 设定中，训练 40K、推理 256K，此时单 agent 在上下文上并不吃亏，因此更能看出递归是否带来结构性泛化。Oolong-Real 使用 Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct，训练时上下文上限 32K，而任务文档至少 55K token，单 agent 无法完整读取输入，递归 agent 则可通过分块子代理覆盖全输入。摘要还提到 RAO 在训练效率、超上下文任务泛化、以及 wall-clock latency 上都有优势，但给出的全文片段里没有完整表格数字；阅读时需要直接看主实验表和附录超参。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction，把作者要解决的问题和递归 agent 的执行模型弄清楚；再看 TextCraft-Synth 设定，因为这是最干净的机制验证；最后看 Oolong-Real，判断这种方法在真实长上下文任务里是否只是“分块读取”，还是确实学到了更好的 delegation policy。预计 20–30 分钟能抓住主线。如果只看一个点，优先看训练时是否真的学会了更好的任务分解，而不是单纯依赖更多 token 或更长 context。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies how to train agents that can recursively spawn sub-agents, rather than treating recursion as a purely inference-time wrapper around a pretrained model.
summary_en.importance: This is more of a post-training and agent-training contribution than a pretraining one, but it matters for anyone thinking about test-time scaling. It frames recursive delegation as a structured way to allocate inference-time compute, similar in spirit to long-context processing, external memory, and search. It also reinforces a broader lesson: if a scaffold is important at inference time, training the policy with that scaffold in the loop can materially change how well the model uses it.
summary_en.technical_approach: RAO uses reinforcement learning to train recursive agents that can launch fresh instances of themselves on subtasks. Because each sub-agent gets a fresh context, recursion increases effective working memory and supports divide-and-conquer as well as parallel execution. The optimization target is not just task success, but competent use of recursion: when to delegate, how to phrase subgoals, what information to pass across levels, and how to aggregate sub-results. The paper evaluates this on a synthetic compositional environment, TextCraft-Synth, and on a real long-context benchmark, Oolong-Real. The main idea is to treat the recursive execution tree as part of the policy and optimize it directly with RL.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover controlled and realistic settings. In TextCraft-Synth, task difficulty is controlled by crafting-tree depth: Easy is depth 2–3, Medium 4–6, and Hard 7–9. Training is done only on medium tasks, with evaluation on both easier and harder tasks to test generalization. The model there is Qwen-3-4B-Instruct-2507. In the constrained-context setup, both training and inference use an 8K context window, testing whether recursion can compensate for limited context. In the unconstrained setup, training uses 40K and inference 256K, so the single-agent baseline is not context-limited; this makes it possible to test whether recursion helps beyond raw context length. On Oolong-Real, the model is Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B-Instruct, trained with a 32K limit on tasks requiring at least 55K tokens of input, where recursive chunking becomes necessary. The abstract claims gains in training efficiency, out-of-context generalization, and wall-clock time, but the excerpt here does not include the full result tables, so the exact margins need to be checked in the main experiments and appendix.
summary_en.reading_guide: A good skim is to read the introduction first, then the TextCraft-Synth section, and finally the Oolong-Real experiments. That is enough to understand the execution model, the training objective, and the intended benefit of recursion. Budget about 20–30 minutes. The main thing to watch for is whether the learned policy truly improves task decomposition and communication, rather than merely exploiting more total tokens or a chunking heuristic.

recommendation.zh: 想看 test-time compute 如何被训练成策略可以扫一眼；但它更像 agentic decomposition，不会直接改你的 pretrain recipe。
recommendation.en: Worth skimming if you care about learning test-time compute policies, but this is agentic decomposition rather than something that will directly change your pretraining recipe.

paper.title: Safactory: A Scalable Agent Factory for Trustworthy Autonomous Intelligence
paper.abstract: As large models evolve from conversational assistants into autonomous agents, challenges increasingly arise from long-horizon decision making, tool use, and real environment interaction. Existing agenticinfrastructure remain fragmented across evaluation, data management, and agent evolution, making it difficult to discover risks systematically and improve models in a continuous closed loop. In this report, we present \textbf{Safactory}, a scalable agent factory for trustworthy autonomous intelli

summary.core_problem: 现有智能体基础设施在评测、数据管理、模型迭代三个环节碎片化，无法系统挖掘长周期多步交互场景下的智能体隐性安全风险，也难以形成从风险发现到模型优化的连续闭环。
summary.importance: 为智能体场景下的强化学习预训练、持续安全对齐迭代提供了系统级设计参考，解决了安全对齐数据难以规模化生产、离线交互数据与在线策略迭代脱节的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 搭建三个深度耦合的功能平台：1. 并行仿真平台，支持多环境预 heating、异步调度、多轨迹并发重评，可在执行过程中注入攻击和扰动，系统挖掘长周期交互中的安全风险；2. 可信数据平台，结构化存储交互轨迹、奖励信号、失败上下文，通过意图驱动引擎完成安全审计、样本筛选和经验蒸馏；3. 自主进化平台，基于处理后的轨迹数据执行异步强化学习和同策略蒸馏，在版本控制、轨迹过滤、群体一致性约束下实现模型能力和安全水平的同步提升。
summary.experiments: 当前公开内容仅披露系统架构和功能设计，未给出具体量化实验结果。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读第1章的智能体风险特征分析、第2章的现有基础设施缺陷梳理、第3章的三大核心平台架构设计，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing agent infrastructure is fragmented across evaluation, data management and model iteration, which fails to systematically uncover hidden safety risks of agents in long-horizon multi-step interaction scenarios, and cannot form a continuous closed loop from risk discovery to model optimization.
summary_en.importance: It provides system-level design reference for reinforcement learning pretraining and continuous safety alignment iteration in agent scenarios, solving the pain points of large-scale safety alignment data production and disconnection between offline interaction data and online policy iteration.
summary_en.technical_approach: Three tightly coupled functional platforms are built: 1. Parallel simulation platform, which supports environment pool preheating, asynchronous scheduling, concurrent re-evaluation of multiple trajectories, and attack/perturbation injection during execution to systematically discover safety risks in long-horizon interactions; 2. Trustworthy data platform, which stores interaction trajectories, reward signals and failure contexts in a structured manner, and completes safety audit, sample filtering and experience distillation through an intent-driven engine; 3. Autonomous evolution platform, which performs asynchronous reinforcement learning and on-policy distillation based on processed trajectory data, and realizes synchronous improvement of model capability and safety under the constraints of version control, trajectory filtering and group consistency.
summary_en.experiments: Only system architecture and functional design are disclosed in the currently public content, no specific quantitative experimental results are provided.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim Chapter 1 for analysis of agent risk characteristics, Chapter 2 for review of limitations of existing infrastructure, Chapter 3 for architecture design of three core platforms. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: Agent全链路进化的基础设施设计，仅看§3三大平台架构即可，可参考构建内部Agent训练闭环。
recommendation.en: Infrastructure design for full-pipeline agent evolution, only read §3 architecture of three platforms, can be referenced for internal agent training pipeline construction.

paper.title: PRAISE: Prefix-Based Rollout Reuse in Agentic Search Training
paper.abstract: In agentic search, large language models (LLMs) are trained to perform multi-turn retrieval and reasoning for complex tasks such as multi-hop question answering (QA). However, current search-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods suffer from two core limitations: expensive long-horizon rollouts are under-utilized during training, and supervision is typically available only at the final answer, resulting in severe reward sparsity. We present Prefix-based Rollout reuse for Agentic search with I

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agentic search 中 RLVR 奖励过稀、过程监督又常常与最终结果不对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心增量，但对 pretrain↔post-train 接口有启发：如果模型需要通过多步检索和外部交互来扩展能力，如何构造与最终 outcome 一致的中间训练信号，是后续 tool-use、search policy、甚至合成训练轨迹时都会遇到的问题。论文的价值不在提出一个通用 RL 新算法，而在于把“过程奖励要和最终可验证目标对齐”这件事做得更具体，并且避免了固定 evaluator 与 evolving policy 的失配。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 OASES。核心做法是把中间 search state 也放到最终任务的 outcome metric 下评估，而不是用相似度、启发式规则或外部 judge 打分。具体来说，给定某一步搜索状态下已经积累的证据，evaluator 基于当前状态生成一个 state-conditioned answer，再用与最终答案相同的可验证指标去打分；相邻状态之间这个分数的提升，就被当作 dense process reward。这样得到的奖励信号直接对应“这一步搜索是否让最终答案更可回答”，而不是“这一步看起来是否相关”。

第二个关键设计是 search–evaluation co-training：作者不单独训练一个冻结的 reward model 或 evaluator，而是让同一个共享参数模型同时承担 search policy 和 state evaluator 的角色，并用 PPO 优化。这样做是为了解决 evaluator–policy mismatch：如果 evaluator 固定不变，它看到的状态分布和当前 policy 生成的真实搜索轨迹会逐渐偏离；如果直接用外部模型算 likelihood gain，也可能和当前 policy 的行为不一致。OASES 让 evaluator 随 policy 一起更新，试图让过程奖励始终贴近当前策略的真实搜索分布。

从方法定位看，它更像 outcome-aligned process supervision，而不是传统意义上的 reward shaping。因为它没有引入一个与最终目标不同的代理目标，而是把最终目标投影到中间状态上。
summary.experiments:
实验主要在 multi-hop QA 的 agentic search 场景上，结论是 OASES 相比强 RL baseline 能稳定提升搜索表现。摘要和引言明确给出的结论包括：1）outcome-aligned process rewards 比只用最终 outcome reward 的 RLVR 更有效，说明稠密信用分配确实有帮助；2）shared-policy 的 search–evaluation co-training 优于 frozen evaluator 或只优化 search policy 的替代方案，说明 evaluator–policy mismatch 不是边缘问题，而是会实质影响训练质量。

从阅读重点看，正文里最值得确认的是三类实验：一是主结果相对 PPO/RLVR baseline 的提升幅度；二是 process reward 的消融，例如与 heuristic reward、retrieval relevance reward、likelihood/information-gain reward 的比较；三是 evaluator 设计的消融，即共享参数、冻结 evaluator、分离 evaluator 三种设置谁更稳。若论文还报告了 rollout reuse 或 prefix reuse 带来的 sample efficiency 改善，那部分更偏训练效率，但不是这篇工作的主要研究价值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看方法总图和 reward 定义，再看消融，不必在环境细节上停留太久。重点确认两件事：第一，state-conditioned answer 的打分是否真的避免了答案泄漏或过早拟合 gold answer；第二，共享 evaluator 是否会带来自举偏差，即模型既当裁判又当选手时会不会奖励自己偏好的轨迹。预计 20–30 分钟可以抓住主要思想；若只关心对训练信号设计的启发，主实验表、reward ablation、co-training ablation 三处足够。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a central difficulty in RL training for agentic search: outcome rewards are sparse and delayed, while existing process rewards are often misaligned with the final objective or become unreliable as the policy evolves.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the pretrain-to-post-train interface. Once models are trained to use tools, search, or external evidence, the quality of intermediate supervision becomes a bottleneck. The useful idea here is not a new general RL algorithm, but a cleaner way to derive dense process rewards from the same verifiable objective used at the end of the trajectory, while reducing evaluator–policy mismatch.
summary_en.technical_approach:
OASES builds dense process rewards by evaluating intermediate search states with the final outcome metric itself. At each search state, given the evidence accumulated so far, an evaluator generates a state-conditioned answer. That answer is then scored with the same verifiable metric used for the final answer, such as exact match or F1. The score improvement between consecutive states becomes the process reward. This makes the reward signal answer-oriented rather than proxy-oriented: the question is whether a search step makes the final answer more supportable, not whether it merely looks relevant.

The second key design is search–evaluation co-training. Instead of using a separate frozen evaluator, external judge, or fixed likelihood model, OASES uses a shared-parameter model as both the search policy and the state evaluator, optimized with PPO. The motivation is to reduce evaluator–policy mismatch. A frozen evaluator may become stale as the policy changes its search behavior, while likelihood-based evaluators can be inconsistent with the policy’s own generation dynamics under partial prefixes. Jointly training search and evaluation is meant to keep the process reward adaptive to the current policy distribution.

Conceptually, this is closer to outcome-aligned process supervision than to conventional reward shaping, because it does not replace the final objective with a different proxy objective.
summary_en.experiments:
The experiments are conducted on multi-hop QA benchmarks in an agentic search setting. The main reported finding is that OASES consistently improves over strong RL baselines for search. The paper also claims that outcome-aligned process rewards provide better credit assignment than outcome-only RLVR, and that search–evaluation co-training outperforms alternatives based on frozen evaluators or search-only optimization.

The most important details to verify in the full paper are: the absolute gain over PPO/RLVR baselines, comparisons against other process-reward formulations such as heuristic relevance or likelihood-based information gain, and ablations on evaluator design. If the paper also includes rollout or prefix reuse for sample efficiency, that is useful from a training-efficiency angle, but it is secondary to the main contribution, which is the reward construction and co-training setup.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Read the method overview first, then the exact reward definition, then the ablations. There are two questions worth checking carefully. First, does the state-conditioned answer evaluation avoid answer leakage or premature fitting to the gold answer? Second, does using the same model as both policy and evaluator introduce self-reinforcing bias? If your interest is mainly in training-signal design, the main results table, reward ablations, and co-training ablations are enough. Around 20 to 30 minutes should be sufficient.

recommendation.zh: Prefix rollout复用和step-level奖励推导是Agent RL训练中值得关注的数据效率改进方向，主要看方法部分（§3）即可。
recommendation.en: Prefix rollout reuse and step-level reward derivation are interesting directions for data-efficient Agent RL training; focus on the method section (§3).

paper.title: 即可阅读笔记。
paper.abstract: 大模型知识分享 清华大学 关注 谷歌SkillOS：让自进化Agent学会skill策展 LLM Agent 正越来越多地被用来处理流式任务，但通常解决的是一次性问题，无法从过往交互中学习。 从经验中提炼出的可复用 skills 为自进化提供了基础，而高质量技能策展（skills curation）依然是关键瓶颈。现有方法要么依赖人工 skills curation、规定启发式 skills 操作，要么针对短程 skills 操作进行训练，仍难以从间接的、延迟的反馈中学习复杂的长期 curation 策略。 为应对这一挑战，谷歌团队及其合作者提出了一个经验驱动的 RL 训练方案 SkillOS，用于在自进化 Agent 中学习 skills curation。SkillOS 将一个冻结的 Agent 执行器（负责检索和应用技能）与一个可训练的 skills 策展器（负责从积累的经验中更新外部 SkillRepo）配对。 为给 curation 过程提供学习信号，他们设计了复合奖励机制，并基于 skills 相关的任务依赖关系，对分组任务流进行训练：前期轨迹更新 SkillRepo，而后

summary.core_problem: 讨论自进化 LLM Agent 在流式任务中如何从历史交互里学习“可复用技能”，并把技能策展（skills curation）从人工/启发式规则推进到可学习的长期策略。
summary.key_insights: 介绍 Google 的 SkillOS：将冻结的执行器（检索/应用技能）与可训练的策展器（更新外部 SkillRepo）解耦；用复合奖励为策展提供学习信号，并用“前期轨迹更新技能库、后期相关任务评估更新效果”的分组任务流来解决延迟反馈下的 credit assignment；宣称在多轮 agentic 任务与单轮推理任务上同时提升有效性与效率，并且策展器可跨执行器骨干与任务域泛化；观察到 SkillRepo 中的技能随时间演化为结构更丰富的 Markdown/元技能，带来更有针对性的技能调用。
summary.limits: 内容看起来是二手笔记式复述，缺少关键实验细节（奖励构成、训练稳定性、对比基线强度、成本/样本效率、失败案例）与可复现信息；与“基座预训练”关联偏间接，更偏向 agent 记忆/工具/技能库的后训练与系统设计。

summary_en.core_problem: How to make self-improving LLM agents learn reusable skills from streaming interactions, focusing on learnable skill curation rather than manual or heuristic updates.
summary_en.key_insights: Summarizes Google SkillOS: decouples a frozen executor (retrieves/applies skills) from a trainable curator that updates an external SkillRepo; uses a composite reward and a grouped task-stream setup where early trajectories modify the repo and later related tasks evaluate those modifications, addressing delayed-feedback credit assignment; reports consistent gains in effectiveness and efficiency on multi-turn agentic tasks and single-turn reasoning tasks, with curator generalization across executor backbones and domains; notes the repo evolves into more structured Markdown-like artifacts encoding higher-level meta-skills.
summary_en.limits: Appears to be a secondary, high-level recap with limited methodological detail (reward design, training dynamics, baseline rigor, compute/sample efficiency, failure modes) and no reproducibility pointers; relevance to foundation-model pretraining is indirect, leaning more toward post-training/system-level agent learning.

paper.title: On Training Large Language Models for Long-Horizon Tasks: An Empirical Study of Horizon Length
paper.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise as interactive agents that solve tasks through extended sequences of environment interactions. While prior work has primarily focused on system-level optimizations or algorithmic improvements, the role of task horizon length in shaping training dynamics remains poorly understood. In this work, we present a systematic empirical study that examines horizon length through controlled task constructions. Specifically, we construct controlled tasks in wh

summary.core_problem: 该工作研究一个很具体的问题：在决策规则和推理结构不变时，仅仅把任务所需的交互步数拉长，会怎样影响 LLM agent 的 SFT/RL 训练稳定性和最终能力。
summary.importance: 对基座和 post-train 接口有直接启发。长程任务失败不一定来自推理难度增加，也可能来自 horizon 本身带来的训练信号退化：成功概率随步数连乘下降，探索空间变大，延迟奖励让信用分配更噪。这个结论会影响长轨迹数据构造、agent SFT 的轨迹切分、RL rollout 设计、curriculum 设计，以及用短 horizon 数据训练后外推到长 horizon 的评估方式。贡献更接近训练动态诊断和经验原则，不是新架构或新优化器。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是受控变量实验。作者把 LLM 建模为 token-level MDP，再把 agent 与环境交互建模为有限 horizon MDP。状态包含任务目标、记忆和环境观测；动作由模型生成；一条轨迹由多轮状态、动作和环境转移组成。关键设计是构造一组任务：底层决策规则相同，推理结构相同，只改变到达目标所需的动作序列长度。这样可以把“horizon length”从“任务更难”里拆出来单独观察。训练侧覆盖常见的 SFT 行为克隆和 RL，尤其关注长 horizon 下探索、稀疏回报和高方差更新带来的不稳定。缓解思路是 horizon reduction：把训练时需要完成的有效目标距离缩短，降低探索和信用分配压力，再观察模型是否能在推理时泛化到未见过的更长 horizon。
summary.experiments: 实验围绕受控任务族展开：固定决策规则与推理复杂度，只改变 goal distance 或成功所需动作步数。报告的主要现象是，短 horizon 下可以稳定学习的策略，在 horizon 增大后会出现明显训练不稳定，甚至性能崩塌；这种退化在推理结构不变时仍然存在，说明 horizon 是独立瓶颈。作者还测试了 horizon reduction 类训练策略，结果显示训练稳定性和最终表现都有改善，并观察到 horizon generalization：模型在较短 horizon 上训练后，推理阶段可迁移到未见过的更长 horizon。给出的全文内容没有包含具体表格数值、模型参数量、数据规模或提升百分比，因此不应补写未经确认的数字。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，约 20–30 分钟。重点看三处：第一，horizon 的形式化定义和任务构造方式，确认作者是否真正控制住了推理复杂度；第二，训练曲线和失败案例，尤其是性能崩塌是否来自探索不足、奖励稀疏还是轨迹长度导致的 token-level 误差累积；第三，horizon reduction 的实现细节和外推实验，判断它更像 curriculum、轨迹分解，还是一种对奖励延迟的工程性缓解。对预训练研究员，最值得带走的是变量隔离方式和长轨迹训练信号质量的分析框架。

summary_en.core_problem: The study asks whether horizon length alone can make LLM agent training unstable, even when the decision rule and reasoning structure of the task are held fixed.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a clean training-dynamics observation for long-horizon agents. Failures on multi-step tasks are often attributed to weak reasoning, poor tool use, or insufficient orchestration. This work isolates another factor: the required number of environment actions. Longer horizons reduce end-to-end success probability, enlarge the exploration space, and make delayed feedback harder to assign to individual decisions. For pretraining and post-training researchers, this matters for trajectory data design, agent SFT, RL rollout construction, curriculum schedules, and evaluation of long-horizon generalization. The contribution is an empirical diagnosis and a training principle rather than a new model architecture.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper frames an LLM as a stochastic policy in a token-level MDP, then extends the view to an environment-interaction MDP with finite horizon. Each state includes the task goal, agent memory, and current observation; each action is generated by the model; a full episode is a sequence of states, actions, and transitions. The experimental design is the important part: construct controlled task families where the underlying rule and reasoning pattern stay the same, while only the number of required action steps changes. This separates horizon from task complexity. Training is discussed under standard agent SFT and RL settings, with attention to exploration difficulty, sparse or delayed reward, and high-variance updates. The proposed mitigation is horizon reduction: train on shorter effective goal distances to reduce credit-assignment and exploration burden, then test whether the resulting policy can extrapolate to longer horizons.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments compare matched tasks with different required goal distances. The reported finding is that policies that learn reliably on short horizons can become unstable as the horizon grows, sometimes collapsing in performance, despite unchanged reasoning complexity. Horizon reduction improves training stability and final performance. The authors also report horizon generalization, where models trained under shorter horizons can handle longer, unseen horizons at inference time. The provided full-content excerpt does not include concrete numerical tables, model sizes, dataset sizes, or percentage gains, so exact numbers cannot be stated reliably.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 20–30 minutes. Focus on the formal definition of horizon, the controlled task construction, and the learning curves that separate horizon effects from reasoning complexity. The most useful parts are the failure analysis under longer horizons and the implementation of horizon reduction. Check whether the observed instability is driven by exploration failure, delayed reward, or accumulated per-step error. The practical takeaway is a clearer way to reason about long-trajectory training signals for LLM agents.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不改 pretrain prior，但把 long-horizon agent 训练失败更干净地归因到 horizon 本身；先看实验设定和短到长训练曲线，若你做 RL-for-agents，值得立刻复现实验模板。
recommendation.en: It does not change pretraining priors, but it cleanly attributes long-horizon agent failures to horizon itself; read the controlled setup and short-to-long curves first, and reuse the template if you work on RL-trained agents.

commentary.article_excerpt: 代码熊大模型论文分享 关注 🎯任务长度竟成训练瓶颈？新研究揭示关键 大家有没有想过，为什么大语言模型（LLM）在解决需要多步交互的任务时，表现经常不尽如人意？🤔 现有研究大多关注系统优化或算法改进，却忽略了一个根本因素——任务本身的“长度”。这篇来自ICML 2026的论文，系统地研究了任务长度对LLM训练的影响，结果发现：仅仅增加任务所需的行动序列长度，就会导致训练不稳定、性能崩溃！即使推理难度不变，长任务也会带来探索困难和信用分配挑战，让模型难以学习。这就像让AI走迷宫，迷宫结构一样，但路径越长，它就越容易迷路。作者认为，长度本身就是训练瓶颈，我们需要正视这个被忽视的问题。 那么，如何解决这个长度瓶颈呢？论文提出了一个简单但强大的原则——长度缩减（horizon reduction）🎯。核心思想是：在训练时使用较短的任务版本，让模型更容易学习稳定的策略，然后利用一种叫做“长度泛化（horizon generalization）”的现象，让模型在推理时自然地处理更长的任务。具体来说，作者设计了受控实验，确保任务规则和推理结构不变，只改变目标距离（即行动序列长度）。结果发现，直接在长任务上训练RL会导致梯度方差大、学习信号噪声高，而先在短任务上训练再微调，不仅训练更稳定，最终性能反而更好！这就像教小孩学数学，先让他做简单的题打好基础，再挑战难题。 实验部分非常扎实！作者在多种任务设置下验证了长度缩减的有效性，包括不同的环境、不同的模型大小。结果显示，使用长度缩减训练的模型，在长任务上的成功率显著高于直接训练；更神奇的是，这些模型还能在推理时泛化到更长的任务上，而无需额外训练。🔥 例如，在某个导航任务中，直接训练的成功率不到20%，而长度缩减方法达到了60%以上。此外，作者还分析了长度泛化的机制，认为短任务训练帮助模型学会了更鲁棒的推理模式，从而能够应对更长的交互序列。这项研究不仅揭示了长度作为独立因素的重要性，还提供了一条实用的训练路径，未来有望应用于代码生成、机器人控制等需要长期规划的复杂场景。 Arxiv：2605.02572 🔗 关键词：大语言模型，强化学习，任务长度，训练稳定性，泛化 每天分享AI前沿研究，点个关注不迷路，一起探索AI的无限可能！🚀 #多模态人工智能 #大模型 #人工智能 #学术研究 #LLM #AI #深度学习 #科技前沿 #强化学习 #机器学习 昨天 17:15
