paper.title: Compute Aligned Training: Optimizing for Test Time Inference
paper.abstract: Scaling test-time compute has emerged as a powerful mechanism for enhancing Large Language Model (LLM) performance. However, standard post-training paradigms, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL), optimize the likelihood of individual samples under a base policy, creating a misalignment with test time procedures that rely on aggregated or filtered outputs. In this work, we propose Compute Aligned Training, which aligns training objectives with test-time strategies. By con

summary.core_problem: 标准预训练和后训练（SFT/RL）目标优化的是单个样本的似然，这与测试时依赖聚合或过滤输出（如 Pass@N、多数投票、Best-of-N）的推理策略不一致，导致模型在测试时扩展计算（test-time scaling）时表现次优。
summary.importance: 提出了一种统一的理论框架，将测试时策略视为对基础策略的算子，从而推导出与推理策略对齐的新损失函数。这为解决训练目标与测试时策略不匹配的普遍问题提供了一种计算高效的精确梯度缩放机制，对提升模型在复杂推理任务中的表现具有启发意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出计算对齐训练（Compute Aligned Training, CAT）。核心思想是将推理策略概念化为算子 $\mathcal{T}$，它将基础策略 $\pi_{\theta}$ 转换为有效的测试时分布 $\tilde{\pi}_{\theta}$。通过对这个转换后的分布执行梯度下降来最小化损失，从而使模型训练与其部署环境对齐。无论是 SFT 还是 RL，CAT 都会根据样本对聚合结果的“边际效用”重新加权梯度，且不增加额外开销。该框架统一并推广了先前的 Direct Coverage Optimization (DCO) 方法。
summary.experiments: 论文在 SFT 和 RL 范式下，针对 Pass@N、多数投票等常见测试时策略实例化了 CAT 损失函数。实证结果表明，CAT 广泛提高了测试时扩展的性能，不仅适用于 LLM，还成功扩展到了蛋白质语言模型（PLMs）。
summary.reading_guide: 建议重点阅读 Method 部分关于如何将推理策略形式化为算子的理论推导，以及 CAT 如何在 SFT 和 RL 中具体实例化的细节。关注实验部分中 CAT 在不同测试时策略下的性能提升幅度，特别是与标准训练方法的对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Standard pre-training and post-training (SFT/RL) objectives optimize the likelihood of individual samples, which is misaligned with test-time inference strategies that rely on aggregated or filtered outputs (e.g., Pass@N, Majority Vote, Best-of-N), leading to suboptimal performance during test-time compute scaling.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a unified theoretical framework that conceptualizes test-time strategies as operators on the base policy, deriving new loss functions aligned with inference strategies. This provides a computationally efficient, exact gradient scaling mechanism to address the pervasive mismatch between training objectives and test-time strategies, offering insights for improving model performance on complex reasoning tasks.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces Compute Aligned Training (CAT). The core idea is to conceptualize inference strategies as operators $\mathcal{T}$ that transform the base policy $\pi_{\theta}$ into an effective test-time distribution $\tilde{\pi}_{\theta}$. By performing gradient descent to minimize the loss with respect to this transformed distribution, model training is aligned with its deployment environment. For both SFT and RL, CAT re-weights gradients based on the 'marginal utility' of a sample to the aggregate outcome without additional overhead. This framework unifies and generalizes the prior Direct Coverage Optimization (DCO) method.
summary_en.experiments: The paper instantiates CAT loss functions for common test-time strategies like Pass@N and Majority Vote under both SFT and RL paradigms. Empirical evidence shows that CAT broadly improves performance under test-time scaling, extending successfully not only to LLMs but also to Protein Language Models (PLMs).
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the Method section for the theoretical derivation of formalizing inference strategies as operators, and the specific instantiations of CAT in SFT and RL. Pay attention to the performance gains of CAT under different test-time strategies in the experiments, especially the comparison with standard training methods.

recommendation.zh: 训练与测试对齐的思路可复用至预训练目标设计，重点看§3损失函数推导部分即可。
recommendation.en: The training-test alignment idea can be reused for pretraining objective design, focus on §3 loss derivation.

paper.title: One Refiner to Unlock Them All: Inference-Time Reasoning Elicitation via Reinforcement Query Refinement
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) often fail to utilize their latent reasoning capabilities due to a distributional mismatch between ambiguous human inquiries and the structured logic required for machine activation. Existing alignment methods either incur prohibitive $O(N)$ costs by fine-tuning each model individually or rely on static prompts that fail to resolve query-level structural complexity. In this paper, we propose ReQueR (\textbf{Re}inforcement \textbf{Que}ry \textbf{R}efinement), a modula

summary.core_problem: 很多 LLM 的推理能力并非不存在，而是用户原始问题与模型更易激活的结构化推理输入之间存在分布错配；这篇工作试图在推理时自动改写问题来激活能力。
summary.importance: 贡献属于后训练/推理接口设计，而不是预训练本身。新意在于把 query refinement 视为一个可训练的 inference-time alignment 模块，用 RL 训练一个独立 Refiner，而不是对每个底座模型分别微调。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ReQueR：冻结目标 LLM，把它当作环境；训练一个 Refiner policy，把原始查询重写成显式逻辑分解后的版本。为稳定 RL 训练，作者引入 Adaptive Solver Hierarchy，用课程式方式动态匹配环境难度与 Refiner 当前能力。整体上是“前置重写器 + 冻结求解器”的模块化框架。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调相较于逐模型微调的 O(N) 成本，ReQueR 试图用一个可复用 Refiner 适配多个冻结 LLM；但未给出具体模型规模、任务集合、奖励设计和提升幅度。现阶段更像一个值得快速扫方法部分的后训练思路，而不是可直接迁移到预训练结论的证据。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学、上海创新研究院、东南大学和香港中文大学。不是头部实验室技术报告，但选题贴近“post-train 如何激活 latent capability”这一近年常见问题。

summary_en.core_problem: Many LLM reasoning failures may come from a mismatch between raw human queries and the structured inputs that better trigger latent reasoning; this paper tries to fix that by rewriting queries at inference time.
summary_en.importance: The contribution belongs to post-training and inference interface design rather than pretraining. Its novelty is to cast query refinement as a trainable inference-time alignment module, using RL to train a standalone Refiner instead of fine-tuning each base model separately.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ReQueR: keep the target LLM frozen as the environment, and train a Refiner policy that rewrites raw queries into explicit logical decompositions. To stabilize RL, it introduces Adaptive Solver Hierarchy, a curriculum-like mechanism that matches environment difficulty to the Refiner’s evolving capability. The overall design is a modular “front-end rewriter + frozen solver.”
summary_en.experiments: The abstract argues that ReQueR avoids the O(N) cost of per-model fine-tuning by using a reusable Refiner across frozen LLMs, but it does not provide model sizes, task suites, reward details, or exact gains. At this stage it looks more like a method worth skimming than a result that directly updates pretraining beliefs.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Zhejiang University, Shanghai Innovation Institute, Southeast University, and The Chinese University of Hong Kong. This is not a major frontier-lab report, but it touches the increasingly relevant question of how post-training can unlock latent capability.

recommendation.zh: 把它当成“外置 CoT 诱导器”来看就行；若实验真能跨模型复用，会影响 post-train 接口设计，但对 pretrain 的启发目前还偏间接。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an externalized CoT elicitor; if the refiner truly transfers across models, it matters for post-train interfaces, but the pretraining implications are still indirect.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Sparse Personalized Text Generation with Multi-Trajectory Reasoning
paper.abstract: As Large Language Models (LLMs) advance, personalization has become a key mechanism for tailoring outputs to individual user needs. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dense interaction histories, making them ineffective in cold-start scenarios where such data is sparse or unavailable. While external signals (e.g., content of similar users) can offer a potential remedy, leveraging them effectively remains challenging: raw context is often noisy, and existing methods struggle to reason

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM个性化方法依赖稠密用户交互历史，冷启动场景下效果差，外部异构用户信号噪声大难以有效利用
summary.importance: 提出冷启动个性化的双轨迹检索加RL推理框架，属于个性化方法的增量创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出PAT框架，先从风格相似用户提取写作风格线索、从偏好相似用户提取主题上下文，再用RL迭代双推理机制融合两类信息
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验设置，仅说明在冷启动个性化生成任务上效果优于基线方法

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM personalization methods rely on dense user interaction history, perform poorly in cold-start scenarios, heterogeneous external user signals are noisy and hard to leverage
summary_en.importance: Proposes a dual-trajectory retrieval plus RL reasoning framework for cold-start personalization, incremental innovation in personalization methods
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose PAT framework, first retrieve writing style cues from style-similar users and topic context from preference-aligned users, then use RL-based iterative dual-reasoning mechanism to integrate the two types of information
summary_en.experiments: Full experiment setup not disclosed in abstract, only states outperforms baseline methods on cold-start personalization generation tasks

recommendation.zh: LLM个性化冷启动的增量方法，仅看方法部分即可，无通用预训练相关insight
recommendation.en: Incremental method for LLM cold-start personalization, only read method section, no general pretraining insight

paper.title: Prior-Aligned Data Cleaning for Tabular Foundation Models
paper.abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) achieve state-of-the-art zero-shot accuracy on small tabular datasets by meta-learning over synthetic data-generating processes -- making them highly attractive for practitioners who cannot afford large annotated corpora. However, their in-context learning mechanism assumes approximately clean inputs: missing values, outliers, and duplicates in the real-world data create a prior mismatch that degrades both accuracy and confidence calibration simultaneously. Corre

summary.core_problem: 表格基础模型（TFM）的 in-context 机制对“近似干净输入”有隐含先验，真实脏数据（缺失/异常/重复）导致先验失配，从而同时损害准确率与校准；如何用可学习的方式把清洗过程对齐到模型先验。
summary.importance: 把“数据清洗”形式化为“先验对齐”的序列决策问题，并用 RL 学习清洗算子序列；对理解 foundation model 的数据先验、以及把数据处理纳入训练/推理闭环有参考价值，但主要面向 tabular 领域而非通用 LLM 预训练。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 L2C2：将清洗算子（如缺失值处理、异常值处理、去重等）视为动作，RL policy 通过序列化选择算子来最小化“脏输入分布”与 TFM 合成先验之间的分布差距；讨论多种 reward 设计并比较其有效性（摘要仅明确“7 种 reward 中 3 种有效”）。
summary.experiments: 在 10 个 OpenML 表格基准上做 6 组实验；结论包括：不同 reward 设计差异显著，且对准确率与置信度校准有联动影响。摘要未给出具体模型规模、TFM 名称、提升幅度与统计显著性细节。
summary.authors_note: IRD, ESPACE-DEV（Montpellier）

summary_en.core_problem: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) implicitly assume near-clean inputs for in-context learning; real-world missingness/outliers/duplicates create a prior mismatch that hurts both accuracy and calibration. The paper asks how to learn a cleaning procedure that aligns dirty data to the model’s synthetic prior.
summary_en.importance: Recasts data cleaning as “prior alignment” via sequential decision making and uses RL to choose operator sequences. Useful as a lens on model-data prior mismatch, but it is primarily tabular-focused rather than general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: L2C2: treat cleaning operators as actions; learn an RL policy that sequences operators to minimize the distributional gap between dirty inputs and the TFM’s synthetic prior. Compares multiple reward designs (3 out of 7 work per abstract).
summary_en.experiments: Six experiments over ten OpenML datasets. Reports that reward design matters and that accuracy and confidence calibration move together. The abstract does not provide model details, effect sizes, or significance tests.
summary_en.authors_note: IRD, ESPACE-DEV (Montpellier)

recommendation.zh: 把“清洗”讲成“先验失配+序列决策”这点有意思，但实验与度量细节在摘要里不够干净；只建议看 reward 设计与校准联动的结论。
recommendation.en: The “cleaning as prior-mismatch + sequential decision” framing is the only real takeaway; treat results as weak signal unless the reward/metrics and ablations are clean—skim reward design + calibration findings.

paper.title: BitRL: Reinforcement Learning with 1-bit Quantized Language Models for Resource-Constrained Edge Deployment
paper.abstract: The deployment of intelligent reinforcement learning (RL) agents on resource-constrained edge devices remains a fundamental challenge due to the substantial memory, computational, and energy requirements of modern deep learning systems. While large language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful architectures for decision-making agents, their multi-billion parameter scale confines them to cloud-based deployment, raising concerns about latency, privacy, and connectivity dependence.   We introduce

summary.core_problem: 多十亿参数语言模型作为 RL agent 时，内存、算力和能耗限制了边缘设备上的本地学习与推理。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是量化部署框架与资源受限 RL 系统实验：把 1-bit/ternary LLM 架构用于 RL agent，给出内存和能耗收益。它更偏 efficient deployment，不是预训练方法论文。
summary.technical_approach: BitRL 基于 BitNet b1.58 风格的三值权重表示（-1、0、+1），结合优化推理栈来构建 RL agent。论文还声称分析量化误差对策略学习的影响，并在受限资源场景下评估策略性能保留率。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告相对 full-precision baseline 有 10-16 倍内存降低、3-5 倍能效提升，并在多个 benchmark 上保留 85-98% 的任务性能。摘要未说明具体模型规模、RL 环境、训练 token 或硬件设置。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 BRAC University、Missouri State University、Prime University、German University Bangladesh 等。

summary_en.core_problem: Billion-scale language-model agents are hard to deploy on edge devices because of memory, compute, and energy constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an efficient-deployment and quantized-agent paper: it applies 1-bit or ternary language models to RL agents and reports memory and energy savings. It is not a pretraining-method contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: BitRL uses a BitNet b1.58-style ternary weight representation with values {-1, 0, +1}, plus an optimized inference stack for RL agents. The paper also claims a theoretical treatment of quantization effects on policy learning.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports 10-16x memory reduction, 3-5x energy-efficiency gains, and 85-98% task-performance retention against full-precision baselines across benchmarks. It does not specify model scale, environments, token budgets, or hardware details.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with BRAC University, Missouri State University, Prime University, and German University Bangladesh.

recommendation.zh: 只看实验设置和量化误差分析；若 benchmark 太小，这更像 BitNet 迁移到 RL 的工程备查。
recommendation.en: Read only the setup and quantization-error analysis; if the benchmarks are small, treat it as an engineering note on moving BitNet-style models into RL.

paper.title: See Further, Think Deeper: Advancing VLM's Reasoning Ability with Low-level Visual Cues and Reflection
paper.abstract: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have benefited from Reinforcement Learning (RL) for enhanced reasoning. However, existing methods still face critical limitations, including the lack of low-level visual information and effective visual feedback. To address these problems, this paper proposes a unified multimodal interleaved reasoning framework \textbf{ForeSight}, which enables VLMs to \textbf{See Further} with low-level visual cues and \textbf{Think Deeper} with effective visual

summary.core_problem: 这项工作解决的是 VLM 视觉推理中的两个缺口：模型在长推理链里容易忽略边缘、二值图、显著异常等低层视觉线索；同时推理流程多是“看图—推理—作答”的开环过程，缺少基于视觉证据的自我检查和修正。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练的直接贡献有限，更接近 VLM 推理期工具使用和 RL 后训练。但它有一个值得关注的接口问题：多模态模型的推理链不应只承载文本 token，也可以插入由工具生成的视觉中间表征，并让模型学习何时请求这些表征。这个方向对 native multimodal pretraining 有启发，尤其是如何把低层视觉 token、区域证据、反思动作纳入统一序列建模或 RL 训练信号。
summary.technical_approach: ForeSight 将 VLM 推理改成一个多轮、跨模态的过程。第一部分是低层视觉工具集合，用来提供边缘轮廓、二值化图、语义草图等细粒度视觉信息。模型不是固定调用工具，而是通过 RL 学习在推理过程中是否调用、何时调用。第二部分是 mask-based visual feedback。模型先给出初始答案及其对应的框，再把这些框覆盖到原图上，将 masked image 输入回模型，让模型判断原答案是否需要修改。训练信号使用最终答案准确性作为 reward。相比只做区域放大或高层视觉理解工具的 i-MCoT 方法，这里强调低层视觉证据；相比纯文本反思，这里把反思建立在图像扰动后的反馈上。
summary.experiments: 实验基于作者构造的 CG-SalBench，来源于 SalBench，面向显著视觉异常、字符与 grounding 类任务。主要基线是 Qwen2.5-VL-7B。ForeSight-7B 相比该基线 IoU 提升 29.68%，F1 提升 19.27%。这些数字说明收益主要来自更强的定位与细粒度视觉判别能力。给出的内容没有展开具体消融结果，精读时需要确认三类因素的独立贡献：低层工具、RL 决策、mask feedback 反思。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 15–20 分钟。重点看方法部分的工具接口、RL 动作空间、reward 设计，以及 mask feedback 的构造方式。实验部分重点看 CG-SalBench 的任务定义、评价指标和消融表。如果只关心预训练，可快速跳过应用动机，关注它如何把视觉中间结果插入推理链，以及这种监督能否迁移到多模态预训练或 mid-train。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets two gaps in VLM reasoning: long text-only reasoning chains often miss low-level visual evidence such as edges, binarized maps, and salient anomalies; and most VLMs follow an open-loop process where an answer is generated without visual feedback-driven revision.
summary_en.importance: Its direct contribution to foundation-model pretraining is limited; it is closer to VLM tool use and RL post-training. The useful signal for pretraining research is the interface design: a multimodal reasoning trace can include tool-generated visual intermediates, not only text tokens, and the model can learn when to request such evidence. This matters for native multimodal training, especially if low-level visual tokens, region evidence, and reflection actions are later folded into a unified sequence objective or RL objective.
summary_en.technical_approach: ForeSight turns VLM reasoning into a multi-turn interleaved vision-language process. It first adds a set of low-level visual tools that expose fine-grained cues such as edge contours, binarized maps, and semantic sketches. Tool use is not hard-coded; the model is trained with RL to decide whether and when to invoke tools during inference. It then adds mask-based visual feedback. The model produces an initial answer and bounding boxes, masks the corresponding regions in the original image, feeds the masked image back to the VLM, and asks the model to reflect and revise when needed. The final answer accuracy is used as the reward. Compared with i-MCoT systems focused on region zooming or high-level visual tools, this work emphasizes low-level visual evidence. Compared with text-only reflection, the feedback signal is grounded in an image perturbation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are conducted on CG-SalBench, a dataset built from SalBench for character and grounding-style salient visual reasoning. The main baseline is Qwen2.5-VL-7B. ForeSight-7B improves IoU by 29.68% and F1 by 19.27% over the baseline. These gains point to better localization and fine-grained visual discrimination. The provided content does not include detailed ablations, so the key question to verify is how much comes from low-level tools, RL-based tool selection, and mask-based reflection separately.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in about 15–20 minutes. Focus on the method section: tool API, RL action space, reward design, and construction of the masked visual feedback loop. In the experiments, check the CG-SalBench task definition, metrics, and ablation tables. For pretraining-oriented readers, the useful part is not the benchmark itself, but how visual intermediate representations are inserted into the reasoning trajectory and whether that training signal could be moved earlier into multimodal mid-training.

recommendation.zh: 对预训练本身帮助有限，但它把“视觉 grounding 不够”拆成低层线索缺失和反馈闭环缺失两件事；先看方法图和 ablation，别急着信 RL 带来的总分提升。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly decomposes weak visual grounding into missing low-level cues and missing feedback loops; read the method figure and ablations before trusting the RL headline gains.

paper.title: World-R1: Reinforcing 3D Constraints for Text-to-Video Generation
paper.abstract: Recent video foundation models demonstrate impressive visual synthesis but frequently suffer from geometric inconsistencies. While existing methods attempt to inject 3D priors via architectural modifications, they often incur high computational costs and limit scalability. We propose World-R1, a framework that aligns video generation with 3D constraints through reinforcement learning. To facilitate this alignment, we introduce a specialized pure text dataset tailored for world simulation. Utiliz

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的是视频生成模型缺少稳定 3D 几何约束，导致大视角运动、长时序场景里物体形变、消失和时序不一致的问题。
summary.importance: 它对预训练本身不是核心推进，更接近视频生成模型的 post-training / RL 对齐工作。但有两个启发点值得记住。第一，作者把 3D foundation model 和 VLM 作为 reward model，用 RL 而不是改架构去注入几何一致性，这说明生成模型的一部分“世界知识”可以通过后训练被显式唤醒。第二，纯文本 world-simulation 数据集和 decoupled training 的设计，反映出一个重要取舍：几何约束太强会压制动态和多样性，因此 reward 设计和训练节奏比单纯加更多约束更关键。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是用 Flow-GRPO 对 flow matching 视频生成模型做强化学习微调，而不是在推理时加入昂贵的 3D 约束，也不改原模型结构。奖励由两部分组成：一部分来自预训练 3D foundation models，用 reconstruction 和 trajectory alignment 约束刚性几何一致性；另一部分来自 VLM，评估 novel views 或 meta-views 的语义合理性，避免模型只追求几何而牺牲内容可读性。为了在不改架构的情况下控制相机运动，作者把 trajectory prior 隐式注入 latent noise。训练数据方面，他们构造了一个 pure text 数据集，试图把“物理/几何学习”从具体视觉偏置里拆出来。另一个关键设计是 periodic decoupled training：周期性地把几何强化和一般生成训练解耦，缓解 rigid 3D reward 对非刚体动态、视觉多样性的抑制。
summary.experiments: 作者报告在几何一致性相关指标上有明显提升，摘要里给出的数字是 PSNR 分别提升 10.23 dB 和 7.91 dB，同时一般视频生成 benchmark 没有明显退化。正文还提到做了 reconstruction-independent 的 multi-view consistency 指标、数据规模分析、长视频评测、场景复杂度分解，以及与 3D-aware generation 方法的比较。这些实验如果成立，说明 RL 注入 3D 约束并不一定要以明显牺牲视觉质量为代价。不过从基座研究视角看，重点不在具体分数，而在 reward 组成、训练稳定性和 trade-off 是否讲清楚。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和 Preliminaries，理解为什么作者选 Flow-GRPO 而不是监督微调或推理时约束。然后看 reward 设计和 periodic decoupled training 两节，这两处决定方法是否有可迁移性。实验部分优先看几何一致性指标、长视频结果和与 3D-aware baselines 的比较。若只想抓住方法要点，30-40 分钟足够；若要判断它对统一 world model 训练是否有借鉴意义，需要再细看 reward ablation 和 failure cases。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a familiar weakness of video generation models: they produce visually plausible clips but often fail to maintain stable 3D geometry under large camera motion or long temporal horizons, leading to object distortion, disappearance, and temporal inconsistency.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper; it is closer to post-training or RL alignment for video generators. Still, it offers two useful lessons. First, geometric consistency can be injected through reward design rather than architecture changes, using pretrained 3D models and VLMs as critics. That suggests some world-modeling capability is already latent in large video models and can be elicited after pretraining. Second, the paper makes the trade-off explicit: overly rigid 3D constraints can suppress dynamics and diversity, so the training schedule and reward composition matter as much as the constraint itself.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method fine-tunes a flow-matching video generator with Flow-GRPO instead of adding expensive 3D constraints at inference time or redesigning the backbone. The reward has two parts. One comes from pretrained 3D foundation models and enforces rigid geometric consistency through reconstruction and trajectory alignment. The other comes from VLMs, which score the semantic plausibility of rendered novel views or meta-views so that the model does not optimize geometry at the expense of content coherence. To control camera motion without modifying the architecture, the trajectory prior is injected implicitly into the latent noise. The training data is a synthetic pure-text dataset intended to separate physical or geometric learning from visual dataset bias. A key additional design is periodic decoupled training, which alternates or separates geometry-focused RL from general generation training to avoid over-constraining non-rigid motion and visual diversity.
summary_en.experiments: The headline result is a substantial gain on geometry-related metrics, with the abstract reporting PSNR improvements of 10.23 dB and 7.91 dB, while preserving strong performance on general video-generation benchmarks. The paper also mentions a reconstruction-independent multi-view consistency metric, dataset-scaling analysis, long-video evaluation, scene-complexity breakdowns, and comparisons against 3D-aware generation baselines. If those results hold under close reading, the main takeaway is that RL-based geometric alignment does not necessarily require a large sacrifice in visual quality. For foundation-model readers, the more important question is whether the reward decomposition, optimization stability, and diversity-consistency trade-off are convincingly analyzed.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim should start with the Introduction and the Flow-GRPO preliminaries to understand why the authors chose RL rather than supervised finetuning or inference-time constraints. Then focus on the reward design and the periodic decoupled training section, since those are the transferable parts of the method. In the experiments, prioritize geometry-consistency metrics, long-video results, and comparisons with 3D-aware baselines. Around 30 to 40 minutes is enough to extract the main idea. If the goal is to judge whether this has implications for unified world-model training, spend extra time on reward ablations and failure cases.

recommendation.zh: RL加跨模态反馈的对齐方案无需修改基座架构，可复用于多模态预训练的约束对齐实验，只读第3章方法部分即可
recommendation.en: The RL + cross-modal feedback alignment pipeline requires no base model modification, can be reused for multimodal pretraining constraint alignment experiments, only read §3 methods section.

paper.title: POCA: Pareto-Optimal Curriculum Alignment for Visual Text Generation
paper.abstract: Current visual text generation models struggle with the trade-off between text accuracy and overall image coherence. We find that achieving high text accuracy can reduce aesthetic quality and instruction-following capability. Although reinforcement learning approaches can alleviate the problem through aligning with multiple rewards, they are often unstable for text generation, as existing approaches normally optimize multiple rewards in a weighted-sum way. In addition, it is difficult to balance

summary.core_problem: 解决视觉文字生成中“文字准确率”和“整体图像质量/指令跟随”之间的多目标对齐冲突。
summary.importance: 贡献是多模态生成模型的后训练/对齐方法，重点在多 reward 优化和 prompt curriculum；对 LLM 预训练研究的价值主要是观察 reward 权重、训练稳定性和数据选择如何影响生成模型对齐。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Pareto-Optimal Curriculum Alignment，将文本准确率、图像连贯性、美学质量和指令跟随等目标视为多目标优化问题，通过识别 Pareto-optimal set 避免简单加权和带来的权重敏感性，并用 curriculum 选择训练 prompts 以提升训练效率。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、训练数据量、baseline 名称或具体提升幅度；只说明现有 weighted-sum RL 在视觉文字生成上不稳定，POCA 旨在用较少 prompts 获得更稳的多目标对齐。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Tohoku University 和 Amazon Web Services。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the trade-off between text accuracy and overall image coherence or instruction following in visual text generation.
summary_en.importance: It contributes an alignment method for multimodal generation, centered on multi-reward optimization and prompt curriculum design. For LLM pretraining researchers, the useful signal is about reward interference and data selection rather than base-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach: Pareto-Optimal Curriculum Alignment frames text accuracy, image quality, aesthetics, and instruction following as a multi-objective optimization problem. It identifies Pareto-optimal solutions instead of relying on a fragile weighted reward sum, and uses a curriculum to select prompts efficiently.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes, training data, baselines, or exact gains. It claims that weighted-sum RL is unstable for visual text generation and that POCA aims to improve multi-objective alignment with a more efficient prompt set.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Tohoku University and Amazon Web Services.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座预训练论文；若关心 reward 冲突，只看 Pareto 目标定义和 prompt 选择实验。
recommendation.en: Not a base-pretraining paper; if you care about reward conflict, read only the Pareto objective and prompt-selection experiments.

paper.title: SFT-then-RL Outperforms Mixed-Policy Methods for LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Recent mixed-policy optimization methods for LLM reasoning that interleave or blend supervised and reinforcement learning signals report improvements over the standard SFT-then-RL pipeline. We show that numerous recently published research papers rely on a faulty baseline caused by two distinct bugs: a CPU-offloaded optimizer bug in DeepSpeed that silently drops intermediate micro-batches during gradient accumulation (affecting multiple downstream frameworks including TRL, OpenRLHF and Llama-Fac

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文要解决的不是一个新的推理训练算法，而是一个更基础、也更麻烦的问题：近一批 mixed-policy reasoning 论文声称“监督信号与 RL 信号混合训练”优于传统 SFT-then-RL，但这个结论是否建立在正确基线上。作者通读并复现实验后发现，很多工作共享的 SFT 基线被两个实现层面的 bug 系统性压低了：一个是 DeepSpeed CPU-offloaded optimizer 在梯度累积时静默丢失中间 micro-batch 梯度；另一个是 OpenRLHF 等框架在 loss aggregation 上把 per-mini-batch mean 当成全局 per-token mean，导致不同长度样本权重失真。修复后，标准的先 SFT 再 RL 不但没有落后，反而整体优于这些 mixed-policy 方法。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的分量很重，原因不在于它提出了新算法，而在于它重新校准了 reasoning post-train 领域的经验事实。过去一段时间，很多人把 mixed-policy 的收益理解为训练范式进步；这篇论文说明，其中相当一部分“收益”来自错误实现压低了 SFT 基线。对预训练和后训练接口研究，这个结论很关键：如果 SFT 阶段本身被 bug 弄弱，那么关于 RL 是否需要更复杂混合策略、dense supervision 与 on-policy exploration 如何配比、以及 RL 起点该如何设定的判断都会偏掉。更具体地说，它强化了一个朴素但常被忽略的观点：高质量 SFT 先把策略推到有足够成功率的区域，再做 RLVR，往往比一开始就把 demonstration 和 sparse reward 混在一起更算力经济，也更稳定。贡献类型上，这是一篇“纠偏型”工作，但影响面很大，因为它涉及 DeepSpeed、OpenRLHF、TRL、Llama-Factory、verl 等广泛使用的训练栈。
summary.technical_approach:
技术上分两层。第一层是 bug 定位与验证。作者定位到 DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 1/2 配合 CPU-offloaded Adam 时，梯度累积逻辑有一个分支错误：copy_gradients_to_cpu() 只在 micro_step_id == 0 的路径上执行，导致只有第一个 micro-batch 的梯度被拷到 CPU 侧优化器，后续 micro-batch 虽然在 GPU 上累积了，但不会同步到 CPU，最终 optimizer step 实际只看到了首个 micro-batch。这个 bug 来自 2024 年 9 月的 DeepSpeed PR #6550。修复方式很直接，把梯度拷贝调用移到分支外，让每个 micro-batch 累积后都同步。作者没有停留在代码阅读，而是用两个独立参照系做了交叉验证：OpenRLHF 中不 offload 的 GPU-resident DeepSpeed optimizer，以及 verl 里的 PyTorch FSDP optimizer。修复后，平均 loss 和 gradient norm 与这两个参照实现对齐。

第二层是 loss aggregation bug。标准 SFT 的 cross-entropy 应该按所有有效 response token 的总损失除以总 token 数，也就是全局 per-token mean；但 OpenRLHF、Llama-Factory、早期 verl 会先在每个 mini-batch 内求 mean，再在梯度累积或多卡之间平均这些 mean。由于不同 mini-batch 的有效 token 数不同，这相当于给每个 mini-batch 相同权重，而不是给每个 token 相同权重，长短样本的贡献被扭曲。修复方法是先聚合 token-level loss sum 和 token count，再统一相除。

在这两个 bug 修复后，作者重新实现并比较标准 SFT→RL 与多种 mixed-policy 方法。论文的论证逻辑很清楚：不是抽象地说 sequential 更好，而是说明为什么它在 reasoning 上常更有效。SFT 提供的是 dense、低方差的学习信号，先把格式、领域知识和基本解题轨迹学稳，RL 再在已有成功轨迹附近做策略锐化；而 mixed-policy 在训练早期同时面对 off-policy demonstration 和 on-policy sparse reward，优化目标更杂，且如果初始策略太弱，RL 部分几乎不给有效梯度，算力利用率并不高。作者还给出 truncated RL 结果，说明即便只做很少轮数的 RL，只要 SFT 起点足够强，也能超过很多复杂混合方法。
summary.experiments:
实验部分最关键的是“修 bug 前后基线重排”以及“修复后与 mixed-policy 的直接对比”。论文指出，两类 bug 合起来可让 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 的 SFT 表现最多下降 5.7 分，其中 optimizer bug 是主要来源，loss aggregation bug 贡献较小但稳定。修复后，标准 SFT-then-RL 在 in-distribution 数学任务上超过已发表 mixed-policy 最优结果：Qwen2.5-Math-7B 提升 3.8 分，Llama-3.1-8B 提升 22.2 分，同时在 out-of-distribution benchmark 上保持泛化，没有出现只会刷训练分布的情况。另一个很有信息量的结果是 FLOPs 对比：顺序式 pipeline 即便只做 50 次 RL iteration，而不是完整的 500 次，也已经超过所有 mixed-policy 方法，说明 mixed-policy 的额外复杂度并没有换来更高的样本效率或算力效率。

论文还做了多种验证来证明这不是偶然。包括：修复后的 DeepSpeed offload 版本与 GPU-resident optimizer、FSDP optimizer 在 loss 曲线和梯度范数上对齐；单独修一个 bug 与同时修两个 bug 的效果拆分；不同模型家族上复现，包括 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 和 Llama-3.1-8B；以及 ID/OOD benchmark 的分开报告。若从实验设计质量看，最有说服力的是它没有只给最终分数，而是把训练栈一致性、梯度统计、算力开销和泛化一起摆出来。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇建议精读。第一优先级是 bug 章节，尤其 DeepSpeed CPU offload 梯度累积的代码路径和示意图，弄清楚为什么会“静默丢梯度”，以及为什么这种 bug 很难在常规日志里暴露。第二优先级是 loss aggregation 的公式与例子，这个问题在长短样本混合训练里很常见，不只影响 reasoning SFT。第三优先级是主结果图表：修复前后 SFT、SFT→RL、mixed-policy 的排名变化，以及 FLOPs 对比图。第四优先级是 cross-framework validation 和 ablation，确认作者不是靠某个私有实现把结果做高。阅读时可以带着三个问题看：1）你的训练栈是否也可能踩到同类 bug；2）你过去看到的 mixed-policy 收益有多少可能来自弱基线；3）在自己的任务上，是否应该先把 SFT 做到足够强，再讨论更复杂的 RL 混合。若时间有限，至少看 Introduction、Bugs in Widely-Used SFT Frameworks、主结果表和附录里的 patch 说明。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper does not introduce a new reasoning algorithm. Instead, it asks a more fundamental question: are recent claims that mixed-policy training beats the standard SFT-then-RL pipeline actually based on correct baselines? After reproducing and auditing the training stacks used in several recent works, the authors identify two implementation bugs that systematically depress SFT performance: a DeepSpeed CPU-offloaded optimizer bug that silently drops intermediate micro-batch gradients during gradient accumulation, and a loss aggregation bug in OpenRLHF-style SFT that averages per-mini-batch means instead of computing the true global per-token mean. Once these bugs are fixed, the conventional SFT followed by RL pipeline matches or exceeds the reported mixed-policy methods.
summary_en.importance: This is a high-importance paper because it recalibrates a widely cited empirical conclusion in reasoning post-training. A substantial part of the apparent advantage of mixed-policy methods seems to come from broken SFT baselines rather than a genuinely better training paradigm. That matters directly for the pretrain–posttrain interface: if SFT is artificially weakened, then conclusions about how much RL needs off-policy demonstrations, how to mix dense supervision with sparse rewards, and where RL should start from all become unreliable. The paper reinforces a simple but consequential point: if SFT is implemented correctly and pushed to a strong enough starting policy, RL from verifiable rewards can be both more compute-efficient and more stable than trying to learn demonstrations and on-policy exploration simultaneously. The contribution is corrective rather than algorithmic, but the blast radius is large because the affected stack includes DeepSpeed, OpenRLHF, TRL, Llama-Factory, and earlier verl code paths.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The technical contribution has two layers. First is bug identification and validation. The authors trace a bug in DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 1/2 with CPU-offloaded Adam: during gradient accumulation, copy_gradients_to_cpu() is executed only in the branch where micro_step_id == 0. As a result, only the first micro-batch’s gradients are copied to the CPU-side optimizer. Later micro-batches accumulate on GPU but are never transferred, so the optimizer step effectively uses only the first micro-batch instead of the accumulated gradient. The bug was introduced in DeepSpeed PR #6550 in September 2024. The fix is simple—move the gradient copy outside the conditional so it runs after every micro-batch accumulation—but the paper goes beyond code inspection and validates the patch against two independent references: a GPU-resident DeepSpeed optimizer in OpenRLHF and a PyTorch FSDP optimizer in verl. After the fix, loss trajectories and gradient norms align across implementations.

The second layer is the loss aggregation bug. In standard SFT, cross-entropy should be computed as the total loss over all valid response tokens divided by the total number of valid tokens, i.e. a global per-token mean. OpenRLHF, Llama-Factory, and earlier verl versions instead compute local means within each mini-batch and then average those means across gradient accumulation steps or distributed ranks. Because mini-batches contain different numbers of active response tokens, this gives equal weight to each mini-batch rather than each token, distorting the contribution of short and long samples. The correct fix is to aggregate token-level loss sums and token counts first, then divide once globally.

With both bugs corrected, the authors re-run the standard SFT→RL pipeline and compare it against published mixed-policy methods. The conceptual argument is straightforward and well supported: SFT provides dense, low-variance supervision that teaches formatting, domain knowledge, and basic reasoning traces; RL then sharpens the policy around trajectories that already have nontrivial success probability. Mixed-policy training, by contrast, mixes off-policy demonstrations with sparse on-policy rewards from the beginning, which makes optimization noisier and often less compute-efficient when the initial policy is weak. The paper also includes truncated-RL results showing that even a small amount of RL can outperform more elaborate mixed-policy methods if the SFT starting point is strong enough.
summary_en.experiments:
The key experimental story is the reordering of baselines before and after bug fixes, followed by direct comparisons against mixed-policy methods. The two bugs together can reduce SFT performance by as much as 5.7 points on Qwen2.5-Math-7B, with the optimizer bug accounting for most of the drop and the loss aggregation bug adding a smaller but consistent penalty. After fixing them, the standard SFT-then-RL pipeline surpasses the best published mixed-policy result on in-distribution math tasks by +3.8 points for Qwen2.5-Math-7B and by +22.2 points for Llama-3.1-8B, while maintaining generalization on out-of-distribution benchmarks. Another important result is the compute comparison: even a truncated variant with only 50 RL iterations, instead of 500, still beats all mixed-policy methods on the math benchmarks, indicating that the extra complexity of mixed-policy optimization is not buying better sample efficiency or FLOP efficiency.

The paper also includes several validation layers that make the case more convincing. These include alignment of the patched DeepSpeed offload implementation with GPU-resident and FSDP optimizers in both loss curves and gradient norms; ablations that isolate the effect of fixing each bug separately versus both together; replication across model families including Qwen2.5-Math-7B and Llama-3.1-8B; and separate reporting on in-distribution and out-of-distribution benchmarks. Methodologically, the strongest aspect is that the paper does not rely only on final benchmark numbers; it also checks optimizer consistency, gradient statistics, compute cost, and generalization.
summary_en.reading_guide: This one is worth a close read. Start with the bug sections, especially the DeepSpeed CPU-offload gradient accumulation path, and make sure you understand why the bug silently drops gradients and why normal training logs may not reveal it. Then read the loss aggregation discussion carefully; this issue is broader than reasoning SFT and can affect any setup with variable-length responses. After that, inspect the main result figures and tables showing how the ranking of SFT, SFT→RL, and mixed-policy methods changes after the fixes, along with the FLOP comparison. Finally, read the cross-framework validation and ablations to verify that the gains are not tied to a private implementation. A useful reading lens is to ask three questions: could your own training stack contain similar silent bugs; how much of previously reported mixed-policy gains might come from weak baselines; and in your setting, should you first maximize SFT quality before considering more complex RL mixtures? If time is limited, prioritize the introduction, the bug sections, the main result tables, and the appendix patch details.

recommendation.zh: 极其重要的排雷工作！直接推翻了近期关于 SFT/RL 混合训练的诸多结论，做 post-train 的团队必须立刻检查自己的 infra 是否踩了 DeepSpeed/OpenRLHF 的坑。
recommendation.en: Crucial debugging work! Directly overturns many recent conclusions on mixed SFT/RL training; post-train teams must immediately check if their infra is affected by these DeepSpeed/OpenRLHF bugs.

paper.title: Process Supervision of Confidence Margin for Calibrated LLM Reasoning
paper.abstract: Scaling test-time computation with reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a reliable path to improve large language models (LLM) reasoning ability. Yet, outcome-based reward often incentivizes models to be overconfident, leading to hallucinations, unreliable confidence-based control, and unnecessary compute allocation. We introduce Reinforcement Learning with Confidence Margin (\textbf{RLCM}), a calibration-aware RL framework that jointly optimizes correctness and confidence reliability via

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是 reasoning RL 中的置信度失真问题：模型通过 outcome reward 学会提高最终答案正确率，但中间推理过程和最终答案的置信度不可靠，常见表现是错得很自信。这会影响早停、重试、工具调用、人类转交、置信加权投票等依赖 uncertainty 的控制策略。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练接口的启发在于，推理能力训练不能只看最终答案 reward。RLCM 把“置信度是否有可用排序信息”作为过程监督信号引入 RL，避免直接把每个样本的 confidence 拟合到 correctness probability。这个选择比较实际：逐点校准目标噪声大，和提高正确率的 RL 方向容易冲突；相对 margin 信号更弱，但更稳定，也更容易和最终答案优化共存。它更像是给 reasoning policy 增加一个可被下游控制使用的过程状态评分，而不是单纯优化 ECE 之类的后验指标。
summary.technical_approach: 方法是 Reinforcement Learning with Confidence Margin，简称 RLCM。核心不是直接要求置信度等于经验正确率，而是把校准转成同一条 reasoning trajectory 内不同中间状态的排序问题。模型在若干 compute budget 位置截断推理前缀，取截断点的 final-layer hidden state，接一个轻量 confidence probe，估计“从这个前缀结束思考并生成最终答案时答对的概率”。训练目标鼓励正确或更可解的中间状态比错误或更差的中间状态有更高 confidence，并通过 margin reward 拉开差距。最终 RL reward 同时包含答案正确性和中间过程的 confidence margin。与 Brier reward 这类直接 score matching 相比，RLCM 不把每个 prefix 的置信度压到一个绝对数值目标上，而是优化相对区分度；这降低了 calibration loss 和 reasoning accuracy 之间的拉扯。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖数学推理，并扩展到代码、科学问答、逻辑问答等域外任务。提供的全文片段显示，直接使用 Brier reward 调权会形成 accuracy-calibration trade-off，不能稳定地产生 Pareto 改进；这是作者选择 margin-ranking 监督的主要实验证据。RLCM 在保持或提升 reasoning accuracy 的同时改善校准，并进一步改善两个下游控制场景：一是 conformal risk control，用校准后的 confidence 约束目标错误率；二是 confidence-weighted aggregation，用更可靠的中间或样本置信度做加权汇聚。片段中没有给出完整表格数字，因此不应从摘要外推具体提升幅度。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分 3.1–3.3：3.1 解释为什么直接校准 reward 不稳定，3.2 说明 confidence probe 如何从中间 hidden state 估计 prefix solvability，3.3 是 margin process reward 和最终答案 reward 的组合方式。图 3 值得看，它展示 Brier reward 权重导致的正确率和校准权衡。实验部分优先看数学任务主结果、域外迁移结果，以及 conformal risk control / confidence-weighted aggregation 两个下游使用场景。需要特别留意 probe 的训练目标、截断预算的选择、以及 margin reward 是否依赖额外 rollout 成本。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses miscalibrated confidence in reasoning RL. Outcome-only rewards can improve final-answer accuracy, but they do not teach the model how confidence should evolve during the reasoning process. The result is a model that can be confidently wrong, which weakens early stopping, retry policies, tool invocation, human deferral, and confidence-weighted aggregation.
summary_en.importance: The useful signal for pretraining and post-training research is the objective design. RLCM treats confidence as a process-level control signal rather than a final-answer annotation. It avoids pointwise confidence matching, which is noisy and can conflict with accuracy-driven RL, and instead optimizes a relative margin between better and worse intermediate reasoning states. This is a practical way to add uncertainty supervision without turning calibration into a brittle auxiliary loss.
summary_en.technical_approach: RLCM attaches a lightweight confidence probe to intermediate reasoning states. For a sampled trajectory, the method selects several compute-budget truncation points, extracts the final-layer hidden state at each truncated prefix, and estimates how likely that prefix is to lead to a correct final answer when thinking is stopped and an answer is generated. The RL reward combines final-answer correctness with a margin-based process reward: prefixes associated with correct or more solvable continuations should receive higher confidence than incorrect or less solvable prefixes within the same trajectory. This differs from Brier-style score matching, which tries to force confidence to match an absolute correctness probability at each point and can interfere with the main reasoning objective.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation spans mathematical reasoning and out-of-domain tasks including coding, science QA, and logic QA. The provided content highlights an important ablation: varying a direct Brier reward weight moves the model along an accuracy-calibration trade-off and does not yield a stable Pareto improvement. RLCM is reported to improve calibration while preserving or improving reasoning accuracy. The gains also transfer to decision-making settings, including conformal risk control with target error guarantees and confidence-weighted aggregation. The supplied text does not include the full numerical tables, so exact percentage gains should not be inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20–30 minutes. Focus on Sections 3.1–3.3: the motivation against direct score matching, the probe-based confidence estimator, and the margin process reward. Figure 3 is important because it motivates the move from absolute calibration targets to relative margin supervision. In the experiments, prioritize the main math results, out-of-domain transfer, and the two downstream control studies. Check the cost of constructing prefix targets, the choice of truncation budgets, and whether the probe remains reliable under distribution shift.

recommendation.zh: 不是预训练论文，但 reward 设计把置信度推歪这件事很实在；先看方法定义和 calibration 图，若曲线干净，值得拿去审视内部 RL recipe。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the claim that RL reward design systematically warps confidence is worth checking; read the method and calibration plots first, and use it to audit your internal RL recipe if the setup is clean.

paper.title: Beyond Chain-of-Thought: Rewrite as a Universal Interface for Generative Multimodal Embeddings
paper.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have emerged as a promising foundation for universal multimodal embeddings. Recent studies have shown that reasoning-driven generative multimodal embeddings can outperform discriminative embeddings on several embedding tasks. However, Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning tends to generate redundant thinking steps and introduce semantic ambiguity in the summarized answers in broader retrieval scenarios. To address this limitation, we propose Rewrite-driven Mul

summary.core_problem: 这项工作要解决的是生成式多模态 embedding 中 CoT 接口与检索目标不匹配的问题。CoT 会生成较长的中间推理，但通用检索通常不需要唯一答案；检索目标可能是多粒度、多候选、跨模态的，CoT 最后的总结答案反而会把语义压窄。与此同时，联合训练自回归生成和对比学习容易互相干扰；把推理器和 embedding 编码器拆开又会带来参数和部署成本。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在训练接口设计，而不只是换一个 retrieval prompt。RIME 把“生成推理链”改成“生成检索友好的 rewrite”，让 MLLM 的生成能力服务于表示学习，而不是把 CoT 原样接到 embedding 任务上。对预训练研究的启发在于：生成目标可以被设计成表示学习的中间语义规范；判别 embedding 可以作为稳定锚点来约束生成式 embedding；RL 的奖励也可以来自 embedding 空间中的可验证间隔，而不是只依赖文本答案正确性。它更接近 multimodal representation mid-training / post-training 的方法研究，对通用多模态 embedding 模型有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 方法包含三个核心部分。第一是 Rewrite-Driven Joint SFT。模型不生成 CoT 和最终答案，而是对不同模态做结构化重写：图像、视频、文档被 recaption，文本被进一步解释。重写结果保留检索相关的实体、属性、关系和上下文，但避免给出单一结论。这样做的取舍很明确：CoT 强调解题过程，rewrite 强调可检索语义的展开，更适合开放检索。第二是 Cross-Mode Alignment，简称 CMA。它用互相对比学习把同一样本的判别式 embedding 和生成式 embedding 拉近，把负样本拉开，使两套 embedding 空间可以互相检索。这样在低延迟场景下可以先用判别 embedding，在需要更强语义展开时再用生成式 embedding。第三是 Refine-RL。方法把判别 embedding 当作稳定语义锚点，用生成式 embedding 相比判别式 embedding 是否产生更大的正负样本相似度间隔作为过程奖励，鼓励 rewrite 产生更有区分度的语义补充。它和常见 verifiable reward 的区别是，奖励不来自最终文本答案，而来自表示空间的检索间隔。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 MMEB-V2、UVRB 和 MRMR 等多模态检索 benchmark。给出的核心结果是：相比已有 CoT 型生成式 embedding 方法，RIME 将 thinking process 约减少 50%，同时在 MMEB-V2 上明显优于现有生成式 embedding 模型，并在 UVRB、MRMR 上保持优势。消融重点应关注三类对比：只做判别 embedding、CoT 生成式 embedding、rewrite 生成式 embedding；是否加入 CMA；是否加入 Refine-RL。全文提供的信息表明，CMA 的作用不是简单提升一个分数，而是让判别空间和生成空间可以交叉使用；Refine-RL 的收益来自把 rewrite 从“描述更长”推向“检索间隔更好”。具体表格数值需要以正文实验表为准，给定材料中没有完整列出参数量、训练数据规模和各 benchmark 的逐项分数。
summary.reading_guide: 建议精读 Introduction 中对 CoT 缺陷的拆解，以及 Method 中 Rewrite-Driven Joint SFT、CMA、Refine-RL 三个部分。重点看两类图表：一类是模型结构和训练目标图，判断生成 token、embedding token、对比损失和 RL 奖励之间如何连接；另一类是消融表，尤其是去掉 CMA 或 Refine-RL 后跨空间检索是否退化。还应检查 rewrite 示例，确认它是否真正减少语义歧义，而不是把 CoT 换成更长 caption。值得深挖的问题有两个：第一，rewrite 的监督数据如何构造，是否依赖强模型蒸馏；第二，判别 embedding 作为 anchor 时是否会限制生成式 embedding 学到更细粒度的新语义。

summary_en.core_problem: The work targets a mismatch between CoT-style generative multimodal embeddings and open-ended retrieval. CoT produces long reasoning traces and often ends with a single summarized answer, while retrieval targets are frequently multi-granular, non-unique, and cross-modal. The final answer can narrow the semantics that the embedding should preserve. There is also a training conflict: autoregressive generation and contrastive embedding learning do not always optimize compatible behaviors. Decoupled think-then-embed systems reduce this conflict but add parameters and serving cost.
summary_en.importance: The main contribution is an interface change for training multimodal embeddings. RIME replaces reasoning traces with retrieval-oriented rewriting, using generation to expose useful semantic content rather than to solve for a single answer. For foundation-model training, the useful idea is that a generative objective can act as a semantic normalizer for representation learning. A discriminative embedding can serve as a stable anchor, and reinforcement learning can use verifiable similarity margins in the embedding space instead of relying only on textual answer correctness. This is most relevant to multimodal representation mid-training and embedding-oriented post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method has three parts. First, Rewrite-Driven Joint SFT trains the model to generate structured rewrites rather than CoT plus an answer. Images, videos, and visual documents are recaptioned; text queries are elaborated. The rewrite keeps retrieval-relevant entities, attributes, relations, and context, but avoids committing to a single summary. This is a better fit for general retrieval than CoT, because retrieval needs semantic coverage and discrimination more than explicit reasoning trajectories. Second, Cross-Mode Alignment aligns discriminative and generative embedding spaces through mutual contrastive learning: embeddings of the same query across the two modes are pulled together, while negatives are separated. This enables cross-retrieval and lets a system trade latency against semantic refinement. Third, Refine-RL uses discriminative embeddings as stable anchors. The process reward is based on whether the generative embedding improves the positive-negative similarity gap over the discriminative embedding. This pushes rewriting toward better retrieval separation, not just longer or more fluent descriptions.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses MMEB-V2, UVRB, and MRMR. The reported headline result is that RIME reduces the thinking process by roughly 50% compared with prior CoT-based generative embedding methods, while outperforming existing generative embedding models on MMEB-V2 and showing gains on UVRB and MRMR. The important ablations are expected to compare discriminative-only embeddings, CoT-based generative embeddings, and rewrite-based generative embeddings; remove CMA; and remove Refine-RL. The supplied content indicates that CMA matters because it makes the two embedding spaces mutually usable, and Refine-RL matters because it optimizes retrieval margins rather than text-form answers. Exact per-benchmark scores, model sizes, and data sizes are not fully available in the provided material.
summary_en.reading_guide: Read the introduction carefully for the failure analysis of CoT in retrieval. Then focus on the method sections for Rewrite-Driven Joint SFT, Cross-Mode Alignment, and Refine-RL. The most useful figures and tables are the training-objective diagram, the cross-space retrieval setup, and the ablation tables. Example rewrites are also important: they show whether the method actually reduces target ambiguity or merely replaces CoT with a longer caption. Two details deserve close inspection: how rewrite supervision is produced, and whether using discriminative embeddings as anchors constrains the generative embedding from learning finer-grained semantics.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是预训练主线，但它认真碰了“生成式监督如何变成稳定表示”这个老问题；先看 rewrite 接口和 Refine-RL，若 ablation 干净，值得迁到 unified LM 表示学习里试。
recommendation.en: Not core pretraining, but it seriously tackles the old problem of turning generative supervision into stable representations; read the rewrite interface and Refine-RL first, and port it to unified LM representation learning if the ablations are clean.

paper.title: Learning Evidence Highlighting for Frozen LLMs
paper.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason well, yet often miss decisive evidence when it is buried in long, noisy contexts. We introduce HiLight, an Evidence Emphasis framework that decouples evidence selection from reasoning for frozen LLM solvers. HiLight avoids compressing or rewriting the input, which can discard or distort evidence, by training a lightweight Emphasis Actor to insert minimal highlight tags around pivotal spans in the unaltered context. A frozen Solver then performs downstream

summary.core_problem: 核心问题是：冻结的 LLM 在长上下文、强噪声场景下经常“看不见”关键证据（lost-in-the-middle、被干扰项淹没），导致推理/决策失败；在不改动 Solver、也不压缩/改写原文的前提下，能否学习一个轻量模块把证据显式凸显出来，从而稳定提升下游表现，并且能跨 Solver 迁移。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练是间接贡献，但对“长上下文利用率”这个长期痛点给了一个工程上可落地、且与模型权重解耦的思路：把 evidence selection 从 reasoning 中拆出来，用输入侧的结构化标记（highlight tags）作为控制接口，并用弱监督 RL 只靠任务 reward 学出来。对做长上下文训练/检索增强/agent 轨迹压缩的人，价值在于：它证明了‘不改写、不裁剪’也能通过极小的输入干预显著改善证据利用；同时提供了一个可解释的中间产物（高亮片段）用于诊断。
summary.technical_approach:
HiLight 是 Actor–Solver 两段式：
- Solver：冻结的 LLM，只负责在给定“被强调的原始上下文”上完成任务（QA/分类/推荐等）。
- Emphasis Actor：轻量策略模型，输入 (Q, X) 后输出一组 span 选择与标记动作，在不改变原文 token 序列内容的情况下插入最小化的 highlight tags（结构标记），把关键证据包起来。
关键取舍：
1) 不做 summarization/rewriting：避免压缩导致证据丢失或语义漂移，也避免引入额外幻觉；同时保留全文让 Solver 在需要时仍可利用未高亮部分。
2) 不做 hard pruning：作者明确做了消融，直接只喂 Actor 选中的片段（裁剪）不如“全文+高亮”，说明收益不仅来自过滤噪声，还来自注意力/归因被显式引导。
3) 学习方式是弱监督 RL：没有 token-level evidence 标注，只用 Solver 的任务 reward 作为回报来训练 Actor（把 highlighting 视为决策过程）。这使得方法对 API/闭源 Solver 也可用：不需要梯度、不需要中间激活。
4) 可迁移性：Actor 学到的是输入侧的‘证据凸显策略’，理论上比 prompt-tuning 更不绑定某个 Solver 的内部表征；论文用跨模型/跨规模实验验证零样本迁移。
从实现上看，Actor 的 action space 需要受预算约束（highlight budget），并且要处理离散 span 选择的 credit assignment；论文强调对 marker 格式与预算范围的鲁棒性分析。
summary.experiments:
论文在多任务上评估：顺序推荐（如 Amazon-Beauty 等高噪声用户历史）、多跳 QA、阅读理解、以及生物医学 QA 分类（如 PubMedQA）。对比对象包括多种 prompt 优化/自动 prompt 搜索基线。
关键结果（文中给出的明确数字）：在 Amazon-Beauty 这类 sparse-signal/high-distractor 场景，HR@10 相对强基线最高提升约 27%。在证据更集中、瓶颈更偏复杂推理的任务（如 PubMedQA）提升更小但仍一致。
关键消融与分析点：
- Pruning 消融：只给 Solver Actor 选中片段 < 全文+高亮，支持“强调而非删减”的设计。
- 预算与 marker 形式敏感性：在较宽的高亮预算范围与多种标记格式下表现稳定。
- 跨 Solver 迁移：用一个 Solver 训练的 Actor 可零样本迁移到未见过的不同家族/不同规模 Solver（包含 API-based Solver）。
- 与人工证据对齐：在无证据监督下，高亮 span 与人标证据的对齐可达 F1=0.78（文中给出的上限数字）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 35–50 分钟）：
- 先看 Figure 1 和 Problem Formulation：弄清 Actor 的输出形式（span+tag）、预算约束、以及 reward 只来自 Solver 的设定。
- 重点看“为什么不裁剪/不改写”的实证：pruning 消融与保持全文的对比，是这篇方法成立的关键证据。
- 看跨 Solver transfer 的实验表：它决定了 HiLight 是“某个模型的 prompt trick”还是更通用的 evidence policy。
- 最后看对齐分析（human evidence F1）与 marker/budget 鲁棒性：这两块决定可解释性与可部署性。
如果只想抓住要点：读 Introduction 的动机 + Table 2（主结果）+ pruning/transfer 两组消融即可。

summary_en.core_problem: Frozen LLMs often fail to utilize decisive evidence in long, noisy contexts (e.g., lost-in-the-middle, distractor dilution). The paper asks whether we can learn a lightweight, solver-agnostic module that explicitly emphasizes pivotal spans—without rewriting or compressing the input and without modifying the solver—to improve downstream reasoning and decision making, with transfer across different solvers.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining contribution per se, but it targets a core bottleneck that pretraining alone hasn’t solved: reliable context utilization under low signal-to-noise. The key practical idea is to decouple evidence selection from reasoning via input-side structural markup learned with weak supervision. For long-context training, RAG pipelines, and agent traces, it offers an interpretable control surface (highlighted spans) and a way to improve performance even when the backbone is frozen or API-only.
summary_en.technical_approach:
HiLight is an Actor–Solver pipeline.
- Solver: a frozen LLM that performs the task on an emphasized version of the original context.
- Emphasis Actor: a lightweight policy that inserts minimal highlight tags around selected spans while preserving the raw context (no summarization, no rewriting).
Core design choices:
1) Non-destructive emphasis instead of compression/rewriting to avoid evidence loss and semantic drift.
2) Emphasis instead of hard pruning; the full context remains available, and tags act as attention/attribution cues.
3) Weakly supervised RL: the Actor is trained using only the solver’s task reward, with no token-level evidence labels and no access to solver gradients/activations—making it compatible with proprietary/API solvers.
4) Transfer hypothesis: because the Actor learns an input-level evidence policy rather than solver-specific internal features, it should generalize across solver families/scales; the paper validates this empirically.
The method also introduces a highlight budget and studies robustness to marker formats, which matters for stability and deployment.
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on sequential recommendation (including high-distractor datasets like Amazon-Beauty), multi-hop QA, reading comprehension, and biomedical QA classification (e.g., PubMedQA), against strong prompt-optimization and automated prompt-search baselines.
Reported headline numbers include up to ~27% improvement in HR@10 on Amazon-Beauty in sparse-signal/high-noise settings. Gains are smaller but consistent when evidence is less diffuse and the remaining bottleneck is deeper inference (e.g., PubMedQA).
Key analyses:
- Pruning ablation: feeding only Actor-selected spans underperforms keeping the full context with highlight tags, supporting “emphasize, don’t delete.”
- Robustness: stable across a range of highlight budgets and marker formats.
- Cross-solver transfer: an Actor trained with one solver transfers zero-shot to unseen solvers across families/scales, including an API-based solver.
- Evidence alignment: despite no evidence supervision, highlighted spans match human-annotated evidence up to F1=0.78.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (35–50 minutes):
- Start with Figure 1 and the formal problem setup to understand the action space (span tagging), budget constraints, and reward source.
- Prioritize the pruning-vs-full-context ablation; it is the main empirical justification for the non-destructive design.
- Read the cross-solver transfer table/section to judge whether this is solver-agnostic or a solver-specific prompt hack.
- Then check robustness (budget/marker) and human-evidence alignment for interpretability and deployment confidence.
If time is limited: Introduction + main results table (Table 2) + pruning and transfer analyses are sufficient.

recommendation.zh: 读 §方法和主表即可；它把“找证据”做成可迁移的轻量 policy，比改 prompt 更像可复用模块。
recommendation.en: Read the method and main table; turning evidence finding into a transferable lightweight policy is more reusable than prompt tinkering.

paper.title: CharTide: Data-Centric Chart-to-Code Generation via Tri-Perspective Tuning and Inquiry-Driven Evolution
paper.abstract: Chart-to-code generation demands strict visual precision and syntactic correctness from Vision-Language Models (VLMs). However, existing approaches are fundamentally constrained by data-centric limitations: despite the availability of growing chart-to-code datasets, simply scaling homogeneous chart-code pairs conflates visual perception with program logic, preventing models from fully leveraging the richness of multimodal supervision. We present CharTide, a novel data-centric framework that syst

summary.core_problem: 解决chart-to-code任务中，现有VLM训练数据把视觉感知与代码逻辑混在一起，导致模型难以同时学好图表理解、程序结构和跨模态对齐的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献主要在数据设计与后训练接口，而不是新基座架构。它有两点值得看：一是把训练数据拆成视觉、纯文本代码、模态融合三路，二是把对齐从启发式打分改成可验证的询问式RL，这对“如何构造训练信号”有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出CharTide数据中心框架。先用Tri-Perspective Tuning构建200万样本数据，将训练显式分为视觉感知、纯文本代码逻辑和视觉-代码融合三种视角；再提出Inquiry-Driven RL，把对齐视为数据验证问题，通过询问和核验生成结果来提供更可靠的奖励信号，而不是依赖粗糙的启发式评分。
summary.experiments: 摘要称使用2M样本训练，7B模型仅靠监督训练就超过专门基线；随后再用Inquiry-Driven RL进一步提升。任务是chart-to-code生成，评价应同时覆盖视觉精度与代码可执行/语法正确性。没有看到能直接外推到通用LLM预训练的clean scaling或架构结论，因此更适合作为数据与训练信号设计案例阅读。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学、Shopee、华东师范大学、南京理工大学、中南大学等。Alex Jinpeng Wang在多模态与医疗AI方向较活跃，但这篇工作更像面向图表代码生成的数据与对齐工程。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets chart-to-code generation, arguing that existing VLM training data entangles visual perception and code logic, which prevents models from learning both reliably.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is in data design and post-training signal design rather than a new foundation architecture. Two parts are relevant: decomposing training data into visual, pure-code, and fusion streams, and reframing alignment as verifiable inquiry-driven RL instead of heuristic scoring.
summary_en.technical_approach: CharTide is a data-centric framework. It first builds a 2M-sample dataset with Tri-Perspective Tuning, explicitly separating visual perception, text-only code logic, and multimodal fusion supervision. It then introduces Inquiry-Driven RL, where alignment is treated as a data-verification problem through question-and-check style reward construction rather than heuristic reward proxies.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract claims that a 7B model trained on the 2M dataset surpasses specialized baselines using supervised training alone, and improves further with inquiry-driven RL. The task evaluates both visual fidelity and code correctness. However, the paper does not appear to offer clean scaling or architectural conclusions that transfer directly to general LLM pretraining.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Nanjing University, Shopee, East China Normal University, Nanjing University of Science and Technology, and Central South University. Alex Jinpeng Wang is known in multimodal and medical AI, but this work is primarily a data-and-alignment engineering effort for chart-to-code generation.

recommendation.zh: 不是基座论文，但“把监督拆成感知/逻辑/融合三路”这个数据配方值得借鉴；只看数据构造和RL奖励定义，别被任务指标带跑。
recommendation.en: Not a foundation-model paper, but the split of supervision into perception/logic/fusion is a useful recipe; read the data design and reward construction, not the task leaderboard.

institutions: Nanjing University of Science and Technology

paper.title: SOLAR-RL: Semi-Online Long-horizon Assignment Reinforcement Learning
paper.abstract: As Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) mature, GUI agents are evolving from static interactions to complex navigation. While Reinforcement Learning (RL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for training MLLM agents on dynamic GUI tasks, its effective application faces a dilemma. Standard Offline RL often relies on static step-level data, neglecting global trajectory semantics such as task completion and execution quality. Conversely, Online RL captures the long-term dynamics but suffers from

summary.core_problem: 解决GUI Agent训练中Offline RL缺失全局轨迹语义、Online RL交互成本高且环境不稳定的两难问题
summary.importance: 属于通用Agent训练方法创新，提出半在线长程分配强化学习框架
summary.technical_approach: 从静态交互数据重构多样化推演候选，检测轨迹首个失败点，回溯分配稠密步级奖励，将全局轨迹语义融入离线训练过程
summary.experiments: 面向GUI交互任务场景，未公开具体训练模型规模
summary.authors_note: 机构包括vivo AI Lab、浙江实验室、CUHK MMLab、湖北大学，无知名作者

summary_en.core_problem: Solve the dilemma that offline RL for GUI agent training lacks global trajectory semantics, while online RL suffers from high interaction cost and environment instability
summary_en.importance: General agent training method innovation, proposes SOLAR-RL semi-online long-horizon RL framework
summary_en.technical_approach: Reconstruct diverse rollout candidates from static data, detect first failure point of trajectories, retroactively assign dense step-wise rewards, integrate global trajectory semantics into offline learning process
summary_en.experiments: Targets GUI interaction task scenarios, no specific model scale disclosed
summary_en.authors_note: Institutions include vivo AI Lab, Zhejiang Lab, CUHK MMLab, Hubei University, no well-known authors

recommendation.zh: GUI Agent强化学习训练的增量改进，对预训练研究员仅做领域备查即可，无需深读
recommendation.en: Incremental improvement on GUI agent RL training, only for domain reference for pretraining researchers, no in-depth reading needed

paper.title: Foveated Reasoning: Stateful, Action-based Visual Focusing for Vision-Language Models
paper.abstract: Vision-language models benefit from high-resolution images, but the increase in visual-token count incurs high compute overhead. Humans resolve this tension via foveation: a coarse view guides "where to look", while selectively acquired high-acuity evidence refines "what to think". We introduce Foveated Reasoner, an autoregressive vision-language framework that unifies foveation and reasoning within a single decoding trajectory. Starting from a low-resolution view, the model triggers foveation o

summary.core_problem: VLM 需要高分辨率才能看清细节，但视觉 token 数随分辨率上升导致注意力计算爆炸。现有“视觉聚焦/放大”方法要么多次跑模型（multi-pass，状态被打断、成本高），要么用文本坐标/工具调用表达注视点（token 开销大、格式脆弱）。论文要解决的是：能否把“决定看哪里”和“基于看到的证据推理”放进同一条自回归解码轨迹里，用非语言动作完成 stateful 的证据获取。
summary.importance:
对预训练研究的相关性偏间接，但对多模态基座的训练范式有启发：
- 把“视觉证据获取”显式建模为动作序列（policy），并与文本生成共享同一隐藏状态，这更接近可微/可学习的感知-推理闭环，而不是外部多轮调用。
- 两阶段训练（coldstart 监督 + RL）提供了一种把离散动作（选区域、取高分辨率 crop）纳入训练的工程路径，和当前 VLM 的 tool-use / agentic perception 有接口。
如果你的关注点是纯预训练目标与数据配比，这篇更像架构/训练流程的参考；如果做原生多模态、长上下文视觉 token 成本控制，它更实用。
summary.technical_approach:
Foveated Reasoner（FoveateR）的核心是“单次、自回归、状态连续”的 foveation：
1) 输入从低分辨率全局视图开始，先用少量视觉 token 建立粗理解。
2) 在生成过程中，模型可以触发一个非语言的 foveation action（类似眼跳），选择若干区域去请求高分辨率证据。
3) 系统从原图裁剪/提取对应高分辨率 patch，并把这些高分辨率视觉 token 注入回同一条解码轨迹（不重启模型、不重新跑一遍完整 forward），从而保持隐藏状态连续。

对比已有两类方法：
- multi-pass：每次 zoom 都要重新跑一遍 VLM，推理状态被重置；
- text-grounded：用坐标字符串/特殊 token 表达区域，既占 token 又容易格式错。
FoveateR 把“看哪里”从文本通道移到动作通道，减少 token 负担，也避免坐标解析脆弱性。

训练：两阶段。
- coldstart：用监督信号先教会模型基本的 foveation 行为（论文强调不需要人工标注的 foveation 轨迹，通常意味着用启发式/自动生成的区域监督或从任务信号反推）。
- RL：再用强化学习联合优化“何时 zoom、zoom 哪、回答质量”，把证据获取策略和最终任务回报绑定。
summary.experiments:
论文宣称在多个基准上优于近期视觉聚焦方法，并验证：
- 在相近或更低的视觉 token/计算预算下，细粒度视觉任务准确率更高；
- 单轨迹 stateful 机制减少多次解码 pass 的开销；
- 相比文本坐标方案，输出更稳健（不依赖严格格式）。

你给的全文片段未包含实验表格与具体数字（分辨率设置、foveation 步数、token/latency 节省、各 benchmark 提升幅度）。要做可复现的量化总结需要补齐实验章节。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（30–45 分钟）：
1) 先看方法图（通常是 Figure 1/框架图）：确认“动作触发→取高分辨率证据→注入同一解码轨迹”的数据流，理解它为何不是 multi-pass。
2) 精读训练部分：coldstart 的监督信号怎么来、RL 的 action space/奖励怎么定义、是否有约束避免无意义频繁 zoom。
3) 看效率-精度曲线：同等计算预算下的提升是否来自更高分辨率 token，还是来自更好的策略。
4) 看消融：去掉 stateful 注入、改成文本坐标、改成多 pass，性能/成本如何变化。

summary_en.core_problem: High-resolution images improve VLM accuracy but explode visual-token count and attention cost. Existing visual focusing either (a) runs the model multiple times on crops (expensive and breaks reasoning continuity) or (b) encodes focus as text coordinates/tool calls (token overhead and brittle formatting). The paper aims to implement foveation as a stateful, non-linguistic action process within a single autoregressive decoding trajectory.
summary_en.importance: This is not a tokenizer/scaling-law paper, but it matters for multimodal foundation-model training as an example of making perception an explicit, learnable action policy that shares hidden state with language generation. The two-stage recipe (coldstart supervision + RL) is a practical pathway to train discrete evidence-acquisition behaviors without hand-labeled foveation trajectories, aligning with broader trends in agentic perception and tool-augmented multimodal models.
summary_en.technical_approach:
Foveated Reasoner (FoveateR) integrates focusing and reasoning in one continuous AR rollout:
1) Start from a low-res global view to keep initial visual tokens cheap.
2) During decoding, the model can emit a foveation action (non-text) that selects regions to inspect.
3) The system retrieves high-res evidence (crops/patches) from the original image and injects the resulting visual tokens back into the same decoding trajectory, preserving hidden-state continuity (no restart, no separate pass).

This avoids multi-pass recomputation and avoids text-based coordinate serialization.

Training is two-stage:
- Coldstart: supervised bootstrapping of foveation behavior (the paper claims no human-annotated foveation trajectories, implying heuristic/auto-derived supervision).
- Reinforcement learning: jointly optimize the foveation policy (when/where to zoom) and final answer quality via task reward, tying evidence acquisition to downstream success.
summary_en.experiments:
The paper reports improvements over recent visual focusing baselines across multiple benchmarks, emphasizing better accuracy under constrained compute/visual-token budgets, reduced overhead versus multi-pass approaches, and robustness versus text-coordinate methods.

The provided excerpt does not include the quantitative tables (resolutions, number of foveation steps, token/latency savings, benchmark deltas). Exact numbers require the experiments section.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 min):
1) Start with the system diagram to verify the “action → high-res retrieval → same-trajectory injection” mechanism.
2) Read the training section carefully: action space, reward design, and how coldstart supervision is generated.
3) Check accuracy–compute curves to see whether gains hold at matched budgets.
4) Review ablations that replace stateful injection with multi-pass or text coordinates to isolate what actually drives improvements.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“把视觉取证动作并入解码轨迹”这个接口设计，不一定改变预训练范式，但若你在做 native multimodal 或 test-time compute，先看 RL 目标和 token-budget 曲线。
recommendation.en: What matters is the interface: visual evidence acquisition is folded into the decoding trajectory. It likely won't change pretraining priors by itself, but if you work on native multimodal models or test-time compute allocation, inspect the RL objective and token-budget curves first.
